jobs.title: Research Intern, Robotics - 2027
jobs.description:
NVIDIA Research is seeking research interns in Singapore to advance fundamental and applied robotics research, with a particular focus on agentic robotics.
We are interested in exploring how AI agents can autonomously develop, refine, and generalize robotic capabilities by integrating reasoning, programming, experimentation, and feedback within the full robot systems stack. Our research spans robot learning, planning, simulation, perception, and control, with an emphasis on building intelligent systems that can generalize over tasks, environments, and embodiments.
We are looking for interns with strong research and engineering skills, intellectual curiosity, and a collaborative mindset. You will have the opportunity to formulate and pursue ambitious research questions, develop novel algorithms and systems, and validate your ideas through rigorous experimentation. Research projects will be aligned with your expertise and the team's priorities, with opportunities to contribute to scientific publications and practical robotic systems.

What you will be doing
* Conduct research on novel models, algorithms, and systems for agentic robotics.
* Investigate how AI agents can autonomously develop, evaluate, and improve robotic programs and capabilities.
* Explore research directions at the intersection of foundation models, robot learning, planning, and programming.
* Develop and evaluate methods for robotic skill acquisition, adaptation, and generalization.
* Design and conduct experiments in simulation and, where appropriate, on physical robots.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineers across robotics and AI, and communicate research outcomes through publications, demonstrations, open-source contributions, and presentation.

What we need to see
* Currently pursuing a PhD in robotics, artificial intelligence, computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* Strong technical foundation in robotics, AI, or related areas, with an interest in real-world robotic systems.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research, evidenced by publications, impactful projects, or substantial research contributions.
* Strong programming skills and experience in developing research software.
* Ability to formulate research questions, implement novel methods, and rigorously evaluate experimental results.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
* Research experience in AI coding agents, robotics, foundation models, or program synthesis.
* Expertise in one or more areas such as robot learning, planning, simulation, perception, control, ...
* Familiarity with robotics and simulation platforms such as ROS 2, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or MuJoCo.
* Experience implementing and validating methods on real robotic systems.
* Publications at leading robotics conferences and journals, such as RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, T-RO, IJRR, or RA-L.
Join NVIDIA Research to explore how AI agents can transform robotics research and industry.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI Policy and Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Perplexity is seeking an intrepid Member of Technical Staff to take on one of the AI industry's most unique engineering roles. You'll work directly with Perplexity's senior leadership to spearhead a broad portfolio of strategic technology initiatives across policy, law, operations, and corporate affairs.

Reporting to Perplexity's VP Global Affairs & Deputy CTO, you'll occupy a front-row seat to the foremost policy issues animating the AI ecosystem. You'll also get a panoptic view of how leading AI companies operate, make decisions, and engage with broader society.

Those seeking to marry technical expertise and broader interests in law, policy, and corporate affairs will find a home in this role. You'll make contributions to Perplexity that defy traditional boundaries, with a bench of mentors who will push you to learn and grow day after day.







WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Your work will be both highly interdisciplinary and firmly grounded in engineering rigor. On any given day, you might:

 - Harness AI agents to research high-stakes policy and regulatory issues pertaining to Perplexity.

 - Build automated platforms for harvesting, prioritizing, and patenting Perplexity's inventions, in collaboration with our AI researchers and intellectual property attorneys.

 - Work hands-on with our Legal team and outside counsel in support of high-tech litigation matters in U.S. federal court.

 - Engineer privacy and compliance systems that efficiently scale with our growing portfolio of frontier AI products (such as Comet https://www.perplexity.ai/comet and Computer https://www.perplexity.ai/products/computer).

 - Contribute to regulatory filings and responses that require impeccable command of AI technology, Perplexity's own systems, and the broader policy landscape.

 - Embed with our People team to implement first-party software solutions for recruiting, labor compliance, and performance management.

 - Participate in meetings with Capitol Hill, executive branch officials, international partners, and civil society as a subject-matter expert on both AI technology and policy.

The above is a small sampling of activities; no two days will be the same, and your work will take you to all corners of our company. You'll interact each day with Perplexity's senior leaders, who will come to rely on you as a creative problem solver for simple and complex matters alike.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

No single profile defines our ideal candidate for this role. Here are some examples of people who might thrive here:

 - Exceptionally talented early-career engineers (new grads welcome) who are (1) well-read in law, tech policy, or economics, and (2) wish to grow in both technical and non-technical disciplines.
   
   - We welcome candidates who plan to attend law school or PhD programs in the future; we ask for a minimum 2-year commitment (i.e., you would apply for the entering class of 2028 or later).

 - Experienced engineers at top tech companies who wish to develop policy, business, and operations chops.

 - Lawyers or economists (new JD or PhD grads welcome) who've kept their engineering skills sharp and are excited to reimagine their fields in the age of AI.

 - This is a non-exhaustive list; other profiles may also be great fits.

No matter which profile describes you, we'll also be looking for:

 - Evidence of exceptional ability and 99th-percentile work ethic.

 - Strong technical skills at or above Perplexity's hiring bar for software engineers.

 - Fluency with frontier intelligence tools (such as Perplexity Computer https://www.perplexity.ai/products/computer).

 - High intrinsically-enforced standards for the craft and quality of your work.

 - Strong communication and writing skills, ideally demonstrated via samples of past written work product.

 - Curiosity and excitement about new and unfamiliar fields; eagerness to redefine your job every 3-6 months.

 - Ability to quickly dive deep in any given field and develop mastery rivaling that of domain experts.

 - Unimpeachable judgment, integrity, and discretion to be entrusted with the company's most important matters.

 - A service-oriented attitude that continually questions how company systems and processes might better serve stakeholders.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.description:
Mercury's Design Systems team helps product teams build interfaces that feel consistent, accessible, and carefully considered. We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to help evolve the shared components and patterns behind those experiences, making it easier for teams across Mercury to turn good ideas into well-crafted software.

You'll work closely with designers and engineers to understand product needs, explore solutions, and carry improvements into the hands of the teams using them. This role is open to early-career and intermediate engineers. You'll build depth in frontend engineering and design systems through meaningful project ownership, with guidance from experienced teammates suited to your experience.

Design systems will be your initial focus within the team's broader Design Foundations work. As opportunities and interests align, you can also contribute to code-based prototyping and tools that help designers and AI agents work with Mercury's components. Strong AI fluency is part of how we build from the start.

As part of this role, you will:

• Build shared components and patterns that make Mercury's interfaces better. You'll work in React and TypeScript, turning recurring product needs into flexible solutions that teams can use across different experiences.

• Partner with designers and product engineers to connect design intent with working software. Help evolve components and tokens across Figma and code, using feedback from real product work to improve the system.

• Improve the quality of the experiences built with our components. Consider how they look and behave for different users, bringing accessibility, thoughtful interactions, and reliable behavior into implementation and testing.

• Make the design system easier to use. Help teams adopt shared patterns and improve the examples, documentation, and workflows that let people build confidently with them.

• Use AI tools to explore approaches and move ideas into working code. Apply your judgment to what agents produce, test the results in context, and contribute useful approaches back to the team.

What you'll bring:

We're interested in what you've built and how you think. Your experience may come from professional work, internships, coursework, open source, or personal projects.

• A foundation in React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience building interfaces and the ability to explain the decisions behind your code.

• Care for visual craft and how people use software, including an interest in accessible interfaces and the details that make interactions feel right.

• Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools. You can provide useful context, evaluate and improve generated code, and verify that it works as intended.

• Ownership and a willingness to learn: you follow work through, communicate when you need help, and use feedback to improve your approach.

• Curiosity about reusable systems and the tradeoffs involved in serving different product needs with shared components.

• An interest in solving problems alongside designers and engineers, contributing ideas, and understanding the needs behind a request.

• Experience with design systems, prototyping, or developer tooling is a plus. You don't need to have held a design systems role to bring useful skills and ideas to this team.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com. 

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Associate
jobs.description:
Company Description

Farther is a rapidly growing RIA that combines expert advisors with cutting-edge technology - delivering a comprehensive, tailored wealth management experience.

Farther’s founders are leaders and innovators from the private wealth industry who possess a unique blend of traditional wealth management, fintech, and technology production expertise. We’re backed by top-tier venture capital firms, fintech investors, and industry leaders.

Joining Farther means joining a collaborative team of entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping their clients and our teammates achieve more. If you’re the type who breaks through walls to get things done the right way, we want to build the future of wealth management with you.

The Role

Finance runs on good data, and we need a Business Intelligence Associate to help keep ours clean, current, and useful. You'll work directly with our Revenue Operations Manager and alongside the Finance team to run our monthly reporting, dig into the numbers behind it, and get a little sharper every cycle. Expect real coaching, hands-on projects, and a clear path toward data analyst or data science work in finance and AI. If you're excited about finance and want to learn fast, this is a great place to build.

Your Impact

• Run our monthly financial and operational reports using established frameworks, and keep them accurate and on time

• Pull data from databases, spreadsheets, and APIs with SQL and Python to spot trends and answer questions

• Check data quality so everyone can trust what they see

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis and automate repeat work

• Support ad hoc requests from Finance, Revenue Operations, and partner teams like HubSpot, and explain what you find in plain English

The Ideal Match

• A real interest in finance or wealth management, and a clear reason you want to build a career in it

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Analytics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, plus at least one relevant internship

• Intermediate Python and SQL, and comfort reading code and working with AI to write and debug it

• Sharp attention to detail and strong integrity with numbers

• Coachable, motivated, and quick to learn: you take feedback and turn it into better work

Bonus Points

• Early-career experience in finance, fintech, consulting, or analytics

• Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform

• Background in wealth management or financial services

Why Join Us

• Hands-on coaching from a manager who invests in your growth

• Your scope grows as fast as you do — we'd rather stretch you than box you in

• A flat team where anyone can talk to anyone and good ideas win regardless of title

• Competitive pay that tracks your impact

• Full health, dental, and vision from day one, plus 401(k) matching and Roth IRA options

• Unlimited PTO

• Recognized as one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces two years running

Ready to build the next era of wealth management? Let's talk!

jobs.title: AI Engineer Intern - Enterprise Technology Services
Data Analytics & Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
Simbe is building the AI-powered operating system for physical retail. Our autonomous robots and multimodal data collection systems turn complex, constantly changing stores into accurate, actionable intelligence for leading retailers around the world. Simbe combines robotics, computer vision, machine learning, data infrastructure, and analytics to help retailers improve shelf availability, inventory accuracy, store execution, and operational decision-making.
Simbe is looking for a Data Analytics & Data Science Intern to join our Data Science & Analytics team and help turn large-scale retail and robot data into reliable insights, analytical products, and internal tools.
This internship is designed for students who want hands-on experience working with production data systems and solving real analytical problems at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, AI, and robotics.

Why This Internship Is High Impact
• 
Work with real production data. Analyze data generated across Simbe’s robot fleet, retail environments, and operational systems.

• 
Learn modern analytics engineering. Gain experience with SQL, Python, BigQuery, dbt, dimensional modeling, data quality, and BI workflows.

• 
Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

• 
Own a defined project. You’ll have clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

• 
Connect data to real-world outcomes. Help translate robot, store, inventory, service, and operational signals into useful insights and tools.

• 
Learn from experienced data practitioners. You’ll work directly with Simbe’s Data Science & Analytics team and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.
Responsibilities
• 
Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Data Science & Analytics team’s priorities during your internship.

• 
Write and maintain SQL and Python used for data analysis, transformation, validation, or automation.

• 
Work with data in BigQuery and help transform raw information into trustworthy analytical datasets.

• 
Contribute to dbt models, tests, documentation, and other analytics engineering workflows.

• 
Support dimensional modeling and development of organized data marts for analytical and reporting use cases.

• 
Build or improve dashboards and reporting in tools such as Looker.

• 
Investigate data-quality issues, validate results, and help ensure metrics are accurate and reliable.

• 
Analyze fleet, service, store, or retail data and communicate useful findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Depending on team priorities, contribute to AI-assisted analytics prototypes or tools that make data easier to explore and understand.

• 
Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, Operations, and other teams to understand data requirements and business context.

• 
Communicate progress, technical decisions, challenges, and results throughout the internship.

• 
Present your project, approach, results, and key learnings at the end of the program.
Required Qualifications
• 
Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 
We primarily target students in their final year of study and will also consider strong juniors.

• 
Strong SQL skills and comfort working with structured datasets.

• 
Experience using Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation.

• 
Coursework or hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics, data science, databases, or a related area.

• 
Familiarity with Git or another source-control system.

• 
Ability to investigate data carefully, recognize when results do not make sense, and validate conclusions.

• 
Strong technical problem-solving skills and willingness to work through ambiguous or unfamiliar problems.

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Bonus Qualifications
• 
Experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, or another cloud data warehouse/platform.

• 
Familiarity with dbt or another SQL-based data transformation framework.

• 
Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas or Kimball-style modeling.

• 
Experience building dashboards or reports in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a similar BI tool.

• 
Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, workflow orchestration, or tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with pandas, Jupyter notebooks, or other Python data tooling.

• 
Experience writing automated data tests, monitoring data quality, or documenting analytical models and metrics.

• 
Personal data, software, analytics, or AI projects outside of coursework.

• 
Previous internship, research, or project experience involving data engineering, analytics engineering, BI, or data science.

• 
Experience using AI-assisted coding, LLMs, or automation tools to accelerate analysis or software development, with good judgment around validating generated output.

• 
Interest in building conversational or natural-language interfaces over structured data.
Internship Program Structure
Interns join Simbe as part of a structured cohort and work full time from our Burlingame, California headquarters.

Each intern will have:

• 
A defined technical project aligned with current team priorities

• 
A hiring manager responsible for project scope, performance, and feedback

• 
A dedicated mentor separate from the hiring manager

• 
Structured midpoint feedback

• 
Regular opportunities to collaborate with and learn from Simbe engineers and data practitioners

• 
A final project presentation at the end of the internship

We do not believe in creating busywork for interns. Your project will be selected closer to your start date based on active team priorities so that you can contribute to meaningful work alongside our full-time team.

Transparent — We value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback.
Agile — We are eager to learn and adapt quickly to changes and customer needs.
Innovative — We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design, user experience, and customer value.
Leaders — We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field.

jobs.title: Computer Vision / Applied AI Intern
jobs.description:
Simbe is building the AI-powered operating system for physical retail. Our autonomous robots and multimodal computer vision platform turn complex, constantly changing stores into accurate, actionable intelligence for leading retailers around the world. Simbe combines robotics, computer vision, machine learning, data infrastructure, and customer-focused product design to help retailers improve shelf availability, price and promo execution, inventory accuracy, and store team productivity.
Simbe is looking for a Computer Vision / Applied AI Intern to join the team building and improving the computer vision systems that transform imagery collected by Tally into actionable retail intelligence.
This internship is designed for students who want hands-on experience applying computer vision and machine learning to real-world data and production systems at meaningful scale.

Why This Internship Is High Impact
• 
Work with real-world visual data. Help improve systems that interpret imagery collected by autonomous robots operating in live retail environments.

• 
Learn production computer vision. Gain exposure to the full lifecycle of CV/ML systems, from datasets and experimentation through evaluation and production deployment.

• 
Contribute to meaningful work. Your project will align with an active team initiative rather than being isolated “intern work.”

• 
Own a defined project. You’ll be given clear goals and an appropriately scoped problem you can meaningfully contribute to during the internship.

• 
Learn from experienced CV and ML engineers. You’ll work directly with Simbe engineers and have a dedicated mentor separate from your hiring manager.

• 
See how models perform in the real world. Work with the challenges that come from noisy imagery, changing retail environments, data quality, edge cases, and production requirements.
Responsibilities
• 
Own and contribute to a scoped project aligned with the Computer Vision / Applied AI team’s priorities during your internship.

• 
Develop, test, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning solutions using Python and modern ML frameworks.

• 
Work with production image datasets and help identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities for improvement.

• 
Contribute to areas such as object detection, OCR, barcode decoding, segmentation, dataset curation, annotation quality, model evaluation, or error mining depending on current team needs.

• 
Build or improve tools that support dataset analysis, model evaluation, experimentation, or production workflows.

• 
Write maintainable, well-structured code and contribute tests where appropriate.

•

jobs.title: Software Intern
jobs.description:
Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing!
 
Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics - including cell therapies, gene therapies, mRNA therapies, and more.
 
Currently, advanced biological therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. This keeps costs astronomical—often exceeding $0.5M-$2M per patient—and limits access to only a fraction of those in need. 
 
As labor scarcity for scientists compound against increased product complexity and sky-high costs of failure, the emergence of robotics and AI makes the automated manufacturing of biologics feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. 
 
We envision that the biomanufacturing factory of the future is fully robotic - closed, automated, and scalable, making therapeutics for some of the most important indications for patients today widely accessible.  
 
Why This Matters
 
We don’t just build robots; we build the infrastructure for the next generation of biologics manufacturing. Our technology allows biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, drastically lowering regulatory hurdles and bringing costs down to a level where these treatments can actually reach patients.
 
The Stack & The Scale
 
The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all.
The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning.
The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
The Backing: Supported by premier investors, including Casdin Capital, Lux Capital, and Y Combinator.
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for Software Engineering Interns to join a highly collaborative team to deliver production ready software that will shape the future of personalized medicine and cell therapy manufacturing systems. This role is for you if you are a strong problem solver, motivated and hard-working student, and excited to experience what it’s like being an engineer at an early-stage startup.

Responsibilities include:
• Design, build, deploy, troubleshoot and maintain high-quality software that manages the state and coordination of a multi-robot cluster.

• Build fast, discrete-event simulation tests to validate scheduling logic and throughput assumptions before code hits physical hardware.

• Collaborate with team members in implementing and testing scheduling logic for multi-agent workflows.

• Help develop and maintain tools to intelligently manage shared resources across parallel manufacturing batches.

• Work on developing and monitoring the connectivity tooling between on-premise robots and AWS.

• Contribute to the automated test suite, focusing on improving test coverage for non-deterministic robotic behaviors and streamlining the integration process.

• Participate in code reviews, document system architectures, and work closely with senior mentors to learn and apply industry-standard clean architecture and testing patterns.
Qualifications
• Currently working towards a Bachelor, Masters, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or equivalent.

• Self-starter comfortable working in a fast paced, technically challenging startup environment. 

• Strong background in: linear algebra, Python, data science, and data structures / algorithms.

• Strong communication skills that clearly express ideas and design details in meetings, team presentations, white board brainstorming sessions and in various technical documentation. 

• Prioritize organization and detail orientation, with ability to handle multiple project and task assignments simultaneously. 

• Passionate, curious, and eager to learn.
Nice to Haves
• Experience with robotic systems.

• Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS.

• Industry experience with Python.
Total Rewards & Life at Multiply Labs
• 
Competitive Compensation: $5,000-$7,000/month.

• 
Real Ownership: Own meaningful design projects on robots that go into production, not side tasks.

• 
Mentorship: Work side by side with experienced mechanical, robotics, and software engineers.

• 
Office Perks: An energetic SF office culture featuring catered team lunches, stocked kitchen, and frequent team events.

• 
Great people, meaningful work, and a team that genuinely believes in what we’re building.

• 
No Set Hours: Set your own schedule in alignment with your manager and team. We hold a high bar, measuring success by impact and outcomes—not hours logged.

Come build the world’s best robots—and help make life-saving therapies accessible to all.
We actively seek candidates with diverse perspectives and lived experiences. We’re committed to building a team where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work.
Multiply Labs encourages candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every qualification. If you’re excited about our mission and think you can contribute, we’d love to hear from you.
Our headquarters is located in San Francisco’s vibrant Dogpatch neighborhood.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Data Science
jobs.description:
United Risk is a global property and casualty insurance underwriting and distribution platform. It is independently owned and operated by its practice partners and affiliated with Applied Underwriters. Our practices cover specialty casualty and property, surety, financial lines, aviation, crisis and political risk, marine, fine art and more. Each one is led by underwriters who run their specialty with real autonomy.
Our AI team builds the tools that make those underwriters quicker and smarter. That includes submission ingestion, underwriting workbenches, risk analysis, and automation across the back and middle office. Our focus is to deliver tailored solutions to improve efficiency, while also maintaining our standards to security and compliance.
The Role:
You'll be one of a small group of AI Engineers. You'll work directly with underwriters and operations staff. You'll adapt the products we already run to their needs, and build new ones where nothing fits.
This role leans toward data science: turning our submission, policy and loss data into insight underwriters can act on. Everyone on the team also builds applications and works on infrastructure. Three senior AI engineers review your work and teach you along the way.

Requirements:
• A bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field

• 0–4 years of experience, including internships and co-ops

• Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with messy real-world data

• A grounding in statistics

• Work you built yourself and can show us. For this role, that means one or more of:

• A structured-extraction or document-processing project

• A RAG or document Q&A system

• An evaluation or testing setup for model or LLM output

• A data analysis or modeling project on a real dataset

• Curiosity about how the business runs, and the patience to learn insurance from the people who know it

• Clear communication with non-technical colleagues
Our Benefits Include: 
• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees.

• 401(k) plan with 100% immediate vesting and a 4% company match.

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays. 

• Life, disability, critical illness and accident insurance.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Pre-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for health, dependent care, and commuter-related expenses.

• Tuition reimbursement.

• Fitness reimbursement and various additional quality-of-life benefits.
How to apply
Apply through this posting with your résumé and a link to your GitHub, a deployed app or a portfolio. We review portfolios first. If you're shortlisted, you'll walk one of our senior engineers through a project you built and the choices you made.

jobs.title: MScAC Intern
jobs.description:
About The Role

Boson AI builds real-time speech and multimodal AI that makes talking to AI feel like talking to people. Our Higgs models listen, speak, and see. Higgs Realtime is a speech-to-speech API with tool calling and support for 100+ languages, and it is drop-in compatible with the OpenAI Realtime API. Higgs TTS 3 is an expressive, open-weight text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning. Higgs Avatar turns a single image into a streaming, talking video, and Higgs VoiceOver brings directable AI voice-over into video editors. We are a team of 40+ researchers and engineers, and we train our models on our own cluster of 900 GPUs.

Eligibility: this internship is only open to students enrolled in the Master of Science in Applied Computing (MScAC) program at the University of Toronto. Applications from anyone who is not an MScAC student at the University of Toronto will be automatically declined.

We are hiring MScAC students for the program's 8-month applied research internship, starting in May 2027; an earlier start is possible. You will join one of the projects below and work with a Boson AI mentor on problems that feed directly into our models and products. The internship is based in our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule.

Research Projects
• Audio data extraction and annotation. Our speech models learn from very large amounts of audio in 100+ languages. You will build pipelines that collect, segment, transcribe and annotate audio with as little manual engineering as possible, using unsupervised and semi-supervised methods, and you will close the loop so that annotation and model training improve each other (see NVIDIA Granary, arXiv:2505.13404). This suits you if you enjoy scripting, experiments and large datasets, and have a working knowledge of statistics and machine learning.

• Audio evaluation and benchmarking. Good speech is more than correct pronunciation. It has to fit the context, emotion and style, sound natural in a conversation, and match the voice it clones. You will design benchmarks and automatic metrics for expressive, multilingual and conversational speech, for voice cloning, and for speech recognition under the conditions real voice agents face (see our EmergentTTS-Eval, arXiv:2505.23009, and Back to Basics: Revisiting ASR in the Age of Voice Agents, arXiv:2603.25727), and use them both to evaluate our models and as signals for training them. This suits you if you like experimentation, have a good ear, ideally speak more than one language, and are comfortable automating evaluation in Python.

• Video generation and computer vision. Higgs Avatar turns a single image into a streaming, talking video. You will work on the data pipeline behind it (collection, multi-stage filtering and synthesis) and on the models: audio-driven video generation with accurate lip sync and natural expressions, distilled diffusion models that run in real time, and computer vision that lets our models see and react to the person they are talking to (see Wan-S2V, arXiv:2508.18621, and LTX-Video, arXiv:2501.00103). This suits you if you have a background in image or video generation (diffusion models, VAEs, GANs, NeRFs) or in computer vision, and are comfortable with large-scale data and model optimization.

• Efficient training. You will make training on our 900-GPU cluster faster and more robust: numerical formats (FP8, FP4, BF16), fused CUDA or Triton kernels for architectures that go beyond standard Transformers, overlapping communication with computation, faster checkpointing and recovery from failures, newer optimizers such as Muon, and stable reinforcement-learning post-training when the training and rollout systems differ (see our Let the Batch Decide, arXiv:2605.12380). This suits you if you enjoy systems work and optimization, like writing CUDA or Triton, and want experience training across hundreds of GPUs. Strong coding skills are required.

• Serving and real-time inference. Higgs Realtime responds in under a second, and Higgs Avatar streams live video into calls. You will make our streaming speech and video models faster and cheaper to serve, on our own GPUs and in the cloud, using SGLang or vLLM: 8-bit and 4-bit quantization, speculative decoding, kernel and memory-layout optimization, KV-cache management across many concurrent users, and scaling capacity with demand (see our Alignment Drift in Single-Model Speculative Decoding for ASR, arXiv:2608.12703, and TARQ, arXiv:2605.27808). This suits you if you enjoy systems work, have some experience with GPU hardware and CUDA or Triton, and want to work with large numbers of GPUs. Strong coding skills are required.

• Agents: conversational design, theory of mind and reinforcement learning. Our voice agents handle customer support, sales and training calls for businesses. They must follow business rules exactly while sounding natural, keep track of context, and adapt to the person on the other end. Projects include declarative dialog frameworks that separate workflow state from language generation and keep agents on track through multi-step workflows, even after the user interrupts (see our IHBench, arXiv:2606.19595); theory of mind, so that agents model the user's state of mind and act on needs the user has implied but not said (see our ProactBench, arXiv:2605.09228); and reinforcement learning that improves agents from real call traces (see Flow-GRPO, arXiv:2510.05592). This suits you if you are a rigorous logical and systems thinker, know the basics of LLMs and reinforcement learning, and are curious about human behavior. Experience with dialog systems or human-computer interaction is a plus, and so is a love of storytelling or role-playing games.

• Full-duplex conversation, for audio and audio-video. People talk over each other, nod, say "mm-hm" and react while they listen. Turn-based voice AI does none of this. You will work on full-duplex models that listen and speak at the same time, handling interruptions, backchannels and turn-taking, following instructions about when to speak, and keeping up with several people in one conversation: first for speech, then for audio-video, where the avatar also has to look like it is listening and react in real time (see our Instruct-FD, arXiv:2607.20460, and MSI-Bench, arXiv:2609.24812). This suits you if you have a background in speech, sequence modeling or multimodal learning, and want to work on an open research problem with a direct path into our products.
Minimum Qualifications
• Enrolled in the MScAC program at the University of Toronto. This is mandatory, and applications from anyone else are automatically declined

• Strong programming skills in Python, plus C++, CUDA or Triton for the systems projects

• Solid foundations in machine learning and deep learning, with hands-on experience in PyTorch or JAX

• Careful experimental practice: you design experiments, measure what matters, and report results honestly

• Available for the full 8-month internship and able to work from our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule
Preferred Qualifications
• Research, coursework or project experience in one of our project areas: speech and audio, video generation, computer vision, LLM agents, reinforcement learning, or ML systems

• Papers, open-source contributions or GitHub projects you can point to

• Experience with large datasets or multi-GPU training

• Fluency in a language besides English. Our models speak 100+ of them
Internship Details
• 8-month applied research internship, starting in May 2027. An earlier start is possible

• Based in our Toronto office on a hybrid schedule

• Compensation: CAD 70,000–100,000 for the 8-month term

• In your application, tell us which one to three projects interest you most

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Company Overview 

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

About Amperesand

Amperesand is building next-generation power infrastructure systems for Data Centers, EV charging platforms, and future energy applications. Our systems combine advanced power electronics, embedded controls, and scalable energy architectures to rethink how power is converted, controlled, and deployed.

About the Role

This internship is an opportunity to work hands-on with a startup engineering team that builds and experiments with the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. You will contribute to multiple teams, architecting and implementing AI/ML solutions to help improve reliability, and accelerate the development process

You will work closely with engineers, product owners, and internal and external stakeholders who rely on our AI enabled solutions every day. This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment where you'll be expected to take ownership of real, production-facing work.

What You’ll Do

• Design and develop AI/ML solutions that accelerate product development and engineering workflows.

• Build AI frameworks, agentic workflows, and knowledge assistants that help teams access and utilize engineering data.

• Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) for domain-specific engineering use cases.

• Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications using engineering documentation, test data, and design knowledge.

• Train and deploy machine learning models to support Mechanical Design Engineering and related teams.

• Partner with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Software Engineers to solve high-impact business and engineering problems.

• Build data pipelines, model evaluation frameworks, and AI experimentation workflows.

• Document solutions and contribute production-quality code in a fast-paced startup environment.

• Bring a customer-oriented, team-first mindset to a fast-paced startup environment.

What You’ll Bring

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.

• Strong programming skills in Python, Go, Rust, and TypeScript.

• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or similar.

• Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, Evals, and AI agents.

• Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, model evaluation, and data processing.

• Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

• Self-motivated, team-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

• Available to work on-site.

Nice to Have

• Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source LLMs.

• Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases, or agentic frameworks.

• Exposure to MLOps, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), or model deployment.

• Experience applying AI/ML to engineering, manufacturing, hardware, or industrial systems.

• Familiarity with CAD, PLM, simulation tools, or engineering workflows.

• Interest in energy systems, power electronics, AI infrastructure, or industrial automation.

• Research, open-source contributions, hackathons, or personal AI/ML projects.

Working Model

Employment Type:
• Full-time 

Location:
Sunnyvale

Work Model:
• Onsite
Please note: This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options. 

While this role is listed for the location above, we may consider candidates in other locations on a case-by-case basis.

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:

Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems

• High ownership and visibility

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure

• Fast-moving startup environment

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. 

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States:

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

Additional benefits may be available depending on the role and employment type. Benefits are subject to the terms of applicable company policies and plans.

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

Company Overview

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

Role Overview 

ID.me is looking for an Analytics Engineer Intern to help us put AI to work across our data organization. You are a curious builder who loves turning data into answers, and you’re ready to use AI to put those answers in the hands of the teams who rely on them every day.

As an intern, you'll build conversational analytics chatbots, automate data pipelines, and create detection agents that help us get more from our data and improve the member experience.

Location: Mountain View, California- onsite in office five days a week 

What You'll Work On

As an intern, you will own a focused set of AI enablement projects, working alongside analytics engineers, data analysts, and data engineers.

• Conversational analytics chatbots: Build chatbots that let teams ask questions of our data in plain language and get trusted answers.

• Data pipeline automation: Use AI-assisted tooling to automate and streamline parts of our data pipelines.

• Detection agents: Design agents that monitor data and flag anomalies, quality issues, and unusual patterns.

• Data architecture and domain-driven design: Explore how AI can improve our data models, documentation, and overall architecture.

Responsibilities

• Build and iterate on chatbot prototypes that support conversational analytics on top of Snowflake and dbt models

• Automate data pipeline tasks such as testing, documentation, and monitoring using AI tools

• Develop detection agents that surface data quality problems and anomalies

• Apply domain-driven design principles to help improve data models, metric definitions, and metadata

• Partner with analysts, engineers, and data scientists to understand needs and gather feedback

• Document your work and present results and learnings to the team at the end of the internship

Basic Qualifications

• College junior with an expected graduation year of 2028, currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Math, or a related quantitative field. Students with a software engineering background who want to build a career in data are encouraged to apply.

• Interest in AI and large language models, including prompting and building simple applications on top of them

• Basic understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts

What You'll Gain

• Hands-on experience building AI-powered analytics tools on a modern data stack

• Mentorship from experienced analytics engineers

• A real project with visible impact on how ID.me uses its data

• Exposure to data architecture, domain-driven design, and data governance in practice

• A portfolio-ready project to present to the team at the end of the internship

Our Culture

At ID.me, we believe that an in-office culture fosters professional growth and development, mentorship, collaboration, and accelerated innovation. This position will be in-office based at our Mountain View, CA location. Working in an office together allows our culture to thrive and our team members to establish real connections with their coworkers and the opportunity for lifelong friendships. Our work is critical to protecting online identity and we're confident that working together is how we'll change the world.

All ID.me employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling our commitment to equal employment opportunity. ID.me does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. ID.me adheres to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, ID.me's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works. Upon request we will provide you with more information about such accommodations.

Please review our Privacy Policy, including our CCPA policy, at id.me/privacy. If you provide ID.me with any personally identifiable information you confirm that you have read and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Location: Watertown, MA
Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with hybrid schedule. 

About ProFound Therapeutics

ProFound™ Therapeutics is a biotechnology company discovering novel proteins across the expanded human proteome to unlock first-in-class medicines and transformative drug targets. The company’s proprietary ProFoundry™ Platform integrates state-of-the-art protein detection, validation, and computational technologies to systematically identify and characterize previously inaccessible proteins and validate their therapeutic potential. This approach has generated a rapidly expanding portfolio of novel targets and drug discovery programs advancing toward the clinic, enabled by strategic collaborations with leading pharmaceutical partners. Together, these efforts support the development of breakthrough treatments across a broad range of disease areas.

The company is now poised to define the disease-relevant function of these proteins at scale using advanced proteomics technologies, high throughput experimental biology, and causal agentic AI, enabling rapid identification and characterization of the most promising protein drugs and drug targets.

Founded by Flagship Pioneering, ProFound works with pharmaceutical partners including Novartis, Pfizer and GSK, and with the Gates Foundation, which has committed up to $35 million to a ProFoundprogram focused on preeclampsia.

About Flagship Pioneering 

ProFound Therapeutics was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

Position Summary

ProFound’s AI/ML team builds SAGE, an internal multi-agent LLM platform that helps our scientists reason over knowledge graphs, biological databases and the scientific literature. SAGE is a central part of how ProFound applies agentic AI to understand novel proteins and accelerate drug discovery.

As an AI/ML Engineering Co-Op, you will help extend what SAGE can do and make sure it performs reliably. You will own real features from design through deployment, working closely with our ML engineers and with the scientists who use SAGE every day. The Co-Op is designed to complement your academic training with hands-on experience building and operating a production AI system in an industry drug discovery setting.

Scope

• Agent tools and integrations, including external data sources, MCP servers and user-uploaded documents

• User experience and collaboration features in the SAGE chat interface

• LLM evaluation and benchmarking (answer quality, accuracy and hallucination rate)

• Monitoring of usage, performance and cost, and quality checks in CI/CD

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following.

• Tools and capabilities

• Design, build and ship new SAGE tools that connect the agent to external data sources, APIs and MCP servers.

• Extend SAGE’s ability to ingest and reason over documents that users upload, including parsing, chunking and retrieval.

• Contribute to agent orchestration and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) components that work across knowledge graphs, biological databases and the scientific literature.

• User experience

• Build features that make the SAGE chat interface easier to use and collaborate in (e.g., sharing conversations, displaying sources and citations).

• Gather feedback directly from scientists and turn it into practical, prioritized improvements.

• Evaluation and quality

• Develop evaluation and benchmarking pipelines that measure SAGE’s answer quality, accuracy and hallucination rate.

• Help build and curate benchmark datasets with input from scientists, using automated (e.g., LLM-as-judge) and human-review approaches.

• Help integrate automated quality checks and regression tests into our CI/CD pipeline.

• Monitoring and engineering practice

• Build monitoring for SAGE usage, performance, reliability and LLM cost.

• Write clean, tested and documented code, and take part in code reviews.

• Present progress and results to the AI/ML team and scientific stakeholders, including a final co-op presentation.

What Success Looks Like by the End of the Co-Op

• At least one new SAGE capability designed, built and deployed to production, and in use by scientists.

• An evaluation and benchmarking pipeline running regularly, giving the team a clear baseline for answer quality and hallucination rate.

• Better visibility into SAGE usage, performance and cost.

• Well-documented work that the team can maintain and build on after the co-op ends.

Qualifications

Required

• Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field, and available for a full-time, 4–6 month co-op term.

• Strong Python skills.

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs (e.g., LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or MCP) through coursework, projects, or prior internships

• Familiarity with Git and software engineering best practices, such as testing, code review and documentation.

• Curious and self-driven, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues.

Preferred

• Experience with web or backend development (e.g., FastAPI, React or TypeScript).

• Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks or observability and tracing tools.

• Exposure to knowledge graphs, vector databases, or scientific and biological data sources.

• Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g., AWS), containers (e.g., Docker) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions).

• Prior internship or co-op experience in software or ML engineering.

• Interest in biology or drug discovery; no biology background required.

Why Join Us?

You’ll work on a production AI platform used by real scientists. You’ll own projects end to end, with mentorship from experienced ML engineers, and contribute to the discovery of new medicines.

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Data Engineering Co-op
jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Location: Watertown, MA
Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with hybrid schedule. 

About ProFound Therapeutics

ProFound™ Therapeutics is a biotechnology company discovering novel proteins across the expanded human proteome to unlock first-in-class medicines and transformative drug targets. The company’s proprietary ProFoundry™ Platform integrates state-of-the-art protein detection, validation, and computational technologies to systematically identify and characterize previously inaccessible proteins and validate their therapeutic potential. This approach has generated a rapidly expanding portfolio of novel targets and drug discovery programs advancing toward the clinic, enabled by strategic collaborations with leading pharmaceutical partners. Together, these efforts support the development of breakthrough treatments across a broad range of disease areas.

The company is now poised to define the disease-relevant function of these proteins at scale using advanced proteomics technologies, high throughput experimental biology, and causal agentic AI, enabling rapid identification and characterization of the most promising protein drugs and drug targets.

Founded by Flagship Pioneering, ProFound works with pharmaceutical partners including Novartis, Pfizer and GSK, and with the Gates Foundation, which has committed up to $35 million to a ProFoundprogram focused on preeclampsia.

About Flagship Pioneering 

ProFound Therapeutics was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

Position Summary

As a Bioinformatics Data Engineering Co-Op, you’ll work on production pipelines and datasets, with code review and mentorship from the team. You’ll own a scoped project from start to finish and present it to the team at the end. Typical projects include a QC dashboard, a pipeline benchmark, a new annotation resource or a statistics module. You’ll also work directly with the scientists who use what you build.

The Co-Op is designed to complement your academic training with hands-on experience in production bioinformatics and data engineering in an industry drug discovery setting.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following.

• Run and monitor pipelines. Run Nextflow pipelines for ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq), long-read sequencing and DIA proteomics on AWS Batch. Triage failed jobs and summarize QC with MultiQC and alignment metrics.

• Build and validate QC. Flag samples that fail set thresholds. Compare results across GENCODE versions. Write automated checks that catch suspicious or missing experiment data before it reaches downstream scoring.

• Analyze proteomics evidence. This includes peptide-to-protein mapping, sequence coverage, FDR-filtered evidence, and comparisons across search engines and experiments.

• Write and test scripts. Use Python and R to parse, filter and summarize outputs (FASTA, GTF, BAM, peptide and protein tables) into Parquet or TSV. Turn exploratory notebooks into reusable, version-controlled code.

• Grow the data catalog. Add or update a dataset: ingest it, document its schema and check it with Athena (SQL) queries.

• Build tools for scientists. Prototype a visualization or dashboard (Plotly/Dash, Streamlit or a notebook) that scientists use to review targets and QC results.

• Document and share. Write READMEs and runbooks, and present results in team meetings, including a final co-op presentation.

Example Projects

• Benchmark two MS search engines on the same dataset and report where they agree and where they disagree.

• Build a Ribo-seq QC report that flags samples failing periodicity or mapping thresholds.

• Add a new QC view to a scientist-facing dashboard, from requirements through deployment.

• Ingest and document a new biological annotation resource in the data catalog.

Qualifications

Required

• Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biology, Biochemistry, Computer Science or a related field, and available for a full-time, 4–6 month co-op term.

• Python (pandas) and comfort with the Linux command line.

• Git, and a habit of writing clear, tested, reproducible code.

• Coursework or project experience in genomics or molecular biology, such as RNA-seq, translation, protein or DNA sequence analysis, or proteomics basics.

• Clear written communication; you document what you build.

Preferred

• Basic R.

• SQL.

• Nextflow, Snakemake, Airflow or another workflow manager, plus Docker.

• Exposure to AWS (e.g., S3, EC2, Athena).

• Familiarity with Ribo-seq, long-read sequencing or mass spectrometry data (e.g., peptides, PSMs, database search).

• Basic statistics, such as differential expression, false discovery rate and multiple-testing correction.

• A dashboard or web app you’ve built (e.g., Dash, Streamlit, Shiny), linked from GitHub or a portfolio.

• Experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) on real projects, with a sense of where they help and where they fail.

• Exposure to LLM APIs, agents, MCP, or classic ML (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch) applied to biological data.

What You’ll Learn and Gain

• How production Nextflow pipelines are built, tested and run on the cloud.

• How a data catalog (Glue, Athena, Parquet) turns raw omics outputs into queryable resources.

• How a computational team supports a drug discovery platform, with exposure to the wet-lab work behind the data.

• How to use AI-assisted development responsibly in a regulated, data-sensitive setting: verification, testing, and knowing what data may and may not go to which tools.

• A shipped project with your name on it.

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

jobs.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Associate Data Engineer at BeyondTrust, you will contribute to building and enhancing our data lake which currently consumes billions of events each day. You will leverage state-of-the-art data engineering tools to help develop cost-effective cloud solutions that enable next-level cybersecurity research. You will maintain and optimize existing infrastructure, build new data assets, and collaborate with experienced engineers to deliver reliable data solutions that drive business value. 

What You’ll Do

• Contribute to data modelling efforts that support identity security use cases and analytical requirements. 

• Develop and maintain data pipelines that bring together complex information from disparate systems to support security analysis in the datalake 

• Optimize data workloads at a software level by improving processing efficiency. 

• Work with senior engineers to identify areas for process improvement and help implement solutions. 

• Use monitoring and observability best practices to ensure optimal pipeline performance. 

• Assist with ML Operations to ensure optimal model efficiency. 

• Leverage CI/CD best practices to effectively develop and release source code. 

• Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to improve engineering practices. 

What You’ll Bring

• Programming and technology knowledge in cloud data processing. 

• Spark experience is needed, existing Databricks knowledge is a plus. 

• Ability to learn fast and strong desire to develop 

• Interest in cybersecurity; interest in identity security is preferred. 

• Understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and distributed data processing concepts. 

• Experience working with distributed systems and data processing on object stores. 

• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively. 

Technologies You Should Know

• Required: Data warehousing for analytics use cases 

• Required: Proficient in Python (or another object orientated language) 

• Required: Distributed processing framework experience 

• Highly Preferred: Spark 

• Highly Preferred: Realtime processing experience. 

• Ideal: Some experience with graph data stores 

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



Developer Interfaces builds the tools developers and AI agents use to work with 1Password from code. We own the 1Password CLI and we are building out the SDKs and the public developer API experience. Our goal is to make every one of those surfaces feel like one product that is fast, consistent and secure by default. The work sits where developer experience meets security, so the problems are real and the bar for correctness is high.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027.



What You Can Expect:

 - Ship features and fixes in the 1Password CLI, written in Go and Rust, that developers use every day in terminals, scripts and CI pipelines.

 - Measure and improve CLI and SDK performance with benchmarks and usage data.

 - Write a short design doc before you build, get feedback from senior engineers, then carry the work through code review, testing and release.

 - Learn how a security company builds developer tools, from authentication flows like OAuth to handling secrets safely.

 - Use AI coding tools with judgment. You review and verify what they produce, and you own every line you submit.



What we're looking for:

 - Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion.

 - Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them).

 - Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are.

 - Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team!



Bonus points for:

 - Experience with Go or Rust

 - Familiarity with OAuth 2.0 or other authentication flows

 - Experience with developer docs, OpenAPI specs or static site generators

 - Interest in how AI agents use developer tools
   
   

Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of most roles. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. 


How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

💡 1Password University access and learning sessions
🥳  Monthly internship events and socials

We believe in tech for good, and establishing Canada as a preferred destination for growing careers wherever we can!
