Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of most roles. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. 


How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

🏝 Generous PTO policy - 2.08 days per month (1.5 work weeks per 4 month term)
💖 Company-wide wellness days (1 per quarter) 
🌎 Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs
🏠 Remote-first environment
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
💡 1Password University access and learning sessions
🥳  Monthly internship events and socials



1Password is part of  Team True North https://www.communitech.ca/how-we-help/team-true-north/ , a comprehensive group of Canadian tech firms with performance and growth rates that match the top 1% of companies worldwide – companies with the highest probability of reaching $1 billion in annual revenue. We believe in tech for good, and establishing Canada as a preferred destination for growing careers wherever we can!



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.title: Mid Level Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Are you a software engineer looking for your next challenge? Are you looking to advance your career by collaborating with experts on a next-generation video management system? Do you want to join a highly skilled team based in Edinburgh and across the UK, influencing the direction of future features and bringing innovation and dynamism to our work?

Motorola Solutions’ Avigilon Alta Video brings Cloud video security systems to the next level. Alta’s cloud-based video security solution offers industry leading full AI video analytics and exceptional operational insights. 

The Alta Video engineering team injects intelligence into their approach to security and all their solutions. They help organisations see, understand, and act on their surroundings to protect people, business, and reputation in real-time.
We are seeking enthusiastic and talented graduates and software engineers with several years of experience to expand our teams and contribute to product development. We offer a hybrid working environment with 2 days in our fantastic city centre office in Edinburgh.
Job Description
What You Will Do
• Delivering high quality, reliable software in our cloud video management system in an agile environment.

• Contributing to, and thriving in, a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate within your cross functional team and with international colleagues.

• Contribute to feature refinement and generate innovative solutions.

• Participate in peer reviews, sharing and learning from others.

Basic Requirements
What you bring:
• Strong skills in at least one general-purpose programming language, including any of: Golang, Python, C, C++, Rust or Java.
• Several years of solid industry experience as a Software Engineer, although we will consider talented graduates as well.
• Be able to demonstrate strong software development fundamentals
• A passion for owning, building and delivering great software experiences for end-users. 
• A formal qualification (Degree) in Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent or a proven industry track record.
• Experience with the use or adoption of AI tools in a software development context is preferred.
• Exposure to Cloud platforms (GCP preferred).
• Desire to build a T-shaped skill set combining deep expertise in backend services with a broader technical outlook.
• Able to collaborate in-person in our Edinburgh office 2 days per week.

The Avigilon Alta Video teams default to programming using Go for backend and Typescript for frontend, but also use a wide variety of different languages and frameworks. It is not expected that you would be familiar with Go (or any of the other languages we use) but you should be enthusiastic and willing to learn new things!

We are looking for a team player who thinks holistically, enjoys solving complex problems and thrives in an agile, cross functional environment.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace spawns innovation – the more diverse our employees are, the more ideas and talents we have to excel as a leader in the technology sector. If you would like to be part of a dynamic team of people who are ambitious, focused, and hardworking then we look forward to meeting you!

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:
• Competitive salary and bonus schemes.
• Two weeks additional pay per year (holiday bonus).
• 25 days holiday entitlement + bank holidays.
• 10% time (1 day in every 10 to pursue innovation and personal development).
• Attractive defined contribution pension scheme.
• Employee stock purchase plan.
• Flexible working options.
• Private medical care.
• Life assurance. 
• Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
• Career development support and wide ranging learning opportunities.
• Employee health and wellbeing support EAP, wellbeing guidance etc.
• Carbon neutral initiatives/goals.
• Corporate social responsibility initiatives including support for volunteering days.
• Well known companies discount schemes.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Early Career - AI Platform
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking an Early Career Product Manager to join the AI product management team. Our team owns some of Addepar's flagship AI products, including Addison, agentic workflows, and the Addepar MCP. Our mission is to accelerate front- and back-office work for the investment industry. 

As an Early Career Product Manager, you'll get hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, working alongside senior PMs in a high growth, fast moving environment - leveraging the latest and greatest in conversational AI, agents, and emerging standards like MCP to build transformative new products that deliver value to clients. This role will require working closely with engineering, design, product, marketing, go-to-market to drive new AI products to success.

This is a fast-paced, cross-functional role for a hands-on operator who wants to get real AI products into clients' hands, making an impact at the intersection of AI, customer-centric product development, and financial technology.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

• Drive the end-to-end development of new AI features: help scope requirements, write specs, partner with engineering, design, and GTM to get them built and launched

• Dig into how clients actually use our AI products today, surface what's working and what isn't, and turn those insights into clear, actionable product recommendations

• Own well-defined pieces of the roadmap under the mentorship of senior PMs, with increasing autonomy

• Get hands-on with the AI tools and techniques the team uses daily, including prompting, evaluating agent behavior, and understanding what makes an AI feature actually work in practice

• Define product analytics focused on usage patterns, adoption, feature performance

• Help the team stay organized and move fast: support operations, maintain product documentation, and triage incoming feedback and bugs

• Work directly with cross-functional partners in engineering, design, marketing, and go-to-market to keep execution tight and stakeholders aligned

Who You Are

• 0–2 years of professional experience; strong internship, research, or project experience in a fast-paced, analytical environment is a plus

• Genuinely excited about AI and how it's changing what products can do. You use AI tools yourself, you keep up with what's new, and you have opinions about where this is all headed

• Sharp analytical instincts. You're comfortable breaking down ambiguous problems, working with data, and reasoning your way to a recommendation

• A bias for ownership. You don't wait to be told exactly what to do — you ask good questions, make a plan, and move

• Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a technical idea clearly to both an engineer and a client

• Comfortable communicating with senior stakeholders, whether that's a client or an executive

• Low ego, high accountability. You're as comfortable digging into the details as you are stepping back to see the bigger picture

• Drawn to fast-paced, high-growth environments where the problems are still being defined and the stakes are real

• Curiosity about financial services and fintech is a plus, but not required

• Experience speaking or working directly with clients is a plus, but not required

• Engineering/ CS background is a plus, but not required

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range
$83,000—$130,000 USD

Our Values 

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact
As a Facilities Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will actively contribute to engineering tasks under the guidance of senior professionals. From analyzing systems to testing solutions, you will apply your academic knowledge to solve real-world challenges while ensuring accuracy and completeness in engineering records and documentation. This role provides hands-on experience and the opportunity to strengthen your skills in a dynamic and collaborative environment, directly impacting the efficiency and reliability of Intel's facilities operations.

Business group
The Facilities Operations team at Intel Corporation is dedicated to maintaining and optimizing the physical infrastructure that supports Intel's cutting-edge technologies. The group works to ensure operational excellence across all facilities, enabling efficient processes while fostering sustainability initiatives. Joining this team means working at the intersection of innovation and practicality, contributing to Intel's broader mission of delivering world-changing technology.

Position 1: Project Engineering Intern
Key Responsibilities:
- Support tracking and coordination of small to medium-sized facilities/construction projects.
- Attend meetings and consolidate project updates from APAC and US sites.
- Develop and maintain reports/dashboard using Microsoft Power BI and other Microsoft tools.
- Support Safety Walk activities, including scheduling, attendance tracking, and follow-up of findings closure.
- Assist in managing project and engineering documentation.
- Support process improvement, reporting automation, and other tasks assigned by the team.

Position 2: Electrical Intern
Key Responsibilities:
- Assist senior engineers with analytical and testing tasks related to engineering projects to fix issue and improve electrical system reliability.
- Apply theoretical knowledge to solve basic engineering problems and develop solutions to solve the problem under Electrical System.
- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of engineering records, drawings, and documentation including Electrical POC tracking, CB setting, Arc-flash management, etc.
- Help maintain parts catalogs, owner's manuals, and operational instruction manuals for assigned systems.
- Support development of automation report, dashboard using Power BI & other Microsoft tools.
- Assist Energy Conservation Managers in daily tasks & Energy Saving project execution.
- Support Factory Shutdown Planning and Execution to perform major maintenance for Electrical system.

Position 3: Mechanical Intern

- Assist senior engineers with analytical and testing tasks to fix issue and improve system reliability: HVAC Heating Ventilating Air Conditioning, Oil-free air, Compressed Air, Vacuum systems. Chilled water plant (chillers, pumps, cooling towers), Exhaust Systems, DX systems.
- Apply theoretical knowledge to solve basic engineering problems and develop solutions to solve the problem under Mechanical System.
- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of engineering records, drawings, and documentation for Mechanical systems listed above.
- Help maintain parts catalogs, owner's manuals, and operational instruction manuals for assigned systems.
- Support development of automation report, dashboard using Power BI & other Microsoft tools.
- Assist Energy Conservation Managers in daily tasks & Energy Saving project execution.

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact 
As a Facilities Technician Intern, you will support the operation, maintenance, and repair of critical building systems to ensure they run optimally and safely. In this hands-on role, you will gain practical experience through preventative maintenance tasks, troubleshooting system failures, and assisting with inspections. This opportunity allows you to enhance your technical skills while contributing to Intel's facility operations and reliability.

Business Group 
Intel Foundry focuses on delivering world-class manufacturing capabilities and innovative technologies to support Intel's business goals. This group plays a key role in enabling Intel's leadership in the semiconductor industry by ensuring operational excellence in facility systems. Joining this team offers the chance to work in a collaborative, high-impact environment where your contributions will support Intel's broader mission of advancing cutting-edge innovations.

- Assist in the operation and preventative maintenance of mechanical systems, including HVAC, chillers, and vacuum systems. 
- Conduct inspections, troubleshoot failures, and perform routine repairs on building systems with guidance from experienced technicians. 
- Support hands-on tasks such as filter replacement, vibration analysis, pump maintenance, and localized exhaust ventilation (LEV) upkeep while adhering to safety protocols. 
- Read and interpret technical documents, including drawings, layouts, and maintenance manuals. 
- Collaborate with facilities teams to uphold compliance with safety standards and facility maintenance procedures. 
- Participate in projects aimed at improving system reliability and energy efficiency.

Job Details:

Job Description: 
What if your next project helped power the future of technology? 

At Intel, you'll do more than learn, you'll contribute. As an intern, you'll work side-by-side with industry leaders, gain hands-on experience on meaningful projects, and help solve real-world challenges that affect billions of people worldwide. From advanced semiconductor manufacturing to AI-powered innovations, you'll play a role in technologies that redefine how the world works, learns, and connects. 

What makes Intel unique is the opportunity to see the entire technology lifecycle in action. Unlike many companies where hardware, software, and manufacturing operate separately, Intel brings them together, giving you exposure to everything from research and design to advanced semiconductor manufacturing and global deployment. 

Whether you're tackling engineering challenges, improving operations, analyzing data, advancing next-generation technologies, or supporting global customers, you'll build valuable skills while contributing to innovations that enable a more sustainable and connected future. 

Bring your curiosity, make an impact, and see where your ideas can take you at Intel. 
 
What You'll Do 

The world's most advanced semiconductors depend on world-class facilities engineering. As a Facilities Services Intern, you'll support the critical infrastructure, systems, sustainability, and reliability behind Intel's manufacturing operations. 
• Support engineering projects and continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Analyze system and equipment performance to identify improvement opportunities. 
• Assist with troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical problem solving. 
• Contribute to the safe, reliable, and sustainable operation of critical facility systems. 
• Partner with cross-functional teams to solve real-world engineering challenges. 
Gain exposure to facilities engineering, instrumentation and controls, chemical management, water treatment, environmental health and safety, and manufacturing infrastructure. 

Where Your Career Could Take You

jobs.title: AI Hardware Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
About the Job
Intel is seeking exceptional Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, and AI/ML students to join an AI Hardware Engineering internship focused on the future of AI inference and AI infrastructure with hardware/software co-design expertise. 

This internship approaches AI infrastructure as a hardware/software co-design challenge. The intern will analyze how model architecture, inference behavior, memory movement, data-center constraints, and software stacks influence end-to-end customer outcomes, including throughput, latency, time-to-first-token, tokens per second, power consumption, utilization, total cost of ownership, and deployability. 

The successful candidate will be technically hands-on, capable of independent research and analysis, and comfortable working within a highly technical team of researchers and engineers addressing complex AI hardware and infrastructure challenges. 

What You Will Do 
• Conduct technical research on the next generation of AI infrastructure, including CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, ASICs, memory systems, networking, storage, rack-scale architecture, power delivery, cooling, and cluster management. 
• Analyze GenAI and agentic AI workloads to understand their hardware implications, including transformer architecture based inference, mixture-of-experts architectures, multimodal models, real-time interactive inference, and distributed serving. 
• Evaluate the hardware behavior of AI inference pipelines, including the distinct demands of prompt processing/prefill and token generation/decode, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, KV-cache management, compute utilization, interconnect bandwidth, and latency. For example, cluster architecture around optimizing both prefill and decode through hardware, memory, and system co-design. 
• Identify product and system gaps that may limit Intel's ability to serve AI customers effectively, including hardware capabilities, developer tooling, performance libraries, reference architectures, deployment models, observability, and ecosystem enablement. 
 - Expertise in modern high-performance CPU, GPU, or AI accelerator architecture and hardware/software interactions. 
 - Support Silicon HW programs through multiple phases of the silicon lifecycle, with end-to-end chip execution from concept to silicon. 
 - Good understanding with firmware codebases, compilers, kernels, serving stacks and model architectures. 
 - Familiar with driving silicon design for subsystems and/or top-level functions with ASICs and SOCs from an architecture specification to production silicon including memory subsystems and interconnects: scale up, scale out, scale across, power management , liquid cooling at rack scale level, deep system level observability & telemetry and dependent impact into Gen AI and LLM level performance/tco/execution KPIs 
• Develop technical recommendations for what Intel should build, optimize, enable, partner on to meet AI customer requirements based on deep understanding of customer use cases, workload performance, and ML systems research. 
• Benchmark and compare relevant AI hardware and infrastructure approaches across performance, power efficiency, cost, programmability, memory hierarchy, scalability, ecosystem maturity, and workload fit. 
• Develop technical models, simulations, prototypes, or analysis tools to evaluate hardware/software trade offs for AI workloads. 
• Investigate system bottlenecks across compute, memory, networking, storage, and software orchestration, and propose methods to improve end-to-end AI workload performance. 
• Work with Intel technical teams and external ISVs to collect data on model requirements, inference bottlenecks, deployment challenges, hardware optimization opportunities, and customer priorities. 
• Engage with AI software ecosystem partners, including model providers, inference-engine developers, cloud providers, framework teams, and ISVs, to understand how their stacks interact with underlying hardware. 
• Good understanding of modern AI software layers, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, model serving, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Kubernetes, and Neocloud design efficiencies. 
• Present findings through architecture diagrams, benchmark analyses, technical reports, design recommendations, and executive-ready presentations. 

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Strong foundation in computer architecture, operating systems, distributed systems, parallel computing, AI/ML systems, high-performance computing, or systems software.
• Familiarity with generative AI models and inference concepts, including transformers, attention, token generation, model serving, quantization, batching, KV cache, long-context workloads, and latency-throughput trade-offs.
• Experience programming in one or more of the languages - C, C++, Rust, CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, or a comparable low-level or performance-oriented language.
• Strong academic performance with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher required.

Preferred Qualifications
• Coursework, research, or project experience in computer architecture, VLSI, digital design, ASIC/FPGA systems, compilers, kernel development, GPU programming, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or AI systems.
• Experience using profiling, tracing, or benchmarking tools to evaluate CPU, GPU, accelerator, network, memory, storage, or software performance.
• Familiarity with AI hardware platforms such as Intel Xeon processors, Intel GPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, TPUs, custom AI accelerators, FPGAs, or domain-specific inference ASICs.
• Understanding of memory hierarchies and performance concepts, including cache behavior, DRAM, HBM, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, latency, data locality, DMA, and data movement.
• Experience with inference frameworks or runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Triton, or Ray.
• Familiarity with AI systems infrastructure such as Linux, containers, Kubernetes, distributed storage, RDMA over Ethernet, InfiniBand, CXL, PCIe, NVMe, UALink/eSUN based interconnects, silicon photonics and cluster-management software.
• Some experience with simulation, modeling, emulation, RTL, FPGA prototyping, firmware, driver development, or low-level debugging.
• Some experience contributing to open-source systems, ML infrastructure, compiler, kernel, framework, or performance-engineering projects.

jobs.title: Deep Learning Model and System Optimization Engineering Intern – 2027
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Deep Learning Performance Engineer Intern to join our team. Large language models are transforming how people interact with computing, while placing unprecedented demands on inference performance, memory efficiency, scalability, and deployment cost.

Our team develops GPU-accelerated software for deep learning inference. We work across model architectures, algorithms, numerical representations, inference systems, and GPU architectures to continuously improve the performance and deployment capabilities of large language models on NVIDIA GPUs. Our work contributes to inference frameworks such as TensorRT-LLM and helps bring state-of-the-art models to production efficiently. We are looking for outstanding interns who are passionate about large language model inference, low-precision computing, GPU performance optimization, and hardware-software co-design.

What you’ll be doing:
• Analyze and optimize inference performance across model architecture, numerical precision, GPU kernels, memory systems, and end-to-end serving frameworks.
• Develop low-bit quantization techniques for model weights, activations, attention operands, and KV caches.
• Explore numerical formats and mixed-precision strategies involving FP8, NVFP4, MXFP4, and other emerging low-precision formats while preserving model accuracy and capabilities.
• Design and evaluate techniques for KV cache compression, sparsification, hierarchical storage, and reuse across inference requests.
• Optimize the inference of model architectures including MHA, GQA, MQA, MLA, sliding-window attention, sparse attention, linear attention, and state space models.
• Investigate model-system co-optimization techniques such as speculative decoding, state reuse, and computation reuse.
• Build performance models and optimization strategies for long-context inference and agentic workloads, with a focus on throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency, memory efficiency, and deployment cost.
• Collaborate closely with model, framework, kernel, library, system software, and GPU architecture teams to influence the design of future models, software platforms, and hardware architectures.

What we need to see:
• Pursuing an MS or PhD from a leading university in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with an expected graduation date in 2028.
• Available to work as an intern for at least three months and at least four days per week.
• Strong understanding of Transformer architectures and large language model inference, including core components such as attention, MoE, and KV cache management.
• Experience with at least one large language model inference framework, such as TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, or a comparable framework.
• Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with strong experimental design, data analysis, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with at least one GPU programming technology, such as CUDA C/C++, Triton, or a comparable parallel programming framework.
• Understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, Tensor Cores, parallel computing, and performance analysis.
• Familiarity with low-precision computing concepts, including quantization error, scaling, rounding, clipping, group or block quantization, and mixed-precision computation.
• Ability to evaluate an optimization technique across model accuracy, kernel performance, and end-to-end inference performance.
• Good communication, technical writing, organization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Hands-on experience optimizing kernels or end-to-end workloads on NVIDIA GPUs.
• Research or engineering experience in model quantization, KV cache optimization, efficient attention, speculative decoding, or long-context inference.
• Contributions to inference frameworks, GPU libraries, compilers, or other relevant open-source projects.
• Experience profiling and optimizing production-scale LLM inference workloads.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity among our current and future employees and do not discriminate in our hiring or employment practices on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Power Analysis and Optimization Engineer  - New College Graduate 2027
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is committed not only to delivering outstanding chip performance but also to continuously improving power efficiency across every product. Performance per watt is critical to our success.
The Power Analysis and Optimization team works closely with architecture, design, verification, and physical-design teams to define power targets for architectural changes and new features. We identify power-saving opportunities throughout the ASIC design process—from architecture definition through place and route—and resolve power issues that could affect functionality or performance.
Joining the team, you will contribute to ASIC power analysis, modeling, optimization, and flow automation. Your work will help make NVIDIA GPU and SoC products more energy-efficient and maintain their leadership in performance per watt.

What you’ll be doing
• Develop IP-level power models to estimate the impact of architectural changes and new features.
• Analyze power consumption across different workloads and application scenarios.
• Collaborate with architects and design teams to define power targets and evaluate power, performance, and area tradeoffs.
• Use internally developed flows and industry-standard tools to identify power inefficiencies and optimization opportunities.
• Work with RTL and physical-design teams to implement and validate power optimizations.
• Investigate power regressions and determine their architectural, RTL, workload, or physical-design root causes.
• Develop scripts, automation flows, and AI-assisted solutions to improve the efficiency and scalability of power analysis.
• Explore new methodologies for power modeling, analysis, attribution, and optimization.

What we need to see
• Expected to graduate in 2027 with a MS or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of digital circuit design, computer architecture, or ASIC design methodology.
• Understanding of power-consumption fundamentals and common low-power design techniques.
• Programming or scripting experience in Python, C++, Tcl, or a similar language.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
• Familiarity with ASIC power-analysis tools such as PrimeTime PX or PowerArtist.
• Experience with power modeling, workload analysis, power attribution, or low-power design.
• Experience analyzing power, performance, and area tradeoffs.
• Experience developing or integrating AI agents, engineering skills, or AI-assisted automation workflows.
 
NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology industry’s most desirable employers, bringing together some of the world’s most talented and innovative people. Are you creative, analytical, and eager to improve the power efficiency of cutting-edge GPU and SoC designs? Do you enjoy understanding complex architectures, analyzing power behavior, and finding opportunities to improve performance per watt? If so, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Intern
jobs.description:
Sheffield or London | 2 days per week in the office, 3 days working remotely

8-week placement (November - January with break for Christmas)



ABOUT THE ROLE

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

 - Work on well-scoped analysis and data tasks, with guidance and peer review from the team.

 - Use SQL to explore data, answer questions and build simple, reusable datasets.

 - Help create or improve dashboards that allow teams to monitor key metrics and performance.

 - Check data quality, investigate unexpected results and clearly document your assumptions.

 - Speak with stakeholders to understand their questions and help translate them into structured analysis.

 - Use appropriate charts and written summaries to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Contribute to an individual or team project that demonstrates what you have learned and creates value for the business.

 - Take part in team ceremonies, knowledge-sharing sessions and regular one-to-one coaching.

 - Use AI tools thoughtfully to support tasks such as learning, exploring approaches, drafting code or documentation, while checking outputs and protecting confidential data.



ABOUT YOU

We would like you to be:

 - Interested in data analysis and in using data to understand and solve real business problems.

 - Comfortable working with numbers and able to break a question into logical steps.

 - Familiar with SQL, spreadsheets, Python or another analytical tool through study, work experience or personal projects.

 - Able to explain your thinking and communicate clearly with people who may not have a technical background.

 - Curious about how businesses work, willing to ask questions and keen to investigate why something has happened.

 - Careful with detail, particularly when checking data and deciding whether a result can be trusted.

 - Open to feedback, collaboration and learning new tools and ways of working.

 - Familiar with AI tools and able to use them responsibly to support your work, rather than accepting their output without question.

It would also be useful if you have:

 - Completed a university, college, apprenticeship, bootcamp or self-directed project involving data.

 - Created a dashboard, report or analysis and can describe the question, tools, approach and outcome.

 - Used an AI tool in a personal, academic or external project and can explain what it helped you do, how you checked its output and what you learned.

 - Some familiarity with databases, data visualisation, statistics or cloud-based data tools.

You do not need to meet every point or have experience with our exact technology stack. We are more interested in your potential, curiosity and ability to learn than in a long list of tools.



WHAT TO TELL US IN YOUR APPLICATION

We would love to hear about a data, coding, research or AI-assisted project you have worked on. This can come from your studies, employment, volunteering or something you built independently. Tell us:

 - What problem or question you were trying to address.

 - Which tools or technologies you used and why.

 - How you checked the quality or accuracy of your work.

 - What the outcome was and what you would improve next time.

 - If you used AI, how you used it, how you validated its output and where your own judgement was important.




WHY YOU'LL LOVE BEING A GOODLORDIAN

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

 - Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1558877. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

 - Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

 - 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

 - Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

 - Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics




WHAT’S NEXT?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.


Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. 

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.



No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

About the Team

DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We’re looking for experienced engineers to join our fast-growing engineering team to help us develop a 24x7 global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.

About the Role

This intern will report into a manager on the Assignment Engine team. We believe interns are essential to our mission of attracting and retaining top talent. During the 12 week Operations Research internship, interns will be completely immersed in their teams and will have the opportunity to develop, maintain & ship products. As an intern, you will directly impact our business by collaborating with your team to solve real problems for our customers.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. to be considered for this position. F-1 students are eligible if they are using Curricular Practical Training (CPT). DoorDash does not support students on J-1 visas at this time.

This position will be hosted in person at the DoorDash office in Sunnyvale, CA. #LI-Onsite

• Analyze data to understand each delivery at the lowest level of detail, perform cutting-edge research, and inspire new lines of work

• Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product managers, business operators, and more to develop cross-cutting and scalable solutions to guide value for our consumers, dashers, and merchants

• Receive actionable feedback from your mentor and team members

• Socialize with and learn from colleagues all across the company, through events including Lunch and Learns with executive members, game nights, movie nights, intern offsites, and more

• Have research or industry experience working on complex optimization problems through mathematical programming or metaheuristics

• Have strong programming fundamentals, experience in object-oriented and/or functional programming languages, and a solid understanding of algorithms

jobs.title: Signal Integrity Solutions Architect Intern
jobs.description:
Signal Integrity Solutions Architect Intern 

As a Signal Integrity Intern on the Solutions Architecture team, you will model system-level channels across a wide range of compute and switch architectures to determine what is feasible for next-generation AI infrastructure. You will uncover the constraints, bottlenecks, and limitations that shape rack-scale designs, and turn those findings into clear guidance on what is possible. 

Your analyses will directly influence Astera Labs' product roadmap and feature set, ensuring our connectivity solutions meet system-level signal integrity goals as AI data rates keep climbing. You will work alongside solutions architects, hardware engineers, and silicon teams at a hyper-growth company whose purpose-built connectivity powers the world's leading AI platforms. 

Responsibilities 

• System Channel Modeling 

• Build and run system-level channel models for a variety of compute and switch architectures 

• Evaluate the feasibility of next-generation architectures across PCIe, Ethernet, and UALink interconnects 

• Identify constraints, bottlenecks, and limitations in end-to-end channel performance 

• Sensitivity and Trade-off Analysis 

• Perform sensitivity analyses to understand interaction effects between channel parameters 

• Determine the main drivers of channel performance and quantify their impact on margin 

• Explore design trade-offs to define what is achievable at the system level 

• Roadmap and Cross-Functional Influence 

• Translate modeling results into system-driven inputs that shape product roadmaps and feature sets 

• Partner with solutions architecture, hardware engineering, and silicon engineering teams to align on signal integrity goals 

• Document findings and present results to technical teams and stakeholders in clear, concise formats 

Basic Qualifications 

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field 

• Coursework or project experience in signal integrity, transmission lines, electromagnetics, or high-speed digital design 

• Basic understanding of high-speed serial link concepts such as insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, and equalization 

• Familiarity with the physical layer of high-speed interconnect standards such as PCIe or Ethernet 

• Proficiency with a scripting or analysis tool such as Python or MATLAB for data processing and modeling 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly 

Preferred Qualifications 

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field 

• Hands-on experience with channel simulation tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, or similar) or S-parameter analysis 

• Familiarity with PCIe Gen 6 or Gen 7, high-speed Ethernet, or UALink 

• Experience with statistical or design-of-experiments methods for sensitivity analysis 

• Curiosity and initiative to learn quickly in a fast-paced, collaborative environment 

Internship experience and compensation

This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.

Equal opportunity

Astera Labs is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage anyone with relevant experience to apply.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a motivated Software Engineering Intern to join our engineering team for the summer. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced software engineers to design, develop, test, and support software solutions that contribute to advanced semiconductor process control and inspection systems. This internship provides hands-on experience with real-world projects, modern development tools, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Participate in the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of software applications and features.
• Develop and execute unit tests, automation scripts, and validation procedures.
• Analyze software defects, troubleshoot issues, and assist in implementing solutions.

• Utilize development tools, source control systems, and CI/CD workflows.
• Document software designs, test results, and technical findings.
• Present project progress and results to engineering teams and management.

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience with one or more programming languages such as C++, C#, Python, Java, or JavaScript.
• Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with software development tools such as Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, or similar IDEs.
• Knowledge of software testing methodologies and automation frameworks.
• Exposure to AI/ML, computer vision, image processing, or data analytics.
• Familiarity with Agile development practices.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges.  We are seeking interns for the Summer 2027 season to join our R&D team. You will work on the firmware that acts as the brain stem for our autonomous drones and accessory products. jobs.description:
About Carrier
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About this role
Carrier has an opening for a Computer Scientist or Software Engineer to serve as a vital member of the eDesign team. This team is responsible for developing and maintaining software-based tools used to design and optimize the energy efficiency of Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems for commercial buildings. eDesign tools are used by thousands of engineering firms worldwide in their business. This position is based in Syracuse, NY.
The candidate’s responsibilities include but are not limited to
• Developing desktop application software for HVAC system design and energy modeling.
• Analyzing software requirements and designing software solutions.
• Coding to implement solutions.
• Working collaboratively with other developers for planning, design & code review, test planning, etc.
• Performing unit and system testing.
• Participating in Agile development process.
• Participating in team project meetings.
• Evaluating and identifying new libraries, tools, and technologies for use by the software development team, as needed.
Basic Qualifications 
• Must be currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or any engineering field (junior or senior level)
• Must have an overall GPA of 3.0 or higher 
• Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship 
Preferred Qualifications 
• Previous internship experience preferred
• Understanding of object-oriented design and analysis (OOD and OOA)
• Technology experience including Microsoft Visual Studio, SQL, XML, JSON, WPF, XAML.
• Demonstrated experience working on independent, self-motivated tasks, with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Experience with software development principles and processes
• Experience using agentic AI tools for software development
• Excellent verbal, writing, and presentation communication skills.

Pay Range
The annual salary for this position is between $43,500.00 - $87,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.
Other Compensation
This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements. 
Benefits

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

This is an existing vacancy.

Your Team, Your Impact
Central Engineering AMS-IP team provides leading-edge SerDes PHY solutions and other Analog Mixed-Signal IPs to support all Marvell products.
What You Can Expect
Design Verification Intern is responsible for the design verification and evaluation of digital circuits in high-speed data communication ICs. The candidate will be involved in verification plan development, test environment setup, modeling, testcase development and execution. He or she will be responsible for block and /or chip level verification.

The responsibilities include but not limited to.

• Use and improve UVM DV environment

• Collaborate with Analog/DSP/Digital Design/FW/AE teams to deliver the competitive SerDes IP solutions for all the Marvell product lines.
• Provide the support to the product teams, for both pre and post silicon

jobs.description:
Are you a problem solver looking for a hands-on internship position with a market-leading company that will help develop your career and reward you intellectually and professionally?

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.

ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.

At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.

Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.

About the Role
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Design Verification Intern to join our CSS DV team. You will work alongside experienced design and verification engineers to validate IP and subsystem-level designs for high-performance semiconductor products in consumer markets.
This role offers hands-on experience with System Verilog based verification, simulation environments, testbench development, and functional coverage Ideal for students or early-career engineers exploring a path into ASIC/SoC development.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in developing and executing verification plans for digital IP blocks and subsystems.
• Develop, enhance, and maintain testbench components using System Verilog, UVM, or similar methodologies.
• Run simulations, analyze results, identify failures, and help debug issues.
• Create directed and constrained-random tests to validate functionality and corner cases.
• Perform functional, code, and assertion coverage reporting, review, and tracking.
• Work closely with design and architecture teams to clarify specifications and ensure coverage completeness.
• Support automation flows and continuous regression infrastructure with scripting.
• Document verification environments, methodologies, and results.
Required Skills & Qualifications
• Pursuing a Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Strong understanding of digital logic design and computer architecture.
• Coursework or practical exposure to:• Verilog/System Verilog or VHDL
• RTL design principles
• Simulation workflows

• Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Perl, Tcl, Bash, etc.).
• Good analytical and debugging skills.
• Strong communication and willingness to learn in a fast-paced engineering environment.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with UVM-based verification.
• Familiarity with EDA tools (Xcelium, etc.).
• Knowledge of:• SoC design concepts
• Bus protocols (AXI, AHB, APB)
• Assertions (SVA)
• Coverage-driven verification

What You Will Learn
• Industry-standard ASIC/SoC verification methodologies.
• Writing and debugging System Verilog-UVM testbench components.
• Simulation and coverage-driven verification flows.
• Collaboration with digital design, architecture, and modelling teams.
Why Join Us
• Gain hands-on verification experience with real silicon IP.
• Work with experienced engineers who provide mentorship and guidance.
• Exposure to modern EDA tools and methodologies.
• Opportunity to convert to full-time/graduate roles.
• Collaborative, learning-driven workplace culture.

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

jobs.title: Technology Placement Analyst Intern - Application Development
jobs.description:
You are the brain behind our work …
At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Technology Placement Analyst Programme is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!
 
Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilising a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
 
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…
We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Placement Analyst Program starts in June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Placement Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology. 
 
Your time here will look like this... 
You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
• Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
• Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
• Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
• Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.

No matter your team placement, as a member in our programme, you can expect:
· Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
· Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programmes that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.
· Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
 
To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:
· Graduation between Dec 2028 and July 2029.
· Educational background: Pursuing Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
· A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
· Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
· Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
· Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
· Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
· Work Authorisation: Authorised to work in UK without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
 
Who we think will be a great fit...
A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
 
This program is ideal for those who:
· Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
· Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
· Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

Job Description
International Insights, Analytics and Commercial Operations – Summer Intern
Paddington, London UK
 
Why Vertex? 
 
Are you ready to make a real impact? At Vertex, our mission is to tackle serious diseases and to change lives, for the better, for the future. Our aim is to give you the skills, insights, and career guidance to be an important part of that future; to turn your potential into progression. As a Vertex Summer Intern, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented teams, and learn from industry leaders. We’re passionate about innovation, inclusion, and supporting your growth—inside and outside the lab. 
 
Real Projects: You’ll work on assignments that make a real impact, not just busy work. 
 
Mentorship & Networking: Connect with leaders and peers who want to see you succeed through professional networks, connections, and collaborations that will shape your longer-term career. 
 
Inclusive Culture: Collaboration and inclusion are embedded in everything we do. 
 
Career Launchpad: Build skills, explore career paths, and get guidance for your future career. 
 
Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 
 
What you will be doing: 

We are recruiting roles to support with projects across three functions within the IIACO (International Insights, Analytics and Commercial Operations) team. A successful candidate will need to demonstrate the skills and experience aligned with at least one of these functions:
 
Insights and Analytics
Supporting the development of commercial analytics, forecasting, and Key Performance Indicator reporting that inform strategic decision-making across the International business. Candidates will gain exposure to large-scale datasets, statistical analysis, and reporting automation, as well as emerging applications of AI and advanced analytics to drive efficiency and insight generation. This function suits candidates with strong quantitative skills and an interest in applying data-driven thinking to real commercial challenge.
 
Commercial Excellence
Focused on supporting our field forces by leveraging our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system and supporting field execution metrics. Projects with this team look at impact of customer facing activities so successful candidates will need to be comfortable analyzing data and reporting on the impact of activities.
 
Digital Customer Engagement
Driving the development and execution of digital marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies and tactics. jobs.title: Architecture Research Intern - Predictive Modelling & Simulations
jobs.description:
PREDICTING WHAT HAPPENS NEXT IS JUST THE beginning OF YOUR JOURNEY. 

The Opportunity
If building models that help people make better decisions, understanding uncertainty, and turning complex systems into meaningful predictions sounds like your kind of challenge, we’re looking for you. 
 
As an Architecture Research Intern, you’ll use simulation and queueing theory to understand how business changes (new service channels, process redesigns, demand shifts) ripple through operations and shape the customer experience. You’ll contribute to initiatives in Queue Management, Estimated Wait Time, and Predictive Simulation. From forecasting wait times to modelling the dynamics of complex operational systems, you’ll help develop solutions that improve experiences for our members. 

Your background might be in queueing theory, simulation science, applied mathematics, stochastic processes, differential equations, or optimization. Either way, you’ll apply your research skills to real-world problems where uncertainty isn’t a complication, it’s part of the solution. 
 
*This role is for a 12-month opportunity with the possibility of extension.*
 
The Team You’ve Been Looking For
AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance, and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy: 
• Competitive wage
• Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
• Ongoing professional development
• Vacation earnings paid out with each pay period
• Flexible work models that makes sense for your lifestyle

For us, curiosity fuels innovation. We value people who are eager to explore new ideas and who are comfortable putting emerging technologies into practice. We see experience with AI‑powered tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar platforms as a real plus - especially when it’s used to work smarter, increase efficiency, and find better ways to get things done.

Who You Are
• You’re fascinated by uncertainty and enjoy understanding how complex systems behave over time. 
• You see queues everywhere and naturally think in terms of arrivals, service, congestion, and waiting. 
• You naturally think in terms of probabilities, outcomes, and trade-offs. 
• You ask “what if we changed this?” and know how to build a model that answers it rigorously. 
• You’re comfortable working with incomplete information and building models that help make sense of it. 
• You can balance model fidelity against computational cost and decision deadlines. 
• You communicate technical concepts clearly and can explain uncertainty without creating confusion. 
• You’re analytical, curious, and motivated by solving real-world problems. 
• You enjoy collaborating and know the best solutions come from combining different perspectives. 
• You love turning research ideas into practical models that create measurable value. 

How You’ll Make an Impact
• Contribute to predictive models and simulation frameworks that support queue management and estimated wait-time forecasting. 
• Apply queueing theory to model customer flow, congestion, and waiting (for example multi-server queues, priority queues, queues with abandonment and retrials, and queueing networks) and use it to derive fast, interpretable wait-time estimates. 
• Build simulation models (discrete-event, agent-based, and/or system dynamics) to evaluate how proposed business changes affect wait times, service levels, abandonment, and overall customer experience before they are implemented. 
• Compare analytical queueing results against detailed simulation and real operational data to determine where theory holds, where it breaks down, and which approach best suits each decision. 
• Formulate and analyze continuous-time models of system behavior using ordinary and stochastic differential equations (for example fluid and diffusion approximations of queues, including heavy-traffic limits based on reflected Brownian motion), and validate them against detailed simulation and real operational data. 
• Design and apply time-constrained optimization algorithms (such as simulation-based optimization, parameter tuning, and anytime or heuristic methods) that deliver good decisions within real operational time limits. 
• Design, test, and refine models that capture uncertainty, customer behavior, and system dynamics. 
• Apply probabilistic and statistical techniques to evaluate performance, calibrate and validate models, and improve predictive accuracy. 
• Run scenario, sensitivity, and what-if analyses that help business leaders understand bottlenecks, trade-offs, and future outcomes. 
• Analyze results and communicate key insights, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
• Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and business teams to turn theory into practical, deployable solutions. 
• Explore innovative approaches that improve decision-making across AMA’s products, services, and operations. 

What You Bring to the Table
• You’re currently pursuing, or have completed, an MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, or a closely related quantitative discipline. 
• You have in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience of queueing theory, including Markovian and general queues (M/M/c, M/G/1, G/G/c), Little’s Law, queues with abandonment and priorities, queueing networks, transient and steady-state analysis, and heavy-traffic and diffusion approximations. You can fit queueing models to real data and judge when their assumptions hold. 
• You have in-depth knowledge of simulation science, including discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation, Monte Carlo methods, variance reduction, input modelling, model verification and validation, and experimental design for simulation studies. 
• You have a strong foundation in differential equations (ordinary, partial, and/or stochastic), including Brownian motion and diffusion processes, Fokker-Planck equations, and numerical methods for SDEs, and can apply them to model the dynamics of real systems. 
• You have working knowledge of optimization, particularly time-constrained or real-time settings: simulation optimization, stochastic and dynamic programming, metaheuristics, or anytime algorithms. 
• You have a strong foundation in probability and stochastic processes, with experience in one or more of the following: 
• • Markov chains and Markov decision processes 
• Renewal and point processes (for example Poisson and non-homogeneous Poisson arrival processes)
• Statistical mechanics 
• Stochastic differential equations 

• You have strong statistical judgment and understand the nuances of uncertainty, including the distinction between prediction intervals and confidence intervals. 
• You’re proficient in Python and can independently translate models and research concepts into reliable, well-tested code (for example NumPy, SciPy, SimPy, and optimization libraries). 
 
Belonging Matters Here
AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ama.ab.ca. We’ll work with you to feel supported throughout your journey with us.
