jobs.title: Architecture Research Intern - Optimization & Decision Modelling
jobs.description:
TURNING complex DECISIONS INTO SMARTER experiences IS JUST THE BEGINNING OF YOUR journey. 

The Opportunity
If solving challenging optimization problems, building intelligent decision-making models, and applying advanced mathematics to real-world products sounds like your kind of opportunity, we’re looking for you. 
 
As an Architecture Research Intern, you’ll apply graph theory, optimization, and decision support methods to two big questions: how can we build a dynamic Graph Network of Opportunities that adapts as needs change, and how can we enhance the travel experience for our members? You’ll help transform complex constraints, preferences, and data into practical solutions that create exceptional experiences for users. Whether your passion lies in optimization theory, graph algorithms, combinatorics, operations research, or mathematical modelling, you’ll have the opportunity to see your research move beyond the whiteboard and into production environments.
 
*This role is for a 12-month opportunity with the possibility of extension.*
 
The Team You’ve Been Looking For
AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance, and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!
Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy: 
• Competitive wage
• Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
• Ongoing professional development
• Vacation earnings paid out with each pay period
• Flexible work models that makes sense for your lifestyle

For us, curiosity fuels innovation. We value people who are eager to explore new ideas and who are comfortable putting emerging technologies into practice. We see experience with AI‑powered tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar platforms as a real plus - especially when it’s used to work smarter, increase efficiency, and find better ways to get things done.

Who You Are
• You’re naturally curious and love tackling complex problems that don’t have obvious answers. 
• You enjoy moving between theory and practice, transforming mathematical ideas into working solutions. 
• You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and breaking large challenges into manageable pieces. 
• You communicate complex concepts clearly and can adapt your message for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
• You thrive in collaborative environments where ideas are shared, challenged, and improved. 
• You have a passion for optimization, decision science, and finding elegant solutions to difficult problems. 
• You’re curious about what makes a trip memorable and how technology can make travel simpler, smarter, and more personal. 
• You’re eager to learn, experiment, and contribute to projects that create real-world impact. 

How You’ll Make an Impact
• Research and develop a dynamic Graph Network of Opportunities that adapts to changing member needs, demand, availability, and constraints. 
• Apply graph theory, network analysis, and optimization to model the relationships between opportunities, members, and the resources that connect them, and to determine how the network should reconfigure in response to change. 
• Design the architecture of the network, including its data model, scalability, and update mechanisms, so it can evolve from research prototype to production system. 
• Build decision support models that evaluate trade-offs across competing objectives (cost, convenience, quality, availability, member preferences) and produce clear, explainable recommendations. 
• Research ways to enhance travel experiences, including personalized travel recommendations, smarter routing and scheduling, and better matching of travellers to relevant opportunities. 
• Develop mathematical models that optimize decisions, recommendations, and system performance. 
• Design, test, and evaluate algorithms related to optimization, routing, scheduling, resource allocation, or recommendation systems. 
• Collaborate with engineers and researchers to transition concepts from research into practical applications. 
• Analyze experimental results and recommend improvements based on quantitative evidence. 
• Communicate modelling approaches, assumptions, and findings to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise. 
• Explore emerging techniques and contribute innovative ideas that help advance our products and capabilities.

What You Bring to the Table
• You’re currently pursuing, or have completed, an MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. 
• You have expertise in one or more of the following areas: • Graph theory and network science (including dynamic and evolving graphs) 
• Optimization theory (including dynamic or stochastic optimization) 
• Decision support and multi-criteria decision analysis 
• Combinatorics 
• Numerical methods
• Operations research 
• Statistical physics related to optimization 

• You’re proficient in Python and can independently translate models, algorithms, and research concepts into functional code. 
• You have a foundational understanding of cloud computing platforms such as AWS or similar environments. 
• You’re able to explain complex models and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a way that builds understanding and confidence. 
• Experience publishing research, completing thesis work, or applying advanced quantitative methods to real-world problems is considered an asset. 
• Experience with travel, logistics, transportation, or marketplace/network problems is also an asset. 
 
Belonging Matters Here

The Future Talent Program within our Research & Development Division Data, AI, and Genome Sciences (DAGS) Department is offering internships that last 10-12 weeks. jobs.description:
Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology. 

About Copart 
Copart is a global leader in online vehicle auctions, connecting buyers and sellers worldwide. We're transforming the automotive remarketing industry through innovative technology solutions that process millions of vehicles annually. jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.   

Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

Job Description:

US Campus Summer 2027 Intern Job Description 

You are as unique as your background, experience, and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families, and communities around the world.
What’s it like to work at Sun Life?
You’ll find it dynamic and highly professional; collaborative and supportive. We encourage career mobility. Sun Life is also a socially responsible employer, supporting the communities in which we live and work, with a globally recognized commitment to the environment and sustainability.
This internship will be hybrid, and interns must be located near one of our US based offices – Wellesley, MA; Kansas City, MO; Hartford, CT; Portland, ME; Milwaukee, WI.
The Role 
This role will provide advanced analytics support within the Business Analytics function that applies the power of data with machine learning to improve business outcomes across the Health and Risk Solutions business. This team is expected to work closely with the other teams across the organization, including functional teams and the analytic agile squads supporting AI use cases within various business domains. This position reports to the Director of Advanced Analytics Transformation and offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientist on high impact projects. Responsibilities include assisting in the development and monitoring of predictive models and AI solutions to support our pricing, underwriting and clinical review processes, as assigned. Additional responsibilities may include applying machine learning techniques to explore ways to streamline and automate aspects of these processes.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
• Support the application of data science techniques to solve business problems across various analytical areas, including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and visualization.
• Collaborate with the team to develop, validate, and maintain high-quality, robust predictive models and AI solutions. 
• Utilize multiple sources of data, including structured and unstructured data, along with variety of machine learning techniques to improve model performance and interpretability.
• Follow team standards for writing, organizing, and documenting codes to ensure project work is reproducible and easy to be understood. 
• Interpret data and model outputs to generate clear actionable insights and recommendations that drive business decisions.
• Other duties as assigned
Core skill sets needed for this role:
• Strong academic foundation in developing and implementing data science techniques
• Strong knowledge of statistical and data science techniques, including machine learning, data visualization, and experience with databases
• Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, modeling, and automation
• Experience with machine learning framework and libraries
• Commitment to data compliance, model governance and security protocols
• Strong problem-solving skills and effective communication, with an ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience
• Experience with generative AI, including prompt engineering, RAG workflows and integrating LLMs into business processes, is a plus

The Candidate
To be eligible for an internship at Sun Life, you must meet the following requirements:
• Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university during the time of internship (June 2027 – August 2027)
• Must be an undergraduate or graduate student in statistical, mathematical, or technical field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Actuarial Science)
• Eligible to legally work in the United States
• Ability to work full-time (40 hours/week) during Intern session

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. Internship Program Overview: 
Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. 

Summary of Role: 
GlobalFoundries is seeking a motivated college intern to join our Tapeout Operations team. Tapeout Engineering works with GF customers to guide final design preparation before manufacturing, and the intern will work alongside experienced Tapeout Engineers to support the final verification and release of customer semiconductor designs to manufacturing. Key areas of the internship include supporting customer design verification, contributing to quality and cycle-time improvement projects, analyzing data, and gaining hands-on experience with industry-leading EDA tools and foundry tapeout processes. This role provides an opportunity to learn how semiconductor designs transition from design completion to manufacturing while gaining exposure to advanced technologies, manufacturing processes, and real-world engineering challenges. 

Essential Responsibilities include: 
• Support the development and improvement of automation scripts and tools for data handling and job submission. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including design, manufacturing, and IT. 
• Assist in analyzing and documenting tapeout workflows. 
• Collect and analyze process metrics to identify bottlenecks and propose improvements. 
• Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for tapeout-related issues.

• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Summary of Role: 
Join the MIPS CPU IP Engineering organization for hands-on experience in the design and verification of advanced RISC-V processor IP. You will work with CPU architects, RTL designers, and verification engineers on CPU microarchitecture, RTL implementation, functional verification, performance analysis, automation, and debug in Austin, Texas or Santa Clara, California.

jobs.title: AI Hardware Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
About the Job
Intel is seeking exceptional Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, and AI/ML students to join an AI Hardware Engineering internship focused on the future of AI inference and AI infrastructure with hardware/software co-design expertise. 

This internship approaches AI infrastructure as a hardware/software co-design challenge. The intern will analyze how model architecture, inference behavior, memory movement, data-center constraints, and software stacks influence end-to-end customer outcomes, including throughput, latency, time-to-first-token, tokens per second, power consumption, utilization, total cost of ownership, and deployability. 

The successful candidate will be technically hands-on, capable of independent research and analysis, and comfortable working within a highly technical team of researchers and engineers addressing complex AI hardware and infrastructure challenges. 

What You Will Do 
• Conduct technical research on the next generation of AI infrastructure, including CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, ASICs, memory systems, networking, storage, rack-scale architecture, power delivery, cooling, and cluster management. 
• Analyze GenAI and agentic AI workloads to understand their hardware implications, including transformer architecture based inference, mixture-of-experts architectures, multimodal models, real-time interactive inference, and distributed serving. 
• Evaluate the hardware behavior of AI inference pipelines, including the distinct demands of prompt processing/prefill and token generation/decode, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, KV-cache management, compute utilization, interconnect bandwidth, and latency. For example, cluster architecture around optimizing both prefill and decode through hardware, memory, and system co-design. 
• Identify product and system gaps that may limit Intel's ability to serve AI customers effectively, including hardware capabilities, developer tooling, performance libraries, reference architectures, deployment models, observability, and ecosystem enablement. 
 - Expertise in modern high-performance CPU, GPU, or AI accelerator architecture and hardware/software interactions. 
 - Support Silicon HW programs through multiple phases of the silicon lifecycle, with end-to-end chip execution from concept to silicon. 
 - Good understanding with firmware codebases, compilers, kernels, serving stacks and model architectures. 
 - Familiar with driving silicon design for subsystems and/or top-level functions with ASICs and SOCs from an architecture specification to production silicon including memory subsystems and interconnects: scale up, scale out, scale across, power management , liquid cooling at rack scale level, deep system level observability & telemetry and dependent impact into Gen AI and LLM level performance/tco/execution KPIs 
• Develop technical recommendations for what Intel should build, optimize, enable, partner on to meet AI customer requirements based on deep understanding of customer use cases, workload performance, and ML systems research. 
• Benchmark and compare relevant AI hardware and infrastructure approaches across performance, power efficiency, cost, programmability, memory hierarchy, scalability, ecosystem maturity, and workload fit. 
• Develop technical models, simulations, prototypes, or analysis tools to evaluate hardware/software trade offs for AI workloads. 
• Investigate system bottlenecks across compute, memory, networking, storage, and software orchestration, and propose methods to improve end-to-end AI workload performance. 
• Work with Intel technical teams and external ISVs to collect data on model requirements, inference bottlenecks, deployment challenges, hardware optimization opportunities, and customer priorities. 
• Engage with AI software ecosystem partners, including model providers, inference-engine developers, cloud providers, framework teams, and ISVs, to understand how their stacks interact with underlying hardware. 
• Good understanding of modern AI software layers, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, model serving, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Kubernetes, and Neocloud design efficiencies. 
• Present findings through architecture diagrams, benchmark analyses, technical reports, design recommendations, and executive-ready presentations. 

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Strong foundation in computer architecture, operating systems, distributed systems, parallel computing, AI/ML systems, high-performance computing, or systems software.
• Familiarity with generative AI models and inference concepts, including transformers, attention, token generation, model serving, quantization, batching, KV cache, long-context workloads, and latency-throughput trade-offs.
• Experience programming in one or more of the languages - C, C++, Rust, CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, or a comparable low-level or performance-oriented language.
• Strong academic performance with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher required.

Preferred Qualifications
• Coursework, research, or project experience in computer architecture, VLSI, digital design, ASIC/FPGA systems, compilers, kernel development, GPU programming, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or AI systems.
• Experience using profiling, tracing, or benchmarking tools to evaluate CPU, GPU, accelerator, network, memory, storage, or software performance.
• Familiarity with AI hardware platforms such as Intel Xeon processors, Intel GPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, TPUs, custom AI accelerators, FPGAs, or domain-specific inference ASICs.
• Understanding of memory hierarchies and performance concepts, including cache behavior, DRAM, HBM, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, latency, data locality, DMA, and data movement.
• Experience with inference frameworks or runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Triton, or Ray.
• Familiarity with AI systems infrastructure such as Linux, containers, Kubernetes, distributed storage, RDMA over Ethernet, InfiniBand, CXL, PCIe, NVMe, UALink/eSUN based interconnects, silicon photonics and cluster-management software.
• Some experience with simulation, modeling, emulation, RTL, FPGA prototyping, firmware, driver development, or low-level debugging.
• Some experience contributing to open-source systems, ML infrastructure, compiler, kernel, framework, or performance-engineering projects.

Summer 2027 Intern – Product Data Engineering
 
An internship with American Family Insurance is a great opportunity to build your skillset and explore your career interests. Our summer student internship is a 10 to 14 week program that starts in mid to late May and ends in August. 
 
During your internship, you'll work on impactful projects that make a difference at our company, with our customers, and in our communities. You'll also gain exposure to different areas of our business and have numerous opportunities for networking and coaching. 
 
Interns may be eligible for a one-time hiring bonus to assist with housing costs depending upon proximity to an AmFam office location. 
 
Compensation Minimum: $25.00 
Compensation Maximum: $39.00 
 
As a Product Data Engineering intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers on our service-oriented data and AI platform, which supports teams across AmFam, including security and AI. You'll build a real AI agent, put it into a real workflow, and then help improve the shared tools that make the next agent easier to build. You'll be paired with a mentor engineer for the full internship and finish with working software and a final presentation of what you built.

Responsibilities 
• Develop an understanding of our business, corporate culture and structure to support your work. 
• Contribute creative ideas and strategic approaches in response to changing situations. 
• Work with your mentor and a partner team to understand a real business problem, and help turn it into a working AI solution by breaking it into small, clear tasks.

• Contribute to a shared platform capability, such as evaluation, observability, or internal developer tooling, alongside the engineers who own it.

WHO WE ARE

Welcome to TELUS Digital  https://www.telusdigital.com/— where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS https://www.telus.com/en/, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.




LOCATION & FLEXIBILITY

Our interns are integral parts of our teams at TELUS Digital. To help retain our deep culture of collaboration, our interns maintain an in-office presence in a hybrid capacity (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays on-site). This role is located in Vancouver, BC.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We believe the best ideas come from shared creativity. What sets us apart from other agencies is that our engineers sit right beside researchers and creatives, so perspectives from multiple disciplines shape our products. Our summer internship program gives current students the chance to make an impact by contributing ideas and adding a fresh perspective to real client projects, all while receiving one-on-one mentoring from our full-time team members. Not only that, but you’ll have snacks galore, and plenty of chances to socialize with your fellow interns — including fun outings during work hours. You'll with us full-time (think 40 hours a week for approx. 16 weeks) and yes, it is definitely paid. Not a bad gig, right?

We understand our responsibility to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive place within the tech industry, while pushing to make our industry more representative. Because of this responsibility, we need candidates who value diversity and inclusion through their work, team collaboration, or involvement in student organizations.




YOUR IMPACT

 - Your day-to-day contributions will support real client work, helping TELUS Digital deliver technical excellence for the stakeholders who depend on us

 - You’ll have the opportunity to learn every day from engineering leadership

 - You’ll build amazing products people love

 - You’ll participate in the delivery of large and complex software projects in a team-based environment

 


YOUR BACKGROUND

 - You plan to graduate in December 2027 or later

 - Have experience with mobile or web development (Swift, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Javascript, etc.)

 - You’ve done a mobile or web project in school, at a previous internship, or in your spare time

 - You have experience integrating AI technology into your development process

 - You're a self-starter who embraces new technologies

 - You're intellectually curious and enjoy digging into what makes each platform unique

 - You are committed to delivering quality code for best-in-class digital experiences

 - You appreciate good design and have an eye for details

P.S. Even if you don’t have expertise in all of the qualifications listed, we value new perspectives and encourage you to apply. We’re committed to building a diverse company that reflects the diversity of our users. If you feel confident about a good amount of the bullet points above, we’ll ramp you up on the rest.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description:
About Trace

 

Trace is building the data, infrastructure, and research that enable robots to learn from the real world. General-purpose robotics requires a deeper understanding of how robots learn from real-world data. Our research explores how to transform human experiences, including egocentric video, demonstrations, hand-object interactions, and multimodal sensory signals, into transferable representations, actionable knowledge, and generalizable robot behaviors. At our Brooklyn research lab, we combine fundamental research in robot learning, computer vision, and embodied AI with large-scale datasets, machine learning infrastructure, and real-world robotic experimentation. Our goal is to advance the science of robot learning while developing the datasets and learning foundations for increasingly capable, adaptable, and reliable robots.

 
 

About the role

 

We are looking for highly motivated Research Interns to join our research team and work on challenging, high-impact problems at the intersection of robot learning, embodied AI, and learning from human experience. This internship is designed for PhD students and exceptional Master's students who are passionate about advancing the state of the art in robotics and machine learning.

 
 

As a Research Intern, you will take ownership of a focused research project, working closely with our scientists and engineers to formulate research questions, develop novel methods, design rigorous experiments, and evaluate results using real-world datasets, simulation, and/or robotic platforms. We encourage ambitious, scientifically grounded research with the potential to contribute to top-tier robotics, machine learning, and computer vision conferences. You will have opportunities to pursue original research, collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, and help shape Trace's long-term research directions.

 
 

Research areas

 

Research projects may span one or more of the following areas, but are not limited to:

 
 

• Learning from Human Experience and Egocentric Data

 

• Human-to-Robot and Cross-Embodiment Transfer

 

• Foundation Models for Robot Learning

 

• Visual-Tactile and Multimodal Robot Learning

 

• Data-Centric Robot Learning and Scaling

 

• Dexterous Manipulation and Generalizable Robot Skills

 

• Robustness, Generalization, and Reliable Robot Learning

 
 

We particularly welcome candidates who bring novel perspectives, strong methodological expertise, or creative research ideas that complement these directions.

 
 

What you'll do

 

• Lead an original research project from problem formulation and hypothesis development through method design, implementation, experimentation, and evaluation, with guidance and collaboration from Trace's research team.

 

• Develop and evaluate novel robot learning methods, including learning algorithms, representations, models, or training strategies that leverage human demonstrations, multimodal datasets, and robotic interaction data.

 

• Design rigorous experiments and benchmarks to investigate fundamental questions about data quality, human-to-robot transfer, policy learning, generalization, and real-world robotic performance.

 

• Work with diverse data modalities, potentially including egocentric video, human hand and body motion, teleoperation demonstrations, visual-tactile signals, force measurements, and robot trajectories.

 

• Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to build reproducible experimental pipelines, train and evaluate models, and validate research findings in simulation and/or on real robotic platforms.

 

• Analyze experimental results and failure modes, draw actionable scientific insights, and communicate findings through technical discussions, presentations, and written reports.

 

• Contribute to high-quality research publications and open research artifacts, with opportunities to submit work to leading robotics and machine learning venues.

 
 

What we're looking for

 

• Currently pursuing a PhD or Master's degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field.

 

• Strong research background in at least one relevant area, such as robot learning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, embodied AI, foundation models, dexterous manipulation, multimodal learning, or learning from human demonstrations.

 

• Demonstrated research excellence and potential, evidenced by high-quality publications, impactful research projects, open-source contributions, or other substantial research accomplishments. Publications at leading venues such as RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, T-RO, IJRR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or CVPR are highly valued. First-author or co-first-author publications are a strong plus.

 

• Excellent programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Experience with C++ and parallel programming, such as CUDA, is a plus.

 

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary research environment.

 
 

Nice to have

 

• Experience with real-world robot learning experiments, robotic manipulation platforms, or deployment of learned policies on physical robots.

 

• Experience with egocentric video, human demonstrations, hand tracking, pose estimation, motion retargeting, or cross-embodiment learning.

 

• Experience with vision-language-action models, diffusion-based policies, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or world models.

 

• Experience with tactile sensing, force estimation, multimodal sensor fusion, or contact-rich manipulation.

 

• Experience with robotics simulation environments and tools such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or related frameworks.

 

• Previous research experience in an industrial research lab or a collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment.

 
 

How to apply

 

Please submit your CV/resume, along with links to your Google Scholar profile, personal website, GitHub, or other relevant research portfolio, if available. Internship start dates are flexible. Academic credit may be available if required by your degree program, subject to institutional requirements.

 
 

Trace is an equal opportunity employer.

We are looking for highly motivated and technically curious Robotics Engineering Interns to join our team in a hands-on hardware-and-software role, contributing to the development of robotic systems, data infrastructure, and experimental platforms that support cutting-edge research in robot learning and embodied AI. This internship is designed primarily for Master's and undergraduate students, although PhD students are also welcome to apply. We value practical robotics experience, strong engineering fundamentals, problem-solving ability, and a genuine interest in robotics research. Prior research publications are not required.

As a Robotics Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our research scientists, research interns, and engineers to build and operate robotic platforms, develop reliable data collection and processing pipelines, implement and evaluate learning-based robotic systems, and support experiments that connect human and robot data to downstream policy performance. You will have opportunities to take ownership of well-defined engineering and experimental projects, from hardware and software integration through implementation, testing, evaluation, and documentation. Depending on your background and interests, you may also contribute to research experiments, algorithm development, and technical publications. Our goal is to provide meaningful hands-on experience at the intersection of robotics engineering and robot learning research, while giving students opportunities to develop practical skills, deepen their research understanding, and contribute to advances in physical AI.

 - Robotic Hardware and System Integration

 - Multimodal Data Collection and Infrastructure

 - Data Processing, Calibration, and Quality Evaluation

 - Human Demonstration and Robot Learning Systems

 - Robot Policy Implementation and Evaluation

 - Simulation and Experimental Validation

jobs.description:
You are the brain behind our work …
At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Summer Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!
 
Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
 
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…
We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program starts in early June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology. 
 
Your time here will look like this... 
You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
• Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
• Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
• Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
• Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
• Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
• Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.
• Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
 
To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:
• Graduation between Dec 2027 and May 2028.
• Educational background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
• GPA of 3.0 or better is preferred. 
• A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
• Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
• Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
• Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
• Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
• Work Authorization: Authorized to work in (country name) without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

Who we think will be a great fit...
A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
 
This program is ideal for those who:
• Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
• Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.
 
Annual Salary = $80,000

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one. 
 
We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose. 
 
From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.  
 
We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club. 
 
Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.  
 
This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves. 
 
So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team. 

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

As part of the Business Analytics team, this internship will support the delivery of reporting, business insights, and analytical projects that help drive decision-making across MLSE. Working alongside analysts and business leaders, you will contribute to recurring performance reporting, marketing analytics, executive presentations, and ad hoc analyses that support a wide range of business functions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, uncovering insights, and communicating findings through compelling reports and presentations. You will gain exposure to multiple areas of the business—including marketing, ticketing, broadcast, commercialization, venue operations, and strategy - while helping transform data into actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
A key focus of this role will be bridging data and marketing - translating complex datasets and technical findings into clear, actionable insights that stakeholders across the organization can understand and use, regardless of their technical background.

Responsibilities

· Support the preparation and delivery of recurring business performance reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely distribution.
· Use SQL, Python, Databricks and/or R to analyze data
· Analyze business and operational performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights for stakeholders across MLSE.
· Analyze survey data to identify areas of strength and growth for the business, and prepare into slides and actionable insights for the business
· Support marketing performance reporting by analyzing email marketing and CRM campaign results, helping evaluate campaign effectiveness through key performance indicators such as engagement, conversion, revenue attribution, and audience behaviour.
· Help evolve email performance measurement by identifying benchmarks, trends, audience insights, and optimization opportunities that enable Marketing teams to make more data-informed decisions.
· Support the development of scalable cross-channel measurement frameworks, using email performance as a foundation for evaluating emerging channels such as SMS.
· Partner with Marketing and Business Intelligence teams to help pioneer paid media performance reporting within MLSE’s Databricks environment, bringing together campaign data and translating performance into accessible insights for stakeholders.
· Build upon existing marketing reporting by identifying opportunities to improve dashboards, reporting processes, visualizations, and insight generation.
· Translate analytical findings into clear, concise presentations and executive-ready reporting that effectively communicates business performance to technical and non-technical audiences.
· Go beyond reporting “what happened” by helping identify why performance changed, what it means for the business, and recommended actions or opportunities for future campaigns.
· Provide ad hoc analytical support across the Business Analytics team, including creating PowerPoint presentations, building charts and visualizations, formatting reports, and conducting research.
· Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automate recurring tasks, and enhance analytical workflows.

Winter Term: January 4th - April 23

Qualifications

We recognize that you may not meet every qualification listed below and encourage you to apply if you're excited about the opportunity to learn and contribute.
· Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in Business, Commerce, Psychology, Marketing, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to create polished reports and executive-ready presentations.
· Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis and presentation development while maintaining strong critical thinking, analytical judgment, and ownership of the final output.
· Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate meaningful business insights.
· Interest in marketing analytics, customer behaviour, and measuring campaign performance using data and key performance indicators.
· Ability to translate complex data into a clear story, connecting analytical findings to practical business and marketing recommendations.
· Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
· Familiarity with email marketing, CRM platforms, digital marketing metrics, or campaign reporting is an asset.
· Ability to manage multiple priorities while working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
· Curious, proactive, and eager to continuously learn and improve.
· Interest in sports, live events, and entertainment is highly desirable.

Job Title
Intern – Service Offer Design – Cambridge, MA – Summer 2027
Job Description
Are you interested in an Internship opportunity with Philips? We welcome individuals who are currently pursuing an undergraduate (BS) and/or graduate (MS) degree to participate in 3 month paid intern opportunities at our site in Cambridge. Through this role you will gain meaningful, hands-on experience working for a HealthTech company.
Your role:
• Help design and refine Philips service offers for the North American healthcare market through customer and market research, data analysis, and clear offer-design materials. Support business cases, pilot planning, and launch readiness to improve service value and the customer experience.
• Join the North America Services and Solutions Marketing team supporting Diagnosis & Treatment businesses, collaborating with offer management, marketing, sales, service operations, finance, and business stakeholders. Help document customer journeys, service workflows, requirements, and decisions while tracking project milestones and follow-up actions.
• Gain hands-on experience in product management and offer design, with coaching from experienced leaders and exposure to the service-offer lifecycle from insight and concept through validation and launch planning. Strengthen your business analysis, stakeholder management, communication, and executive-presentation skills through a meaningful healthcare services project.
You're the right fit if:
• You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, marketing, product management, engineering, healthcare administration, data analytics, or a related field.
• Your skills include basic data analysis and comfort working with spreadsheets, presentations, and written documents. You can organize information, identify patterns, and summarize complex topics in clear recommendations for different audiences.
• You are interested in healthcare technology, services, customer experience, innovation, or product management. Prior internship, project, research, or team experience is helpful but not required.
• You communicate clearly in writing and conversation and enjoy collaborating across functions and locations. You ask thoughtful questions, take initiative, and welcome feedback.
• You bring attention to detail, dependable follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple assignments with guidance. You are ready to follow Philips quality, privacy, compliance, and information-security requirements when handling project information.
 
How we work together
 
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
 
 This is an office role.
 
About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business.
• Discover our rich and exciting history.
• Learn more about our purpose.
• Learn more about our culture.
 
Philips Transparency Details
 
The pay range for this position in (Massachusetts) Bachelor Level: $26 – 30 an hour, Masters Level $33.00 to $46.00, plus overtime eligible.
The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.   
 
Details about our benefits can be found here. 
At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case. 
 
Additional Information
 
US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.
 
Company relocation benefits will not be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in or within commuting distance to Cambridge.

This requisition is expected to stay active for 45 days but may close earlier if a successful candidate is selected or business necessity dictates. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible to ensure consideration.

Philips is an Equal Employment and Opportunity Employer including Disability/Vets and maintains a drug-free workplace.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
About Altera
At Altera™, our independence as the world’s largest pure‑play FPGA solutions provider gives us the focus, speed, and agility to innovate without compromise. With more than four decades of industry‑leading FPGA expertise, our singular mission is to deliver the programmable technologies that help customers differentiate, innovate, and scale across rapidly evolving markets like AI, cloud, networking, and edge. As an independent company, we move faster, invest deeper, and partner more closely—empowering our teams to drive breakthrough innovation and shape the future of the FPGA industry.

About the Role
Join Altera IP solutions team and work on cutting edge FPGA RTL and IP design!  Altera's IP Solutions Engineering (IPSE) team develops comprehensive solutions to provide customers easy and efficient access to the capabilities of Altera’s FPGA devices. These solutions are provided as highly configurable intellectual property (IP) cores that are fully integrated with Altera's software CAD tool, Quartus Prime. The External Memory Interfaces (EMIF) and IO team is responsible for developing IPs for communication with state-of-the-art DDR and LPDDR devices, MIPI cameras and sensors, and other high-speed I/O applications. The ever-growing demand for faster I/O interfaces - especially in the data center and machine learning sectors - presents a challenging design problem that requires system-level knowledge of silicon, software, IP, and customer applications. 
 
You will work with a team of engineers to develop and verify state-of-the-art IP cores for interfacing with external memories and other I/O devices. You will be working on advanced FPGA architectures, design definition, implementation, and verification. Additionally, you will also be developing design examples and simulation models, accompanied by a rich set of technical documentation. In this role, you will work closely with multiple teams, including silicon design and validation, post-silicon validation, application engineering, and customer experience teams, to ensure seamless development, integration, and optimization of high-speed interface IP solutions. 

Your specific responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following: 
• Architecture and Design based on the latest protocol specifications for DDR, LPDDR, and MIPI devices
• RTL development
• Device support and CAD tool integration
• Verification (e.g. verification IP, methodologies, frameworks, bus functional models, regression tests)
• Hardware power-on and debug
• New product release and rollout support
• Customer technical support 
  
The candidate should possess the following behavioral traits: 
• Strong skills in communication, initiative, innovation, and teamwork
• Highly motivated to learn and adapt to fast-changing technologies and environments
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Demonstrate fundamental values such as accountability, integrity, and a winning mindset
• Collaborative mindset, strong influencing skills, and a willingness to work across geographical locations

Salary
Our compensation is designed to reflect the Canadian labour market. The actual salary offered may vary based on several factors, including the position’s location, as well as the candidate’s experience, skills, training, and job-specific knowledge. In addition to base salary, we offer performance-based incentive opportunities that reward both individual contributions and overall company success.​ 
 
Estimated Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 CAD​ 
​ 
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess, or select applicants for the position.​ This posting is for an existing vacancy.​ Canadian work experience is not required for this role. Applicants must be eligible for any required Canada export authorizations.

Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum education requirements and minimum required qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Relevant experience can be obtained through schoolwork, classes, project work, internships, and/or military experience. Additional preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. 
 
Minimum Qualifications: 
• Currently pursuing a BS degree in Computer Engineering, Engineering Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related field
• 3+ months of experience in Digital logic hardware (e.g. SystemVerilog, Verilog and/or VHDL) design or verification
• 3+ months of experience in scripting languages and/or software programming (e.g. Python/TCL/Perl and/or C/C++) 
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
• FPGA design experience
• Experience with RTL simulation, timing closure and static timing analysis
• Experience with DDR, LPDDR, or MIPI hardware interfaces

Job Description
We are seeking a strategic, analytically rigorous, and innovative MBA summer associate to help measure and increase the impact of Medical Affairs. The intern will lead measurement and KPI establishment of Medical-led activities such as publications, congress presence, digital education, and field medical education, using advanced analytics and AI to generate actionable insights and inform decisions. This role is designed for a candidate who can combine business judgment with hands-on quantitative analysis, translate ambiguous questions into analytical approaches, and communicate findings to senior leaders and non-technical audiences.

The Medical Information, Technology and Innovation (MITI) group is responsible for leading the technological advancement and innovation of Vertex’s Medical Affairs teams. MITI enables and advances internal capabilities and efficiency, and external excellence in how we interact with healthcare providers in support of our medicines. The team applies data, technology, advanced analytics, and AI to improve business processes, strengthen scientific exchange, and increase the impact of Medical Affairs.

MBA Intern Program Highlights 
• Lead a business-critical Medical Affairs project during a 9 to 10-week, hands-on internship
• Apply advanced analytics and AI to evaluate the impact of scientific communication and identify opportunities for increasing impact
• Gain practical experience using analytical tools and diverse datasets to address complex business questions
• Learn how Medical Affairs operates across Insights Generation, Evidence Generation, and Scientific Communication
• Create an executive-ready presentation and present recommendations to senior leadership
• Participate in industry and career-development programming, including the “Lunch and Learn” speaker series

Responsibilities 
• Translate Medical Affairs business questions and strategy into clear analytical hypotheses, models, and measures of impact
• Plan and execute advanced analyses using statistical methods, AI, and exploratory data analysis
• Acquire, validate, cleanse, link, transform, and analyze structured and unstructured data from collaborators across the company
• Assess the reach, engagement, quality, and business impact of publications, congress activities, digital education, and field medical education
• Evaluate analytical approaches and model outputs for rigor, interpretability, appropriate use, and business relevance
• Visualize results and translate complex analytical findings into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions for non-technical audiences
• Partner with Medical Affairs, technology, and analytics stakeholders through discovery interviews, working sessions, status meetings, and project presentations
• Develop and deliver senior-leader-quality presentations that connect analytical findings to practical business impact
• Bring an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and ethical mindset to the use of data and AI

Qualifications 
• Currently enrolled in an accredited two year full time MBA program
• Four to Six years of experience prior to starting your MBA
• Demonstrated strength in analytics and a background or substantial experience in statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, data science, or another quantitative discipline
• Strong hands-on experience with advanced analytics, including statistical analysis, predictive modeling, AI, experimental design, or causal inference
• Experience integrating and analyzing multiple data sources, including data preparation, validation, feature development, and model evaluation
• Demonstrated ability to frame ambiguous business problems analytically and translate findings into business implications and recommendations
• Strong data-visualization, written communication, and executive-presentation skills, including proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel

• Healthcare, life sciences, or Medical Affairs experience is a plus
• Legal authorization to work in the United States, both now and in the future

With premier video services like DIRECTV, our industry leading team is at the forefront of making it all happen. Dive into the DIRECTV Digital Services Team as a summer intern! We are looking for a customer-first, innovative, and results driven individual to join us in transforming the way we serve our customers. 
 
In this role, you may work on:
• Ideate and deliver digital first experiences that seamlessly integrate into an omni-channel ecosystem.

Summary: 
Huntington’s internship programs provide emerging talent with meaningful, hands‑on experience aligned to their area of study. Internship Opportunities at Huntington:

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff intern to work hand-in-hand with our founders and team


This is a hands-on role that combines engineering, storytelling, and community. You'll ship code alongside our product and engineering teams, and work closely with our GTM and DevRel teams to turn what we build into demos, content, and experiences that inspire builders.

You'll be part of our mission of connecting AI agents to the web.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take part in the development of new products and features built on top of Linkup's proprietary index.

 - Develop and maintain SDKs, templates, integrations, and reference implementations for AI and agentic workflows.

 - Build and ship polished demos, sample apps, and starter kits that showcase what's possible with Linkup's APIs.

 - Produce technical content: blog posts, tutorials, videos, and benchmarks that make complex tech approachable.

 - Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and developer experience priorities.
   


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every demo, integration, and product you build helps define how AI agents connect to the web.

You'll operate on the frontier between product and developers, bringing the voice of builders into everything we build and say.

If you love blending engineering with impact, building things developers actually use: this role is for you.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Have high agency: you see something that should exist, and you build it. You don't wait to be told what to do.

What would be a big plus:

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, LLMs, agents, and DevTools.

 - A taste for turning technical depth into compelling storytelling.

 - Participation in active developer communities, hackathons, or open-source projects.
   .


DETAILS

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the founders and the team, with real ownership from day one: your work ships to production and reaches thousands of developers.



ABOUT LINKUP






OUR VISION



We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google's ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.



OUR MISSION

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world's freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.



OUR CULTURE

Our culture is built on the following values:

 - Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

 - Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

 - Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

 - Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

 - Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team members to take an active role in shaping our company culture.



OUR TEAM

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

 - Philippe Mizrahi https://www.linkedin.com/in/philippe-mizrahi/- Led the development of Lyft's Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen https://www.amundsen.io/, an open source search engine.

 - Denis Charrier https://www.linkedin.com/in/denis-charrier/- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

 - Boris Toledano https://www.linkedin.com/in/boris-toledano-7b53a496/- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

We are searching for the best talent for Laboratory Automation Systems Intern to be in Spring House, PA.

Purpose:
The Laboratory Automation Systems Intern will support a campus-wide initiative at the Spring House Campus focused on improving the visibility, documentation, and knowledge management of laboratory automation platforms.
Working alongside Laboratory Operations, automation specialists, scientists, engineers, and IT/Digital partners, the intern will help inventory and characterize laboratory automation systems, organize and reconcile technical information, and identify practical Large Language Model (LLM) use cases that improve access to automation-related knowledge.
This 10–12 week internship provides hands-on exposure to laboratory automation, digital systems, technical data management, responsible AI, and cross-functional collaboration within a scientific laboratory environment.

You will be responsible:
• Conducting supervised laboratory walkthroughs to develop and maintain an accurate inventory of automation systems, components, software, locations, system owners, operational status, and scientific use cases.

• Developing standardized automation system profiles and supporting the creation of an organized, searchable repository of equipment and technical information.

jobs.description:
About us:

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.



Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.



Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.



We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).



Why we’re hiring:

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.



This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.



As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This program exists to close that gap. We are looking for 2-3 Product Managers-in-Training to work directly with, and be mentored by, our Cofounder/CEO (2x YC founder), and work on building or scaling one of our new product verticals.



Reporting directly to our CEO, you will have a unique opportunity to develop the craft of product building, learn how a serial founder/CEO thinks and makes decisions, and see/understand a late stage tech startup’s day-to-day challenges as it goes through a rapid growth phase. You will be exposed to nearly every function at the company (i.e., product, growth, operations, finance, engineering, data), learn how to execute big-picture strategies and navigate the intricacies of a complex business.



A successful graduate will likely go on to become a product leader or commercial leader (e.g. owning P&L) here or elsewhere. If you’re looking for an opportunity to greatly accelerate your career trajectory, we’d love to hear from you.



Who we get excited about:

 - Insatiable learner: You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever craft or goal you’ve set your mind to.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 - Tenacious: You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.

 - Sense of urgency: You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.



What you bring:

 - Ideally 1+ years of experience in a demanding environment such as management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, an early startup environment, or similar

 - Bachelor's degree in any discipline

 - Ability to work in-person in our Palo Alto office alongside our CEO and executive team at least for the first 6-12 months



Compensation:

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position within the San Francisco Bay Area is 130,000—160,000 USD, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience and appropriate job levelling. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.



Location:

This role requires being in our Palo Alto office five days a week, at least until you are capable of operating independently.



While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

If you want to be part of a dynamic team delivering cutting-edge cyber training solutions, this is the place for you. Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to join the DevOps team in Hanover, MD. The team develops, deploys, and supports mission-focused cyber training solutions used across multiple locations. Team members work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment supporting the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software development, testing, deployment, infrastructure management, and operational support. Engineers work closely with instructors, developers, and system administrators to deliver reliable, realistic training capabilities. Unlike many software organizations where engineers are assigned to a single product or technology stack, members of the DevOps team contribute across a diverse portfolio of applications, services, and supporting infrastructure. This provides opportunities to build broad technical expertise while collaborating with teammates to deliver integrated solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. This position is ideal for software engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, learning new technologies, and applying their skills across a diverse portfolio of software, infrastructure, and operational systems.  
 
Work Schedule: The courses being supported are active from 0700-1800 M-F. Contract core hours are 1000-1400. The DevOps team is flexible on arrival and departure time however there are occasions where one or more DevOps team members will be needed to support testing and maintenance before or after course hours. 
 
Essential Responsibilities: 
 
The Software Engineer will assist in the development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software applications while building experience across the software development lifecycle under the guidance of senior engineers. 
Responsibilities include: 
· Assist in developing, troubleshooting, testing, and maintaining software applications supporting cyber training environments. 
· Assist with implementing technical solutions based on established requirements. 
· Develop software components, scripts, APIs, and user interface enhancements under guidance. 
· Support the operation and maintenance of software development pipelines. 
· Assist with application deployment and environment configuration.

· Perform software testing, debugging, validation, and analysis of results. 
· Document software designs, configurations, processes, and operational procedures. 
· Collaborate with instructors, developers, system administrators, and other technical teams to improve training capabilities. 
· Recommend improvements to applications and workflows. 
· Familiarity with one or more programming languages and object-oriented software development concepts. 
· Familiarity with Linux or Windows operating systems. 
· Exposure to Agile software development practices. 
· Exposure to virtualization or container technologies is desirable.

Bachelor's degree Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field

· Developing or supporting web applications, backend services, APIs, or databases using SQL or NoSQL technologies. 
· Software development practices including source control, automated testing, and debugging. 
· Linux or Windows operating systems, scripting, virtualization, container technologies, or cloud-native concepts. 
· Automation, CI/CD, or DevOps tools through academic, personal, or professional experience.
