jobs.description:
Software Modelling Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship 2027

Salary: £23,000 plus a £3000 joining bonus 

Location: Bristol

Duration: 4 years

Learning Provider: University Centre Weston - Winter Gardens

Due to the need to attend your MBDA site and the training provider as required for your apprenticeship, applicants need to ensure their home or rental location is appropriate, travel arrangements are manageable and travel time is minimised as required for your role.

The qualification: You'll study for a Digital and Technology Solutions Degree Apprenticeship, Software pathway. Your final award will be a BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions.
Find more details about the course here: https://www.ucw.ac.uk/courses/digital-and-technology-solutions-bsc-hons/

Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. 
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. 

This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Friday 22nd January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

What we can offer you:

• Fully funded qualification starting September 2027
• Paid travel expenses to and from your place of study
• Annual pay reviews
• Healthcare Cash Plan: provides support with everyday health related costs – including medical, dental, optical, physio and health & wellbeing
• 25 days annual leave (plus holiday purchase) and up to 15 days flexi leave
• Study leave during exam periods

The opportunity:

Study with the University Centre Weston (UCW) will be a blend of day release attendance, e-learning and workplace projects. You can typically expect to be at UCW one day per week; when not studying, you will be working in your home function of Simulation and Modelling and this will typically be onsite at MBDA Bristol for the majority of the rest of the working week.

System modelling is a vital tool used to ensure MBDA provides reliable and cost efficient weapon systems to our customers!

We build a variety of dynamic system performance models, embedded systems and real time models for MBDA products. Our models are developed and used extensively throughout the product lifecycle, from feasibility through to service support. When used internally our performance models allow our system designers to estimate performance which they can use to guide the product design. For our customer, these models provide a method of verifying system performance, whilst reducing reliance on prohibitively expensive testing and trials. Our real time models contribute to training environments for pilots and provide numerous engineering testing capabilities. Once the product is in service, the customer continues to use our models to understand the systems and assist with operator training.

Models of modern weapon systems consist of a large number of automated subsystems integrated together to provide the overall capability. This provides unique challenges when:
• Developing accurate system models that are both large in scale and highly sophisticated with many interdependencies.
• Developing lower fidelity models designed to run at real time whilst maintaining an accurate representation of the weapon system.

As a model developer this means you will often encounter new and exciting challenges which will require you to apply intuition and innovation to optimally tackle!

You will learn how to build simulation software in programming languages/environments such as:
• Mathworks (MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow)
• Fortran
• C/C++

Our teams implement Agile working practices and dynamic working across multiple projects to meet demand, aided by the use of collaborative tools. We work closely with other departments and companies to integrate subsystem models and design data. From these interactions you'll gain a broad understanding of each subsystem that makes up the weapon, and how the system architecture integrates the subsystems to provide an overall capability.

Placements outside the department are also encouraged for our apprentices to gain knowledge of the wider business.

What we’re looking for from you:

This role has specific qualification and subject criteria so please make sure you carefully check your eligibility against this criteria before applying otherwise your application will not be considered. If you are currently studying and predicted to meet these requirements by the start date you are welcome to apply.

GCSEs:

A minimum of 5 GCSEs at a minimum of grade 4

This must include:
• English Language
• Mathematics
• Any Science or Technology subject

After GCSEs:

After your GCSEs you must have completed one of the following and achieved 120 UCAS Tariff points:

• A levels: Three A levels totalling 120 UCAS Tariff points, including A level Mathematics and either a Science OR Computing/Computer Science subject, with no individual grade below C.
• T level: T Level in Engineering or Computing with a minimum Merit grade. 
• BTEC: A single Level 3 Extended Diploma in Maths, Science, IT OR Engineering at a minimum grade of DDM. Those applying with a Science, IT or Engineering subject must provide evidence of completing a Further Maths module.

Please note: We look at entry criteria based on your top three full A Levels or equivalent qualifications (BTEC/T Level). We do not include UCAS points gained from an Extended Project Qualification. Additionally, as an employer we set our own entry criteria based on the requirements of this role. This means that the criteria above may differ from the university.

MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom.

The Software teams at MBDA deliver software for the next generation of weapons in an ever evolving environment - to support those on the battlefield. Our teams provide a range of products from high integrity software running on our weapon systems, to mission planning solutions integrated into a complex battle space arena. We have an open and encouraging approach to software development and are always seeking to improve the way we work and deliver our products. jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The AI Machine Learning Engineer supports the development, testing, and deployment of AI and machine learning solutions that enhance business capabilities. This entry-level role provides hands-on experience working with data and models while building foundational knowledge in AI engineering practices. 
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES 
 
• Assist in designing, developing, and testing machine learning models for tasks such as classification, regression, clustering, and recommendations. 
• Support preprocessing and basic analysis of datasets using standard data tools. 
• Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to help integrate models into production systems. 
• Assist with experiments and model evaluations, documenting results for senior team members. 
• Stay up to date with the latest AI/ML research and contribute to team knowledge sharing. 
 
SUCCESSFUL CHARACTERISTICS / SKILLS 
 
Experience & Background 
• 1–2 years of experience in machine learning, data science, or software development (internship or academic projects acceptable). 
 
Core Technical Proficiency 
• Familiarity with Python and major ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn). 
• Basic knowledge of data manipulation and visualization tools. 
• Broad understanding of machine learning principles and algorithms. 
 
MLOps & Deployment 
• Awareness of MLOps practices and tools, such as version control, containerization, or model monitoring. 
 
Advanced Methods 
• Foundational understanding of deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), or computer vision concepts. 
 
Professional Traits 
• Ability to work independently with guidance and take initiative on assigned tasks. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with eagerness to learn and grow. 
• Ability to clearly document and communicate findings. 
 
EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS 
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
• Azure AI Fundamentals or similar entry-level certification (preferred). 
 
WHAT RSM OFFERS 
• Opportunities to develop AI/ML engineering skills in a collaborative environment. 
• Mentorship from experienced professionals and exposure to enterprise-level projects. 
• Access to training and professional development programs. 
• Competitive salary and benefits package. 

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/working-at-rsm/benefits.

We believe flexibility and in-person connection both play an important role in how we work and grow. Most roles at RSM follow a hybrid workstyle, which means team members are aligned to an RSM office and come together in person when it best supports clients, teams, development or relationship-building. Some roles may be virtual or primarily on-site based on role requirements, team priorities and client needs.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment as RSM does not tolerate discrimination and/or harassment based on race; color; creed; sincerely held religious beliefs, practices or observances; sex (including pregnancy or disabilities related to nursing); gender; sexual orientation; HIV Status; national origin; ancestry; familial or marital status; age; physical or mental disability; citizenship; political affiliation; medical condition (including family and medical leave); domestic violence victim status; past, current or prospective service in the US uniformed service; US Military/Veteran status; pre-disposing genetic characteristics or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law. 

Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please call us at 800-274-3978 or send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

RSM does not intend to hire entry level candidates who will require sponsorship now OR in the future (i.e. F-1 visa holders). If you are a recent U.S. college / university graduate possessing 1-2 years of progressive and relevant work experience in a same or similar role to the one for which you are applying, excluding internships, you may be eligible for hire as an experienced associate.

RSM will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records. For those living in California or applying to a position in California, please click here for additional information.

At RSM, an employee’s pay at any point in their career is intended to reflect their experiences, performance, and skills for their current role. The salary range (or starting rate for interns and associates) for this role represents numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, education, skills, work experience, certifications, location, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range.

Compensation Range: $102,800 - $176,000
Individuals selected for this role will be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on firm and individual performance.

jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description
**This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

Location expectations:
This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

U.S. Bank is seeking a Python Backend Software Engineer to join our Identity and Access Management Automation Team. This role will develop and support backend applications, services, integrations, and automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen security and compliance processes.

This person will serve as a hands-on engineer responsible for building and delivering automation solutions from end to end. The engineer will develop primarily in Python, support existing applications using JavaScript and TypeScript, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and help transform manual identity and access processes into reliable, code-driven workflows. The role is best suited for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work, independently solving problems, and owning software through development, implementation, and ongoing support.

Main Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain backend automation solutions using Python.
• Build services, APIs, and integrations supporting identity and access management workflows.
• Develop automated solutions for privileged-access and local-administrator-access processes.
• Support applications and integrations built around HashiCorp Vault and related IAM technologies.
• Replace manual and cumbersome processes with scalable, code-driven workflows.
• Troubleshoot application errors, integration failures, and production issues.
• Perform software enhancements, bug fixes, maintenance, and patching.
• Work with team members and business partners to identify processes that can be streamlined through automation.
• Apply sound software design, architecture, testing, and development practices.
• Deliver solutions that support operational efficiency, risk reduction, compliance, and cost avoidance.
• Contribute to future opportunities involving cloud automation, artificial intelligence, and large language models.

Must Have Skills:
• Strong professional Python development experience, including building and maintaining backend applications or services.
• Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production software.
• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, architecture, testing, debugging, and maintainable code.
• Demonstrated experience independently troubleshooting technical problems and researching root causes.
• Experience developing APIs, integrations, automation workflows, internal tools, or backend services.
• Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
• Ability to take ownership of technical solutions and deliver working software, rather than only providing recommendations.
• Curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies.

Nice to Have Skills:
• Docker experience.
• AWS or other cloud-platform experience.
• Identity and Access Management experience.
• HashiCorp Vault or other secrets-management platform experience.
• Experience with privileged-access or access-management workflows.
• Full-stack application-development experience.
• Experience with cloud identities or cloud-based automation.
• Experience building automation that supports security, risk, compliance, or operational processes.
• Interest or experience integrating AI or large language model capabilities into enterprise workflows.

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience

____________________

Kollmorgen is seeking an Electronics Lab Technician I to join the Compliance Engineering team in Radford, Virginia. This entry-level role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical work and wants to build expertise in electronics testing, troubleshooting, product safety, and compliance within a collaborative laboratory environment.
 
Working under the guidance of experienced technical personnel, this position partners with electronics development, compliance, quality, and components engineering teams to verify the safety and performance of new and existing servomotor drives, motors, embedded motion controllers, and accessories. The technician will support testing of motor and drive systems operating at up to 1,000 volts, along with related quality and first-article activities.

A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

jobs.title: Analyst AI ML and Cloud Security
jobs.description:
Analyst, AI ML & Cloud Security 

Why Us!
At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We’re proud to be leading a healthcare revolution, and we’re looking for people who can help us deliver on our ambition

Job Purpose:
Support AI engineering delivery on the platform and data fabric workstreams. You configure AI platform environments, document data fabric build outputs, maintain CI/CD pipeline documentation, and develop the automation that keeps the builds moving and surfaces failures before they affect delivery.
 
About the team: AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that CAS designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US.
 
What makes this role different: An entry point into AI platform engineering for someone with a scripting and automation background who wants to build depth in AI infrastructure. You will support senior engineers rather than lead workstreams, and a real share of the job is documentation and test evidence that has to be right, because a managed service vendor will operate the data fabric from it without anyone from CAS present. Curiosity and precision matter more here than existing AI experience.

Key Responsibilities:
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 
• Configure and maintain AI platform environments for development and test. 
• Document data fabric build outputs and keep the build registry accurate. 
• Maintain CI/CD pipeline documentation to the standard the vendor needs to operate the fabric once it transfers. 
• Develop automation scripts for pipeline health monitoring so failures surface before they affect delivery. 
• Build and execute test cases for platform and data fabric builds. 
• Maintain build records so the platform estate stays traceable and auditable. 
• Work to the architecture specifications provided and raise gaps rather than filling them informally. 
• Support senior engineers across the platform and data fabric workstreams. 
• Raise defects and blockers early with enough detail to be actionable. 
• Build subject matter depth in AI platform engineering and data pipeline delivery.

Why You!
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
 
Basic Qualifications: 
• Experienced in AI, platform or software engineering with a relevant technical degree — domain focus: AI Engineering (AI platform and data fabric workstreams)
• Configuring AI platform environments and supporting LLM, agent and RAG pipeline builds — environment setup, embedding and vector index jobs, and evaluation runs
• Building and running test cases for AI components — prompt-injection, output-validation and regression tests for non-deterministic behaviour
• Python automation for AI pipeline health — data quality, ingestion failures, model and API latency, token usage and cost — with automated alerting
• Documenting data fabric builds and CI/CD pipelines to vendor-handover standard and maintaining build records, working to architecture specifications and raising gaps rather than filling them informally. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
• You have debugged a failing vector index rebuild and can explain what you changed.
• Azure or GCP fundamentals certification (AZ-900, AI-900 or equivalent)
• Working knowledge of prompt-injection test patterns from the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, enough to extend an existing test suite.
• Terraform and Helm for environment provisioning, with enough Git discipline to work in a shared repository.
• Exposure to MLOps tooling — MLflow, model registries or CI/CD for model deployment.

Ready to apply?
Ready to lead the future of secure AI and cloud technology? Join GSK and help us make a real difference in improving health worldwide. Apply today. We look forward to hearing from you. (Please take a personal copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available online post closure of the advert)
 
Closing Date: 6th November 2026

Working Pattern
This role is based in the United Kingdom and offers a hybrid working model, with 2/3 days a week onsite at our central London HQ.

#AGTech
#LI-Hybrid

Skills
AI for Cybersecurity, AI Platforms, Application Security, CI/CD, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, PHP (Scripting Language), Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vector Databases, Vulnerability Management 

Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. 

We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

GSK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.

Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments, we will not be able to support you through these channels. However, we have created a Recruitment FAQ guide. Click the Link where you will find answers to multiple questions we receive

jobs.title: Associate Analyst-Digital - Launchpad
jobs.description:
Do your Best Work in Mooresville

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

Your Impact
The Associate Analyst-Digital will support the team in evaluating and enhancing the customer's shopping experience. This includes assisting senior team members in reviewing internal and external research, customer behaviors, and other relevant data to transform analysis into actionable insights and recommendations. This role will help execute project plans established by leaders based on these insights, ensuring activities within the assigned area meet strategic and financial objectives. Additionally, the Associate Analyst will assist in aggregating key performance metrics to drive ongoing improvements and enhance customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

Launchpad Program 
The tech industry is constantly evolving, creating new opportunities and assess challenges for businesses globally. If you’re looking to break into Tech, we’ve developed a program where you will have the opportunity to engage with tech leaders, develop your skills, and learn more about our culture while advancing your career. In this program, you will gain hands-on experience in your targeted discipline and lay the groundwork for the future of tech. If you want to make a difference in your work and community, you’ll find a home here at Lowe’s. 

You must be available to start on Monday, January 25, 2027.
 
This program offers experience to candidates who want to break into tech by following our program timeline below: 
 
Orientation • 1 Week 
• Learn Lowe’s policies, benefits, and business strategy 
• Hands-on integration with Lowe’s culture 
• Learn tech processes, systems, and operations 
 
Bootcamp • 8 Weeks 
• Fast-paced learning in targeted discipline 
• Dedicated coaching with a structured curriculum 
• Skills assessments 
• Individual & Group Projects 
 
Rotation 1 & 2 • 12 Months 
• Rotations in different areas of Tech 
• Hands-on experience & meaningful work 
• Professional development 
 
Final Placement 
On completion of Launchpad, you are matched with a Tech team that best suits your interests to continue advancing your career and driving big changes with Lowe’s. 

You’ll gain valuable skills and a place to connect with tech leaders, all while finding full-time job placement in this expanding industry. 
 
Do Your Best Work in Mooresville 
This opportunity is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

What You Will Learn
• Assist senior team members in gathering and synthesizing competitive intelligence and data to create comprehensive reports.
• Consolidate analysis across a variety of factors related to customer opportunities to inform projects in the assigned business area.
• Coordinate communication of team project plans and expectations, support the execution of projects including ticket submission and presentation creation, and partner cross-functionally to execute project plans to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget.
• Aid in pulling data from Adobe Analytics and other reporting suites to inform decisioning.
• Review industry research to develop functional knowledge, sharing key insights with the team.
• Contribute to strategic initiatives by leveraging data insights and cross-functional collaboration to drive business growth and enhance customer experience.

Minimum Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Completion of coursework or program focused on business administration, marketing, finance, or related skills
 
Preferred Skills/Experience
• Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, finance, or related field
• 1-2 years of experience in omnichannel, merchandising, marketing, and/or brand/product management
• Proficiency in analytic tools

Benefits
• 10% Associate Discount
• For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit: https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager New Grad
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description

Our Product teams deliver the holistic product strategy for Visa and accelerates the seamless delivery of our products into markets. We are investing in the next generation of talent to ensure our products, services and data are the centre of the changing ways businesses, corporates and governments pay and get paid. We are fueled by a diverse team of talented team members who continuously raise the bar on delivering best-in-class products and services to people all over the world.

As an Associate Product Manager at Visa, you will be a key member of the team that drives the latest and most innovative ideas from product ideation, to build, to launch, to scaling in the market. You will assist in delivering next generation product offerings to businesses, corporates and governments, including innovative payment experiences, cutting edge fraud prevention, capabilities to help banks, tech companies, fintechs and merchants meet their consumers’ needs, and local solutions tailored to one or more of the 200 countries we operate in.

We are looking for graduates who are passionate about building innovative products and solutions, and interested in developing a long-term career across Visa's product ecosystem to join our Associate Product Manager Programme. In this programme you will be staffed on our highest need initiatives and enrolled in a learning and development plan targeted at developing our most critical product manager competencies. While experiences may vary based on business priorities and individual development needs, the programme will include four six-month rotations over two years across teams within Visa's Product, Commercial & Money Movement Solutions (CMS), and Value-Added Services (VAS) organisations. Graduates will gain exposure to a broad range of product-focused disciplines and experiences, developing a well-rounded understanding of how products are conceived, developed, commercialised, implemented and scaled.
 
Rotational assignments may include opportunities in areas such as product strategy, product management, innovation, commercialisation, go-to-market execution, product implementation, client solutions and product operations. Throughout the programme, Associate Product Managers will work on high-impact initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, strategy, finance and marketing, building the commercial, analytical and leadership capabilities required for a successful career in product at Visa.
 
The programme is designed to provide breadth of experience alongside depth of expertise, equipping participants with a holistic understanding of Visa's products, clients and markets. Upon successful completion, high-performing Associate Product Managers will be well positioned to pursue a variety of product-related career paths across Visa.
 
Responsibilities (please note that responsibilities may vary based on business priorities and individual development opportunities)
• Support the development and execution of product strategies, business plans and go-to-market initiatives for innovative payment and value-added solutions.
• Support the development of the product roadmap to define/support the product goals and strategies
• Become knowledgeable on Visa’s products and support the product team in driving the development of product features and functionality, leveraging the strong foundation of existing capabilities where appropriate.
• Research and use market trends and competitor benchmarking to define product and user requirements
• Use Visa's data assets, analytics tools and emerging technologies to generate insights that support product, commercial and client-focused decisions. Leverage AI tools in day-to-day work in order to create meaningful outputs and optimise projects/ workflows.
• Develop product propositions, leveraging user experience tools such as Figma to build interactive and experiential payments journeys and use cases
• Develop business cases and commercial recommendations by assessing market opportunity, demand, pricing considerations and potential value
• Distill market research to provide perspective to the team and product management leaders to inform insights and decisions
• Support product launches, commercialisation activities, client implementations and post-launch performance analysis.
• Collaborate with internal Visa teams (e.g., regional teams, Product Marketing, Business Development, Finance) to define and execute a cohesive strategy related to a specific product or feature
• Own defined product workstreams, manage dependencies, and communicate progress and decisions to stakeholders.
• Prepare and present clear recommendations and insights to product leaders and cross-functional stakeholders based on your analysis

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

• Less than 6 months of relevant work experience with either Bachelor's or Master's degree graduating December 2026 - August 2027. 
• Must be available to start working September 2027 – no early or late start dates to ensure a common onboarding experience and development opportunities.
• Permanent authorisation to work in the UK is a precondition for this position. Home Office sponsorship requirements mean that Visa will not be in a position to sponsor applicants for work visas in connection with this position. Future sponsorship will not be considered. 

Preferred Qualifications
• Degree in Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in conjunction with a less technical BA/BS
• Eagerness to learn, self-starting approach and an entrepreneurial mindset
• Problem-solving, organisational, analytical, and critical thinking skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to independently drive activities all the way to successful completion.
• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and collaborative environments.
• Proficiency in using AI tools, including CoPilot
• Knowledge or experience with Agile methodology to drive product development and delivery• Technical fluency including programming languages; data analysis; business case/modeling; pricing; design
• Coursework or experience is a plus

• Proven ability to take initiative and to build strong and productive relationships
• Entrepreneurial and resourceful with the ability to handle numerous projects concurrently
• Focused on providing excellent customer experiences
• Team oriented, collaborative, and flexible

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Join the Wavelogic team developing advanced high-speed analog circuits used in Ciena's optical fiber transmission solutions. The role contributes to mixed-signal IP blocks for the Wavelogic family of products, including high-speed DAC and ADC circuits, SERDES solutions, transimpedance amplifiers, modulator driver circuits, and precision analog circuits for control and monitoring functions. Work spans advanced deep-submicron CMOS and/or BiCMOS design and characterization in Ciena's state-of-the-art lab.

• Collaborate with layout team members on overall implementation through full GDSII delivery to Ciena’s integration partner.

• Characterize analog circuits in Ciena’s state-of-the-art lab, from test chips through full product implementation, with members of the Analog Macro Integration team.

• Experience: Previous internship, co-op, or applied project experience relevant to the role.
• Experience leading designs in advanced BiCMOS and/or CMOS technology.
• Ability to methodically address technical problems.
• Excellent organization, written and oral (English) interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency with use of applicable design tools from Cadence, Mentor and Synopsys for analog design (eg. Virtuoso, Calibre, STAR-RC, MMSIM).

• Experience with 2.5D or 3D E-M tools such as HFSS or EMX.
• Experience with mixed-signal design validation using state-of the art probing and test equipment.

jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries 
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, powerefficient and highperformance solutions for highgrowth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. 

New College Graduates Overview: 
We offer many full-time employment paths for recent graduates, which provide accelerated training in a fast-paced work environment, cross-functional working opportunities, and talent mobility. New college graduates are provided with mentorship, networking, and leadership opportunities, which give our new team members life-long connections and skills. 

Summary of Role: 
GlobalFoundries is seeking a New College Graduate CPU IP Design & Verification Engineer to join the MIPS CPU IP Engineering team and develop and verify advanced RISC-V processor IP. The role provides hands-on experience in CPU microarchitecture, SystemVerilog RTL implementation, functional verification, power, performance, and area analysis, automation, and debug in Austin, Texas or Santa Clara, California.

Essential Responsibilities include: 
• Design and develop RISC-V CPU microarchitecture and SystemVerilog RTL design and development. 
• Contribute to CPU functions including instruction fetch and decode, execution, load/store, caches and memory interfaces, control and status registers, exceptions, and interrupts. 
• Develop verification tests, assertions, checkers, and functional coverage for CPU features. 
• Run CPU simulations and regressions and debug failures using logs, architectural traces, and waveforms. 
• Support functional and coverage closure through design and verification reviews. 
• Support CPU power, performance, and area analysis and optimization. 
• Develop Python, C/C++, or scripting-based automation to improve design, verification, regression, and debug productivity. 
• Collaborate across architecture, design, verification, performance, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality CPU IP. 

Other Responsibilities: 
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications: 
• Education – Graduating with a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field from an accredited degree program. 
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing. 
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) 
• Strong foundation in digital logic design and computer architecture. 
• Coursework, research, internship, or project experience with Verilog or SystemVerilog. 
• Understanding of CPU fundamentals including pipelines, instruction execution, loads/stores, caches, and memory hierarchy. 
• Programming or scripting experience with Python, C/C++, or similar languages. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Prior related internship or co-op experience. 
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
• Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Strong planning & organizational skills 
• Knowledge of the RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture (ISA). 
• Experience with SystemVerilog/UVM, assertions, functional coverage, or constrained-random verification. 
• CPU architecture, microarchitecture, FPGA, ASIC, or processor-design project experience. 
• Familiarity with caches, memory subsystems, privilege modes, exceptions, interrupts, or virtual memory. 
• Experience with simulation, waveform debug, Git, and Linux. 
• Exposure to synthesis, lint, clock-domain crossing analysis, formal verification, or timing analysis. 
• Assembly-language programming experience. 
• Interest in using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve RTL design, verification, automation, and debug productivity.

jobs.title: Government Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Government Human Services Consulting (GHSC) team at Mercer. This role will be based in Phoenix, AZ, Seattle, WA, or Minneapolis, MN. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. 
 
Medicaid is a government-sponsored health insurance program in the United States designed to provide healthcare coverage to low-income individuals and families. As a consulting firm specializing in Medicaid, Mercer’s GHSC team assists state governments in optimizing their Medicaid programs. Our team plays a vital role in managing and analyzing Medicaid claims data to enhance patient access to care, improve cost efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to these individuals. As an Analyst, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced programmers, actuaries, and clinicians, contributing to meaningful projects that aim to positively impact the lives of individuals and families in need. Join us in making a difference! 
 
To learn more about Mercer’s GHSC practice, please visit www.mercer-government.mercer.com 

We will count on you to: 
• Perform comprehensive analysis of health care data using spreadsheet and database management software, with most time spent in Excel 
• Assist in the development of reports, spreadsheets, and presentations 
• Work on multifaceted projects to gain a better understanding of health care delivery systems, specifically government-sponsored health and welfare programs, such as Medicaid and Medicare 
• Excel in a fast-paced, challenging and dynamic consulting environment with colleagues across the practice at all levels 
• Collaborate with colleagues on smaller teams with opportunities for growth on other projects and clients depending on practice needs. 

What you need to have: 
• A bachelor’s degree with graduation year in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 and concentration in computer information sciences, economics, finance, mathematics, actuarial science, management information systems, statistics, supply management, public policy, public health, or a related analytical major 
• Minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 
• Legal work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis without the need for sponsorship now or in the future 

What makes you stand out? 
• Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative, and moderate skills in Microsoft Office—Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 
• Knowledge of data analysis, project management, and presentation design 
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills 
• Intellectual curiosity 
• Ability to work collaboratively on a team 
• Flexibility to address changing client needs 
• Superior organizational skills and strong attention to detail 
• Creative problem-solving abilities 
• Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment 
 
Why join our team: 
• We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
• We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. 
• Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. jobs.description:
If you are motivated and believe in the credit union philosophy of "People Helping People," join our team!

The Loan Analytics Associate Data Scientist will work with senior members of the department to develop, implement, and monitor predictive models across all loan portfolios. This position will also develop complex reports and dashboards from multiple data sources using a variety of software tools to analyze and generate data-driven insights and recommendations based on those data.

Essential Responsibilities:
 
• (40%) Work with Senior Data Scientists to develop machine learning models and forecasts for various aspects of loan portfolios including delinquency, default, and new loan origination using validated statistical and machine learning methodologies.
• (30%) Perform routine extracts of data from core systems (both mainframe and distributed databases) and the enterprise data warehouse and generate reports, advanced analyses, and dashboards using this data.
• (15%) Assist Senior Data Scientists with identifying erroneous or outlier data based on operational knowledge and be able to make sufficient modifications to reports and analyses to account for these data anomalies.
• (15%) Assist operations departments with routine report writing, data validation, and analysis.
 
Required Education & Experience (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):
• Four-year degree or high school diploma or equivalent.
• 0 – 2 years of experience. 
• Must have a high level of technical aptitude and a passion for analytics, data, and problem solving. 
• Must have the ability to define complex business problems and drive the development of analyses resulting in tangible insights and solutions and the ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with external third parties such as vendors and regulators as well as internally at multiple levels across the organization. 
• Must have the ability to work collaboratively with others to define analytical strategies and solutions while also being self-driven to autonomously execute on deliverables.
• Must understand the fundamentals of the Cross Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRISP-DM) and apply this process to analytics projects.
 
Preferred Education & Experience (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):
 
• Four year or graduate degree in analytics, computer science, business, statistics, or mathematics.
• 1 – 2 years of direct experience preferred.
• Experience developing reports and dashboards using ibi WebFocus, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Report Builder/SSRS, Tableau or other BI and reporting applications is desired. A strong proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications, specifically Excel, is needed. 
• Experience with SQL and R, Python, SAS, or other data analysis tools or programming languages is preferred.

Job Environment & Physical Requirements:
 
• This is a hybrid role with work from home permitted as determined by departmental needs.
• Typical office environment with background noise from employees, copy machines, and telephones.
• This job entails a substantial amount of sitting, use of hands/fingers to operate a computer keyboard, ability to comprehend verbal instructions/phone calls, and ability to lift up to five pounds.

jobs.title: Analyst – Media Effectiveness
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Our mission is to Drive Business Performance. We use data to create personalized and connected experiences that deliver transformative business outcomes. Our role is to ensure our clients meet their quantifiable business goals every day, consistently, in every market. We are entirely focused on delivering better business results through optimization, creation and analysis across all digital platforms. Our scope ranges from recommending how to use content more effectively to optimizing daily media channel performance and maximizing visibility in eCommerce platforms.

The Analyst, Media Effectiveness supports the measurement and evaluation of media performance, helping deliver actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making across client campaigns. Working closely with analytics, media, and client teams, you will contribute to reporting, dashboard development, and performance analysis while building expertise in media measurement and marketing analytics.

Reporting & Analytics
• Support campaign measurement and performance reporting across media platforms, including Google Ads, Meta, GA4, and others. Work alongside senior team members to track and interpret campaign performance.
• Assist with reporting infrastructure by learning how performance data is tracked, organized, and maintained. Collaborate with team members and internal stakeholders to understand client reporting needs.
• Contribute to data-driven reporting and insights by supporting the analysis and presentation of campaign performance. Learn to communicate findings clearly to internal and client teams with guidance from senior colleagues.
• Participate in media testing initiatives by supporting test analysis and learning how campaign effectiveness is measured. Help collect data, organize findings, and support statistical interpretation under supervision.
• Develop an understanding of analytical approaches used to assess campaign performance, including foundational statistical methods. Support senior analysts in evaluating media impact through hands-on learning and mentorship.

Dashboard Building & Data Management
• Help maintain and improve client dashboards across visualization platforms such as Looker Studio, Tableau, and Power BI. Support dashboard updates and optimization efforts under guidance.
• Work with data engineering teams to understand how advertising data is extracted, transformed, and organized. Learn to write basic SQL queries for data extraction and validation. Support the creation and maintenance of data connections to media platforms.
• Monitor data quality by identifying discrepancies and supporting the resolution of data issues. Assist in automating routine reporting processes where applicable.

Stakeholder Collaboration
• Support team projects and collaborate with agency and client teams on reporting and analytics initiatives.
• Participate in the preparation of client meetings and help present reporting updates and performance summaries to stakeholders. Learn to translate data and findings into clear, business-friendly language with support from senior team members.
• Communicate findings clearly to internal and client stakeholders while developing presentation and storytelling skills through mentorship and feedback.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Master's or PhD degrees in related disciplines with transferable skills are considered an asset.
• Up to 2 years of experience in analytics, data management, research, or related fields. Prior advertising or marketing experience is not required. We will provide training on media platforms and measurement fundamentals.
• Foundational SQL skills, including the ability to write basic queries for data extraction, filtering, and validation. You do not need to be an expert; we will support your development as you grow in the role.
• Comfortable working with data and using quantitative insights to support decision-making. Willing to work with spreadsheets, dashboards, and reports while developing analytical skills and business acumen.
• Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, data visualization tools, or similar technologies. Expertise is not required; we will support growth across multiple tools and platforms.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings, ask thoughtful questions, and collaborate with team members and stakeholders.
• Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn. Interested in data, analytics, and understanding how advertising and media measurement work. Excited to grow both technically and professionally.

Nice-to-Have 
• Experience with Python or R. Helpful for automating analysis and learning statistical methods, but not required. We will support your development in these areas.
• Exposure to advertising or media platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, GA4, or similar tools. If you have not worked with these platforms before, we will provide training.
• Exposure to statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, experimental design, or related methodologies. Academic coursework or practical application is considered an asset.
• Familiarity with experimentation, testing methodologies, or measurement frameworks. Valuable context for our testing work but can be learned on the job.
• Interest in data visualization and dashboard design, including an understanding of how to present information in a clear and actionable way.

Additional information
Vacancy: Is this posting for the purposes of filling an existing vacancy [Y/N]
The salary range for this position is $60k-$65k. Actual salary within the salary range will be based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, knowledge, and skills. A range of medical, dental, RRSP, paid time off, and/or other benefits also are available to all permanent employees.

jobs.description:
You are the brain behind our work …
At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!
 
Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
 
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…
We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi. 
 
Your time here will look like this... 
You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
• Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
• Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
• Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
• Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
• Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
• Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.
• Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
 
To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:
• Graduation between Dec 2026 and June 2027.
• Educational background: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
• GPA of 3.0 or better is preferred. 
• A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.
• Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
• Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
• Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
• Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
• Work Authorization: Authorized to work in (country name) without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
 
Who we think will be a great fit...
A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
 
This program is ideal for those who:
• Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
• Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

jobs.title: Associate AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Fuel Cycle:

Fuel Cycle empowers leading organizations with agile research solutions that deliver decision-ready insights — fast, flexible, and fully integrated. As a market research disruptor, our AI-powered Insights Platform is built for speed, precision, and scale. With cutting-edge tools and seamless audience connectivity, we help brands ditch the guesswork and make smarter, customer-led decisions at lightning speed.

 

Why work at Fuel Cycle?

Join a high-growth team where curiosity is valued, ownership is encouraged, and your work drives real-world impact. Whether you’re based at our Los Angeles HQ, New York City hub, working remotely across the U.S., or part of our global team in India, you’ll help shape the future of decision intelligence for some of the world’s most iconic brands.

Overview:

Build real AI agents on a production platform, with senior engineers working alongside you. You will work in Python and FastAPI, build tool-calling agents on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore using the Strands Agents framework, and own technical decisions within the problems you take on, with your scope growing as you do. This role is fully in-office in Los Angeles because our mentorship model depends on it: pair programming, in-person code review, and a mentor a few desks away.

We hire for fundamentals, curiosity, and initiative. This is an early-career role. Engineers new to the field are welcome, and so are engineers with a year or two of experience who want to go deeper into AI and agentic systems. You do not need to know our stack on day one.

What You’ll Work On:

 - Design, build, and improve AI agents, deciding how tool-calling loops, model configuration, and multi-step workflows are structured using Strands Agents and AWS Bedrock

 - Build and integrate MCP tools and servers, and learn how tool names and descriptions shape what an LLM does

 - Deploy and run agents on Bedrock AgentCore, working with the platform team and your mentor

 - Build RAG pipelines over pgvector or FAISS, choosing chunking, embedding, and retrieval approaches based on what the results show

 - Design, test, and iterate on prompts; evaluate answer quality, latency, and token cost, and decide which tradeoffs to make; learn how guardrails are applied in production paths

 - Evaluate models, tools, and approaches, and recommend which to use, with your reasoning documented

 - Ship features and bug fixes in FastAPI services (REST and WebSocket APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis), deciding how to design, implement, and test them

 - Contribute to background jobs and queue consumers so agent work runs outside the API request path

 - Apply our architectural standards, use your judgment on design choices within them, help keep design documents current, and flag where the standards should change

 - Submit pull requests, respond to review feedback, and review teammates’ code as you grow

What You Bring:

 - Solid Python from coursework, internships, or work: functions, classes, type hints, error handling, testing basics

 - Data structures and algorithms, with awareness of time and space complexity

 - SQL fundamentals (joins, aggregations, indexes, schema design); PostgreSQL exposure preferred

 - REST and HTTP concepts, and how a web API is structured

 - Git and pull-request workflow

 - Clear communication, comfort asking questions, and a habit of picking up new tools and asking for help when you’re stuck

Preferred:

 - An agent project built with Strands Agents, LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or a similar framework (coursework, personal, or professional), including how an LLM chooses and calls tools

 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): building or using MCP tools and servers

 - AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore, or AWS basics such as S3 and SQS

 - RAG: chunking, embeddings, and vector stores

 - Prompt engineering: writing, testing, and iterating on prompts

 - FastAPI or a similar framework such as Flask or Django, SQLAlchemy or another ORM, and a willingness to learn async Python

Experience:

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, self-taught, or on-the-job)

 - Roughly 0–2 years of software engineering experience; internships, research, and substantial projects count

 - A track record of learning quickly, shown through coursework, projects, work, open-source contributions, or community involvement

Benefits & Perks:

Fuel Cycle is committed to supporting the well-being, flexibility, and growth of our team. We offer a competitive and inclusive benefits package that includes:

 - Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans

 - 401(k) with Company Match: Plan for your future with our retirement savings program

 - Equity Purchase Option: Participate in Fuel Cycle’s long-term success

 - Flexible Work Schedule: Empowering you to balance life and work

 - Generous Time Off:
   
   - 15 vacation days and 7 sick days per year
   
   - 12 company holidays
   
   - 4 floating holidays/recharge days to rest or celebrate what matters to you

 - Paid Parental Leave: Time to bond with your growing family

 - Monthly Internet & Phone Stipend: Support for remote work setup

 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Access to tools like Rightway (healthcare navigation), Headspace (mental wellness), Peloton (fitness), and more

 - Team Connection Perks:
   
   - Weekly community lunches, refreshments, and snacks at our LA & NY headquarters

 

Compensation Overview:

The expected starting salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000. This range represents the typical starting compensation offered to candidates hired into this role. Final base salary will be determined based on a variety of factors, including location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education, and certifications.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for variable bonus, and may include an equity grant or purchase option. These components make up your total compensation package, which will be reviewed in greater detail during your initial recruiter conversation.

 

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Equal Opportunity:

At Fuel Cycle, we embrace the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion and are committed to fostering an inclusive company culture. We believe that everyone, regardless of their background or identity, should have equal access to opportunities for growth and advancement. Our selection processes and career pathways are designed to be fair, transparent, and free from bias. We value the unique perspectives and contributions of each team member, knowing that this diverse range of experiences strengthens our team. Fuel Cycle stands firmly against discrimination based on disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law.

Fuel Cycle is an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities, as needed, to enable them to perform the essential functions of their job and participate in the application and interview process. If you require accommodations during any part of the application process, please contact us at hr@fuelcycle.com to discuss your needs.

Meijer Rewards
• Weekly pay 

• Scheduling flexibility

• Paid parental leave 

• Paid education assistance

• Team member discount 

• Development programs for advancement and career growth

Please review the job profile below and apply today!

The Software Engineer I, AI designs, develops, tests and supports AI-enabled software applications and services as a member of an Agile development team. This position is part of the AI team within Meijer Technology, which builds and operates the company's enterprise AI assistant and the shared services that support AI-enabled applications across the business. This role delivers assigned features and components, participates in code reviews and testing, and develops a working knowledge of Meijer's technology platforms, including cloud and AI-enabled application development. 

Position will follow our hybrid schedule – Monday-Wednesday in office, Thursday-Friday remote.
 
What You Will Be Doing 

• Delivers assigned features and components, taking on broader ownership over time.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
HELP BUILD THE NEXT CATEGORY-DEFINING AI COMPANY

AI has transformed how we write, communicate, and build software. The next frontier is even bigger: transforming how businesses actually operate. That's what we're building at Sola.

Sola is an AI-native platform reinventing enterprise process automation and disrupting legacy RPA tools. Our AI agents can execute complex workflows across any application, browser, desktop, or legacy system—free from the limitations and fragility of traditional automation tools. Users simply record their screen, and Sola creates a custom agent to run that process at scale.

The opportunity at hand is enormous. Nearly every enterprise, across every industry, runs on processes that are still painfully manual. We're building the technology to change that. And we're just getting started.

We're hiring a small group of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bring Sola to the world's largest enterprises and rewrite the playbook for how automation is built in the enterprise.

 


WHY SOLA? WHY NOW?

 


A MASSIVE MARKET READY FOR REINVENTION.

Enterprise automation is one of the biggest opportunities in AI. Legacy automation platforms have been constrained by rigid rules, complex implementations, and brittle workflows.. Sola is changing that with AI agents that can reason, adapt, and execute work across enterprise systems: the next generation of a massive software category.

 


REAL TRACTION. SERIOUS MOMENTUM.

Sola today powers enterprise workflows across healthcare, finance, legal, logistics, and more, including at Fortune 500 companies. We've closed seven-figure enterprise deals with a lean team. The product is proven. The market is responding. Now we're building the team to scale it.

 


BUILD ALONGSIDE LEADERS WHO'VE DONE IT BEFORE.

Work alongside David Fullerton, formerly CTO of Heap (Series C to acquisition) and Stack Overflow (Series A to E), as well as Sola's founders Neil Deshmukh and Jessica Wu. You'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional engineers and help shape how the company grows.

 


EARLY-STAGE OWNERSHIP. EXCEPTIONAL UPSIDE.

Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Conviction, and Y Combinator, Sola has raised more than $20M to build the future of enterprise automation.

We’re still early enough that individual contributions can meaningfully influence the company’s trajectory, and you’ll have a direct influence on how the FDE role evolves over time.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Sola, you'll combine hands-on technical execution with customer-facing communication and partnership.

 - Dive deep on customer workflow failures using logs, browser tools, APIs, and code, then implement and verify fixes

 - Build custom integrations and contribute production code to Sola's platform, turning recurring customer needs into reusable improvements

 - Join customer calls alongside Customer Success, ask questions that clarify the problem, and own the solution through resolution

 - Help customers onboard and adapt their workflows to Sola, including occasional travel for customer onboarding and key projects as needed

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're open to early-career engineers, new graduates with demonstrated programming ability, or strong customer-facing engineers who are comfortable writing production code.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

 - Strong technical foundations, whether from a CS degree with demonstrated coding abilities, or hands-on experience in a strong technical environment

 - Flexibility to move across different customer environments, with a solid understanding of how core web technologies work and the ability to dive into complex desktop or legacy systems

 - A strong sense of curiosity and a drive to go anywhere needed to solve tricky customer problems

 - Excellent communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical findings into clear non-technical explanations

You'll work 5 days a week out of our office in NYC (we'll cover relocation!) and occasionally travel to customers as needed.

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Sola offers competitive salary plus meaningful equity at Series A stage. Exact compensation is based on experience and level.

We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, daily meals together in the office, flexible PTO (4 weeks per year), and relocation support for candidates not already based in NYC.
