Forward Deployed Engineer - Data Integration
jobs.description:
Nexla, briefly

Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.

Nexla, briefly
Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.

Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.

Role description 
Our customers run complex, high-stakes data environments: fragmented systems, legacy pipelines, compliance constraints, aggressive timelines. You would embed with the most strategic of them, work out what they actually need, build it on Nexla, and get it into production. This is a hands-on, engineering-first role, not pre-sales and not solution architecture. You write the code, you deploy it, and when it breaks at the customer site you are the first responder. You would be one of the first people in this function here, so you get a real say in how we do forward-deployed engineering.

What you’ll own

• Technical delivery at strategic customer sites, end to end. You scope it, build it, test it, deploy it, and keep it running. Production pipelines, connectors, and workflows across their warehouses, SaaS apps, streaming systems, and internal APIs.

• The integrations nobody else can make work. Undocumented APIs, schemas that change without warning, legacy systems, and regulatory constraints, solved with intelligent connectors, context-aware transformations, and agentic capabilities in real customer environments rather than in a deck.

• What the product learns from the field. You spot the patterns that repeat across engagements, take the gaps and friction straight to Product and Engineering, and contribute reusable connectors, templates, reference architectures, and playbooks back to the platform.

• The commercial edge of the work. Supporting Sales through high-stakes technical evaluations, scoping proof-of-value, and being a technical partner customer stakeholders trust, from individual data engineers up to VPs of Data.

Roughly 60% building and deploying at customer sites, 25% feeding what you learn back into the product, 15% partnering with Sales and Customer Success.

Ninety days in: [one sentence on what they will have shipped or changed by then].

The hard problem

Every engagement is a special case. Messy schemas, undocumented APIs, legacy systems, and regulatory constraints, all specific to one customer and all solved against their timeline. At the same time, the platform only improves if what you build for one customer becomes something we ship for everyone. Deciding which parts of an engagement are genuinely one-off and which should become a product is the judgment this role runs on.

Must-haves

• 0 to 4 years of software engineering, with production systems you built and shipped yourself. Former technical founders, and engineers with consulting backgrounds, fit well here.

• Strong Python. You build data pipelines, write integrations, work with APIs, and script your way through ambiguous problems.

• Hands-on with AI and LLM tooling: prompt engineering, agent development, orchestration frameworks, or AI-powered workflows. You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to build with these tools.

• Real knowledge of enterprise data infrastructure. Warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, streaming platforms such as Kafka, ETL and ELT patterns, and the modern data stack. This is the part of the job most people underestimate.

• Customer-facing confidence. You can run a technical discovery call, whiteboard an architecture with a customer’s data team, and explain tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing them down.

Bonus points

• Experience building or deploying agentic AI systems in enterprise environments.

• Time at a data integration, iPaaS, or ELT company such as Fivetran, MuleSoft, Informatica, or Airbyte, or in another customer-facing engineering role.

• Familiarity with data protocols and patterns: CDC, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks, REST.

• Cloud-native experience on AWS or GCP, including managed data services, IAM, and networking.

You’ll thrive here if

• You have high agency. The problem is not well defined, the playbook does not exist yet, and you move anyway.

• You have owned outcomes, not tasks. You have been the person responsible for making something work in a real environment, not a staging cluster.

• You translate in both directions, between a customer’s world and ours, and between an individual data engineer and a VP of Data.

• You get bored doing the same thing for months. No two engagements here are the same.

One thing to be clear about: this function is new here, so there is no playbook to inherit and no bench to escalate to. When something breaks at a customer site, you are the first responder.

How we hire

Four conversations, about 3 weeks end to end.

• Take-home assignment. What you build, scoped to roughly X hours.]

• Live vibe coding. Building something real with AI tooling in the loop, the way the job is actually done.

• System architecture, vibe coding. Designing a solution for a customer-shaped problem, again with AI in the loop.

• Customer strategy and relationships. How you run a discovery call, handle a stakeholder who disagrees with you, and keep an engagement on track.

On AI in our interviews. Two of these rounds are built around working with AI tooling, because that is how the job is done. Use it the way you would on an engagement, ours or anyone else’s. jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the role

Skydio’s mission is to make the world safer and more efficient through autonomous drones. Public safety, critical infrastructure, and enterprise customers rely on Remote Flight Deck (RFD), Skydio’s browser-based piloting experience, to get eyes on the scene in seconds and coordinate a response. As a frontend intern on the RFD Platform team, you will help build that experience. RFD is the product the customer flies from, so the work starts in the interface and reaches into video, telemetry, and the services behind it when the feature calls for it.



The RFD Platform team builds the browser platform every remote pilot uses: live video, telemetry, the map, and flight controls. As an intern, you will ship production features with engineers, designers, and product managers, and you will have room to follow a problem past the frontend when that is where it leads.


HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Design and implement pilot-facing features that help operators make faster, safer decisions while flying.

 - Leverage curiosity, technical skill, and a collaborative mindset to help make the world more productive, creative, and safe with autonomous drones.

 - Collaborate across functions (product managers, designers, engineers, and support) to deliver high-quality, impactful features to customers.


PROJECT EXAMPLES

 - Build on the multi-cockpit view that allows pilots to open several drone pilots at once.

 - Ship a camera control like click-to-focus. Hold F, click a point in the live video, and lock focus and exposure on a moving target

 - Add a map layer like the flight-path breadcrumbs where pilots can turn on a live trail of where the drone has flown.

 - Render AR bounds around subject tracks from the vehicle, and allow users to interface to instruct the drone to follow a vehicle.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

 - Solid software engineering foundation and a commitment to writing clean, well-architected code.

 - Junior, senior, or MS-level student with meaningful project or internship experience developing modern web applications that connect to backend APIs and data systems.

 - Experience in modern web development (React, TypeScript, GraphQL, WebGL/Three.js).

 - Experience building and maintaining scalable APIs, services, and integrations for handling large datasets.

 - Bonus: familiarity with robotics software development concepts.



What Makes You a Good Fit:

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Graduate students, and $70/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Interns are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence Research Intern
jobs.description:
Who we are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About the Role

We are seeking a visionary AI/ML Research Intern to join our founding team and bridge the gap between high-level AI research and real-world physical actuation for our next-generation autonomous transport platforms.

In this role, you will contribute to core research initiatives on World Models and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. You will help translate cutting-edge theoretical breakthroughs into scalable, real-world deployment on physical autonomous systems, driving how our platforms perceive, simulate, and navigate complex environments.

What you'll do

• Research and develop cutting-edge RL and distillation techniques for trajectory planning.

• Integrate emerging research from the broader AI community, identifying and prototyping the most promising solutions.

• Design and prototype end-to-end multimodal models that translate real-time visual perception and high-level behavioral goals into physical vehicle actuation.

• Develop interactive world models from raw multi-sensor logs, allowing the team to re-simulate events and query what a vehicle would see if it altered its trajectory.

• Ensure core autonomous driving models can seamlessly adapt to novel urban environments and edge cases.

• Partner with validation and research teams to run model experiments through rigorous simulated scenarios, detecting regressions and identifying systemic performance bottlenecks.

What we're looking for

• Education: Currently enrolled in a PhD degree program in Computer Science, EECS, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a closely related quantitative field.

• Research Track Record: Publications or submissions in top-tier machine learning or robotics venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, RSS, ICRA, CoRL).

• Core Expertise: Graduate-level research background focused on at least one of the following domains:

• Generative World Models / Video Generation / Diffusion Models

• Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or embodied AI

• Reinforcement Learning (RL), trajectory optimization, or decision-making systems

• Large-scale multimodal Transformer architectures applied to robotics or spatio-temporal data

• Framework Fluency: Advanced hands-on proficiency with PyTorch or JAX for training and fine-tuning large-scale neural networks.

• Programming: Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C++.

Preferred qualifications

• Hands-on experience with Sensor Fusion integrating inputs across multi-camera setups, LiDAR, and Radar.

• Familiarity with Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) visual representations, 3D occupancy forecasting, multi-task learning, or specialized data tokenization for spatial data.

• Prior experience with large-scale distributed training on GPU/TPU clusters (e.g., DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Ray, or PyTorch FSDP).

• Prior research or internship experience in autonomous driving, mobile robotics, or spatial AI.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Mountain View or San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change, we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The hourly pay range for this internship role is $70/hr per hour. 

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. 

Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

#LI-Onsite

jobs.description:
Please apply to this job with your personal email address (not your University or Program account) to avoid important Twitch emails hitting your spam inbox.

About Us:

Launched in 2011, Twitch is a global community that comes together each day to create multiplayer entertainment: unique, live, unpredictable experiences created by the interactions of millions. We bring the joy of co-op to everything, from casual gaming to world-class esports to anime marathons, music, and art streams. Twitch also hosts TwitchCon, where we bring everyone together to celebrate, learn, and grow their personal interests and passions. We’re always live at Twitch. Stay up to date on all things Twitch on Linkedin, X and on our Blog.

About the Role

**This internship is only for undergraduate students at North American colleges/universities with Spring 2028 graduation dates. We understand these can be flexible, so if that's the case, you can indicate on the application that you'd like to be considered for both. No need to apply to both roles.**

At Twitch, we’re always looking for high-potential talent. If you’re a current student in computer science, we’d love to see you apply. See below for just a few reasons why our cohort-based internship program is one-of-a kind.

Project-Based Learning at Scale: Twitch operates at a massive scale, requiring us to push the boundaries of technology and experiment with techniques used by only the largest websites. As an intern, you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging engineering problems in the industry, making every project a valuable learning experience. 

Comprehensive Support Team: To ensure our interns thrive, we provide a dedicated support system, including a Manager, Mentor, and Early Careers Advisor. This team will work closely with you to guide your project from start to finish and ensure you have the resources needed to succeed. 

Enriched Intern Community: In addition to hands-on engineering work, you will participate in leadership and interpersonal development curriculum, as well as gain valuable industry insights from Twitch leaders through fireside chats. To complement the technical aspects of the program, we offer a variety of enrichment activities, including cohort trips, weekly advisory sessions, and local community events. We also provide housing assistance to make your summer internship as rewarding and enjoyable as possible.

Want to learn more? Check out the Early Careers Page for internship and student-focused content. 

You can work from San Francisco, CA.

You Will:

• Contribute to product design and implementation discussions

• Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production

• Test and iterate code before and after production release

• Connect with intern peers, new teammates, and colleagues from across the business

You Have:

• BA/BS Graduation Year: Spring/Summer 2028. No Masters/PhD

• Eagerness to investigate challenges and present reasonable solutions reliably and quickly 

• Excitement to pick up a new language and be productive with it in a week 

• Desire to work collaboratively in a team environment 

• Completed coursework in or have an understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms

Perks

• Housing Stipend provided 

• Relocation assistance to and from San Francisco, CA

• Free Snacks & Beverages

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Twitch. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $42.5/hr in our lowest geographic market up to $88.94/hr in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Amazon is a total compensation company. Dependent on the position offered, equity, sign-on payments, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. For more information, please visit https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/employee-benefits. Applicants should apply via our internal or external career site.
Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Campaigns Data Services Intern
jobs.description:
Grassroots Analytics (“GA”) is a political tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers in fundraising for progressive campaigns and causes. To facilitate that work, GA maintains a detailed database on more than 20 million active, left-leaning American donors, including data on net worth, ideological preferences, political donation history, non-profit donation history, demographics, and contact information. Our overall mission is to use that data to amplify forward-thinking voices, causes, and people.

Grassroots Analytics is seeking a Campaigns Data Services Intern to join our team of experts to provide top-tier, individualized fundraising guidance and hyper-targeted data directly to our clients. The intern will collaborate closely with the Sr. Fundraising Strategist to offer campaigns and nonprofits highly-targeted donor lists, comprehensive fundraising instruction, and industry-leading customer service. This role is ideal for someone passionate about political strategy, relationship building, and empowering progressive campaigns and organizations up and down the ballot.

Responsibilities:

Data Querying & Donor List Building (70%)

• Understand the ins and outs of Grassroots’ donor database and targeting capabilities

• Build personalized donor lists for clients based on their profile (type of race, pertinent biographical info, demographics, top-issues, etc.)

• Support execution of GA’s comprehensive data services

• Provide data targeting recommendations to other members of the Grassroots team

• Complete incoming data requests efficiently. 

Fundraising Assistance to Campaigns and Nonprofit Clients (20%)

• Assist the Fundraising Strategy team with client onboarding and check-in calls

• Participate in call time training sessions with clients and their teams

• Help the Fundraising Strategists assess each client’s level of fundraising knowledge to make relevant recommendations. 

• Showcase the value of Grassroots to consultants and firms. Encourage them to refer us to other potential clients. 

Taking Initiative & Final Projects (10%) 

• Schedule a 1-on-1 chat with members of every department at Grassroots. 

• Volunteer to help with inter-department or company projects. 

• Attend internal team building events (happy hours, professional development sessions, GA socials, intern events, etc.) 

The Grassroots Approach: 

• Customer service is our core - clients are always, without exception, treated with the highest level of professionalism and respect. 

• Model a high bar for performance - we operate with the best interests of both the organization and every client in mind.

• Strengthen relationships at every level - our “people first” approach builds trust with team members and clients alike.

• Proactivity is the key to problem solving - We look at the “big picture” to develop solutions to challenges and identify and prevent potential future setbacks.

• We remain flexible - we adapt quickly as events change; we take advantage of unexpected opportunities and are ready to act quickly. 

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate for the internship position will: 

• Possess an adept understanding of the political landscape, particularly at the state and local levels. 

• Be a skilled relationship builder with the ability to cultivate and maintain a broad network. 

• Demonstrate exceptional communication, writing, and presentation skills; aptitude to convey complex solutions in an accessible manner.

• Be highly organized, capable of managing multiple accounts. 

• Prove an ability to turn work around diligently and efficiently; able to meet tight deadlines. 

• Have an interest in progressive causes and a desire to support candidates from diverse backgrounds. 

Compensation:

The pay rate for this position is $20/hr. This is a full-time, in-office position based in our office in Chinatown at 806 7th St NW, Washington, D.C. 20001. The internship will run from January 25, 2027 to April 16, 2027.

Grassroots Analytics is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming environment where everyone is empowered to do their best work. Grassroots Analytics does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. The Data team also functions as an internal "customer" that dogfoods the Databricks platform and drives product improvements.

• Work with the Data team and internal stakeholders (Product, Customer Success, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Finance) to use data to solve problems

• Apply your expertise in data science methodologies such as causal inference modeling and recommender systems to real data to deliver insights and/or deploy algorithms to the Databricks platform

Pay Range Transparency

We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Data Analyst Summer Internship

Systems & Technology Research (STR) is a growing technology company. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security.

We are seeking a Data Analyst Intern to support data analysis, business systems, process improvement, and operational documentation across STR. This is an in-person role out of our Arlington, VA or Woburn, MA site. This position will provide hands-on experience in data interpretation, reporting, workflow analysis, software applications, and the development of standardized procedures and training materials. The intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data visibility, streamline business processes, maintain accurate documentation, and support operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Assist with collecting, organizing, validating, and analyzing data to support business operations and internal decision-making.

• Develop and maintain spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, and data trackers using Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.

• Analyze data trends, identify discrepancies, and summarize findings to support operational reporting and process improvement initiatives.

• Support the use and administration of business systems, software applications, databases, and other operational tools.

• Evaluate existing workflows and business processes to identify inefficiencies, opportunities for improvement, and potential areas for automation or standardization.

• Assist with documenting business processes, developing standard operating procedures (SOPs), and maintaining clear, consistent process documentation.

• Create training documentation, instructional materials, and presentations to support employee education and the adoption of business systems and processes.

• Develop and update user guides, training materials, and presentations using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and applicable content development tools such as Articulate.

• Assist with organizing, maintaining, and improving SharePoint sites, document libraries, and other document management systems.

• Support data and document quality initiatives by maintaining accurate records, validating information, and ensuring documentation is current and accessible.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, troubleshoot system or process issues, and communicate findings and recommendations.

• Assist with implementing standardized reporting methods, improving data accessibility, and enhancing operational workflows.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Must be a U.S. citizen due to the nature of STR's work and applicable regulations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, recognize patterns, and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Experience with or an interest in data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, as well as querying languages such as SQL, is preferred.

• Ability to learn new software applications, business systems, and technical tools quickly.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to develop clear, organized, and user-friendly documentation, SOPs, and training materials.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when working with data, documentation, and business processes.

• Familiarity with or an interest in SharePoint, document management, workflow analysis, and process standardization.

• Self-motivated, adaptable, and collaborative, with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Previous experience with data analysis, reporting, technical documentation, process improvement, or business systems is beneficial but not required.

Perks:

• Competitive pay

• Free housing for interns at our Massachusetts site, or bonuses at other sites

• Flexible working hours

• Fun summer activities both in and outside the office

Pay Information

Hourly Range: $25.20–$54.00/hour

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.
STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Internship - Warp Speed
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
 
The Role
 
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. The Warp Speed Deployment role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to manufacture high-quality products is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into a reality.
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most exciting problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into an understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 
You'll immerse yourself in our customers' most intricate workflows. You'll partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll seek will require a curious and analytical approach, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user insight to ultimately empower our customers to improve decisions.

No two days are the same, but you can expect to:
• Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest problems

• Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows

• Work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline

• Work with the customer to build customized workflows for new user groups

• Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and having concrete impact on their operations

• Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives

• Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings

• Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers

• Scope out potential engagements in new industries and expanding locations around the world
What We Value
• Team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers and will dive into the details of the data

• Low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit

• Extraordinary ability to confront open-ended problems in unstructured environments

• Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, guide, lead and follow
What We Require
• U.S. Person Required

• Must be graduating in December 2027 or Spring 2028

• Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team

• Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL)
Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $6,700/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.


Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Relocation assistance
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship - Warp Speed
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

What We Value
• A highly analytical approach and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools

• Experience or curiosity about working with and using large scale data to take on valuable business problems

• Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and iteration with users
What We Require
• U.S. Person Required

• Must be graduating in December 2027 or Spring 2028

• Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science

• Strong coder with shown proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar

• Ability and interest to travel up to 25%, as needed to client sites, but flexible based on personal preferences
Salary
 
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,000/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad - Warp Speed
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

What We Value
• A highly analytical approach and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools

• Experience or curiosity about working with and using large scale data to take on valuable business problems

• Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and iteration with users
What We Require
• U.S. Person Required

• Must be graduating in December 2026 or Spring 2027

• Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science

• Strong coder with shown proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar

• Ability and interest to travel up to 25%, as needed to client sites, but flexible based on personal preferences

Nous sommes un studio de développement de jeux de premier plan composé de vétérans de l'industrie du jeu. jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern - Central Applied Science
Marketing Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
Kensington delivers the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that’s tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure that they enjoy the authentic best of their destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime!

We achieve this because of our extraordinary people, passionate experts with deep knowledge of their destinations. They are what enables us to deliver remarkable experiences in over 120 countries worldwide, and across each of our businesses – Private Touring, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Expeditions, Ultraluxe Land, Private Jets, and Air. 

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com. 

About the Role

As a Marketing Analytics Intern, you will work hands-on with web analytics platforms (GA4 and Amplitude) to turn raw data into insights that shape real marketing decisions. You will partner directly with marketing stakeholders across channels, advising on campaign strategy and helping the team understand what is working, what is not, and why. This role is highly autonomous: you will be trusted to own your work, and you will have room to take on a big stretch project in marketing or analytics that you can present to the team by the end of your internship.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Own

• Web Analytics. Gather, clean, and analyze web data for the marketing teams that drive traffic to our site (paid, email, social, SEO, and partnerships). Track traffic, engagement, and conversion trends, and translate what you find into clear, actionable recommendations.

• End-to-End Analysis. Connect marketing spend to results. Identify overperforming and underperforming campaigns, segment audiences, and dig into the small details (landing pages, funnel drop-offs, device or channel differences) that make a big impact. You will take an analysis from question to data to insight to recommendation.

• Dashboards and Reporting. Help build dashboards in Amplitude or Power BI so stakeholders can see results immediately and self-serve answers without waiting on an ad hoc request.

• Stakeholder Consulting. Meet with marketing partners to understand their goals, define success metrics, and recommend how to improve campaign performance and measurement.

• Stretch Project. Pick up and drive a larger initiative of your choosing, such as an attribution analysis, A/B test readout, customer journey study, or a new reporting framework, and share the results with the broader team.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

• Experience with web analytics platforms such as GA4, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics, or equivalent (coursework, projects, or prior internships count).

• Experience working with fragmented data from multiple sources and combining it into a single, trustworthy view.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling, and clear charting).

• Nice to have: SQL and/or Python for querying, cleaning, and analyzing data.

• A curious mindset and a genuine desire to understand user behavior through data.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain findings to non-technical audiences and tell a clear story with data.

• Interest in data, marketing, and UI/UX, and how they come together to shape the customer experience.

• Self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, asks good questions, and manages their own time.

What You'll Gain

• Hands-on experience with industry-standard analytics and BI tools.

• Real ownership of work that influences live marketing campaigns and budget decisions.

• Regular exposure to marketing and analytics leaders, plus mentorship throughout the internship.

• A portfolio-ready project and the experience of presenting insights to stakeholders.

Position Details:

This is a full-time, hybrid internship offering $20 per hour for 40 hours per week.

We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.
The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by the hiring team.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Midstream Services Intern
jobs.description:
At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. 

Join our Qrew! 

As an EQT Intern, you will participate in a 12-week paid “real-world experience” internship program. Not only will you be involved in learning activities unique to your role, but you will learn and grow with #Qrew. If innovation and powering the future sounds exciting to you, we encourage you to apply!

Here is how the Midstream Services Intern will impact our business: 

The Midstream Services Intern will support EQT’s Midstream organization in the continued development of a modern, data-driven operating platform. The intern will gain hands-on experience working across Midstream operations, enterprise systems, data and analytics, asset management, financial reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The position will work closely with Midstream Services and cross-functional partners across Operations, Engineering & Construction, Finance, Information Technology/Digital, and other business functions. The internship is designed to provide exposure to both the operational and technology sides of the Midstream business while giving the intern ownership of meaningful projects and deliverables.

Midstream Services is focused on strengthening enterprise systems and asset management, expanding business intelligence and enterprise integrations, improving data quality and governance, and increasing automation and operational efficiency.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems, technologies, and business processes.

This internship provides exposure to the intersection of energy operations, engineering, technology, data, finance, and asset management. The intern will have the opportunity to work with real Midstream business challenges, interact with leaders and subject-matter experts, visit operating facilities where appropriate, and see how technology and data are being used to modernize a large-scale natural gas Midstream organization.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineering Intern - Hardware Systems
Compiler Engineering Graduate Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
Join Us in Shaping the Future

At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.

The Team
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.

Position Overview
We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on an engineering or research project that may involve compiler features, MLIR-based intermediate representations, Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), optimization, code generation, runtime or offload support, debug information, testing infrastructure, performance analysis, or developer tools. Projects may connect hardware capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for a graduate student who can apply deeper technical expertise to an ambiguous engineering or research problem, evaluate alternatives, and deliver a well-supported solution or prototype.

Responsibilities
• Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, or analysis of compiler and runtime technologies.
• Develop and debug software in C or C++ within a large, collaborative codebase.
• Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions.
• Evaluate functional correctness, compile-time behavior, runtime performance, or code quality, as applicable to the project.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and team members.
• Document designs, experiments, results, and lessons learned, and present project outcomes to the team.
• Contribute to open-source projects when aligned with the assigned work.

Success in This Role

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

As a Software Engineering Intern, you’ll join a growing, diverse, and mission-driven team building a new cloud infrastructure from the ground up and work at the forefront of distributed system technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to work on a range of projects across our platform that enables innovation in computationally intensive fields including artificial intelligence, graphics rendering and computational biology.



You’ll collaborate with other engineers to build and maintain scalable and highly available fault-tolerant distributed systems at scale, build products and tools from the ground up that will be used by customers around the world, triage bugs and solve issues in production, and work with product owners and other stakeholders to iterate on new features.



What You'll Be Working On:

Software Engineering Interns may work within one of these three organizations based on your interest and business needs:

 

Product focused — Managed Cloud

 - We build the parts of Crusoe Cloud that customers actually use: the UI they log into, the command-line tool they type into, and the APIs their code talks to. You'll ship features that real customers use before your internship ends.

 - Good fit if you like: full-stack or backend web development. Languages: Go, TypeScript/React.

Systems focused — Cloud Availability

 - Crusoe runs tens of thousands of GPUs, and our job is keeping them all healthy — mostly by writing software that detects and fixes problems automatically instead of waking someone up at 3am. You'll build tools that replace manual work at real scale.

 - Good fit if you like: automation, scripting, and figuring out why things break. Languages: Go and Python.

Infra focused — Cloud Infrastructure

 - We build the layer everything else runs on — the compute, storage, and networking that turn racks of servers into a cloud, plus Crusoe Managed Kubernetes, the product customers use to run containers on our GPUs. Work ranges from operating-system-level code to building Kubernetes controllers and operators.

 - Good fit if you like: operating systems, distributed systems, or Kubernetes. Languages: mostly Go.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Educational Background: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field preferably graduating between Fall 2027 and Spring 2028.

 - Programming: You are familiar with coding in a language such as Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, Rust, Go, etc.

 - Foundational Knowledge: You're familiar with computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithm design.

 - Collaborative Mindset: You are a proactive communicator who enjoys working closely with a team to solve challenging problems.

 - Problem-Solving Skills: You have a curious and analytical mindset with a talent for troubleshooting and optimizing complex systems.



Our Internship Program

Our 12-week, in-person program pairs high-impact work with one-on-one mentorship and direct access to leaders across the organization. You'll gain hands-on experience that goes beyond the classroom. The program is built to support your professional growth and help you forge valuable connections within Crusoe and beyond.



We're looking for motivated, talented people who are eager to take on real responsibility and make a real impact. Are you ready to join the Future Cru?



2027 Summer Internship Dates (choose one cohort):

 - May 24 – August 13, 2027

 - June 14 – September 3, 2027
   
   

Benefits:

 - Compensation will be $49/hour

 - One-time housing stipend

 - Access to HealthiestYou and Calm

 - Paid holiday and volunteer days

 - Commuter allowance



Crusoe is not sponsoring visas for these positions at this time or in the future.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: System Electrical Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Tacit

We are an early-stage, deep tech startup based in San Francisco, developing innovative hardware that rethinks human-computer interaction. We are backed by General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Greylock Partners, with a founding team from Stanford, BrainGate, Oculus, and Tesla. While we can’t reveal too much just yet, our team is tackling cutting-edge engineering challenges to bring revolutionary products to life.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a System Electrical Engineer Intern to help validate, debug, and improve the electrical blocks in our sensing hardware. You'll work alongside our hardware engineers on real prototype boards: bringing them up on the bench, measuring how they perform, tracking down problems, and helping turn what you learn into the next design.

You'll take part in the product's journey from prototype to mass production, including bring-up, design updates, and testing. We hire interns on a rolling basis and are flexible on start date and timeline.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help bring up prototype boards and get them ready for testing.

 - Run bench measurements on power rails, battery charging, sensor front ends, and digital interfaces, following validation plans and helping write new ones. Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and multimeters to characterize how blocks perform.

 - Help debug hardware issues and narrow down root causes with the hardware team. Propose and implement small schematic and layout changes to improve performance, power, or board area.

 - Build and automate repeatable bench tests, and collect and analyze data across multiple boards.

 - Document results and present findings and recommendations to the team.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

 - Solid grasp of EE fundamentals: circuit analysis, analog and digital electronics, and power basics

 - Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies, from coursework, projects, or prior internships.

 - Experience designing or debugging a circuit board, in class, in a club, or on your own.

 - Curiosity and persistence when tracking down why something isn't working. Clear communication and good documentation habits.


STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE

 - PCB design experience in Altium or a similar tool.

 - Python for test automation or data analysis, or embedded C/C++.

 - Background in signal integrity and power integrity simulation.

 - Familiarity with RF circuits and components.

 - Exposure to mixed-signal, power, or battery-powered designs.

 - Experience with high-speed or communication interfaces such as USB, SPI, or I2C. Independent work ethic, flexibility, and resourcefulness.

 - Comfort in a fast-moving startup, and excitement to build independently.

jobs.title: Hardware Test and Reliability Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the role:

We are seeking Summer 2027 interns or Co-ops for our Hardware Test & Reliability Team!

Autonomous systems are a new breed of product that bring together electronics hardware and real-time AI software. The complexity of the systems combined with the fact they can move freely in the real world, makes the development and reliability testing strategy a key element of delivering a great product.

We are seeking a driven and cross-functional engineering intern to help the development and execution of test plans and testing infrastructure to enable rapid design iteration and robust product validation for state-of-the-art autonomous flying machines servicing a broad range of consumer and commercial use cases.

How you’ll make an impact:

 - Own the design and implementation of hardware and software systems to execute comprehensive performance and reliability validation for products performing in a wide array of use cases

 - Analyze data, calculate statistics, and carefully document results to explain trends and inform impactful design improvements

 - Perform failure analysis to identify root cause and help develop process/design mitigations to resolve system issues, collaborating with mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams

 - Participate in design reviews and provide key design for reliability inputs to mitigate risks at every stage of the product development lifecycle

What makes you a good fit:

 - A sense of how to test, how not to test, and how to find vulnerabilities in processes and design

 - A systematic approach to problem solving, and a knack for rapidly identifying issues within electro-mechanical systems; strong desire to drive failure analyses to true root cause

 - Enthusiastic tendencies toward diving in and applying first principles to engineer creative solutions to complex problems

 - Experience with Python or other programming languages for test automation, data analysis and visualization

 - Strong desire to learn and contribute across multiple domains within a dynamic and growing organization

 - Excellent project management, written & verbal communication and cross-functional teamwork skills

 - Familiarity with testing equipment and basic knowledge of stress, environmental, and accelerated life testing methods to assess product durability and reliability.

Compensation Range: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Graduate students, and $58 for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience.

*For some positions the pay may be dependent upon the individual's regional location.

🎨 ABOUT OPENART

OpenArt is an AI Storytelling and Visual Creation Platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future.

🚀 Why Join OpenArt

 - Real impact through leadership exposure — work directly with C-level leaders and the key decision-making committee, with opportunities for your ideas and judgment to shape a product used by more than 10M users worldwide.

 - A direct role in growth strategy — help leadership assess where to expand, which customers and partners to prioritize, and how to plan for scale.

 - Exposure to the creative AI ecosystem — research the market and gather insights from creative professionals, agencies, model providers, operators and investors.

 - Return offer opportunities — strong interns will be considered for full-time roles across product, engineering, research and GTM.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll help shape how OpenArt feels to use. This role is for builders with a technical background and strong product taste: people who follow AI progress closely and know how to turn new capabilities into features creative professionals love.




EMPLOYMENT TYPE

Year-round internship with rolling start dates: full-time in summer, part-time (15–20 hrs/week) during the fall and spring semesters. Minimum 3-month commitment




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Track tech progress: follow new AI models, tools and tech trends at the cutting edge, often before public launch through early access, understand what each makes possible, and bring a regular take on what OpenArt should adopt or build.

 - Turn ideas into features: translate new capabilities into feature ideas, prototype them, and work with designers and engineers to ship them.

 - Test hands-on: run usability tests on new features and benchmark competing creative AI products, then form a clear judgment on what's great, what's broken and what to do next, and get the team aligned on it.

 - Partner across teams: work with Growth and Community on creator programs, challenges and showcases that highlight great work made on OpenArt.

 - Stay close to users: listening to users is part of doing this job well. Talk with them every day (interviews, Discord, social), understand what they need, and let that shape every feature you push for.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - Studying or trained in CS, engineering, HCI, design or a related technical field. We welcome undergraduate and graduate students at any stage, as well as candidates on a gap year or in other situations.

 - Proactively using AI creative tools (OpenArt, Midjourney, Runway, Krea, Higgsfield, ComfyUI or similar) with strong opinions on what makes them great or frustrating.

 - A builder with product taste: you have engineering skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, working with APIs), you've built or shipped something (an app, side project, tool or design), and you can explain the choices behind it.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Close involvement in developer and creative professional communities, which gives you early exposure to new trends and high-value information.

 - Good taste in what you read and strong learning habits, so you catch important trends early.


WORK SETUP

 - Bay Area required (hybrid allowed)

 - Visa sponsorship available


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The expected base salary range for this role is $40 to $50 per hour, plus the same in-office benefits as our full-time employees.

 Northrop Grumman is hiring a Cyber Software Engineer Intern to join our Mission Systems sector in San Antonio, Texas. You will work with our Xetron team to build capabilities for military and intelligence customers. This is a full-time, paid internship for Summer 2027.

There’s never been a better time to be part of Insperity, and our best work is still ahead. Learn more at Insperity.com.

Why Insperity?

Flexibility: Over 80% of Insperity’s jobs have flexibility. We want your time to have balance, whether it’s spent with coworkers, clients, family or your community.

Career Growth: Insperity provides many ways to grow with the company. We offer continuous learning programs, mentorship opportunities and ongoing training.
