Want to work for us and find out why? 

As a trusted advisor to America's best businesses for more than 34 years, Insperity provides an array of human resource and business solutions designed to help improve business performance.  

Rotational Data Analytics Intern 

We are seeking Data Analytic Interns to engage in various work assignments, projects, and activities of varying complexity, structured to enable the intern to gain the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities needed to perform at a professional level, typically identified with a targeted existing position. Our interns will receive training and mentorship in planning and carrying out activities and assignments. The work projects will involve assignments that are relevant to Insperity’s current business needs and opportunities. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Learns through completion of work assignments by applying up-to-date knowledge in subject area to meet deadlines; following procedures and policies, and applying data and resources to support projects or initiatives; collaborating with others, often cross-functionally, to solve business problems; supporting the completion of priorities, deadlines, and expectations; communicating progress and information; identifying and recommending ways to address improvement opportunities when possible; and escalating issues or risks as appropriate.  

• Pursues self-development and effective relationships with others by sharing resources, information, and knowledge with coworkers and customers; listening, responding to, and seeking performance feedback; acknowledging strengths and weaknesses; assessing and responding to the needs of others; and adapting to and learning from change, difficulties, and feedback. Contributes to the completion of projects and department objectives as specified by the rotation manager.  

• Observes and learns the practical applications of:  

• Consults with business stakeholders across the enterprise (ITS, Sales, Marketing, Operations, GPO) to understand key priorities for market, competitive, and customer insights. 

• Designs executes and analyzes appropriate research & analysis to address priority enterprise insights needs.  

• Recommends ideal project design to address specific information needs involving multiple phases or methodologies.  

• Develop compelling reports & executive briefs from the data analysis results; consult with business stakeholders to share findings and implications. 

• Supports execution of summary analysis and reporting of insights on key topics of priority for enterprise. 

• Supports teams with data collection & analysis, as prioritized by department leadership. 

• Attends events designed to connect Interns and Associates working across different functional areas throughout Insperity.  

• Provides ongoing feedback on improvements and upgrades to the program. 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

• High School Diploma or equivalent is required.  Actively pursuing or has obtained a Bachelor’s Degree is required.  A Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Data Science or a related field is preferred. 

• GPA of 3.25 or higher preferred. 

• Effective problem solving/decision making skills. 

• Proven skills in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies and data analysis. 

• Ability to effectively convey information derived from data sets to all levels of stakeholders. 

• Working knowledge of database programs, data manipulations and customized report development. 

• Functional understanding of data analysis concepts associated with unstructured data. 

• Demonstrated analytical, statistical, and critical thinking skills.  

• Project management skills and experience in managing multiple projects and activities in an efficient and timely manner. 

• Basic presentation skills.  

• Proficient use of Microsoft Office programs, experience using customer relationship management software, and demonstrated ability to learn other application programs as needed. 

At Insperity, we celebrate the diversity of our employees and our leadership. Insperity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the role 
 As a Rotational AI Intern, you will work with diverse teams to design, develop, test, and maintain AI solutions. You will rotate through various projects that apply AI concepts to real-world business challenges. This role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions while working alongside senior staff. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Apply AI tools and concepts to complete work assignments and support business initiatives. 
 Communicate project progress, insights, and risks to team leaders. 
 Assist in problem framing, system design, and defining parameters for AI solutions. 
 Develop and refine AI models and workflows using machine learning, data analysis, and programming.

 A High School Diploma or equivalent.

Electrical Hardware Engineering Intern 

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
 
Hewlett Packard Enterprise advances the way people live and work. We bring together the brightest minds to create breakthrough technology solutions, helping our customers make their mark on the world.
 
At HPC and AI Infrastructure Solutions, we focus on cutting-edge, high-performance, high-scale customer solutions serving a wide range of industries and end-users. Our organization includes High-Performance Computing (HPC), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and High-Performance Networking.
 
At HPE we believe in bold moves, the power of “Yes we can”, and being a force for good. Our work thrives on differences, fueling creativity to give our customers all they deserve. But our work is far from over. In fact, we continuously push for better. We empower our team members to make an impact on our business and in the world while fostering a culture that is unconditionally inclusive. Whether you’re looking for an internship or to start your professional career, at HPE you’ll be able to create and collaborate on projects that challenge and inspire you.
 
Is this you? We are looking for an Electrical Hardware Engineering Intern within HPE, High Performance Computing to join us!
You will have an exciting opportunity to learn and collaborate on hardware engineering projects with guidance from R&D experts that create innovative solutions for smart digital experiences. 

Responsibilities:
• You will work on a specific project critical to HPE
• You will evaluate portions of engineering solutions for electrical and electronic parts, subsystems, integrated circuitry, and algorithms based on established engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements.
• You will implement established test plans for existing designs, including validation of tolerances, form/fit/function, shock and vibration, electromagnetic interference, safety, reliability, thermal generation, and system power measurements
• You will participate as a member of project team of other electrical hardware engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high-quality solutions for low to moderately-complex products
• You will be mentored by a senior member of the engineering team who will help you to technically approach the use case

Education & Experience:
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree program; 3rd Year of University completed
• Experience or understanding of electrical design tools and software packages
• Demonstrate good analytical and problem-solving skills
• Maintain a strong interest in high-tech and a passion for learning.
• Understand design for electronic components, integrated circuitry, and algorithms
• Have good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

HVP/Cert Engineer Intern

Your Role
As an Engineering Intern on our team, you will support the development, implementation, and certification of safety-critical software products used by Aerospace, Industrial, and Automotive customers. You will be involved in feature development, certification activities, and defect resolution while working closely with software engineers, architects, and product management teams.
The team is responsible for developing and certifying VxWorks/HVP features on platforms such as ARM and IA. You will gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects while contributing to the development of world-class system software for next-generation hardware and software platforms
 
Responsibilities
• Support the development of software modules for VxWorks and HVP products.
• Contribute to feature implementation, certification activities, and defect resolution.
• Collaborate with product management and system architects to understand and implement product requirements.
• Participate in the development and certification of software running on ARM, IA, and related platforms.
• Take initiative in identifying opportunities to improve features and engineering processes.
• Contribute ideas for product enhancements and future iterations.

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is looking for someone to join our Software Systems team as Software Engineer Intern. The ideal candidate for this position will be able to work part-time during the school year and full-time during the summer in Boise Idaho. If you are looking for the opportunity to gain hands on experience with industry professionals, then this position is for you! 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Support SEL’s software development process 
• Verify that software meets requirements.
• Implement firmware/software design.
• Provide support to engineering staff as needed.
• Follow engineering quality assurance procedures.
• Continuously identify, measure, and improve processes.
• Follow and apply SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles.
• Understand. Create. Simplify.
• Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:
• Current student pursuing a degree in computer science or equivalent with at least one year of technical coursework completed
• Programming experience in JavaScript and typescript 
• Ability to execute and document defined testing procedures
• Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills
• Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities
• Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment
• Background check results satisfactory to SEL
• Negative drug test result(s)

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience using scripting languages, such as Python, Golang
• Practical knowledge of developing Microsoft Windows applications
• Knowledge of SQL and database concepts
• Experience using revision control and source code management systems such as Git, Mercurial, SVN, and Rational ClearCase

Physical Requirements
None

Location:
Boise, ID – This position is located in Boise, ID, capital of the gem state, and on the Boise River in the southwestern part of the state. You will enjoy local restaurants in a vibrant downtown full of small businesses, easy access to mountain foothills and 190 miles of trails. jobs.description:
Undergraduate Placement
Data Science & Fraud Analytics

APPLICATION CLOSING DATE
January 2027

START DATE
July 2027

LOCATION
London (Hybrid)

DURATION
13 months

Ready to take on real-world challenges?
Are you looking for a paid industrial placement as part of your degree and want to work on problems that genuinely matter?
At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, you'll join an analytics team that helps some of the world's largest organisations combat fraud, reduce risk and make smarter decisions through advanced analytics, machine learning and digital identity intelligence.
We're looking for curious, ambitious students who enjoy tackling complex problems, working with data and learning new technologies. If you thrive on challenges and want to apply your skills to real customer problems at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

The Placement:
This 13-month placement offers an opportunity to work within our Professional Services and Data Science teams, supporting fraud detection and risk analytics solutions used by global organisations across financial services, e-commerce, and digital platforms.
Rather than working on theoretical projects, you'll gain hands-on experience delivering solutions that have a measurable business impact. You'll work alongside data scientists, fraud analysts, data engineers and consultants to develop insights, optimize products and help customers stay ahead of increasingly sophisticated fraud threats.
You will have access to modern cloud-based technologies and AI-assisted tools, working with large-scale datasets and real-world fraud challenges from day one.

What You'll Be Doing:
• Analyse large-scale fraud and customer behaviour datasets to uncover actionable insights.
• Build and optimise data pipelines using modern analytics platforms such as Snowflake and dbt.
• Develop interactive dashboards and analytical applications using Streamlit.
• Explore and apply machine learning techniques to fraud detection and risk management problems.
• Use Copilot and AI-powered agents to accelerate analysis, automate workflows and improve productivity.
• Support the development of fraud detection strategies for global customers.
• Work with consultants and data scientists to solve complex customer challenges.
• Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Contribute to innovation projects that shape the future of fraud prevention and digital identity.

We're Looking For Students Who:
Love Solving Difficult Problems: You enjoy tackling challenges that don't have obvious answers. You are curious, analytical and willing to experiment, learn and adapt.

Have Strong Analytical Skills: You can interpret data, identify patterns and think critically about business problems.

Are Passionate About Data and Technology: You're excited by the opportunity to work with modern data platforms, cloud technologies and AI tools.

Enjoy Learning New Technologies:
Whether you've used them through university projects, personal projects, hackathons or internships, we'd love to hear about your experience with technologies such as:
• Python
• SQL
• Snowflake
• dbt
• Streamlit
• Machine learning frameworks
• Generative AI tools
• Copilot and AI agents
• Data visualisation platforms

Have an Interest in Fraud, Risk or Cybercrime:
You are interested in understanding how fraud evolves and how analytics, data science and AI can be used to combat increasingly sophisticated threats.

Are Collaborative Team Players:
You enjoy working with others, sharing ideas and contributing to a supportive and inclusive team environment.

Essential Requirements
• Studying a STEM-related degree, including Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
• Returning to university following the placement year.
• Right to work in the UK for the duration of the placement.

What Will Make You Stand Out:
We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate initiative beyond their academic studies through:
• Personal data science or AI projects
• Open-source contributions
• Hackathons or competitions
• Analytics portfolios or GitHub projects
• Experience building applications or dashboards
• Experience using Snowflake, dbt, Streamlit, machine learning or AI tools
• Curious exploration of fraud, cybersecurity or risk-related topics

Show us something you've built, analysed, automated or improved. We value practical evidence of learning and problem solving as much as academic achievement.

Learning & Development:
You'll receive structured support throughout the placement, including:
• An immersive onboarding programme
• Technical training in data science, fraud analytics and consulting
• Mentorship from experienced professionals
• Exposure to customer-facing projects
• Opportunities to collaborate with data scientists, analytics engineers and consultants
• Access to modern AI and analytics technologies used across the business

Our goal is to help you develop both technically and professionally, preparing you for a future career in data science, analytics, fraud prevention or consulting.

Life at LexisNexis Risk Solutions:
Our culture combines innovation, collaboration and continuous learning. We encourage people to challenge ideas, explore new technologies and take ownership of meaningful work.
You'll join a community of graduates, placement students and experienced professionals who are passionate about solving complex problems and delivering real value to customers.

Diversity & Inclusion:
We value different perspectives and are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

If you require additional support at any stage of the application process, please let us know what adjustments would help.

Benefits
• Hybrid working
• 25 days annual leave, plus the option to buy more
• Graduate and placement networking events
• Volunteer and community engagement opportunities
• Wellbeing and mental health support

Application Process
To apply, submit your CV and include any projects, coursework, hackathons, internships, GitHub repositories or extracurricular activities that demonstrate your technical ability, curiosity and problem-solving mindset.

We're looking for people who are excited by challenging problems, motivated to learn and eager to build the next generation of analytics and fraud prevention solutions.

jobs.title: Development Data and Research Intern
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

SCOPE OF WORK:
The Development Data and Research Intern will support IRC Silver Spring’s Development team by organizing program data, creating impact materials and conducting research to support fundraising efforts. The intern will analyze FY27 outcomes, research local benchmarks, coordinate with program teams to verify data and support donor prospecting and funding research. 

RESPONSIBILITIES: 
• Review and organize program data, tracking sheets and reports to identify key annual results and achievements.
• Create data summaries, program one-pagers and materials that show IRC Silver Spring’s impact for proposals.
• Research local data and trends to compare IRC Silver Spring’s results with community needs.
• Work with program teams to collect program data updates, confirm information and ensure data accuracy.
• Maintain organized data files, templates and resources for fundraising and reporting.
• Research potential foundation, corporate and individual donors aligned with IRC Silver Spring programs.
• Identify funding opportunities and update donor research and proposal tracking tools.
• Support proposal development, reporting and other Development team projects as needed.
• Submit intern hours through the volunteer dashboard.
• Other duties as assigned 
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: 
• Gain experience organizing program data and creating clear impact materials for fundraising and reporting.
• Learn how nonprofits use internal and external data to support grant proposals and donor communications.
• Develop skills in donor prospecting, funding research and nonprofit development strategies.
• Build experience collaborating with program teams to collect information and communicate outcomes.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATION:
• Pursuing undergraduate or master’s degree.
• Previous experience demonstrating strong research and analytical skills.
• Prior relevant coursework preferred.
• Strong communicator with clear verbal and written expression.
• Strong organization and administrative skills.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, collaborative environment.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
• Proficient in spoken and written English.
• Ability to work independently and be resourceful. 
TO APPLY  
Click Apply Now at the top of this page. Please attach a resume, cover letter and list of (at least) three references to your application. The deadline for applying is 01/04/2027. 
 
This position is for Spring 2027 and requires a minimum commitment of 12 weeks and 22.5 hours per week. This is not a fully remote position and interns must be able to work in the office at least one day per week. Overall ability to work in person is preferred
Spring 2027 interns are expected to begin their internship term by attending an in-person intern orientation on Jan 25th, 2027, from 9:15AM-3:30PM.

We currently offer internships during the following semesters:

jobs.title: Research & Development Intern
jobs.description:
Job Location
READING TECH CENTER
Job Description
Ready to fuel the success of globally renowned brands like Gillette? Do you want to be part of the innovation and technological advancement of products used every day by millions of the world’s consumers? Want to work for a company consistently recognised as one of the UK’s leading graduate employers?

We are offering summer internship opportunities in July 2027 at our Reading Innovation Centre. This specific role is focused on Master Data and Digital Transformation. 

About our Reading Innovation Centre

This role is available in our Reading Innovation Centre which is home to over 200+ scientists and engineers responsible for innovating consumer products in several business areas including Personal Health Care (Vicks) Oral Care (Oral-B), Grooming (Gillette and Venus) and Beauty Care (Olay).

The site is a specialist Healthcare & Grooming Research & Development Hub in Europe and supports our European Beauty Franchise business. The site is friendly, diverse and has a rich history in innovation in multiple business areas.

Our site is located close to the town centre and is served by motorway networks of M4 and M25 as well as the A33. We’re within 20 mins of Reading Central and Green Park railway stations and are served by buses that run every 10 minutes.

What To Expect:

Research and Development (R&D) at P&G will help you to discover the essence behind crafting some of the world's most renowned brands. Delve into a realm where science takes centre stage. Some of the best scientists in the world go to work making our products just right for the billions of consumers who use them. We're talking cutting edge technology, "hands-on" labs and pilot plants, 41,000+ active patents and a team full of inventors.

During your summer internship, you will get a first-hand experience of what a career in R&D with P&G involves, and if it is right for you. You will be working on live business R&D projects and expected to dive straight in and take the lead. Each intern receives a customized learning plan to ensure they get the right levels of coaching, mentoring, and training as they deliver their work. If you are looking for an exciting and challenging experience, have a passion for winning, strong leadership credentials and an interest in pursuing a career at P&G – this internship is for you!

What You Will Gain:
• Responsibilities and Real Work from Day 1: You will be given specific projects and responsibilities working on real and live business challenges, just like a true P&Ger.
• Continuous training & coaching: You will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager.
• Competitive Compensation & Benefits: The monthly salary for this summer internship is £2,625. On top of this you’ll enjoy lots of benefits like the option to enroll in our pension, flexible working arrangements, and your very own ‘Flex4Me’ Fund which enables you to allocate a portion of your benefits package to the areas that matter most to you.
• Full Time Role: Successful interns have the potential to secure a full-time position with P&G after graduation. As a 'build from within' company, our people start at entry level and progress through the organization. When we make a job offer, it’s with the expectation that you will grow into one of our future leaders, and to help you get there, you will work closely with skilled P&G veterans for mentoring and coaching at every step.

Job Qualifications
What We Look For:
• University students pursuing a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (please note the additional detail below on required knowledge) graduating in 2027 or 2028. We also welcome applications from those who have already graduated who are able to complete a summer internship.
• Evidence of passion and achievements in academic and/or non-academic activities. Tell us what you’re proud of – be it playing a musical instrument or holding down a job alongside your studies. We want to get to know you during your application!
• Demonstrated leadership skills and a strong passion for research and innovation.
• Strong verbal and written English language skills.
• Knowledge of at least one of the following (the candidate is not expected to be knowledgeable in every area): Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL & data modeling, Data wrangling and ETL, Data visualization (Power BI/Tableau), Machine Learning fundamental, API integration, Generative AI & prompt engineering, AI application development, Workflow automation, Web application development (Streamlit/React/Flask), Cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Product thinking and user-centric design, System integration and APIs.

Start date:

The internship's duration is from July 5th, 2027, until September 24th, 2027.

Right to Work:

For our internship roles, you will need to provide your own right to work in the UK for the full duration of your internship without requiring sponsorship from P&G. Note, this will require your right to work permission to be valid between 5th July 2027 to 24th September 2027 for a minimum of 37.5 hours per week.

P&G is legally required to ensure all candidates have the right to work in the UK from Day 1 of their employment. All applicants will therefore be asked to provide evidence of their right to work at the conclusion of the recruitment process as a condition of employment.

Application Deadline: 

1pm (GMT) December 2nd, 2026. You must apply by the deadline. We encourage you to apply and complete our online assessments as soon as possible, as we may close early if positions are filled. 

Application Process: 
• Complete your Application (Deadline 1pm GMT 2nd December 2026) 
• Complete our Online Assessments (Deadline 1pm GMT 9th December 2026) 
• Virtual Interviews (These will run from October until our roles are filled)

At P&G #weseeequal

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. At P&G we strive to build a culture where everyone feels welcome, included, and able to bring their full selves to work.

We champion social mobility and believe socio-economic status should not be a barrier to accessing job opportunities. That’s why in addition to this internship being paid, we offer provision of all the necessary technology and electronic equipment, access to a range of benefits, and financial support if you need to relocate for your internship - such as covering the cost of travel to your internship location.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process. Please click here if you require an accommodation during the application process. Please make sure to wait to hear back from us regarding your accommodation before proceeding with the online assessment, we thank you in advance for your patience.

jobs.title: Compiler Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
Join Us in Shaping the Future
At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.
The Team
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.
Position Overview
We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on an engineering or research project that may involve compiler features, MLIR-based intermediate representations, Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), optimization, code generation, runtime or offload support, debug information, testing infrastructure, performance analysis, or developer tools. Projects may connect hardware capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for a graduate student who can apply deeper technical expertise to an ambiguous engineering or research problem, evaluate alternatives, and deliver a well-supported solution or prototype.
Responsibilities
• Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, or analysis of compiler and runtime technologies.
• Develop and debug software in C or C++ within a large, collaborative codebase.
• Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions.
• Evaluate functional correctness, compile-time behavior, runtime performance, or code quality, as applicable to the project.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and team members.
• Document designs, experiments, results, and lessons learned, and present project outcomes to the team.
• Contribute to open-source projects when aligned with the assigned work.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
• Graduate-level coursework, research, or project experience in compilers, programming languages, computer architecture, parallel computing, systems software, or a closely related area.
• Experience programming in C or C++ and working with complex software systems.
• Experience designing experiments, analyzing technical results, and communicating conclusions.
Preferred Qualifications
• Hands-on experience with LLVM or related compiler infrastructure, including front-end development, intermediate representations, optimization passes, code generation, runtimes, or debug information.
• Research or development experience involving CPU/GPU architectures, heterogeneous computing, AI/ML compilation, HPC, parallel programming, or performance optimization.
• Familiarity with LLVM, MLIR, Clang, Flang, SYCL/DPC++, Triton, OpenMP, CUDA, or another compiler or parallel-programming ecosystem.
• Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi.
• Tile-base programming model knowledge 
• GPU Compute kernel writing experience
• Experience contributing to open-source software or working in a large collaborative codebase.
• Publications, technical reports, patents, open-source contributions, or other evidence of advanced technical work.
Success in This Role
• Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
• Clear written and verbal communication.
• Ability to work independently on scoped tasks while seeking guidance when needed.
• Collaborative mindset and commitment to high-quality engineering.

jobs.title: Software Analytics Co-op
jobs.description:
Start your engineering career by working with real data, real automated systems, and real customer challenges. This 2027 Kettering University Co-op opportunity with Dematic’s Digital Solutions Software team gives you the chance to apply what you’re learning in the classroom while building analytics solutions for some of the world’s most advanced warehouse automation systems.

You’ll work alongside experienced software and analytics professionals to develop dashboards, analyze data, test solutions, and solve technical problems using tools such as SQL, Python, visualization platforms, and cloud technologies. We’re looking for a curious problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies, working with data, and building solutions that make an impact.
We offer:
• Competitive pay and benefits
• Pay Transparency
• Global Opportunities

Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer
Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $19.00-$23.00 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:
What You Will Do in This Role
As an Advanced Analytics Co-op, you’ll work alongside software engineers, data analysts, and other technical team members to solve real-world problems using data. You’ll gain hands-on experience with analytics, dashboards, databases, cloud technologies, and warehouse automation while contributing to projects that are used by real customers.
This is an opportunity to take what you’re learning in the classroom and apply it to large-scale, automated distribution and manufacturing environments.
Key Responsibilities
• Work with engineers, analysts, and business partners to understand problems and turn them into practical analytics solutions.
• Help design, build, test, and improve dashboards, reports, and other data-driven applications.
• Query and analyze data using technologies such as SQL, Google BigQuery, or Microsoft SQL Server.
• Work with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker to turn data into useful insights.
• Learn how data moves through automated warehouse and material handling systems and how it can be used to improve operations.
• Assist with testing and validating analytics solutions to make sure the results are accurate and ready for customer use.
• Participate in requirements discussions, technical design sessions, troubleshooting, and solution reviews.
• Document solutions and communicate your findings to both technical and non-technical team members.
• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary engineering team while also taking ownership of individual assignments.
• Gain exposure to cloud platforms, modern data architectures, and large-scale industrial automation systems.
What We Are Looking For
Education
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree at Kettering University, preferably in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
• Students at different points in their co-op journey are encouraged to apply. We’re looking for curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn, not someone who already knows everything on this list.
Knowledge / Qualifications
You don’t need to check every box. A strong candidate will have some of the following experience through coursework, personal projects, previous co-op rotations, or other hands-on learning:
• Basic experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Experience with or an interest in Python for data analysis, automation, or application development.
• Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is a plus.
• An interest in working with data to identify trends, investigate problems, and develop solutions.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to dig into unfamiliar technical challenges.
• Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical ideas clearly.
• Experience working on team-based programming, engineering, or analytics projects through coursework, extracurricular activities, or previous co-op assignments.
• Exposure to cloud technologies, data engineering, APIs, or modern software development is a plus.
• An interest in automation, robotics, material handling equipment, manufacturing, logistics, or supply chain technology is a plus.
• Most importantly, a desire to learn, experiment, ask questions, and build things that solve real problems.
What You’ll Get From the Experience
• Hands-on experience with real production data and customer-facing engineering solutions.
• Exposure to modern analytics, cloud, and data technologies.
• Experience working with software and data generated by automated warehouse systems.
• Opportunities to develop your skills in SQL, Python, visualization, data analysis, and software engineering.
• Experience working through the complete lifecycle of a solution, from understanding the original problem through development, testing, validation, and delivery.
• Mentorship and collaboration with experienced software, analytics, and automation engineers.
• Meaningful project ownership rather than purely observational or administrative co-op work.

Sponsorship is not available for this role. 
 
At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team. 
 
What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry? 
 
GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind!  Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters. Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following: 

• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients.  
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge.  
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion. 
• Interact with GDIT leaders. 
• Participate in professional development. 
 
How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own 
 
As a Financial Data Analyst Associate Intern you’ll gain hands-on experience working with data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies while contributing to initiatives that have a measurable impact across the finance organization. You will interact with employees and leadership across all levels of the finance organization while building valuable business and technical skills. Working alongside a small, highly collaborative team, you’ll have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to initiatives that improve how finance professionals work, analyst information, and make decisions. 
 
A Day in the Life 
 
• Support finance initiatives focused on analytics, automation, reporting, and process improvement. 
• Assist in building reports, dashboards, visualizations, and other tools that support business decision making. 
• Explore new technologies that can enhance finance processes and improve user experiences. 
• Partner with finance stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate needs into practical solutions. 
• Document processes and assist with testing, deployment, and user adoption of new tools and technologies. 
• Collaborate with team members on projects that help transform and modernize the finance organization. 
• Perform additional duties as assigned. 
 
The Must-Haves 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree program in, Finance, Accounting, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field from a United States-based college or university. 
• Interest in the intersection of finance, data, analytics, automation, and technology. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel preferred 
 
What You’ll Need to Deliver Your Best Every Day
 
• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Natural curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new tools, applications, and technologies.
• Stakeholder-focused mindset with a focus on understanding user needs and delivering effective solutions.
• Exposure to or proficiency in coding and scripting languages (such as Python, SQL, VBA, or similar).
• Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or similar analytics and automation tools.
 
What you Offer as a Stand-Out Candidate 
 
• Knowledge of accounting principles, interpreting financial statements, and exposure to quantitative financial analysis.
• Familiarity with fundamental data structures, data relationships, and data quality concepts is a plus, but not required
 
GDIT interns are paid and full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks. Applicants should have a minimum of one semester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. Take the first step and apply today! 
 
Note: We receive a high volume of applications and review them on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks of your application. 

The likely hourly rate for this position is between $27.43 - $37.11. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

jobs.description:
At the NSLSI-II, the DSSI (Data Science and Systems Integration) Division is responsible for the computing infrastructure, data collection and analysis tools, various beamline controls systems, and much more. DSSI works together with staff across the facility to help enable accelerator operations, beamline experiments, and user data analysis. DSSI is an exciting place to work and use technology to contribute to the amazing scientific discovery taking place throughout the facility.
 
Position Description
The Data Engineering Group within the NSLS-II’s Data Science and Systems Integration Division is seeking a student assistant to join the team as a software engineer. A successful candidate for this position is an engaged and motivated student who is excited to collaborate with a broad range of scientists and engineers. Potential projects and tasks include work on central data infrastructure, such as the open-source data access service Tiled, as well as beamline-specific data systems. We seek those who are interested in managing large, complex collections of data, especially to support scientific discovery.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain software which makes up part of the facility’s data infrastructure
• Perform limited operations support for software or infrastructure under development
• Collaborate with other engineers and scientists to gather and address requirements
• Configure infrastructure (such as databases, containers, system monitors) and deploy changes using IaC (infrastructure as code)

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Currently enrolled in an academic program leading to a bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, information technology, or a related field
• A demonstrated passion for collaborative software development
• Experience developing software in Python, especially web servers or storage utilities
• Experience working in a Linux environment, including command line and basic system management
• Knowledge of file systems, databases, SQL, and authentication & authorization concepts is a plus

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Senior standing or equivalent placement in an academic program in one of the prescribed fields
• Existing contributions to open-source software projects or other scientific software
• Experience working with FastAPI and related libraries.
• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills. Ability to work well in a team environment, with people who have a range of interests and abilities.

Other Information:
• This position is primarily on-site, with limited hybrid allowed for some situations (such as remote meetings)

Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program

Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews. 

As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. jobs.title: Data Science & Machine Learning Intern - Agentic AI Discovery & Prototyping
jobs.description:
2027 Spring Intern - Data Science & Machine Learning

Department Summary
At Genentech, we are leveraging cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence to transform medical information delivery, commercial and clinical workflows, and patient impact. We are seeking a highly motivated Spring Intern – Agentic AI Discovery & Prototyping to join our Data Science & Machine Learning team.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of Generative AI, software prototyping, and system evaluation. You will research, rapidly prototype, and benchmark next-generation Agentic AI systems, ranging from specialized question-answering agents to multi-agent evaluation frameworks used across Generative AI initiatives. Because our work ultimately serves patients and healthcare professionals, a core pillar of your efforts will involve ensuring our agentic systems are safe, reliable, compliant, and aligned with rigorous healthcare standards.

This position is based in South San Francisco, CA, On-Site.

The Opportunity
• Build, test, and refine functional prototypes for AI agent workflows tailored for interactive question-answering, search, and workflow automation.
• Design and implement a general-purpose evaluation framework to benchmark LLM outputs, agent reliability, tool calling, and reasoning accuracy across projects.
• Explore and implement guardrails to ensure AI agent outputs are safe, hallucination-resistant, compliant with regulatory standards, and aligned with strict patient safety and privacy guidelines.
• Develop clean, maintainable Python code to integrate LLMs with internal APIs, search tools, and structured data sources.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, data scientists, and domain stakeholders to gather requirements, iterate on feedback, and showcase prototype capabilities.
• Share your project findings, system architectures, and evaluation metrics to the broader team at the end of your internship.

Program Highlights
• Intensive 12-weeks, full-time (40 hours per week) paid internship with possibility to extend to 6 months or a year.
• Program start dates are in January (Spring). 
• A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship. 
• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects.
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are (Requirements) 
Required Education: 
• Must be pursuing a Master's Degree (enrolled student).
• Must be pursuing a PhD (enrolled student).

Required majors: Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative field.

Required Skills
• Currently enrolled in a graduate degree program (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative field).
• Foundational proficiency in Python and standard software development best practices (version control/Git, writing modular code).
• Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and core Generative AI patterns (e.g., prompt engineering, agentic workflows, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
• Awareness of AI safety principles, output reliability, and the importance of compliance in high-stakes environments like biotechnology and healthcare.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
• Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
• Academic projects or coursework involving LLM API integration or open-source AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or building with commercial/open-source APIs).
• Experience or strong interest in system evaluation, benchmarking, or testing (e.g., setting up test cases, evaluating model accuracy/consistency, or unit testing agent steps).
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an eagerness to experiment in a fast-paced environment.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. 

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $52/hour. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits. 

Genentech is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact us by completing this form Accommodations for Applicants.

jobs.description:
Who we are
With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe: Spring (Jan-May 2027)
 
At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment. 
 
Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements. 
 
Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! 

What you’ll do  
• Architect and scale our software platform to support current and future autonomous capabilities.  
• Collaborate with ML R&D teams to ensure new models meet deployment requirements.  
• Optimize the robotic hardware fleet deployment pipeline, streamlining processes from merge requests through testing to roll-out for systems using ONNX/TensorRT and custom hardware.  
• Maintain and improve edge computing infrastructure to meet real-time performance and reliability needs.  
• Create pipelines to train robotic machine learning systems including dataset curation, labeling, training, and evaluation metrics.  
• Double speed and efficiency of robotic system evaluation using simulation of hardware and mechanics  
• Reduce mechanical hardware maintenance during robotic scale-up using data-driven diagnostics and alert systems.  
• Engineer state-of-the-art robotic software to increase performance of machine learning.   
• Design efficient compilation architectures to decouple hardware program inter-dependencies.  
• Structure docker compose configuration to balance robotic hardware sharing.  

What you’ll need  
• Bachelor’s degree or above in computer science, software engineering, robotics engineering or related field  
• Demonstrated experience with cloud-based infrastructure and services, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Microsoft Azure 
• Experience working with complex data systems, including data storage, telemetry data, and camera or sensor data 
• Strong software engineering skills with expertise in at least one programming language and its ecosystem. You should be comfortable delivering high-quality, working code quickly and consistently.  
• Proficiency in Python or C++.  

Our Environment 
• Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. 
• The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

jobs.description:
Sony Corporate Technology Center America, a branch of Sony AI, is a remotely distributed organization spread across the U.S. and Canada. Sony AI is Sony’s new research organization pursuing the mission to use AI to unleash human creativity. Sony AI works closely with Sony’s other business units, including Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC., Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc., and Sony Music Entertainment. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: https://ai.sony/
Research Intern – Self-evolving Multimodal Foundation Models
Sony is seeking research interns to join us. Our team mainly focuses on fundamental and applied research, with a focus on building next-generation foundation models for vision in a responsible manner. The role of a research intern is to develop efficient and effective methodologies and prototype solutions. You will work with a productive team of world-class scientists and engineers to tackle the most challenging problems in foundation models, including self-evolving vision foundation models (VFM), vision-language models (VLM), unified models, content management, automatic model optimization and deployement on cloud and edge. You will see your ideas not only published in papers, but also improve the experience of billions of customers.

Roles and Responsibilities
• Conduct fundamental and innovative development in low-cost yet powerful foundation models, automatic model optimization and deployement on cloud and edge.
• Collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams to translate research into practical solutions, leveraging foundation models, RSI and agentic approaches where appropriate.
• Contribute to library and tool development to support business; or Publish influential research in top-tier conferences and journals.

Required Qualifications and Skills
• Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a master/PhD degree in computer science or related field.
• Be very self-motivated and capable of proposing and implementing innovative ideas.
• Solid presentation and communication skills to internal and external audiences.
• Publications or expertise in compact foundation model development and deployment. Influential open-source projects or paper publication at top conferences, e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, etc.
• Better to have front-end development experience.
• Solid coding skills in Python, Pytorch, etc.

jobs.title: Automation Product Manager Intern - Product Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...
About Walmart Supply Chain Automation

Sam Walton founded our company with the belief that the customer is #1. Today, Walmart’s Supply Chain team is at the forefront of retail transformation, working together to delight our customers and save them both time and money.

Walmart’s Supply Chain Automation team develops and deploys innovative technology to transform how products move through one of the largest supply chains in the world. We focus on automating facilities, improving associate experiences, increasing operational capacity, and delivering better quality and service to our customers.

The Supply Chain Automation organization supports automation across Ambient, Grocery, Fulfillment, and Transportation. As an Automation Product Manager Intern, you will have an opportunity to experience how product management, engineering, operations, data, and automation come together to solve complex supply chain challenges at Walmart scale.

Fulfillment Automation Software

The Fulfillment Automation team works with robotics and advanced automation technologies to transform how customer orders are processed and fulfilled across Walmart’s next-generation fulfillment centers.

Our Automation Software Product team focuses on third-party automation software and its integration with Walmart’s in-house Warehouse Management and Control Systems. We partner with Operations, Engineering, Technology, and automation vendors to create reliable, scalable, and high-performing solutions that connect software with the physical movement of products through our fulfillment centers.

As an Automation Product Manager Intern supporting Fulfillment Automation Software, you will gain hands-on exposure to product management at the intersection of supply chain, software, robotics, data, and emerging technology.

What You’ll Do
• Learn and practice product management by gathering feedback from Operations, Engineering, and other partners and helping translate business needs into product requirements, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
• Support product discovery, roadmap planning, and backlog prioritization for automation software capabilities and integrations between third-party automation platforms and Walmart systems.
• Use data to solve real operational problems by analyzing automation performance, identifying trends and opportunities, and helping develop dashboards and recommendations to improve system stability, throughput, and efficiency.
• Participate in testing, pilots, and product launches, gaining exposure to how new software features, defect fixes, and system integrations move from an idea through validation and deployment in a live fulfillment environment.
• Explore emerging technologies and help evaluate opportunities to apply Data, AI, Predictive Analytics, and Digital Twin capabilities to automation and fulfillment operations.
• Collaborate across a broad technology ecosystem, gaining exposure to Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), Material Handling Equipment (MHE), robotics, and third-party automation platforms.

If you are curious about how technology moves millions of products through a complex supply chain and want to help develop products that connect software, robotics, data, and real-world operations, this internship provides an opportunity to learn while contributing to the future of automated fulfillment at Walmart.

About Our Intern Program: 
Each summer, we select the best and brightest to look under the hood of the world’s largest retailer at our Walmart Home Offices across multiple locations. During the 11-week program, our interns work directly with teams who are changing the way the world shops. This is the beginning of what could be an exciting career with Walmart! 

The intern experience includes: 
• An impactful individual project designed to align to your skillsets and interests 
• Direct access to leadership across the enterprise 
• Executive-led speaker sessions with insightful Q&A 
• Community outreach events 
• Networking and social events 
• Learning & development opportunities targeting both hard and soft skills 
• Deep dives into different areas of our business 
• Time management and leadership development as a full-time associate 
• An in-depth look at our Belonging practices 
• Compensation and housing assistance provided 

Desired Majors
Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, Operations Management, Product Design, and other relevant majors.

Office Environment: This role is in a Field (Distribution/Fulfillment Center) setting

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation. 

The Analytics Team 
At Arity, our Business Intelligence team is at the core of helping us transform mobility. We not only know how to analyze and find meaning within billions of miles of driving data collected from smartphones, onboard devices and third parties; we are passionate about how it affects the end-users of our products. On our team people get the opportunity to build scalable distributed data pipelines, extract meaningful insights, and create eye-opening data visualizations. We find top talent from various quantitative disciplines to collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and experienced designers in development teams to create innovative products to make transportation smarter, safer, and more useful for everyone. 

Where good people build rewarding careers. 

This is a Summer 2027 internship for students currently enrolled in a degree program. This role is responsible for the use and development of the data that powers analytics projects for internal and external audiences. This person partners with others on work with data analysts and analytic engineers on tactical solutions. This role will participate in new ETL work tracks for Business Intelligence from inception and prototyping to fully developed solutions. This is a highly dynamic position that requires a greater degree of flexibility, analytic agility, and the ability to rapidly adapt to changing business requirements/needs, new technologies, and data sources. This role also requires business acumen in order to output the best technical solutions. 

Job Description 
• Utilize a multidisciplinary approach to Data Analytic problems combining technical expertise with analytics and business knowledge 
• Work with other Data Analytic Engineers, Data Analysts, and business partners on embedded cross-functional teams; developing subject matter expertise in the business as well as data analytics 
• Execute requirements to develop datasets for use by Data Analysts and business users 
• Execute rapid development of new data work tracks with fast iteration over quick sprints 
• Leverage and enhance the data infrastructure required to support Analytic needs, including AirFlow, GCP Composer and BigQuery. 
• Build test scripts, execute testing, work with data engineers, analysts and business partners to ensure end user acceptance 
• Contribute to an environment that supports innovation and process improvement 
• Contribute to the development of corporate research data files, information platforms or data spaces designed for exploring and understanding the data 
• Demonstrate analytic agility to meet fluid and dynamic business needs in this space

• Target start date: May/June 2027 
• Currently pursuing and will be completing a bachelor’s degree in a field such as Computer Science, Data Analytics or equivalent skills 
• Basic familiarity with Python and/or Google Cloud Platform/Amazon Web Services and SQL 
• Familiarity with the software development lifecycle and source control (Github) 
• Basic familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau or Looker 
• Computer Proficiency in Linux and bash 
• Experience in time and task management 
• Ability to learn new technologies 
• Strong attention to detail 
• Intermediate written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively collaborate with multi-disciplinary groups and all organizational levels 
 
Preferred: 
• Development knowledge and experience in Spark or other distributed processing frameworks 
• Familiarity with statistical concepts and related technology (scikit-learn, pandas, tensorflow) or geospatial analysis a plus

• Contribute to AI and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and automation

jobs.title: AI/ML Intern
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking a talented AI/ML Intern for Summer 2027. In the Leidos Autonomy and Artificial Intelligence branch, you will work to solve complex engineering problems with a highly technical, multidisciplinary team consisting of aerospace engineers, computer scientists, research scientists, and statisticians. This group provides cutting-edge solutions to aerospace and defense problems such as autonomous battle management, robotic vehicle guidance, and model-based system identification. 

Primary Responsibilities:
The AI/ML Intern will work to develop solutions to aerospace and defense problems by applying a variety of engineering, AI/ML, and software technical skills. In general, the Intern will be presented with one or more, open-ended, research problems that are related to on-going projects. This allows the Intern to directly contribute to active development and make a significant impact on the greater project success. 

The Intern will utilize and develop technical skills throughout the summer as they work through their specific problems. This may include topics such as dynamical modeling and simulation, machine learning (e.g., supervised learning, reinforcement learning), statistic-based analysis, and data visualization. The aforementioned skills and solutions are expected to be implemented in software via programming languages such as Python.

To succeed in this role, the Intern will be required to leverage internal resources (e.g., software toolkits), collaborate with peers and experienced professionals, and learn independently. The Intern will also work closely with an experience mentor throughout the summer. By the end of the internship, the Intern will have the opportunity to showcase gained experience and work in company-wide events and a formal presentation.

• Working towards a bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
• Advanced proficiency in programming, specifically including Python and MATLAB.
• Fundamental understanding of mathematical concepts, including linear algebra, matrix math, statistics, trigonometry, and coordinate frames.
• Fundamental understanding of core aerospace concepts, such as vehicle and attitude dynamics, control systems, and flight mechanics.
• Understanding of machine learning basics, supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and statistics.
• Effective technical communication skills.
• Ability to perform independent research to learn new skills.
• Ability to work both in collaborative team environments and independently on open-ended research problems.
• Ability to relocate to work on-site at the Huntsville, AL office.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with CI Poly Security Clearance.

jobs.title: Laboratory Automation Engineer Co-op
jobs.description:
Job Title: 2027 Spring Co-op Laboratory Automation Engineer Process Chemistry Lab
• Grade: Co-op
• Location: Cambridge, MA
• Duration: 6 months (January-June)

About the Job
Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. As Spring Co-op in our Laboratory Automation Engineer team.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to join our laboratory automation team. As a co-op in lab automation engineering, you will play a key role in advancing our automated laboratory systems within Sanofi's R&D CMC Synthetic organization. This position is located in Cambridge MA and will collaborate closely with colleagues to implement and optimize automated laboratory workflows.

We believe that lab automation is crucial for the future of process development in Pharma. By joining our team, you will be at the forefront of this transformation, using your technical skills to enhance laboratory efficiency and data quality.
This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge laboratory automation in a scientific department developing the next generation of Sanofi medicines that will improve the quality of life for patients across the world.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to Early Careers learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and maintain automated laboratory workflows using robotics platforms and integrated instruments. Configure and optimize automated systems to meet experimental requirements.
• Write, test, and debug scripts for laboratory automation systems using languages such as Python, LabVIEW, or other automation software. Develop interfaces between laboratory instruments and data management systems.
• Connect and integrate various analytical instruments with laboratory automation platforms. Ensure seamless data transfer between automated systems and Sanofi's data management infrastructure.
• Analyze existing manual laboratory processes and identify opportunities for automation. Collaborate with scientists to translate manual procedures into automated protocols.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
We are looking for an Electrical Engineer Intern who is interested in gaining hands-on experience in electrical hardware development. You will work alongside and receive mentorship from experienced electrical engineers while contributing to the development and testing of electrical hardware used in industrial products. 

You will report to the Engineering Manager in either Mequon, WI or Eden Prairie, MN. This role does not provide relocation assistance.

Your Responsibilities:
• Assist with the design and validation of alternate electronic components to achieve cost reduction or address component obsolescence.
• Design PCB schematic and support PCB layout.
• Support hardware testing and validation in accordance with established test plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure products meet quality and performance standards.
• Assist with failure analysis and documentation, contributing to root cause investigations and corrective action processes.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
• Pursuing a Bachelor's degree at an accredited college or university.
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

• Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 on a 4.0 scale
