jobs.title: Real Estate Strategy & Reporting Intern
jobs.description:
This position is fully in office and based in Charlotte, NC.

Job Summary
The Real Estate Strategy & Reporting Intern will report to the Manager of Real Estate Strategy & Reporting. This role is designed for a highly motivated, analytical self-starter who is excited to learn how data, analytics, and strategy shape real estate investment decisions at a global scale.

This position will contribute to meaningful, hands-on project work that supports portfolio strategy, site selection analytics, and executive reporting. This role offers exposure to cross-functional partners across Real Estate, Finance, Construction, Property Management and Operations, and provides the opportunity to turn complex datasets into insights that inform real business decisions.

This position is an in-office role based in the Charlotte office.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
• Support real estate strategy and analytics projects through research, data development, and financial or pro forma modeling.
• Build, validate, and maintain store-level datasets used for analytics and reporting, including location attributes (latitude/longitude,) square footage, opening dates, and other key site characteristics.
• Contribute to ad-hoc analyses by leveraging store performance data, financial metrics, and market-level insights to support strategic decision-making.
• Assist in documenting processes, methodologies, and best practices related to real estate analytics and reporting.
• Support team members with coordination of communications, organization of analytical outputs, and maintenance of shared data and tools.
• Collaborate cross-functionally and participate in meetings to gain exposure to how analytics informs broader business strategy.
• Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.
Requirements
• Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and work with large datasets.
• Working knowledge of data analysis concepts and comfort learning new tools or methodologies.
• Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and data organization techniques.
• Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint with the ability to communicate insights clearly and concisely.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a desire to learn how to “tell the story” behind the data.
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
• Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
• Availability to work 16–20 hours per week during the academic semester and up to 40 hours per week during school breaks.
• Must be able to work in the Charlotte office; this position is not remote.

Preferred Qualifications
• Major or coursework in business, analytics, geography, finance, real estate, economics, or a related field.
• Experience working with SharePoint or other document management tools.
• Exposure to Power BI, Alteryx, GIS systems, or location-based analytics tools (e.g., Google Earth.)
• Curiosity, initiative, and a desire to learn how analytics supports real estate and corporate strategy.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.  

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. 

Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense. 

As a Mission Analyst Intern, you will be part of a team of systems engineers dedicated to delivering best-in-class Raytheon products for the warfighter through modeling, simulation, and analysis. Your work will help demonstrate mission effectiveness of systems and system-of-systems operating in complex threat environments. On this team, you will be responsible for developing and analyzing solutions across mission technologies, including sensors, effectors, communications, command and control, and more.
Responsibilities will include:
· Participating in the development and implementation of model-based solutions to support mission trade studies using mission and engagement level simulations.
· Participating in the development and integration of variable-fidelity computer models and simulations that effectively capture system and system of systems effects in complex threat environments.
· Modeling of system and mission kill chains using Government, Commercial, and/or Raytheon simulation tools.
· Executing mission system simulations and analyzing their results.
· Development of metrics and results products that communicate the chain of events that led to an action.
· You will contribute and collaborate in a team environment, receiving input from the program or team experts, and work on projects, as you determine, develop, and implement analytic approaches that will generate the supporting data to inform programmatic decisions.
 Qualifications You Must Have:
· Must be pursuing Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.
· Must have a minimum of 30 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session.
· Experience working with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, MATLAB, or other common languages.
Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.
Qualifications We Prefer:
· Prior internship, co-op, or work experience.
· Experience working in Linux environments.
· Experience with standard government modeling tools including AFSIM, Suppressor, Brawler, or similar tools.
· Experience in Sensors (RADARS, EOIR, etc.), Network Communications, Weapons/Effects (Missiles, Projectiles), Command & Control, and/or Resource Management
· Ability to understand tactics as described by military experts and to represent their employment (verbally, graphically, and in simulations).
· Experience with Military Operations Analysis, Modeling & Simulation experience in the defense industry, and/or data analysis & visualization.
· Familiar with performing data analysis and statistics with large volumes of data.
· Familiar with Numerical Optimization Techniques, Analysis of Alternatives, or Design of Experiments.
· Active Secret Clearance

· Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
· Relocation Eligibility
Learn More & Apply Now!

jobs.description:
ABOUT WIND RIVER

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Within the Wind River Cloud team, we work with large-scale projects including
Kubernetes, Docker, OpenStack and fast-paced Open-Source technologies that are in high demand from our customers. Wind River Cloud has adopted these technologies into the core of our product, which is driving us to find experienced and high-performing individuals that can learn and contribute to these full software stack solutions to fulfill the strict requirements of edge computing use cases from security to high availability. The team delivers in the areas of configuration management, fault management and host management. In addition, Wind River Cloud team is a leading contributor to the Open-Source StarlingX cloud native project, to manage and maintain the critical infrastructure for highly distributed Edge solutions.

YOUR ROLE

As an Associate Cloud Engineer, you will join Wind River's Cloud Platform Engineering team and contribute to the development of cloud-native infrastructure solutions that power next-generation edge computing and 5G deployments.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

You will work alongside experienced engineers to develop, test, and improve software components used in highly distributed cloud environments. This role provides an excellent opportunity to build expertise in cloud technologies, automation, distributed systems, and open-source platforms while working on products used by some of the world's leading telecommunications and technology companies.

In your daily work, you will:

• Design, develop, and maintain software modules using C, C++, and Python.

• Participate in the development and testing of cloud platform components for edge and distributed computing environments.

• Support the integration, validation, and automation of cloud infrastructure solutions.

• Contribute to software quality through test automation, debugging, and root cause analysis.

• Collaborate with global engineering teams in an agile development environment.

• Participate in code reviews and continuously improve development practices.

• Document technical solutions, designs, and implementation details.

• Contribute to open-source projects, including technologies associated with StarlingX and cloud-native infrastructure.

• Learn and apply best practices related to scalability, reliability, and cloud software development.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong programming skills in C and C++.

• Experience with Python scripting.

• Solid understanding of object-oriented programming concepts.

• Knowledge of software development methodologies and debugging techniques.

• Understanding of Linux-based development environments.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

• Passion for learning new technologies and solving technical challenges.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas is considered an asset:

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• OpenStack

• StarlingX

• Cloud-native technologies

• Distributed systems

• Test automation frameworks

• CI/CD methodologies

• Edge computing platforms

• Telecommunications or 5G technologies

• Open-source software development

WHAT SETS YOU APART

• Curiosity about cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• Strong learning agility and willingness to explore new technologies.

• Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.

• Interest in automation and modern cloud platforms.

• Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.

• Passion for building scalable, reliable, and high-quality software.

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES
• Work alongside experienced cloud and platform engineers.

• Gain hands-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenStack, container technologies, and large-scale distributed systems.

• Contribute to industry-leading edge computing and 5G cloud solutions.

• Grow into increasingly complex technical responsibilities and ownership areas.

• Develop expertise in open-source cloud infrastructure technologies.

BENEFITS - CANADA
• Workplace Flexibility: Hybrid Work.

• Company-sponsored health, dental, and life insurance.

• Income protection through short and long-term disability coverage.

• Matching RRSP.

• Vacation and various time-off policies to encourage work-life balance.

• Well-being programs including Employee Assistance Program and mental wellness resources.

• Learning and development opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning and technical training programs.

COMPENSATION

Compensation will be determined through interviews and a review of the candidate's education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and internal equity considerations. Annual incentive plan eligibility may apply based on company policy and position level.

Your privacy is of the utmost importance to us. At Wind River, we strictly adhere to all applicable data privacy laws. Please review Wind River's Applicant Privacy Notice on the Wind River careers website.

As a software sustainment engineer, you play a pivotal role in an application’s functional life. From troubleshooting to fixing bugs, you’ll use your operations and maintenance skills to ensure that things run smoothly. We’re looking for a software sustainment engineer like you to apply your knowledge to our clients’ challenges and their legacy enterprise systems. 

As a software sustainment engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll have an operational impact from day one. Supporting a team of professionals, you’ll help maintain applications and keep systems working. You’ll use programming and scripting languages as you continuously enhance and maintain the applications, troubleshoot any issues that arise operationally, and upgrade the systems to meet security requirements.

Join us. The world can't wait.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone. Want to learn more? Visit our YouTube Channel or the link below.

Life at Intel

In this role you will be part for the Server SoC Design Validation team, working on next-generation Xeon server product SOCs and IPs.

Who You Are:
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Performs functional logic verification and emulation validation of an integrated SoC to ensure design will meet specifications.
• Defines and develops scalable and reusable block, subsystem, and SoC verification plans, test benches, and the verification environment to meet the required level of coverage and confirm to microarchitecture specifications.
• Executes verification plans and defines and runs emulation and system simulation models to verify the design, analyze power and performance, and uncover bugs.
• Replicates, root causes, and debugs issues in the pre-silicon environment. 
• Finds and implements corrective measures to resolve failing tests.
• Collaborates and communicates with SoC architects, micro-architects, full chip architects, RTL developers, post-silicon, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural and microarchitectural features.
• Documents test plans and drives technical reviews of plans and proofs with design and architecture teams.
• Incorporates and executes security activities within test plans, including regression and debug tests, to ensure security coverage.
• Maintains and improves existing functional verification infrastructure and methodology.
• Absorbs learning from post-silicon on the quality of validation done during pre-silicon development, updates test plan for missing coverages and proliferates to future products.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

• Self-reliance in taking an issue to closure with internal and external partners. 
• Takes ownership of assigned tasks.
• Keen problem solver, strong communicator, quick learner, effective team player and open to learning and teaching new and more efficient validation execution techniques to meet time-to-market.

Qualifications:
This is an entry-level position and will be compensated accordingly. You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. 

Minimum Qualifications:
 Master's degree in electrical or computer science, Engineering or related field.

Related coursework/technical experience in/with: 
• 10+ months experience with Silicon Design and/or Validation/Verification.
• 10+ months experience with x86 Architecture.
• 10+ months experience with Design and validation experience with global domains (Reset, Clock, Fuse, GPIO, MPP)

Preferred Qualifications:
Knowledge and Experience with:
• Design and/or Design Verification with developing, maintaining, and executing complex IPs and/or SOCs.
• Strong debug skills. 
• Robust understanding of fundamental principles of cache coherency in multi-processor SOCs, and experience with layered protocols - transaction layer, data link layer, and PHY layer.
• UVM/SV constrained-random coverage-based design verification and Formal Verification methodology.
• Complete verification life cycle (verification architecture, test plan, execution, debug, coverage closure).
• Developing validation test suites and driving continuous improvement into existing validation test suites and methodologies.
• Xeon CPU Pre-Silicon, Emulation Validation or Post Silicon Validation.
• One or more scripting languages to facilitate automation.

Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research, and relevant previous job and/or internship experience.

Benefits at Intel
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you're looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Go to Intel Benefits | Intel Careers for details of benefits available to you. Intel reserves the right to modify, change or discontinue benefit plans at any time in its sole discretion.

jobs.description:
Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award-winning, data-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud.

We’re transforming the software industry.  We’re Flexera.  With more than 50,000 customers across the world, we’re achieving that goal. But we know we can’t do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans?  Come and see why we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at flexera.com

We are building a new model for software engineering: a small, autonomous team that combines strong engineering fundamentals with AI coding agents to deliver valuable software quickly, safely, and reliably.

We are looking for motivated Software Engineers who want to develop their engineering skills while working in an AI-first environment. You will work closely with a Principal Engineer and another software engineer to design, build, test, deploy, and improve real software used by our business and customers.

AI coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex will be integral to your daily workflow. Rather than writing every line of code manually, you will learn to direct AI agents, provide the right context, break down problems, evaluate generated solutions, and verify that the resulting software actually works.

We are hiring engineers who can use AI to solve problems, not simply people who can generate code with AI.

This role offers the opportunity to build production software, develop strong technical judgment, take ownership of meaningful features, and grow faster through hands-on experience and mentorship.

What You'll Do:
Build and Deliver Software
• Implement product features, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and engineering improvements using our technology stack
• Turn requirements and technical designs into small, well-defined implementation tasks

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations.

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

AutoStore – moving things forward.

The Role:

AutoStore is hiring an Entry-Level Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career. You will help design, build, and test the software that powers our automated storage and fulfillment systems, working alongside experienced engineers on real production code.

We are looking for a recent graduate with a strong academic record and, ideally, some internship experience. You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is a genuine passion for software, curiosity about how things work, and an eagerness to learn quickly.

You will receive structured mentoring and hands-on training, including in C++ and Python, the core languages our team works with.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Software Development
• Design, write, and maintain clean, well-structured code in C++ and Python under the guidance of senior engineers.
• Implement new features and fix bugs across our software products.
• Apply object-oriented design principles and follow the team's coding standards.
Testing and Quality
• Write unit and integration tests for the code you develop.
• Debug and troubleshoot issues, and learn to find root causes.
• Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback and reviewing teammates' code as you grow.
Collaboration and Delivery
• Work in an agile team, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
• Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews.
• Work with QA, DevOps, and product teammates to deliver working software.
Learning and Growth
• Develop your C++ and Python skills on the job through training, mentoring, and real project work.
• Write and update technical documentation as you learn our systems.
• Ask questions early and often, and share what you learn with the team.

Key Qualifications:
• Working knowledge of C++ and Python, or of another object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, C#).
• If your experience is in a language other than C++ and Python, a commitment to learning both on the job.
• Basic familiarity with Git and version control.
• A genuine passion for technology and a strong eagerness to learn.
• Good problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly in a team.
• Cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale, or equivalent.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, completed recently or within the next six months.

Nice to Have:
• Internship, co-op, or placement experience in software engineering.
• Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
• Exposure to unit testing frameworks (e.g., GoogleTest, pytest).
• Basic experience with Linux, the command line, or debugging tools.
• Exposure to embedded systems, robotics, or real-time software.
• Experience with networking and communication protocols, including TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, and WebSockets.
• Personal projects, open-source contributions, or hackathon experience.

We Offer:
AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere.
• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
• Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution
• Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents
• Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution
• Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders
• Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more!

jobs.title: Analyst – Performance Reporting
jobs.description:
What’s Under the Hood

DriveTime Family of Brands includes in-house financing and servicing through Bridgecrest, which is one of the country’s leading financial servicing providers. Bridgecrest services roughly $25+ billion in finance receivables for DriveTime and other third parties. We service auto loans across a wide credit spectrum with the intent of creating a strong path to vehicle ownership for our customers.

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

In short, as the Analyst, Performance Reporting you will be responsible for leverage analysis of large datasets and strategic business acumen to improve processes and identify efficiencies across a dynamic business.
 
In long, the Analyst, Performance Reporting is responsible for:
• Supporting a holistic view across all business partners making recommendations on strategic business changes.
• Collaborating with teams across the business to develop reporting and analytical tools, supporting the monitoring of key performance metrics
• Integrating data from across the organization and wider market to generate relevant, actionable insights and make recommendations to senior executives across DriveTime’s business segments.
• Constructing in-depth quantitative analysis by processing, manipulating, and studying large datasets by leveraging strong SQL, Python, R, and Excel skills.
• Leading large analytically based initiatives to reveal step-change improvements in profitability of business.
• Demonstrating strong conceptual skills supported by rigorous quantitative analysis to recommend strategic initiatives to senior management. Leveraging emerging technologies and critical thinking skills to continually innovate and automate existing methodologies, processes, and reporting.
• Ability to demonstrate a strong understanding of business operations, finances and market economics.
• Effectively communicating with concise insights and/or visualizations utilizing software such as Tableau or Power BI while partnering collaboratively with colleagues and senior leaders in DriveTime.
• Being self-driven and able to take initiative to further the success of the business.
 
So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking for?
Agile in a fast-paced environment. We move, and we move quickly. Thriving in an environment that never stops, is a must.
Plays well with others. Part of your job will be working in conjunction with various corporate groups to achieve corporate and ground goals.
Operate autonomously. This isn’t a “hold your hand” kind of role. We give you autonomy to be creative in your space and do your thing. We need an individual that is self-motivated to get the work done and get the work done well.
Passionate and goal-oriented. We are looking for someone that is enthusiastic about their work and is passionate about not only meeting their goals but exceeding them.
Fantastic problem solver. Your job is not only to find the problem, but more importantly, find the solution.
 
The Specifics.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, statistics, engineering, or hard science.
• 0-1 year of relevant experience.
• Exceptional problem-solving skills, collaborative teamwork, intellectual horsepower, curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.
• Demonstrated skill and extensive experience developing quantitative analysis in Excel.
• Experience in the following coding languages such as SQL, R, Java, or Python.
• Ability to simplify complexity and communicate statistical and analytical concepts and findings to executive, operational, and technical audiences with appropriate levels of detail and emphasis.
 
The nice to haves.
• Advanced degree in a quantitative or STEM field.

So What About the Perks? Perks matter
• We take a hybrid work approach, finding balance between the benefits of in-person and work-from-home environments. This position has an on-site expectation of a minimum of three days a week.
• Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage. 
• But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
• Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
• Tuition Reimbursement. We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
• Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
• Gratitude is Green. We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
• In-House Gym. We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day or finish strong with a workout!
• Give Us a Reason (or not), and We’ll Celebrate. Regardless of whether there is a holiday or not, we are finding ways to kick back and enjoy each other’s company outside of day-to-day work.
• Smart-Casual Dress. Come dressed in jeans (you’ll fit right in with the rest of us).
• Paid Time Off. Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

Your contributions will directly enhance product readiness and help deliver transformative technologies to market.

jobs.title: Master Data Management Analyst
jobs.description:
Crescent is a differentiated U.S. energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with a deep, high-quality development inventory. Crescent is a top three producer in the Eagle Ford basin and a scaled operator in each of the Permian and Uinta basins. Crescent’s leadership is an experienced team of investment, financial and industry professionals that combines proven investment and operating expertise. For more than a decade, Crescent and our predecessors have executed on a consistent strategy focused on cash flow, risk management and returns. Through disciplined and accretive investments, we have successfully tripled the size of our company since going public in December 2021 while maintaining a strong balance sheet.

Crescent Energy is seeking multiple MDM Analysts to join the Master Data team. This opportunity is well suited for an early-career professional with practical experience in master data, SAP, accounting, operations, or data quality. Level will be determined based on relevant qualifications and experience.

POSITION SUMMARY
The MDM Analyst supports the accuracy, completeness, and timely maintenance of enterprise master data in SAP. The role works closely with Accounting, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Technology, and other business teams to execute master data requests, resolve data issues, strengthen controls, and improve the efficiency of data-management processes. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, analytical, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and interested in developing broader SAP and upstream oil and gas knowledge.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
· Create, update, and maintain master data in SAP accurately, in the proper sequence, and within established service-level expectations so dependent business processes can be completed reliably.
· Review master data requests for completeness, required approvals, supporting documentation, and compliance with established standards and controls.
· Perform data validation and quality checks to identify duplicate, obsolete, incomplete, or inconsistent records and coordinate remediation.
· Research and resolve master data issues by tracing data across SAP records, source systems, workflows, and supporting documentation.
· Partner with Accounting, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and improve data quality.
· Support recurring data-quality reporting, reconciliations, audits, and control activities.
· Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate master data processes, including the use of Excel and other available tools.
· Document procedures, business rules, data definitions, and changes to master data standards.
· Assist with system implementations, acquisitions, integrations, conversions, and other special projects as needed.
· Manage multiple requests and projects while communicating status, risks, and dependencies clearly.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
· Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
· Two or more years of relevant professional experience in master data, accounting, operations, business systems, data quality, or a related area.
· Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with formulas, lookups, filters, and large data sets.
· Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns, exceptions, and data inconsistencies.
· Ability to follow established controls and procedures while applying sound judgment to resolve exceptions.
· Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
· Ability to work effectively across functions and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
· Experience using SAP or another enterprise resource planning system.
· Experience with master data creation, maintenance, cleansing, standardization, validation, or governance.
· Exposure to upstream oil and gas operations, accounting, joint ventures, wells, cost centers, vendors, materials, or related data domains.
· Experience with workflow, ticketing, reporting, data visualization, SQL, or automation tools.
· Interest in developing deeper expertise in SAP master data management, data governance, and process improvement.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
· Master data requests are completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with documented controls.
· Data issues are investigated thoroughly and communicated clearly to the appropriate stakeholders.
· Recurring problems are identified and translated into practical process, control, or automation improvements.
· Business partners view the MDM team as responsive, reliable, and knowledgeable.

Crescent Energy is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please let us know by contacting recruitment@crescentenergyco.com.

jobs.description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.
 
We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Healthcare Reporting Analyst I

Cleveland

Remote Location

Job Summary
 
Job Details

Join the Cleveland Clinic team where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and make a lasting, meaningful impact on patient care. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world. 
 
As a Healthcare Reporting Analyst, you will prepare, analyze, and report key financial and revenue cycle management (RCM) information through standard and ad hoc reports that support enterprise needs. In this role, you will audit and validate provider roster data from contracted commercial health plans, ensuring accuracy and alignment with contract requirements, value-based initiatives, and service level requirements (SLRs). You will compare health plan data against internal provider databases, identify discrepancies in provider demographics, credentialing, enrollment status, practice locations, and provider assignments, and collaborate with health plans to resolve data quality issues. You will also monitor and trend roster errors, validate provider attribution for value-based care and risk contracts, and support new health plan implementations through roster audits and quality assurance reviews.
 
Using advanced Excel skills, you will analyze large datasets, develop reporting requirements, validate reporting outputs, and partner with database developers and the Network Data & Reporting team on data quality initiatives. This position leverages AI tools, such as Copilot and ChatGPT, to improve reporting efficiency and documentation while investigating provider data issues that may affect claims processing, reimbursement, authorizations, network participation, and patient access to care. Although this role does not involve direct patient interaction, your work is essential to ensuring health plans maintain accurate provider information, directly influencing patient satisfaction and the overall Cleveland Clinic patient experience.
 
A caregiver in this role works remotely from 8:00 a.m. -- 5:00 p.m. or 7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in Ohio, Florida or Nevada.

A caregiver who excels in this role will: 
• Prepare, analyze and communicate key financial information and provide support to management and other staff members regarding financial reporting and other related issues. 
• Assist with budget preparation and financial planning processes and budget review for compliance and opportunities. 
• Serve as consultant to all levels of management to provide decision support for initiatives, policies and procedures. 
• Complete special projects and duties including providing necessary research, forecasting and conflict resolution. 
• Other duties as assigned.
 
Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include: 
• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field
• OR Associate’s Degree and two years of experience 
• OR High School Diploma/GED and four years of experience
• Ability to complete basic analytical, consultative and information support through analysis and report preparation
• Awareness of key performance indicators, cash flow analysis, product line analysis and proposal development
 
Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:
• One year of Accounting, Finance, Healthcare, Investment Banking or Management Consulting experience
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Management Account (CMA) certification
• Familiar with SQL coding or backend system relationships
• Experience with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Epic's Coco, and Snowflake-related AI capabilities
• Advanced excel proficiencies (conditional formatting, pivot tables, formulas, VLOOKUP)
• Credentialing experience
• Professional experience working with provider enrollment, credentialing, provider rosters, provider demographics, or provider directory data within a healthcare organization or health plan

Physical Requirements: 
• Ability to communicate and exchange accurate information. 
• Ability to perform work in a stationary position for extended periods. 
• Ability to work with physical records or operate a computer or other office equipment. 
• In some locations, ability to travel throughout the hospital system. 
• In some locations ability to move up to 25 lbs.

Personal Protective Equipment:
• Follows Standard Precautions using personal protective equipment as required for procedures.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description
GE Aerospace Research is seeking an exceptional early career researcher to join our Robotics & Autonomy Lab as a Robotics & Autonomy Engineer.
You will build deep technical expertise in Robotics while developing the organizational intelligence and leadership skills that define Research's technical leaders.

At GE Aerospace Research’s Robotics & Autonomy Lab, we advance the future of flight through breakthroughs in robotic manufacturing automation and vehicle/mission autonomy. We develop technologies to enable high‑mix low-volume work cell that operate independently and alongside human teammates without bespoke retooling.  We also create autonomous solutions for uncrewed and reduced‑crew vehicles spanning sensing, localization, navigation, mission planning, and execution.

Your first three years at Research include structured development to accelerate your growth: establishing your technical foundation in your home lab, strategic stretch assignments that provide breadth across our capabilities, and connection to a cohort of early career peers. Through independent research, structured projects, coursework, and mentorship, you'll progress from foundational researcher to recognized technical contributor ready for long-term impact in aerospace innovation.

Qualifications/Requirements:
• Masters Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, or related STEM discipline.
• Must be willing to work from the GE Aerospace Research office in Niskayuna, NY.
• This role may require an individual to obtain active US Government Secret Clearance with ability to attain a Top-Secret Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. citizenship.
• This role may require use of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or security clearance to access classified information. Therefore, employment is contingent upon your ability to prove that you meet the qualification of being a US Citizen.
 
Eligibility Requirements:
Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen. Due to the nature of our projects, US Citizenship is required.

You will stand out if you have one or more of these attributes:
• Prior intern, co-op, or research experience (university, national lab, industry, or applied research setting).
• Exceptional academic performance with research orientation (e.g., thesis-based work, publications, conference presentations, patents, or open-source technical contributions).
• Humble and inclusive: seeks to learn, welcomes feedback, and values different perspectives in technical debate. Creates an environment where others can contribute and do their best work.
• Focused and rigorous: uses data to make decisions, frames hypotheses, designs experiments, and strengthens solutions through iteration and learning. Connects their research to real world impact.
• Transparent and collaborative: communicates clearly to varied audiences, partners across teams, and builds alignment through evidence to deliver outcomes that matter.
• Demonstrated initiative and commitment to community/university involvement (e.g., mentoring, affinity groups, teaching assistantship, outreach, lab leadership, or service that strengthens the research community).

The pay range for this position is $90,000-$100,000 USD annually. The specific annual rate offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s experience, their education, and the work location. The position includes eligibility in the GE Aerospace AIR Bonus Program. You will be eligible for an annual bonus that is a percentage of base salary. Under current plan provisions, the bonus target for this role is 5%, and the actual bonus could increase or decrease depending on a variety of factors, including individual performance and company financial performance.

GE Aerospace provides a comprehensive benefits package that provides access to plans which support the overall wellbeing of our employees and their dependents. These benefits include, but are not limited to, health care coverage (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), a retirement plan that includes Company Retirement Savings and a 401K with Company matching, Life Insurance options, Disability coverage, paid time-off, EAP, and more.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information
GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Product Development Engineer in the DRAM Technology Node Development group at Micron, you will join a collaborative team building world-class memory technologies. You will work from initial development and silicon bring-up through certification, yield improvement, and production expansion. This outstanding opportunity lets you apply your academic background to practical semiconductor engineering skills while working with seasoned engineers on innovative projects.

Responsibilities:

• Support new DRAM process-node and product development, including build validation, silicon bring-up, qualification, yield learning, and production ramp.
• Analyze electrical test, probe, simulation, and characterization data to determine trends, build marginalities, and potential causes of performance or yield loss.
• Assist with characterization and optimization of memory, logic, and analog functions, such as Sense Amplifiers, timing distribution, calibration, training, and related control circuits.
• Complete experiments and established debug methods; coordinate results, compare outcomes with expectations, and recommend data-supported next steps.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to investigate process-, build-, test-, and manufacturing-related issues affecting product quality, robustness, performance, and manufacturability.
• Use approved AI-enabled tools for engineering analysis, coding, automation, visualization, documentation, and problem-solving—while validating outputs and protecting confidential information.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics focusing on semiconductor electronics, or a related technical area.
• For Engineer I / candidates recently completing a bachelor’s or master’s degree or possessing equivalent experience, with fewer than two years of relevant full-time professional experience.
• Foundational understanding of semiconductor devices, CMOS circuits, digital or analog electronics, memory operation, computer architecture, build verification, test, or data analysis.
• Demonstrated problem-solving ability through coursework, laboratory work, research, internships, co-ops, or technical projects.
• Build proficiency with approved AI-assisted engineering tools and critically evaluate AI-supported results.
• Ability to collect, coordinate, analyze, and communicate engineering data using tools such as Python, JMP, MATLAB, Excel, or similar software.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Coursework or project experience in semiconductor device physics, VLSI, CMOS building, analog or digital circuits, memory architecture, statistics, or the composition of experiments.
• Exposure to DRAM or other memory technologies, circuit simulation, Verilog, CAD tools, bench characterization, semiconductor test, probe, or electrical failure analysis.
• Experience developing scripts, dashboards, data pipelines, or automation that improves analysis quality or workflow efficiency.
• Familiarity with structured problem-solving methods, statistical process control, development of experiments, or root-cause analysis.
• Evidence of initiative, curiosity, collaborative behavior, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technical concepts.
• Experience applying AI, machine learning, or generative AI to engineering workflows and decision support.

We foster a highly collaborative environment where design, verification, product engineering, and manufacturing teams partner across global sites to deliver world-class semiconductor products.

As a Memory Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, simulation, optimization, and validation of analog and digital circuits used in advanced memory products. This role involves working across the full product lifecycle, from technology development and circuit architecture through silicon validation and product qualification. You will collaborate with multi-functional teams to ensure designs meet performance, quality, reliability, manufacturability, and cost objectives while supporting next-generation memory technologies.

Responsibilities
• Design, simulate, analyze, and optimize analog and digital CMOS circuits used in DRAM and other advanced memory products, including power delivery network (PDN) circuitry and block-level power generators.
• Collaborate with design, verification, product engineering, process integration, test, probe, assembly, and marketing teams to develop high-quality memory solutions that meet product and manufacturing objectives.
• Perform circuit verification, layout review, parasitic extraction analysis, and silicon correlation to validate circuit performance against design simulations.
• Partner with process integration and transistor modeling teams to develop circuits for future semiconductor process technologies and next-generation memory products.
• Demonstrate the ability to effectively use AI-enabled tools, including Microsoft Copilot and approved AI solutions, to improve productivity, accelerate problem solving, and support engineering decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 5 years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience; OR Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 3 years of relevant experience.
• Experience with analog and digital circuit design and simulation.
• Experience with power delivery network (PDN) circuit design, analysis, and optimization.
• Experience using UNIX and CADENCE design environments, including simulation, schematic entry, and SPF extraction.
• Experience performing circuit verification, layout verification, parasitic extraction, semiconductor device evaluation, and circuit optimization.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience designing memory circuits, including DRAM or other high-performance semiconductor products.
• Strong understanding of transistor modeling, CMOS circuit design methodologies, and silicon validation techniques.
• Experience collaborating with multi-functional semiconductor development teams across design, manufacturing, and product engineering organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking and human judgment to validate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with Micron policies.
• Experience adopting emerging AI-enabled workflows and approved AI-assisted tools to improve engineering efficiency and business outcomes.

The AI Engineer I is an early-career engineering role focused on building and operating AI powered products. You will work with experienced engineers and product stakeholders to develop, evaluate, deploy, and improve LLM and machine-learning applications. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, practical understanding of modern AI systems, and an ability to learn quickly and solve problems pragmatically. This role is suitable for strong graduates and engineers in the early stages of their AI/ML career.

Major Job Responsibilities and Related Duties:
• Develop and maintain components of LLM, agentic, retrieval, and other AI/ML applications.
• Work with engineers and product stakeholders to translate product requirements into technical solutions.
• Build experiments and evaluations to measure AI system quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
• Prepare and integrate data required by AI applications, including retrieval and embedding-based systems.
• Contribute to deploying, monitoring, debugging, and improving AI services in production.
• Write clean, tested, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and team engineering practices.
• Keep up to date with developments in applied AI and evaluate new techniques and tools where they can improve our products.
Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, AI/ML, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 0–2 years of relevant professional experience. Internships, research, and substantial academic or personal projects are relevant experience.
• Strong Python programming skills and sound software engineering fundamentals.
• Practical experience building at least one meaningful AI/ML application or project.
• Sound understanding of modern LLM application concepts such as prompting, structured outputs, tool use, embeddings, retrieval/RAG, or agentic workflows.
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate and debug AI system behavior.
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Nice to Have:
• Experience with LLM or agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent.
• Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, or vector databases.
• Familiarity with SQL and data-processing workflows.
• Experience building APIs or backend services.
• Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform.
• Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or production of deployment workflows.
• Thorough understanding of core machine learning and NLP concepts.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively.

Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines. Other perks include full private medical cover, dental cover, Life Assurance and member rewards, 28 days annual leave, a competitive pension, season ticket loans, enhanced maternity and paternity pay and much more!

jobs.description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. 

Job Description
Summary:

The R&D Electrical Engineer supports the electrical and electronic hardware development activities of instrumented, automated diagnostic systems. A member of a project team, they work closely with other development engineering functions, software, mechanical, and systems. This role interfaces with manufacturing, regulatory, and quality teams to ensure product reliability, quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Electrical Engineer with experience developing electrical and electronic hardware for complex, instrumented systems. They are a strong communicator and collaborator who works effectively across software, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams.

They possess excellent technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including experience with root-cause investigation and failure analysis. Most importantly, they demonstrate a strong commitment to quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance, helping deliver high-performing diagnostic products that meet rigorous medical device standards.

Responsibilities
• Support the design and development of electrical, electronic and electro-optic components and systems for automated diagnostic instruments.
• Participate and hold design reviews for modules and subsystems.
• Design and develop microcontroller-based modules.
• Assess the ability of proposed designs to meet specified requirements including manufacturability and serviceability.
• Learn and practice the Global Product Development System phase and gate design process. Conduct project work in compliance with internal procedures and processes, ISO 9001, and FDA cGMP standards for the design of Medical Devices.
• Learn and practice design for compliance to IVD and medical standards for safety, EMC, and security.
• Interact closely with software, systems, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering functions to develop comprehensive solutions to design problems.
• Develop and execute functional tests for modules and systems.
• Conduct failure investigations and root cause analyses documenting the results.

Minimum Qualifications:

• BS in Electrical or Computer Engineering.
• Hands-on experience building and testing breadboards and prototypes.
• Experience working with microcontrollers. 
• Experience using schematic capture and PCB layout tools.
• Familiarity working with standard lab equipment, oscilloscope, logic analyzer, MCU debug probes.
• Solid understanding of basic electronic circuits and components, LEDs, photodetectors, sensors, amplifiers, voltage regulators, logic, ADC, DAC, memory.
• Good understanding of electro-mechanical components, motors, blowers, heaters, TEC, solenoids, relays. 

Preferred Experience:

• Experience with Altium
• Experience with embedded programming experience in Assembler, C or HDL languages.
• Experience in BOM management and PCBA ordering
• Experience with motion control.
• Experience in the design of analog and mixed signal circuits, sensor to ADC to MCU.

Why Join Us?
To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. 

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

The Data Engineer will support the development, maintenance, and optimization of data solutions using the Databricks platform. This is an entry-level data engineering role designed for candidates with foundational experience in SQL, Python, cloud technologies, and modern data engineering concepts.
The engineer will work as part of an Agile development team and collaborate with experienced data engineers, analysts, and business partners to build reliable data pipelines, data models, and analytics-ready datasets.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain data pipelines and data transformations using Databricks, SQL, Python, and PySpark.
• Assist with the ingestion, transformation, and processing of structured and semi-structured data from multiple source systems.
• Develop and maintain Databricks notebooks, pipelines, workflows, and jobs supporting data engineering and analytics use cases.
• Build and maintain data tables and datasets using Delta Lake and lakehouse architecture principles.
• Write, test, troubleshoot, and optimize SQL queries used for data processing, analysis, and reporting.
• Support the development of ETL/ELT pipelines that move and transform data across source systems, cloud storage, Databricks, and downstream applications.
• Work within an Agile Scrum team to design, develop, unit test, debug, document, and maintain data solutions based on defined functional and technical requirements.
• Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to ensure solutions follow established architecture, development standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.
• Assist with defining data models, data structures, transformation logic, and information flows.
• Perform data validation and troubleshooting to help ensure the quality, consistency, completeness, and accuracy of data products.
• Monitor data pipelines and Databricks workloads and assist with troubleshooting pipeline failures and data-related issues.
• Participate in root-cause analysis and resolution of data and application issues with cross-functional teams.
• Use Git and established CI/CD practices to manage and deploy data engineering code and configurations.
• Create and maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, transformations, data models, and other data products.
• Collaborate with business and technical teams supporting areas such as Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations to understand data requirements and deliver appropriate data solutions.
• Support data solutions spanning ingestion, transformation, data modeling, analytics, and reporting.
• Develop knowledge of data governance, data security, access controls, and data quality management practices.
• Participate in production support activities on a rotating basis as needed.
• Can work remotely.

Minimum Education Requirement
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field of study.
Equivalent education, technical training, certifications, internships, or relevant practical experience may also be considered.

Minimum Experience Requirement
0–2 years of experience in data engineering, software development, business intelligence, data analytics, data science, or a related technical field.
Relevant internships, academic projects, certifications, or hands-on project experience may be considered toward the experience requirement.

Required Knowledge or Experience
• Foundational knowledge of Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms.
• Experience or coursework using SQL for querying and transforming data.
• Experience or coursework using Python for data processing or software development.
• Familiarity with Apache Spark or PySpark concepts.
• Understanding of ETL/ELT and data pipeline concepts.
• Basic understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
• Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and services, preferably AWS.
• Familiarity with Git source control and software development practices.
• Understanding of basic data quality concepts, including validation, completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to learn new technologies and work collaboratively within a technical team.

Preferred Knowledge or Experience

The following experience is beneficial but not required:
• Databricks notebooks, workflows, jobs, or Databricks SQL.
• Delta Lake and lakehouse architecture concepts.
• PySpark DataFrames and Spark SQL.
• Databricks Unity Catalog and data governance concepts.
• AWS services such as S3, IAM, Glue, Athena, or related data services.
• Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration technologies.
• CI/CD concepts and automated deployment practices.
• Data visualization tools such as Power BI.
• Streaming and event-driven technologies such as Apache Kafka.
• Data warehouse and data lake concepts.
• Data governance, metadata management, and access-control concepts.
• Databricks or cloud-provider certifications.

Awarded a Healthiest Employer, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona aims to fulfill its mission to inspire health and make it easy. AZ Blue offers a variety of health insurance products and services to meet the diverse needs of individuals, families, and small and large businesses as well as providing information and tools to help individuals make better health decisions.

At AZ Blue, we have a hybrid workforce strategy, called Workability, that offers flexibility with how and where employees work. Our positions are classified as hybrid, onsite or remote. • Onsite: daily onsite requirement based on the essential functions of the job

• Remote: not held to onsite requirements, however, leadership can request presence onsite for business reasons including but not limited to staff meetings, one-on-ones, training, and team building

As an IP Design Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of critical IP designs through rigorous verification processes. Using industry-standard tools and methodologies, you will create and execute test plans, identify and resolve bugs, and contribute to delivering robust IP solutions. jobs.title: Silicon Co-Design Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice, join our diverse team today!

Working at the Silicon Co-design Engineering Team at NVIDIA, you will be responsible for productizing NVIDIA's chips into groundbreaking consumer, professional, server, mobile, and automotive solutions. The qualified candidate should be comfortable in a lab environment and should demonstrate a passion towards creation, execution and improvement of silicon validation plans.

What you’ll be doing:
• Develop and implement methodologies to characterize silicon and validate system features on pre-production silicon.

• Drive root-causes analysis efforts of hardware failures through lab experimentation and collaboration with other teams within NVIDIA.

• Find innovative solutions to sophisticated silicon and system level problems to productize silicon and refine future designs to fine-tune architected features post-silicon.

• Analyze workloads like DL/AI, AAA games, Adobe Suite, and Video Conferencing to understand how we can push market leading energy efficiency.

• Characterize pre-production silicon fabricated using innovative processes for speed, performance, power, yield, and quality to draw correlation to design.

• Design or commission tools on evaluation platforms to automate and optimize characterization, data collection, test case execution, and results analysis.

• Analyze workloads to achieve best-in-class energy efficiency and evaluate the return and investment of new techniques and features, including use case benefit and design-for-productization.

What we need to see:
• Completing a BS, MS or PhD degree in EE, CE, Systems Engineering or equivalent experience.

• Problem solving, debugging, analysis and logical reasoning skills with examples to prove it.

• Understanding of digital design, circuit analysis, algorithms, computer architecture, BIOS, drivers, and software applications.

• Strong programming skills in one or more of Python, JavaScript, C/C++

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Familiarity with statistical methods, tools for data analysis, and analyzing large datasets to draw actionable conclusions, possibly applying deep learning techniques.

• Knowledgeable in signal integrity, timing analysis, fault analysis, sampling, computer architecture, filters.

• Familiar with lab tools (oscilloscopes and logic analyzers).

• Experience in Database and Web Development is a plus!

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We welcome you join our team with some of the most hard-working people in the world working together to promote rapid growth. Are you passionate about becoming a part of a best-in-class team supporting the latest in GPU and AI technology? If so, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 116,000 USD - 189,750 USD for Level 2, and 136,000 USD - 218,500 USD for Level 3.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 26, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology. 

Associate Product Manager

Location: San Francisco, CA (in office) 
Reports to: Product Management Leader 
Classification: Full-Time 
Travel: To operating locations, Dallas headquarters, and customers as needed 

About Copart
Copart is a global leader in online vehicle auctions and automotive remarketing services. We serve Members across multiple countries through a culture built on integrity, ownership, innovation, operational excellence, and results.

The Opportunity
The Associate Product Manager will support product discovery and delivery while building the foundational skills required to lead Copart products.
This role will combine customer empathy, commercial judgment, data-informed decision-making, and hands-on execution to advance early-career product management. The successful candidate will operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, work across functions and geographies, and turn complex needs into simple, scalable solutions.

What You Will Do
Product Strategy and Customer Insight
• Define a clear product vision and roadmap for early-career product management.
• Develop a deep understanding of buyer, seller, partner, employee, and operational needs through research, data, and direct observation.
• Translate enterprise priorities into measurable customer and business outcomes.
• Make explicit tradeoffs based on value, effort, risk, and strategic fit.
Execution and Delivery
• Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Marketing, Legal, Security, and other teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Write clear product requirements, define acceptance criteria, and maintain an actionable backlog.
• Establish release plans, manage dependencies, and remove barriers to execution.
• Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, accessible, and supportable.
Measurement and Continuous Improvement
• Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to evaluate product performance and prioritize improvements.
• Run structured experiments and convert learning into roadmap decisions.
• Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and results with clarity.
Collaboration and Change Leadership
• Build trust with field and corporate stakeholders and engage users early throughout discovery and delivery.
• Create practical adoption plans, training, communications, and feedback loops.
• Model ownership, disciplined decision-making, and follow-through.
• Represent the product perspective in cross-functional planning and executive discussions.

What You Bring
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; internship or project experience in product, analytics, design, engineering, or operations preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to define ambiguous problems, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes.
• Strong analytical, communication, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
• Experience partnering across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and business functions.
• Familiarity with agile product development, experimentation, analytics, and modern cloud platforms.
• Ability to work from Copart’s San Francisco office and travel to operating locations, Dallas headquarters, and customers as needed.

How Success Will Be Measured
• Establish a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for early-career product management.

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027. 

You'll join Coinbase as a software engineer intern and help build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features. You'll solve large-scale, complex technical problems at the intersection of web-scale applications and blockchain technology, shipping real code that impacts millions of users.
