jobs.description:
Graham Capital Management, L.P. (collectively with its affiliates, "Graham") is an alternative investment manager founded in 1994 by Kenneth G. Tropin. Specializing in discretionary and quantitative macro strategies, Graham is dedicated to delivering strong, uncorrelated returns across a wide range of market environments. As one of the industry’s longest-standing global macro and trend-following managers, Graham remains committed to innovation, evolving its strategies through a robust investment, technology, and operational infrastructure. Graham harnesses the synergies between its discretionary and quantitative trading businesses to offer a broad suite of complementary alpha strategies, each built on the principles of thoughtful portfolio construction, active risk management, and diversification by design. Graham invests significant proprietary capital alongside its clients – including global institutions, endowments, foundations, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, investment management advisors, and qualified individual investors – reinforcing alignment of interests across all strategies.

The foundation of Graham’s sustainability and success is the experience and contributions of its people. The firm seeks to cultivate talent, encourage the diversity of ideas, and respect the contributions of all. In turn, each employee shares in the responsibility of strengthening those around them.

Description

Graham Capital Management, L.P. is seeking a junior-to-mid-level Software Developer to join its Trading Technology team in support of continued growth across its quantitative and discretionary trading businesses. The role will focus primarily on maintaining, enhancing, and supporting critical Windows client and server applications, while also contributing to new development projects. The successful candidate will work within a small, collaborative team and interact closely with development peers, the quantitative trading team, and other business users, with meaningful autonomy in developing technical solutions.

Responsibilities

• Working closely with developers and business users, primarily within the quantitative trading team, to gather requirements and scope projects

• Maintaining, enhancing, and updating existing Windows client and server applications, while also contributing to new development projects

• Analyzing existing systems for robustness and performance improvements

• Presenting ideas for system improvements, both technical and business-related

• Producing product specifications and training peers and users on system use and maintenance

• Performing unit, integration, and functional testing

• Maintaining and supporting business-critical pre-trade signal and order generation systems through UAT and production, with a focus on accuracy, reliability, and timely processing

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field

• 1-5 years of relevant software development experience; strong recent graduates with relevant internship, academic, or project experience will also be considered. Prior financial services or investment management experience is not required

• Strong object-oriented programming skills; C# is preferred, but strong candidates with experience in Java, Python, or another modern programming language will also be considered

• Experience with or strong knowledge of concurrency, automated unit testing, and SQL

• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with developers and business users throughout the software development life cycle

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to developing reliable, thoroughly tested software

• Experience with event-driven architecture (messaging), F#, or functional programming (preferred)

This role requires commuting into our Rowayton, CT office Mondays through Fridays.

This wage range may be modified in the future.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, as well as a wide array of benefit programs, such as medical and life insurance, 401(K) plans, and access to other healthcare programs.

No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. jobs.description:
ABOUT US

B2B payments are a multi-trillion-dollar industry and, as the industry pushes further into digitization and faster settlement, fraud has become a massive problem — to the tune of $43B in annual losses.

Walrus http://walrusfi.com is the leader in B2B payment verification, with clients that include some of the biggest names in investment management. Our DoubleCheck platform combines advanced authentication, proprietary technology, AI, and novel UX to collect and confirm payment details. DoubleCheck has defined a new category: verifying the safe transfer of financial information and assets.

Walrus is led by PhD computer scientists and security researchers, with decades of experience in engineering, cybersecurity, and cryptography, and many research accomplishments at Harvard, Stanford, MIT, the University of Chicago, Columbia, UTexas, and NYU. 

We’re backed by one of the world's leading fintech VC funds, as well as founders and former executives of Twitter, Google Maps, Databricks, and Kayak.




THE ROLE

You will be part of the core team at Walrus, working on our flagship product https://www.walrusfi.com/doublecheck. You will design, build, and own exciting new modules; examples include payments, reputation, and new kinds of authentication.

We are an early-stage company, so you and the team will work together to create standards and culture that will endure for years to come. Of course you’ll get to design and innovate solutions to hard problems, and write a lot of code. But beyond that, as all entrepreneurial software teams do, you’ll be able to design ways of approaching software development.

We are looking for people who are thoughtful, not only about software problems, but about how teams work together to solve them, and how people collaborate to build an energizing and supportive workplace.




ABOUT YOU

You are someone who cares a lot about designing software in a thoughtful way that takes into account bug prevention, testability, and maintainability. You are comfortable with the idea that product design should be data-driven, using evidence rather than opinion.

You are:

 - Experienced with tools for testing. You know that the best software developers demonstrate that their code works, rather than dumping it on a QA department.

 - Curious, and have an interest in teaching and learning from your colleagues.

 - A strong written communicator.

 - Graduating in December 2027, anytime 2028, or spring 2029 with an undergraduate degree in computer science, math, physics, or electrical engineering.

We meet sparingly and efficiently. We understand our innate biases and celebrate diversity. We have a low-ego workplace, where we provide the tools for everyone to do their best work. You will work closely with the leadership team, and have room for extensive growth within the company.

 - Remote work is welcomed, but candidates who wish can report to work in NYC.

 - For full time permanent employees, Walrus offers competitive compensation and benefits, including salary, equity, paid medical insurance, dental, vision, company contribution to wellness, good coverage for dependents, parental leave, retirement, relocation assistance, and unlimited PTO.

We believe talent comes from all backgrounds and walks of life, and are committed to providing a comfortable environment for everyone to work.

This is a temporary internship position with full time hours. The annual base pay for this internship is $75,000 - $110,000 (depending on location and experience). This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

In our hybrid early career program, you’ll be paired with a tenured Affirmer and have an opportunity to collaborate in-person 3 days a week out of our New York City, or San Francisco offices. You'll experience the best of both worlds: the in-office experience and remote work. After the one-year, you can remain hybrid, go remote, or stay in an office. Opportunities are available across different tech stacks and teams so that you can find a perfect fit to launch your career with Affirm!

About the Risk & Analytics Team: The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk, to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

Our Teams (Where You Might Sit): We are hiring multiple Early Career Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

• Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

• Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

• Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

• Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

• Servicing and Payments: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

• International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As an Early Career Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

• Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

• Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

• Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

• Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

• AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, copilots) into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, holding the line on verifying outputs.

What We Look For

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher with an expectation that you will complete your most recent full-time degree program by August 2027 or earlier; relevant internships or prior experience in the consumer lending, fintech, or broader financial services industry are highly valued.

• Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Math or a related quantitative field preferred.

• Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

• Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

• Basic understanding or deep curiosity about consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

• Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively.

Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 5

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. Benefits designed for you

jobs.title: Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer
jobs.description:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

About the Role

We are building a next-generation lab automation and robotics platform that brings together robotic systems, simulation, computer vision, and AI to improve the speed, reliability, reproducibility, and scale of experimental biology.

As a Robotics Systems & Simulation Engineer, you will connect digital environments with physical systems and make robotic capabilities easier to adapt to new equipment and settings. You will own the simulation and digital-twin infrastructure that lets us bring vision-guided robots to new instruments quickly, and that serves as the testbed for robotics control, perception, and embodied AI. Working alongside robotics, AI, software, and automation engineers, you will develop and validate integrated systems from prototype through real-world operation.

This is an on-site hands-on role spanning software, 3D geometry, simulation, and hardware. We value strong fundamentals, practical problem-solving, and the ability to learn across disciplines using modern engineering and AI development tools.

What You’ll Do

• Build integrated Real2Sim and Sim2Real workflows that can be reused across robotic platforms and laboratory environments.

• Create and validate digital twins from CAD, robot and sensor models, and reconstructed scenes, including coordinate alignment, articulation, and collision geometry.

• Connect simulation, perception, motion planning, and physical execution through the existing robot control stack, including robot state feedback and synchronization; investigate discrepancies between simulated and measured behavior.

• Integrate AI models and task-level state machines with simulation and robotic tools, including structured requests, action validation, and execution feedback.

• Build synthetic-data and augmentation workflows, along with synchronized video and telemetry capture, replay, and evaluation tools.

• Benchmark system accuracy, reliability, latency, and GPU resource use; improve performance across local and cloud computing environments.

• Collaborate with software engineers on reusable configuration and operator tools; validate new installations and reduce manual setup effort.

• Work with scientists to integrate new capabilities, debug physical systems, and document architecture, experiments, and operating procedures.

Qualifications (Required):

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Recent graduates with substantial relevant research or project experience are encouraged to apply.

• Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, or C#, with experience developing and debugging integrated applications in Linux.

• Hands-on experience building or extending robotics simulations or digital twins using Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or comparable tools.

• Solid understanding of 3D coordinate transformations, robot kinematics, calibration, and the relationship between simulated models and physical systems.

• Experience integrating robots, sensors, or other physical systems through APIs, SDKs, ROS2, or comparable middleware.

• Familiarity with GPU computing and cloud-based workflows for simulation, AI, or data processing.

• Strong debugging and experimental skills, clear technical communication, and the ability to learn unfamiliar methods while critically validating software and AI-generated outputs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with 3D reconstruction, CAD/robot-model pipelines, RGB-D perception, multi-view fusion, or learned scene representations.

• Experience integrating LLMs, vision-language models, AI agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with external tools and physical systems.

• Experience with spatial or object reasoning, active perception, or perception of transparent, reflective, or partially occluded objects.

• Experience with video understanding, human-object interaction, learning from demonstrations, imitation learning, or other robot-learning methods.

• Experience with GPU profiling, CUDA programming, accelerated inference, or edge deployment.

• Experience with 6-axis robotic arms, mobile robots, laboratory instruments, or hands-on mechanical prototyping.

• Experience integrating robots, sensors, or other physical systems through APIs, SDKs, ROS2, or comparable middleware.

• Experience mentoring students, interns, or junior engineers.

What We Offer:

• Hands-on ownership of robotics and simulation systems in a state-of-the-art biotechnology laboratory.

• Opportunities to work across biology, mechanical and computational engineering with AI, software, automation, and scientific teams.

• Access to advanced robotic platforms, scientific instrumentation, GPU computing, and AI development tools.

• Technical mentorship, the opportunity to mentor research interns and residents, cross-disciplinary growth, and the opportunity to contribute to AI-enabled drug discovery in a collaborative environment.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, seeking to provide an open, flexible, and friendly work environment to empower employees and provide them with a platform to develop their long-term careers. A Summary of Benefits is available for all applicants. We offer a competitive package that includes base salary, bonus, and equity. The base pay range for this position is expected to be $150,000 - $185,000 annually; however, the base pay offered will vary depending on the market, job-related knowledge, skills and capabilities, and experience.

Xaira Therapeutics an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that our strength is in our differences. Our goal to build a diverse and inclusive team began on day one, and it will never end.

TO ALL RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Xaira Therapeutics does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or employees. Xaira Therapeutics is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco. 

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover 

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. JOB SUMMARY:

jobs.description:
Opportunity 

Brunswick Group is seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Apprentice BI Data Analyst to join its Group Business Intelligence (BI) team.

The Group BI team plays a key role in supporting the business globally by delivering meaningful data, reporting and analysis to inform strategic decisions. Working closely with Finance, FP&A, the Commercial Hub and other business teams, the function develops and maintains reporting systems and BI dashboards, helping stakeholders better understand financial performance, revenue and recovery data.

The successful candidate will work within the BI development team, reporting to the BI Technical Support Analyst. The role involves providing technical support, investigating and resolving reporting issues, and assisting with the development and improvement of dashboards to enhance self-service reporting across the firm.

Alongside gaining hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure SQL Server and Power BI, the successful candidate will complete a Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship.

We are looking for a motivated individual with strong analytical and interpersonal skills, a keen interest in data and technology, and a willingness to learn. Previous Business Intelligence experience is not required, as training and mentoring will be provided. Applicants must meet the apprenticeship eligibility requirements.

About the Role 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

• Perform daily integrity checks

• Investigating issues raised by end-users and resolve them or escalating them to the development team

• Provide immediate solutions to system issues and liaise with other support teams to ensure prompt resolution

• Manage small scale changes through to completion

• Perform quality assurance tests and assisting with new release processes

• Automate and enhance workflows

• Manage and administer reporting security

• Collaborate with people across the firm to enable them to self-serve Business Intelligence through Power BI

• Work with developers to support the technical implementation and roll-out of new reporting dashboards on Power BI

• As skills and knowledge are gained, personally take on development work, through SQL and Power BI within the team.

What We're Looking For

At Brunswick, we seek smart and curious individuals dedicated to learning and growth. We value potential, strong work ethic, and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Standout candidates demonstrate:

• Working knowledge of Excel, with an enthusiasm to develop more advanced skills

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills

• An interest in working with data and using it to solve business problems

• The ability to communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels of the business

• A proactive approach and willingness to learn

• A resilient, enthusiastic team player with strong self-motivation and a collaborative, hands-on approach

• An interest in databases and data; previous exposure to SQL would be beneficial but is not essential

• An interest in Business Intelligence and data visualisation; previous exposure to Power BI would be beneficial but is not essential

• An interest in developing commercial and financial understanding

• A sense of fun

Applications close on Friday 30th October 2026 at 4.00pm.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

About the team

Avride is a leading developer in the autonomous vehicle and delivery robot industry. Our dynamic team, composed of a few hundred engineers develops and operates autonomous cars and delivery robots across the globe, shaping the future of mobility and logistics.

At Avride, we are committed to making the roads safer and more accessible for everyone. At the core of our philosophy is the belief in the transformative power of technology. Every product we develop, every test we conduct, and every service we launch is anchored in our vision of creating a safer and more sustainable world with help of cutting-edge technologies and breakthrough solutions.

About the role

Our Autonomy Platform Engineering Hardware team designs the electronics on these vehicles, including compute, power, networking and sensor interface boards. We're looking for a hands-on technician in Austin to keep our fleet's electronics running and to help build the hardware we test next.

What you'll do

• Diagnose and test electronic units on robotaxis and delivery robots, following written test procedures and using electrical test equipment

• Disassemble and reassemble electronic units

• Remove and install units on vehicles and robots

• Route and install wiring on vehicles and robots

• Re-terminate and re-crimp cable assemblies and harnesses

• Repair PCB assemblies by reworking and replacing components, including fine-pitch work under a microscope, then run the follow-up tests in the procedure

• Assemble prototype hardware

• Build and modify test benches and fixtures

• Work through assigned task lists and plans, and write clear reports on what you found, what you did and the test results

• Keep repair and inventory records up to date in our tracking systems

What you'll need

• Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and wiring diagrams

• Strong soldering skills, including fine-pitch and microscope work (SMD components, rework of small packages)

• Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment: multimeter, bench power supply, oscilloscope, and similar tools

• Experience with crimping, connector termination and cable assembly

• Comfortable with everyday computer tools: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets), email, online schematic/PCB viewers, and databases or ticketing systems

• Ability to follow detailed written procedures exactly and to document your work

• Very precise, disciplined and detail-oriented: you take pride in work that is done right and recorded properly

• Able to work on your own and finish tasks on schedule

Nice to have

• IPC certification: J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721 (rework/repair) or IPC/WHMA-A-620 (cable and harness)

• Experience with automotive, robotics or other vehicle electronics

• Familiarity with ESD-safe work practices

• EV / high-voltage safety awareness

• Associate degree or technical certificate in electronics, or equivalent hands-on experience

Work Environment

• On-site in Austin, split between the electronics lab and the vehicle/robot fleet area

• Flexible full-time schedule, coordinated with the team

Metalenz is developing next-generation sensing systems for consumer electronics with metasurface technology. As an intern on the software team, you will help develop applications that make use of our meta-optic camera systems. You will work with novel polarization imaging systems that require creative approaches to image processing and sensor integration. A successful candidate will be able to design, implement, and deploy software for testing and tuning these systems and for leveraging these systems in customer-facing applications.

What you’ll do

 - Design and implement software that make uses of our unique camera hardware

COMPANY OVERVEW:
Analytic Partners is a global leader in commercial measurement and optimization, turning data into expertise for the world’s largest brands for almost 25 years.
 
Our holistic approach to decisioning is powered by our industry-leading platform and team of experts, who help leaders make better decisions, faster – unlocking business growth and creating powerful customer connections.
 
With clients in 50+ countries and global offices across New York City, Miami, Dallas, Dublin, London, Paris, Singapore, Shanghai, Munich, Sydney, Melbourne, Charlottesville and Denver, we’re growing fast. And we’re looking for top talent to join us in shaping the future of analytics.
 
To learn more about what we do, visit analyticpartners.com, and see why we’re recognized as a leader by  The Forrester Wave™: Marketing Measurement & Optimization, Q3 2023 Report. 

POSITION & TEAM OVERVIEW:
• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

• Must be willing to commit to minimum 6 months for this internship

• Position: Data Science Co-Op FY27 (6 or 8 month Co-Op Program)

• Starting Date: January 2027

Analytic Partners Science Team develops algorithms and technologies using the mathematical framework to address business challenges analytically. The algorithms and technologies then feed into Analytic Partners’ analytical engines! The Science Team is an integral part of R&D Group who is the core of Analytic Partners software as a service platform. The team is comprised of motivated individuals that do exceptional work. They face challenges together and they win together. As a Data Scientist Intern, you’ll collaborate with a fun and agile team to research, architect, implement, test, and continuously deliver new features and products to our company and clients! You also have opportunities to work with clients to develop customized models and solutions to address their business challenges.

Why participate:

• This would be a great opportunity if you are eager to apply quantitative analysis theories and techniques you learn at school to real-world solutions and you’re passionate about working with data.

• You will thrive in our collaborative work environments and grow personally and professionally.

• You will be challenged to harness innovation and are constantly looking for ways to improve.

Participants will:

• Creatively apply science methodology and techniques solving real-world problems to generate business impact.

• Conduct Data Science methodology research and derive novel analytical solutions to expand company solution capabilities and options.

• Work closely with cross function business teams on client engagement and implementation Discover and address users’ pain points to enhance AP analytics platform. 

YOU WILL OWN & COLLABORATE ON:

• Conduct data analysis using various tools and techniques.

• Assist in documenting model specifications and implementation details.

• Assist team members in developing and implementing statistical, ML and AI solutions, models, and algorithms.

• Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE YOU WILL NEED:

• Minimum: 

• Solid technical skills in probability & statistics, machine learning and optimization algorithms.

• Proficient in Python and SQL.

• Set up and maintain Python environments, including virtual environments, dependency management, and package installations.

• Familiarity with version control systems like Git.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, great work ethic, sense of ownership and intellectual curiosity, desire, and ability to collaborate in a team environment.

• Preferred: 

• Implement common machine learning algorithms from scratch (e.g., linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, k-means clustering, Bayesian Regression)

• Linux and R skill set are a plus.

ELIGIBILITY:

• Undergraduate and graduate students graduating between 2027 – 2028

People: We value our people, customers, and partners
Passion: We love what we do
Growth: Unlimited growth means unlimited potential
 
AP is a customer-focused, team-oriented organization where innovation and results are rewarded, and individuals can chart the course of their own careers.
 
As a woman founded and led company, this has meant supporting a meritocracy where everyone has opportunities to achieve their best and ensure we foster an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion. In practice this means we will not only work to recruit a diverse workforce, but also maximize the full potential of all of our people. You can read more about our commitment to DEI here
 
Additionally, Analytic Partners participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defense capability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Robotics Engineers contribute to delivery of vehicle perception and planning capability integrated into our products. This includes systems analysis, sensor selection and integration, perception architecture and implementation, motion planning, health management, behavior analysis, simulation and test infrastructure, and interfaces with lower- and higher-level systems. We expect Robotics Engineers to demonstrate end-to-end ownership of their projects, contributing as a member of a team to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

• Implement trusted safe navigation, collision avoidance, and situational awareness systems that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment

• Implement scalable sub-systems including sensor processing, perception, tracking, motion planning, health management, anomaly detection, simulation, testing fixtures, and vehicle interfaces

• Contribute to the development of existing software components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines

• Utilize advanced techniques in computer vision, sensor fusion, and machine learning to enhance perception and planning capabilities of Anduril vehicles

• Conduct thorough testing and validation of perception and planning algorithms through development and use of simulation and analysis of data from real-world experiments, including evolving the data analysis tooling

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers, to ensure effective system integration and testing

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Ability to complete a 16 to 24-week in-person co-op in one of our offices in winter 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experienced and proficient in C++ and/or Python software development

• Familiarity with autonomous vehicle hardware and sensors such as radar, sonar, LIDAR, and cameras

• Demonstrated knowledge of at least one of: computer vision, sensor fusion, SLAM, motion planning, machine learning

• Ability to collaborate with stakeholders to define and implement robust validation and verification strategies for perception and planning modules

• Experience with autonomous systems in the ground, air, maritime or space domains

• Experience with simulation tools and frameworks, such as Gazebo, Unity, or Unreal Engine, for algorithm validation and testing

• Knowledge of safety standards and certification processes for autonomous systems

• Familiarity with System Engineering concepts

US Hourly Range 
$42—$60 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. jobs.title: Optical Engineer Co-op
jobs.description:
Optical Engineer Co-Op

The Hardware Engineering Group at QuEra Computing is seeking strong candidates for an Optical Engineering Co-Op to serve as an individual contributor to the company’s mission of building state-of-the-art, manufacturable, and deployable neutral atom quantum computers. The Hardware Engineering Group plays a crucial role in accelerating the company’s technology leadership and translating the company’s scientific breakthroughs into products delivered to customers. To accomplish this mission, we are looking to hire a candidate with an undergraduate or graduate-level education in optics, optical engineering, or applied physics, paired with hands-on experience designing, building, and testing optical systems. The ideal candidate will combine a solid fundamental understanding of optics with strong laboratory skills and a desire to grow as an engineer within an enterprise engineering environment.

Key Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate with senior engineers and physicists to design, build, and test optical sub-systems, modules, and components supporting QuEra’s neutral atom computers through the full development lifecycle (R&D, productization, maintenance, and beyond).

• Execute hands-on laboratory work—assembly, alignment, cleaning, and characterization of optical systems—and contribute to engineering documentation, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Coordinate with the R&D/science team to support cutting-edge R&D and help translate scientific advances into the next generation of products.

• Assist with troubleshooting technical issues at company headquarters and, as needed, support off-site installations at customer locations (in coordination with the local support team).

Qualifications

• Work towards M.S. or PhD in optics, optical engineering, applied physics, or a closely related field (M.S. preferred).

• Experience designing, building, or testing optical and opto-mechanical systems in a non-academic (industry, national lab, FFRDC or similar) environment with enterprise engineering practices.

• Strong system-level design skills including Zemax simulation skills and CAD design skills (e.g. Inventor, Solidworks)

• Working knowledge in several of the areas of

• Free-space optics

• Fiber optics

• Modulators

• Electro-optics

• Lasers

• Optical system characterization and testing

• Strong hands-on laboratory skills (e.g. assembly, alignment, cleaning, testing)

• Experience contributing to the design of scientific instruments and apparatuses, or to bringing optical systems from concept to production.

• Excellent attention to detail, communication, and documentation skills

jobs.title: Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for an Internal Communications Manager to scale how Vercel gives every employee the context to make good decisions without waiting to be told. You’ll shape how the company hears from its leaders and from one another, so everyone at Vercel knows what we’re building, why it matters, and how their work moves our mission forward. You’ll oversee the channels, moments, and cadence that carry company news, and make sure what employees hear matches what the world hears.

This role is for someone who can build, run, and grow programs with rigor while continually bringing creative ideas to the table. You'll work closely with our communications leadership and cross-functionally with People, Finance, Legal, Design, and executives to ensure shared understanding among employees, so a company of builders can move as one.

You will report to our Head of Communications and will be located in our SF office with in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

What You Will Do:

Build the operating system

• Design and run the internal communications processes and calendar: All Hands, leadership updates, and team-level cadences, with a clear owner and format for each

• Decide what belongs in Slack, email, Notion, and video, document it, and get the company to follow it

• Stand up an internal comms metrics baseline (reach, read rates, All Hands attendance, pulse-survey sentiment) and report on it quarterly

Land major company moments

• Co-lead major announcements and organizational changes, owning defined workstreams and flagging sensitive issues, dependencies, and decisions that need leadership input

• Build the internal plan for company milestones: what employees hear, when, and from whom

• Write and edit content across internal channels, including leadership and org updates, Slack posts, FAQs, explainers, and All Hands materials

• Partner with Legal, People, and Finance on confidentiality guidelines for anyone who talks to the outside world

Incubate new programs

• Design and launch creative programs that educate and engage employees beyond the standard cadence

• Create structured opportunities for cross-department collaboration

• Train employees to be Vercel ambassadors: how to talk about the company, share our work, and represent us at events and online

• Use agents to surface the opportunities and news employees would otherwise miss: open roles, speaking slots, product launches, customer wins, and community moments

• Measure what lands, double down on it, and retire what doesn’t

Keep internal and external comms aligned

• Sit on the communications team’s approval processes so internal messages are reviewed to the same standard as external ones

• Make sure what employees are told matches what customers, press, and partners are told, in substance and in timing

• Partner with the People team on employer brand, onboarding content, and culture programs where comms is the lever

• Use employee questions and feedback to identify gaps in understanding and improve communication

About You:

• Have 5+ years of experience in internal communications, ideally with exposure to technical teams

• Bring strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and making information useful to the audience

• Have independently managed communications projects from planning through delivery, coordinating stakeholders and balancing competing deadlines

• Are curious about AI, research, and product development, and comfortable asking questions until you understand a topic well enough to explain it

• Build strong working relationships and can gather input, offer editorial guidance, and keep projects moving with busy partners

• Exercise sound judgment with sensitive information and ambiguity, and know when to make a decision independently or seek guidance

• Enjoy creating practical, repeatable processes that improve the quality and consistency of communications

• Respond well to feedback and adapt as priorities change

Bonus If You:

• Interest in and proficiency with using agents in your workflow.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $198,000 - $297,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. 

Disclosures:

• Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

• Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Capital Planning Data Assistant Co-op
jobs.description:
The MSBA is a quasi-independent government authority which grants funding for school building construction and renovation projects. The MSBA is pleased to provide a Co-Op opportunity to help students learn about data analysis in the building and construction industry. We are seeking a Capital Planning Assistant to provide a great opportunity to learn and gain skills in data analysis and construction. 
 
Students can expect to be challenged by their assigned projects, connect with other MSBA departments, 
feel valued by the MSBA community, while gaining experience and exposure to designer selection and 
interviews, preliminary design evaluations, and feasibility analyses. Not only will the selected Co-op learn 
about their day-to-day tasks through their specific work assignments, but they will have exposure to our 
organizational leaders and their teams through a series of internal Capital Planning Training. A Co-Op 
position at the MSBA provides exposure to a range of design and construction firms actively engaged in 
publicly funded school projects. Most Co-Ops move on to job opportunities within the industry and even 
return to MSBA when there is an open opportunity. 
 
The Capital Planning Data Assistant (Co-op) is a full-time opportunity (up to six months) that will 
temporarily provide support and assistance to Project Managers and Architects for Massachusetts public 
school construction projects. 
 
Responsibilities include data analysis, development of data tools, preparation of reports and
presentations, and support of technical review. The individual will also assist in developing tools for 
information gathering and analysis of databases associated with cost-tracking, construction cost 
estimates, capital project statuses and policy making, as well as potentially attending site visits. Interested 
students should possess basic knowledge of data analysis and/or previous experience in data.

Minimum Qualifications
• Must be enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a degree program leading to a Bachelor’s or Master's in an analytical based subject.

• Legally eligible to work in the U.S.
Preferred Qualifications
• Prior internship experience in a data or analysis based discipline

• Working knowledge of Tableau, MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with excellent attention to detail

• Ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment with multiple, competing priorities

• Ability to deliver results with limited direction and guidance and on tight deadlines; a self-starter

• Highly motivated and energetic

• Strong work ethic and tenacity

• Minimum 3.2 GPA
This job description is intended to be general and will evolve over time.  The description is subject to periodic updating.  At management’s discretion, the employee may be assigned different or additional duties from time to time. 
 
 
For more information and learn more of what we do, please visit the www.massschoolbuildings.org.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist & Marketing Effectiveness
jobs.description:
London – Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness
Multiple Start Dates available for Jan-March 2027 Start date
£40,500 + Bonus + benefits. 
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI-powered solutions. We are one of the world’s largest independent analytics and consulting firms, pioneering the use of AI and advanced data science for over 16 years. 
 
Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for long-term sustainable business performance
 
Key figures about Eki
·        400 data science experts globally 
·        1000+ diverse projects for more than 350 clients
·         5 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London, New York & Shanghai 
·        $1 billion in profits generated for our clients
·        7000 tons of CO2 prevented by our clients in 2022.
·        UK data company of the year 2023
·        Shortlisted Best STEM company to work for Women 2024
·        Voted Great Place to Work 2023 
·        Voted as a leader in “Marketing Measurement and Optimisation” by Forrester Wave 2023.
 
Here in the UK, at our London-based office, we engage across four business offerings: MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations, and AI4 sustainability. We have clients across multiple industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
 
About the Role 
As a Junior Consultant, this is an exciting opportunity to develop a dual profile – The data scientist and strategic consultant. You will be working on challenging data science projects with international clients across multiple industries, building bespoke marketing analytics solutions to answer our clients’ key questions. 
 
What you’ll be doing as a Junior Consultant:
·        Apply econometrics using data science and AI for business problems.
·        Understand clients’ business context and collaborate in a fast-paced environment.
·        Work on Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and Customer Analytics projects end-to-end, from gathering and analysing data to building statistical machine learning models and delivering presentations.
·        Work on 1-3 projects across global markets and industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
·        Contribute to Ekimetrics R&D to support the development of new methodologies and build data Engineering/Architecture capabilities in the office.
·        Contribute to Eki.Life culture initiatives, well-being and help drive our CSR commitments 
 
This is a great opportunity to join a growing, international pioneer in data science that will empower you to have an immediate impact from the beginning. At Ekimetrics, we thrive on accelerating growth for ambitious individuals. A Junior Consultant can expect to develop significantly in a short period while consistently delivering exceptional, high-quality results for our clients.
 
About You
Ekimetrics is seeking individuals who can wear 2 hats – the data scientist and the strategic consultant. You will most likely be a recent graduate with internship experience or early in your professional career.
 
What you need to succeed:
·        A degree in Data Science, Economics or a similar analytical field (e.g. econometrics, statistics, mathematics, or other quantitative degrees like Engineering, Data Science, etc.)
·        Prior experience (academic or professional) in data analysis/ modelling / advanced analytics or ML.
·        Experience with programming languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki. 
·        Capacity to work and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.
·        Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
·        Interest in Data and Marketing to make an impact for businesses
·        Ability to work within an inclusive and diverse team to deliver innovative solutions. 
·        A passion for joining a small team and a keen interest in personal learning and development.
·        Demonstration of behaviours that support our values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission, and Pleasure.
 Additional Requirements:
·        Must be able to work on-site a minimum of 2 days a week in London, UK (Hybrid)
·        Good sense of humour! 
 
Working for Eki
 
Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! Our London team is growing (65+people). We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success.
 
As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:
·        Competitive Compensation + individual & company y bonuses
·        Continuous Learning and development opportunities with Eki.Academy, training programs and certifications
·        Hybrid working (Minimum 2 days a week in the office)
·        20 days a year Work from Anywhere
·        25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays + additional days for tenure)
·        Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services
·        Group pension scheme
·        An emphasis on work-life balance and a strong company culture
·        Eki. Anniversary gifts for every year of service
·        Opportunities to develop a dual profile in data science and strategic consulting.
·        Opportunities for international mobility
·        Cycle to Work Scheme
·        Wellbeing support, Gym and retail discounts & 50% off runners need! 
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We encourage entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values which serve as pillars in our work and attitude. 
 
Follow our Ekimetrics’ values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure.
 
Ekimetrics is an equal opportunities employer committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, creed, religion, nationality, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military veteran status, current employment status, or any other legally protected categories, subject to applicable law.


Interview process
1. Online Hacker rank - May contrain Python coding
2. HR interview
3. Assessment with a consultant
4. Case study Assessment
5. Final interview with a Manager

Risk Modeling Intern
jobs.description:
At Enact, we understand that there’s no place like home. That’s why we bring our deep expertise, insightful offerings, and extra mile service to work every day to help lenders put more people in homes and keep them there. 

We’re looking for a Risk Modeling Intern in Raleigh, NC to join us in fulfilling our mission while utilizing our values of excellence, improvement, and connection. In addition to the multiple weekly events attended by all interns, you’ll work alongside industry experts for a 12-week internship beginning May 17, 2027. You will work with the risk modeling team to help answer business questions and improve the predictive modeling process using both traditional modeling techniques and machine learning.

THE PROGRAM 
Enact’s Internship Program provides an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on experience in achieving business results while developing technical and professional skills. The internship program is a critical component of Enact’s talent pipeline as we look to interns to provide cutting edge ideas and skills that will drive business success. 

Enact invests time, energy, and resources to create a worthwhile experience for interns. Interns work on meaningful business projects, but beyond that, they will network directly with leaders throughout the company (all the way up to the CEO), attend teambuilding events with their internship cohort, connect with the community through volunteer opportunities (both on-site and off-site), and attend professional development workshops. It’s a unique internship experience that helps interns develop a network of peers and mentors who act as a source of constant engagement and guidance during the internship. 

LOCATION
Enact Headquarters, Raleigh, NC – Hybrid Schedule

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Design, create and implement advanced analytics and forecasting models to optimize business processes; provide insights for decision making using Machine Learning and traditional statistical modeling
• Use large datasets to develop and perform exploratory data analysis and build models using structured and unstructured data to guide business decisions
• Communicate the models and methods in a logical and understandable manner for non-analytical business users and model governance teams

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
• Undergraduate junior or First year graduate student in a quantitative research field such as: Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Demography / Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Quantitative Social Sciences, Epidemiology, Engineering, etc.
• Experience in applying machine learning algorithms to data
• Previous coding experience in Python, R, SAS or a related language
• Ability to communicate complex ideas to a variety of audiences
• Desire to analyze and interpret data in the insurance, banking, or financial services industries
• Preference for candidates pursuing degrees in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, and Finance; all majors are considered, given strong work or project experience
• Minimum GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Exposure to insurance, banking, or financial services industries
• Knowledge on cloud data services such as Snowflake, AWS.
• Experience with Structured Query Language

(Nasdaq: ACT), operating primarily through its wholly owned subsidiaries, is a leading publicly traded U.S. private mortgage insurance provider, offering borrower-centric products that enable lenders and other partners across the U.S. to help people responsibly achieve and maintain the dream of homeownership.

By empowering customers and their borrowers, Enact seeks to positively impact the lives of those in the communities in which it serves in a sustainable way. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, we play an active role in supporting a prosperous Triangle community. We strive to create an environment where employees can bring their full, authentic selves to work to help each other and their customers.

WHY WORK AT ENACT
• We bring innovative thinking to the situations at hand
• We seek out and incorporate diverse views to strengthen our outcomes
• We work on challenging and rewarding projects

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description:
WisdomTree is seeking a Quantitative Research Intern to support the development and evaluation of systematic investment strategies. Working closely with the Research team, the intern will apply financial data, statistical methods, and programming skills to investment questions relevant to new and existing WisdomTree products.
The intern will contribute to ongoing research initiatives under the guidance of the team, with opportunities to propose and explore independent research ideas. The role also provides exposure to the practical application of machine learning, AI, and analytical tools in asset management.

Key Responsibilities
• Support the Research team in developing and testing investment hypotheses, with opportunities to pursue an independent research project.

• Analyze financial datasets to investigate investment signals, evaluate strategies, and assess market behavior.

• Review academic and industry research to identify ideas for replication, extension, or application to WisdomTree’s investment strategies.

• Build and test quantitative models in Python, applying statistical and machine learning methods where appropriate.

• Collaborate with the team to assess the robustness, economic relevance, and limitations of research findings.

• Contribute to research tools, data workflows, and analytical processes.

• Document research methods and present findings and recommendations to the Research team,
Qualification & Skills
• Academic background in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Strong Python programming skills, including experience with pandas, NumPy, or similar data analysis libraries.

• Foundation in statistics and experience applying quantitative methods through coursework, research, or independent projects.

• Strong interest in financial markets, systematic investing, and empirical research.

• Ability to formulate hypotheses, critically evaluate results, and communicate conclusions clearly.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with a research team.
Benefits for this Role:
WisdomTree offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial security and overall well-being of our employees. Benefits include:
·       medical, dental and vision coverage with multiple plan options;
·       health savings and flexible spending accounts;
·       employer-paid life, disability and business travel insurance; 
·       401(k) plan with company match; 
·       flexible paid time off;
·       educational reimbursement programs;
·       wellness and fitness activities;
·       paid parental leave; and
·       volunteer time off
 
 
All such benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of WisdomTree’s benefits plans and policies.

jobs.title: Risk Modeling Intern
jobs.description:
At Enact, we understand that there’s no place like home. That’s why we bring our deep expertise, insightful offerings, and extra mile service to work every day to help lenders put more people in homes and keep them there. 

We’re looking for a Risk Modeling Intern in Raleigh, NC to join us in fulfilling our mission while utilizing our values of excellence, improvement, and connection. In addition to the multiple weekly events attended by all interns, you’ll work alongside industry experts for a 12-week internship beginning May 17, 2027. You will work with the risk modeling team to help answer business questions and improve the predictive modeling process using both traditional modeling techniques and machine learning.

THE PROGRAM 
Enact’s Internship Program provides an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on experience in achieving business results while developing technical and professional skills. The internship program is a critical component of Enact’s talent pipeline as we look to interns to provide cutting edge ideas and skills that will drive business success. 

Enact invests time, energy, and resources to create a worthwhile experience for interns. Interns work on meaningful business projects, but beyond that, they will network directly with leaders throughout the company (all the way up to the CEO), attend teambuilding events with their internship cohort, connect with the community through volunteer opportunities (both on-site and off-site), and attend professional development workshops. It’s a unique internship experience that helps interns develop a network of peers and mentors who act as a source of constant engagement and guidance during the internship. 

LOCATION
Enact Headquarters, Raleigh, NC – Hybrid Schedule

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Design, create and implement advanced analytics and forecasting models to optimize business processes; provide insights for decision making using Machine Learning and traditional statistical modeling
• Use large datasets to develop and perform exploratory data analysis and build models using structured and unstructured data to guide business decisions
• Communicate the models and methods in a logical and understandable manner for non-analytical business users and model governance teams

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
• Undergraduate junior or First year graduate student in a quantitative research field such as: Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Demography / Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Quantitative Social Sciences, Epidemiology, Engineering, etc.
• Experience in applying machine learning algorithms to data
• Previous coding experience in Python, R, SAS or a related language
• Ability to communicate complex ideas to a variety of audiences
• Desire to analyze and interpret data in the insurance, banking, or financial services industries
• Preference for candidates pursuing degrees in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, and Finance; all majors are considered, given strong work or project experience
• Minimum GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Exposure to insurance, banking, or financial services industries
• Knowledge on cloud data services such as Snowflake, AWS.
• Experience with Structured Query Language

Enact Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACT), operating primarily through its wholly owned subsidiaries, is a leading publicly traded U.S. private mortgage insurance provider, offering borrower-centric products that enable lenders and other partners across the U.S. to help people responsibly achieve and maintain the dream of homeownership.

By empowering customers and their borrowers, Enact seeks to positively impact the lives of those in the communities in which it serves in a sustainable way. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, we play an active role in supporting a prosperous Triangle community. We strive to create an environment where employees can bring their full, authentic selves to work to help each other and their customers.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and all hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

WHY WORK AT ENACT
• We bring innovative thinking to the situations at hand
• We seek out and incorporate diverse views to strengthen our outcomes
• We work on challenging and rewarding projects

jobs.description:
What you'll need:
• A degree in computer science, engineering or another STEM field. 

• 0–2 years of experience; internships, co-ops and research.

• You built projects, where you integrated AI as a part of your SDLC (internship, research or hackathon entry) that you can walk us through in depth: what worked, what broke, and what you'd change.

• Hands-on Claude Code basics. 

• Strong programming fundamentals in Python or TypeScript. 

• Curiosity and speed of learning — you pick up unfamiliar subjects quickly and ask good questions, especially about how real businesses work. 

• Good commication skills - ability to explain complex technical subjects to non-engineers

• Willingness to spend real time learning a client's job before you write code. It's the most unusual part of this role, and the most valuable.
Great if you have:
• Cloud basics: AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, CI/CD AI/ML coursework or foundations.

• Comfort with ambiguity — our engagements start open-ended by design Interest or coursework in financial services, insurance, healthcare or asset management.

• Data pipelines or SQL; classical ML or MLOps (PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow); infrastructure-as-code.

• Open-source contributions, hackathon projects or public writing on applied AI.

• Claude certification or AWS certification.
What you'll learn:
• How to deploy LLM and agentic systems into regulated production — banks, insurers, health systems.

• How to build evaluation harnesses: defining what "working" means, then measuring it.

• Cloud delivery on AWS Claude Code in production, working toward Claude certification.

• A real business domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset management.

• How to work with clients: their operators, engineers and executives.
Your first 90 days:
• Foundations — onboarding into our Blueprints, our delivery stack (Claude Code, AWS) and how we build evals, plus a primer on your first client's industry. 

• The seat — join an engagement with your senior FDE. Shadow the operator, then do the work yourself. 

• Your first piece — own a scoped part of a production system, with code review and your senior FDE beside you.
What you'll do:
• Take the seat — learn a client's function from the inside, and help redesign it alongside your senior FDE and the Forward Deployed Executive.

• Build — ship production code for LLM applications, agentic workflows, and retrieval and extraction pipelines.

• Build the evaluation harness before the feature — define what working means, then measure it.

• Take systems to production on AWS, and feed what you learn back into the Blueprint.

• Grow into ownership — your team is measured by the client's business results, not by hours. Drive adoption, because a system nobody uses hasn't shipped — and build credibility with the client's engineers and operators.
What you'll get:
• A senior FDE paired with you on every engagement, a named mentor accountable for your growth

• Regular feedback and a clear path to Forward Deployed Engineer.

• Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare.

• Real production experience in regulated industries most early-career engineers never see.

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions.

• Full-time model.

• Unlimited Vacation policy.

• Generous health, vision, and dental insurance.

• 401(K) matching plan.

• Salary baserange $120-145k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data.
How we hire:
• Intro conversation — your background and what you want to do.

• One live engineering session — a real problem in your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude); autocomplete and agentic coding tools are off.

• The learning session — we describe an unfamiliar business function. Talk us through how you'd learn it, what you'd ask the person who does it, and what you might build. No LLMs for this one. Team conversation.
