Media AI Software Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact: 
Join Intel's Datacenter Media Software team as a Software Engineering Undergraduate Intern and work where real-time media meets AI. Our team builds software that moves, processes and understands video, audio and voice on Intel Xeon platforms. This includes the open-source Media Transport Library for SMPTE ST 2110 broadcast media over IP, an optimized voice and speech codec SDK, and AI tools and agents that analyze and search video and audio. In this role you will help develop, optimize and deploy these solutions for broadcasters, telecom providers and cloud media services. This is an exceptional opportunity to gain hands-on experience, develop your technical expertise and explore long-term career possibilities in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.

Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design, development and optimization of media software, from high-performance network transport and speech codecs to AI-based video and audio analysis.
• Build and integrate AI tools and agent workflows for media understanding, such as transcription, object and event detection, and semantic video search.
• Measure and improve performance and efficiency on Intel CPUs, GPUs and Ethernet NICs.
• Strengthen software quality through test automation, conformance and performance testing, fuzzing and CI pipelines.
• Contribute to open-source projects and work with internal product teams and external collaborators.
• Keep learning and apply new skills to advance projects in line with Intel's business objectives.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.
• Comfortable working in C and Python, and writing Bash scripts. You don't need to know everything, but you should be ready to jump into unfamiliar code and work out how it works.
• Hands-on experience with Linux, including the command line and building and debugging software.
• Understanding of modern software development practices, including code reviews, CI (e.g. GitHub Actions workflows), test automation and AI-assisted programming.
• Basic knowledge of server and networking hardware (servers, network cards, switches, cabling), and willingness to set up and connect equipment in the lab.
• Basic knowledge of AI/machine learning.
• A resourceful, persistent problem solver: you take on topics you don't fully understand yet, look for creative ways around obstacles, ask good questions and keep going until you reach a solution instead of giving up.
• Ability to execute tasks in a disciplined, detail-oriented way.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with C++, or with writing and debugging GitHub Actions workflows.
• Practical experience with lab or homelab setups, such as configuring servers, NICs and switches, or troubleshooting network connections.
• Interest in or exposure to media technologies (video, audio, voice codecs, FFmpeg, GStreamer) or high-performance networking.
• Experience with AI applications such as computer vision, speech recognition or LLM-based agents.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented, dynamic environment.
• Effective communication skills for contributing to projects and exchanging ideas with cross-functional teams.

We invite you to bring your curiosity, drive and talent to Intel, where you will have the opportunity to grow, innovate and make a meaningful impact through your contributions.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact 
We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented undergraduate student to join our Linux Core OS Validation team as a system software engineering intern. In this hands-on role, you will contribute to the design, testing, and optimization of Linux Kernel testing, gaining invaluable exposure to real-world engineering challenges. Your work will directly impact product quality and innovation, helping build and validate solutions that support Intel's technologies and platforms. 

Business Group 
The Linux Core OS Validation team is part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a business unit focused on delivering innovative technologies that power data centers and cloud computing solutions globally. This team ensures the reliability and performance of Intel's platforms by validating system software, optimizing cross-stack solutions, and driving advancements in Linux-based environments. Join a collaborative and forward-thinking group dedicated to supporting the broader Intel mission of delivering world-class solutions for enterprise and cloud customers. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Analyze and interpret test results from validation runs, identifying meaningful patterns, issues, and regressions. 
- Collaborate with team members to debug software failures and validate solutions across various testing environments. 
- Contribute to the development and optimization of automation tools using C/Bash/Python to improve test result analysis and reporting efficiency. 
- Work with open-source frameworks and tools for system software validation and metrics reporting. 
- Support the enhancement of CI/CD pipelines, particularly in areas related to system software validation across diverse hardware configurations. 
- Participate in code reviews and team discussions to drive improvements in validation tools and processes. 
- Engage with Linux-based environments, gaining familiarity with command-line operations and scripting.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Enrollment in a Bachelor's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience in system software engineering gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training. 
- Proficiency in C/Bash/Python programming and basic Linux command-line operations. 
- Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail in interpreting test results. 
- Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical findings clearly. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience with version control systems, such as Git, and familiarity with pull request-based workflows. 
- Knowledge of test automation frameworks and tools for software validation. 
- Familiarity with kernel drivers, hardware validation, or low-level software testing methodologies. 
- Enthusiasm for contributing to open-source projects and collaborative development. 

If you're ready to dive into system software validation, automation, and hands-on engineering in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply today to join Intel's Linux Core OS Validation team.

Adobe's Student-Athlete Micro Internship Program is focused on giving athletes a unique opportunity to gain valuable skills and work on real-world projects. As an Adobe intern, you’ll put your smarts and creativity to work on business-critical projects, you’ll be mentored by the top talents in your field, and you’ll get all the credit when you dream up our next big thing. Our SAMI Internship Program is 8 weeks long (May 24th, 2027 - July 23rd, 2028) and part-time (25 hours per week).

The Adobe Sales Academy is a multi-phase world-class accelerated sales program built to take top sales talent from a Sales Development Rep (SDR) to an Enterprise Field Account Executive (AE). With multiple locations in North America, this program is crafted to see you grow, develop and succeed. At Adobe, we want to create the next generation of sales professionals, and that starts with you!

SDRs are responsible for nurturing inbound leads through the early stages of their buyer journey and uncover qualified opportunities to be handed over to the Field Account Executive. This includes target market penetration, calling on CXOs, senior-level executives, following up on marketing-generated leads, webinar and event follow-up, and more. 
• Generate and nurture viable high-quality inbound leads. You will be responsible for aspects of the Adobe product solutions including the Marketing, Creative and Document Clouds. 
• Maintain proactive relationships with all partners associated with respective opportunities. 
• Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets. 
• Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet our core values and culture.

• Consistent over-achievement in past positions 
• Strong curiosity about technology, self-motivated, and driven by results

jobs.title: 2027 Intern - Emerging Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture & Emerging Technology team is part of Digital Employee Experience (DEX). We explore what’s next for how people work and turns the most promising ideas into something real. Our incubator looks at AI, data, and new ways of working to figure out what Adobe should build, test, and bet on next!

As an Emerging Technology & Innovation Intern, you will bring the perspective of someone entering the workforce just as it is being reinvented. You will own a prioritized emerging-tech challenge end-to-end: frame the problem, research it, generate ideas, prototype the strongest one, and present your findings to senior leaders. We will agree on the specific challenge together at the start of your internship so that it reflects the most relevant questions at that time and your own strengths and interests.

This is a role for an ideas person who is curious about where technology is headed, thinks in terms of people and problems rather than tools, and is eager to make ideas tangible. You will work alongside a team spanning architecture, AI, and incubation. You'll receivewit mentorship and visibility you rarely get this early in a career!

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.

What You'll Do
• Research emerging technologies and trends in AI, data, and the future of work, and assess which matter most for Adobe
• Use design thinking to frame problems, interview employees and partners, and uncover unmet needs
• Generate and evaluate ideas, and make a clear case for the ones worth pursuing
• Build quick, lightweight prototypes using AI tools, low-code approaches, or mock-ups to test ideas and make them tangible

jobs.title: Software Engineer - 3D Graphics
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

At Mach9, Digital Surveyor turns massive LiDAR datasets into precise CAD deliverables, automating work that currently takes surveyors and engineers weeks. Making that possible in a browser requires a 3D engine that can render tens of millions of points while supporting CAD-grade picking, clipping, snapping, and measurement. You'll work directly on that engine and the tools built on it.

This role is ideal for an early-career engineer with a strong foundation in 3D math who wants to work on a real production renderer, not a demo.

You'll do well here if you enjoy digging into difficult technical problems and building software that stays fast and reliable on large, messy real-world datasets. When the right approach isn't obvious, you'll research how others have solved similar problems, test your assumptions, and choose a practical solution. Our engineers are trusted to own their work and drive meaningful outcomes.


WHERE YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Build 3D tools that surveyors use to inspect point clouds and create precise engineering drawings

 - Extend our point-cloud renderer and GPU picking system

 - Solve geometry problems behind clipping, snapping, construction planes, and camera controls

 - Find and fix performance problems that appear with large real-world datasets

 - Improve the shared rendering and interaction systems behind our CAD tools


WHAT YOU BRING

 - A strong foundation in 3D math and spatial reasoning, including transforms, planes, and projections

 - Experience building software through coursework, personal projects, internships, or full-time work

 - The ability to read and change code you did not write

 - Attention to correctness and performance

 - Sound judgment about when to refine a solution and when to ship it

 - Experience with TypeScript and browser graphics, or comparable experience writing performance-sensitive graphics code in a statically typed language

 - The initiative to investigate problems, ask useful questions, and finish what you start


BONUS EXPERIENCE

 - WebGL, GLSL, Three.js, Cesium, or another real-time graphics system

 - Point clouds, geospatial data, or large-coordinate rendering

 - Experience applying geometry, spatial algorithms, or numerical methods to open-ended problems with noisy data and real-world tradeoffs

 - CAD, mapping, visualization, robotics, or game-engine projects





ABOUT MACH9

Mach9 is transforming civil infrastructure design with AI-powered geospatial tools. Our platform accelerates the creation of engineering deliverables from raw data, cutting manual drafting time by 96×. Trusted by global leaders in engineering and construction, we're backed by Y Combinator, Quiet Capital, and top founders and executives from Cruise, Autodesk, Adobe, and DoorDash.

We believe the needs of a startup benefit from an in-person culture. The team works out of our office in SoMa, with the flexibility to work from home when needed.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Inference
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.


THE ROLE

Our foundation world models have to run fast enough to control robots in the real world, and efficiently enough to support large-scale research. As an Inference Infrastructure Engineer Intern, you'll work with our infra and research engineers to make model inference faster and more efficient across the stack, from data pipelines down to GPU kernels. You'll own a scoped, high-impact project end to end, ship it into our production or research workflow, and present your results to the team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Profile and benchmark inference for large video and world models to find bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory.

 - Apply and evaluate inference optimization techniques like quantization and low-precision inference, step distillation and sampling acceleration for diffusion-style models, attention and caching optimizations across frames, model compilation, and graph-level optimizations.

 - Make data movement and processing more efficient: video decoding and preprocessing, input pipelines, host–device transfer, caching, and storage/IO paths that feed inference and training.

 - Write and tune GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for performance-critical operators, and integrate them into our inference stack.

 - Build tooling and benchmarks that let the team track performance regressions and improvements reliably.

 - Work with researchers to turn promising ideas into production-quality infrastructure.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need all of these. Strong depth in any one of the areas below is enough to apply:

 - ML inference optimization: hands-on experience making deep learning models run faster or cheaper, e.g. quantization (INT8/FP8), pruning/distillation, operator fusion, mixed precision, or compilers and runtimes such as torch.compile, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or TVM.

 - Data efficiency optimization: experience speeding up data loading and preprocessing pipelines (especially video or other high-bandwidth sensor data), cutting IO and memory overhead, or improving data/compute utilization in ML systems.

 - GPU kernel optimization: experience writing or tuning GPU kernels in CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or similar; familiarity with the GPU memory hierarchy, occupancy, and profiling tools (Nsight Systems/Compute, PyTorch profiler).


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++.

 - Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals and at least one framework (PyTorch preferred).

 - Comfortable reading performance data and reasoning about trade-offs between latency, throughput, memory, and accuracy.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with video model inference is a huge plus, e.g. optimizing video generation, video diffusion, or world models, or real-time video understanding pipelines.

 - Research experience in systems or ML, e.g. publications or substantial research projects (MLSys, OSDI/SOSP, CVPR/ICCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, or similar).

 - Experience with real-time or latency-critical inference, e.g. on robots or edge/embedded accelerators.

 - Experience with multi-GPU inference (tensor/sequence/pipeline parallelism).

 - Contributions to open-source ML systems projects.


WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - A real project with measurable impact on robots operating in the real world.

 - Mentorship from experienced infra and research engineers.

 - Access to modern GPU compute for experiments.

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description:
PROGRAM OVERVIEW

The ClickHouse PhD Research Internship Program offers doctoral students the opportunity to pursue ambitious research alongside ClickHouse Labs researchers and engineers working on some of the most interesting challenges in databases, systems, and data infrastructure.

Research interns join ClickHouse Labs for approximately 10-12 weeks to explore meaningful research questions, develop new ideas, and investigate technologies that have the potential to advance both the broader research community and the future of ClickHouse.

The program is intentionally designed around research collaboration. Interns are paired with experienced researchers and have the opportunity to pursue work that aligns with their academic interests, ongoing research, and areas of interest within ClickHouse Labs. In some cases, an internship may build on research, a prototype, or a system the student has already begun exploring at their university.

We believe the strongest research relationships extend beyond a single summer. Interns may continue their work after returning to their university through academic research, open-source contributions, publications, or other forms of collaboration. Where there is a strong mutual fit, an internship may become the beginning of a longer-term relationship between the researcher, ClickHouse Labs, and the broader academic community.

During their internship, researchers will have the opportunity to work closely with ClickHouse Labs, engage with ClickHouse's open-source technology and engineering community, share their findings, and contribute to the intellectual life of the broader research community.

Program length: 10-12 weeks, with flexibility based on academic calendars and research needs

Typical timing: Summer, beginning approximately June 1

Locations: Opportunities available across the US and Europe, subject to role and employment requirements. Remote first.

Research environment: ClickHouse Labs

Internship format: Research-focused, mentor-supported, and shaped around areas of mutual research interest

Compensation: commensurate with experience, a monthly stipend will be paid




RESEARCH AT CLICKHOUSE LABS

ClickHouse Labs explores ambitious ideas at the intersection of databases, distributed systems, data infrastructure, and the broader systems research community.

We believe some of the most interesting advances in these areas happen through close collaboration between industry and academia. ClickHouse Labs brings together researchers and engineers to explore new ideas, investigate challenging technical problems, and connect academic research with real-world systems at scale.

Research interns are an important part of that community. Interns have the opportunity to bring their own research interests and perspectives into ClickHouse Labs while working alongside researchers and engineers who are deeply engaged with both the practical challenges and open research questions shaping the future of data systems.




PROGRAM GOALS

 1. Identify exceptional PhD researchers working in areas directly relevant to ClickHouse.

 2. Give researchers the opportunity to work on meaningful, open-ended problems with ClickHouse Labs.

 3. Build long-term relationships with researchers and academic institutions.

 4. Encourage continued research and open-source contributions after the internship.

 5. Create opportunities for co-authored papers, thesis advising, or other academic collaboration.

 6. Increase ClickHouse's visibility within the database and systems research community.

 7. Publish and share meaningful research outcomes through the ClickHouse website and other appropriate channels.


WHAT MAKES THE PROGRAM DIFFERENT

This is intentionally not a highly structured engineering internship and should not detailed planning. ****But the high-level problem area and expectations should defined several months before the internship begins. This flexibility is intentional and allows ClickHouse Labs to respond to:

 - Emerging research questions

 - Current ClickHouse priorities

 - New academic research

 - Interesting systems or database prototypes

 - Work candidates have already completed

 - Opportunities to apply new research ideas to ClickHouse

The goal is to identify researchers whose work is already closely aligned with areas ClickHouse cares about and then determine the most valuable research problem to pursue together.




CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are looking for exceptional PhD students conducting research directly relevant to ClickHouse and the broader database/systems space.




IDEAL CANDIDATES

 - Currently pursuing a PhD in computer science or a closely related field

 - Conducting research in areas relevant to ClickHouse

 - Demonstrated research excellence

 - Strong database systems, distributed systems, hardware, or related technical background

 - Has demonstrated ability to independently pursue complex research questions

 - Ideally has prior experience with ClickHouse open source but not required**.**

 - Has research, prototypes, or publications that could translate into meaningful work with ClickHouse

 - Interested in continuing research beyond the internship

 - Potential interest in open-source contribution and academic collaboration


CANDIDATE SELECTION PHILOSOPHY

The strongest candidates will be researchers whose work is specifically relevant to what ClickHouse Labs wants to explore.

A candidate who has already:

 - Worked with ClickHouse

 - Built a relevant database or systems prototype

 - Published research in an area relevant to ClickHouse

 - Explored a technical problem ClickHouse is interested in

may be significantly more valuable than a candidate with an otherwise impressive academic profile but no meaningful connection to our research areas.




RESEARCH AREAS & PROJECT SCOPE

Unlike an engineering internship program, specific projects do not need to be defined when recruiting begins.

Research projects may emerge from:

 - A candidate's existing research

 - A recent academic paper

 - A prototype or system the candidate has developed

 - An emerging ClickHouse Labs research priority

 - An opportunity to test or extend an existing research concept within ClickHouse




IF THIS IS RELEVANT AND EXCITING TO YOU, PLEASE APPLY!


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice for our Privacy Statement.

OUR MISSION

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.




ABOUT BRAIN CO.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.




WHY NOW

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

At Brain Co., new-grad engineers contribute to real production systems and see their work deployed at global scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AI Platform Engineer at Brain Co., you’ll help build the backend services and shared capabilities behind our AI products. You’ll solve technical problems, develop reliable software, and collaborate with Product and ML teams to bring AI applications to enterprise and government customers.

This full-time, entry-level role is designed for candidates completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027. You’ll turn cutting-edge AI into systems that important institutions can depend on, taking ownership of clearly scoped projects involving APIs, distributed services, and developer tooling. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, with support through code reviews, design discussions, and ongoing collaboration.


WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Design and build backend services and data pipelines that power Brain Co.’s AI products. Own scoped projects across implementation, testing, and maintenance, with guidance from experienced engineers.

 - Build tools that accelerate AI product development, including ML experiment tracking, artifact management, and automated training and evaluation pipelines.

 - Help build reliable systems for enterprise and government customers, with attention to testing and handling common failure cases.

 - Design modular, reusable components and clean APIs (REST, gRPC). Use profiling to improve application latency and throughput.

 - Partner with engineering, Product, and ML teams to build shared platform capabilities that remove bottlenecks and reduce the time it takes to ship new AI products.


YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

 - Expect to complete a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field in Spring 2027.

 - Have solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and databases, with familiarity with API design and testing.

 - Are comfortable writing and debugging code in at least one language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, Java, or C++.

 - Have built a backend service, API, data-intensive application, or developer tool through an internship, research, coursework, or a personal project.

 - Are curious about how systems work under the hood and eager to learn distributed-systems concepts such as consistency, failure handling, retries, and idempotency.

 - Care about building intuitive, well-documented, and maintainable APIs and shared tools for internal ML and product teams.

 - Enjoy breaking down open-ended problems into clear technical designs, reasoning from first principles, and communicating your ideas.

 - Take ownership of your work, care about its quality over time, and actively seek feedback and guidance when needed.

 - Eligibility: Completing a bachelor’s degree in Spring 2027.

 - Competitive full-time compensation and benefits

 - Support and feedback from experienced platform engineers

 - Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally

 - Meaningful ownership from day one, with room to grow alongside the team

 - Daily lunches (if onsite)

jobs.title: AI Resident
jobs.description:
Why RoboForce

RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability.

The AI Residency Program

The AI Residency Program is designed for exceptional early-career researchers and engineers who want to tackle some of the hardest problems in robotics and AI. Residents will work alongside a deeply technical team on core challenges in embodied physical intelligence, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, World Models, World Action Models, and 3D foundation models, as well as the full stack of real-world learning—from efficient data collection systems and simulation to reinforcement learning and deployment on physical robots.

This is a hands-on residency for people who want to do ambitious work with real consequences: building learning systems that connect perception, reasoning, and action in service of capable, deployable robots. What makes this program different is the direct connection between research and real-world deployment. Residents work with actual RoboForce robots, iterate quickly between simulation and physical execution, and contribute to systems designed for real use.

The problems are hard, the standards are high, and the goal is to build systems that matter outside the lab.

Research Focus Areas

As an AI Resident, you may contribute across several core areas:

• 
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for general-purpose robotic behavior

• 
World Models for predictive modeling, planning, and long-horizon decision-making

• 
World Action Models for jointly modeling action and environment dynamics

• 
Simulation and sim-to-real transfer for scalable training, evaluation, and data generation

• 
Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and policy optimization for embodied agents

• 
Multimodal learning across vision, language, proprioception, force, and action

• 
Learning systems for manipulation and real-world embodied interaction

What You’ll Do

• 
Conduct research and build systems for embodied physical intelligence

• 
Develop and evaluate methods in VLA, World Models, World Action Models, simulation, and RL

• 
Design and run experiments on robotics tasks involving perception, planning, control, and long-horizon behavior

• 
Build training and evaluation pipelines for large-scale embodied learning systems

• 
Work closely with research and engineering teams to move ideas from prototype to real or simulated robot platforms

• 
Explore how multimodal foundation models can improve robot capability in real deployment settings

• 
Contribute to technical reports, internal research discussions, and, where appropriate, publications

Basic Qualifications

• 
PhD student, recent graduate, or early-career researcher/engineer in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• 
Experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

• 
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools and agentic development workflows to prototype, iterate, and build quickly

• 
Ability to implement, debug, and evaluate research ideas in a fast-moving environment

• 
Strong engineering judgment, including the ability to validate, refine, and productionize AI-assisted code

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Rich hands-on experience in robotic manipulation, mobile manipulation, or industrial robotics

• 
Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating multimodal or embodied models

• 
Experience with World Models, action-conditioned prediction, model-based learning, planning, or control

• 
Strong hands-on experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, Habitat, or similar systems

• 
Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or post-training for robotic policies

• 
Experience working with real robot hardware, data collection systems, evaluation workflows, or deployment pipelines

• 
Demonstrated technical initiative through research, open-source contributions, or high-impact engineering work

Compensation and Resources

Duration:

• 3–6 months, full-time

Compensation: 

• $10,000 monthly salary

Benefits:

• 
Company-provided lunch and dinner, a fully stocked kitchen, and team events

• 
Premium fitness center membership covered by the company

Resources: 

Access to large-scale GPU clusters and production-grade infrastructure, with dedicated support to enable fast, uninterrupted experimentation on ambitious robotics and AI workloads

Job Description: 
About bp
bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition.

Our internships
Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 11-week summer programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business.

Role and responsibilities
We are looking for a motivated and curious geophysics summer intern to join bp’s Imaging R&D team in solving complex subsurface imaging challenges. Together we form an integral part of bp’s Upstream R&D group in Technology, which comprises expert geologists, reservoir engineers, petrophysicists, as well as geophysicists. Collaboration on integrated research and development, technology deployment, and specialist technical services is delivered through focused squads. We work on pressing business needs across bp: from resource access and renewal, through resource development to production and long-term subsurface monitoring.

Working with our Imaging R&D team and high-performance computing centre, you could help address tough subsurface challenges through advanced seismic processing, imaging and characterisation using bp’s dedicated supercomputing resources.

The precise nature of your role will be defined by your skills and research experience as well as the needs of the business, although your responsibilities could include: 
• Delivering high-quality and high-impact seismic imaging research and solutions, in close partnership with bp’s asset teams and business groups.
• Developing and deploying computationally demanding computer codes and workflows for geophysical data processing, modelling, inversion, and analysis, as an individual contributor and/or as part of a flexible and often self-organizing squad.
• Working collaboratively with both computational scientists in bp’s Centre for High-Performance Computing, other imaging specialists and geophysicists.

As part of bp, you will also be able to take part in additional activities outside of your role, whether it be supporting local community initiatives, our bp business resource groups, and you are given the encouragement and time to participate. 

In addition, demonstrable numerical skills would be advantageous for any geoscience candidate applying for a role in bp. Specifically, proficiency with analysis methods to interrogate large datasets for geophysical insight and applying high-level languages for fast prototyping such as Python and development environments like Jupyter. 

We are particularly interested in PhD candidates conducting research in relevant areas, for example:
• Time-series analysis, data processing and imaging, and signal and noise separation
• Inverse problems, optimization theory, signal/image processing and statistics
• Probabilistic methods of inversion and subsurface characterisation
• Numerical simulation of wave phenomena and wave equations in realistic media, coupling with deformation and/or fluid-flow modelling
• Blended acquisition, deblending, novel signal reconstruction and sparse inversion
• Active and passive methods for subsurface monitoring and surveillance
• Geophysical acquisition techniques, survey design and operations

If you have a curious mind, aptitude for solving complex problems, and openness to learn and adapt then you should apply.

About the Role
As an Analog Design Engineer Intern at Analog Devices (ADI), you will work alongside experienced engineers on the design, simulation, and characterization of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs). You will contribute to the development of circuits such as amplifiers, filters, data converters, and clocking solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with industry-standard design and simulation tools including Cadence and SPICE.
In this role, you will support circuit design, simulation, layout, silicon validation, and laboratory testing activities, developing practical skills across the full IC development lifecycle. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to learn from industry experts and contribute to cutting-edge semiconductor products used in a wide range of applications.
Key Responsibilities
• Assist in the design, simulation, and verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits, including amplifiers, filters, and data converters.
• Use industry-standard simulation tools such as SPICE and Cadence to analyse circuit performance and validate design concepts.
• Support IC layout activities with a focus on performance, matching, reliability, and manufacturability.
• Perform laboratory measurements and characterization using equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power supplies.
• Collaborate with senior engineers to debug design issues, optimize circuit performance, and support silicon bring-up activities.
• Document design results, test findings, and technical analyses in a clear and structured manner.
Required Skills and Qualifications
• Fundamental understanding of analog circuit design, including amplifiers, filters, biasing circuits, and feedback systems.
• Basic knowledge of mixed-signal IC design principles and the interaction between analog and digital circuitry.
• Familiarity with circuit simulation and modelling using tools such as SPICE or equivalent EDA tools.
• Understanding of CMOS technologies and semiconductor device fundamentals.
• Exposure to integrated circuit layout concepts, including matching, parasitic effects, and layout best practices.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Your impact
Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?

At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something bigger—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.

Our Industrial Placement Programme

Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.

Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.

During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.

What you will do as an Industrial Placement Detector IC Design Engineer
You will support the design and development of our world leading infrared imaging products for use in remote sensing and thermal imaging applications including earth observation, border surveillance, search and track systems and laboratory equipment. 

You will be introduced to utilising state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, acceptance and product support.
You will interface with customers (internal and external) on many factors within the design and liaise closely with Engineers from all other disciplines including Mechanical, Software, Systems, Supportability and Design Integrity. 

This role will be based within our mixed-signal IC design team, where you will gain experience working at transistor, cell or block level schematic and layout as well as testing of devices within the lab. 

Key Areas of Responsibility
• Support design, simulation and verification of circuit blocks
• Support transistor level layout of circuit blocks
• Support characterisation of circuits in the lab to retrieve circuit measurement data
• Assist in the progression of IC design development activities
• Support test set-up and automation of data acquisition

Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required
Qualifications
All of our Industrial Placement roles require you to be currently studying an electronics biased degree including modules covering topics such as digital design, analogue design and signal processing with experience of using PCB design and simulation tools is highly desirable.

Security Clearance 
Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 

Why join us 
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
• Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
• Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity. 
• Tailored perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more. 
For a full list of our company benefits please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/company-benefits 

We are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people, communities and our customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know. 

Start your extraordinary career – apply now!

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Software Developer I

Introduction to the team
Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A technology platform powered by data and machine learning helps us build secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

As a Software Development Intern, you will join a collaborative engineering team and contribute to meaningful work that supports Expedia Group’s global travel marketplace. You will learn from experienced engineers, build practical software-development skills, and gain exposure to the full lifecycle of delivering reliable technology.

In this role, you will:
• Contribute to well-defined software features, enhancements, and bug fixes with guidance from experienced engineers.
• Write clear, maintainable code and automated tests using established team practices and patterns.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, team ceremonies, and demonstrations of your work.
• Collaborate with teammates and partners to clarify requirements, share progress, and incorporate feedback.
• Investigate issues, use debugging tools, and help improve the reliability, quality, and usability of software.
• Document what you learn and share knowledge through technical notes, walkthroughs, or presentations.
• Explore development tools, including artificial-intelligence-assisted tools, thoughtfully and responsibly while validating suggestions against requirements, security expectations, and team standards.

Minimum qualifications
• You are pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; or you have equivalent practical experience.
• You have experience with at least one modern programming language through coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions, or previous work experience.
• You understand fundamental software-development concepts, including data structures, algorithms, version control, testing, and debugging.
• You are able to work collaboratively, ask clarifying questions, communicate clearly, and receive and apply feedback.
• You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to learn new technologies and engineering practices.

Preferred qualifications
• Experience building a project that includes multiple components, services, or user-facing functionality.
• Familiarity with application programming interfaces, databases, cloud platforms, or continuous integration and delivery.
• Experience using Git or a similar version-control system.
• Exposure to automated testing, observability, accessibility, security, or performance considerations.
• Interest in travel technology and in building products that serve millions of travelers and partners.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. jobs.description:
About Marvell 
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Rack Scale Switch Chip Validation team validates and delivers the high-performance switching silicon and system-level solutions used inside modern AI and cloud data center racks. As an intern, you will contribute to day-to-day engineering work such as running emulation and verification tests, debugging silicon and hardware issues, troubleshooting switch performance and efficiency, and writing scripts to automate workflows, all alongside experienced engineers. Your work will support the team's efforts to deliver reliable, high-bandwidth, low-latency switch products that are a key part of Marvell's data infrastructure portfolio. These products help customers scale AI workloads and enable the next generation of data center networking.
What You Can Expect
Support post-silicon validation of high-speed switch silicon under the guidance of senior engineers.
· Assist in developing, documenting, and executing test plans and test cases for switch chip validation.
· Support lab-based silicon bring-up and run unit tests on hardware and firmware functionality, including emulation and verification environments.
· Help collect and analyze high-speed signal and link data (such as eye diagrams, jitter, and BER) using lab test equipment.
· Assist in debugging silicon and hardware issues, and in troubleshooting switch performance and efficiency.
· Use diagnostics, software tools, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers to help isolate the root cause of failing tests.
· Write and maintain scripts (for example in Python) to automate test execution, data collection, and result reporting.
· Document test results, findings, and debug progress, and present them to the team.

What We're Looking For
· Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028
· Foundational understanding of digital logic, computer architecture, and high-speed I/O concepts such as SerDes and PCIe or Ethernet protocols.
· Basic hands-on lab experience through coursework, research, or projects, such as hardware bring-up, testing, and debug.
· Familiarity with common lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or BERTs.
· Programming or scripting experience in Python, Perl, or a similar language.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with a willingness to learn.
Preferred/Plus:
· Coursework or project experience with PCIe, Ethernet, or other high-speed interfaces.
· Exposure to the physical and protocol layers of high-speed interfaces (for example PHY, PCS, MAC).
· Experience with emulation, simulation, or verification environments.
· Ability to read board schematics and layouts.
· Familiarity with signal integrity concepts such as eye diagrams, jitter, and BER.

28 - 56, $ per hour.
The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Data Expert, Integration & Delivery, Data Capability, DDC,
Computational Sciences Center of Excellence

Location(s): Welwyn office based

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Opportunity

The Data Expert, Integration & Delivery is responsible for the support of the data operations for discovery and research data management and automation solutions. This role serves as a team member to support data management, solution architecture and cloud implementation needs of the department. 

• Work closely with the Automation teams, bioinformatics, and machine learning scientists to facilitate data ingestion, acquisition, and storage. 
• Contributes to technical/functional initiatives related to modernization of data management and curation solutions.
• Contributes to the design of solutions that modernize and improve the efficiency of FAIR data management and curation processes, providing business impact.
• Is proficient in at least one scientific or data domain, and is able to provide support to initiatives based on that knowledge.
• Provide data management support for integrated systems.
• Contribute to and deliver Data architecture vision and standards in conjunction with data users, engineering capabilities and key stakeholders. 
• Fosters a OneRoche data-centric mindset within the team, advocating for data standards, governance, and FAIR principles.
• Contributes to data strategies that ensure data is ready for AI/ML (AI data readiness).
• Contributes to tactical efforts that enable data quality tracking and policy compliance.

Program Highlights:

• 13 months at full time (37.5 hours per week) paid placement. 
• Program start date is 1st July 2027. 
• Contribution to challenging and impactful business projects.
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are:

jobs.description:
The UVA Library StatLab is seeking a Graduate Student Associate for the spring 2027 academic semester and beyond. 

The StatLab Associate will work with the Library’s full-time statisticians to provide statistical consulting and support to UVA students and faculty across disciplines, write online instructional articles, and contribute to data analysis projects (internal to the Library or in collaboration with other organizations) as they arise. 

• Consultations: Help students and faculty develop research designs, identify appropriate statistical analyses, interpret results, carry out data wrangling, and implement models in supported software environments.
• Instructional articles: Contribute to StatLab articles, a collection of highly-viewed articles and tutorials explaining common statistical methods, statistical programming, data visualization, and more. 
• Library projects: The Library has increasing needs for data science expertise to analyze its own data, prepare new open-source materials, and collaborate on projects with other groups. StatLab contributes to these projects, and Associates will be brought in as new projects develop. 

Associates will be paid hourly at $24/hour for up to 10 hours a week for 15 weeks each semester, with the possibility of project-based work over the summer.

• Graduate student standing

jobs.title: Machine Learning Science Intern
jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

By joining the Expedia Group 2027 Global Summer Internship Program as a Machine Learning Science Intern you’ll fully integrate into our inclusive community and gain a well-rounded experience of life at Expedia Group. Our global program offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to business-critical projects by developing your skills through tailored learning and training, providing ongoing support, and offering insightful intern-specific events to build knowledge and community. We’re building a more open world. Join us. 
 
Internship Program Highlights: 
• Start strong from day one: Your first week is designed to help you build connections, settle in quickly, and get set up for success through cohort orientation, support, and structured onboarding. 
• Learn the skills that matter: You will take part in role-specific technical and professional skills learning, delivered through a mix of in-person and virtual sessions, to help you build confidence and capability from the start. 
• Work on meaningful projects: Interns join Expedia Group teams and contribute to real business priorities and workstreams. At the end of the internship, you will showcase your work to team members and senior leaders. 
• Grow beyond your day job: Our Learning Series includes interactive workshops focused on professional development and workplace skills, with topics such as communication and presentation skills. 
• Gain exposure to leaders: Through our Leadership Series, interns take part in exclusive events with Travel Leadership Team leaders to hear about their career journeys, learn more about the business, and ask questions directly. 
• Build your network and community: Participate in regular social events designed to help you build relationships, experience Expedia Group culture, and have fun along the way. 
• Receive dedicated mentorship: Every intern is paired with a mentor to support development, learning, and career exploration throughout the program, while also helping expand your network across Expedia Group. 
• Feel supported throughout the experience: Interns receive ongoing coaching and guidance from managers, team navigators, and a dedicated Emerging Talent & Careers contact, so there is always a strong support system in place. 

In this role, you will: 
Travel is so much more than simply reaching your destination. Along the way you will make an immediate impact on reimagining the way people search for travel with our awesome team by inventing brand-new techniques to power global travel for everyone, everywhere. From building pipelines and prototyping new ML models with A/B testing, to applying new techniques to services that run tens of thousands of requests per second, there is no shortage of opportunities for technical innovation at Expedia Group – the sky’s the limit! 
• Design, prototype, and evaluate machine learning models under the guidance of more experienced machine learning scientists, contributing to well-scoped research and product-focused experiments. 
• Implement clean, maintainable model training and inference code using standard software engineering practices, including basic unit testing, code reviews, and reproducible experimentation workflows. 
• Participate in low-level system design, API design, and data modeling for ML-powered features, learning how to translate product and data requirements into robust, production-aware ML solutions. 
• Explore, analyze, and prepare data using fundamental statistical and ML techniques to improve model quality, robustness, and fairness, including feature engineering and basic error analysis. 
• Collaborate with peers, mentors, data scientists, engineers, and product partners to understand problem spaces, define success metrics, and iterate on ML solutions that deliver measurable impact across different product domains. 
• Learn to work with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes within defined guidance and scope. 
 
Who You Are: 
We know that many potential candidates can be hesitant to apply for a job if they aren't sure that they meet all the criteria shared. If you meet all the criteria labelled ‘Must’ and are interested in this role, we encourage you to apply! 
• Must be available to commit to the full program dates: 21st June – 27th August 2027 
• Must be graduating with a PhD degree in a technical subject (e.g. PhD degree in a technical, or analytical-related, subject such as Computer Science (with focus in areas like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Data Mining, Data Science), Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Operations Research, Electrical & Computer Engineering, or any Engineering degree) between December 2027 and July 2028 
• Must be willing to relocate to city of job location if outside commuting distance 
• Must have Python and/or Scala, SQL knowledge

• Helpful to have experience with programming, statistical, and querying languages like Python, R, SQL/Hive, Java 
• Helpful to have understanding of distributed file systems, scalable datastores, distributed computing and related technologies (Spark, Hadoop, etc.); implementation experience of MapReduce techniques, in-memory data processing, etc. 
• Helpful to be familiar with cloud computing, AWS specifically, in a distributed computing context 
• Helpful to be able to effectively communicate and engage with a variety of partners (e.g., internal, external, technical, non-technical people) 
• Helpful to have Java, R, C++, Hive, Hadoop, Microsoft SQL Server knowledge 
 
What We Offer: 
Successful candidates will receive a competitive compensation package including the benefits below and others:

• Hybrid Work Policy 
• Travel discounts 
• Opportunity to receive a full-time permanent offer after graduation and 12 months of customized support from our Emerging Talent & Careers team 
• Community support through Expedia Group’s Inclusion Business Groups 
• Relocation support (if eligible) 
 
Next Steps: 
Apply now! After you apply, eligible candidates will be encouraged to take a skills based online assessment as the first step. Depending on the role profile, selected candidates will then progress to a functional online assessment focused on skills for that role. Candidates who are invited to the final stage will have the opportunity to meet members of our team through two virtual interviews covering both technical and behavioral skills. These interviews will also be a chance for you to learn more about us. 
Our Emerging Talent & Careers team will be there to support each step of the way, for more information you can visit our careers page.

jobs.title: SMS Pathfinding Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Department Overview
The Storage and Memory Systems (SMS) Pathfinding team explores next-generation memory, storage, and interconnect technologies that will enable future AI, cloud, and high-performance computing systems. The team evaluates emerging architectures, advanced memory solutions, and innovative technologies to help shape Micron's long-term product strategy and technology roadmap.

Position Overview
As an intern in the Storage and Memory Systems (SMS) Pathfinding group, you will research photonic interconnect technologies that enable disaggregated memory architectures for future AI systems. You will develop modeling and analysis tools to evaluate silicon photonic memory fabrics, assess system-level tradeoffs, and explore how optical interconnects can improve memory capacity, latency, bandwidth, energy efficiency, and scalability for next-generation AI workloads.

Responsibilities
• Develop parameterized photonic link budget and system-level models to evaluate optical memory fabrics, including lasers, modulators, waveguides, switches, photodetectors, and interconnect architectures.
• Analyze performance, latency, bandwidth, power efficiency, reliability, and scalability tradeoffs across photonic memory architectures and memory technologies such as HBM, DDR5, and LPDDR.
• Evaluate protocol and system-level impacts of CXL-based memory expansion and disaggregated memory architectures for AI workloads.
• Utilize AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve productivity, data analysis, technical problem solving, documentation, and decision-making.
• Calibrate and validate models using industry data, proof-of-concept platforms, simulations, and available measurement results.
• Collaborate with architects, researchers, and industry partners to communicate findings through technical reports, white papers, presentations, and architecture recommendations.

Minimum Qualifications
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through research, internships, academic projects, publications, or coursework in photonics, optical interconnects, computer architecture, memory systems, or related fields.
• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Photonics, Optics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline.
• Coursework or research experience in silicon photonics, integrated optical devices, computer architecture, memory systems, interconnects, or system design.
• Proficiency in Python and scientific computing tools for modeling, simulation, and data analysis.
• Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and collaborative problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with photonic link budget analysis, optical transceivers, optical communications, or photonic system modeling.
• Familiarity with CXL, PCIe, memory fabrics, memory expansion architectures, or large-scale system interconnects.
• Experience with photonic simulation tools such as Lumerical, GDSFactory, MEEP, SAX, Simphony, or similar platforms.
• Knowledge of AI infrastructure, AI inference workloads, GPU memory systems, memory pooling, or large language model architectures.
• Publications, research contributions, or hands-on experience involving photonic systems, optical networks, memory architectures, hardware characterization, or experimental validation.

jobs.title: Computer Vision/Robotics Intern
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! 
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. 
Job Description:
Parsons is now accepting applications for our Summer 2027 Computer Vision / Robotics Internship, supporting development of a new AI-enabled infrastructure inspection capability using drone data, 360° video, localization, and voice to transform how bridge and vertical structure inspections are captured and reported.
 
This internship offers an exciting opportunity to apply robotics and computer vision to real-world infrastructure, working side-by-side with an experienced mentor and a software intern. You will help integrate 360° cameras and SLAM/localization tools, map inspector motion on a simple bridge model, and prototype basic defect detection and visualization workflows.
 
What You'll Be Doing:
• Ingest and process 360° video, working with an off-the-shelf SLAM/localization SDK to estimate inspector position over time.
• Develop scripts and tools to map timestamps and poses to 3D locations on a simple bridge or structure model.
• Prototype basic computer vision routines (e.g., region-of-interest extraction, simple crack/rust/spall detection using existing models or APIs).
• Visualize inspector paths and defect points in 2D/3D for internal review and demos.
• Collaborate with a software intern and mentor to define interfaces between perception/localization outputs and the inspection data/reporting pipeline.
 
What Qualifications You'll Bring:
• Must be enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field at an accredited college or university.
• Strong programming skills in Python (and/or C++), with experience using libraries such as NumPy and OpenCV.
• Familiarity with SLAM, visual odometry, or robotics localization through coursework or projects.
• Comfort working with real-world sensor data (video, trajectories, etc.) and debugging noisy inputs.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
• A GPA of 3.0 or higher is desirable.
• Prior project or internship experience in robotics, computer vision, or perception is preferred but not required.

None

Overview:
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
 
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:
The purpose of this internship is to prepare students for entry into the business world by providing a thorough understanding of the various functions of the Zebra Technologies organization. The program is designed to provide students with experiences that provide insights into a career with Zebra. Students will be positioned for success with training and hands-on experiences, invited to social and development activities, and provided a professional mentor relationship.

Current Business Management is the analytics and operational backbone for Zebra’s product lines, turning sales, bookings, inventory and sell-out data into the forecasts, performance dashboards and insights that product, sales and finance leaders use to plan. The team builds data pipelines, run-rate sales forecasting models and AI-enabled tools that replace manual reporting and help the business anticipate demand and market shifts.

US Summer Internship Benefits:
Summer Fridays, As Applicable With Your Team
30+ Social and Professional Events in 12 Weeks
Global Immersion With Your Teams and Interns
Intern Allowance (when applicable)Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Core Project: Predictive Sales & Market Driver Analysis – build an automated analytics pipeline and Power BI dashboard that combines Zebra’s internal sales data with external market indicators to explain and anticipate sales trends.
• KPI Dashboard Development: Partner with stakeholders to design intuitive dashboards that track critical KPIs such as revenue, channel inventory and pipeline health, performance metrics and product trends in near real time
• Data Fusion: Combine internal sales records (bookings, inventory, sell-out) with external macroeconomic indicators and market trends to build a unified analytical dataset
• Predictive / Driver Analysis: Identify which market drivers most influence sales performance and support the team’s run-rate forecasting by surfacing leading indicators
• Requirements Gathering: Interview business users to understand their questions and translate them into clear technical dashboard and data requirements
• AI-Assisted Development & Quality: Use LLM tools (e.g., Gemini and Claude) to write, optimize and debug SQL queries and Power BI DAX, and validate data accuracy so automated reporting is robust and bug-free
• Final Presentation: Present the finished dashboard, key insights and recommendations to team leadership at the end of the internship.
 
This position requires hybrid work (3 days/week in office) in the Lincolnshire, IL office.
Required Qualifications:
• Current enrollment in an undergraduate degree program in Business Analytics, Management Information Systems or Data Science 
• Must have an anticipated graduation date between December 2027-2028
• Must be authorized to work in the US without requiring sponsorship now or in the future
 
Preferred Qualifications:
• Power BI; SQL (joins, filters, aggregation); advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query); introductory Python (pandas, numpy); LLM prompt engineering for SQL/DAX
• Strong translational communication, detail-oriented and logic-driven, and confident presentation skills
• Business acumen: Understands the key factors that drive business performance and can connect data and analysis to practical business decisions
• Quick learner: Demonstrates curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to quickly learn new tools, data sources, and business processes
