jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What you'll be doing
At CIBC, our Personal and Business Banking team is focused on making everyday banking simpler, smarter, and more seamless for our clients. As a Product Analyst Co-op, you'll support product management work as part of a squad in the Payments and Open Banking Crew by helping us better understand the client experience and identify opportunities to improve it. You'll map client and customer journeys step by step to uncover pain points, support the delivery of small projects and initiatives, and help document action plans that move work forward. You'll work closely with partners across the business to gather information, coordinate next steps, and support ongoing project activity. In this role, you'll gain hands-on experience contributing to meaningful work that informs future product enhancements and supports the team's broader priorities.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

Important information 
• We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills tests (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency, MS Office). Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us. 
• You must be currently enrolled in post-secondary education and returning to full-time studies to be eligible. However, you do not need to be in a registered co-op program to be considered for a role. 
• Please include your resume (no more than 2 pages), a cover letter (no more than 1 page), and your most recent unofficial transcript with your application. These should all be uploaded into the resume section of the application as one pdf document. 
• Duration of term: 4 months (January – April 2027) 
 
How you'll succeed
• Client journey mapping - Support the team by documenting end-to-end client experiences across payments products to identify friction points, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
• Project coordination - Contribute to small projects and initiatives by tracking actions, organizing information, and helping move deliverables forward.
• Stakeholder collaboration - Work with business partners and team members to gather input, document discussions, and support meetings and follow-ups.
• Product support - Assist with product management activities by preparing materials, organizing updates, and contributing to work that informs future initiatives.
• Documentation and analysis - Create clear, organized documentation, action plans, and working materials that help the team make informed decisions.
• Team contribution - Learn within a chapter and squad model, work closely with a mentor, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

Who you are
• You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems and making sense of information. You communicate detailed information in a meaningful way.
• You embrace and advocate for change. You continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.
• You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
• You can demonstrate experience in communication, stakeholder coordination, Microsoft Office Suite, and working with tools such as Jira and Confluence. It’s an asset if you have exposure to product management, payments, journey mapping, or financial services environments.
• You have a degree/diploma in business, commerce, finance, economics, technology, or a related field.
• You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.”

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential.
• We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive compensation, a banking benefit*, wellbeing support and additional offers such as employee and family assistance programs and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

• Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

*Subject to program terms and conditions

What you need to know
• CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com

• CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

• You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit

• We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency). 

• We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us. 

Expected End Date
2027-04-23
Job Location
Toronto-81 Bay, 25th Floor
Employment Type
Temporary (Fixed Term)
Weekly Hours
37.5
Skills
Collaboration, Microsoft Office, Teamwork

jobs.title: Seasonal Associate Intern - Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Who Are We Looking For?
We are seeking motivated Seasonal Associates with a foundation in programming and a passion for solving real problems using modern AI-enabled technology. The ideal candidate is eager to collaborate, comfortable learning quickly, and interested in applying GenAI tools (e.g., LLMs and prompt techniques) alongside core software and data engineering practices.
The position is fully remote from anywhere in the United States. At this time, we are unable to provide relocation or housing assistance for this internship.
Key Responsibilities
As a Seasonal Associate, Full-Stack Developer for the Chief Technology Office, you will:
• Support rapid prototype development using AI tools and AI frameworks
• Hands-on experience building lightweight front ends and back ends that allow stakeholders to interact with our prototypes
• Navigate responsible LLM usage, prompt design, and practical grounding patterns (such as grounding responses in authoritative client data)
• Collaborate with senior engineers and technology partners to integrate, test, and demonstrate capabilities in real workflows
• A key objective of this opportunity is to create a win-win engagement where you obtain a fresh perspective, new ways of thinking, and emerging AI skills to solve real challenges. The goal is to deliver work with measurable impact, and the intern may have the opportunity to present learning or deliverables to leadership before the internship concludes.
Minimum Qualifications
• By start date, a completed bachelor’s degree
• Acceptance/ enrollment verification, or at least 9 credit hours of completed graduate-level courses in computer science or a relevant discipline
• Candidate must be a US citizen or lawful permanent resident (Green Card holder), reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S. per contract requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
• Demonstrated interest, knowledge or early experience in using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT) for software development tasks
• Familiarity with at least one programming language (such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java)
• Familiarity with GenAI/LLM tooling — prompt frameworks, vector databases, modern LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI), or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
• Exposure to cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in data and systems thinking
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and applying them to real-world challenges

Bot and Third-Party Applications
Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

Working at ICF
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Work Authorization and Sponsorship All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.
 
Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.  

Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act. 

Candidate AI Usage Policy
At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.  

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  

Pay Range - There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. 

The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is:
$41,822.00 - $71,098.00

Nationwide Remote Office (US99)

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Delivery Manager, Front End Analytics, North America
__
As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience through various projects. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your skills by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.
 
The work model for the role is onsite/hybrid in Cary, NC

You will be mainly accountable for:
• Collaborating with various teams to support ABB’s operations, ensuring effective coordination and timely project completion within the defined timelines.
• Leveraging insights about customer needs and ABB’s offerings to identify suitable solutions for clients, leading to project results that meet customer expectations.
• Participating in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and other collaborative efforts.
• Seeking feedback and guidance from manager and team members to improve performance and skills.
• Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, connecting to multiple data sources to deliver actionable business insights.
• Develop and maintain Power Automate workflows to automate repetitive tasks and improve team efficiency.
• Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from Snowflake and other databases.

Qualifications for the role:
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master’s degree program in Data & Analytics, Data Science, Business, or related fields in the United States.
• Intern must have reliable transportation to and from the worksite.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now and in the future.
• Utilize critical thinking skills to analyze complex situations and develop strategic solutions.
• Effectively organize and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
• Exhibit the capability to manage several tasks at once while maintaining high standards of quality.
• Collaborate with team members to convey ideas, share information, and provide updates on project progress.

Why ABB? 
 
What's in it for you
 
We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

jobs.description:

Regular

Clearance Level Must Currently Possess:
None

Job Description:
Sponsorship is not available for this role. 
At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team. 

What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry? 
• GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind!  Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters.
• Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following: 
• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients.  
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge.  
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion. 
• Interact with GDIT leaders. 
• Participate in professional development. 

How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own 
Our Technical Intern, Estimation Associate summer intern, will work on a range of projects that ideally align with their interests. Projects and daily work include AI builds/testing (Agentic and Generative), Data Analytics and Metrics Ingestion and Analysis, scripting and automation builds/testing, and AI / labor modeling and tools. You’ll collect metrics, data, analyze the data, and provide data analysis reporting and clean data ready for ingestion, and use your scripting/coding skills and AI tools to build and test automated workflows and models. Your work will provide insights to help guide labor estimates and decision-making, statistical modeling and includes involvement in technical IT discussions, working with our CTO / technology teams as we tackle large Enterprise IT challenges.
You’ll have the opportunity to be part of the team as we continue to apply the power and efficiency of AI tools to our IT labor estimation processes and opportunities, bringing more to our customers’ missions every day. Come join and experience GDIT culture as we work together with honesty, trust, transparency and alignment.
The ideal intern will have good reliability and high integrity, strong attention to detail, passion for IT and supporting federal customer missions, good Excel experience and hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (M365 Studio or other tools). Additionally, the following: daily knowledge/experience with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, CoPilot, Gemini, etc.), training/application of data analytics, familiarity with Generative and Agentic AI, understanding of vibe coding principles, familiarity with scripting/automation, and a PASSION for IT Technology and desire or interest to support IT technology data analysis and IT Labor Estimation. Come spend your summer working with an experienced team supporting growth and programs, bridging the gap between technical solutions and labor/cost to deliver.

The Must-Haves 
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree program in computer science, IT, engineering, or other STEM field from a United States-based college or university.  
• Use/understanding of Microsoft Office products (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, and Teams) 
• Hands-on experience building out an Agentic AI workflow using tool like MS365 Studio
• Experience with or knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, vibe coding, and familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, Gemini, etc.) and their applications in IT processes.

What You’ll Need to Deliver Your Best Every Day 
• Attention to Detail, Creative Problem solving and interest in large complex IT program delivery (AI / ML, data centers, Cybersecurity, etc.) supporting federal customers
• Familiarity with both Generative and Agentic AI frameworks and applications.
• Knowledge or interest in exploring AI/ML coding and its relevance in AI-driven IT solutions.
• Experience using or building with AI tools (e.g. M365 Studio, ChatGPT, CoPilot, Gemini, etc.)
• Ideally experience with both Generative AI and Agentic AI tools
• Strong interest in IT technology – large complex Enterprise IT solutions (AI, data, data centers, cloud, networks, quantum, etc.)
• Interest in or experience with: data analysis, metrics and business/finance
• Good experience with MS Excel
• Interest in learning/doing estimation, risk analysis and parametric models
• Knowledge of statistical techniques 
• Knowledge of Python, Powershell or similar or other basic coding capability Experience working in a collaborative team environment. 
• Intuitiveness with an ability to identify and solve complex problems related to rapidly changing technology.  
• Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions 

The likely hourly rate for this position is between $25.50 - $34.50. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40

Travel Required:
Less than 10%

Telecommuting Options:
Hybrid

Work Location:
USA VA Falls Church

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:
Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identify Verification Process:
As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes. 
 
About our Work:
We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.

Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events atgdit.com/tc.

Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Aerospace Corporation is hiring an Embedded Undergraduate Software Engineer Intern for the Cyberspace & Mission Technology Department (CMTD) in the Information Systems and Cyber Division (ISCD) . This position will be full-time, onsite at our office in El Segundo, CA.
 
Job Summary
ISCD staff couple the latest in information system technologies, such as elastic compute clouds, containerization, microservices, real-time operating systems, and visualization frameworks, with expertise in cyber security, software architecture, software engineering, data science, Artificial Intelligence, process improvement, and software development to deliver responsive, resilient, high-performance software intensive systems to our Intelligence Community, DoD, and civilian customers.

CMTD is seeking an Undergraduate Embedded Software Engineer Intern to support its Embedded & Specialized Computing section. You will perform research and development activities towards innovative embedded prototypes in areas such as image and signal processing, accelerated computing, and AI/ML at the edge. You will provide design and implementation support to a wide range of customers, translating cutting-edge research into mission-critical space systems that advance next-generation satellite capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Develop embedded software solutions for evaluating novel processors and state-of-the-art on-board processing systems
• Rapidly prototype and test embedded software on diverse platforms including Linux-based SoCs, embedded GPUs, FPGAs, application-specific accelerators, microcontrollers, and other emerging processors
• Design and optimize algorithms for low SWaP embedded implementations across image processing, signal processing, and AI/ML application domains
• Work closely with Aerospace scientists to assess the radiation susceptibility of embedded processors and develop appropriate mitigations
• Present project status, technical findings, and technical demonstrations to your team and customer
• Learn and grow through new work opportunities, trainings, and mentorship from experienced staff

What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring
• Strong written and oral communication skills
• Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment
• Possess organizational, time management and project management skills
• Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need
• Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations

What You Need to be Successful
Minimum Requirements:
• Currently enrolled full-time in an accredited college/university program pursuing a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or related discipline 
• Availability to work full-time for a minimum of 10 weeks outside of university term and ability to return to a degree program full-time after completion of the internship
• Minimum GPA of 3.0
• Proficiency in at least one of the following areas: embedded systems design and development, software development for resource-constrained environments, edge AI/ML implementation, or FPGA design and development
• Proficiency in at least two of the following programming languages: C, C++, Python, FPGA design languages/tools (such as SystemVerilog, VHDL, or HLS frameworks)
• Experience with leading hardware platforms and tool suites (e.g., AMD/Xilinx, Altera, Microchip, ST Microelectronics)
• This position requires ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.
• Transcripts required
  
How You Can Stand Out
It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:
• GPA of 3.5 or higher
• Experience developing embedded software solutions for space, aerospace, or defense applications
• Proven ability to collaborate across hardware and software teams, especially on projects that bridge heterogeneous computing (CPU, FPGA, GPU) architectures
• Proficiency implementing AI/ML algorithms on embedded platforms utilizing frameworks such as LiteRT (TensorFlow Lite), TensorRT, Vitis AI, or similar
• Experience leveraging high-level synthesis (HLS) to accelerate and deploy algorithms on FPGAs
• Demonstrated experience developing and optimizing CUDA kernels for embedded GPU applications
• Active security clearance

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?
 
Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?
 
Join our innovating Internship Program
The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a Bachelors’ or Masters’ degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.
 
Partner with the best
You’ll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset.
You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes. as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.
 
As an Intern, you will be responsible for:
• Completing internal projects to deliver business outcomes and identify process improvement opportunities.
• Learning internal software and tools to support analysis, reporting, and project delivery.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams and interns to interact and network with global business leaders.
• Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained.
• Developing exceptional applications for our business
• Writing clean, scalable code using C#/Type Script programming languages
• Developing end-to-end applications using Angular/.net
• Developing technical interfaces, specifications, and architecture with strong attention to detail
• Applying software development life-cycle principles and methodologies such as Agile and Kanban, to continuously improve our code and processes
• Improving code quality and deployment processes, enhancing CI/CD pipelines undefined
• Working on all aspects of the software engineering discipline

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
• Be currently enrolled or recently graduated in a Bachelors’ or Masters’ level degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related programme.
• Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country.
• Demonstrate understanding of working with Back-End development frameworks such as C# / .net
• Demonstrate understanding of Front-End development frameworks such as Angular, React, Vue
• Display knowledge of Relational/NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB
• Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills.
• Have good interpersonal and leadership skills.
• Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.
 
Working with us
Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious, and collaborative. We're on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data, and science.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Intern/ Trainee/Apprentice

jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

.Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation. 
 
The Team 
Looking to join a strong Product team with a vision to build the future of transportation? At Arity, we are looking for a Product Management Intern eager to confront tough problems and collaborate regularly with engineers, customers, and stakeholders to drive creative solutions. 
Within the Product team, you’ll be helping to discover, deliver, and manage the products in Arity’s growing portfolio, as well as ensuring we are building the right products and defining KPIs to measure their success. Our purpose is to work collaboratively across functions at Arity to move forward the most impactful work for the organization. 
We’re looking for a dynamic new teammate who’s comfortable with change and ambiguity. You may be scoping out use cases of a new implementation at one moment, providing design critique the next, and then finishing up by building out a roadmap around a new feature. Above all, a Product Management intern at Arity should possess insatiable curiosity and high attention to detail. 
Want to join our team? Let’s chat! 
 
The Role 
Working closely alongside Product Managers, the Product Management Intern will contribute to the product vision, discovery, roadmaps, and backlog to maximize the customer value provided by Arity’s products. Product Management Interns in this role should also possess a strong desire to learn new skills and grow in their Product Management careers, actively participating in Arity’s learning culture and working with other members of the Product team to drive improvements. 
 
Responsibilities 
• Assist in the creation and maintenance of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with company goals and market trends. 
• Collaborate with design and engineering teams to translate product requirements into user stories, wireframes, and prototypes. 
• Assist in conducting market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and industry trends to inform product strategy. 
• Gather and prioritize feature requests from stakeholders and customers, balancing business objectives and technical feasibility. 
• Work closely with data analysts to analyze product performance metrics and user feedback, making data-driven recommendations for improvements. 
• Support the product launch process, including developing go-to-market strategies, coordinating with marketing teams, and ensuring successful product releases. 
• Act as a liaison between technical and non-technical teams, facilitating communication and ensuring clear understanding of product goals. 
 
Qualifications 
• Target Start Date: May/June 2027 
• Rising Junior/Senior student 
• Entrepreneurial with a strong inclination towards taking initiative and action 
• Understanding of Agile development methodologies and tools 
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence stakeholders. 
• Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to make informed decisions based on data.

jobs.title: Systems/Process Engineering Intern - Tapeout Operations
jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries 
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. 

Internship Program Overview: 
Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. 

Summary of Role: 
GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly skilled and motivated college intern to join our Tapeout Operations team. This internship offers hands-on experience in systems and process engineering within the semiconductor design and manufacturing flow, with a focus on process optimization, data analysis, and automation initiatives that enhance tapeout efficiency and quality. 
The intern will work directly with the Tapeout Operations team to develop automation supporting web- and Linux-based execution of the mask release process. The assignment provides exposure to leading-edge foundry electronic design automation (EDA) tools and tapeout flows, advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes, technology trends, and data analysis. 

Essential Responsibilities include: 
• Assist in documenting and analyzing tapeout workflows and process steps. 
• Support the development and improvement of automation scripts and tools for data handling, job submission, and web- and Linux-based mask release execution. 
• Collect and analyze process metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and propose scalable process enhancements. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, information technology, and EDA stakeholders. 
• Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for tapeout-related issues. 
• Help maintain and update process documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Other Responsibilities: 
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications: 
• Education – At least a sophomore at time of application and actively pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. 
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and be in good academic standing. 
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) 
• Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Prior related internship or co-op experience 
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
• Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. 
• Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Strong planning & organizational skills 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or other data analysis tools. 
• Experience with Linux/Unix environments. 
• Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl, or Shell). 
• Exposure to version control systems. 
• Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) is a bonus. 
• Basic understanding of semiconductor design or manufacturing processes is a plus.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Sierra Space Careers:
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. 

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role
Launch Your Future at Sierra Space 

Begin your career journey alongside the industry's most brilliant and innovative minds. At Sierra Space, interns engage with meaningful projects while developing the foundation for an exceptional career in aerospace and defense. Our early career professionals benefit from a distinctive experience—receiving dedicated mentorship while collaborating directly with recognized industry experts on real-world challenges aligned with their academic focus. Bring your knowledge and passion for learning, and we'll provide transformative experience. 

Summer Intern Academy: May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027.

The Sierra Space Summer Intern Academy runs for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027 for undergrad students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Participants work on meaningful projects, network with industry experts, and develop skills at one of our state-of-the-art facilities.
About You
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. 

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Join our team to design, build, and test software for spacecraft systems and mission tools. In this role, you will collaborate with development teams to write and debug code, participate in code reviews, and support projects involving artificial intelligence. You will gain hands-on experience with modern programming languages and the full software development lifecycle.

During your internship, you will: 
• Master essential business processes and procedures 
• Strengthen your technical expertise through hands-on application and expert guidance 
• Participate in our comprehensive program developed by our University Talent Acquisition team 
• Engage in cross-functional workshops and leadership sessions that provide valuable insights into our operations and Sierra Space's forward-thinking culture 
• Join us in our mission to build the next generation of space innovation and become part of the team that's expanding humanity's reach beyond Earth. 
 
Minimum Qualifications
• Actively enrolled in an undergraduate degree program.
• Expected graduation date between December 2027-June 2028. 
• Passion for solving problems by leveraging data and technology.
• Excellent written and verbal communication.
• Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment.
• Strong organization skills, detail oriented, and self-initiative.
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Participated in the 2026 Sierra Space Intern Academy.

Compensation:

Pay:
$32.00The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required. To conform to U.S. Government international trade regulations, applicant must be a U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce
 
About Sierra Space 
Headquartered in Colorado, Sierra Space is an industry-leading defense-tech space company. We design, manufacture, and deliver satellites, spacecraft and space subsystems including reusable spaceplanes, hypersonic technologies, propulsion systems, and infrastructure for the nation’s most critical missions. 
With more than three decades of space flight heritage, expansive classified and unclassified infrastructure and disruptive cutting-edge technology, Sierra Space is trusted by National Security, civil and commercial customers. Our flight-proven technologies advance our customers’ missions, including safeguarding our nation, protecting space-based assets, and enabling the next generation of space exploration and economic development. 

Sierra Space is dedicated to defining the new era of space defense, strengthening deterrence today and preserving freedom of action for generations to come. 

Elevate Your Career
At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. 
 
We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified. 

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

At Zillow, you’ll have the rare chance to shape the most significant moments of people’s lives - redefining how they buy, sell, rent, and finance homes.

For bold and hardworking people who thrive in an environment always in motion, Zillow is the place to advance your career, our company, and even an industry. We align our actions to our values and keep our consumers at the heart of every decision.

Here, you’ll be part of a team with a proven history of leadership and innovation that encourages new insights and gives you the keys to move them forward. Join us as we make our next big move, crafting a truly seamless real estate transaction experience for our consumers.
About the role
At Zillow, interns do meaningful work that contributes to the business from day one. Our nine-week summer internship program, running June through August, gives students the opportunity to bring their ideas and perspectives to real projects alongside Zillow teams. 

Interns build hands-on experience, connect with mentors and leaders, and take part in learning and community experiences with their intern cohort. Our 2027 internships are based in Seattle and follow a hybrid schedule, with interns generally working together in person Tuesday through Thursday. Eligible interns may receive a stipend to help offset summer housing relocation costs. 

As a Software Development Engineer Intern at Zillow Group, you will partner with people who are passionate about our product. Through mentoring from fellow developers, you will gain tremendous experience in multiple functional areas, setting the stage for a well-rounded computer science career. Work on real problems and ship your code.

• Work at one of our highly rated brands, enjoying the best of both worlds between a large company (stability) and a small startup (growth potential and impact)
• Opportunity to own and tackle sophisticated problems
• Work with highly accomplished teammates and craft your own path to achieving your career goals
• Competitive pay and benefits like: health benefits, intern-only events, speaker series, exposure to senior leadership, and many more

Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
The Vehicle Intelligence Theia Team at Motorola Solutions, responsible for License Plate Recognition (LPR) data processing and device management through the development and support of the Theia LPR Application Suite, is seeking a Software Engineer Co-op. Working alongside senior engineers, the successful candidate will contribute to developing scalable cloud solutions for secure LPR data distribution, implementing AI-driven capabilities within the Theia ecosystem, building edge-awareness features such as camera scene change detection, and establishing a Vehicle Intelligence Operations Notification system to enhance operational excellence and incident response.
Job Description
We are seeking a Software Engineering Co-op responsible for the development of Machine Learning and AI functionalities within the realms of Elastic Elasticsearch. In this role, you will work on integrating AI capabilities, machine learning features, and analytics tools into software solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and integrate Machine Learning and AI capabilities leveraging Elastic Elasticsearch functionalities.
• Write efficient scripts and queries using Elastic KQL and ESQL for data search, analysis, and retrieval.
• Build reporting and visualization tools using Elastic Kibana functionalities.
• Design and develop AI agents using the AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
• Implement clean, maintainable, and scalable code in Python and TypeScript.

Requirements:
• Knowledge of the NoSQL databases.
• Knowledge of Go programming language, desired but not mandatory.

Job Description:

About the Role
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineering Intern to work closely with experienced senior developers on a next-generation network management service.
As an intern, you’ll contribute to a focused engineering project that may involve systems software, automated testing, performance and scale analysis, or developer tooling.
A key part of the internship will be learning how experienced engineers use AI throughout the software development lifecycle. You’ll use modern AI coding tools to understand existing code, investigate problems, implement changes, troubleshoot failures, generate and improve tests, and analyze results.
Just as importantly, you’ll learn how to question and validate AI-generated work using tests, measurements, code review, and engineering judgment.
What You’ll Work On
Depending on project priorities, your work could include:
• Improving parity and behavioral testing that compares expected behavior across implementations.
• Testing how network management pipeline components work together, from incoming data through processing to stored or displayed results.
• Developing end-to-end test scenarios for realistic user, network, or device workflows.
• Measuring performance and scale and comparing results across configurations or implementations.
• Improving the tools and automation engineers use to build, test, troubleshoot, and validate software changes.
• Using AI to understand unfamiliar areas of the codebase, investigate defects, analyze logs and test failures, and propose potential solutions.
• Participating in code reviews, debugging sessions, and technical discussions with experienced networking software engineers.
Working in an AI-Driven Engineering Process
This internship is about more than using AI to generate code.
You’ll learn how experienced developers integrate AI into their engineering workflow:
Senior developer defines the problem and constraints → Intern works with AI → AI assists with analysis and implementation → Tests and measurements validate the result → Intern reviews the output → Senior developer provides technical guidance
You’ll learn how to provide AI with the right technical context, recognize when its suggestions are incomplete or incorrect, and use objective evidence to determine whether a change actually works.
The goal is to develop both AI fluency and strong engineering judgment.
Mentorship
You’ll work closely with a senior developer who will help:
• Define and scope your project.
• Explain relevant system behavior and architecture.
• Help you navigate an existing codebase.
• Guide your use of AI development tools.
• Review your code, tests, and technical conclusions.
• Help you understand the engineering trade-offs behind different approaches.
You won’t be expected to make product or architecture decisions independently. Instead, you’ll get first-hand experience seeing how experienced engineers approach complex problems and how AI can augment that process.
What We’re Looking For
You may be a good fit if you:
• Are pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Have experience programming and debugging software.
• Understand basic software development concepts such as testing, version control, and code review.
• Have an interest in networking, systems software, or distributed systems.
• Are curious about Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted software engineering.
• Enjoy investigating problems and understanding why something works or fails.
• Can communicate technical reasoning and findings clearly.
• Are comfortable questioning and verifying AI-generated suggestions rather than simply accepting them.
Experience with Rust, Linux, Git, networking, automated testing, containers, or AI coding tools is helpful, but not required.
What You’ll Learn
During the internship, you’ll gain hands-on experience with:
• AI-assisted software engineering.
• Working directly with senior software developers.
• Understanding and modifying a production-scale codebase.
• Network management and systems software.
• Automated and end-to-end testing.
• Performance and scale analysis.
• Debugging and root-cause investigation.
• Using tests and measurements to validate AI-generated software changes.
• Professional code review and engineering practices.
What Success Looks Like
A successful internship will deliver a useful, tested engineering improvement along with a clear explanation of:
• What problem was addressed.
• What changed.
• How AI was used.
• How the result was tested and validated.
• What was learned.
• What limitations or follow-up work remain.
The objective is not simply to generate more code with AI. It is to learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly within a disciplined software engineering process, while developing the technical judgment needed to produce software that engineers can understand, test, and trust.

jobs.title: System Software Engineer, Automotive Cybersecurity - Tegra Security Software
jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we invite hard-working new college graduates and early-career engineers to apply for our System Software Engineer, Automotive Cybersecurity role and join the HPSE Interface team in the United Kingdom. This is a remarkable opportunity to aid the creation and upkeep of software that delivers security services for NVIDIA's automotive platforms. You will examine sophisticated, low-level software and gain hands-on knowledge of how PKCS#11 functions within the DRIVE OS security architecture alongside hardware and software components. As you expand your system-level expertise, you will collaborate with global engineering teams to translate requirements into durable solutions for our customers. Engage throughout the software lifecycle, from development and deployment to validation, integration, release support, and issue resolution.

What you'll be doing

• Build your expertise in our HPSE security architecture and its interactions with hardware security, operating-system components, and other security services.
• Build, implement, test, debug, and maintain C-based software and interfaces for PKCS#11 and related security services within DRIVE OS and other deployments of the Tegra chipsets.
• Collaborate with software, hardware, system architecture, safety, security, quality, and customer-facing teams to clarify requirements and refine specifications.
• Contribute to investigating and resolving complex system, integration, and customer-reported issues; communicate technical findings clearly and help drive issues to closure, taking on greater ownership as your experience grows.
• Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; improve test automation and software quality.
• Participate in code reviews, design and build discussions, and documentation to ensure maintainable, secure, and reliable software.
• Contribute to development and release activities that follow applicable product lifecycle, safety, security, and quality processes.

What we need to see

• Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical area. The role welcomes new college graduates and early-career candidates with up to 4 years of experience following a Bachelor's degree or up to 2 years following a Master's degree. Responsibilities and ownership will reflect your experience, with opportunities to grow toward greater independence.
• Sound C programming and debugging skills; ability to write clear, reliable, and maintainable code, demonstrated through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional experience.
• Solid foundations in data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, and software engineering practices.
• A methodical and analytical approach, a willingness to learn complex systems, and the ability to work effectively with distributed cross-functional teams.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate on customer requirements.
• A proactive, quality-focused approach and a desire to learn and deliver in a safety- and security-conscious engineering environment, while exploring and adopting Agentic AI in disciplined and creative ways.
• Curiosity about the broader effects of our work. A desire to develop technical expertise alongside commercial awareness and learn to make sound technical and practical decisions.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

These are opportunities to showcase your interests and experience, not prerequisites; examples from coursework, personal projects, research, or internships are welcome alongside professional experience.

• Coursework, personal projects, internships, research or professional experience in Linux/QNX embedded systems, SoCs based on ARM technology, platform security, or device and driver connectivity.
• Python experience, particularly for test automation, tooling, analysis, or developer efficiency; interest in or experience with Rust for systems programming, secure software, or tooling.
• Knowledge of applied cryptography, PKCS#11, key management, hardware security modules, secure boot, roots of trust, trusted execution environments, or hardware/software security boundaries.
• Familiarity with automotive ISO 26262 functional-safety and ISO 21434 cybersecurity concepts.
• Exposure to or understanding of a disciplined product lifecycle (PLC) environment, including requirements, traceability, configuration management, verification, and release-quality practices; exposure to CI/CD, source control, code review, automated testing, and debugging of hardware/software integration issues.

jobs.title: Programmer Analyst 1
jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, you must attach a cover letter and resume to your employment application.

The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) at the University of Southern California is seeking a Programmer Analyst I to join our dynamic team. We are looking for a skilled and motivated individual who can contribute to projects within the Program on Global Aging, Health, and Policy (Global Aging Program).

The primary responsibilities of this position include writing, modifying, and adapting software applications using standard procedures and techniques. Performs limited analysis under direct supervision of more experienced programming staff. The position also includes the responsibility of constructing documentation of programming decisions and output to be communicated with the research public. The role also includes identifying the comparability of survey items across multiple years of a survey and between different surveys, and constructing documentation of this comparability. The position also involves close collaboration with internal and external programmers and researchers.

This is a grant funded, one year (renewable) fixed term position and hybrid work arrangement.

Key responsibilities:
• Develop, test, debug, and document code for new harmonization projects.
• Develop test data and routines required to test and revise application(s). Ensures application(s) is thoroughly tested before release and prepares reports of the test results.
• Designs analysis variables to answer research questions and communicates findings back to research teams.
• Prepare extensive documentation for harmonized codebooks in accordance with internal and external standards.
• Develop datasets, create tables, perform analyses, and otherwise participate in the production of publications in collaboration with researchers.
• Attend conferences as a representative of the Gateway to Global Aging Data.
• Give online and in-person technical presentations and demonstrations highlighting the Gateway to Global Aging Data.

Successful candidates for this position will have demonstrated data management and programming skills. The role demands the ability to produce careful and detail-oriented work, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the capacity to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams. You will be part of a team of dedicated professionals in a dynamic and supportive environment that values innovation and scientific excellence.

Required Qualifications:
• Minimum Education: Master's degree
• Master’s degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Economics, or related field. 
• Strong organizational and communication.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• High level of technical competency with Stata, SAS, or R.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:
• A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.

Work Arrangement:
This is a hybrid position, requiring 2-3 days on site at University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA.

Compensation: 
The hourly rate range for this position is $36.55 - $41.07. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.
 
About the Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR)
The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) is a multidisciplinary research center dedicated to discovering how people around the globe live, think, interact, age, invest, and make important, life-changing decisions. Our in-depth research and analysis are deepening the understanding of human behavior in a wide range of economic and social contexts. Our ultimate goal: to improve social welfare by informing and influencing decision-making in the public and private sectors. Along the way, we are leading a creative revolution in how scientists conduct social science and economic research through the use of innovative technology.

About the USC Schaeffer Institute
The USC Schaeffer Institute develops evidence-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, it houses three flagship programs: the USC Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics, the Leonard D. Schaeffer Fellows in Government Service, and the Center for Civic Society. Schaeffer experts have testified before numerous Congressional committees and are regularly sought out by media outlets—including the New York Times, NPR, Stat, Wall Street Journal, and Washington Post—to provide insight on policy issues.

The Schaeffer Institute is home to more than 150 scholars and staff, including three Nobel Laureates and seven members of the National Academy of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. It has offices at USC in Los Angeles and at the USC Capital Campus in Washington, DC.

About the Sol Price School of Public Policy
Ranked among the foremost schools of public policy in the nation, the USC Sol Price School of Public Policy generates uncommon knowledge for the common good. The school is composed of overlapping disciplines that generate innovative approaches to critical issues ranging from health-care policy to homelessness, and sustainability to congestion – to name a few. A wide-ranging curriculum, including extensive experiential learning, prepares our graduates to navigate problems that demand multi-layered solutions driven by critical, informed thinking.

The Price School, founded in 1929, is anchored by four departments: Public Policy and Management, Health Policy and Management, Wilbur H. Smith III Department of Real Estate Development, and Urban Planning and Spatial Analysis. The School’s rigorous academic programs provide students with the knowledge and distinctive opportunities to make meaningful contributions to their professions. Integrating classroom instruction with real-world experience and led by some of the world’s most renowned faculty in their fields, our students establish a clear pathway to successful careers.

Our academic programs are augmented by numerous research centers, institutes and initiatives that provide additional research expertise and experiences, notable among them are: The Judith and John Bedrosian Center on Governance and the Public; The Center for Philanthropy and Public Policy; The USC Lusk Center for Real Estate; The METRANS Transportation Consortium; The Leonard D. Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics; and The Schwarzenegger Institute for State and Global Policy. Together, they account for over $100 million in externally funded research grants and contracts.

Together, these departments and research enterprises provide unmatched breadth and depth to tackle an enormous range of challenges facing our country and the world. Price graduates hold leadership positions across diverse sectors – public, private, and nonprofit – championing the advancement of the common good. They come from around the world and from a variety of cultures and socio-economic backgrounds to create a rich intellectual environment that celebrates, supports and benefits from a variety of backgrounds and opinions.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer 1 - Robotics & Automation
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Join our team at Siemens Healthineers as a Systems Engineer 1 – Robotics & Automation, where you will help design, integrate, and validate robotic systems that advance the next generation of laboratory diagnostics. Working alongside experienced systems, hardware, and software engineers, you will apply collaborative robotics, sensing, and automation to make complex laboratory workflows more precise, reliable, and efficient. This position is ideal for an early-career engineer with hands-on robotics experience who is excited to work at the intersection of mechanical, electrical, and software engineering to bring robotic systems from concept to reliable operation in a regulated medical-device environment.As a Systems Engineer 1 – Robotics & Automation, you will be responsible for:
Robotics & automation (core focus):
• Program, configure, and tune robotic arms to execute precise, repeatable multi-step workflows in a laboratory setting.
• Characterize and improve robot accuracy and repeatability, and apply calibration and measurement techniques to achieve tight positioning tolerances.
• Develop and optimize motion paths and parameters to balance cycle time, reliability, and precision.
• Integrate vision-guided perception and robust grasping for manipulation of objects in real-world laboratory conditions.
• Use simulation and modeling tools to prototype and de-risk robotic behaviors before deployment on physical hardware.
• Design and iterate mechanical fixtures, adapters, and end-effectors to support robust robotic handling, including rapid prototyping.
Systems engineering & integration:
• Support system-level design, integration, and verification of robotic subsystems within larger diagnostic and lab-automation platforms.
• Translate product and process requirements into technical specifications, interface definitions, and structured test plans.
• Build data-collection and analysis tools to quantify robot and process performance, and communicate results to cross-functional stakeholders.
• Perform root-cause analysis and troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and software domains.
• Contribute to design reviews, risk assessments, and engineering documentation within a regulated (FDA / ISO 13485) environment.
Required skills to have for the success of this role:
• Bachelor’s degree in robotics, biomedical, mechanical, electrical, systems, or a related engineering discipline (May 2027 graduation).
• Hands-on experience programming and integrating robotic arms – including configuration, calibration, and motion planning.
• Practical experience with the Robot Operating System (ROS2) and integrating robots, sensors, actuators, and microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino) into working platforms.
• Strong programming skills in Python and MATLAB for control, data collection, and analysis.
• Working knowledge of systems and controls fundamentals and the ability to reason about how subsystems interact as a whole.
• Experience with CAD / design tools such as SOLIDWORKS, Siemens NX, or Autodesk Inventor and rapid prototyping (3D printing) for fixtures and end-effectors.
• Familiarity with computer vision / perception for robotics (e.g., depth sensing, object detection, OpenCV).
• Exposure to agentic / AI-assisted programming – using AI coding assistants and agent-based tools to accelerate development, prototyping, and automation of engineering tasks.
• Strong analytical rigor, curiosity, and structured problem-solving; comfort characterizing and improving system performance with data.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical results clearly.
• Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and project-coordination experience (academic, research, or extracurricular).
Preferred / nice to have:
• Experience with robot simulation and modeling environments.
• Exposure to robot kinematics and control of multi-degree-of-freedom arms.

jobs.title: High-Performance LLM Training Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
GPU computing is the most productive and pervasive platform for deep learning and AI. It begins with the most advanced GPUs and the systems and software we build on top of them. We integrate and optimize every deep learning framework. We work with the major systems companies and every major cloud service provider to make GPUs available in data centers and in the cloud. We craft computers and software to bring AI to edge devices, such as self-driving cars and autonomous robots. AI has the potential to spur a wave of social progress unmatched since the industrial revolution.

We are now looking for a High-Performance LLM Training Engineer! NVIDIA is seeking experienced engineers specializing in performance analysis and optimization to improve the efficiency of LLM training workloads, which are shaping the world's most advanced computing systems. This position focuses on optimizing NVIDIA's high-performance LLM software stack in frameworks like PyTorch and JAX for high-performance pre-training and post-training on thousands of GPUs, while also helping shape hardware roadmaps for the next generation of GPUs powering the AI revolution.

What you will be doing:
• Understand, analyze, profile, and optimize AI training workloads on innovative hardware and software platforms. 
• Understand the big picture of training performance on GPUs, prioritizing and then solving problems across all state-of-the-art LLMs. 
• Implement production-quality software in multiple layers of NVIDIA's deep learning platform stack. 
• Implement key LLM training workloads in NVIDIA's proprietary processor and system simulators to enable future architecture studies. 
• Build agentic tools to automate workload analysis, workload optimization, and other critical workflows.

What we want to see:
• M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience).
• Strong background in deep learning and neural networks, in particular model training optimizations.
• A deep background in computer architecture and familiarity with the fundamentals of GPU architecture.
• Proven experience analyzing and tuning application performance & processor and system-level performance modeling.
• Programming skills in C++, Python, and CUDA.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/
