jobs.title: Graduate Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH.

We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

We move fast, set a high bar, and expect excellence from everyone on the team.





THE ROLE

We're looking for exceptional graduates to join Trading 212 as Graduate Product Managers. You'll help shape products that make investing simpler and more accessible, turning complex problems into intuitive experiences.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. You'll work with engineers, designers and teams across the business to understand client needs, decide what matters most, and take ideas from problem to launch. You'll be expected to question assumptions, get into the details and measure whether what we build actually makes things better.

This is a highly demanding role for exceptionally ambitious people who want to accelerate their career growth. It requires sustained effort, discipline and a commitment to excellence. You'll face difficult problems, high expectations and a steep learning curve.

No prior work experience is required. We're looking for exceptional ability, sound judgment and the drive to turn ideas into results.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Understand client needs through research, feedback and product data, identifying problems worth solving.

 - Turn ambiguous problems into clear proposals, user journeys and product requirements.

 - Work closely with designers and engineers to build simple, reliable and intuitive solutions.

 - Prioritise improvements by weighing client value, business impact, effort and risk.

 - Define success metrics, analyse results and design experiments that help us make better decisions.

 - Take ownership of features from discovery through launch and iteration, with support from senior colleagues.

 - Spot confusing interactions, unnecessary steps and overlooked details, and drive improvements.

 - Use LLMs and prototyping tools to explore ideas, test assumptions and accelerate your work, checking the quality of their output.
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

 - Outstanding academic performance. An achieved First-Class degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Finance or another highly quantitative subject from a top university, placing you in the top 10% of your cohort.

 - Exceptional problem-solving ability. You can bring structure to ambiguous problems, identify root causes and develop simple, practical solutions. You reason from first principles, challenge assumptions and test your conclusions against evidence.

 - Uncompromising work ethic. You set demanding standards for yourself and are willing to put in exceptional, sustained effort to meet them. You're ambitious about your growth, embrace difficult challenges and take responsibility for improving quickly. You persevere, follow through on commitments and take pride in delivering excellent work.

 - A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes from start to finish. You act without waiting to be asked, anticipate obstacles, raise issues early and stay accountable until the problem is resolved.

 - Exceptional analytical reasoning. You work confidently with numbers, distinguish signal from noise and reach defensible conclusions from incomplete information.

 - Strong product judgment. You can explain what makes a product excellent, identify where an experience falls short and propose a simpler solution with clear trade-offs.

 - Evidence of exceptional initiative. You've taken a demanding idea beyond the brief and produced something tangible through an academic, personal or extracurricular project. You can explain your decisions, what you learned and what you would improve.

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex problem into a concise, structured explanation and defend your recommendation under questioning.

 - Technical fluency. You understand how software products work, can use SQL to answer questions from data, and can build a simple prototype to communicate or test an idea.

 - Proficient, critical use of LLMs. You use them effectively for research, analysis and prototyping, recognise their limitations and independently verify important outputs.

 - Fast learning and intellectual honesty. You get up to speed quickly, seek demanding feedback and change your mind when the evidence warrants it.

 - A strong interest in investing and financial products. You're curious about how they work and how to make them easier for people to understand and use.

 - Full-time availability and willingness to work in-office.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Distinction in a highly competitive academic competition, Olympiad, hackathon or research award.

 - A self-directed app, tool or other project that people have chosen to use, with evidence of how you improved it from feedback.

 - Strong foundations in statistics, probability and experimental design.

 - Ability to code in Python or JavaScript, or create interactive prototypes in Figma.

 - A thoughtful understanding of investing products and the trade-offs between simplicity, functionality and client protection.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - The chance to help shape products used by millions of investors to build wealth.

 - The opportunity for exceptionally fast career growth through demanding challenges, real responsibility and direct feedback, with progression driven by your performance and impact.

 - Real ownership, with direct feedback from experienced product, design and engineering colleagues.

 - Smart, ambitious, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal.

 - An environment where nothing is set in stone and good ideas win.

 - Appreciation for your talent and ideas.

 - A highly competitive package, including annual bonuses.



Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At a glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: Usually once every two weeks, when your team is in

Employment type: Paid internship, 10 weeks summer 2027



Why this role exists: To give people heading into their final year of university the chance to spend summer 2027 as a full member of one of our product teams, building software that database professionals around the world rely on.



About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on. It’s a space that’s only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.



AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can’t match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgment. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.



Why join our software engineering team?

· You’ll join a product team as a full member, working on the same things as everyone else, not on a side project in a corner.

· You’ll work in a team that cares about craft, collaboration, and quality.

· There’s real support to grow, with your own intern manager for feedback and a buddy for everything else, plus protected time every week to learn and develop skills.



About the role

For 10 weeks, you’ll work alongside our engineers on real software, shipping features that real customers use. You’ll be part of the day-to-day life of the team, with the support and room to learn what a first role in software deserves.

• Pair with engineers, get your code reviewed (and review theirs), and take part in standups, planning and retros.

• Work on the same things as everyone else, using the same tools, including AI tools like Claude.

• Spend every Friday afternoon (10% of your time) on learning, whether that’s lightning talks, a community of practice or building something of your own.

• Last year’s interns merged code in their first week, shipped a feature customers had been asking for, fixed a customer support issue, ran team standups and retros, gave a talk to the wider company, and learned C# and .NET on the job to build their own project.

“I didn’t feel like an intern, I really felt like part of the team.” Kris Sananpanichkul, past software intern



What makes you a great fit

You don’t need to tick every box. We care more about how you communicate, learn and work with others than how many lines of code you write.

• You expect to graduate in 2028 with a degree in a relevant subject, and you’re available for the full 10 weeks.

• You enjoy software and like figuring out how things work.

• You communicate clearly, ask questions, and share what you learn.

• You enjoy working as part of a team, including giving and receiving feedback.

• You have the right to work in the UK (we can’t offer visa sponsorship for the internship).



How to apply

No cover letter needed. Just send your CV that includes:

• Education: your course and year of graduation

• Work experience: anything relevant, if you have it. It’s fine if you don’t.

• Something you’re proud of: something you’ve built, fixed or figured out. It could be a uni project, a side project, a game mod, a Discord bot or a tricky bug. It all counts.

• What you want from this: what you hope to learn or get out of the internship



What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don’t use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You’ll hear back within a few days. Whether it’s a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you’re not left waiting.



Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Diversity at Redgate Software https://www.red-gate.com/our-company/careers/belonging/ .

At Intel, the Design Verification Engineer Graduate Intern role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the functional verification of silicon designs, ensuring they meet specifications and performance targets. In this role, you will engage in hands-on tasks such as developing verification plans, creating test benches, and contributing to the verification environment to ensure thorough architecture coverage. Your efforts will play a key part in uncovering design issues and collaborating on solutions, enhancing both your technical expertise and Intel's innovative products.

Business group 
This position is part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a dynamic organization dedicated to transforming how data is processed, stored, and analyzed across global industries. DCG drives innovation in server, cloud, and AI technologies, enabling Intel to deliver powerful, scalable solutions that support the future of computing. - Support the development of verification plans, test benches, and verification environments to ensure design architecture coverage.

- Assist with emulation and simulation tasks to validate designs, analyze power and performance metrics, and uncover bugs.

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact 

As a Module Engineering PhD Intern, you will contribute to the development, optimization, and implementation of advanced manufacturing processes within semiconductor production. In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers to troubleshoot, sustain, and qualify manufacturing equipment while supporting process improvements that enhance operational performance, yield, and reliability. This internship offers a unique opportunity to apply cutting-edge research and technical expertise in a high-volume manufacturing environment, gain hands-on industry experience, and make meaningful contributions to technology that powers the world. 

Business Group 

Intel Foundry is at the forefront of semiconductor manufacturing innovation, delivering world-class process technologies and manufacturing solutions. The organization is focused on driving operational excellence, advancing manufacturing capabilities, and enabling the production of industry-leading semiconductor products. As part of Intel Foundry, you will collaborate with talented engineers and researchers who are shaping the future of technology through innovation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. 

Key Responsibilities 

• Support the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes for semiconductor production modules. 

• Troubleshoot, sustain, and qualify manufacturing equipment to improve performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 

• Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to develop and enhance process control methodologies.

jobs.title: AI Software Development Intern
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
Join Intel's Datacenter and AI Software Ecosystem Engineering team to help accelerate the deployment and optimization of Generative AI solutions. This internship focuses on evaluating, benchmarking, and optimizing large language model (LLM) inference workloads across Intel platforms using state-of-the-art serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO. You will work on AI infrastructure, performance analysis, and cloud-native deployment solutions spanning on-premises and public cloud environments.

Project Context
Generative AI is rapidly transforming enterprise applications, with organizations increasingly deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational AI, knowledge retrieval, software development, content generation, and intelligent automation. As model sizes and user adoption continue to grow, delivering low-latency, cost-efficient, and scalable AI inference becomes a critical challenge.
Modern AI serving stacks combine model serving frameworks, optimized inference engines, cloud infrastructure, and observability platforms to deliver production-ready AI services. Organizations must balance performance metrics such as throughput, Time to First Token (TTFT), Time per Output Token (TPOT), latency, scalability, and total cost of ownership (TCO) while supporting a diverse range of deployment environments spanning on-premises datacenters, private clouds, and public cloud platforms.
This internship focuses on developing and validating modern AI inference solutions using technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO. The work will involve deploying and benchmarking state-of-the-art LLMs, analyzing inference performance across Intel platforms, automating testing and deployment workflows, and evaluating cloud-native AI architectures. The objective is to help build scalable, efficient, and production-ready AI serving solutions that enable customers to maximize the value of Generative AI deployments.

What You'll Work On
You will explore the design, deployment, and optimization of Generative AI infrastructure, including:
- LLM deployment and serving: Deploy and evaluate large language models using frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO
- Performance analysis: Measure and optimize serving metrics including throughput, latency, TTFT, TPOT, concurrency, and resource utilization
- AI benchmarking: Develop automated benchmarking workflows to characterize model performance across different hardware and software configurations
- Cloud infrastructure: Deploy and evaluate AI workloads in AWS and Google Cloud Platform environments
- DevOps and automation: Build CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and infrastructure tooling using Jenkins, Python, and Linux-based environments
- Data management: Design and maintain systems for storing, querying, and analyzing benchmarking and telemetry data using PostgreSQL and related technologies
- Solution validation: Investigate trade-offs between performance, scalability, accuracy, and cost across various deployment scenarios

Why This Internship?
- Cutting-edge AI engineering: Work on real-world Generative AI deployment and inference optimization challenges
- Industry impact: Contribute to technologies that help customers deploy and scale AI solutions on Intel platforms
- Hands-on experience: Gain practical expertise with LLM serving frameworks, cloud infrastructure and execution
- Mentorship: Learn from experts in AI systems, performance engineering, cloud computing, and software development
- Broad technical exposure: Develop skills across AI, Linux, DevOps, cloud computing, databases, and infrastructure automation
- Intel ecosystem: Build deep knowledge of AI deployment and optimization on Intel Xeon processors and Intel AI software solutions

Qualifications:
Required Qualifications:
- Strong background in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field
- Programming skills: Proficiency in Python and experience developing software applications and automation tools
- LLM knowledge: Understanding of transformer-based generative AI models, inference workflows, tokenization, quantization, and serving architectures
- Linux proficiency: Experience working in Linux environments, shell scripting, system monitoring, and troubleshooting
- Academic standing: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering or related field

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with one of LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or similar
- Experience benchmarking and performance tuning AI inference workloads
- Cloud fundamentals: Experience with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform services
- DevOps knowledge: Understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins, Git, and containerized workflows
- Knowledge of model optimization techniques including quantization, pruning, KV-cache optimization, and speculative decoding
- Experience working with container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker
- Experience building APIs and services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI
- Personal or academic projects involving LLM deployment, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, or inference optimization

Take the next step in your career by joining a team passionate about advancing the future of AI software. This internship offers a unique opportunity to develop your skills, contribute to impactful projects, and grow alongside industry-leading experts.

jobs.title: 2027 Intern - Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
The Cyber Operations team is responsible for the most critical security platforms that help protect Adobe at global scale. We operate and evolve the technologies that enable vulnerability management, endpoint security, and security analytics across hundreds of thousands of systems. Our mission is to ensure Adobe's security tooling remains effective, scalable, and capable of helping defenders make informed decisions in a constantly evolving threat landscape.

As an intern, you'll have an opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, data, automation, and AI! Rather than being limited to operational tasks or classroom-style projects, you'll work on meaningful problems using real security data and enterprise-scale technologies. You'll be exposed to how a world-class security organization collects and acts on information from major security platforms. You will contribute to finding opportunities to improve efficiency, visibility, and meaningfully reduce security risks.

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.

What You’ll Do
• Explore and analyze large-scale security datasets to uncover meaningful insights.
• Learn how enterprise security technologies help defend Adobe's global environment.
• Build tools, automations, and visualizations that solve real operational challenges.
• Use data, analytics, and AI to improve security decision-making.
• Partner with experienced security engineers on high-impact cybersecurity initiatives.
• Present findings and recommendations to security experts throughout the organization.
• Gain hands-on experience with industry-leading security platforms and technologies.
• Deliver a project that demonstrates measurable value to Adobe's security program.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineer - New College Graduate 2027
jobs.description:
Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. This is truly an extraordinary time — the era of AI has begun. Image recognition and speech recognition — GPU Deep Learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human creativity, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human creativity and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” Come join a team full of world-class computer scientists to work in its Compute Developer Technology team as an AI Developer Technology Engineer.

What you will be doing:
• Study and develop cutting-edge techniques in deep learning, graphs, machine learning, and data analytics, and perform in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures.
• Work directly with key customers to understand the current and future problems they are solving and provide the best AI solutions using GPUs.
• Collaborate closely with the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams at NVIDIA to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models.

What we need to see:
• A degree from a leading university in an engineering or computer science related discipline (BS; MS or PhD preferred)
• Strong knowledge of C/C++, software design, programming techniques, and AI algorithms
• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, time management, and task prioritization skills
• Some travel is required for conferences and for on-site visits with customers.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people on the planet working with us and our engineering teams are expanding fast. If you’re a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Research Intern - 3D World Models
jobs.description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

 

We're looking for bold, innovative individuals driven by a passion for pushing the boundaries of generative 3D AI. You should thrive in an environment where creativity meets technical challenge and be fearless in tackling the hardest problems in 3D world modeling. Our team is built on a foundation of dedication and a shared commitment to excellence, so we value people who take immense pride in their work and place the collective goals of the team above personal ambition. As a part of SpAItial, you'll be at the forefront of building World Models that bridge generative AI and the physical world. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you.

 

We're seeking PhD Research Interns to work with our research team on open problems in 3D generation and reconstruction. You should have strong knowledge of at least one of our core areas, such as generative video and diffusion models, scene representations like Gaussian splats and radiance fields, or 3D reconstruction from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Over a 5-7 month internship, you will own a well-defined research question with the goal of publishing a paper. 

 

Responsibilities

 - You will explore novel research directions in 3D generation, reconstruction, and world models. 

 - You will design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art methods, turning innovative research ideas into working systems and prototypes. 

 - You will be working closely with our research team.

 -  You will also present your findings and contribute to scientific publications targeting leading conferences in computer vision, computer graphics, and machine learning, such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, and ICLR.

Key Qualifications

 - Currently enrolled in the third year or beyond of a PhD in computer science, computer vision, computer graphics, machine learning, or a related field.

 - 2-3 first-author papers at top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or ICLR.

 - Knowledge of at least one of: generative models (diffusion or video models), neural scene representations, or 3D reconstruction.

 

At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Data Science – Forward Deployed Engineer: PhD Intern
AI Initiatives Fellow
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Join the 2027 New York Times Fellowship class as an A.I. Initiatives fellow in New York.

We are looking for a fellow who will bring a mix of machine-learning and journalism experience to newsroom reporting projects. You will work with journalists across departments to identify, develop and execute projects that use the power of artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science techniques to address investigative challenges. You will be part of the A.I. Initiatives team, which includes editors, engineers and a product designer.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities: 

• Collaborate with investigative reporters to support projects that benefit from A.I., including large-scale research, transcription, translation, document search, language analysis and computer vision tasks

• Identify opportunities and experiment with responsible A.I. tools to empower the newsroom

• Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

• No more than five years of full-time, professional experience in journalism and/or machine learning

• Technical proficiency and experience analyzing data, developing applications and conducting research with machine-learning models

• Editorial experience, such as interning in a newsroom or working on a college newspaper

• Engineering skills and experience with APIs, front-end web applications and databases

• Recent experience working with LLMs and other machine-learning models

• Interest in the intersection of journalism and artificial intelligence

• Understanding of ethical considerations surrounding the use of A.I. in journalism

Preferred Qualifications:

• Record of multiple news or opinion journalism internships, or equivalent experience

• Work demonstrating experience applying A.I. to real-world problems

• Experience working with large datasets and cloud computing platforms

• Experience working with Svelte or similar front-end frameworks

To apply, upload a résumé and cover letter. The application will prompt you when to upload materials. Applications that fail to include any of these materials or follow these instructions will not be considered.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. We will not sponsor work visas for the fellowship, but we will consider applicants with valid work authorization or a valid student visa that can be extended with Optional Practical Training.

You may apply to only one fellowship position per year. For instance, if you apply as an A.I. Initiatives fellow, you should not apply for any other positions in the fellowship. Duplicate applications will be discarded.

The application deadline is 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Nov. 20. 

The Times Fellowship generates a high level of interest, so we cannot acknowledge the status of every application upon receipt or during the vetting process, which can take eight weeks or more. We cannot accept applications that are mailed or emailed to us. We will contact you for interviews as needed.

The fellowship program will begin on or about June 7, 2027, and end on May 26, 2028, subject to satisfactory performance. There is no guarantee of a full-time position upon completion of the program.

jobs.title: PHY Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented and motivated intern to join our team developing physical layer (PHY) software for our 4G and 5G products. The position is a 12-month internship at our office in the centre of Bristol, where you will be working alongside a team of approximately 50 people, part of a larger (500+) international R&D team motivated by building the future of telecoms.  
If you are looking for a chance to work on cutting-edge, disruptive technology, and gain invaluable experiencein a well-paid internship, Parallel Wireless is for you. 

What you'll do:
• Develop real-time PHY software features on the latest multi-core Intel / AMD / ARM CPUs. 

• Integrate, test and validate features on servers within lab and AWS cloud end-to-end environments.

• Build test scripts and debug tools that form part of our software CI/CD and release packages.

• Use AI coding agents day to day to develop and debug PHY software, scripts and tools.

• Use various lab equipment for end-to-end testing: UE simulators, mobile phones (Android), and other RF equipment.
What you'll gain:
• Hands-on experience of developing real-time high-performance C/C++ software in a Linux environment, using Docker containers and Kubernetes

• Understanding of modern CPU instruction sets and SIMD programming.

• Experience of a modern software development environment (Git, JIRA, Bitbucket, Jenkins CI/CD).

• Hands-on experience of agentic development including building the skills and tools to automate engineering workflows.

• A better understanding of wireless telecommunications and digital signal processing concepts.

• Experience of working in multi-national Agile teams, familiarity with modern Scrum and SAFe ways of thinking and working.
What you must have:
• Strong C and/or C++ programming skills (assessed at technical interview).

• Experience with Python scripting.

• Interest in AI-assisted software development.

• Willingness to learn about wireless communications. Prior experience is an advantage but not a requirement.
During your internship you'll get:

• Salary between £28-30k per annum 

• Flexible working hours

jobs.title: Hardware Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Humble Robotics
Working at Humble Robotics means taking on the biggest change in ground transportation in decades. We’re building an autonomous, zero-emissions hauler that dramatically lowers the cost of freight with groundbreaking vision-based AI, designed for today’s global logistics network.
We’re a fast-moving, close-knit team of AV industry veterans and innovative thinkers. We don’t believe culture can be engineered – but when it falls into place, it’s a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.
Progress has never felt so present.

About The Role
You’ll join the Hardware Integration team and work hands-on with the hardware behind our autonomous vehicle fleet. You’ll build and maintain our test benches, debug electrical issues across the fleet, and help bring up new hardware alongside our engineering teams and suppliers. 

The person who fills this role would primarily work from Humble Robotics’ San Francisco office 5 days a week. We aim to create an in office environment that fosters a collaborative, generative atmosphere where the team can build together.
What You'll Do
• 
Build and maintain test benches for system integration and new hardware bring-up, keeping wiring, configuration, documentation, and change logs up to date

• 
Bring up new hardware and troubleshoot electrical issues on the bench and across the vehicle fleet, from first power-on through testing and validation

• 
Write scripts and small tools in Python or other languages to test, troubleshoot, and automate bench and vehicle checks

• 
Work closely with our engineering teams and supplier companies on hardware development and troubleshooting, and help put engineering changes into practice

• 
Build, test, and repair low-voltage and high-voltage harnesses and electrical boards as needed (including hi-pot testing), and support their design and design for manufacturing (DFM)

• 
Follow high-voltage and lockout/tagout safety practices and help keep the lab and garage organized
What You Bring
• 
BS in Electrical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or related field; 0–2 years relevant experience (including internships, projects, and student teams such as Formula SAE or robotics)

• 
Hands-on electrical skills: using a DMM, oscilloscope, and bench power supply; reading schematics and wiring diagrams; crimping and soldering

• 
Basic understanding of 12/24V and high-voltage systems and CAN bus

• 
Basic programming skills in Python or other languages

• 
Comfortable working on vehicles, in the lab, and in the field, including lifting up to 50 lb; willing to be trained for high-voltage work

• 
Clear communication and attention to detail

• 
Eligible to work in the United States
Bonus Points
• 
Experience with high-voltage systems or battery packs

• 
Experience building, testing, or designing harnesses or electrical boards (e.g., hi-pot testing, harness CAD, design for manufacturing)

• 
Experience using code to automate tests or analyze test data

• 
Familiarity with CAN tools (PCAN, SavvyCAN), Linux, and the command line

Our space is a fast-moving field, and we don't expect any one candidate to tick every box above. If you're excited about building the systems that enable autonomous trucks to get safely on the road, and your background covers most — but not all — of what we've listed, we'd still love to hear from you. Humble Robotics is built by people who grew into the hardest problems in this field, not just people who'd already solved them.
Compensation
This role is eligible for base salary + benefits + equity compensation. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, and location.
Perks and Benefits
• 
Competitive compensation and equity 

• 
Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for full-time employees

• 
Take what you need vacation policy

• 
Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks and weekly catered meals

• 
Collaborative in office environment located in San Francisco
Additional Information
As part of the interview process, we may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to compare your qualifications and experience to the job description. A human reviews all AI output and makes a final hiring decision. Humble Robotics does not rely on the output to make any employment decisions. Some applicants may have a legal right to opt-out of the use of AI as part of our interview process. Contact legal@humblerobotics.ai to exercise this right or if you have further questions on the use of AI tools in our hiring process.
Humble Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law. Humble Robotics will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with local ordinances.

jobs.title: Intelligence Center X Engineer
jobs.description:
Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases.
About Intelligence Center X
Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.
Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.
How we engage with customers
Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.

Key Responsibilities
The role

As an ICX Engineer, you lead the ideation and creation of these engagements. This is a presales FDE role: you take a business problem and a complex data landscape, model the domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver a working agentic application with a business case compelling the customer to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.

You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the ICX Engineering Manager for the Americas.

An example engagement

An industrial manufacturer wants its engineers to answer in minutes a question that today takes weeks of chasing across teams: what does this change affect? The answer is spread across a dozen systems that each describe the same products, parts and suppliers differently. You connect them, model how they fit together as an enterprise ontology, build an agent that reasons over the result, and show the customer what it is worth with a compelling agentic user experience.
Requirements
Who you are

• You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You build working things, and agentic development tools are how you work. If some of this is new to you, you will learn fast.

• You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.

• You think in business value, and you want to be in the room with customers.

Skills and experience

We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.

• Customer-facing technical communication — running working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including when the solution is still taking shape.

• Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.

• Modern data and AI platforms — experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.

• Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.

• Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.

• Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.

• Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.

• FDE, presales or innovative professional services — experience on a team that builds with customers.

• Technical consulting — designing and building agentic AI, data and analytics solutions for clients at a consultancy or systems integrator.

• Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.

We hire across levels, from recent graduates to experienced data and AI professionals, with no minimum years of experience. What matters is evidence that you build, and the drive to do it with customers.

Travel

Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.
Why Join Us
• Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.

• Shape our future. ICX Engineering is growing fast, and strong leaders get the opportunity to shape where it goes.

• The problem every enterprise is working on. Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.

• A direct line to product. Your engagements help shape the ICX roadmap.

• A clear path to grow. ICX Engineers grow toward Principal or management roles.
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Our Benefits & Rewards
The total cash compensation range for this position is €85,100 to €215,700 with 30% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce
We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer New Grad - Query Engines
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three.
 
Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems.

Technologies We Use
• Java, Scala, Rust, and Python

• Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution

• Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability

• Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage

• Gradle and Cargo for builds, and GitHub for collaboration

You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here.
What We Value
• Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimisers and execution operators to file formats and distributed processing

• A high bar for correctness and a willingness to dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does

• Comfort following a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack

• A practical approach to performance, grounded in measurement rather than intuition

• Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and incorporate feedback

• Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who depend on our software
What We Require
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience

• Proficiency in at least one language such as Java, Rust, Scala, C++, or C

• Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Coursework or projects in databases, compilers, operating systems, or distributed systems

• Contributions to open-source projects
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

jobs.title: Product Manager - Retention & Monetization
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

This role is focused on retention and monetization. Millions of people use Kikoff to build credit - you'll own what happens after they sign up: why members stay, why they leave, and what they choose to pay for. You will own the retention and monetization roadmap for Kikoff's core credit products - churn, reactivation, plan upgrades, pricing and packaging - and be measured on retained, paying members and revenue per member.

This is a full-time position in our San Francisco HQ with benefits and equity in a fast-moving and fast-growing environment that will help you grow your abilities and career as you help build a better ecosystem of credit for our customers.

What you can expect in this role

• Look deeply at the data and talk to users to find what keeps them engaged, what makes them churn, and what they value enough to pay for - then create retention and engagement loops using content and experiences that leverage product, comms and alert touch points.

• Constantly develop and experiment on experiences, offers and types of content that will keep users active, retained and upgrading.

• Own the levers that drive revenue per member: pricing, packaging, plan upgrades, paywalls and cross-sell into other Kikoff products.

• Own cancellation, save and win-back flows that reduce churn without trading away member trust.

• Drive strategic insights that shape roadmaps for engineering, design and marketing using retention, LTV and revenue data and user stories to build conviction.

• Explore our data and users to create segments by value, risk and intent, with relevant insights, offers and content to drive a virtuous loop of engagement and monetization.

• Take direction from leadership regarding the key objectives your team needs to drive, but outline a roadmap with your product team to achieve successful outcomes, together.

• Drive the discovery process to form a deep understanding of our users and to uncover the products and features that will best empower those consumers - and that they'll stay and pay for.

• Reach beyond instinct alone to capture and analyze the right data to allow you to make the most informed decisions as you continue to evolve your approach.

• Partner with legal and compliance so pricing, disclosures and cancellation experiences meet consumer-protection standards.

• Champion your products within your team, across the company, and with consumers.

What will help make you successful

• Excellent writing and communication skills to communicate both with users and internally to drive strategy, learning and iteration.

• Readiness to roll up your sleeves in all parts of the member journey from copy to setting up comms, offers and product touch points to measuring and interpreting results.

• Extremely data driven and constantly looking for the “why” behind the data to understand what drives user behaviors and explains metric patterns. Comfortable with cohort analysis, LTV and unit economics. Pulling the data yourself is a strong plus.

• You've owned a retention, lifecycle, growth or monetization metric and moved it through experimentation.

• Experience with pricing, subscriptions, paywalls or upgrade flows is a plus.

• You have empathy for consumers and a passion for solving consumer problems in new and innovative ways.

• You feel comfortable in the driver's seat and have a natural way of knowing how to get to the destination, but also know when it's time for others to drive.

• You've worked on successful digital consumer products for at least 2 years, preferably in a fast-paced startup environment.

• You can wear as many hats as necessary including marketer, researcher, interface designer, analyst, and friend.

• An interest in and/or history working on modern consumer financial tools and products, with your own perspective on how best to innovate in this space.

Ideal Candidates

• Current undergraduate and master students or early career professionals with high potential such as from consulting or investment banking.

• A passion for solving problems derived from data-driven thinking and user needs.

• A futurist who can collaboratively lead a team to build towards a vision.

• Highly motivated, curious, and adaptable individuals.

• Excellent communication, analytical, and first principles problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and eagerness to learn.

• Strategic thinker able to breakdown and organize problems, assess opportunity areas, and develop big ideas and priorities to move the business forward.

• Commercial instinct - you think in terms of retained users and revenue, not just engagement.

• Have strong bias to action and hunger to move fast and flexibly.

• Technical background a big plus such as being able to pull data with SQL and read code.

Benfits

• 🏥 Medical, dental, and vision coverage - Kikoff covers the full cost of health insurance for the employee!

• 📈 Meaningful equity in the form of RSU's

• 🏝️ 20 days of paid time off per year - we encourage taking real time away to recharge and do your best work

• 💵 401(k) plan with an employer match to help you invest in your future

• 💰 Competitive pay based on experience consisting of base + equity + benefits

Location: Hybrid, 3 days onsite in San Francisco, CA.

Visa sponsorship available: Kikoff is willing to provide sponsorship for H1-B visas and U.S. green cards for exceptional talent.
Base Range
$183,000—$223,000 USD

A note on applying: We know great candidates sometimes hold back if they don’t meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can do the work, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Kikoff Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, ELECTRICAL (STARSHIELD)

Our SpaceX team is working on the toughest and most audacious projects on our planet: making humanity multiplanetary. As an electrical development engineer on the SpaceX team, you will demonstrate extreme ownership through detailed and thorough design, hardware bring-up/characterization/testing, and requirements generation/verification - ultimately seeing your hardware through all aspects of its life cycle. You will work with many cross-disciplinary teams and will need to think at a system level to ensure that your design is viable. Our development timelines are quick and you will need to rigorously explore solutions for previously unsolved or unknown problems. Every day, we push the limits of what is possible through innovation, determination, and teamwork to drive the mission to success.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Rapidly design, develop, and test highly reliable electronics for communicating with our satellites.

• Drive electrical architecture, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging.

• Partner with software, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing teams, and production test teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering.

• Graduating with a bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD in 2026 or 2027.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

• 2+ years of experience rapidly designing and delivering highly reliable products.

• 2+ years of electronic product experience designing hardware from concept through production; strong emphasis on full life cycle development of new hardware products and not small incremental updates to legacy hardware.

• 2+ years of experience designing and implementing mixed-signal circuit boards from concept through production using processors, FPGAs, Ethernet, multi-GHz SerDes, DRAM interfaces (DDR4), I2C, SPI, operational amplifiers, analog to digital and digital to analog converters, and power supply components.

• 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting and debugging electronics.

• 2+ years of experience with fast-paced projects.

• Strong understanding of computers and programming languages (Python, C/C++).

• Demonstrated ability to work in a highly cross-functional role.

• Ability to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up atmosphere.

• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: 

Pay range: 
Level I: $115,000.00 - $140,000.00/per year 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation & will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Worker Type

Job Description

Summer Internship Program
Our paid Summer Internship Program is designed to provide students with an immersive, hands-on experience within the aerospace and defense industry. Interns work alongside AV team members on meaningful projects involving cutting-edge technology while developing professional relationships, strategic problem-solving skills, and practical experience in a full-time work environment.
This is a 12-week, onsite program intended for highly motivated and passionate students who are currently enrolled in college or are recent graduates. Applicants must have a minimum 3.0 GPA, with a preference for students at the junior level or above.
Our program has been recognized by Yello and WayUp as one of the Top 100 Internship Programs in the United States for multiple years.
Depending on the team and location, students who are willing to relocate for their internship may be eligible for a relocation and housing reimbursement stipend.
AV offers internship opportunities across various teams and locations throughout the United States. Specific team, location, and program details will be discussed during the interview process.

As a Machine Learning Intern, you will have the opportunity to support the R&D Group at AV in developing innovative computer vision solutions for defense and commercial applications. You will contribute to small, focused design teams working on detection, classification, localization, and tracking technologies. This internship will expose you to various stages of the development process including concept design, prototyping, testing, and evaluation.
Position Responsibilities
• Support the development of computer vision and machine learning algorithms for detecting, classifying, localizing, and tracking objects-of-interest using UAV-mounted gimballed cameras.

• Assist in writing and testing software to integrate ML algorithms into aircraft systems (e.g., autopilots, payloads, robotic platforms).

• Explore and visualize data to understand distribution patterns and potential anomalies.

• Assist in implementing machine learning systems and validating designs through experiments.

• Help define objectives, develop models, and track their performance using metrics.

• Perform data analysis tasks using AV tools and industry-standard platforms.

• Help manage project resources such as datasets, hardware, and time to support project timelines.

• Contribute to the evaluation of ML algorithm performance and model deployment strategies.

• Participate in data preparation activities, including cleaning and transformation.

• Assist in error analysis and developing corrective strategies.

• Research and experiment with appropriate ML algorithms and tools.

• Support running tests and experiments on selected datasets and data representations.

• Follow standard procedures to analyze data and support development tasks.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Currently pursuing a BS in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Familiarity with C/C++ and MATLAB.

• Proficiency with office productivity tools.

• Basic troubleshooting skills for technical systems.

Other Skills & Qualifications
• Exposure to deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Keras).

• Familiarity with Python and libraries such as scikit-learn and pandas.

• Experience with data visualization and handling large datasets.

• Exposure to OpenCV and working in a Linux environment.

• Understanding of key concepts in:
• Machine learning

• Computer vision

• Mathematical optimization

• Data mining

• Predictive analytics

• Ability to assist in selecting hardware/software for model deployment.

• Effective communication and teamwork skills.

• Strong initiative and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced R&D environment.

• Willingness to take ownership of tasks and learn from feedback.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work independently under supervision.

Physical Demands
• Ability to work in an office and lab environment.

• May be required to sit or stand for long periods, use hands/fingers for computer and communication tasks.

ITAR Requirement:

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. Based in California, AeroVironment (AVAV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Founded in 1971 by celebrated physicist and engineer, Dr. Paul MacCready, we’ve been at the leading edge of technical innovation for more than 45 years. Join us today in developing the next generation of small UAS and tactical missile systems that will deliver more actionable intelligence to our customers so they can proceed with certainty – and succeed.

Agencies of the U.S. Department of Defense and allied military services use the company’s hand-launched UAS to provide situational awareness to tactical operating units through real-time, airborne reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Altera is hiring a FPGA IP Design Engineer - Intern! As modern FPGAs become increasingly like a SoC, Altera's IP Systems and Solutions Engineering (IPSS) team develops comprehensive solutions to provide customers easy and efficient access to the capabilities of Altera's FPGA devices. These solutions are provided as highly configurable intellectual property IP cores that are fully integrated with Altera's software CAD tool, Quartus Prime. The IP Cores we develop include Memory Interfaces (such as DDR5, LPDDR5, or HBM), custom chip-to-chip interfaces for high-speed ADC/DAC tiles (for radar processing), and leading-edge transceiver interfaces (to enable Ethernet, PCIe, and other protocols).

Altera's IP cores provide configurable access to these high-speed, high-bandwidth interfaces, leveraging dedicated and specialized silicon subsystems in the FPGA. The constantly rising speed and complexity of memory devices, chip-to-chip, and transceiver interfaces presents a challenging design problem that requires system level knowledge of silicon, software, IP, and customer applications. As an IP Design Engineering Intern, you will work with a team of engineers to develop and verify state-of-the-art memory interface, chip-to-chip, or transceiver-based IP cores. You will be working on advanced device architectures, design definition, implementation, and verification. You will also be developing design examples and simulation models, accompanied by a rich set of technical documentation.

Job Responsibilities:
Your specific responsibilities can include, but are not limited to the following:
• Architecture and Design based on the latest protocol specifications for memory, chip-to-chip, or transceiver interfaces
• RTL development
• Device support and CAD tool integration
• Verification (e.g. verification IP, methodologies, frameworks, bus functional models, regression tests)
• Hardware power-on and debug
• New product release and rollout support, customer technical support.

Our compensation is designed to reflect the Canadian labour market. The actual salary offered may vary based on several factors, including the position’s location, as well as the candidate’s experience, skills, training, and job-specific knowledge. In addition to base salary, we offer performance-based incentive opportunities that reward both individual contributions and overall company success.​

Estimated Salary Range: $95K – $100K CAD​

Job Description:

Your impact 
Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 
At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 

Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 

Our Industrial Placement Software Engineer Programme
 
Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
 
Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.
 
During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.
 
What you will do as a Software Engineer Industrial Placement
As part of our early careers community, you will work alongside developers and experts in an environment that is both challenging and rewarding. Your responsibilities will include:
• Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of a multi-disciplinary Integrated Project Team.
• Developing practical skills in design techniques for products. 
• Growing your understanding of the business as well as the software engineering lifecycle.

Qualifications
This is an exciting and challenging Software Engineering opportunity for students currently studying a science-based degree e.g. Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering (BSc (Hon) / BEng (Hon) / MEng.) You are expected to have an appropriate gap in studies.
 
• Be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code with experience of doing this from education or outside interests.
• You will have some experience of computer programming
• Have some experience of an object-oriented programming language such as Java, C++, C# or JavaScript and knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language) is an advantage but not essential
• A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV
• Applications are also welcomed from candidates who have completed a first degree and are looking to gain industrial experience prior to commencing a relevant higher degree (i.e. PhD, MSc)

Security Clearance 
Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 

To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 

For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 
Why join us 
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
• Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
• Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity. 
• Tailored perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more. 

For a full list of our company benefits please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/company-benefits 

We are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people, communities and our customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know. 

Start your extraordinary career – apply now!
