jobs.description:
Job Description

As an AI Enablement Intern, you will apply academic knowledge to real business challenges while gaining a personalized view of what it is like to work at Constellation Brands. Under the mentorship of experienced professionals, you will support responsible enterprise AI adoption, evaluation and prioritization of AI use cases, AI enablement content, user engagement, and measurement of the value and impact of AI enablement programs. You will collaborate with IT leaders, communications partners, and business teams, gaining exposure across departments while helping employees apply AI tools safely and effectively. The ideal candidate combines technical curiosity with strong people and communication skills and is eager to contribute creative ideas in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities 

• Working with a technical mentor, provide support for key strategic projects and contribute to solving real challenges in a corporate environment. 
• Document and organize enterprise AI use cases, including intake details, objectives, stakeholders, user needs, and expected outcomes. 
• Engage IT and business users through interviews, feedback sessions, or focus groups to understand their needs, evaluate whether AI enablement messages are effective, and identify opportunities to improve AI adoption. 
• Collect and analyze usage data and employee feedback to assess adoption and determine whether AI enablement programs are saving time, improving work quality, or delivering other value; present findings through clear dashboards, charts, or other visuals. 
• Develop and refine concise, engaging AI enablement materials such as quick-start guides, FAQs, office-hours content, safe-use reminders, demonstrations, and other digital communications aligned to internal guidance. 
• Support lightweight testing of AI solutions and workflows, including creating and testing prompts, identifying where AI works well and where it may struggle, and documenting recommended practices. 
• Communicate project work and promote responsible AI use through appropriate channels, helping technical and nontechnical audiences understand how to use AI tools effectively. 
• Provide ad hoc project support as needed and follow assigned work through to completion. 
• Participate in pre-planned intern events such as Senior Leader Meetings, Goal Setting, Team Building, Tour, and Final Presentations. 

Core Competencies to be Successful 

• Curious, creative, innovative, and willing to bring forward new ideas. 
• Technical and problem-solving skills, with enthusiasm for learning and solving open-ended challenges. 
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain ideas in both technical and user-friendly language. 
• Ability to organize work and collaborate effectively across levels, departments, and teams. 
• Strong ability to deliver concise, logical analyses, visuals, and proposals. 
• Initiative to seek out information and solutions and the ability to work independently when appropriate. 
• Commitment to quality, sound judgment, and timely completion of work. 

Qualifications 

• Current student in, or recent graduate of, a Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Communications, Digital Media, or related program, with relevant AI, data, technology, or enablement experience. 
• Basic understanding of AI concepts, including generative AI and common limitations and risks such as hallucinations, bias, and privacy considerations. 
• Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint. 
• Ability to work independently, exercise strong technical judgment, and troubleshoot problems. 
• Strong interpersonal skills and interest in helping employees adopt technology safely and effectively.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
The opportunity:
 
Our Central London team is looking for talented and enthusiastic Industrial Placement Analytics Engineer to help perform weapon system assessments for our UK Ministry of Defence (MOD) customer. The role will suit those with a STEM background who wish to apply their abilities in a technical analysis and systems assessment environment. 

The type of project you will be working on:
 
• Customer Integration: You will be a member of a weapons project team within our larger Defence Analytics Group working in Central London. The group is integrated into a joint unit with government employees, members of the armed forces, and other contractors.
• The Challenge: To conduct analysis to assess the performance and capability of weapon systems. Problems are solved through the application of scientific methods, physical principles, and analytics to complex data sets. This process may involve new techniques and their encapsulation in improved tools.
• Collaboration: You will be working in close liaison with similar teams within the UK and partner nations, with the opportunity to contribute, influence, challenge and improve joint ways of working and knowledge.
• Breadth: You will be working in an environment where both the complexity and capabilities of the systems are continually evolving throughout the world.
 
What you’ll do:
 
• Conduct analysis through the application of physical principles to real world problems. This will be facilitated using the suite of in-house software tools and the occasional development of ad-hoc software, primarily in Python.
• Production of reports and presentations of your work and presentation of them to local MOD customers and the wider community both within the UK and partner nations.
• Provide ad hoc advice and support to MOD customers, often at short notice.
• Travel for technical exchanges with our partners, in the UK and potentially abroad.
 
What we need from you:
 
• A STEM background with an emphasis on numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to apply these to real world problems.
• A good understanding of scientific methods and their use through the application of fundamental physical principles.
• Good Interpersonal skills to facilitate collaborative and effective working within an inter-disciplinary team.
• Ability to problem solve and self-steer, work to deadlines as necessary, sometimes at short notice.
• Ability to communicate, both in writing and verbally, with audiences of differing technical backgrounds and seniority.
• The ability to work office-based in central London.

It would be nice if you had: 
• Although not essential, an appreciation of and interest in aerospace technologies.
• Experience of Python and C# would be a distinct advantage.

What you will get: · 
• Impact: You will help ensure that MOD’s weapon assessments are robust and delivered in a timely manner to UK Defence partners and front-line forces.
• Opportunity: You will play a key role in MOD weapon assessment which is a critical input to MOD’s equipment procurement programs. 
• Knowledge: You will develop an understanding of weapon systems and how they operate.
• Skills: You will develop a range of analytical, software and interpersonal skills.
• Insights: You will get to work within a Leonardo team that is fully integrated with its MOD customer which will provide an excellent opportunity to see up-close how the MOD operates. 
• Teamwork: You will work with a diverse technical team in a highly collaborative environment.

Security Clearance 

Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 

To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. 

Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 

Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.

jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Job Description

Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation. 
   
The Engineering Team  
Our engineers are fueled by a passion to impact the future of mobility. They push the boundaries of telematics and transportation tech by creating and supporting cutting-edge products. As part of an Agile team, they are armed with the freedom to innovate and the opportunity to see projects through from start to finish. Using a variety of languages and a top-notch technology stack, our engineers make critical advances in areas like sensor technology, enterprise engineering and platform development. Our team understands what it means to collaborate and communicate in an interconnected global team, all while having trust, transparency and empathy for the end user. Which is pretty cool, if you ask us.   
 
The Role   
The Arity - Infrastructure Software Engineer Intern will serve as a member of a product/infrastructure team. They practice and are the champions of the Scrum methodology in a cloud environment with a product mindset within each product team.  
 
Job Description 
• Participates in iteration planning meetings ensuring that the team has a common understanding of each story and chores in a team’s backlog  
• Participates in daily site, cross-site, and product team standups  
• Participates in retrospectives to gather feedback and derive actionable items to improve the team and the product  
• Participate in executing the strategy, keeping the customer needs and wants in mind  
• Collaborates within the team in designing systems and apps  
• Practices daily paired programming and test-driven development in writing software and building products  
• Establishes continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous deployment pipelines and practices  
• Provides support for software products in user environments  
• Working with geographically disbursed team across multiple time-zones 
 
Job Qualifications 
• Target Start Date: May/June 2027 
• Rising Sophomore, Junior or Senior  
• Working towards a Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science or similar field, including a solid understanding of Computer Science fundamentals  
• Strong understanding of computer science concepts, object-oriented design principles  
• Knowledge of developing software in different programming languages, and demonstrated ability to quickly learn new languages  
• Knowledge and experience on approaches and tools for automated testing and monitoring  
 
Preferred Qualifications:  
• Experience with Java, KOTLIN, GO or Scala and Python  
• Experience with the Spring framework with Java or Kotlin 
• Backend development, design and implementation; database (relational like Postgres, NoSQL like Cassandra, caching), messaging and big data development, implementation and optimization  
• Experience and knowledge in web and API security including authentication, authorization, OAuth, OWASP, OpenID, and SAML  
• Experience in testing frameworks like JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Protractor, Cucumber, and other like technologies  
• Experience with packaging/build tools like Gradle, Maven, NPM, Artifactory, Jenkins, Concourse, etc.  
• Experience with Amazon Web Service components like (Lambdas, Athena, S3, EMR, Step functions, Route53, EC2, etc.,) 
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP (compute, storage, networking, IAM) 
• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) 
• Scripting and automation experience in Python or Bash, with comfort working in Linux/Unix environments 
 
At Arity, great things happen when our people work together.

Compensation offered for this role is between $26 and $37 an hour and is based on experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
The Client & Customer Experience (C&CE) team is responsible for the servicing of Cigna customers across multiple lines of business, including US Medical, Pharmacy Benefits, and more. C&CE owns the delivery of exceptional client and customer experience while operating Cigna’s call centers effectively and efficiently for the business. The Business Analytics Intern will be responsible for supporting critical analytical work that impacts C&CE strategic priorities.
 
This role is part of a Business Analyst team that provides direct support to the C&CE organization, including driving strategic improvements in customer experience, redesigning the destination servicing experience, and supporting improvements in the associate experience through better capabilities and tools. During the internship, the associate will work closely with operational partners to deeply understand 1-2 assigned business case projects, develop analytical insights and build/share compelling presentations that positively influence future strategy.
 
What You Will Do:
• Develop 1-2 business cases that evaluate options and assess costs/benefits to guide prioritization decisions
• Leverage data to solve business problems by identifying data needs, pulling data from relevant sources, and performing analysis
• Identify business opportunities using trend analysis and mining operational data for insights
• Distill work into crisp presentations that educate, inform, and inspire action
 
Role Components:
• Strategy – Influence action through data-driven analysis and business acumen. Identify and assess potential opportunities for change over the next 3-5 years.
• Business Judgment – Develop and use frameworks to scope and address ambiguous problems. Understand where the leverage is and focus problem-solving efforts to uncover insights that drive action.
• Analytics – Evaluate business opportunities and make strategic recommendations. Identify an effective method, perform data analysis, and develop recommendations that account for benefits, costs, risks, and alternatives.
• Data – Ground analysis in data as much as possible. Define needs, identify data sources, ensure data quality, and partner with data teams to complete analysis. Coding experience in a relevant language (e.g. SQL or Python) is a preference.
• Communications – Influence leaders across C&CE and our stakeholder teams. Distill complex analytical work into key insights, recommendations, and next steps.
• Teamwork – Partner across Operations, Tech, Finance, and business teams. Learn from supportive Analytics leaders and join an inclusive, empowering team where you can grow professionally and have fun!
 
Basic Qualifications
• Rising senior working towards a Bachelor’s degree (Business Analytics, Business, Economics, Math, Statistics or related field preferred)
• Strong communication (oral and written), presentation, and facilitation skills
• Ability to structure project plans and independently manage to deadlines
• Ability to partner across organizations and roles to influence and deliver work
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced knowledge of data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. Excel, SQL, Tableau)
• Proficiency in an analytics-focused coding language, e.g. SQL, Python, or R
• Experience with building, managing, or using business models, e.g. optimization, predictive analysis, or financial / credit modeling

Additional Information
• Location: This role is located at our Bloomfield, CT headquarters office.
• Housing: Summer housing is available for interns who live more than 50 miles from the Bloomfield, CT office. 
• Work Authorization: One goal of this internship is to prepare and identify qualified candidates for roles with Cigna post-graduation. Therefore, this temporary internship is open only to individuals who are eligible for employment in the United States and who would not require visa support including H-1B, CPT/OPT/STEM, etc., now or in the future.
• Schedule: You must be available to work 40 hours per week for the duration of the internship beginning May 24, 2027. 

Pre‑Employment Requirements: Selected candidates will be required to complete mandatory pre‑employment tasks approximately 45 days prior to the program start date. Completion of the drug test requires availability within the United States during this timeframe. 

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. jobs.title: Applied Scientist Intern - Economics
jobs.description:
About the team
The forecasting and business economics group at Zillow shapes planning and drives decision making across Zillow’s businesses. Embedded in the finance organization, our team prioritizes research projects that directly impact the company’s bottom line and growth. 

We bring together forecasters, economists, applied scientists, data scientists, and data visualization engineers to build forecasts and craft research that elevates how our businesses operate. We transform our industry-leading data with our expertise in statistics and economics into actionable insights that inform decisions at every level of the company. Our work combines state of the art quantitative methods across forecasting, data science, and causal inference to help answer practical questions for our business leaders.
About the role
At Zillow, interns do meaningful work that contributes to the business from day one. Our 9 week summer internship program, running June 14th through August 13th, gives students the opportunity to bring their ideas and perspectives to real projects alongside Zillow teams.

Interns build hands-on experience, connect with mentors and leaders, and take part in learning and community experiences with their intern cohort. Our 2027 internships are based in Seattle and follow a hybrid schedule, with interns generally working together in person Tuesday through Thursday. Eligible interns will receive a stipend to help offset summer housing and relocation costs.

We’re looking for students who are analytical and detail-oriented with the ability to create structure from ambiguity. You have an intense curiosity to learn and can do so in a fast-paced dynamic environment. If you are not afraid of working with large amounts of data, you’ll get the chance to make it all come together into meaningful metrics used to make strategic business decisions.

During your internship, you will have opportunities to: 
• Partner with your manager and stakeholders to translate open-ended business questions into an analytical approach, with clear deliverables that will directly translate to tangible benefits to revenue. 
• Explore, clean, and validate housing, economic, business, or financial data; document assumptions and identify data-quality issues.
• Build and compare models to support prediction and forecasting.
• Transform observational data into causal models using clever identification
• Design experiments to improve how we price and operate across our different businesses 
• Evaluate models using appropriate baselines and time-based validation, and communicate uncertainty, limitations, and trade-offs.
• Investigate trends, forecast errors, and drivers of business performance to develop actionable insights.
• Create reproducible analyses, visualizations, or reporting workflows that help partners understand and use your findings.
• Share your approach, results, and recommendations with technical and nontechnical audiences, and document your work for a clear handoff.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $104,000.00 - $166,000.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
Who you are
• Currently pursuing a Masters or PhD in statistics, economics, data science, applied mathematics, quantitative finance, or a related quantitative field, with an expected graduation between December 2027 and Summer 2028. 
• Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and regression analysis, with exposure to econometrics. Specifically time-series and causal analysis through coursework and research experience.
• Use AI tools to accelerate and expand their work without outsourcing their own thinking to it.
• Can use Python or similar to prepare data, conduct analysis, and build models. Even if you’re not writing code anymore, we expect an ability to express statistical concepts clearly through pseudocode and think through edgecases when designing systems. 
• Can explain analytical findings clearly and collaborate with people who bring different perspectives and expertise including non technical stakeholders.
• Move quickly and ambitiously without sacrificing attention to detail; enjoy zooming in and out based on context. 
• Approach problems thoughtfully: you check your assumptions, validate results, and distinguish what the data supports from what remains uncertain.
• Are interested in applying quantitative methods to housing markets, business forecasting, and financial decision-making.

Get to know us
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
About Inmar Intelligence
Inmar Intelligence provides data-driven technology and solutions that help businesses operate more efficiently across retail, healthcare, and digital commerce. Our teams work collaboratively to solve complex business challenges through technology, analytics, and innovation. 

At Inmar, we foster a High Challenge, High Support environment grounded in collaboration, continuous improvement, and a Customer First mindset.

About This Opportunity
Inmar Intelligence is seeking a part-time Data Science Intern to support the MarTech Data Science team. This position provides an opportunity to gain practical experience while contributing to ongoing data science and analytics initiatives.

The MarTech Data Science team designs, develops, and deploys data science and engineering solutions supporting Inmar's media and incentives businesses. The intern will assist with data pipelines, machine learning models, and analytics solutions that support business needs and product development.

What You'll Do
• Assist in developing and maintaining reusable components for data transformation, feature extraction, and model deployment using cloud technologies, primarily Google Cloud Platform.
• Support the development and deployment of machine learning models and analytics pipelines.
• Collaborate with internal teams to develop data-driven solutions for business and product needs.
• Assist with ad-hoc analyses and identify opportunities to improve or standardize recurring analytical processes.
• Utilize AI tools to support coding, analysis, and problem-solving while following appropriate validation and review practices.
• Contribute to ongoing team projects and technical documentation as needed.

Your Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Data Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
• Experience with SQL and cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform. Experience with AWS, Azure, or Spark is also relevant.
• Experience with statistical programming languages and machine learning frameworks, including Python, R, SAS, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and problem-solving tools, including appropriate validation and review practices.
• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Ability to work part-time onsite in Winston-Salem, NC, while enrolled in an academic program.

Why Intern at Inmar Intelligence
This part-time internship provides an opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a professional setting while gaining experience with data science, machine learning, and cloud-based technologies.

Interns work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to ongoing projects, and develop technical and professional skills through practical experience and collaboration.

The position is designed to accommodate continued academic enrollment while providing meaningful work experience during the school year.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.

Scammers sometimes impersonate Inmar recruiters on LinkedIn and other channels. We will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. Verify any role on our official Workday Careers site and learn how to spot scams in our full notice.

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.

ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.

At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.

Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.

Analog Design Intern – CSS Audio
Location: Edinburgh, Scotland
Job Description
Analog Devices is seeking an Analog Design Intern to join our Consumer Audio design team in Edinburgh.
The successful candidate will join a collaborative team developing the next generation of high-performance mixed-signal audio solutions. Working alongside experienced analog, mixed-signal and digital design engineers, the intern will contribute to real IC development activities while developing practical experience in transistor-level design, modelling, simulation and verification.
Our audio products combine precision analog and mixed-signal circuits, data converters, Class-D amplification and power-management functions. This internship provides an opportunity to apply university knowledge to real silicon designs and to develop an understanding of the complete IC development process.
Responsibilities
• Conduct circuit architecture research and feasibility studies.
• Design, simulate and verify analog and mixed-signal IC blocks under the guidance of experienced engineers.
• Develop simulation testbenches and contribute to design verification across process, voltage and temperature conditions.
• Analyse circuit performance and understand key trade-offs involving noise, distortion, power consumption, silicon area and robustness.
• Work closely with layout engineers during physical implementation and review.
• Participate in technical and design reviews.
• Support integration and verification of circuit blocks within larger mixed-signal systems.
• Where appropriate, contribute to behavioural/system-level modelling and silicon evaluation activities.
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a BEng, MEng, MSc or PhD in Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or a closely related discipline.
• Good understanding of analog circuit fundamentals and CMOS device operation.
• Familiarity with common analog building blocks such as amplifiers, comparators, references, bias circuits and oscillators.
• Understanding of feedback, frequency response and circuit stability.
• Some experience with circuit simulation and electronic design tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability and enthusiasm to work collaboratively within an engineering team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with transistor-level IC design and Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre.
• Understanding of ADCs, DACs or delta-sigma conversion.
• Understanding of Class-D amplifiers or other audio signal-chain circuits.
• Familiarity with switched-mode power supplies such as buck, boost or charge-pump converters.
• Experience with MATLAB, Python or similar modelling/data-analysis tools.
• Experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, signal generators and audio/precision measurement equipment.
• A genuine interest in analog IC design and a passion for audio.

Analog Design Intern – CSS Power Management
Location: Edinburgh, Scotland
Job Description
Analog Devices is seeking an Analog Design Intern – Power Management to join our engineering team in Edinburgh.
The successful candidate will join a collaborative team developing advanced low-power analog and power-management IP for highly integrated mixed-signal ICs. Working alongside experienced analog, mixed-signal and power-management engineers, the intern will contribute to real IC development activities while gaining practical experience in circuit architecture, transistor-level design, modelling, simulation and verification.
The team develops power-management solutions with a strong focus on low-power operation, high efficiency and small solution size. Key areas include switched-mode DC/DC converters such as buck, boost and buck-boost architectures, together with the analog building blocks required for their control, monitoring and protection.
This internship provides an opportunity to apply university knowledge to real silicon designs and develop an understanding of the complete IC development process, from architecture and modelling through circuit implementation, physical design, verification and potentially silicon evaluation.
Responsibilities
• Conduct circuit architecture research and feasibility studies for low-power power-management functions.
• Contribute to the architecture, design, simulation and verification of DC/DC converter IP, including buck, boost and buck-boost topologies.
• Design and analyse analog sub-circuits used within power converters, potentially including error amplifiers, comparators, voltage/current references, oscillators, gate drivers, level shifters, current-sensing circuits and protection functions.
• Develop simulation testbenches and contribute to design verification across process, voltage, temperature and operating-load conditions.
• Analyse important converter performance trade-offs including efficiency, quiescent current, transient response, output ripple, stability, silicon area and external component requirements.
• Explore different converter operating modes and control techniques to optimise efficiency across load conditions.
• Contribute to behavioural and system-level modelling to evaluate converter architectures and control-loop performance.
• Work closely with layout engineers during physical implementation, including review of parasitic effects and layout-dependent performance.
• Participate in technical and design reviews with experienced analog and power-management engineers.
• Support top-level integration and verification of power-management IP within larger mixed-signal systems.
• Where appropriate, contribute to laboratory evaluation and comparison of simulated and measured silicon performance.
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a BEng, MEng, MSc or PhD in Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or a closely related discipline.
• Good understanding of fundamental analog electronics and circuit theory.
• Understanding of CMOS devices and basic transistor-level circuit operation.
• Familiarity with feedback systems, frequency response and stability.
• Basic understanding of power electronics and switching circuits.
• Some experience with circuit simulation or electronic design tools through university, personal or industry projects.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Enthusiasm for learning and working collaboratively within an engineering team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Understanding of DC/DC converter architectures, particularly buck, boost or buck-boost converters.
• Familiarity with concepts such as PWM/PFM operation, feedback control, loop stability and transient response.
• Familiarity with transistor-level IC design and tools such as Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre.
• Exposure to power-converter modelling or simulation using tools such as SIMPLIS, MATLAB or Simulink.
• Understanding of common power-management building blocks such as LDOs, voltage/current references, comparators, oscillators, current sensing and gate drivers.
• Familiarity with low-power circuit-design techniques and quiescent-current optimisation.
• Experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads and signal generators.
• Programming or scripting experience using Python, MATLAB or similar tools for modelling, simulation or data analysis.
• A strong interest in analog IC design, power management and energy-efficient electronic systems.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Fixed Term & Temporary
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Interns for Summer 2027 who want to help build the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research internship. You will work like a founder within Salesforce: exploring high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, and seeing how ideas are validated with customers and turned into production-ready solutions. You will have the freedom to propose and explore new ideas, alongside mentors and research scientists, with access to Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, bring energy and focus to their work, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this internship offers a unique opportunity to do research with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

• Collaborate with research scientists and engineers on a project focused on real-world product impact, with the opportunity to publish your work at top-tier conferences.
• Explore research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.
• Help turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.
• Build models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.
• Learn how research partners with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.

You're Our Person If...

• You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or experience building AI research into real-world systems.
• You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.
• You are motivated by real-world impact and care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.
• You bring expertise in one or more core focus areas:• Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.
• Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.
• Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.
• Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.

• You can conduct research with guidance from mentors, and you are ready to grow toward independence and translate ideas into impactful systems.

Even Better If...

• You are a PhD or MS candidate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
• You have experience building and scaling ML models for real-world applications.
• You have strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g., ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).
• You are thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.
• You are a fantastic problem solver, able to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.
• You have excellent written and spoken communication skills.
• You collaborate effectively with teammates.

Internship Details
This is a Summer 2027 internship with a minimum duration of 12 weeks.

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. jobs.title: Hardware Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
As a Hardware Engineering Intern/Co-op for Rockwell Automation, you will join a dynamic team developing the next-generation of automation control systems. You'll contribute to all stages of hardware product development—from sub-circuit design and integration to functional analysis and regulatory compliance—while building key technical skills in a supportive environment. If you value knowledge sharing, teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement, Rockwell Automation is the place for you.

This position is full time, paid, internship from May 2027 through August 2027. It is located in Mayfield Heights, Ohio and does not provide relocation assistance. 

Your Responsibilities:
• Collaborate on an agile team to design electrical circuits, develop test requirements and execute hardware verification testing on new industrial automation products.
• Perform programming, functional analysis, and hands-on troubleshooting of electronic hardware prototypes. 
• Contribute to associated product design documentation and test reports.
• Participate in technical projects such as researching new technologies, implementing new circuit design tools, and troubleshooting failures. 
• Take ownership of assignments by understanding expected output, requesting help, and helping teammates.
• Build relationships with technical leads and peers to grow your knowledge of the product development lifecycle.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
• You must be currently pursuing a bachelor's or advanced degree from an accredited college or university.
• Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas for this internship. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
• Previous co-op/intern experience in Hardware Development
• Experience using design capture tools, able to understand schematics. 
• Graduating in December 2027 or later
• Basic knowledge of circuit theory and operation, including microprocessors, digital logic devices, analog and/or DC-power conversion, programmable devices (CPLDs, FPGAs).
• Hands-on experience with hardware test equipment, including debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
• Experience developing or using programs for product initialization, debug, or test (C/C++, Python, Ladder).
• Experience working with KiCAD, Eagle, and Altium
• Knowledge of industrial control systems, programmable logic controllers or similar devices.
• Experience performing product certification testing, such as testing to meet CE and IEC 61010
• Met on campus, national recruiting events, a Rockwell Automation-hosted event, or a targeted recruiting campaign
• Located within 50 miles our Mayfield Heights, Ohio location

What We Offer:
• Health Insurance
• 401k
• Paid holidays
• Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
• To learn more about our benefits package for interns, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $20 - $32/hour. Our benefits for the US can be found here. Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Audit Analytics Intern - AO
jobs.description:
About Our Job
The Auditor's Office, an independent agency of the City and County of Denver, delivers independent, transparent, and professional oversight to safeguard the public’s investments in the City and County of Denver. The Auditor has Charter authority to audit Denver’s agencies in accordance with generally accepted governmental auditing standards (GAGAS). Our audit reports are issued each month to the public through Denver’s Audit Committee. We review the efficiency and effectiveness of the city’s services and programs and provide recommendations for improvement. Our work is performed on behalf of everyone who cares about the city, including its residents, workers, and decision-makers.

The Auditor's Office of the City and County of Denver is seeking a highly motivated Audit Analytics Intern to perform data analytics supporting audit functions. Interns perform entry-level data analytics under the guidance of the Audit Analytics Manager. Our assignments enable you to learn about using data analytics to assess risks in city operational or financial performance, while providing analytics support for audit teams doing performance, financial-related, and/or IT audits and other studies of city departments and contract providers. 

Auditor’s Office employees are currently working a hybrid schedule. This position requires a combination of in-office attendance at our Downtown Denver location and remote work. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their remote work days. 

We provide a computer with all work-related software applications; you must have a stable home internet connection for any remote work.

Please submit your complete application as soon as possible as application reviews will begin immediately.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: 
• Assist the Audit Analytics Manager and team members with identifying data requirements for analytics team projects.
• Develop Python scripts to merge data sets, clean data, and create analyses to identify outliers, trends, or control failures.
• Use Python to automate data collection, analysis, and reporting steps.
• Use Microsoft Excel to examine data for outliers, trend analysis, or control tests.
• Write internal workpapers that describe your methodology and results.
• Present the results of analytical work to the Audit Analytics Manager and teammates.
• Assist in writing internal and external reports synthesizing analytical tests.
• As needed, present the results of analytical work to Auditor’s Office management, and the public if presenting at the city’s Audit Committee meeting.

About You
Our ideal candidate will surpass our minimum qualifications by possessing: 
• Strong organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
• Strong interest in working in the public sector after graduation from an advanced degree program.
• Experience using python to prepare and analyze data.
• Enrollment in a bachelor's degree or higher, with experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, or Statistics.
• 
We realize your time is valuable, so please do not apply if you do not have at least the following required minimum qualifications:

• Education Requirement: Current enrollment in an accredited college program leading to a bachelor’s or higher degree, or a recent college graduate (completed college program within 1 year).

Please complete an applicant profile and online application. Attach a copy of your resume, cover letter, and unofficial transcript for faster processing. Failure to fully complete the online application will result in your application materials being rejected. Statements such as “see resume” or “resume attached” will not be considered.

Please refrain from using AI in the application or interviewing process. We want to get to know you and understand your skills, abilities, and experiences. The use of AI in the writing of materials or in the participation of interviews will result in immediate disqualification.

jobs.title: Product Technical Development Intern - Digital Sciences Focus
jobs.description:
2027 Summer Intern - Product Technical Development - Digital Sciences Focus

Department Summary

Pharmaceutical Technical Development (PTDU) develops, delivers, and supports robust, cost-effective production methods and technologies for innovative therapeutics to meet the needs of Genentech’s Research, Development, Commercial, and Product Operations groups. The group has long been recognized as a world leader in developing large-scale manufacturing processes, sophisticated analytical methods, and effective drug delivery systems.

This internship position is located in South San Francisco, on-site 

Program Highlights

• Intensive 12-week, full time (40 hours per week) paid internship.
• A $2500 OSA Stipend
• Program start dates are in May and June 2027
• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry
• Final presentations of project work to senior leaders

Key Responsibilities

As a Digital Sciences intern, you can expect to leverage your programming, machine learning, and AI skills to contribute to digital projects, such as full-stack software applications and data science models, that will make an impact across the entire PTD organization. These projects are often aimed to enable greater insights from data, more innovative drug development, and faster delivery of medicines to patients. Previous internship projects have included but are not limited to:

• Developing an interactive, web-based tool that visualizes an antibody sequence and highlights notable characteristics of its constituent residues
• Synthetic lipid modeling with in-silico simulations 
• Creation and implementation of information databases and electronic laboratory notebook schemas
• In-silico protein stability studies
 
Who You Are

Education:

• Must be pursuing a bachelor's degree at the time of application (having completed at least 2 years of the degree program)
OR
• Must have attained a bachelor's degree within 2 years of your application date and must not be currently enrolled in a graduate program
• Relevant work experience with coding/computer science (e.g. Python, R, Flask, Django, React, etc.) in a research lab or biotechnology industry setting is desirable but not required.
• Must be able to work 40 hours/week for the duration of the 12 week internship.

Required majors: 

• Computer Science, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Biophysics, or related disciplines.

Other Qualifications

• Detail-oriented, enthusiastic, and self-directed individual who is excited about tackling complex and creative scientific challenges in an industrial setting.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
• Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.

jobs.title: Retail Risk Modeling Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?
The Retail Risk Modeling team specializes in leveraging large datasets to generate new insights and make fact-based decisions on how to profitably grow loan originations by balancing risk, pricing, operational efficiency, and customer impact. 
As a co-op analyst on the team, you will support the team on analyzing, implementing, and testing solutions to support real-time decision making for RBC’s lending business lines (credit cards, home equity financing, various unsecured loans, automotive financing, small business). You will have the opportunity to develop deep understanding of all of RBC's retail banking product offerings through advanced data analytics.

What will you do?
• Support in developing and maintaining AI and machine learning credit risk models used in the credit decisions related to RBC’s various lending business lines across all risk spectrums (from prime to subprime).

• Extract, clean, validate, and analyze usable data from multiple data sources/providers in a distributed compute environment to quantify borrower behavioral patterns and market dynamics.

• Support the construction of prediction systems through the usage of machine learning tools and advanced statistics to select features, create and optimize classifiers or regression models.

• Present result in a clear and concise manner for non-technical stakeholders and comprehensive model documentation.

What do you need to succeed?
Must-have:
• Currently enrolled in a related degree in computer science, finance, mathematics, statistics, or engineering.

• Hands-on SQL and Python coding skills.

• Understanding of advanced statistical methods, machine learning, and AI techniques for classification and regression tasks.

• Demonstrated capability with AI tools such as copilot

Nice to have:
• Experiences with large datasets and big data/cloud technologies (Hadoop, PySpark, S3).

• Experience in code sharing and version control solutions (GitHub).

• Ability to work with UNIX command line.

Please note: This posting is for a 8-months Winter 2027 Student placement with a start date of January 2027, and end date of August 2027. In order to be eligible for this 8-months Student position, you must either:
• Be returning back to school after the work term end-date of August 2027 ; or
• If you are not returning back to school (i.e. are graduating in August 2027), you must require the full 8-months work term as a mandatory component to in order to graduate successfully.
Please ensure that you meet these eligibility requirements before applying - candidates who apply but are found to be ineligible are not able to be considered.
We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we accept applications on a rolling basis, but please note that the formal application deadline is September 20, 2026. RBC is committed to supporting flexible work arrangements when and where available. The successful candidate for this role will be required to be located within Ontario for the duration of the work term. Details regarding the specific virtual, hybrid, and in-office arrangements for this Integrated Learning/ Co-op position are to be discussed with the Hiring Manager.

jobs.title: SSD Firmware Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Department Overview
The SSD Engineering team develops the firmware and software technologies that power Micron's industry-leading storage solutions. By leveraging embedded systems expertise, AI-enabled development practices, and innovative engineering methodologies, the team delivers high-performance, reliable SSD products for data center, enterprise, and cloud applications.

Position Overview
As an SSD Firmware Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to develop, test, and optimize firmware for Micron's SSD products. This role provides hands-on experience in embedded systems, firmware development, debugging, code quality improvement, and AI-assisted engineering workflows while contributing to the performance, reliability, and scalability of next-generation storage solutions.

Responsibilities
• Collaborate with firmware engineers to develop, test, and enhance SSD firmware functionality using modern software development and AI-assisted engineering tools.
• Debug and resolve firmware issues to improve product performance, reliability, and quality.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to software quality, maintainability, and development best practices.
• Develop and execute test plans to validate firmware features and support product qualification activities.
• Document firmware features, enhancements, and technical information for internal and external stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, coursework, academic projects, or firmware/software development activities.
• Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• Proficiency in C/C++ programming acquired through coursework, projects, internships, or research experience.
• Basic understanding of embedded systems, firmware development, debugging, and software engineering principles.
• Familiarity with generative AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI development platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
• Previous internship, research, or project experience in firmware, embedded software, storage systems, or software engineering.
• Knowledge of SSD technology, NAND flash memory, storage architectures, or data storage systems.
• Experience using software development tools such as Git, JIRA, or similar version control and project management platforms.
• Experience with scripting languages such as Python for automation, testing, or data analysis.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet project deadlines, and deliver high-quality technical solutions.
• Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and workflows to improve engineering productivity, software development, debugging, or technical analysis.

The US base salary range that Micron Technology estimates it could pay for this full-time position is:

$33.10 - $55.82 an hour
Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses and equity.
Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Job Description:
Role: TGI Intern
 
Overview
FleishmanHillard is seeking an intern with an interest in research and strategy to join its TRUE Global Intelligence team in one of the following U.S. office locations: Dallas, Los Angeles, New York, Seattle, St. Louis or Washington DC. This hybrid role will support both primary research and communications measurement, providing exposure to qualitative and quantitative research, media and social intelligence, audience analysis, and performance measurement.
 
Our team of analysts provides below-the-surface analytics, measurement, and insights discovery capabilities to help companies accomplish their business objectives. Furthermore, we assess audiences, channels and content – and the interplay among them – to arrive at the most actionable strategy. We are looking for someone who is curious, analytically minded, comfortable learning new tools and methods, and motivated to turn complex information into clear, evidence-based insights.
 
FleishmanHillard believes a diverse team brings a wider range of personal and professional experiences and perspectives. We recognize that diversity and inclusion benefit our agency, our clients, and the communities in which we work and live. To that end, we strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, veterans, and individuals with disabilities. As part of our ongoing effort to be the world’s most inclusive agency, we are committed to seeking candidates who possess and demonstrate a profound interest in furthering our DE&I goals. 

Responsibilities
· Monitor digital news stories
· Conduct secondary research via Google, research databases and other sources, including media and social platforms and emerging research tools; evaluating source credibility and synthesizing findings across multiple inputs
· Assist with qualitative and/or quantitative primary research projects, including conducting survey data cleaning, taking notes during focus groups/in-depth interviews, analyzing and QCing data, and contributing to research reports
· Support communications measurement and analytics projects by organizing, cleaning, validating and analyzing media, social, audience, survey and other datasets
· Assist with media analysis projects by creating charts in Excel and developing insights to explain key findings 
· Identify meaningful trends, patterns, anomalies and questions in data, and help connect findings to the communications or business question being addressed
· Build clear charts, tables and visualizations in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint that communicate analytical findings effectively
· Use AI-enabled and other emerging research tools responsibly to improve research efficiency, explore hypotheses and support analysis, while validating outputs and sources
· Employ excellent time management to deliver multiple assignments on deadline while collaborating across teams
 
Please submit your resume to apply. Cover letters are optional – though they can be an opportunity to discuss your interest in the internship in greater detail, or discuss your experience if it isn’t directly related to communications or research & analytics. Writing samples are optional as well, but highly encouraged.

· Ability to join us in a hybrid model of working in-person in one of our U.S. offices weekly.
· The ability to work 40 hours per week for a minimum of 6 months
· Bachelor’s degree or higher
· Academic coursework or professional experience in primary research, such as surveys, focus groups, or in-depth interviews
· Academic coursework or professional experience in secondary research, such as literature reviews, research papers and media summaries
· Innate curiosity to learn more and dig deeper
· Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to condense and summarize research data into meaningful findings
· Ability to evaluate source credibility, recognize limitations or inconsistencies in information, and maintain accuracy and data integrity
· Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills
· Collaborative team player able to integrate with a diverse team and respond constructively to feedback
· Proficient in Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint

jobs.title: Graduate Intern - Marine Hydrokinetic Data Curation
jobs.description:
Posting Title
(Year-Round) Graduate Intern - Marine Hydrokinetic Data Curation.
Location
CO - Golden.
Position Type
Intern (Fixed Term).
Hours Per Week
20.
Working at NLR
NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.
Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

Job Description
The NLR Data Engineering Group is seeking a Graduate Intern to serve as a curator for the Marine & Hydrokinetic Data Repository (MHKDR) and support other related domain-specific data repositories. These data repositories provide public access to the outcomes of official Department of Energy (DOE) funded research in the geothermal and marine and hydrokinetic sectors as well as research and development activities in other technologies including water purification, the energy-water nexus, renewable energy systems, and alternative energy systems. Work will consist of curating individual data submissions and advising researchers and scientists on better organizing their project data for submission. Submissions frequently relate to computational fluid dynamics, mechanical engineering, wave and current monitoring, structural testing, and various types of MHK energy converters.

Curation includes the review of metadata provided with each data submission for accuracy, completeness, and relevance to the submitted files. Curation also includes the organization of disparate submissions, creating consistency amongst metadata fields, adoption and implementation of emerging data standards and requirements, and the addition of supplemental information that may assist the DOE in categorizing data submissions. When necessary, curators contact submitters directly to resolve any discrepancies or omissions detected during the review. Because many data submissions involve complex or open-ended organizational challenges, the intern should be comfortable working independently, evaluating datasets critically, and proposing practical data organization and metadata solutions. The intern may also have opportunities to support other energy research projects through data organization, analysis support, or documentation of datasets used in ongoing research activities. 
 
The intern in this position is expected to contribute an average of 20 hours per week during semesters and 40 hours per week during breaks, including summer.

Key Responsibilities 
 
Data curators review and enhance data submissions to ensure metadata quality, consistency, and usability. Responsibilities include: 
• Curate marine and hydrokinetic datasets for metadata completeness, accuracy, and alignment with repository standards. 
• Apply data standards and identify gaps or inconsistencies in submissions. 
• Coordinate with data submitters to resolve issues and improve data quality and usability. 
• Occasionally support energy research, including data management, analysis support, and literature review. 
 
Our Team 
The Data Engineering group is a multi-disciplinary team of data and software engineers, data scientists, and product developers that are at the forefront of developing advanced data solutions for strategic energy analysis at scale. Our work is focused on making energy data and software more accessible, usable, and actionable for researchers and engineers at NLR and beyond. You will join a team where everyone is striving to improve their knowledge of software development best-practices, while caring about creating the best possible solution to cutting edge problems. 

Our team creates secure, reusable, and efficient code, while supporting a variety of teams: 
• A collaborative, fast paced, and fun work environment. 
• Endless opportunities to learn and grow from experienced professionals in both web development and renewable energy. 
• Work developing cutting-edge projects and contributing to research in the renewable energy industry. 
• A life-long desire to build better a future through technology and data. 
 
Mission and Vision 
NLR strives to achieve our vision of an affordable and secure energy future through our mission: leading research, innovation, and strategic partnerships to deliver integrated solutions for an affordable and secure energy future. 
 
As the energy systems laboratory, we bridge foundational research with practical applications to ensure various energy sources, storage, buildings, transportation, and emerging technologies work together to lower energy costs, drive economic growth, bolster national security, and deliver abundant energy.

The purpose of this internship is to prepare students for entry into the business world by providing a thorough understanding of the various functions of the Zebra Technologies organization. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Digital Solutions and Enterprise Applications team develops innovative software platforms that enable business operations, automation, and digital transformation across Micron. By using modern software engineering practices, AI technologies, and cloud-native solutions, the team delivers scalable applications that improve productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency throughout the organization.

Position Overview
As a Software Engineering Intern, you will help design, develop, and support software solutions that address critical business needs across Micron. You will gain hands-on experience building full-stack applications, AI agents, automation solutions, and enterprise platforms while working with modern development tools, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and enhance software solutions that improve business processes, productivity, and operational efficiency.
