jobs.description:
Overview:
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
 
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:
The purpose of this internship is to prepare students for entry into the business world by providing a thorough understanding of the various functions of the Zebra Technologies organization. The program is designed to provide students with experiences that provide insights into a career with Zebra. Students will be positioned for success with training and hands-on experiences, invited to social and development activities, and provided a professional mentor relationship.

The Supplies & Sensors R&D Team designs and develops next generation smart media, specialty environmental indicators, and advanced asset tracking solutions. The team is a multidisciplined research unit focused on delivering a smart and frictionless product portfolio for our customers. Ultimately, this research bridges the gap between physical tracking and real-time digital intelligence driving operational excellence in global supply chains across many industries.

US Summer Internship Benefits:
Summer Fridays, As Applicable With Your Team
30+ Social and Professional Events in 12 Weeks
Global Immersion With Your Teams and Interns
Intern Allowance (when applicable)The purpose of this internship is building and developing the innovation portfolio as well as promotion of R&D innovation company-wide. Driving forward R&D Pipeline Projects following the Product Development Processes. Monitoring next generation sensor technology advancement including competitive developments. Supporting the business in technical and scientific aspects including complaints resolution and requests for technical information.
 
The prospective intern will be focusing on is the development of a BLE enabled printable wristband device. Such a device should be able to provide sensor data and real time location services to enable actionable insights and data orchestration for ambient intelligence. The responsibilities as it relates to this project and the overall role within the team are outlined below.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Development of Smart Media with ability to sense various environmental conditions from temperature, light, water/humidity, and bacteria via digital and/or chemical methods
• Product development and Innovation around sensors including a variety of topics. Project scope ranging from low hanging fruits to disruptive ones with high potential impact
• Consider manufacturability, customer experience, and data orchestration of Smart Devices in the design of any new product and innovation
• Optimize Radio Frequency systems to improve Smart Device communication within technology ecosystems
• Streamline outdated R&D workflows and consider what changes could be made to improve the R&D innovation experience
• Develop planning, organizational and leadership skills
• Increase technology knowledge and skills
• Develop team-based work proficiencies
• Develop interpersonal skills to connect with day-to-day business contacts through follow up activities
 
This position requires hybrid work (3 days/week in office) in the Morris Plains, NJ office.
Required Qualifications:
• Current enrollment in an undergraduate/graduate (MS/MBA) degree program in Material Science, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Electrochemistry
• Must have an anticipated graduation date between 2027-2028 for undergraduate students or 2027-2029 for graduate students
• Must be authorized to work in the US without requiring sponsorship now or in the future
 
Preferred Qualifications:
• Understanding of Radio Frequency communication systems and protocols such as NFC, UHF RFID, BLE, WIFI and associated small form factor energy systems (both passive and active)
• Materials Characterization experience using analytical instrumentation (SEM, XRD, XPS, Raman, DSC, TGA, UV-Vis, FTIR, particle size analyzers, optical microscopy, surface and interface analysis)
• Hands on experience in 3D printing, small electronics/PCB assembly, Roll-to-Roll converting
• Communication Skills – Clear and effective verbal and written communication
• Adaptability and Learning Agility – Willingness to learn quickly, embrace new tools or methods, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Sony Corporate Technology Center America, a branch of Sony AI, is a remotely distributed organization spread across the U.S. and Canada. Sony AI is Sony’s new research organization pursuing the mission to use AI to unleash human creativity. Sony AI works closely with Sony’s other business units, including Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC., Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc., and Sony Music Entertainment. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: https://ai.sony/
About Sony Ethical Creative and Protective AI Lab
Sony is dedicated to driving innovation, advancing technology and ensuring that AI is developed
responsibly, ethically, and inclusively. The Ethical Creative and Protective AI Lab focuses on creating frameworks, tools, and methodologies that advance the state-of-the-art, while promoting trust, transparency, fairness, and accountability in AI systems and technologies.

Position Summary
We are seeking a motivated and passionate Research Engineer Intern to join our interdisciplinary team working at the forefront of Responsible AI for a 3 month internship. As an intern, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects using multimodal generative AI to address fundamental challenges associated with AI adoption in a global multimedia company. This internship will provide you with hands-on experience exploring the responsible development of
generative AI and offers a unique opportunity to work alongside researchers and engineers in a globally diverse team.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
● Contribute to post-training and evaluation infrastructure for a novel multimodal AI
system.
● Fine-tune models using supervised learning and reinforcement learning-based
approaches (e.g., SFT, RLAIF, RLVR)
● Define and implement custom metrics for evaluating different fine-tuning approaches.
● Contribute to the development of tools and frameworks to assess and mitigate AI-related
risks in generative AI.
● Contribute to influential research outcomes in top-tier conferences and journals.
● Be self-motivated and capable of proposing and implementing innovative ideas.
● Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above

QUALIFICATIONS FOR POSITION 
Your qualifications and experience should include:  
● Completed or currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or
related scientific discipline.
● Strong preference for hands-on experience with RL fine-tuning of LLMs and/or VLMs.
● Experience with LLM/VLM tooling and frameworks, API integration, and prompt
engineering.
● Familiarity with and interest in responsible AI development.
● Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals.
● Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The target hourly rate for this internship is $50.00 per hour. The individual will be paid hourly and eligible for overtime.

jobs.title: Data Quality & Systems Intern
jobs.description:
Data Quality & Systems Intern
Location: Weybridge
 
JOB PURPOSE:

As businesses become increasingly connected and automated, the quality and reliability of data have never been more important.

As our Data Quality & Systems Intern, you'll join the B2B Application Support team at Sony Semiconductor Solutions, helping to ensure the systems and data that support our supply chain, sales and marketing activities run smoothly and efficiently.

You'll gain hands-on experience analysing data, identifying inconsistencies and solving real business challenges, while exploring opportunities to improve processes through automation and smarter ways of working.

Working alongside experienced colleagues, you'll develop valuable analytical, problem-solving and technical skills, gaining an insight into how technology and data support business decisions and day-to-day operations across an international organisation.

This is an opportunity to go beyond working with data, you'll help make it more accurate, reliable and valuable to the business.
 
Start date: 5 July 2027
Disclaimer: Due to high volumes, this job posting may be closed earlier than planned, so don’t hesitate to apply if you are interested.
 
The Job
 
What will you be doing?

• Purchase Order and Reservation Order Reconciliation: Perform daily reconciliation of purchase orders and reservation orders between SAP and our demand planning tool.
• Data Quality Checks: Review daily reports from the demand planning tool to identify missing six-digit material codes and take the necessary corrective action.
• SharePoint User Management: Update SharePoint user groups monthly to ensure that access permissions reflect current user requirements.
• SharePoint Improvement Project (Optional): Support a project to remove outdated documents, refresh existing content, and improve the overall look and structure of SharePoint.
• Customer-Material Registration: Register new customer and material combinations in our demand planning tool.
• Customer EDI Interface Monitoring: Review customer EDI interface reports, identify missing or incomplete combinations and information, and liaise with the relevant business teams to ensure that records are updated.
• Forecast Reporting: Generate ad hoc reports covering sales forecasts, customer forecasts, and marketing forecasts.
 
What do we need you to bring?
 
• Analytical Thinking: An analytical mindset with an eye for detail and a willingness to investigate data discrepancies.
• Communication Skills: The ability to communicate clearly and effectively with colleagues across different teams.
• Enthusiasm for Microsoft Excel: A strong interest in using Excel to analyse data, identify discrepancies, and improve processes.
• Collaboration: A willingness to work closely with different teams and stakeholders.
• Business Curiosity: An interest in understanding business processes, customer requirements, and the reasons behind data discrepancies.
• A Willingness to Learn: The confidence to try new approaches, learn from mistakes, and ask for support when needed.
• Teamwork: Be willing to support teammates and learn from the people around you
 
Our Recruitment Process
 
• After you have submitted your application, selected candidates will be asked to complete a self-service video interview.
• After we have carefully reviewed all the video interviews, those who successfully meet our hiring criteria will be invited to an interview with our hiring team.
• During or prior to the interview, there will be an additional case-study task for applicants to complete. Why? This not only allows us to see what you can do but also enables you to get a taste of what your day-day work will entail.
• After the interviews have concluded, we’ll move to the offer stage, and before you know it, you’ll be here at Sony!
 
Throughout the recruitment process until your start date, you’ll have regular connections with our HR & Sony Placement Year programme team, as well as our current interns to answer any questions and provide guidance and further information on your Sony journey. This will also allow you to connect with the other future interns who will form the 2027 Sony cohort and start building your network. If you will need to relocate, this is also a great opportunity to find others in the same situation.
 
Your new office
 
Weybridge
 
Based at the Weybridge office, you will enjoy a vibrant and friendly working environment. We have an onsite canteen with a wide range of options available, and a barista style coffee shop. There is a well-provisioned onsite gym run by our own Sony Wellbeing Coordinator, with classes on set days in the mornings, at lunch and after work hours. We have a staff car park which includes electric charging points, an undercover and secure bike rack (useful if you’ve made the most of the Cycle-to-Work scheme), or if you will use public transport, we have a shuttle bus service that regularly runs between train station and the office at peak times.
 
We currently require our Weybridge based employees to work on site a minimum 3-days per full working week.
 
Take a look at our video tour of the Weybridge site here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lwbMOzjoVA

Equal Opportunity
 
Sony Europe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, medical condition, or any other protected characteristics.
 
Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Sony Europe
 
Sony Europe will provide reasonable accommodation for any qualified individual with disabilities in the application process. For reasonable accommodation requests, please contact us by email at AccommodationRequest@eu.sony.com or by mail to: Sony Europe B.V, Human Resources Department, the Heights, Brooklands, Surrey, KT13 0XW, UK. When contacting us please indicate the position you are applying for, and the accommodation required.

The Storage and Memory Systems (SMS) Pathfinding team explores future memory and storage technologies that enable next-generation AI, high-performance computing, and data-centric systems. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for ASIC SDK and new switch products. Develops software including Linux operating systems, networks, utilities, and Linux debug tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Has the ability to understand RTL, write C/C++, Python, Rust, Go Lang.

Management Level Definition:
Contributions include applying intermediate level of subject matter expertise to solve common technical problems. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and recommendations for appropriate action. Works independently within an established framework and with moderate supervision.

Applies knowledge acquired in his college courses to solve complex business issues. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and processes. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Contributes to process improvements and establishing policies. • Provides tangible feedback to improve product quality and mitigate risk failures.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines.

Knowledge and Skills:

jobs.title: Applied Research Intern - Integrated Sensing and Communications
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is looking for a graduate research intern to help advance integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) on NVIDIA GPU-accelerated platforms! The right person will join a team building AI-native wireless systems, as well as develop, train, and test ISAC algorithms end-to-end on the NVIDIA Aerial Testbed, which combines our GPU-accelerated 5G/6G software stack with real over-the-air radios. This role suits a student who enjoys both deep algorithm work and turning ideas into working systems.

What you’ll be doing:
• Develop, implement, and benchmark ISAC algorithms in Python on NVIDIA GPU platforms.
• Build radar signal processing pipelines, including radar cube formation, range and Doppler processing, angle estimation, CFAR detection, and clutter suppression (for example MTI, static clutter removal, and adaptive filtering).
• Compose new ML model architectures for sensing and joint sensing-communications tasks, and formulate the corresponding loss functions and optimization objectives.
• Train and evaluate models in PyTorch using both simulated data and data captured over the air.
• Integrate your algorithms with the NVIDIA Aerial Testbed and run real-time, over-the-air experiments.
• Detail your results and contribute to publications, patents, and internal technical reports.

What we need to see:
• Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Strong background in AI/ML for wireless communications.
• Solid understanding of ISAC concepts and waveforms, such as OFDM-based sensing.
• Hands-on experience implementing ISAC or radar algorithms in Python.
• Hands-on experience with PyTorch or another machine learning framework (for example TensorFlow or JAX).
• Confirmed ability to build new ML model architectures and formulate optimization and loss functions.
• Knowledge of the signal processing aspects of ISAC, including radar cube algorithms and clutter reduction techniques.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative research team.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• PhD candidate with publications in ISAC, radar, or ML for wireless.
• Hands-on experience with real-time over-the-air wireless testbeds, such as software-defined radios (for example USRP) or 5G testbeds.
• Experience with GPU programming or acceleration (CUDA, CuPy, or similar).
• Familiarity with NVIDIA Aerial (CUDA-Accelerated RAN, Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin) or NVIDIA Sionna.
• Knowledge of the 3GPP 5G NR physical layer and 6G ISAC study items.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Company
Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas

We are dedicated to serving the public by promoting a strong financial system and a healthy economy for all. These efforts take a team of dedicated individuals doing many different jobs. Together we’re creating a workplace where talented people can thrive, and we welcome your unique background and perspective to help present the best possible solutions for our partners. 

Location: #LI-Onsite. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please notify your Talent Acquisition Consultant.

ABOUT THE DALLAS FED: 

At the Dallas Fed we serve the public by partnering with communities and businesses, promoting jobs and stable prices, and keeping your money safe and available. We welcome different perspectives, ideas, and experiences. As part of the nation’s central bank, we are committed to improving the economy and our communities. Are you ready to make a difference? 
  
Learn more about the Dallas Fed: www.dallasfed.org/fed. 
  
ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP PROGRAM:

The Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas Internship Program is a prestigious, cohort-based experience that attracts top talent from across the country for paid, full-time summer internships spanning majors and functional areas – from economic research and finance to Cash Services, IT, and beyond. While interns take on a specific functional role for the summer with meaningful work and opportunities to grow, the program offers much more than a single assignment. Dedicated staff mentors help launch your career, and curated cohort programming provides broad exposure to central banking, direct access to senior leaders and industry experts, and dedicated learning and development opportunities. As part of the Federal Reserve System, you'll also build a professional network of peers that spans the nation. The program runs approximately for 10-12 weeks, beginning in mid-to-late May and concluding in August. For this specific position, you will be located in the Dallas office.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Oshkosh, we build, serve and protect people and communities around the world by designing and manufacturing some of the toughest specialty trucks and access equipment. We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.

The Engineer – Software team member will support the implementation and test of high-quality vehicle control software. The team member must be able to write embedded C/C++, Matlab autogenerated software to run on embedded platforms that controls various vehicle systems through network messaging and directly connected inputs and outputs. 

YOUR IMPACT: 
• Under close supervision, perform basic engineering calculations, investigations, and tasks as assigned according to Oshkosh, as well as general industry, engineering standards and processes.
• Support senior engineers in the preparation of basic plans, designs, computation methods, and/or reporting.
• Under close supervision, work on projects of limited complexity in a support role.
• Collaborate as needed with other engineering or business support disciplines internally as well as suppliers externally.
• Ability to write high-quality, maintainable, C/C++, Matlab autogenerated software.
• Participate in peer reviews, estimation, and other engineering activities.
• Follow defined CMMI level 3 process and procedures in the writing of software.
• Ability to travel off-site to support engineering projects. 
• Design, implement and document real-time embedded software written in C/C++.
• Support supervisor, engineers, and other departments to execute job assignments.
• Responsible for the design and implementation of software to meet various requirements which include: functionality, memory utilization, performance and maintainability.
• Read and create software designs in UML.
• Provide technical assistance for prototype, pilot and production software.
• Follow good software practices including the use of version control, change control and issue tracking software.
• Participate in project time estimation, technical proposals and decision analysis.
• Other duties as assigned.
• Regular attendance is required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: 
• Accredited Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field with Internship experience or six (6) or more months of related work experience.

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS: 
• Accredited Bachelor's degree in Software, Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering. 
• Familiarity with JavaScript, JSON, Python, or CAN, in addition to embedded C/C++.

CORE COMPETENCIES:
• Internal Contacts: Contact with peers and others involving explanation of information (these contacts may be within or outside department or division), and the gathering of factual information; may include the communication of sensitive or confidential information.
• External Contacts: Limited external contact to gather information, answer queries, or ask assistance.
• Communication Skills: Read, write and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence and memos; Read and interpret safety rules, operating/maintenance instructions and procedure manuals; Write routine reports, correspondence and speak effectively before both internal and external groups; Read, analyze and interpret business manuals, technical procedures and/or government regulations: Read, analyze and interpret scientific and technical journals, financial reports and legal documents.
• Decision-Making: Regularly makes decisions of responsibility, involving evaluation of information. Decisions may require development or application of alternatives or precedents. 
• Complexity, Judgment and Problem Solving: Generally structured work, but involving a choice of action within limits of standard policy and procedures.
• Supervisory/Managerial: General instructing, scheduling, and reviewing the work of others performing the same or directly related work. Acts as “lead worker”.

WORKING CONDITIONS: 
• Physical Demands: Frequent: Standing, Walking/Running, Sitting, Reaching, Hearing, Talking, Visual, Typing; Occasional: Driving, Fine Dexterity, Manual Dexterity; Upper Extremity Repetitive Motion; Seldom: Lifting/Carrying 25lbs., Pushing/Pulling 25llbs.
• Non-Physical Demands: Frequent: Analysis/Reasoning, Communication/Interpretation, Math/Mental Computation, Reading, Sustained Mental Activity (i.e. auditing, problem solving, grant writing, composing reports), Writing.
• Environmental Demands: Frequent: Work Alone, Frequent Task Changes, Tedious/Exacting Work; Occasional: High Volume Public Contact.
• Work Schedule: Routine shift hours. Infrequent overtime, weekend, or shift rotation.
• Demands/Deadlines: Occasional stress due to deadlines or workload because of intermittent or cyclical work pressures, or occasional exposure to distressed individuals within the immediate work environment.

Pay Range: 
$68,600.00 - $109,200.00

jobs.title: Graduate Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Build a career powered by innovations that matter! At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

Graduate Electronics Engineering Scheme

Stockport, Greater Manchester | 24-Month Graduate Programme
Launch Your Engineering Career in Advanced Technology
Immediate Start

Are you graduating in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline and looking for a role where you can apply your knowledge from day one?

The Novanta Bee Graduate Scheme is a structured two-year programme designed to develop future Electronics Engineers within our world-leading CO₂ laser business. You'll gain hands-on experience across manufacturing, testing, process improvement, quality, and engineering while working on technology used in medical, industrial and automation applications.

What you will do:
Over 24 months, you will progress from learning our products and manufacturing processes to leading engineering projects and solving complex technical challenges.

You will:
• Build expertise in electronic assembly, testing and fault finding
• Work alongside experienced engineers and technicians
• Support process improvement and quality initiatives
• Participate in engineering and new product introduction projects
• Learn Lean Manufacturing and problem-solving methodologies
• Gain exposure to ECNs, validation activities and manufacturing systems
• Travel internationally for specialist product training
• Present your work and achievements to senior leaders

What we are looking for:
• Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related engineering discipline
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• A genuine interest in technology and engineering
• Curiosity, initiative and a hands-on approach
• Strong communication and teamwork skills

Why Join Novanta?
• Structured 24-month development programme
• Mentoring from experienced engineers
• International training opportunities
• Exposure to advanced laser technology
• Lean and Continuous Improvement training
• Real project ownership and business impact
• Clear progression into an Electronics Engineering career path

Your Future:
By the end of the programme, you'll have the skills, experience and confidence to progress into an Electronics Engineering role, supporting the development and manufacture of technologies that make a difference across healthcare, life sciences and advanced industry.

Start your engineering career with Novanta and help build innovations that matter.

We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, for example with applications, interviews, or assessments, please inform the Talent Acquisition Partner.
We will work with you to understand your needs and make appropriate arrangements so you can perform at your best.

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

Northrop Grumman is seeking Associate Pathways Electronics Engineer / Electronics Engineer. This position will be located at our Space Systems Sector in Rolling Meadows, IL. This position will be in the Pathways rotational program where there will be three rotation opportunities within engineering.
 
The qualified candidate will become part of Northrop Grumman’s Electronics and Payload Engineering homeroom, in the Electrical Design & Technology group. The primary tasks for this rotation are supporting power supply testing, troubleshooting, and documentation in the Power Conversion Technology group.

This requisition may be filled at either a level 1 or a level 2. Basic qualifications for an Associate Electronics Engineer (level 1) is a Bachelor’s Degree. Basic qualifications for a Electronics Engineer (level 2) is a Master’s Degree.

• Have basic circuit knowledge and understanding

• Knowledge of passive circuit components and semiconductor devices
• Circuit simulation experience such as LTSpice/PSpice, Simulink/Simscape, Saber, etc.
• Coursework or knowledge of power electronics

Do you want to take on a new challenge?
Welcome to ZEISS.
ZEISS is an internationally leading technology company operating in the optics and optoelectronics industries. ZEISS is shaping technological progress and through its solutions is extending the horizon of the world of optics and associated areas.
ZEISS consists of four segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology and Consumer Markets.

Working within the Microscopy Research & Development department at ZEISS, we are looking for a Software Engineer to join a collaborative team developing software for world-leading electron microscopy systems. This is an exciting opportunity to work on applications that directly support scientific research and technological innovation, whilst gaining exposure to a broad range of software and system-level engineering challenges.

• Developing and enhancing software for advanced microscopy and imaging systems
• Working with C#, Windows-based technologies and desktop application development
• Investigating, troubleshooting and resolving software and system-level issues

• Good understanding of Windows as a platform and how software interacts with operating systems and hardware

• A curious and proactive approach, with a genuine desire to learn and develop new skills

jobs.description:
Research Scientist
Huntsville, AL – This is an on-site position
No clearance required to start with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI
 
The Defense Sector at Leidos is seeking a talented Research Scientist. In the Leidos Autonomy and Artificial Intelligence branch, you will work to solve complex engineering problems with a highly technical, multidisciplinary team consisting of aerospace engineers, computer scientists, research scientists, and statisticians. This group provides cutting-edge solutions to aerospace and defense problems such as autonomous battle management, robotic vehicle guidance, and model-based system identification. 
 
Primary Responsibilities:
• Develop solutions to aerospace and defense problems by applying a variety of engineering, AI/ML, and software technical skills.
• Solve open-ended research problems across several different aerospace domains. 
• Utilize technical skills to work through tasks involving dynamical modeling and simulation, machine learning (e.g., supervised learning, reinforcement learning), algorithm development, and data visualization. The aforementioned skills and solutions are expected to be implemented in software via programming languages such as Python. 
• Leverage internal resources (e.g., software toolkits), collaborate with peers and experienced professionals, and learn independently. 
• Each engineer should be able to comfortably and effectively communicate technical results of their analysis to peers.
 
Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree and 0-2 years of prior relevant experience or a master's degree with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience. 
• US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.
• Advanced proficiency in programming, specifically including Python and MATLAB.
• Fundamental understanding of mathematical concepts, including linear algebra, matrix math, statistics, trigonometry, and coordinate frames. 
• Fundamental understanding of core aerospace concepts, such as vehicle and attitude dynamics, control systems, and flight mechanics. 
• Computer Science / Math: Understanding of machine learning basics, supervised learning, reinforcement learning, and statistics. 
• Ability to perform independent research to learn new skills. 
• Ability to work both in collaborative team environments and independently on open-ended research problems. 
• Effective technical communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications:
• US Citizen with an active TS/SCI security clearance.
• Research experience or prior internship positions. 
• Experience with C++. 
• Experience with Linux. 
• Experience with version control systems (e.g. Git).

Location: Work-at-Home/Remote

We are America’s leading health solutions company delivering care in ways no one else can. Our purpose is simple and clear: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. At CVS Health, we possess an extensive repository of data that spans over 150 million individuals, providing an unparalleled foundation for ambitious Data Scientists and Engineers. In this role, your work will underpin data driven business decisions and contribute to our mission of delivering the industry’s best data products with a customer first mindset and team-oriented approach. 
 
Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient, and affordable. 
 
About this business area:
Are you looking for a two-year program to learn how to code and become a full-stack automation engineer? 
 
Good news, CVS Health’s Information Security & Technology Solutions (ISTS) organization in IT is welcoming individuals to join our Infrastructure Software Engineering Program (ISEP). This is a two-year developmental program to learn how to be an automation engineer, work within a fast-paced IT organization, and support our customers. In this two-year program, you will receive training, support, hands-on experience, and feedback from more experienced developers. There will be built-in training, webinars, simulations, game days, and other fresh approaches to learning. We are truly investing in your future and your growth as a full-stack developer. This unique two-year program is built with the growth mindset, allowing you the time and experience to learn how to develop and support our shift towards a secure, AI-driven enterprise using modern delivery methods like Agile, DevSecOps, and Extreme Programming (XP). We are excited to welcome candidates to a unique opportunity to learn and support a Fortune 6 company. 
 
Join us to work on cutting-edge technology in the fields of IT Security, Automation, Network, Cloud, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

• Assisting in the support of existing applications and/or development efforts.
• Writing high-quality code compliant with enterprise and industry regulations.
• Collaborating with business analysts and product owners to ensure understanding of business priorities.
• Analyzing and improving the efficiency of various systems and services.

• Sharing knowledge openly and willingly with other IT business personnel.
• Troubleshooting problems identified by users.

• Work within model delivery frameworks (Agile, XP, Kanban) 
 
*Please note this position is available fully remote, preferably local to any state on the East Coast due to business needs.
Work visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
 
Required Qualifications:

• 6+ months of experience with AI/ML, GenAI, and agent development.
• 6+ months of experience programming, developing, or coding.

• Demonstrated history of continuous learning, growth, and improvement. 
• Ability to work well both independently and as part of a cohort.

Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Position Summary:
This job is responsible for developing or managing data sets, supporting reporting and analysis, and assisting with modeling activities to help manage risk and minimize losses. Key responsibilities include analyzing portfolio trends, developing data sets or queries to extract data, and supporting the curation of data for internal and external reporting needs. Job expectations include supporting new information and insights, often through statistical analysis. The Consumer and Small Business Credit Risk Data, Reporting, and Operations team delivers repeatable, sustainable, and well-controlled processes that support effective risk management across Consumer and Small Business products, including Credit Cards, Home Loans, Consumer Vehicle Lending, Deposits, and Small Business solutions. Our team partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to provide data-driven insights, produce reporting solutions, and support continuous process improvements that enhance decision-making, operational efficiency, and risk oversight to meet evolving business needs while maintaining strong governance and control standards.

Responsibilities:

• Supports reporting to allow risk and business partners to effectively identify and manage risk
• Analyzes information to support data design, portfolio trends, loss trends, and portfolio dynamics to support alignment with business strategies
• Assists product strategic initiatives affecting multiple risk functions and lines of business to ensure company goals are met
• Provides analytical support and utilizes analytical techniques to aggregate data
• Supports with responding to requests for information from both internal and external parties
• Provides assistance to remediate data quality issues by providing analytical support and assistance to cross-functional efforts
• Helps monitor the outputs of controls and supports the investigation of alerts from control checks
• Produce and maintain production-critical monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc credit risk reports that deliver accurate and timely information to stakeholders.
• Execute established reporting processes using SAS, SQL, Tableau, and other reporting tools to support ongoing business and risk management needs.
• Extract, transform, reconcile, and validate data from multiple sources in accordance with established governance and control standards.
• Perform audit-level quality assurance, data validations, and control procedures to ensure reporting accuracy and data integrity.
• Support portfolio monitoring activities by identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality concerns and escalating issues as appropriate.
• Partner with business stakeholders and senior team members to support reporting enhancements, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
• Document procedures and support compliance with enterprise governance, risk, and regulatory requirements.

• 0-2+ years of Reporting, Data Management, Analytics, Risk Management, or related experience
• Working knowledge of SAS, SQL, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to perform data QA, execute audit-level validations, and follow governance requirements
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within established timelines
• Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

• Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or other Business Intelligence tools
• Experience working with large datasets and relational databases
• Knowledge of reporting lifecycle and production support processes
• Understanding of data governance and data quality concepts
• Experience documenting procedures and business processes
• Ability to identify process improvement opportunities
• Experience using Agile, Jira, or other project tracking tools
• Strong attention to detail
• Collaboration and partnership skills
• Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and reporting methodologies

2026-10-20

United States of America

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Security Clearance Type: 
DoD Clearance: Secret

Security Clearance Status: 
Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

The Hardware Engineering Team provides engineering design & development services to a wide range of products within Raytheon. The Critical Item Production Readiness (CPR) department is dedicated to ensuring that every product we develop is designed with its entire production lifecycle in mind. By integrating principles of manufacturability, assembly, scalability, and cost management, we aim to achieve production excellence while meeting the highest standards of quality and reliability. 

CPR is seeking a Product Development Engineer (PDE) to join our team in Tucson, AZ. The PDE section is responsible for internal design activities, providing the expertise that optimizes electronic hardware designs for producibility. The PDE section provides electrical circuit design, strategic procurement relationships, and assembly services through project leadership to achieve cycle time, technology, and cost goals.

What You Will Do:
• Responsible for hosting and facilitating design reviews and collaborating with a multi-disciplined team which takes Printed Circuit Board (PCB) and Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) designs from inception to manufacturing.
• Drive design, procurement and build schedule to meet program need dates.
• Generate drawing notes and review Technical Data Package (TDP) to ensure adherence to IPC specs.
• Perform design for manufacturability analyses.
• BOM (Bill of Material) development and management.
• Review supplier data and lessons learned in order to ensure product excellence and continual improvement.
• Travel to visit suppliers.

Qualifications You Must Have:
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams or projects with ability to multi-task and establish schedule based on priorities.
• Self-starter that seeks to connect the dots between engineering disciplines and actively reaches out to Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

Qualifications We Prefer:
• Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET) is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard. 3.0 cumulative GPA desired.
• Familiarity with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T), engineering drafting standards, and overall producibility considerations related to electronic packaging.
• Familiarity with translating schematic capture into a producible layout.
• Familiarity with soldering and importance of workmanship.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes, specifically PCB and CCA.

What We Offer:
• Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
• Relocation Eligibility

Learn More & Apply Now! 

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role
• Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products. 

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 57,200 USD - 108,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community
 
The Software Engineer 2 contributes to the technology platforms that support the secure exchange of healthcare transactions between providers, payers, and business partners. This role helps deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient solutions while supporting the organization's modernization journey from legacy applications to cloud-native technologies. The ideal candidate enjoys solving technical challenges, demonstrates ongoing technical development through coursework, projects, internships, or hands-on experience, and contributes to the delivery and support of business-critical applications and services.

The Software Engineer 2 develops, enhances, and supports applications, integrations, and platform capabilities that enable healthcare transaction processing and business operations. Working closely with engineers, architects, product teams, and operations partners, this role contributes to both cloud modernization initiatives and ongoing enhancements of existing platforms.

This position provides hands-on experience across software development, system integration, automation, operational support, and cloud technologies. The engineer is expected to independently investigate technical challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and apply sound engineering practices to deliver secure, maintainable, and reliable solutions.

This position follows a hybrid work arrangement in Louisville, KY or Nashville, TN, with an expectation of 1-2 days per week onsite.

Use your skills to make an impact 
 
Solution Development & Delivery
• Develop, test, enhance, and support application, integration, batch, and API solutions across modern and legacy platforms.
• Partner with engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver enhancements and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot application, processing, and integration issues and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
Modernization & Engineering Excellence
• Contribute to cloud modernization efforts, platform simplification initiatives, and reduction of technical debt.
• Develop or enhance automation and tooling that improve operational efficiency and solution reliability.
• Continuously learn and apply new technologies, engineering practices, and development approaches.
Collaboration & Operational Support
• Collaborate with technology and business partners to deliver secure and reliable solutions.
• Support production stability through monitoring, testing, troubleshooting, and incident resolution activities.
• Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and team discussions to strengthen engineering practices.

Required Qualifications
This is an entry-level opportunity open to candidates with relevant software development knowledge and hands-on experience gained through internships, coursework, projects, technical training, or other practical learning experiences. Professional work experience is not required.
• Associate's degree in Computer Science
• Foundational software development knowledge gained through education, internships, projects, or professional experience.
• Hands-on use of .NET/C# and SQL through coursework, internships, projects, technical training, or professional work.
• Evaluating technical challenges, investigating root causes, and recommending solutions.
• Demonstrated application of new technologies, tools, and processes through coursework, projects, internships, or other hands-on experiences.
• Communicates technical information effectively and collaborates with team members and business partners to support solution delivery.

Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or similar programming technologies through coursework, projects, internships, technical training, or other hands-on learning opportunities.
• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, APIs, system integrations, or enterprise applications.
• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, or DevOps practices.
• Exposure to healthcare technology, EDI transactions, or regulated environments.
• Interest in cloud-native technologies, automation, and modern software engineering practices.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40
Pay Range
The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.
 
$80,900 - $110,300 per year
 
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.
Description of Benefits
Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us
 
About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​
Equal Opportunity Employer

This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Statistical Programmer/Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Site: The General Hospital Corporation
 
Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary
Collaborates with team members to assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data sets.

Does this position require Patient Care?
No

Essential Functions
-Writes and runs basic queries as needed. 

-Assists in maintaining existing reporting systems. 

-Contributes to presentations to key stakeholders. 

-Works with senior analysts to design, maintain, and distribute reports. 

-Learn leading practice analysis methodologies. 

-Conduct continuous analysis of current performance and accurately forecast data trends.
 
Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's Degree Analytics required or Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required

Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree?
no

Licenses and Credentials

Experience
Data Analysis Experience 0-1 year preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
- Building proficiency in statistics, data analysis, and data sets.
- Proficient in time management and project management skills.
- Ability to exercise sound judgment to make decisions within the scope of job responsibilities.
- Demonstrated knowledge of and skill in word processing, spreadsheet, and database PC applications.
- Solid quantitative, analytical, and technical aptitude skills.
- Participate in dealing with all levels of employees /management and building proficient relationships with teams and all organizational customers.
- Able to find and define problems, understand business impact, identify solutions, and provide recommendations for corrective action.

Additional Job Details (if applicable)

Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) is the largest research hospital in the United States with an annual research budget of approximately one billion dollars. The mission of MGH Biostatistics is to engage in impactful transdisciplinary partnerships involving quantitative methods in public health and biomedicine. The Biostatistics team includes over 50 faculty and staff who are deeply embedded in collaborative research projects across over 25 Divisions and Departments at MGH and beyond including cancer, cardiology, general internal medicine, global health, neurology, pediatrics, psychiatry, pulmonary and critical care medicine, and surgery.
Specific duties of the Statistical Programmer I (Data analyst 1 )include collaborating with clinical investigators under the direction and supervision of senior biostatisticians to:
• Create and run data reports for study monitoring boards, including tables, figures, listings.
• Collaborate with clinical investigators and senior project biostatisticians in preparation of tables and figures for study manuscripts. Help with manuscript review and validation of data abstraction.
• Develop code for reports used in study management, including reports for data querying and cleaning, study monitoring, and data quality checking.
• Work with study coordinators to resolve data query issues.
• Develop specifications based on study protocol and write code to calculate derived variables and collaborate with statisticians to cross-check and update code as necessary.
• Write code to extract data from Electronic Data Capture Systems (EDC) and maintain internal data files for use in reporting and analysis.
• Provide user support for EDC systems for site coordinators and study investigators, including development of training materials. Work with coordinators and study investigators to resolve data queries in EDC.
• Generate custom and/or deidentified datasets for data repositories, ancillary studies, and/or public distribution.
• Collaborate with other statistical programmers and statisticians to maintain code base. Create and maintain documentation of datasets and data processes.
• Work on optimization and automation of coding, reports, and data processes.
• Other duties as needed to support MGH Biostatistics.

Remote Type

Hybrid
 
Work Location

399 Revolution Drive
 
Scheduled Weekly Hours

40
 
Employee Type

Regular
 
Work Shift

Day (United States of America)

Pay Range
$53,040.00 - $75,888.80/Annual
 
Grade
5
 
At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. jobs.description:
Overview:
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
 
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:
The Software Engineer, I analyzes, designs, develops, and maintains software solutions for the organization’s products and systems. Collaborates on system integrations of software and hardware to ensure optimal performance and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests structures, user documentation, and software functionality. Work is reviewed for accuracy and adherence to established processes and guidelines.Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Collaborates with team members to establish requirements for less complex design projects
• Completes all phases of software engineering design projects, including coding, debugging, testing, and deployment
• Conducts analysis of processes and systems, delivering results to key stakeholders
• Analyzes and interprets results, recommending potential solutions for software and system improvements
• Contributes to the development and testing of software solutions for various products, ensuring they meet quality and performance standards
• Creates and maintains documentation for projects, including code, design specifications, and test results
• Stays up to date with the latest technologies and software engineering methodologies, applying them to projects as needed
• Reviews and evaluates changes or upgrades to existing designs or test processes
• Exercises sound judgment in selecting appropriate methods and techniques for problem solving and solution delivery

This position requires hybrid (3 days/week in office) work in the Lincolnshire, IL office. 
Required Qualifications: 
• Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. Advanced Degree in relevant field is also acceptable
• Relevant experience in software development or a related field• Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

• Successful completion of a Zebra Technologies Internship

• Familiarity with programming languages, operating systems, algorithms and software development frameworks

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world.

As LLM architectures and inference workloads evolve, understanding how they map to hardware is critical to designing efficient AI systems. Our team combines simulation and agentic engineering to understand emerging architectures and inform hardware and software decisions.

What you’ll be doing:
• Building and validating performance models for LLM architectures across GPU, LPU, and heterogeneous systems.
• Developing agents to automate simulation workflows, analyze bottlenecks, and accelerate design space exploration.

• Recently completed a MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Familiarity with modern LLM architectures and their inference characteristics.
• Experience with simulation, profiling, or performance modeling, including roofline analysis for LLM inference.
• Strong analytical skills and a rigorous approach to experimentation and validation.
• Experience building reliable engineering tools using coding agents.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience building agents that automate complex engineering workflows.
• Knowledge of accelerator architecture and compute, memory, or communication bottlenecks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three.
 
Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems.

Technologies We Use
• Java, Scala, Rust, and Python

• Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution

• Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability

• Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage

• Gradle and Cargo for builds, and GitHub for collaboration

You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here.
What We Value
• Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimisers and execution operators to file formats and distributed processing

• A high bar for correctness and a willingness to dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does

• Comfort following a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack

• A practical approach to performance, grounded in measurement rather than intuition

• Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and incorporate feedback

• Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who depend on our software
What We Require
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience

• Proficiency in at least one language such as Java, Rust, Scala, C++, or C

• Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Coursework or projects in databases, compilers, operating systems, or distributed systems

• Contributions to open-source projects

• Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.
Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,500/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.


Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

We’re  http://checkout.comCheckout.com http://Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The program offers an extensive learning experience through technical training, professional development workshops, and direct access to industry experts. You'll be part of a global Early Careers, Graduate community, with regular networking events, mentoring opportunities, and social activities designed to build connections and accelerate your growth and leadership potential.  - Work on impactful projects alongside industry experts, tackling some of the most exciting challenges in fintech.

 - Grow your skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where learning and development are a top priority.

 - Join a diverse and supportive team that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
