jobs.title: Data Scientist 1 - Competitive Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team 
Yield and Analytics helps partners, including hotels, vacation rentals, airlines, destination marketing organizations and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We drive growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply and our leading advertising and travel media network. 
The Competitive Intelligence team uses data, statistical analysis and clear storytelling to help Expedia Group understand market dynamics, competitor activity and opportunities in travel advertising. As a Data Scientist I, you will work with experienced analysts and business partners to turn data into practical insights that support better decisions for our customers, partners and business. 

Make an Impact 
This is an early-career opportunity for someone who is curious about data and motivated to build a strong foundation in analytics. You will receive guidance from your manager and collaborate with analytics teammates while developing your ability to solve well-defined business questions and communicate findings to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. 

In this role, you will: 
• Extract, structure and combine data from multiple sources to support analysis and model development. 
• Apply descriptive statistics, probability and basic statistical methods to investigate business questions, with guidance from your manager and senior teammates. 
• Build clear charts, dashboards and reports that follow sound visualization principles and communicate insights rather than data alone. 
• Perform data quality checks, document analytical code and participate in peer reviews to help ensure reliable results. 
• Collaborate transparently with stakeholders and analytics teammates to gather information, learn the business domain and unblock data questions. 

Experience and Qualifications 
• You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, economics, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience. 
• You have demonstrated experience using data in a previous role, academic project or personal project to create dashboards, reports or a data science product that provides useful insights. 
• You have beginner-level experience using SQL, Python, R or a similar language for data analysis, including filtering, joining, transforming and summarizing data. 
• You understand the fundamentals of descriptive statistics, probability, regression and measurement, and can apply them to business questions with support. 
• You can communicate analytical approaches and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, using concise written and verbal storytelling. 
• You are curious, collaborative and open to feedback, and you are willing to learn visualization tools such as Tableau and new data sources as needed.

Accommodation requests
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

jobs.title: Unilever Future Leadership Programme - Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Our Future Leaders Programme will ignite the leader in you. This unique programme is designed to develop Unilever’s Future Leaders (UFLs) by providing challenging and purposeful opportunities that accelerate their readiness to take on business leadership roles.

The Unilever Future Leaders Program (UFLP) is a global initiative enabling Unilever to build a strong talent pipeline that will support and lead our business growth. In the UK, our UFLP is a 36-month rotational leadership development program for which we recruit top-performing undergraduate talent who demonstrate the potential to become managers within our business. It’s designed to grow you into a manager, through hands-on learning alongside world-class experts. You’ll be hired into a function and develop your leadership skills by working on live projects which offer you all the experience you need to become ready for your first management role. At the heart of it, it’s about developing tomorrow’s leaders, today. 

From Day 1, you will take on real business challenges within your own function and across the organization. Along the way you will develop deep core professional skills and leadership skills, and build a robust support network. On top of all that, you will have a lot of fun along the journey.

We look for people who want to get to grips with the inner workings of a vast business and a desire to understand how it works. It’s about commitment, real people skills and a deep-seated interest in the business as a whole. You’ll become part of a leading-edge company, where you’ll work with outstanding brands and outstanding people to drive sustainable business growth.

Your Future Employer

Unilever is one of the world's leading FMCG companies, home to iconic brands including Dove, Vaseline, TRESemmé, Lynx, Persil, Domestos, Surf, Radox, Sure and Liquid I.V. Through products used by millions of people every day, we help improve health, wellbeing, confidence and care around the world.

Established over 100 years ago, Unilever has a proud heritage of innovation and a long-standing belief that great brands, great people and responsible business go hand in hand.

Today, we are transforming into a faster, more focused growth company centred on Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care and Home Care. Through world-class brands, cutting-edge science and technology, digital innovation and AI-enabled capabilities, we are building unmissably superior products and experiences for consumers around the world.

A career at Unilever offers the opportunity to work at global scale while helping shape the future of some of the world's most recognised brands. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing curiosity, creativity and passion to solve real business challenges and make a meaningful impact every day.

*As we receive a high volume of applications, please make sure to read the job descriptions on our website carefully and apply for the ONE function you are most interested in. Only your first application will be considered* 

What we’re looking for?

We’re looking for curious, purpose‑driven graduates who are excited by how AI is evolving our data, brands and operations and who want to keep learning every day. You don’t need to be an expert yet and we welcome applicants from all degree backgrounds. However, you do need a real interest in data and analytics, a growth mindset, and the confidence to ask good questions. If you enjoy challenging the status quo, spotting patterns in data, communicating clearly, and are comfortable with ambiguity, you’ll thrive here Integrity matters to us: you’ll show good judgement, take ownership, and be comfortable balancing pace with care when the stakes are high.

What will the programme involve? 

You’ll complete six rotations, each lasting six months, allowing you to gain both depth and breadth of experience.

You will: 
• Participate in a leadership development programme designed to accelerate your growth and prepare you to become one of Unilever’s future leaders.
• Specialise in Technology or Cyber Security or Data & Analytics.
• Complete rotations within your chosen area to build core expertise.
• May have the opportunity to work outside your chosen track (e.g. marketing, supply chain, customer development).
• Be flexible on the scheme and work across offices in Kingston upon Thames, London and Port Sunlight (near Liverpool) depending on the rotation.
• Be supported with a dedicated mentor, who is an expert in your chosen stream and will guide you throughout the programme.
• Shape the scheme through our graduate-led pillars, such as wellbeing, learning and development and placement success. These pillars are run by current graduates and play a key role in shaping the UFLP experience.

Please see further information on the Data & Analytics stream below:

In this specialized stream, you will delve into the fascinating world of Data & Analytics, collaborating on real business projects and building expertise in cutting-edge cloud and rapidly advancing AI technologies. As AI continues to evolve at extraordinary speed, ensuring our data is high quality, trusted, and ready is more important than ever. Unleashing the power of data, you'll play a pivotal role in strategic delivery, unlocking invaluable insights for our business.

At Unilever, our commitment to data democratization empowers business users across the globe to make confident, data-driven choices. This pervasive shift facilitates informed decision-making across all aspects of our business, identifying granular growth opportunities and propelling us to outperform the market. Your journey within the program will encompass diverse experiences in data analytics, data science, data engineering, and business partnering, as you leverage and maximize the vast scale of information available at Unilever.

What could your day-to-day role include (depending on your role)?

Day to day, you could be helping prepare our data lakehouses for AI by improving data quality, structure and accessibility, ensuring the information within them is ready to fuel advanced analytics and machine learning. You could partner with teams across the business to create meaningful dashboards, strengthen data pipelines, and analyse rich datasets to reveal insights that guide important decisions. You could be working with some of our strategic technology partners like Google and Microsoft to deliver large scale global programmes, or with niche technology start-ups and industry innovators to solve current business and sustainability challenges. Your work will directly contribute to making Unilever’s data landscape more intelligent, scalable and AI ready.

Some of the teams you could be allocated to include:

• Data Science
• Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence Team
• Data Strategy Team
• Cross-operations
• Data & AI Change Management

Skills required include:

• Curiosity about AI
• Foundational cloud computing awareness
• Interest in statistics
• Basic programming knowledge

Please note, that at Unilever, we have development programmes, the skills below are skills that would be good to have at the beginning however you will develop them throughout the programme.

• Stakeholder Analysis / Management / Business Partnering
• Product Management
• Systems Thinking
• Artificial Intelligence
• Risk Management
• Project Management / Agile Delivery
• Change Management & Activation
• Strategic Thinking
• Third Party Management

Our application process involves: 

Step 1: Online Application

Complete the online application form. It is a simple and easy application process with the option of filling out your details using your LinkedIn profile. You may apply to one function in your application.

Step 2: Profile Assessment 

Complete two stages of profile assessment; a portrait personality test and an online assessment. These are designed to look at different elements of your cognitive, emotional, and social traits. You will receive personalised

What You’ll Do:

In this 6-month contract, as the Specialist, Merch Data Governance, you will help ensure product data remains accurate and flows reliably across critical business systems. You will manage daily operations, database runs, reporting, and the team mailbox while building the technical skills to investigate issues and support the modernization of our product data platforms. This hands-on role provides a clear path from operational execution to analysis.

jobs.title: Technical Product Marketing Engineer - Robotics Simulation
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world!

We are looking for a Technical Product Marketing Engineer to build robotics simulation workflows and demonstrate how AI models can solve robotics tasks. You will develop working examples, evaluate their behavior and performance, and turn your findings into practical resources that help developers understand and adopt NVIDIA robotics technologies. As part of NVIDIA’s Robotics Technical Marketing team, you will work with engineering, product management, and product marketing to connect technical capabilities with developer needs. You will own well-defined projects—from implementation and testing through demonstrations and technical content—with mentorship and technical review from experienced teammates.

What you will be doing:
• Develop and test robotics simulation w/ agentic workflows using NVIDIA platforms Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, including configuring robot models, environments, sensors, and task scenarios.
• Integrate AI models and robot policies into simulation workflows, connecting simulation inputs, model inference, and robot behavior.
• Build reusable Python code and sample applications that demonstrate practical robotics use cases.
• Evaluate task success, runtime performance, and failure cases through repeatable experiments; document configurations, results, and limitations.
• Create demos, tutorials, technical blogs, and workflow guides that explain what you built, how it works, and how developers can reproduce the results.
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to troubleshoot integration issues, validate technical claims, and surface opportunities to improve the developer experience.
• Present your work and contribute to technical demonstrations and educational materials for developers, partners, and customer-facing teams.

What we need to see:
• Pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
• Strong Python programming fundamentals, including experience debugging, testing, and organizing code.
• Hands-on academic, research, internship, or personal project experience with robotics or simulation.
• Foundational understanding of linear algebra, coordinate transformations, and robotics concepts such as sensors, kinematics, or control.
• Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and practical experience running or evaluating models using a framework such as PyTorch.
• Ability to investigate technical problems systematically and communicate results through clear writing and presentations.
• Initiative in learning new tools, incorporating feedback, and following through on defined technical deliverables.
• Relevant experience may come from coursework, capstone projects, research, internships, open-source contributions, or personal projects.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or other robotics simulators.
• A project applying learned policies or pre-trained AI models to robotics tasks, such as perception, manipulation, or navigation.
• Exposure to reinforcement learning, imitation learning, synthetic data generation, or simulation-to-real evaluation.
• Familiarity with Linux, Git, ROS 2, C++, or GPU-accelerated computing.
• Examples of reusable code, demonstrations, tutorials, or technical presentations that make a complex topic understandable and help others reproduce your work.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 84,000 USD - 143,750 USD for Level 1, and 100,000 USD - 161,000 USD for Level 2.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Engineers in the Software team will be working on building and maintaining infrastructure vital for large scale experimentation and deployment of HPC solutions. Domains in which a successful candidate will be encouraged to chip in, will include, data management and data loading, support for machine learning and deep learning model training.
Although familiarity with Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions would be a huge plus, this is primarily a Software Engineering position. Successful candidates are passionate about software and will have outstanding skills and hands on experience with development in C/C++ and Python in a Windows/Linux environment. Object Oriented Design & Programming in Java or C++ Scripting languages like Java Script, Python; Data Structures and algorithms Linux System Programming Distributed systems

Data science skills to acquire, transform and present data from various sources to build powerful debugging and analysis software

jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries 
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, powerefficient and highperformance solutions for highgrowth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. 

New College Graduates Overview: 
We offer many full-time employment paths for recent graduates, which provide accelerated training in a fast-paced work environment, cross-functional working opportunities, and talent mobility. New college graduates are provided with mentorship, networking, and leadership opportunities, which give our new team members life-long connections and skills. 

Summary of Role: 
GlobalFoundries is seeking an early-career AI/ML Systems Engineer to advance workload characterization and performance modeling across machine learning systems. The engineer will own quantitative analyses that connect workload behavior to hardware and software design decisions while communicating results across architecture, compiler, runtime, and product teams. 

Essential Responsibilities include: 
• Characterize AI/ML workloads across inference and training, quantify compute and memory behavior, and identify bottlenecks using methods such as roofline analysis, operational intensity profiling, and bottleneck decomposition. 
• Build and validate analytical or code-based models that estimate achievable throughput, latency, utilization, bandwidth consumption, and efficiency for real or projected hardware. 
• Partner with hardware, compiler, and runtime engineers to translate workload findings into architectural and software optimization discussions, including memory subsystem sizing, scheduling, kernel optimization, and data layout tradeoffs. 
• Own benchmarking or modeling efforts end to end, maintain clear and reproducible analysis artifacts, and communicate conclusions through written reports, presentations, and design reviews. 

Other Responsibilities: 
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications: 
• Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field from an accredited degree program. 
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing. 
• Strong mathematical reasoning, including the ability to apply linear algebra, probability, and numerical analysis to performance estimation and numerical precision questions. 
• Working understanding of computer architecture concepts, including cache hierarchies, memory bandwidth, and CPU pipeline fundamentals. 
• Experience with Python and data analysis tooling such as NumPy, pandas, matplotlib, or similar. 
• Exposure to machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) 
• Travel - Up to 10% 

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Prior related internship or co-op experience. 
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
• Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. 
• Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Strong planning & organizational skills 
• Familiarity with the roofline model, FLOP counting, operator-level profiling, quantization analysis, or performance KPI frameworks. 
• Exposure to compilation or intermediate representation concepts, including MLIR, IREE, TVM, or similar AI compiler infrastructure.

jobs.title: Angular Developer / Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
The Angular Developer / Frontend Engineer is an entry-level software engineering role responsible for developing, enhancing, testing, and maintaining modern web applications using Angular and related frontend technologies. This position is ideal for candidates early in their software engineering career who are passionate about building user-focused applications and learning modern development practices.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior engineers, product partners, and other technology teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Angular, TypeScript, Micro Frontend architecture, automated testing, APIs, and modern CI/CD practices while contributing to enterprise-scale applications.

Responsibilities :
Angular Development
• Develop and maintain Single Page Applications (SPAs) using Angular.
• Build reusable Angular components, directives, and services following established coding standards and best practices.
• Contribute to the development of Standalone Components and modular application features.
• Support application modernization efforts and continuous improvement initiatives.
Frontend Engineering
• Translate business requirements, wireframes, and design specifications into responsive user interfaces.
• Develop user-facing features using HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, TypeScript, and Angular.
• Create accessible and responsive experiences across desktop and mobile platforms.
• Partner with UX designers and product teams to deliver intuitive user experiences.
API Integration & Application Support
• Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
• Participate in troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving application defects.
• Support production applications by investigating and addressing issues when needed.
• Assist in monitoring application performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Testing & Code Quality
• Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Jest and related testing frameworks.
• Participate in peer code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to team standards.
• Support continuous integration and deployment processes.
• Contribute to code quality initiatives through automated testing and static analysis tools.
Learning & Collaboration
• Collaborate with engineers, product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
• Participate in Agile development ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
• Learn application architecture, business processes, and development best practices from senior team members.
• Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving development processes and team efficiency.
Professional Development
• Build an understanding of software engineering principles, secure coding practices, and enterprise development standards.
• Gain familiarity with Micro Frontend concepts, cloud technologies, CI/CD tools, and modern software delivery practices.
• Continuously develop technical skills and stay current with evolving frontend technologies.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 0-2 years of software development experience (including internships, co-ops, academic projects, or professional experience).
• Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript fundamentals.
• Familiarity with Angular through coursework, personal projects, internships, or professional experience.
• Understanding of web development technologies including HTML5 and CSS3.
• Basic understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to Angular, RxJS, or modern JavaScript frameworks.
• Experience with Git and version control systems.
• Familiarity with unit testing concepts and testing frameworks such as Jest.
• Understanding of responsive design and web accessibility principles.
• Exposure to Micro Frontend architectures, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines through coursework, internships, or projects.
• Experience working in Agile development environments.

Success in This Role
Successful candidates will:
• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn.
• Deliver well-tested, maintainable code with guidance from experienced engineers.
• Collaborate effectively within a team environment.
• Continuously improve technical skills and development practices.
• Contribute to the delivery of high-quality software solutions that meet business and user needs.

jobs.title: Associate Electrical Engineer / Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the TimeDescription

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems Sector has a need for an Electrical Engineer at its Integrated Mission Solutions (IMS) organization in Warner Robins, GA. This engineering position is for an electrical engineering role on our systems engineering team. This opportunity provides a chance to have direct impact on the product and mission, moving quickly through design decisions, integration, testing, production and fielding. Our ideal candidate will possess technical expertise, a drive to lead from where you are, collaborative people skills, and the proven ability to work within a technically diverse and fast-paced team.

This position is in Warner Robins, GA and requires that you work on-site daily.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Capture, analyze, and maintain subsystem‑level requirements for an electronic assembly.
• Track parts lifecycle, evaluate DMSMS risks, and propose mitigation strategies.
• Design, prototype, and test Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs), cables, and electrical harnesses.
• Perform schematic capture, layout, and BOM generation using industry‑standard tools (Altium, Mentor, Cadence).
• Work closely with embedded‑software/firmware teams to define electrical interfaces and develop test plans and procedures.

This position may be filled at either Associate Engineer / Engineer Levels.

Basic Qualifications: 
• Associate Engineer: B.S. in Electrical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering from an ABET accredited school.
• Engineer: Minimum of 2 years of direct relevant experience with B.S. in Electrical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering from an ABET accredited school; Minimum of 0 years of direct relevant experience with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering from an ABET accredited school.
• Experience developing detailed test plans and procedures to evaluate electronics.
• Experience in schematic capture, PCB layout, and/or component selection.
• Experience using oscilloscopes, function generators, and power supplies.
• Strong written and verbal skills; able to produce clear technical documents.
• Must currently hold or be able to obtain and maintain a U.S Government Secret level security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience designing and integrating test equipment, including CCAs, cables, electrical harnesses and automated test station software.
• Experience with legacy system sustainment and modernization, including hardware redesign due to obsolescence.
• Experience with Department of Defense programs.
• Expertise with Altium Designer, Mentor Graphics, or Cadence Allegro.
• Active Secret Security Clearance.

Primary Level Salary Range: $65,800.00 - $98,800.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $79,300.00 - $118,900.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Service Product Manager New Grad - Product Line Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$86,500.00 - $119,000.00
Location:
Austin,TX, Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

TEAM OVERVIEW:
Build your product management career with Applied Materials’ Spares Product Line Management team. As a Spares PLM, you will work across engineering, supply chain, operations, field service, and business teams to manage spare parts throughout their lifecycle, drive commercialization and service readiness, and support long-term customer needs. The role provides broad exposure to technology, business strategy, and cross-functional execution while developing future product management leaders.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Support spare parts through the product lifecycle, including product changes, upgrades, obsolescence, replacements, alternate sourcing, and cost reduction.
• Develop semiconductor process and equipment knowledge, building technical domain expertise across different process areas and spare part applications.
• Support Product Change Management (PCM) activities, including ECOs, PCNs, and product configuration changes.
• Help maintain accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs) and product configurations.
• Support component roadmaps and strategies for obsolescence, replacements, alternate suppliers, and cost reduction.
• Analyze product, cost, supply, and service data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
• Collaborate with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Field Service, and Product teams to support lifecycle and customer needs.
• Support resolution of supplier, supply continuity, quality, and product lifecycle issues.
• Use data, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to generate insights and improve decision-making and business processes.
• Prepare presentations, analyses, and project updates for cross-functional and leadership reviews.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Masters degree in Engineering, Physics, or Chemistry
• GPA 3.0 or above preferred
• 0-2 years of experience (internship, co-op, or project management experience encouraged).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
• Exchanges straightforward information, asks questions and checks for understanding
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
• Interest in semiconductor technology, product management, and a general curiosity to learn.

PREFERRED: Internship experience in manufacturing, engineering, product management or semiconductor technology, and experience with data analytics and AI tools.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:
• Experience supporting top semiconductor customers and knowledge of advanced semiconductor platforms.
• Experience leveraging data, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to support product decisions, identify opportunities, and improve business processes
• Exposure to product development, service operations, and lifecycle management.
• Opportunities to work directly with global engineering and customer-facing teams.
• A development path toward Leadership roles

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

jobs.description:
Inside the Role
At Daimler Truck, our employees have the opportunity to work on technologies that are improving the environment year over year. We provide a competitive advantage to our products through our in-house software development. 
The embedded software development and release team is a community of open-minded engineers that are developing the future. We are well known within the company as a team that is easy to work with; we focus on teamwork, knowing that it drives quality above all else. We are looking for software developers who work well in a team, who enjoy testing, and have a curious nature. Our team is ready to help grow the next generation of engineers through a collaborative, helpful environment. If you think that you would flourish in a team like this – please consider applying! 
We are not just about building products and customer experience; we are about building people. 

How we deliver quality software: 
• We strive towards developing a wide breadth of software knowledge to serve our internal and external customers.
• We are as flexible and agile as our products demand, including our personal work-life balance supported by a mild hybrid work schedule. 
• We learn and apply the appropriate standards, processes, procedures and tools throughout the system development life cycle to support our existing engineering applications and wide range of products.
• We interface with customers, suppliers, application users, and other technical and support staff to ensure that we are sensitive to our customer’s needs.
Posting Information
We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected.

We Take Care of Our Team
Position offers a starting salary range of $78,000- $100,000 USD  
Pay offered dependent on knowledge, skills, and experience​  
  
Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans.  

What You Drive at DTNA
• Collaborate with senior SW development staff to develop, test, document, operate and maintain software with opportunities to progress into function ownership.
• Design and develop real-time embedded software for Heavy-Duty Powertrain modules, for both captive and non-captive systems.
• Develop software requirements in cooperation with engineering sponsors from performance, emission, eMobility, OBD/ZOBD, production, and service functional areas.
• Implement vehicle, engine, aftertreatment, (e)powertrain control and OBD functions using model-based and C-programming languages.
• Support software deployment for trucks in reliability growth test, summer and winter tests, pre-series builds, production builds, and post-production field issues. 
• Analyze and document work to resolve software engineering issues with cross-functional teams.
• Interact and coordinate deliverables with other technical groups in the organization
• Implement (modeling and coding) software change requests.
• Create and execute validation test plans (Release testing).

Knowledge You Should Bring
• BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar degree and 0-2 years of experience, is required
• Ability to independently solve complex problems with minimal guidance and identify solutions
• Understanding of object-oriented programming principles.
• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C#, C++, JavaScript).
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
• Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing requirements.
• An attached resume is required.

Exceptional Candidates Might Have
• A Masters degree is preferred
• Familiarity with source control tools such as GitHub
• Internship, co-op, academic project, or personal project experience in software development.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
• Experience with CI/CD tools and automated testing.
• Basic understanding of databases and SQL.

Where We Work 
This position is open to applicants who can work in (or relocate to) the following location(s)-
Detroit, MI US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
Schedule Type:
Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration.

At Daimler Truck North America, we recognize our world is changing faster than ever before. By listening to the needs of today, we’re building to solve with cutting-edge solutions in sustainability and future driving technology across electric, hydrogen and autonomous. These solutions, backed by years of innovative success and achievement, continue DTNA’s legacy as the undisputed industry leader. Our evolving brand portfolio is second to none, including Freightliner Trucks, Western Star, Demand Detroit, Thomas Built Buses, Freightliner Custom Chassis, and Financial Services. Together, we work as one team towards our envisioned future – building a cleaner, safer and more efficient tomorrow for all.

That is what we are working toward - for all who keep the world moving.

jobs.title: Process Data Solutions New Grad
jobs.description:
Worker Type: New Grad

Job Post End Date: 11/03/2026

Start Date: June 2027
Location: Calgary, AB 
 
About this opportunity 
Cenovus’s New Grad Program aims to attract, develop and retain exceptional new grads to build a top talent pipeline for the company​. The program provides new grads with a broad understanding of Cenovus’s core business through challenging work assignments, training and development, field exposure and the opportunity to develop a large network of contacts through networking and mentorship opportunities. 
 
Our Program consists of three consecutive 12-month rotational assignments that span Cenovus’s varied business areas. Upon completion of the three-year program, you will be matched to a permanent role within the organization. This role will be based on business need, and relocation may be required. 
 
As a Process Data Solutions New Graduate within Operational Technology, you will apply your knowledge of engineering, computer science, data analytics and software development to real-world challenges in upstream oil and gas operations. Working alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, you will help develop solutions that collect, validate, analyze and transform operational data to support production optimization, measurement accuracy, equipment performance and engineering decision-making. This opportunity combines engineering problem-solving with technologies such as industrial data historians, databases, automation, big data platforms and application development. The ideal candidate is analytical, curious and motivated to build practical, sustainable solutions across engineering and software disciplines.
 
Your rotations could sit within many exciting business functions, including:
• Process Data Solutions & Software Development
• OT Systems, Security & Infrastructure
• Advanced Process Controls & Process Optimization
 
Note: The application deadline for this position is 11:59 pm MT on November 2, 2026.
 
What you’ll do
Responsibilities may include:
• Collaborate with engineering, operations and IT/OT teams to understand production processes, operational challenges and data requirements.
• Analyze production and process data to identify trends, anomalies, inefficiencies and opportunities to improve operational performance.
• Develop and maintain scripts, calculations, data models and integrations using technologies such as the PI System, SQL, Python and cloud-based data platforms.
• Support the design, testing and deployment of engineering tools, automated workflows, dashboards, APIs and web-based applications.
• Investigate data quality and system integration issues, document technical solutions and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Other duties will vary depending on the business needs.
 
Who you are
• Our ideal candidate will have the following minimum qualifications: 
• Legally authorized to work in Canada 
• Available to begin work June 2027
• Must have an undergraduate Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development related program degree obtained by May 31, 2027, and completed within the last 2 years (2025, 2026, or 2027). 
• Has less than two years of professional experience related to this discipline of study, excluding student experience.
• Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
• Has exposure to programming or scripting, preferably Python, and an interest in operational data, industrial automation and engineering systems.
• Familiarity with SQL, databases, Git, cloud computing, APIs, web development, data visualization or industrial data historians is considered an asset.
 
We acknowledge the value of transferable skills and may consider equivalent combinations of experience and education should you not meet a specific requirement.
 
If you require accessibility assistance to complete the on-line application or otherwise apply for an open position with Cenovus, its subsidiaries and affiliates, please email CareerOpportunities@cenovus.com.

Intel's Foundry Technology Manufacturing (FTM) is seeking a talented and motivated CAD/EDA Tools Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, test, and debug software tools, flows, and methodologies used in design automation and by cross-functional teams in the design of hardware products, process design, and manufacturing. You will play a critical role in enabling engineering productivity by building robust, scalable, and efficient automation solutions that support the full hardware design lifecycle.

jobs.title: Aerospace Software and Simulation Engineer
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Vehicle Systems Division (VSD) sits at the center of the ideas and data behind current and future systems supplying innovative research and development; technical evaluations during the acquisition process; conceptual and detailed design; assembly, integration, and test; and operational support. Comprised primarily of highly-trained mechanical and aerospace engineers, VSD provides national expertise in the areas of vehicle engineering; guidance, navigation, and controls; robotics; electro-mechanical devices; embedded systems; fluid mechanics; propulsion; thermal control; mechanisms; structures; structural dynamics; and dynamic environments. 

The Vehicle Systems Software Department (VSSD) performs independent verification and validation of flight software embedded within avionics systems aboard launch vehicles, spacecraft, and other vehicle systems. Our multidisciplinary staff provides technical oversight throughout the flight software development process, from requirements definition to day-of-launch and on-orbit operations. We develop high-fidelity closed-loop hardware and software testbeds to test the software to assess its readiness for flight. VSSD is seeking an Aerospace Software and Simulation Engineer with a passion for space and software development to be part of our team.

The selected candidate will be required to work full time, on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA. 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Conduct tests and perform analyses of software systems embedded within launch vehicles, spacecraft, CubeSats, and other mission-critical components of space systems.
• Participate in the development and maintenance of these simulations to support software validation, on-orbit anomaly resolution, and day-of-launch mission assurance activities.
• Develop models of space system components such as sensors, actuators, and vehicle dynamics for use in software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and emulator-based simulators
• Develop tools and techniques for enhancing analysis and simulation capabilities.
• Follow software and system best practices to support projects, collaborate with team members, and deliver quality products and reviews to customers.
• Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring 
• Strong written and oral communication skills 
• Must work well in a team environment 
• Possess organizational, time management and project management skills 
• Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need 
• Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations 

What You Need to be Successful
Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related STEM field (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)
• 0-1 year of industry work experience
• Experience in aerospace systems, flight software development, modeling and simulation, or related engineering field
• Experience performing technical support in complex environments involving customers, program offices, engineering support, and contractors
• Relevant project experience in dynamics, control systems, control algorithm design, or modeling & simulation
• Experience programming in Python, Java, C/C++
• Experience with version control systems and Linux/Unix environments
• Understanding of software testing methodologies and best practices
• Willing to travel domestically to customer sites, launch facilities, or test locations approximately 10% as required
• This position requires ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.
• Transcripts

How You Can Stand Out
It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:
• Master's or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related STEM field (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)
• Experience in Guidance, Navigation and Controls (GNC), Modeling and Simulation, Embedded Systems Engineering, Flight Software Engineering, or related industry experience
• Knowledge of spacecraft flight software frameworks (NASA cFS, JPL FSW) or safety-critical software certification standards (DO-178C, ISO 26262)
• Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and software-in-the-loop (SIL) test systems
• Experience with model-based design tools (Simulink, Modelica, etc.)
• Familiarity with launch vehicle and satellite payloads, their relationships to other subsystems, and to mission-level performance

• Experience working with the Atlassian tool suite, including JIRA, Bitbucket, and Confluence

jobs.title: Research Intern - Scene Understanding and Planning
jobs.description:
About Didi Autonomous Driving

Founded in 2016, DiDi's autonomous driving unit is dedicated to developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology to make transportation safer, more efficient, and accessible. In 2019, the unit became an independent company, Voyager, to accelerate technology development, commercialization, and large-scale deployment. By combining DiDi's unique data advantage, operational expertise, and mobility ecosystem, we aim to build a reliable, scalable autonomous fleet that integrates seamlessly with human-driven services. Driven by real-world customer needs and a strong commitment to safety and user experience, our mission is to deliver autonomous mobility solutions that create meaningful value for riders and communities.

About the Role

We want our vehicles to understand the physical world as it is right now, instead of relying on a map drawn long ago. Roads change, and the world a car actually drives in is always more complex than any static record of it. We are seeking a Research Intern to help give our planner a more accurate and up-to-date picture of the world, so the vehicle handles complex real-world scenes more robustly. In this role, you will take on hard, open problems from real-world driving and solve them with frontier research methods. You will report directly to the team lead and work on the problem from definition to validated solution. Strong results will often be worth publishing, and we will support you in writing them up, but the goal is to solve problems that matter to the product.

Responsibilities

• 
 Survey the latest research in scene understanding, prediction, and planning, and turn it into practical approaches that fit our system and constraints.

• 
 Design and implement deep learning models that build a richer, real-time understanding of the driving environment from onboard sensors and other available sources.

• 
 Train and evaluate models on large-scale data from our driving logs and on public benchmarks, and lead failure analysis to find out where and why models fall short.

• 
 Define metrics and evaluation methods that connect perception quality to how the vehicle actually drives.

• 
 Turn successful prototypes into solutions that work with our planning stack, with help from production engineers.

• 
 Collaborate with Perception, Prediction, Planning, and Mapping teams so results move from experiment to product.

Qualifications

• 
 Currently enrolled in an M.S. or Ph.D. program in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, for the full duration of the internship.

• 
 Available for a full-time onsite internship of 3–6 months; start dates are flexible.

• 
 Strong programming skills in Python, and experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• 
 Hands-on experience designing, training, and debugging deep learning models for computer vision, 3D perception, or sequential decision-making.

• 
 Solid understanding of autonomous driving fundamentals, including perception, prediction, and motion planning.

• 
 Ability to read research critically, form hypotheses, and turn them into well-controlled experiments.

• 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Publications at top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ICRA, IROS, CoRL or IV.

• 
Experience with multi-modal sensor fusion (camera, lidar, radar) or BEV representations.

• 
Experience with transformers, graph neural networks, or other structured scene representations.

• 
Experience with uncertainty estimation, or with learning-based prediction or planning.

• 
Experience with large-scale model training and data pipelines.

• 
Experience with public autonomous driving datasets such as nuScenes, Argoverse 2, or the Waymo Open Dataset.

• 
Proficiency in C++ (CUDA is a plus) and experience with robotics systems.

The hourly rate for the Intern position in the selected city is $46.

Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships from 2-4yrs. across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme.

You will study for completion of a BSc (Hons) in Software Development for Business through a mixture of work based learning and day release at University. You will gain the academic requirements for Incorporated Engineer as part of the way to gaining Chartered Engineer status.

You will learn to programme and how to design, integrate and test high-integrity software through a combination of University teaching and work-based learning. You will be given experience of all stages of the software development lifecycle and an awareness of other engineering departments who support the software engineers. Subjects will include: hardware-software interface, data communication, networking and security, software configuration and release management; and subjects in business, personal skills and project management.
 
You must be interested in IT and have a technical aptitude in software development, maybe gained through a hobby, designing an App/website or through programming. Note: This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has very little software knowledge and is NOT suitable for candidates who already have a computing or software degree.

You will:
 
• Learn to design high integrity software and to program in C++

• 5 Higher Grades (or equivalent): BBBBC
• Mandatory: Mathematics

Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 

At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 

Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 

Our Summer Placement Programme 
 
Our role offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.

During your placement, you will be exposed to tools, technologies and processes. You will be introduced to the software development processes and utilise state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools. You will also gain experience on one or more aspects of the software development lifecycle, which could include; applied research, requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test.
 
During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.

The programme will run from June - August 2027.

• Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of a multi-disciplinary Integrated Project Team.
• Developing practical skills in design techniques for products.

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: NoDescription

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

As one of the largest global security companies in the world, Northrop Grumman is proud to help our nation’s military personnel make the transition to civilian careers. Approximately 1/4th of Northrop Grumman’s 90,000 employees self-identifies as veterans, and more than 1,600 are reservists.

The Northrop Grumman Military Internship Program (NG-MIP) is an approved SkillBridge Program under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322.29 . NG-MIP is an opportunity for transitioning service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through an individual internship during their last 6 months of service, for up to 180 days. The Northrop Grumman Military Internship Program is open to all ranks and experience levels. SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from Northrop Grumman, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as active-duty service members.

Responsibilities for this internship position are:

Northrop Grumman Corporation (NGC) has developed the Northrop Grumman – Military Internship Program (DoD SKillbridge) utilizing the DoDI guidance for Skillbridge. During this program the service member will be on-site at his or her host company performing an individual internship in an entry to mid-level career type role. The service member will be on the job training supporting a work schedule equivalent to 40hrs per week. Outlined below are the Goals, Objectives, and Outcomes for the program.

Goals – Provide transitioning service members fellowship-style job skills training during the last portion(s) of their military commitment. This program is specifically designed to offer internships that result in the potential to transition to a full-time opportunity as the conclusion of the training. Interns will serve as a pipeline for high-speed, motivated military candidates into NGC.

Objectives - Service Members who complete the Intern program will be highly trained, capable, future employees that align to the specific needs of the organization and are prepared to meet the NG mission “Defining Possible” on Day 1. This program provides a comprehensive internship experience including professional development, networking with leadership, and training specifically focused on NG leadership principles, company history, customer/stakeholder engagement, product and service overview, and core job responsibilities.

Outcome – Offer transitioning service member a rewarding opportunity to join the Northrop Grumman team.

DoD SkillBridge Eligibility:

· Has served at least 180 days on active duty

· Is within 12 months of separation or retirement

· Will receive an honorable discharge

· Has taken any service TAPS/TGPS

· Has attended or participated in an ethics brief within the last 12 months

· Received Unit Commander (first O-4/Field Grade commander in chain of command) written authorization and approval to participate in DoD SkillBridge Program prior to start of internship.

Our ADG team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycles of numerous avionics components.

• Evaluates, with supervision, uncertainty and risks associated with requirements and designs.

Job Description:
 
Job Family Definition:
Designs, analyzes, develops, modifies and evaluates VLSI components and hardware systems. Determines architecture and logic design, design verification through software developed for component and system simulation, and builds physical implementations through development of multidimensional designs involving the layout of complex integrated circuits. Analyzes designs to establish operating data, conducts experimental tests and evaluates results to enable prototype and production VLSI solutions. May direct support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing and prototype fabrication.
Management Level Definition:
Contributes to assignments of limited scope by applying technical concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education, or previous experience. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.
Responsibilities:
• Designs portions of computer/server/networking architecture and algorithms based on established VLSI engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements.
• Collaborates and communicates with management regarding design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
• Designs, simulates, and tests VLSI circuits. Ensures the VLSI designs meet quality, schedule, and cost goals for prototype or production solutions.
• Participates as a member of project team of other VLSI engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high-quality solutions for VLSI prototypes and products.
Education and Experience Required:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer engineering or equivalent.
• 0-2 years of experience in VLSI design, verification or implementation.
Knowledge and Skills:
• Experience or understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals, VLSI principles, digital logic, and computer architecture.
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Knowledge of a programming and scripting, hardware description language, electronic design automation (EDA), and/or FPGA tools. Coursework in VLSI design or VLSI concepts.

As a Graduate Test Software Engineer, you will

• Contribute to the creation of high quality and robust code; documenting and recording your work products; keeping them under configuration management and providing plans and reports on progress.
• Develop an understanding of complex products through close collaboration with Hardware and Firmware engineers to solve real integration problems on test systems.
• Have opportunities to taking an active role in engineering process improvement.
• Develop software solutions to control measurement instrumentation devices and fully automate testing of a unit under test.

What you’ll bring 
Entry Requirements:
• A minimum of a 2:2 Bachelor’s/Integrated Master’s degree, or higher degree, such as MSc or PhD. 
• For this role, acceptable degree disciplines include: 
Security, Computer Communication and Networks, Computer & Network Technology & Cyber Security.

Security Clearance 
Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

• Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
• Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity
• Rewarding performance: All employees are eligible for our bonus scheme.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Your impact
Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 
At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 
We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development.
At Leonardo, we develop the advanced technologies that help keep people safe. As a Graduate Firmware Engineer, you'll join a team delivering world-leading Electronic Warfare capabilities that protect fast jets, UAVs, naval vessels and land platforms operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
Our structured 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to accelerate your development from graduate to professional engineer. From day one, you'll contribute to real projects, work alongside industry experts, and gain hands-on experience across the full firmware development lifecycle.
This opportunity is based in Luton, with flexible and hybrid working arrangements available. Occasional travel within the UK and overseas may be required to support technical reviews, trials and customer engagements.

What You'll Do
As part of our Firmware Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance digital systems used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
Your activities will include:
• Designing and developing FPGA firmware solutions for complex embedded and real-time systems
• Creating and verifying designs using hardware description languages and industry-standard development tools
• Supporting the development of digital processing technologies used in Electronic Warfare and sensing applications
• Conducting simulation, testing and validation activities to ensure firmware meets functional, timing and performance requirements
• Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams and stakeholders
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across systems, hardware, software and verification engineering to integrate firmware solutions into larger products
• Contributing to technical documentation, design reviews and customer deliverables
• Developing an understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle, from concept through to manufacture and in-service support

SDK Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Role: 

This is a hardware-software integration role on our embodied-AI robotics platform. You will develop and validate our robot SDK across humanoid and quadruped robots from multiple vendors, own edge-side integration and hardware bring-up (compute boards, sensors and buses, on-device inference), and build the developer platform and developer tools (Skill Store, Console, and content creation tools) end to end, from the web frontend and backend services through to verification on real robots. As the roadmap advances, you will also build simulation environments and train, evaluate, and deploy motion policies on real robots. Every interface you write ends up running on real hardware and being called by third-party developers, so a success return code is never our definition of done.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience building software that other people depend on (SDKs, libraries, APIs) or embedded / hardware-software systems. No minimum years required; new graduates with strong hands-on embedded or robotics project work are welcome to apply

• Proven knowledge + expertise, and passion for robotics software, hardware-software integration, and developer platforms

• Top-notch Python or C / C++ skills, at the level of production code with tests

• Strong familiarity with Linux development and deployment (systemd, networking, log forensics) and at least one robotics middleware or communication stack (ROS 2 / DDS / MQTT / zenoh / gRPC)

• Hands-on with real devices: able to bring up hardware, integrate vendor protocols, and diagnose failures on site

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proven expertise with unified abstraction layers over multi-vendor hardware, and with conformance or certification test suites that outside parties have to pass

• A diverse skillset including embedded debugging (I2C / SPI / UART / CAN / USB, logic analyzer, oscilloscope), edge-AI deployment (quantization, ONNX / TensorRT / NPU), and service operations (containers, CI/CD, reverse proxy, monitoring)

• A wide range of experience with robot simulation (MuJoCo / Isaac / Gazebo), reinforcement or imitation learning carried through to a physical robot, motion retargeting, or humanoid whole-body control

• Experience with developer platforms, SDK releases, documentation sites, or app and plugin marketplaces

• Full-stack web development experience for the developer platform and tools: frontend (React / TypeScript or similar) and backend services and APIs (Python / FastAPI, Node.js, or similar) backed by a relational database such as PostgreSQL

• Experience shipping production web products: accounts and sign-in (OAuth / OIDC), file and package upload / download, usage quotas, cloud deployment (AWS, object storage), and frontend testing

• Rust or C++ experience (some runtime components are written in Rust / C++)

• Comfortable working from schematics and datasheets; power, battery management, or thermal experience is a plus

• Open-source contributions, technical writing, or developer-community experience

• A habit of verifying before concluding, and a conservative approach to anything that moves real hardware

• A creative curiosity, collaborative ethic, hardworking enthusiasm, and driving personal vision

• Excellent communication skills and team-working tendencies

• A penchant for multi-tasking and self-starting

• A genuine fascination for the robotics and embodied-AI field and a commitment to global change

• A true sense of determination… and hopefully a sense of humor

Salary Range:

$80,000 - $120,000

 Perks + Benefits

• Healthcare + dental + vision benefits (Free for you/discounted for family)

• 401(k) options

• Casual dress code + relaxed work environment

• Culturally diverse, progressive atmosphere

Faraday Future is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
