jobs.title: Research Intern - Frontier Speculative Decoding
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

• Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)

• When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)

• Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

• Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

• Train, fine-tune and distill draft models, and design rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses.

• Implement optimized version for serving engines to show efficacy in real world workloads

• Communicate the plans, progress, and results of projects to the broader team

• Share findings through technical write-ups and blog posts, and help bring successful ideas into production

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals

• Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning large models with distributed training frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, FSDP)

• Familiarity with modern model architectures, such as Mixture-of-Experts and hybrid attention

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior research experience in speculative decoding, efficient inference, or efficient machine learning

• Publications at leading conferences in machine learning or systems (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys)

• Experience with knowledge distillation, post-training, or reinforcement learning

• Familiarity with LLM serving engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)

• Contributions to open-source machine learning projects

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span January 4th to April 9th.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 - $70 an hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

For more information about our privacy policy, please visit: https://www.together.ai/privacy

jobs.title: QPU Build Co-op - Optics & Data Analysis
jobs.description:
In this Co-Op/Internship you’ll work at the intersection of optics, atomic physics, and data science. The QPU Build team designs and implements system-wide features of QuEra’s neutral-atom quantum computer architecture. You’ll work hands-on in the lab characterizing the optical systems that trap and control atoms and turn those measurements into insights that drive improvements across the machine. Along the way, you’ll get a holistic view of how a quantum computer is designed and built at QuEra Computing Inc.

Responsibilities

• Optical Measurements: Design and run measurements to characterize optical components and systems used in neutral-atom quantum computing, including lasers, beam-shaping optics, and atom-trapping setups. Assist with building, aligning, and troubleshooting optical setups in the lab.

• Data Analysis: Analyze measurement and experimental data using the Python scientific stack. Build tools and workflows that make results reproducible, and turn findings into clear, actionable feedback for the team.

• System Integration Support: Work with physicists and engineers to bring optical subsystems into the broader atomic physics pipeline and help identify ways to improve performance and reliability.

Qualifications

• Pursuing or recently completed a degree in physics, optics/photonics, engineering, or a related field.

• Hands-on optics lab experience (e.g., alignment, beam characterization, working with lasers and optical components) is required.

• Strong Python programming skills for data analysis (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills.

• Strong evidence of independent work.

• A deep background in quantum physics isn’t required, but a solid foundation in physics and mathematics.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with holography, spatial light modulators, diffractive optics and/or metasurfaces.

• Experience with CAD design in Autodesk Inventor and/or optical design in Zemax.

• Exposure to atomic physics or quantum computing experiments.

This is an on-site Co-Op/Internship. Relocation is not offered for this role. Immediate start date preferred.

We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: NoDescription

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

As one of the largest global security companies in the world, Northrop Grumman is proud to help our nation’s military personnel make the transition to civilian careers. Approximately 1/4th of Northrop Grumman’s 90,000 employees self-identifies as veterans, and more than 1,600 are reservists.

The Northrop Grumman Military Internship Program (NG-MIP) is an approved SkillBridge Program under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322.29 . NG-MIP is an opportunity for transitioning service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through an individual internship during their last 6 months of service, for up to 180 days. The Northrop Grumman Military Internship Program is open to all ranks and experience levels. SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from Northrop Grumman, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as active-duty service members.

Responsibilities for this internship position are:

Northrop Grumman Corporation (NGC) has developed the Northrop Grumman – Military Internship Program (SKillbridge) utilizing the DoDI guidance for Skillbridge. During this program the service member will be on-site at his or her host company performing an individual internship in an entry to mid-level career type role. The service member will be on the job training supporting a work schedule equivalent to 40hrs per week. Outlined below are the Goals, Objectives, and Outcomes for the program.

Goals – Provide transitioning service members fellowship-style job skills training during the last portion(s) of their military commitment. This program is specifically designed to offer internships that result in the potential to transition to a full-time opportunity as the conclusion of the training. Interns will serve as a pipeline for high-speed, motivated military candidates into NGC.

Objectives - Service Members who complete the Intern program will be highly trained, capable, future employees that align to the specific needs of the organization and are prepared to meet the NG mission “Defining Possible” on Day 1. This program provides a comprehensive internship experience including professional development, networking with leadership, and training specifically focused on NG leadership principles, company history, customer/stakeholder engagement, product and service overview, and core job responsibilities.

Outcome – Offer transitioning service member a rewarding opportunity to join the Northrop Grumman team.

DoD SkillBridge Eligibility:

jobs.title: Safety Methodologies Intern Co-op
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. We are seeking a curious and analytical Safety Methodologies Intern to support the development and implementation of the frameworks that underpin our driverless readiness decisions. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the autonomous vehicle industry, and you will be helping us quantitatively validate the safety of our autonomous trucking solution using our highly realistic simulator and real-world data. We are looking for a driven, inquisitive self-starter who will use their diverse background to dive headfirst into our data and tooling to generate actionable insights for the Safety team.
 
Application Instructions:
- To be considered for an internship/co-op, please add your most up to date academic transcripts alongside your resume for further review.
- The Summer Internship is expected to start May/June 2027 and continue on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) to August/September 2027.
 
You will…
- Develop Python scripts and tools to calculate quantitative metrics and visualize complex data for collision assessment.
- Support optimization of data pipelines and automated assessment workflows used for safety validation.
- Explore large crash databases and apply multivariate modeling techniques to predict collision related metrics. Gain an in-depth understanding of the ins and outs of publicly available safety resources.
- Conduct A/B testing on collision models using metrics that you develop within the context of our broader safety framework.
- Collaborate with the safety team to integrate the models you develop into safety evaluation pipelines.
 
Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
- Experience identifying and handling missing values, anomalies, and outliers in large-scale, real-world datasets.
- Solid foundation in regression, classification, and hypothesis testing, with the ability to surface patterns in large-scale tabular data.
- AI-native — uses AI tooling to rapidly experiment, prototype, and harden code, and can rigorously validate the results.
- Strong Python scripting skills, including hands-on experience with data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
- Able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and accurately.
- Collaborative team player who works effectively across functional boundaries.
- Genuinely excited about self-driving technology and drawn to solving hard, unsolved problems.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
- Previous internship or academic experience in robotics, automotive, or data science.
- Experience with SQL or other data mining tools.
- Experience creating data visualizations or dashboards.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it!
 
Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. 
 
Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact. 
 
If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler! 
 
 
 
What We Offer: 
- Build and operate real satellites! 
- Get hands-on with cutting-edge space technology and real-world engineering challenges. 
- Dedicated mentorship to support your learning and growth. 
- Fun and collaborative work environment where you'll learn quickly and feel supported. 
- Team-building events and opportunities to connect across the company. 
- Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games, and top-notch kitchen appliances. 
- Frequent in-office and company-wide events to stay connected and engaged. 
- Make a direct impact on Kepler's growth and success. 
- We’re a certified Great Place to Work® seven years in a row. 


We’re on the hunt for a top-tier Software Engineering Intern who will assist in developing and maintaining high-performance backend services and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams such as satellite operations, ground stations and software development to build scalable applications that support the development, testing, and operation of our satellites and mission control software. You will be trusted from day-one to get hands on with the breadth of our software stack.

Responsibilities:
• Support design and development of reliable, high-quality software related to operating Kepler’s satellite network infrastructure and mission control software automation 

• Collaborate with satellite operators and product managers to deliver mission critical ground systems 

• Writing thorough tests and documentation 

• Participating in software design review and code review processes
Required Skills and Qualifications:
• Enrolled in Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent 

• Prior internship experience using Python to develop back end services 

• Prior experience supporting software development and test writing 

• Excellent communication skills 

• Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and returning to studies after the internship

• Available for a full-time internship beginning Jan 2027 for 4-16 months.

• Opportunity to work out of our new Toronto office! This position can be based onsite at our Toronto office (24 Ward Street), or hybrid.
Bonus Points:
• Ability to effectively use git 

• Familiarity in SQL and/or NoSQL databases and data design (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, etc.) 

• Familiarity with containerized software (Kubernetes, K8s) and infrastructure-as-code (Ansible, Terraform, etc.)

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies in the US to the top of the list. 
 
Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.
 
Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.


We are looking for a driven Accounting Intern with a basic understanding of financial principles and terms who is ready for an immersive, real-world experience. Under the supervision of our staff, the Accounting Intern can expect to prepare journal entries and financial reports, analyze financial data, utilize ERP software, and assist the accounting staff with other accounting activities. If you are a motivated team player who can maintain efficiency and accuracy when multitasking, we encourage you to apply! This internship offers a year-long hybrid work schedule, running from May 2025 - May 2026 in Lehi, Utah. During the summer months the role is full-time, but will transition to part-time during the academic year.
 
 
Frequently Asked Questions
 
What does a typical day look like for an accounting intern?
-Shadowing members of the Accounting department as they perform their duties
-Assisting with research, data entry, and maintaining accurate and complete financial records
-Preparing financial reports, such as balance sheets and income statements, invoices, and other documents
-Working with Accounting or ERP software
-Taking on additional tasks or projects to learn more about accounting and office operations
 
What will I need to thrive in this role?
-Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting
-Possess an understanding of accounting and financial principles and a positive attitude
-Demonstrate collaboration, trustworthiness, receptiveness to feedback, and eagerness to learn.
-Handle sensitive or confidential information with honesty and integrity
-Learn to work as part of the Accounting team to compile and analyze data, track information, and support the company or clients
 
What does high performance look like?
-You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
-You give 100% to all tasks and projects assigned to you
-You take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion
 
What is my potential for career growth?
This role will provide opportunities for mentorship and networking. Additionally, outstanding performance during the internship could potentially lead to a full-time position within the company.
 
What is the team like?
You will collaborate closely with full-time Accounting team members and receive supervision from the Global Controller and Accounting Managers. Both the Corporate Controller and the Accounting Mangers will serve as your mentors, meeting wit-h you regularly to discuss your performance and provide guidance. This data-driven and results-oriented team values collaboration, encouraging all members to contribute ideas and insights to implement actionable solutions effectively.

What does a typical day look like for an Operations intern?
• 
Working side by side with the Operations Business Intelligence Analyst on reporting and analysis requests, and shadowing other members of the Operations department to see how their work connects to the data

• 
Pulling, cleaning, and validating operational data from multiple sources (spreadsheets, internal systems, and marketplace and fulfillment partner data), and maintaining accurate and complete operational records

• 
Building and refreshing weekly and monthly reports, dashboards, and spreadsheets that track key metrics such as inventory levels, order status, shipment timeliness, and fulfillment accuracy

• 
Monitoring inventory, orders, and shipments across marketplaces and fulfillment partners, spotting anomalies and trends in the data, and flagging issues to the right owners for follow-up

• 
Digging into ad hoc questions from Operations team members (for example, "why did on-time shipments dip last week?") and presenting what you find in a clear, concise summary

• 
Documenting reporting logic, data definitions, and processes so that others can understand and reuse your work, and identifying opportunities to automate manual tasks and improve efficiency and accuracy

• 
Owning a small project or analysis during your internship and sharing your findings and recommendations with the Operations team

• 
Taking on additional tasks or projects to learn more about ecommerce operations, business intelligence, and supply chain management
What will I need to thrive in this role?
• 
Currently pursuing a degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field

• 
Possess an understanding of operations, supply chain, and business principles and a positive attitude

• 
Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort with formulas, pivot tables, and lookups, and an ease working with large data sets

• 
Familiarity with SQL or BI and data visualization tools is a plus; a strong interest in learning them is a must

• 
Natural curiosity and an analytical mindset: you ask "why" when numbers look off, and you check your work before you share it

• 
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accuracy when working with large volumes of data

• 
Demonstrate collaboration, trustworthiness, receptiveness to feedback, and eagerness to learn

• 
Demonstrate strong organization and communication skills, including the ability to explain data and findings clearly to non-technical teammates, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines

• 
Handle sensitive or confidential information with honesty and integrity

• 
Learn to work as part of the Operations team to compile and analyze data, track information, and support the company or client.
What does high performance look like?
• 
You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

• 
You give 100% to all tasks and projects assigned to you

• 
You take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

• 
You spot issues early and bring forward solutions, not just problems

• 
Your data and reports are accurate, well documented, and trusted by the people who rely on them

• 
You go beyond the numbers: you tell the story behind the data and recommend a clear next step

• 
You proactively look for ways to automate or simplify recurring reports and manual work

• 
You ask thoughtful questions, seek out feedback, and apply it quickly
What is my potential for career growth?
•

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
BUILDING HEALTHCARE THAT REMEMBERS 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're on the hunt for driven and scrappy product-minded engineering interns to join our team at an exciting stage of our startup's journey. If you're eager to build products, tackle challenging problems, and see your work reach real users, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact. You'll gain hands-on experience in a dynamic startup environment, working with cutting-edge generative AI and voice/transcription models and technologies.

As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to take ideas from zero to one. You'll own meaningful projects, contribute to product decisions, and learn what it takes to build and scale software for healthcare professionals. If you're a self-starter who likes to experiment, figure things out, and ship, you'll fit right in. You'll have plenty of autonomy, with guidance and feedback from the team as you navigate new challenges.

The anticipated dates for this role are January 11th - April 30th.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work closely with our engineering team to build features and products from the ground up.

 - Own a scoped project from initial design through implementation, testing, and deployment, with support from experienced engineers.

 - Explore and apply generative AI and voice/transcription technologies to solve real problems for healthcare professionals.

 - Participate actively in product, design, and development discussions, contributing fresh ideas and perspectives.

 - Learn from healthcare professionals and translate their feedback into thoughtful product improvements.

 - Help develop secure, scalable software that meets our HIPAA compliance and security requirements.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field

 - Strong engineering fundamentals and experience building software through coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions, or previous internships.

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills and comfort working through ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment.

 - Willingness to wear multiple hats, from understanding user needs and designing features to writing code, testing, and debugging.

 - Curiosity, openness to feedback, and a willingness to learn through rapid iteration and experimentation.

 - Bonus points for experience with React, TypeScript, or Go; building or deploying AI/LLM applications; or working with evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com http://assorthealth.com email address.

Our Summer Internship Program is designed for students entering their final year of university who are eager to gain meaningful, real-world experience in a fast paced, collaborative, and professional environment.

As a Summer Intern, you'll participate in a comprehensive onboarding experience led by our University Relations team to set you up for success from day one. Throughout the program, you'll also have the opportunity to participate in weekly professional development sessions, networking events, social activities, and other engaging experienced designed to support your personal and professional growth.

• Detail Oriented

jobs.title: Software Engineer 1
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You are a Junior Software Engineer looking to take your career and technical skills to the next level. Your passion is learning new technical areas and coming up with innovative solutions for customer problems. You are looking for an opportunity to grow rapidly and take on high impact work alongside your team.

At Axon, you will develop high quality mission critical software in a collaborative environment while leveraging modern frameworks, tools, and AI-assisted development workflows. You will operate in an AI-first engineering environment where intelligent tooling, code generation, and data-driven decision making are embedded into daily development practices.

You will use your passion, experience, and analytical skills to help bring new solutions to public safety and leave a positive impact on the world.

What You’ll Do

Location: Seattle, Scottsdale, Boston, Atlanta
Reports to: Software Engineering Manager

• Participate in code reviews and architecture design meetings, incorporating AI-assisted insights and tooling

• Own and drive end-to-end features with Product and Design, leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and improve quality

• Ensure that your code hits a high bar for quality and performance, including validating AI-generated code outputs

• Work in an AI-first environment where developer productivity is augmented through copilots, automation, and intelligent systems

• Work together with like-minded people who are passionate about our mission

• Work with the latest open source technologies and AI-enabled development platforms

• Have mentorship from experienced engineers on both traditional and AI-assisted software engineering practices

What You Bring

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering, OR 2+ years of relevant experience, OR coding boot camp

• Professional software development internship

• Experience in at least one managed language such as Java, Scala, Go, C# or similar

• Familiarity with or interest in AI-assisted development tools, code generation, and automation workflows

• You follow the latest in software engineering, including emerging AI-driven development practices

• You love delighting end users and solving novel challenges in a rapidly evolving technical landscape

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Development Programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range
$106,500—$170,400 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com. Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. jobs.title: Software Engineer Co-op
jobs.description:
This is a temporary/seasonal position running from January 2027 through June 2027.



About the Role

At AgZen, you’ll be joining a multidisciplinary engineering team that includes hardware, electrical, and software engineers working together to transform traditional agricultural practices. Our mission centers on retrofitting existing sprayers with advanced technology that enables smarter pesticide use through data collection and real-time insights.

As part of the software team, which spans everything from firmware to computer vision to general software engineering, you’ll help design, build, and maintain the user-facing applications that run directly on sprayers around the world, as well as our cloud portal that enables folks to review and interact with their data. Your work will support a wide range of users, from internal team members to farmers and potential business partners, helping them better understand and optimize chemical usage in agriculture.



What You’ll Do

 - Ship real features, fast! Design, build, test, and deploy changes in hours, not weeks, without layers of red tape.

 - Work across the full stack, from embedded code on field equipment to cloud services and user-facing web apps and learn the whole thing hands-on.

 - Collaborate on features sparked by teammates, company leadership, and real customer needs - then watch your work get used in the field in real time.

 - Get direct exposure to customers and see how your code performs live over satellite connections in actual farming environments.

 - Test your work in a hardware-equipped lab that simulates real-world conditions — no waiting on others to see results.

 - Push the limits of what’s possible with edge computing by creating the most user-friendly touch interface in modern agriculture tech.

What We’re Looking For

 - Proven software development experience through at least one prior internship or co-op.

 - Interest and flexibility to work across both frontend and backend technologies — we’re looking for curious generalists eager to grow.

 - Willingness to learn new tools, dive into unfamiliar systems, and take ownership of real-world problems.

 - Capability to conceptualize and and execute on projects both collaboratively and independently.

 - Alignment with our mission — we value teammates who care about sustainability and want to make a real impact in agriculture and the environment.

jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you


Data Scientist



Your Mission

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies.

You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance.

You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech.


Responsibilities

 - Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members.

 - Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models.

 - Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions.

 - Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them.

 - Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system.

 - Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on.

 - Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills.


Requirements

 - 0–2 years' experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field.

 - Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.

 - Solid grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques.

 - Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets.

 - Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes.

 - Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team.

 - Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus.


The Perks

 - We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team.

 - Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

 - Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support.

 - Cycle-to-Work Scheme.

 - Health and Life Insurance.

 - Pension Scheme.

 - 25 days of Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays).

 - Office snacks every day.

 - Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London.



Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

AIR is seeking a Data Scientist to join the Project Success and Innovation (PSI) team and the Employment and Economic Opportunity Program (EEOP), providing advanced technical expertise to support innovation development, scaling efforts, and applied research and analytics across project teams. Within PSI, the Data Scientist will contribute to AIR’s Innovation Lab by co-designing, developing, and scaling solutions that strengthen and amplify effective practices across diverse technical and operational workflows.

Within EEOP, the Data Scientist will lead end-to-end quantitative workflows, including establishing and maintaining reproducible analytic environments, managing and quality assuring complex datasets, reviewing and strengthening junior staff members’ code, and conducting advanced statistical analyses. These analyses may include causal approaches, such as experimental and quasi-experimental designs, as well as non-causal approaches, including descriptive, predictive, and explanatory modeling. The Data Scientist will also help expand AIR’s capacity to responsibly apply machine learning methods in support of both research and operational objectives, while translating technical findings into clear, actionable products for clients, partners, and other stakeholders.

Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities for the position include:

PSI (approximately 50%)

• Build and maintain shared analytic tools, including code libraries, project templates, and pipelines, that research teams across AIR can adopt and reuse.

• Write documentation, training materials, and onboarding guides that make modern tooling accessible to staff with varying levels of technical experience.

• Support project teams adopting new tools and workflows by answering questions, troubleshooting, and relaying recurring problems back to the team.

• Prototype and test new tools and platforms, including machine learning and AI applications such as large language models, and help assess their fit and responsible use at AIR.

• Help maintain deployed tools by triaging issues, fixing bugs, and tracking user feedback.

• Contribute to work plans, timelines, and progress tracking for PSI activities, communicating regularly with PSI leadership.

EEOP (approximately 50%)

• Conduct quantitative analyses on research and evaluation projects, including analyses for causal and non-causal research questions.

• Serve as lead analyst on discrete studies or analytic components, with support from senior researchers.

• Manage, clean, and quality-assure complex datasets from multiple sources.

• Build and document reproducible analytic workflows and quality control procedures.

• Review analytic code produced by research associates and other junior staff, and support their development in reproducible analysis and documentation practices.

• Contribute to study design and analytic planning discussions.

• Draft analytic sections of client reports, technical memos, and presentations, and help translate findings for non-technical audiences.

• Track deliverables and timelines for assigned analytic tasks.

• Contribute technical content to proposals.

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

• Master's or doctoral degree in a quantitative field, including statistics, computational social science, education data science, statistics, economics, quantitative psychology, quantitative methods, data science, or a related discipline, recently completed or nearing completion. Coursework or applied experience in causal inference and statistical modeling.

• Experience with complex survey data, sampling, and large-scale administrative, longitudinal, or linked datasets.

• Experience applying quantitative methods to education, health, or social policy questions.

• Experience or familiarity with machine learning and AI methods, including applications of large language models in research.

• Interest in building tools that other people use, and willingness to support them in doing so.

• Familiarity with data common in applied social research, such as administrative records, longitudinal student or program data, survey data, or text.

• Prior work building or maintaining code used by others.

• Working knowledge of Stata.

• Familiarity with version control (Git and Github) and an interest in reproducible research practices.

• Familiarity with literate programming and reproducible reporting tools such as Quarto, R Markdown, or Jupyter.

• Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues who have varying levels of technical experience.

• Ability to write clearly about technical work for non-technical readers.

About the Team

DoorDash Labs is DoorDash's autonomous delivery group, building the robots and hardware that move goods without a driver. The Vehicle Electrical team designs the electronics at the core of these systems, including power and motor-control electronics, charging, and the test benches that prove the whole system works.

About the Role

As a summer intern, you will own a defined hardware project in one of three areas: an on-board charger prototype, an in-house motor control circuit, or a full-power hardware test bench with motor power and battery simulation. You will take it from requirements through design, build, and bench validation, and present your results to the team at the end of the summer. You will report into the Director, Electrical Engineering in our DoorDash Labs organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own an end-to-end project in one of three areas: an on-board charger prototype, an in-house motor control circuit, or a full-power hardware test bench.

• Design, build, and bring up hardware, from schematic and component selection through prototype assembly and debug.

• Characterize your design on the bench with lab equipment, measuring efficiency, thermal, and control performance against requirements.

• Collaborate with power electronics, firmware, and test engineers, and incorporate design review feedback into your work.

• Document your results and present your findings to the team at the end of your internship.

We're excited about you because…

jobs.title: Safety Research Scholar Intern
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

That work includes finding where models fail, checking whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Scholars take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Each scholar owns a substantial part of a safety research project. You'll work alongside a mentor from the research question through the experiments to deciding what to test next.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide Research Scholars on projects in selected AI safety research areas in select AI safety research areas, such as:

• AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AIs, including detecting harmful intent or deception.

• Alignment auditing and evaluations: Building scalable methods to test whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.

• Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.

• Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.

• Science of Evaluations: examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.

• Misuse risks and evaluations: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

• ASPI: 728 task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.

• PropensityBench: simulating real-world pressure to choose between safe or harmful behavior

• BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.

• See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

What You'll Do

Projects are mentor-guided. By default, you will be given a list of research proposals and match you with one based on your research interests and background. You’ll meet weekly with a Scale researcher who sets the direction and gives feedback, and you will drive the day-to-day work.

• Own research end to end: Turn a high-level safety question into hypotheses, baselines, and controlled experiments, and produce work that others can inspect and build on.

• Build the measurement: Implement and debug evaluation harnesses, agent environments, datasets, monitoring methods, or post-training experiments.

• Exercise research judgment: Identify confounds, separate what a model can do from what it tends to do, make sense of negative results, and decide what to try next without step-by-step direction.

• Make the work legible: Produce reproducible code, experiment logs, analysis, and precise technical writing. External outputs, where appropriate, remain subject to research, security, and communications review. Outputs also include research papers, which will be submitted to top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

Who We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you:

• are motivated by ensuring the safe and responsible development of advanced AI systems;

• are interested in technical safety research, such as alignment evaluations, AI control, monitoring, multi-agent safety, or open-weight model safety;

• are pursuing or have completed a PhD in CS, ML, statistics, mathematics, or a related field (we also encourage researchers with an equivalent track record to apply);

• can make progress with high-level guidance, including implementing, debugging, getting unstuck, interpreting results, and proposing next experiments;

• communicate research clearly and handle confidential information and internal systems responsibly.

Application Process

• Apply: Submit your resume or CV, your Google Scholar profile if you have one, and one research project you substantially owned, with 2–3 sentences on your contribution.

• Research background discussion: Walk us through a past project, including what you tried, what didn't work, and what you learned.

• Research design: Work through a research problem with us and propose how you'd approach it.

• Onboarding: Successful candidates complete the applicable recruiting, work-authorization, security, and project-onboarding steps.

About the Role

• Location: Remote within the United States, including California and New York

• Hours: 20 hours per week

• Term: 3 months, with the option to extend to 6–12 months for exceptional candidates (part-time Internship structure)

• Compensation: $100/hour

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

Job Description: 
Partner with the Intel performance optimization team on a multi-agent system that profiles real-world software, diagnoses performance bottlenecks down to the hardware level, and proposes code optimizations. As a software engineer intern, you will work at the intersection of agent engineering, harness engineering and performance optimization. You will design and develop new capabilities for the agent. You will validate the agent's results on real-world codebases and hardware, and resolve the technical challenges that come up in turning AI-generated ideas into trustworthy, measurable improvements.

What you will get:

 Mentorship from senior performance engineers, and deep, hands-on learning of how software meets hardware

 Real impact: your work is applied to real-world software, with opportunities to contribute to open-source projects and technical publications

Duration: 6+ months, 4+ days per week

Qualifications:
You should be pursuing a master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related major. This requirement is flexible for candidates with a strong passion for this technical domain.

Required:

 Solid programming skills in at least one of Python/C/C++/Java

 Basic understanding of AI agents

 Fluent English communication skills

 Open to new technologies, eager to learn, and committed to delivering solid work

 Hands-on experience with an AI agent or AI coding tool, with an understanding of how it works

 Experience building a sizable project with LLM

 Knowledge of operating systems, computer architecture or performance analysis

 Experience with Linux profiling tools such as perf or eBPF

jobs.description:

About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Sales
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Start Date: November 2, 2026 or December 7, 2026
Relocation is not provided for this opportunity.

The Experience
As a Business Development Associate at Salesforce, you aren’t just starting a career in sales. You are joining the #1 AI CRM to redefine how business is done. This role is a unique hybrid of active sales development and operational excellence. You will serve as the engine of our SMB (Small & Medium Business) team, tasked with both proactively hunting new business through targeted outbound prospecting and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to streamline workflows. You will be the operational backbone of the team, using data-driven insights to refine our outreach strategies while building the foundational skills to become a world-class Sales Development Representative.

The Salesforce Business Development Associate Program is a fast-track, high-impact initiative. You will work at the intersection of human creativity and Agentic AI, mastering our Customer 360 platform to identify high-value opportunities, optimize lead flows, and drive scalable growth for our customers.

Career Acceleration: Successful completion of this 3-5 month program positions you to advance to the Sales Development Representative role, equipped with a technical and operational edge that sets you apart in the industry.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing
• Pipeline Development: Qualify inbound and outbound leads via phone outreach to prioritize high-potential SMB opportunities.
• Strategic Prospecting: Master the art of the hunt by identifying SMB prospects and executing personalized outreach. You’ll be supported by proven playbooks and tools, with an expectation to provide input on what’s working to help us continuously sharpen our approach.
• Operations & Process Optimization: Drive organizational efficiency by maintaining Salesforce data integrity and deploying AI-powered insights to streamline workflows, improve pipeline hygiene, and scale sales productivity.

You’re Our Person If...
• Sales & Career Ready: Not just interested in sales but hungry for it. Passionate about mastering the #1 AI CRM and building a long-term career in professional sales. Previous internship or work experience in sales is a plus!
• Resilient and Goal Oriented: Energized by achieving/exceeding targets and KPIs, displays a high level of accountability, and brings unstoppable energy and resilience to every challenge along the way.
• Operational Problem Solver: A natural ability to break down complex challenges and develop efficient step by step technical solutions.
• Effective Communicator: Strong verbal and written skills with the ability to convey complex value propositions clearly and professionally.
• Growth Mindset: A self motivated learner who is eager to master the tools and skills required to progress into a full cycle sales role.

Why Salesforce:
• Hands-on Experience: Gain real-world experience in lead qualification and customer profiling while serving as the operational backbone of the team. You will balance direct prospect engagement with critical business operations, ensuring our systems run at peak efficiency while you develop the core sales skills needed for your next career step.
• Growth Trajectory: Build your foundation on the #1 AI CRM. You will develop the technical and operational fluency that serves as a launchpad for your career at Salesforce. This role provides the blueprint to grow into a high-impact sales career.
• Community: Join a team built on Trust and Innovation. We prioritize continuous mentorship and collaborative problem-solving, ensuring you have the support to bring your full self to work while making a tangible impact on how businesses grow.

This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Software Engineer — Automation & Reliability
aMTS - Junior 
Mexico City 

About the role
Help build the next generation of AI-powered engineering. Join our AI-native Academy as an early-career software engineer to solve real production challenges, build intelligent automation and strengthen system reliability. With hands-on guidance from a senior mentor, you’ll combine software development with production support experience, building the skills to grow into broader product and platform engineering roles.
You’ll investigate support cases, troubleshoot production issues and participate in support rotations—gaining firsthand insight into how complex systems work and where they can improve. Your mandate goes beyond resolving individual issues: you’ll build software, AI agents and tools that eliminate recurring manual work and prevent problems from returning.
Your projects could include agentic Tier 1/2 case automation, automated access workflows, technical knowledge retrieval, log analysis and system hardening. You’ll write, test, review and deploy code, with opportunities to own improvements from identifying the problem to measuring the result.
As you demonstrate strong engineering skills and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to graduate into core product engineering teams, based on your readiness and business needs. It’s a chance to learn through practical ownership, deliver meaningful improvements and build a foundation for your software engineering career.

What you’ll do
• Investigate and resolve support cases, production defects, access issues and integration failures.
• Build automation for recurring tasks such as access requests, case responses, log analysis, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Develop AI agents and workflows that help classify cases, retrieve relevant knowledge and execute approved actions with appropriate safeguards.
• Identify root causes and improve code, monitoring, tests and documentation to prevent recurring incidents.
• Write, test, review and deploy maintainable software using established engineering practices.
• Participate in incident response and scheduled support or on-call rotations, with training and guidance appropriate to your experience.
• Work with senior mentors and product teams to understand systems, prioritize improvements and deliver changes safely.
• Measure the impact of your work through reduced manual effort, fewer repeat issues, faster resolution and improved reliability.

What you’ll bring
• Foundational programming skills in at least one language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript or Go.
• An understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, testing, version control and debugging.
• An ability to investigate problems using logs, error messages and system behavior.
• Curiosity about automation, AI-assisted development and reliable production systems.
• Clear communication, a collaborative approach and a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback.
• A degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We welcome evidence of your skills from internships, coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions or professional experience. The scope and independence expected will reflect the level of the role.

Helpful experience
• Building scripts, internal tools or workflow automation.
• Salesforce platform working knowledge preferably with Salesforce admin certification & APEX hands on experience - or desire to obtain certification.
• Working with cloud platforms, databases, CI/CD pipelines or monitoring tools.
• Developing or integrating AI agents, large language models or knowledge retrieval systems.
• Supporting enterprise applications or investigating production incidents.
• Applying secure coding practices, access controls and audit logging.

You’ll receive mentoring, code review and practical experience across the software development lifecycle. As you demonstrate engineering capability and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to increasingly complex systems and broader product development, based on your readiness and team needs.
Success means solving today’s problems while building software that reduces tomorrow’s manual work.
