jobs.title: Test Engineering Co-op
jobs.description:
About Moment Energy

Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it.

Energy should be free. Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone.

The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy.

Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact.

We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale.

Now is the moment. Join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Test Engineering Co-op to join our Test Engineering team. We recently unveiled our new manufacturing facility, the largest second-life battery repurposing facility in the world, and are quickly ramping up our testing and production capacity..

This is a hands-on role, with lots of time in our new R&D lab and around the production floor. You will set up and run test benches, troubleshoot complex issues across multiple subsystems, and command massive amounts of electrical power. You’ll get exposure to every level of the stack from building custom prototyping harnesses to wrangling data from DAQs.

In this role, you will directly support the development and testing of our energy storage products while gaining hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Assist the test engineering team in validating and improving energy storage products

• Set up, configure, and maintain instruments and test benches for battery systems and power electronics

• Assemble and modify electrical assemblies including wire harnessing, soldering, crimping, and circuit board assembly

• Configure, debug, and operate devices via different communication protocols (CAN, Modbus, TCP/IP, serial)

• Develop test plans, execute testing, analyze data, and write technical reports

The Student we’re looking for:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field

• Strong preference for students with Design Team experience

• Career interest in clean tech, energy systems, or electronics

• Comfortable reading electrical schematics

• Some experience with Python or similar scripting tools

• Hands-on experience with soldering, circuit boards, wiring, harness building, system integration or prototyping (academic or project-based experience welcome)

• Ability to use 3D printing, hand tools, or power tools to build test fixtures

• Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment

The Experience You’ll Gain:

• Hands-on experience developing real energy storage hardware

• Mentorship from experienced engineers

• Exposure to prototyping, testing, and certification processes

• The opportunity to contribute to technology that supports the clean energy transition

Moment Energy Co-op Benefits Highlights

Paid Time Off: Co-op’s receive three paid days off per term

Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga and fitness center), and free EV charging on-site.

Why join us?

• Today, we’re delivering 5x the energy density and have all the certifications needed to ship energy independence to the world.

• Be part of a mission-driven company focused on creating sustainable energy solutions and making a positive impact on the world.

• Collaborate closely with passionate co-founders and a team committed to innovation and excellence.

• Contribute to building and scaling a company from the ground up, where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact.

• Thrive in a workplace that values collaboration, wellness, and celebrating successes, with regular company socials, fitness sessions, and more.

We're a fast-paced and dynamic team.

Every day you'll be taking on a new challenge and learning something new. You'll take on a wide breadth of tasks and contribute to disrupting the battery industry. You'll be part of a tight-knit team that is working together to save the planet! Fun, health, and wellness are incorporated into our daily schedule and we encourage all our team members to bring innovative ideas to the table to create an interactive workplace. 

Moment Energy Benefits Highlights (full time, permanent employees only)

Financial Growth: Employee equity and a robust RRSP matching program.

Comprehensive Health Coverage: Extended health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents through Manulife.

Generous Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off plus a paid company closure between Christmas and New Year's, with a generous paid sick leave.

Vibrant Culture & Perks: Open and collaborative office culture, frequent company socials and wellness programs (weekly yoga/fitness), and free EV charging on-site.

Company Dinner: Weekly Tuesday dinner provided by Moment Energy. We also have a generous supply of coffee and snacks for the office! 

Our Commitments

Moment Energy is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes, including our work environment. We especially welcome applications from Indigenous peoples, members of racialized communities, persons with disabilities, women, and persons who identify as 2SLGBTQ+.

—---

Our Values

Our values are key to how we show up every day at Moment Energy! We keep them in the forefront of what we do, and they’re used everywhere. We refer to them when we have tough decisions to make, we give shoutouts based on living out these values, and we include them as part of our performance reviews.

We have 5 core values and 1 foundational pillar (Safety is our Foundation) which lays the groundwork for everything we do.

Safety is our Foundation

We prioritize the safety of our products, customers, employees, and the general public above all else. From the workshop to the field, we maintain the highest standards for our batteries in testing manufacturing and deployment, and daily operations. Safety is not only about procedures—it is about vigilance, responsibility, and speaking up when something does not feel right.

Safety is everyone's responsibility. We follow safety protocols, use proper equipment, and continuously improve our systems to prevent risks before they occur. If something is unsafe, we stop work and address it.

Safety also means protecting our colleagues, customers, and communities by designing reliable products, maintaining safe workspaces, and ensuring our work is done carefully and responsibly.

We’re Building a Greener Future Together: 

We infuse passion for our cleantech mission into every aspect of our work and incorporate fun into the workplace. We motivate one another, celebrate our successes and embrace eco-friendly practices to reduce our carbon footprint.

We Prioritize our Customer’s Needs: 

We place our customers at the core of everything we do, ensuring that every decision considers their needs and aims to provide increased value to them. We provide reliable support for our customers, every step of the way. 

We’re Open, Honest and Accountable:

We prioritize open and honest communication to foster mutual understanding, strengthen knowledge sharing, and reduce miscommunication within the team. We admit when we’ve made a mistake, and remedy our actions. We transparently communicate outcomes whether good, bad, or unexpected. 

We Think

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Recommendation Performance Efficiency
Electrical or Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day 🚀✨

Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one: Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT. For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, a roughly $200B global industry expected to double in the next decade. We work for toll authorities and state DOTs, and we own the whole system, from the roadside camera to the final bill, so every vehicle we see becomes one accurate toll transaction and nothing more. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30. Our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).



You are a good fit if...

 - You love the grind: You take ownership and put in the time to meet deadlines. Our recent team survey showed an average of 55 hours/week, with occasional 70+ hour bursts for major releases.

 - You are detail obsessed: You have experience writing code, designing or building systems that stands up to the unpredictability of the physical world, where the small details are the difference between success and failure.

 - You are adaptable: We are a lean team. If you only want to work on a "niche thing" or are uncomfortable helping other teams when they need a boost, this isn't the place for you. We expect you to figure out what you need to get stuff done.

 - You're not afraid to code: This is a hardware-centered role but most of our teammates have broad skillsets that allow them to build what they need, including code to help make our hardware more effective. At minimum you should be comfortable sketching what you need and collaborating with software engineers to build it. We mostly use Python, but we don’t care what you’re most proficient in today as long as you learn fast.

 - You value working together in person: You’re excited to work alongside the team at our Denver office. This role is in-office five days a week, Monday through Friday, with flexibility to work remotely occasionally when needed.
   
    

The Mission: From Theory to High-Traffic Reality At a team of less than 30, we don't have "junior" tasks. You will be given immediate ownership over the hardware that keeps the Interstate Highway System running. You will use the basics of electrical, mechanical, and software engineering to:

 - Optimize the Edge: Improve the reliability of cameras, detectors, and night-time illuminators that survive 24/7 exposure.

 - Prototyping & R&D: Design circuit schematics and PCBs for new hardware integrations that push our device performance further.

 - Full-Stack Hardware: Write the on-device code (Python/C++) to integrate new sensors and ensure the servers can handle the incoming data.

 - Build for Scale: Iterate on CAD models to make our assembly process faster and more robust.
   
    


REQUIREMENTS:

 - Education: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. We are open to 2027 grads but may run those applications through a separate cohort.

 - Portfolio of "Things": A track record of actually building physical hardware. Whether it’s high-impact internships, senior design projects, or a workbench full of hobbyist electronics (Raspberry Pi, ESP32, custom PCBs), we want to see what you’ve brought to life.

 - Technical Versatility: You have a foundational understanding of circuit design and CAD, but you aren't afraid to write code. You should be comfortable (or eager to become comfortable) in Python or C++ to make your hardware talk to our software.

 - Mindset: You take extreme ownership. You don't wait for a manual or a step-by-step guide; you figure out what you need to get stuff done and you do it with a professional, collaborative mentality. You understand that in a small team feedback is the fastest way to level up, and you welcome it.
   
    

Our Technical Ecosystem: While we value problem-solving over specific syntax, skills that transfer well are:

 - Languages: Python, TypeScript, C/C++

 - Tools: Altium, Onshape, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers

 - Infrastructure: Linux, IoT Edge Devices, AWS

 - Specialties: Edge Computer Vision, CAD, weatherproofing, outdoor deployment, vertical product integration

 

The Interview Process

We're a selectively small team, which means a deliberate and thorough interview process with 3-4 interviews and a final paid work trial. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to roads in weeks, not quarters.



The Essentials (Health & Wealth)

 - Relocation Support: We are excited for you to join the team at our engineering office in Denver. We value in-person collaboration and daily team lunches and we provide a relocation bonus to help you get here.

 - Personalized Health Coverage (ICHRA): We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all healthcare. We provide a monthly allowance for you and dependents so you can choose the individual plan that actually fits your life.

 - Investing in Your Future: 401(k) matching up to 4%.

 - Peace of Mind: Transparent compensation. Company-sponsored life & disability insurance.

 - Early Stage Equity: Competitive equity package. Every year, we facilitate a tender process that gives you the opportunity to sell your vested shares at the same valuation as our investors.

Rest & Recharge 🌴

 - High-Trust Time Off: 4 weeks of untracked PTO. We don't micromanage your calendar; we focus on your impact. Take the time you need to stay sharp and inspired.

 - Family First: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for birth and adoptive parents. We want you present for the moments that matter most.

 - The Deep Breath (Sabbatical): Every 5 years, take 12 weeks of fully paid leave. Go travel, write a book, or master a new hobby—then come back and tell us all about it.

Fuel & Community 😀

 - The Blissway Kitchen: Whether it’s breakfast to start your day or our daily group lunches, we keep the team fueled.

 - Snacks Autonomy: Our kitchen is fully stocked and we mean it—if we’re missing your favorite fuel, just add it to the request list.

 - The "BlissTrip": An annual 4-day getaway for the team and significant others.

 - Monthly Beats: Game nights, escape rooms, and dinners to celebrate the grit we put in.

 - Continuous Learning: Tuition reimbursement for courses, programs, and conferences that sharpen your craft.

jobs.description:
Advanced Reentry Technologies

Who We Are:

Inversion is an aerospace and defense company pioneering advanced reentry technology to enable next-generation capabilities from space. By combining high-performance materials, precision aerodynamics, and mission-driven autonomy, Inversion is transforming reentry into an operational capability for an entirely new class of missions.

The company’s highly maneuverable reentry spacecraft, Arc, is designed for rapid global cargo delivery, hypersonic testing, and other national security missions that require precise, controlled flight through the atmosphere. Arc creates an entirely new transportation domain, unlocking unprecedented speed and global reach.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Inversion designs, manufactures, and integrates its spacecraft under one roof, enabling the company to move rapidly from concept to flight. The company is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Spark Capital, and Lockheed Martin Ventures, with customers across the U.S. government and commercial space industry.

Position Overview:

As an Avionics Embedded Software Engineering Intern, you will support the development, integration, verification, and debugging of embedded software for Inversion’s next-generation reentry vehicles. You will sit within the Avionics team and work closely with embedded software, electrical, RF, GNC, test, and vehicle engineers to develop software that interfaces directly with flight hardware.

You will gain hands-on experience developing and debugging firmware and embedded software, bringing up new hardware, integrating sensors and communications interfaces, and validating software in laboratory and hardware-in-the-loop environments. This is a practical, systems-focused internship for students interested in embedded systems, real-time software, flight computers, hardware/software integration, and aerospace applications.

Key Responsibilities:

• Work closely with embedded software and avionics engineers to develop, integrate, test, and debug flight software and firmware.

• Develop software for microcontrollers, processors, sensors, communications interfaces, and other avionics hardware.

• Support board bring-up and hardware/software integration, including debugging interfaces between embedded software and electrical hardware.

• Implement and debug drivers and interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, GPIO, ADCs, and other embedded interfaces.

• Develop and execute software tests using laboratory hardware, engineering test fixtures, and hardware-in-the-loop systems.

• Support real-time software development using an RTOS or similar embedded software framework.

• Debug software and hardware issues using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, serial consoles, and software instrumentation.

• Develop test scripts and analysis tools using Python or similar languages to automate validation and characterize system behavior.

• Support integration of sensors, flight computers, RF systems, power electronics, and other avionics subsystems.

• Analyze failures and anomalies, identify root causes, and work with multidisciplinary teams to implement and verify corrective actions.

• Document software behavior, test results, interfaces, and technical findings to support flight hardware development and verification.

Required Qualifications:

• Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

• GPA of 3.0 or above.

• 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable).

• Coursework or project experience in embedded systems, computer architecture, operating systems, real-time systems, or related disciplines.

• Experience programming in C or C++.

• Experience developing software for a microcontroller, embedded processor, FPGA-based system, robotics platform, or similar hardware.

• Strong problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical results clearly to multidisciplinary teams.

Desired Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar.

• Experience with embedded Linux or low-level software development.

• Experience developing device drivers or low-level hardware interfaces.

• Familiarity with SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, GPIO, ADCs, or similar embedded interfaces.

• Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, or similar tools.

• Experience with board bring-up and hardware/software integration.

• Experience developing automated software tests or hardware-in-the-loop test systems.

• Experience with Python for test automation, data analysis, or development tooling.

• Familiarity with real-time concepts such as interrupts, scheduling, concurrency, synchronization, timing constraints, and memory management.

• Experience developing embedded systems through Formula SAE, student rocketry, CubeSat, robotics, or similar engineering projects.

• Previous internship experience at a space, aerospace, or hardware startup.

• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, software configuration management, and collaborative software development practices.

Our office headquarters is located in Playa Vista, CA. This position requires in-office presence.

The California annual base hourly rate for this role is currently $38-$41. Pay Grades are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and internal equity.

Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT NIANTIC SPATIAL

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production.

You’ll work alongside world-class researchers in computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics on large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, scene understanding, and geospatial foundation models. This role is open to junior and senior researchers; scope and responsibility are calibrated to your experience.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Research & Publication — Conduct original research in 3D computer vision, machine learning, and spatial AI; publish findings at top-tier venues including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH.

 - Algorithm Development — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models.

 - Research-to-Production — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds.

 - Large-Scale Experimentation — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods.

 - Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models.

 - Rapid Prototyping — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry.

 - A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas.

 - A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent).

 - Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.

 - Evidence that you can carry an idea from research into something real — a shipped feature, a production pipeline, a widely used open-source release, or similar.

 - The independence to drive research projects from idea generation through experimentation, publication, and handoff.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with classical reconstruction tooling (COLMAP or similar).

 - C++ or CUDA experience, and a feel for performance and on-device constraints.

 - Experience with traditional 3D techniques — meshing, texturing, or bringing modern geometry or generative representations into native 3D.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.




LOCATION & WORK MODEL

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.




INCLUSIVE APPLICATION

We know the strongest candidates don’t always tick every box. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we’re looking for.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.




CANDIDATE PRIVACY

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial’s Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


THE ROLE

We're looking for Software Engineering Interns to join Abridge's Engineering team for a 3-month internship program in Fall 2026, Spring 2027, or Summer 2027 with the possibility of extension. You'll collaborate with our engineering team to build and ship real-world features that translate cutting-edge language model capabilities into dependable clinical systems. With mentorship and guidance, you'll gain hands-on experience designing, coding, and releasing AI-powered software that makes a meaningful impact on clinicians' workflows.



What You'll Do

 - Design and build end-to-end features, enhancing our existing systems and contributing to agentic LLM workflows (retrieval pipelines, structured tool use, chained LLM calls)

 - Fix user-facing bugs and issues, and make quality-of-life improvements across our backend and frontend systems

 - Get hands-on with evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, robustness, and clinical reliability

 - Help prototype with new models, prompting techniques, and open-source orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.)

 - Develop a strong user-centric mindset, building empathy for Abridge's clinicians and the challenges they face

 - Collaborate across cross-functional product teams — design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure — to ship features to our customers

 - Receive guidance from an experienced software engineering mentor, and collaborate one-on-one with teammates within your pod



What You'll Bring

 - A strong interest in pursuing a full-time software engineering role in 2027 or 2028 — high-performing interns are eligible to receive a return offer

 - AI tooling is already part of how you work — you use it to write, debug, and learn faster, and you know when to trust it vs. verify

 - Passion for and understanding of Abridge's mission

 - A curious, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment

 - A collaborative, low-ego mindset — we move fast, and we need team players who are eager to contribute wherever needed



Base Salary: $40/hr



Must be willing to work from our San Francisco (Potrero) office 5x per week.



This internship is based in our San Francisco office. Relocation to SF will be supported through reimbursements.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Our vision is to create engaging and unique experiences that bring our mission to life while building a sustainable, high-growth business. We lead with passion, innovation, and a commitment to doing things differently.

• Collaborate with Ticket Sales to communicate complex insights in a clear and compelling way

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with different teams and personalities

JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS
R&D Engineer Intern
Job Description and Position Requirements:
We are searching for a motivated undergraduate student to join the Information Sciences Division, MLOps Department at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. This position will be located at a government facility in Key West, Florida, during the Summer of 2027. The selected students will support research and development activities focused on applying data analysis, information science, software, and security technologies to real-world government applications. The intern will work alongside engineers, researchers, and government personnel to support the development, integration, testing, and evaluation of emerging technologies in an operational environment.
 
Typical focus areas include:
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML)
• Data analytics, data mining, and visualization
• Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and geospatial data analysis
• Relational and network analysis tools
• Software development, integration, and testing
• Information and cybersecurity, both in theory and practice
Students majoring in the following fields are encouraged to apply:
• B.S. in an engineering discipline
• B.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related technical discipline
Interest Skills/Experience areas include:
• Experience with or interest in programming and scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, or similar languages
• Familiarity with data analysis, data visualization, or data-processing techniques and tools
• Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or data-driven applications
• Familiarity with GIS, geospatial technologies, relational databases, or network analysis tools
• Understanding of basic software development, systems integration, or cybersecurity concepts
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to troubleshoot technical challenges
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary technical team
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical activities and results
• Current eligibility for access to classified information at the Secret level or higher is preferred. You may also be subject to a government background investigation to upgrade clearance eligibility, if required.
You will work up to 40 hours/week over the summer. This is a paid internship opportunity, and location will be:
• Fully on-site located in Key West, FL.
 
BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES
Employment with the University will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with University policies. 
 
Notice regarding employment at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL):
Employees must be eligible to obtain a government security clearance, participate in the ARL drug testing program, and comply with electronic and physical monitoring requirements applicable to federal contractors. ARL operates in a secure information environment involving Unclassified, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and Classified information. jobs.title: Software Engineering Apprentice
jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Opportunity
Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships from 2-4yrs. across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that offers the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.

Whether leaving School or College with GCSEs/Standards, A ‘Levels/Highers (or equivalent) or in work and looking for a new career path, you are fully supported as you rotate within the business working on real-time projects alongside highly skilled professionals. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected and enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects.

Are you looking for a career in software engineering and the opportunity to work on real-time projects alongside leading scientists and engineers within a globally renowned company? Then why not apply for the Leonardo Software Engineering Degree Apprenticeship!

Leonardo is an international leader in electronic and information technologies for defence systems, aerospace, data, infrastructures, land security and protection, and sustainable ’smart’ solutions. We are a continually expanding company, offering exciting opportunities to talented individuals who want to work at the forefront of technology.

Programme Description
Are you looking for a great start to your career in Software Engineering, earning and learning on a professionally accredited, award-winning scheme? We are looking to recruit the experts of the future on our nationally recognised, award-winning Apprenticeship Programmes.
You will be working within world class facilities regardless of which site you are based. There may also be opportunities to travel between the Company’s UK sites to meet with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

How this role fits in

Leonardo's four-year Software Engineering Degree Apprenticeship programme is looking for people who understand the importance of communication, who are able to work well as part of a team and on their own initiative. You will have the drive and commitment to work through difficult problems to find the right engineering solutions.

Role description
You will also attend university on a day release basis to complete your Digital and Technology Solutions Professional Apprenticeship (ST0119) which includes a BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions (Software Engineer) degree.

We need people who understand the importance of our Customers and are ready to commit to working in the business, whilst also committing to a degree programme. At the end of the programme, you will work as a highly qualified member of our Software Engineering community.
You will be working for a company at the cutting edge of technology, as well as enhancing your skills and business acumen, opening up your horizons to the diverse and dynamic ways to apply your academic learning in a practical environment.

We have created a programme across our UK sites that value those who continuously ask questions and look to resolve problems through creative and innovative thinking. 

Who would suit this role?
Leonardo values people that look to always develop throughout their career and along with an eager willingness to learn, a successful apprenticeship with Leonardo involves a drive to deliver results, sometimes from your own initiative, a patience for problem solving, as well as a need to comply with safety instructions and clear process compliance at all times. We view commitment to the programme and learning objectives very highly.

Note: This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has little professional engineering experience and is NOT suitable for candidates who already have an engineering/softwre degree.

During your apprenticeship, you will:
• Grow your knowledge of an engineering business and what the role of a Software Engineer is by being part of our Integrated Project Teams.
• Develop practical skills in software engineering and understanding key processes and technologies.
• Support early careers activities - our apprentices have the opportunity to work as STEM ambassadors in schools, colleges and universities
• Commit to the successful completion of all your academic modules and assignments in support of a recognised Level 6 Apprenticeship standard.

Qualifications
You must have as a minimum:
104 UCAS Points to include at least 2 STEM subjects (3 C's at A' Level or T Level core pass C or equivalent qualification)
Plus 5 GCSE grades 9-4 / A* - C or equivalent, must include Maths. English and a Science

Contract Type: Fixed Term
Salary: £23,500

During your Apprenticeship we encourage you to spend at least 3/4 days a week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 

Security Clearance 
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
 
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 

To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 

 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 

Why join us 
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 

• Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
• Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
• Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity. 
• Rewarding performance: All employees are eligible for our bonus scheme. 
• Join in our success: Our annual Employee Stock Ownership Plan provides you the opportunity to own shares in Leonardo. 
• Tailored perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more. 

For a full list of our company benefits please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/company-benefits 

We are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people, communities and our customers. If you have any accessibility requirements to support you during the recruitment process, just let us know.

Job Title:

Prologis

Do you want to play a role in global commerce? Are you seeking practical experience to supplement your academic pursuits? 
The Prologis Summer Internship Program offers students of diverse educational backgrounds the opportunity to secure work experience within their field of study. Over a course of 10–12 weeks, our interns collaborate on significant projects that impact Prologis’ business landscape. Students have opportunities to interact and connect with company leaders and build workplace acumen through seminars and Q&A sessions. A day in the life 
As a Customer Experience intern, you will support a pilot that uses agentic AI to organize and analyze customer feedback and operational data. You will test tagging logic, validate AI-generated outputs, and surface customer themes and trends for Customer Experience partners. You will also analyze survey data and research customer experience practices outside Prologis, then help share findings through dashboards or visual summaries. Your work will inform recommendations on whether and how the pilot can scale, while exploring new ways to collect customer feedback. 

Key responsibilities include: 
• Support a pilot using agentic AI to tag and analyze customer feedback and operational data, producing clear, actionable insights. 
• Test and refine tagging logic, validate AI-generated outputs, and identify key themes and trends. 
• Document findings and recommendations to help determine how to scale the approach. 
• Analyze survey data and conduct external customer experience research. 
• Explore new ways to collect feedback and create dashboards or visual summaries for business partners.

•

People First
Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. People come first here.

All full-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.

jobs.title: Chemistry Data Science Intern - Digital CMC Workflows
jobs.description:
Role Description:

CHEMISTRY DATA SCIENCE INTERN - DIGITAL CMC WORKFLOWS
Location: Kalamazoo, Michigan
 
Internship Summary:
Zoetis VMRD Process Chemistry is seeking a summer intern to help build and test a structured, digital way of managing process chemistry and analytical data. The intern will organize reaction, batch, purity and impurity data from an active development program into a structured CMC data platform, build an impurity-fate case study, and run a head-to-head benchmark against the current workflow. The outcome is an objective, data-backed recommendation on how digital CMC tools should be deployed across the portfolio.
 
Internship Job Duties:
• Structure, clean and validate reaction, batch, purity and impurity data from an assigned process chemistry project, applying consistent compound and impurity naming conventions.
• Build an impurity-fate and data-retrieval case study in a structured CMC data environment (e.g. Luminata or an equivalent platform), mapping impurity formation, carry-through and purge across the synthetic route.
• Design and execute a benchmark comparing defined scientific tasks in the new digital environment against the current workflow, measuring time to correct answer, accuracy, traceability, data completeness and number of systems consulted.
• Analyze benchmark results and build a concise KPI scorecard summarizing where structured data delivers measurable gains and where it does not.
• Document data standards, assumptions and gaps, and deliver a final presentation with recommendations for broader deployment to Process Chemistry, Analytical and Tech & Digital stakeholders.
 
Internship Qualifications:
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD program in Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Chemical Engineering, Data Science, Computational Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry or a closely related field; rising seniors and graduate students preferred.
• Demonstrated experience analyzing structured or semi-structured data using Python, R, SQL, Excel or Power BI. No specific language is required - strong, reproducible data handling matters more than a particular toolset.
• Sufficient organic chemistry background to correctly interpret reaction schemes, HPLC/chromatographic data and impurity profiles; coursework in organic and analytical chemistry required.
• Strong attention to data quality, traceability and reproducibility, with the discipline to document assumptions and flag gaps rather than fill them in.
• Clear written and verbal technical communication; able to present findings and defend conclusions to scientists and to non-chemist stakeholders.

jobs.description:
About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including: 

• Flexible paid time off

• Hybrid work schedule 

• 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution 

• Health & wellbeing benefits 

• Parental Leave benefits 

• Employee stock purchase plan

Job Description

Job Description:

Invesco is seeking a Quantitative Research Intern in New York City for the Solutions and Custom Strategies (SCS). The SCS team collectively comprises approximately 80 investment professionals managing Invesco’s systematic and factor-based investment strategies across equities, fixed income, commodities, and multi-asset, including Invesco’s custom SMAs team.
 
Your Role:
 
• Develop and enhance quantitative and factor-based investment strategies for institutional and retail clients globally.
• Help investigate, explore, and identify tools, techniques, and metrics offering greater insight & perspective on portfolios to enhance value-add to clients.
• Help manage information including data and other analytics.
• Participate in the development and evolution of alpha and portfolio construction of strategies.
• Perform rigorous research and statistical analysis for all aspects of strategy development and ongoing management
 
Work Experience / Knowledge:

• Very strong analytical and mathematical skills, including optimization techniques
• Good coding skills with extensive hands-on experience in R, Python or other languages.
• Experience working in cloud-based environments such as AWS is a plus
• Excellent working knowledge of econometrics and statistics including time-series analysis
• Experience with financial databases such as Compustat, Worldscope, DataStream etc. and risk and optimization tools such as Axioma, Barra
 
The Experience You Bring:

• Passion for quantitative, research driven investment management

jobs.description:
About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our benefit and perk offerings including: 
• Company networking events with other interns

• Peer Sponsor Program 

• Leadership Connection series

• Virtual Lunch and Learns

• Invesco Cares volunteer events

• Complimentary coffee and snacks

• 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution 

Job Description

Solutions and Custom Strategies
The Invesco Solutions and Custom Strategies team comprises the firm’s systematic investing and multi-asset solutions businesses, offering distinct investment capabilities across systematic equities, multi-asset, and alternative solutions. With over 160 members and decades of industry experience, the team possesses depth and breadth of capabilities to address unique client challenges across a wide range of investment outcomes. With presence in 20 regional markets, the team brings local market knowledge combined with a strong global perspective. Collectively, the team is responsible for over USD 250 billion in total assets, including USD 56.6 billion in multi-asset solutions assets managed by a team of 25+ investment professionals with an average of 12 years of experience (as of June 30, 2026).
 
About Portfolio Construction and Engineering Team
The Portfolio Construction and Engineering team is an amalgamation of Quantitative finance, Technology, and cutting-edge financial research. The team comprise of individuals from diverse regions of the world with education from the top-notch engineering and science programs from around the world. Our responsibilities span from building multi-asset portfolio construction models to creating systematic fixed income portfolios and managing risk models for both public and private assets. The team has also pioneered “Vision”, a cloud-based investment management platform that provides a 360-degree investment overview to both institutional and retail clients and help them make complex investment decisions.
 
Internship Overview
As a summer intern based in our Boston office, you'll have the unique opportunity to work closely with senior members of Portfolio Construction and Engineering team, delve into cutting-edge financial technology, and engage in rigorous quantitative analysis assignments. This summer, we're seeking exceptional candidates who can help us expand our knowledge and capabilities in areas such as strategic (long-term, risk-aware) and dynamic (macro-regime driven) asset allocation research, portfolio construction and optimization, and risk modelling for public and private assets. 
 
Minimum Qualifications
• Enrolled in a master’s or PhD program in a quantitative discipline – engineering, financial engineering or financial maths, operations research, statistics, applied mathematics, computer science, or a related field – returning to study after the internship.
• Strong programming skills in Python, including the scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy); exposure to scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow is a plus.
• Solid foundation in statistics, probability, and optimization, with the ability to translate abstract principles into systematic, algorithmic representations.
• Experience managing and manipulating large datasets, preferably using SQL, including the ability to work with unstructured data and transform it into a usable, analysis-ready format.
• Demonstrated interest in finance, economics, and capital markets, and a working familiarity with core portfolio concepts such as mean-variance optimization, factor models, and standard risk and performance metrics.
• Very strong attention to detail, with an internal drive to sanity check and triangulate results.
• Relocation and housing will not be included if an offer is extended. 
• Must be able to work in Invesco’s Boston office.
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows (code review, CI/CD) and with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
• Exposure to building or consuming RESTful services (e.g. FastAPI) and to front-end or visualization work in JavaScript.
• Coursework or project experience with Large Language Models and agentic AI tooling (LangChain, RAG, vector databases).
• Exposure to third-party risk models such as BarraOne or Axioma.
• Progress toward the CFA designation.
 
Personal attributes
• Ability to prioritize work and allocate time efficiently to maximize impact.
• Strong interpersonal and partnership skills, with clear written and verbal communication of technical results to non-technical audiences.
• Self-starter with a desire to excel and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team.
 
What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry?
 
GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind! Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters. Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following:
 
• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients. 
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge. 
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion.
• Interact with GDIT leaders.
• Participate in professional development.
 
How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own
 
Our Quality Analysis Summer Internship is designed to make a direct impact on a broad variety of projects and help to co-create and deliver successful solutions internal GDIT customers. As a Quality Analyst Intern, you’ll play a key part in driving company success by solving complex problems that enable insights into operational performance.
 
A Day in the Life
 
• Learn how to leverage new tools and technologies.
• Collect and analyze information by reviewing repositories and SharePoint sites, interpreting reports.
• Update common information databases to most current standards.
• Communicate complex concepts through comprehensive use of best practices.
• Review Quality metrics to meet ongoing organizational informational needs.
• Assist in the assessment of Quality products to align information technology solutions with organization initiatives.
• Assist in planning and designing SharePoint sites.
• Formulate recommendations to improve and support the Quality Management Office (QMO).

The Must-Haves
 
• Currently enrolled in an associate's, bachelor's or master's degree program in Engineering, Mathematics, Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Economics or related discipline from a United States-based college or university. 
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Office products (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, and Teams)
 
What You’ll Need to Deliver your best every day
 
• Strong interpersonal and written communication skills.
• Ability to build meaningful relationships with manager and members of your team in a remote environment.
• Must be able to prioritize tasks, be self-aware enough to identify and correct your mistakes, and not be afraid to ask for help when needed.
• Passion for problem-solving and desire to develop into a strong business leader.
• Be active in seeking out ways to develop yourself and gain new knowledge personally and professionally.
• Intuitiveness with an ability to identify and solve complex problems related to rapidly changing technology. 
• A sense of genuine, intellectual curiosity and a nimble mindset
 
What you Offer as a Stand-Out Candidate
 
• Previous work experience related to process understanding and improvement.
• Proficiency in SharePoint.
• Broad knowledge of project management.
• Ability to understand and interpret complex compliance requirements.
• Comfortable using various software platforms to conduct analyses and synthesize findings.
 
GDIT interns are paid and full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks. Applicants should have a minimum of one semester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. Take the first step and apply today!
 
Note: We receive a high volume of applications and review them on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks of your application.
 
#GDITInternship

To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. Job Description

Purpose of the role
To support the Client Data & Engineering Group (CDEG) in delivering data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities that enhance client understanding, identify business opportunities and support client activity across the Investment Bank. The role provides exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, datasets and business initiatives spanning Banking, Markets and Technology, while contributing to the development of scalable insight-led solutions.

Accountabilities
• Collaboration with Banking, Markets and Technology teams to support client-focused initiatives through the generation of data-driven insights and analytical outputs.
• Analysis of client, business and market data to identify trends, opportunities and insights that support decision-making and business activity across the Investment Bank.
• Development and enhancement of dashboards, visualisations, reports and analytical tools that improve the accessibility and usefulness of client and business information.
• Contribution to the design, testing and implementation of data, analytics and AI-enabled solutions that support workflow efficiency, insight generation and business outcomes.
• Management and improvement of data quality, consistency and governance standards across datasets to support reliable reporting and analytics.
• Support for the development of data platforms and analytical capabilities that enable scalable client intelligence, business development and coverage activities across Banking and Markets.
• Collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, communicate findings and translate business needs into data-driven solutions.
• Participation in training and professional development activities to build expertise in data analytics, AI, financial markets and client strategy, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within CDEG.

Analyst Expectations
• To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
• Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
• Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
• They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
• OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
• Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
• Partner with other functions and business areas.
• Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
• Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
• Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
• Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation’s products, services and processes within the function.
• Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
• Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
• Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
• Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
• Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Summer Internship Programme Overview
Join us as a summer intern and discover the world of finance, data and technology. You’ll work on real projects from day one, supported by a mentor and line manager, gaining hands-on experience across a 10-week programme. You’ll build technical and commercial skills while developing an understanding of how data, analytics and AI are used to generate insights across financial markets.
 
Why the Client Data & Engineering Group Summer Intern Programme?
As a Summer Analyst, you’ll work on projects combining data, analytics and AI to generate insights across Markets and the wider Investment Bank.

You may:
• Analyse complex datasets to generate insights
• Build dashboards, visualisations and analytical outputs
• Support development of data-driven tools and analytical capabilities
• Contribute to AI and machine learning use cases focused on insight generation and workflow enhancement
• Work with structured datasets to improve data quality and usability
• Collaborate with stakeholders across Markets, Banking and Technology

You’ll gain practical experience of how data, analytics and AI are applied across the business.

How you’ll develop
You’ll build analytical and problem-solving skills through hands-on project work, supported by coaching and mentorship. You will:
• Develop your ability to work with data and generate insights
• Gain exposure to data analysis, visualisation and AI-supported workflows
• Learn how analytics and AI are used in real business environments
• Build communication skills by presenting insights to varied audiences

Client Data & Engineering Group (CDEG) at Barclays
The Client Data & Engineering Group (CDEG) focuses on using data, analytics and AI to generate insights that support how the business understands clients and opportunities. CDEG develops data platforms and analytical capabilities used across Markets and Banking, helping teams work with data more effectively and generate scalable, insight-led outputs.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for students in their penultimate year from any academic background with an interest in data, analytics and financial markets.
You’ll:
• Enjoy working with data and solving problems
• Demonstrate structured thinking and analytical capability
• Be curious about financial markets and insight generation

• Be adaptable, proactive and keen to learn

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. 

More about the role

This is an exciting job opportunity for you as an Electrical Engineer Intern onsite in Peachtree City, GA, with Cooper Lighting Solutions, a business unit of Signify, the world leader in lighting.

• Prototype, breadboard, and build proof-of-concept solutions
• Test and evaluate lighting fixtures, control circuits, IoT circuits, and other critical electrical components
• Support post-sales technical issues
• Resolve quality issues related to components and manufacturing; coordinate with manufacturing teams
• Write executive summaries to communicate issues and resolutions to management
• Create ECNs (Engineering Change Notices) to document product changes

More about you

While we value and appreciate all applicants, we believe that the following experience and skills will be needed to shine brightly in this job opening:

• Currently in pursuit of a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering
• Demonstrates basic electrical design approaches and capabilities
• Basic knowledge of electrical testing 
• Excellent communication, organizational, and people skills and the ability to multitask and work across functional groups
• Able to work a minimum of 16 hours per week onsite in Peachtree City, GA, from February 1 to May 21

*Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future company sponsorship needs.
 
This internship could lead to an at will full-time role.

Pay Rate: Hourly Rate $23 to $31 (based on year of study)
Benefits Overview: Company subsidized benefits plan offerings that include Medical and a Health Savings Account.
