jobs.description:
As an AI Engineer Intern, you will join our innovative AI research and development team to work on cutting-edge, impactful real-world AI challenges.  You will collaborate with experienced AI researchers, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to design, develop, and implement advanced machine learning models, including large language models to deliver scalable and transformative AI-driven solutions. This internship offers the chance to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world, high-impact AI projects and receive hands-on technical mentorship and career development support from industry-leading experts.

This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work will be hybrid (minimum 2x per week) from our Reston, VA office. Pay is expected to be $32 per hour. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position.    

What you will do: 
• Contribute to the AI lifecycle:  
• Support the end-to end AI product development process, encompassing data acquisition, preprocessing, model design, training, optimization, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation to ensure scalable and robust solutions.  
• Assist in all phases of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, preprocessing, model development, optimization, deployment, and evaluation.

jobs.description:
We’re currently seeking for an internship position in the Data Processing Developer Technology team. Would you enjoy researching parallel algorithms to accelerate AI and Data Processing workloads on advanced computer architectures? Do you find it rewarding to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks to achieve the best possible performance on pioneering computer hardware? Could you be thrilled about an opportunity to partner with the developer community, working at the forefront of technology breakthroughs that contribute to the success of an industry leader like NVIDIA? If so, we invite you to consider an internship with the Developer Technology Team.

What you will be doing:
• In this position, you will research and develop techniques to GPU accelerate workloads in deep learning, machine learning or other AI domains.

• Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex AI and HPC algorithms to ensure optimal AI solutions on modern CPU and GPU architectures.

• Publish and/or present discovered optimization techniques in developer blogs or relevant conferences to engage and educate the developer community.

• Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA.

What we need to see:
• Currently pursuing a PhD or Master degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree.

• Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software development.

• A background that includes parallel programming, e.g., CUDA, OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, etc.

• Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc.

• Excellent understanding of linear algebra.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applications will be accepted until November 8, 2026.

Please note: We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis as they are submitted. Strong candidates may be contacted for next steps before the application deadline. We encourage you to apply early.

About bp
bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition. 

Our internships 
Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 11-week summer programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business. 

Role and responsibilities 
bp’s Technology Upstream R&D group develops and deploys innovative technologies that support safer, faster and more reliable operations across bp’s portfolio. 
As a subsurface technology geologist in our Subsurface & Wells group, you’ll combine your geological knowledge with data science capabilities, including Python, machine learning, high-performance computing, AI and analytics. You’ll contribute to projects that transform subsurface ways of working and deliver value across bp’s businesses. 

The precise nature of your role and projects will depend on your skills and business needs. Your responsibilities may include: 
• Work with regional teams around the world, combining geoscience and data science methods to develop innovative solutions to complex subsurface challenges. 
• Develop and deploy Python code to accelerate subsurface workflows and improve predictability by broadening the characterisation of geological uncertainty. 
• Automate and parallelise subsurface workflows using bp’s high-performance computing capabilities. 
• Provide technical support to colleagues using deployed technology solutions.

To apply for this role, you must hold, or have already achieved, a minimum 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) in Geology, Earth Science or a closely related geoscience discipline. 
In addition, you must be currently completing a PhD in Geology, Geological Sciences or a closely related geoscience discipline, with approximately 9-18 months remaining until your expected PhD completion date.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: NoDescription

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

An internship at Northrop Grumman is unique. Sure, you’ll learn new skills, explore our enterprise, network with experts, connect with thought leaders, and finish with a resume that opens doors. But you’ll gain something even more valuable: pride in what you’ve done. Join us and launch your career. We’ll support you with training, professional development and networking opportunities, and our shared vision of global security.

Northrop Grumman is seeking S/W Embedded Engineering Interns for an internship opportunity. This position will be located at our Mission Systems sector in Annapolis, MD. 

The qualified candidate will become part of Northrop Grumman’s Naval & Oceanic Systems business unit headquartered in Annapolis, MD which is seeking S/W Embedded Engineers for an internship opportunity. Our site supports the development, test, and sustainment of state-of-the-art subsea systems. This opportunity will provide you with exposure to a wide range of advanced technologies, including uncrewed undersea vehicles (UUVs), remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), undersea payloads, acoustic and non-acoustic sensors, sensor processing, navigation, platform integration, subsea and maritime-surface communication technologies, advanced algorithms, digital engineering, and more.

Roles and Responsibilities
You’ll Have an Opportunity to: 
• Bring ideas into reality by designing and developing digital logic for our advanced mission solutions
• Gain hands-on exposure to the programmable logic full life-cycle: design, simulation, implementation, verification, and system integration
• Implement and debug designs in simulations and on real hardware
• Collaborate directly with experienced engineers to solve design challenges, get feedback, and learn best practices
• Engage in a full life-cycle approach-- design, implementation, test verification, production of digital electronic equipment and other hardware systems 

Basic Qualifications
• A candidate must meet ALL of the below criteria. The candidate must:
• Be a student who is enrolled full-time and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree from an accredited college/university and will be enrolled full time in Fall 2027
• Be majoring in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a closely related STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) degree. 
• Be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) for at least 10 weeks during summer 2027.
• Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite) as well as Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher
• A current/active US Government Secret clearance 

Intern Pay Range:
Bachelor’s: $20.50 to $37.25 per hour
Master’s: $29.00 to $45.50 per hour 

At Northrop Grumman, our internship pay rates are standardized and take into account three main factors: the anticipated graduation date of the individual, the cost of labor of the geographic location, and whether the internship is considered technical or administrative.
#campusjobs

Primary Level Salary Range: $20.50 - $37.25

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. Contract: Internship — 5.5 months

CHANEL:

At CHANEL, our values are grounded in creating the conditions for people to perform at their best and feel fulfilled and confident in their work.

The Role:

The position is part of the Global Finance and ESG Data Office. This internship offers hands-on exposure to data, analytics and reporting subjects while working with experienced team members.
This role is ideal for a recent graduate with an interest in finance, sustainability, data, and analytics who is eager to learn modern tools such as Microsoft Power BI and Fabric.
Your remit includes:
• Support the team in various analytics projects
• Perform routine data validation & issue resolution
• Manage day-to-day access and security

In this role, you will contribute to Finance and ESG Performance Management by supporting BI dashboards, data products, Microsoft Fabric artefacts, and AI-related projects, while helping improve the performance and usability of analytics solutions.
• Assist with maintaining BI dashboards and data products on Microsoft Fabric.
• Support delivery of AI-related projects.
• Carry out testing and help improve the performance and usability of analytics solutions.
• Work with internal teams and external consultants, escalating questions when needed.

jobs.title: Grid Foundational Models Intern - AGI
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Vernova's Applied Grid Innovation (AGI) team, we are exploring the next generation of AI technologies that will transform how electric utilities operate and manage the power grid. As a Power System Intern focused on foundational models, you will contribute to research and prototyping efforts that combine power system expertise with advanced AI capabilities to create intelligent operational solutions for the grid of the future.

Are you passionate about innovation? Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world? 

We operate with a founder’s mindset. We deliver innovation with passion, speed, and courage. We continuously challenge our thinking and are empowered to dream big and take smart risks.

What impact you’ll make 

As a student of the Applied Grid Innovation team you will be an active contributor to the development and evaluation of AI-powered solutions that improve operational intelligence, decision support, and grid reliability for utilities worldwide.

Job Description
What you’ll do (Job Responsibilities)
 
• Research emerging foundation models and large language models applicable to grid operations.
• Prototype AI-powered workflows for utility control room and engineering use cases.
• Evaluate in-house and external foundation model capabilities using real-world power system scenarios.
• Analyze operational datasets, engineering documents, and grid knowledge sources.
• Develop proof-of-concepts for intelligent search, question-answering, and decision support.
• Collaborate with power system experts, software engineers, and AI researchers.
• Document research findings and recommend future product opportunities.
• Present technical results to AGI leadership and product teams.

What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or AI/ML
• Understanding of power systems, energy systems, or electric utility operations.
• Experience with Python and data analytics.
• Familiarity with machine learning concepts and generative AI technologies.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Must have the ability to work in the US for an unlimited amount of time without sponsorship

What will make you stand out (Desired Qualifications)

• Coursework or project experience in power systems.
• Experience with large language models, RAG, or generative AI.
• Familiarity with cloud technologies and modern AI frameworks.
• Demonstrated interest in energy transition and grid modernization.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Location: Bellevue, WA

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! 
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. 
Job Description:
Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented software engineering intern to join our team! In this role you will get to work alongside hardware and software engineers developing ground-based directed energy systems.

What You'll Be Doing:
• Develop software that supports ground-based directed energy systems, working alongside experienced software and hardware engineers.
• Collaborate with hardware engineers, technicians, and field support representatives to understand requirements and solve technical challenges.
• Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, code reviews, and other team activities.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code using software engineering best practices.
• Test and debug software, investigate issues, and help improve reliability and performance.
• Learn the team's development tools and workflows while contributing to hands-on engineering projects.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:
• Pursuing a degree in one of the following disciplines: computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or software engineering.
• Major GPA greater than 3.0.
• Must be a US citizen.
• Ability to work well in a team as well as independently.
• Experience with one or more programming languages (C, C++, C#, Java, Python, Rust, etc...).
• The desire to learn in a hands-on environment.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:
• Experience with software version control tools, preferably git.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
At GE Vernova's Applied Grid Innovation (AGI) team, we are exploring the next generation of AI technologies that will transform how electric utilities operate and manage the power grid. As a Power System Intern focused on foundational models, you will contribute to research and prototyping efforts that combine power system expertise with advanced AI capabilities to create intelligent operational solutions for the grid of the future.

Are you passionate about innovation? Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world? 

We operate with a founder’s mindset. We deliver innovation with passion, speed, and courage. We continuously challenge our thinking and are empowered to dream big and take smart risks.

What impact you’ll make 

As a student of the Applied Grid Innovation team you will be an active contributor who will help ensure AI solutions are accurate, reliable, explainable, and effective for critical utility applications where performance and trust are essential.

Job Description
What you’ll do (Job Responsibilities)
 
• Develop benchmarks for evaluating AI and foundation model performance.
• Design testing methodologies and evaluation frameworks.
• Create datasets and scenarios for model validation.
• Measure model quality, reliability, accuracy, and operational usefulness.
• Analyze benchmark results and identify improvement opportunities.
• Evaluate competing AI solutions across multiple dimensions.
• Support continuous improvement of AGI AI capabilities.
• Communicate findings through reports and presentations.

What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Power Systems or related discipline.
• Experience with Python programming.
• Familiarity with machine learning evaluation concepts.
• Experience analyzing data and generating insights.
• Strong quantitative and analytical abilities.

What will make you stand out (Desired Qualifications)
 
• Experience evaluating large language models.
• Knowledge of AI benchmarking techniques.
• Experience with experiment design and statistical analysis.
• Familiarity with ML observability and model monitoring.
• Interest in deploying AI for critical infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
As a Hardware Engineering Intern/Co-op for Rockwell Automation, you will join a dynamic team developing the next-generation of automation control systems. You'll contribute to all stages of hardware product development—from sub-circuit design and integration to functional analysis and regulatory compliance—while building key technical skills in a supportive environment. If you value knowledge sharing, teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement, Rockwell Automation is the place for you.

This position is full time from January 2027 through July 2027. This role require students to take off school or use this co-op in place of their current classes and co-op must be approved by their university and/or advisor. 

It is located in Mayfield Heights, Ohio and does not provide relocation assistance. 

Your Responsibilities:
• Collaborate on an agile team to design electrical circuits, develop test requirements and execute hardware verification testing on new industrial automation products.
• Perform programming, functional analysis, and hands-on troubleshooting of electronic hardware prototypes. 
• Contribute to associated product design documentation and test reports.
• Participate in technical projects such as researching new technologies, implementing new circuit design tools, and troubleshooting failures. 
• Take ownership of assignments by understanding expected output, requesting help, and helping teammates.
• Build relationships with technical leads and peers to grow your knowledge of the product development lifecycle.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
• You must be currently pursuing a bachelor's or advanced degree from an accredited college or university.
• Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas for this internship. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
• Previous co-op/intern experience in Hardware Development
• Able to work full-time from January to July (2027)
• Graduating in December 2027 or later
• Experience using design capture tools, able to understand schematics. 
• Basic knowledge of circuit theory and operation, including microprocessors, digital logic devices, analog and/or DC-power conversion, programmable devices (CPLDs, FPGAs).
• Hands-on experience with hardware test equipment, including debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
• Experience developing or using programs for product initialization, debug, or test (C/C++, Python, Ladder).
• Experience working with KiCAD, Eagle, and Altium
• Knowledge of industrial control systems, programmable logic controllers or similar devices.
• Experience performing product certification testing, such as testing to meet CE and IEC 61010
• Met on campus, national recruiting events, a Rockwell Automation-hosted event, or a targeted recruiting campaign
• Located within 50 miles our Mayfield Heights, Ohio location

What We Offer:
• Health Insurance
• 401k
• Paid holidays
• Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
• To learn more about our benefits package for interns, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

jobs.title: Design Validation Co-op
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise
Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview
At Motorola Solutions we are helping solve some of the biggest challenges around safety and physical security by developing advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and products that are used to help keep people, businesses, and cities around the world safer. Avigilon, a Motorola Solutions company, designs, develops, and manufactures advanced AI, video analytics, network video management software and hardware, surveillance cameras, and access control solutions that help change the way people interact with their security systems.
Job Description
Our co-ops don’t wash cars or do coffee runs. They also don’t work on side projects. Our co-ops are treated like full team members and are given the opportunity to learn what being an engineer is like in the real world. You’ll have the opportunity to learn new technologies and best practices in electrical design and validation.

You’ll also have a lot of fun and make a lot of friends. For the duration of your work term, you will be a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team responsible for the design and implementation of the next generation of Motorola’s market-leading high-performance video solutions products.

The successful candidate will work with a team of Design Validation Specialists on evaluating the performance of new camera designs intended for release to manufacturing. In this role you will perform tests, identify performance issues, collaborate with HW and FW teams to find root cause defects and retest to confirm that issues have been addressed.

Responsibilities include:
• Temperature testing on new camera designs. Reproduce and investigate failures and create test reports.
• Perform image quality tests on new camera designs.
• Camera functionality and ease of installation evaluation.
• Perform tests on lenses and other optical elements.
• Perform vibration and drop tests on new camera designs.

Qualifications:
• Mechatronics, Electromechanical, Electrical or Mechanical engineering student;
• Detail oriented and well organized, ability to perform failure investigations, root cause analysis and create clear, easy to understand test reports;
• Knowledge of basic networking;
• Experienced user of Microsoft Office applications such as PowerPoint and Excel.

Preference will be given to candidates with the following skills and experience:
• Prior experience with test automation and creating test scripts using Python.
• Prior experience with cameras or photography and understanding of camera sensor and lens operation.
• “Get it done” attitude looking for ways how to get things done rather than explaining why they can’t be done.

Target Base Salary Range: 45,600 - 66,000 CAD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Enrollment in an accredited university undergraduate or Master's program

Travel Requirements
None
Relocation Provided
None

Intern

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. 

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. jobs.title: Insights and Analytics Intern - Health Systems Marketing
jobs.description:
Job Title
Intern-Insights and Analytics (Health Systems Marketing) Cambridge, MA - Summer 2027
Job Description
Job Description
Are you interested in an internship opportunity with Philips? We welcome individuals who are currently pursuing an undergraduate (BS) and/or graduate (MS) degree to participate in three-month paid internship opportunities. Through this role you will gain meaningful, hands-on experience working for a HealthTech company.
 
Your role: 
• Synthesize quantitative, qualitative, structured, and unstructured data to deliver insights. Use AI-enabled tools to accelerate analysis and validate findings against source data and business context.
• Partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to frame questions, scope research, and deliver timely, actionable recommendations.
• Maintain trusted data sets and semantic models, ensuring data quality, alignment, accessibility, and appropriate governance.
• Translate analysis into clear data stories and business recommendations. Use generative AI to accelerate exploration and drafting while retaining ownership of final outputs.
• Build data and AI applications, dashboards, visualizations, and repeatable analytical workflows using Databricks, BI tools, SQL, Python, R, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
 
You're the right fit if: 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an MBA.
• Experience with modern data and analytics tools, including Python, R, or SQL.
• Experience with BI and data-visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI; Power BI experience preferred.
• Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics or generative AI tools, with sound judgment to validate outputs against source data and business context.
• Familiarity with Databricks, or interest in learning modern cloud data and AI platforms, is a plus.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, teamwork, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Self-directed, curious, and eager to take on meaningful responsibilities.

jobs.title: Finance Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Programme starts: June 2027
Duration: 12 Weeks 
Please review all the internship opportunities and make one application 
 
Our Finance Engineer Summer Internship Programme has been crafted so that you can understand what a career as a Financial Engineer at LSEG would be like. In the internship you will work on projects solving real problems and work as part of a team with experienced engineers. 
 
This position is within the Optimisation Strats Team within the Post Trade Engineering division and will be based in London Office 
 
To be eligible, you should be in the penultimate year of your undergraduate or final year of an Undergraduate degree and plan to continue onto Masters for academic year 2027/28 studying Maths, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or other quantitative fields. 
 
Internship Summary 
The Strats team is responsible for designing, building, implementing and maintaining the algorithms at the heart of our services. This typically involves working on models for linear or convex optimisation problems and interpreting the solution of those problems as a set of financial transactions that should be executed to improve some aspect of a derivatives portfolio. It also involves implementing all the data pre-processing logic as well as the postprocessing validation checks and proposal generations, which require the handling of large data sets. 
The successful candidate will work as part of a small team of 4-6 financial engineers to design and implement improvements to our optimisation services. They will work directly with the Product Development team to enhance the product, based on feedback from clients and analysis of runs, as well as on strategic projects. 

Examples of possible projects include: 
• Developing a new scaling scheme to improve reliability and performance 
• Introducing a mix integer model to achieve rounded solutions 
• Investigating how sensitive the solution is to small changes in the data to understand which constraints we should relax for maximum impact. 
• Refactoring some parts of the code to share functionality and business logic across assets 
• Improving the runtime performance by investigating and adding heuristics to reduce the data set and solution search space. 
• Developing new functionality to better validate incoming client data prior to optimisation.   
 
What we are looking for:  
We are passionate about recruiting people who are interested in pursuing a career within Financial Engineering and would like to learn about the full breadth of our business – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.  
• Experience with python and ideally familiarity with pandas and numpy 
• A strong mathematical background (numerical methods, linear algebra, probability & statistics) 
• Basic understanding of linear and/or mixed integer programming and convex optimisation 
• Excellent problem-solving skills 
• Knowledge of basic financial products is a plus 
• Familiarity with UNIX is desired but not required 
• Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the New York or London without restrictions for the duration of the internship programme 
 
You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.  
 
Applications close: 30th November, We recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis and may close applications early. 
 
Recruitment Process:   
• The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.   
• The second stage is completing Technical and Coding Assessment. This technical assessment is designed to evaluate your coding ability, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
• The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.   
• The third stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style  
• The final stage is a virtual half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite. 
 
Please review all the internship opportunities and make one application If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only. 
Please note, all our assessment centres are run virtually. 
 
Life at LSEG 
We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
About Us: 
Altera is at the forefront of programmable logic and hardware acceleration. Our mission is to empower developers and system architects to rapidly design and deploy cutting-edge solutions using advanced FPGA and SoC technologies. The High Level Synthesis (HLS) team at Altera specializes in creating sophisticated tools and compiler technologies that translate high-level programming languages into efficient hardware implementations. Join us and help shape the future of HLS, enabling faster innovation in fields such as AI, cloud computing, and embedded systems. 

Responsibilities: 
• Assist in the development and maintenance of HLS compiler infrastructure. 
• Support the implementation of compiler passes and code transformations to optimize high-level code for hardware synthesis. 
• Analyze and improve compilation flow from C/C++ to hardware description languages. 
• Research in cutting edge compiler technology for AI computation workload 
• Help integrate and test new features in HLS compilers, focusing on performance and resource optimization. 
• Participate in debugging and validating compiler outputs. 
• Document work and contribute to internal knowledge bases. 

What We Offer: 
• Mentorship and hands-on training from experienced compiler and hardware engineers. 
• Competitive salary and benefits. 
• Opportunities for professional growth and advancement. 
• Supportive and innovative work environment.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.
 
What You Will Do
The Electro-Optical System Design Department is currently in need for an Electro Optical Systems Engineer Intern to support the Advanced Products & Solutions Mission Area in the development and building of advanced electro-optical systems. The systems engineer intern will be part of a design team building electro-optical systems including imagers, passive/active EO tracking, LIDAR, and directed energy systems. The systems engineer intern will be contributing to assessing systems architecture, developing requirements for these systems, and supporting the design and build efforts. It will involve being able to assess mission/system requirements and derive design and performance requirements for subsystem and unit levels. The role also involves understanding verification and test activities to assist in the creation of a proper IV&V plan meeting the requirements of the program.
 
The EOSD Department supports Space and Airborne Systems (SAS) by providing systems engineering expertise in the Electro-Optical Systems (EOS) domain. Typical roles within the department involve:
• EOS System Architects and System Design Engineers
• Integrated Product Team Leadership, Lead Systems Engineers, Chief Engineers
• Requirements Engineers
• EO Systems Analysts
 
Qualifications You Must Have
• Must be pursuing Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Physics, Optical, Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.
• Must have a minimum of 30 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session.
• Experience with electro-optical infrared imagery, focal plane technology, lenses, or apertures
• Experience with fundamental optical principles including geometrical optics, physical optics, imaging systems, aberrations, or detectors
• Hands‑on experience through coursework or lab work with optical testing or alignment

Experience may be obtained through job experience, research, coursework, or projects
 
Qualifications We Prefer
• Internship or project experience related to opto-mechanical engineering, photonics, infrared physics, or optical systems
• Experience with programming using C++ or Python
• Experience or coursework in signal processing, image processing, tracking, computer vision, or machine learning
• Knowledge of systems engineering architecture and design, integration and test, and verification and validation approaches
• Experience using MATLAB for data analysis and strong analytical and problem‑solving skills

jobs.title: Technology Intern - Society of Women Engineers Conference
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community
 
Join Humana as a Technology Intern for Summer 2027 and play an integral role in driving innovation and digital transformation within a Fortune 50 healthcare company.

Our 12-week internship program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a wide spectrum of technological domains, contributing to projects that directly impact the health and well-being of millions. As a Tech Intern, you will collaborate with experienced technologists on initiatives that may include project management, agile development, software and cloud engineering, data science and analytics, user experience (UI/UX), machine learning, and cybersecurity. You will have the opportunity to leverage cutting-edge tools and methodologies to solve real-world challenges, build new skills, and make a meaningful impact in healthcare technology while launching your career at Humana. 
 
The internship program is hosted in-person at Humana’s Headquarters in Louisville, KY, providing a rich experience of our corporate culture and direct mentorship from industry leaders. 

Use your skills to make an impact 
 
Required Qualifications: 
• Must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, on-site for the full 12-week internship program from May 24, 2027, through August 13, 2027, in Louisville, KY. 
• Must not require sponsorship to work in the United States now or in the future. 
• Must be a current full-time undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, or a related quantitative discipline. 
• Must have an expected graduation date between December 2027 - Summer 2028.
• Must successfully complete CodeVue technical assessment requirements, which will evaluate programming fundamentals, problem-solving, and role-relevant technical skills. 
• Must be attending, or have attended, the Society of Women Engineers Conference in Boston, MA on November 5 - 7, 2026.

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Experience with technical tools, frameworks, and methodologies, including but not limited to C++, Java, HTML, SQL, C#, Python, Agile, project management, Scrum, data science, Power BI, Salesforce, JavaScript, CSS, cloud technologies, web/mobile development, API development, and AI applications. 
• Demonstrates strong academic performance, with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5. 
• Completion of introductory to intermediate technical coursework, such as CS 101, MIS, Foundations of Computer Science, Fundamentals of Computer Science, introductory programming courses, Data Structures, Algorithms, or Machine Learning. 
• Active involvement in on-campus and/or community activities. 
• Interest in working in the healthcare industry. 
• Possesses strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills. 
• Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and flexibility through previous jobs, internships, academic work, and/or projects. 
 
Internship Program Overview: 
During Humana’s 12-week internship program, interns can expect a structured and engaging experience designed to support both professional growth and meaningful project contributions. The program includes: 
• A comprehensive onboarding and orientation experience to help interns learn about Humana, the internship program, and their assigned team. 
• Placement on a technical team where interns can work closely with experienced leaders and team members, apply their skills, gain hands-on experience, and contribute to meaningful projects aligned to Humana’s mission, business priorities, and technology objectives. 
• Exposure to executive-level presentations, professional development sessions, and workshops designed to strengthen technical and career skills. 
• A strong support network that may include direct leaders, program managers, mentors, and peers throughout the internship experience. 
• Access to learning, training, and development opportunities that support both technical growth and professional development. 
• Opportunities to participate in intern-led committees and events, which may include initiatives such as Social Events, Yearbook, Volunteering, and other engagement activities. 
• Access to Humana’s Network Resource Groups (NRGs), which help foster connection, community, and inclusion across the organization. 
 
Potential Team Placements: 
Interns may be placed on one of several technical teams across the organization, depending on business need, skill set, and area of interest. Potential team placements may include: 
• CenterWell and Humana Military: The CenterWell and Humana Military IT organization provides technology to support Humana’s commitment of helping the millions of people we serve achieve their best health. The CenterWell area supports senior-focused primary care, home health, and pharmacy segments, while the Humana Military area supports military communities. Intern projects may include health system integrations, clinical support platforms, data interoperability, and digital tools that improve patient and provider experiences. 
• Data and Analytics: Delivers enterprise data, reporting, and analytics capabilities that help inform business and clinical decisions. Work may include data engineering, dashboard development, data quality improvement, and insights generation to support operational and strategic priorities. 
• Enterprise Growth and Digital: Develops digital tools, mobile applications, and self-service experiences that enhance member engagement, support business growth, and improve operational efficiency.  Projects may include building new digital experiences, implementing marketing automation, and using analytics to inform business strategy.  
• Enterprise AI: Builds reusable, human-centered AI capabilities, tools, and services that support enterprise data science and high-priority business use cases. Work may include advancing AI solutions such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Conversational AI, model development, data pipeline optimization, and AI-driven insights for clinical and business challenges. 
• Enterprise Information Protection (EIP): Maintains the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Humana’s business, technical, and customer information for associates and members by complying with industry standards and prioritizing threat management. Projects may include cybersecurity, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity security, AI security, product security, data protection, risk and compliance, and secure cloud architecture. 
• Insurance Technology: Builds and supports the technology systems that enable Humana’s insurance operations and healthcare services. Projects may involve software development, cloud technologies, AI, automation, data engineering, and digital platforms that help deliver seamless member and provider experiences while advancing innovation and operational excellence. 
• CTO: Shapes the vision and roadmap for Humana’s technology landscape by aligning enterprise architecture, technology planning, and emerging technologies with business priorities. Interns may support technical research, AI enablement, enterprise architecture activities, IT framework development, and enterprise-wide technology transformation projects. 
 
Humana does not provide visa sponsorship or support for OPT/CPT/J1 for this internship position.

jobs.title: Intelligent Automation Intern
jobs.description:
Nasdaq’s Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how global markets and technology come together. Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside Nasdaq teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business. 

We believe the best way to learn is by doing - that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program. 

Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Nasdaq Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys.

At Nasdaq, you’ll have the chance to start your career in an environment where learning, teamwork, and innovation come first. In this role, you’ll support the Finance Organization and gain hands-on experience with cutting edge automation technologies to deliver automated solutions leveraging GenAI. This hands-on experience will expose you to real-world finance automation projects, from invoice processing and reconciliation workflows to complex financial reporting and analysis procedures. 

You don’t need to know everything on day one — we’ll help you build the skills, confidence, and network to grow your career. 
 
What You’ll Do 
• Support Intelligent Automation team with day-to-day tasks and contribute to ongoing initiatives.
• Learn how to design, develop, and deploy end-to-end automation solutions.
• Deliver AI-based solutions that enhance decision making and drive operational efficiency
• Develop and implement components of Generative AI solutions and traditional automations, ensuring quality, performance, and reliability.
• Collaborate with teammates across different functions and regions.
• Bring your ideas and curiosity to problem-solving and project work.
• Develop your technical and professional skills through training and mentorship.
 
What You’ll Bring 
• Currently pursuing a degree in Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Mathematics or related field with coursework in data analysis, process improvement, or technology applications. 
• Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and take on new challenges. 
• Ability to work well with others and contribute to a team environment. 
• Good communication and organizational skills. 
• Curiosity about technology, finance, and global markets. 
• Basic skills in Excel, SQL or database querying, and familiarity with at least one programming language (Python, VBA, or similar) or demonstrated interest in automation technologies and process optimization.

Nice-to-Have
• Internship or project experience related to Intelligent Automation, Process Improvement or similar field 
• Involvement in student organizations, volunteering, or leadership roles. 
• Familiarity with Generative AI concepts, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications, RAG, vectorization, etc. 
• Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), programming languages, web-scraping and LLM fine-tuning. 

This position will be located in New York City and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates. 

Come as You Are

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. 

Internship Program Overview: 
Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.

GF’s HR Analytics team is seeking an intern to join the team. This role will apply and integrate advanced and predictive analytics, people metrics and reporting to develop strategic, operational and financial insights for workforce decision-making.

Research Intern, Knowledge Engineering & Generative AI

The Company
About Hitachi America, Ltd.
Hitachi America, Ltd. is the regional headquarters for Hitachi Group companies in the Americas, overseeing the U.S., Canada, and Latin America markets. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Hitachi Americas has been deeply committed to its Social Innovation Business since its establishment in 1959, addressing society's most pressing challenges through innovative solutions. Leveraging its expertise and resources, Hitachi Americas and its subsidiary companies operate across diverse sectors, including transportation, energy, mobility, industrial manufacturing, healthcare, digital engineering, data analytics and others. Driven by Digital, Green, and Innovation, Hitachi Americas remains at the forefront of pioneering solutions that shape the future. For further details, please visit https://www.hitachi.us/.
About Hitachi, Ltd. 
Through its Social Innovation Business (SIB) that brings together IT, OT(Operational Technology) and products, Hitachi aims to be a global leader in continuously transforming social infrastructure through digital, contributing to a harmonized society where the environment, wellbeing, and economic growth are in balance. Hitachi operates worldwide across four sectors – Digital Systems & Services, Energy, Mobility, and Connective Industries – as well as a Strategic SIB Business Unit focused on new growth areas. With Lumada at its core, Hitachi creates value by combining data, technology and domain knowledge to solve customer and social challenges. Revenues for FY2025 (ended March 31, 2026) totaled 10,586.7 billion yen, with 606 consolidated subsidiaries and approximately 290,000 employees worldwide. Visit us at www.hitachi.com.

Summary
Hitachi America, Ltd. has openings for Research Interns in the Industrial AI Laboratory located in Silicon Valley. The laboratory develops innovative AI technologies and intelligent systems for industrial infrastructure, manufacturing, mobility, energy, and supply chain applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated intern to help develop a next-generation AI-powered knowledge platform that integrates engineering knowledge, operational technology (OT) knowledge, technical documents, simulation assets, and domain expertise. This platform will support intelligent search, knowledge discovery, AI-assisted reasoning, and agentic AI systems for industrial applications.

The successful candidate will work on technologies spanning Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Knowledge Graphs, Agentic AI, Information Retrieval, and Enterprise Knowledge Systems. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to design and prototype solutions that help AI systems discover, connect, and utilize complex engineering knowledge.

More information about Hitachi Industrial AI research can be found at:
https://www.hitachi.com/rd/sc/aiblog/index.html
 
Required Qualifications
• Pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Strong programming skills in Python.
• Background in one or more of the following areas:• Generative AI
• Natural Language Processing (NLP)
• Information Retrieval
• Machine Learning
• Knowledge Representation

• Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs).
• Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search technologies.
• Ability to rapidly build prototypes and proof-of-concept systems.
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies, Graph Databases, or Knowledge Engineering.
• Experience with Agentic AI, AI Assistants, or Multi-Agent Systems.
• Experience integrating AI systems with external tools, APIs, databases, or enterprise data sources.
• Experience processing large collections of structured and unstructured documents.
• Research publications, open-source contributions, or relevant project experience.
 
Desired Characteristics
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Self-motivated team player who thrives in a dynamic research environment.
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Passion for applying AI to real-world industrial challenges.
 
Our Values
We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are proud of Japanese heritage, with our values expressed through the Hitachi Spirit:

Employees are eligible to participate in Hitachi America’s variable pay program, subject to the program’s conditions and restrictions.

jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Internship Program provides an immersive journey where you’ll work on impactful projects that drive Visa’s mission forward. As a Visa intern, you’ll build valuable connections across the organization, sharpen your communication and business acumen, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, global environment.

Throughout the program, you’ll have exclusive access to interactive workshops and learning sessions designed to deepen your expertise, expand your industry knowledge, and elevate your professional skillset. You won’t just be learning, you’ll be contributing, collaborating, and innovating every step of the way. In addition to professional development, you’ll enjoy a variety of intern social events that foster community, connection, and fun throughout the summer
The experience culminates in an exciting final presentation, where you’ll showcase your project achievements, share key insights, and present your recommendations to Visa’s leaders and stakeholders. This is your chance to demonstrate your business impact, highlight your personal growth, and align your work with Visa’s vision for the future.
The Data Team is a key part of the decision management engine at Visa. This is a high-performing team of data scientists, data analysts, statisticians, and business analysts from all over the world. The team utilizes quantitative methodologies to analyze extensive data sets and develops sophisticated statistical models that leverage big data. Collaborating across various teams and functions, they design innovative and advanced analytical solutions and processes. Our focus lies on building creative solutions that have an immediate impact on the business of our highly analytical partners. To support our rapidly growing group, we are looking for Data Science Interns who are passionate about the opportunity to use Visa’s rich data to address and deliver significant results to complex problems! 
As a Data Science Intern, you will be responsible for developing Data Analytics solutions to solve business problems. The intern will take part in developing and refining our data models and solutions through a highly collaborative process. They will work with different teams and data sets, apply much of the knowledge they gained at their university, and develop professional experience. 

Potential responsibilities include:
• Prepare and manage datasets using tools such as Python, SQL, Spark, or Hive, including efficient data wrangling and fulfillment of ad-hoc requests.
• Conduct business data analyses to uncover key insights and effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.
• Design and develop BI tools using platforms like Power BI and Tableau.
• Interpret and analyze data by understanding BI pipelines, performing exploratory and machine learning–based analytics, and delivering actionable insights.
• Monitor and enhance BI tools by identifying insights, creating demos, and enabling teams to maximize tool value.
• Execute large-scale data analytics to extract and present meaningful business insights.
• Recommend improvements to tools and techniques that optimize existing processes or support new initiatives with long-term value.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications

Basic Qualifications 
• Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related STEM/quantitative field graduating December 2027 – August 2028
• Strong communications skills, specifically, the absence of repeated grammatical or typographical errors, clear and concise written and spoken communications that demonstrate professional judgment. 

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in understanding and analyzing data using statistical software (e.g., Python, SAS, R, Stata or others)
• Experience with visualization and reporting tools, such as advanced user of PPT, Power BI, Tableau, open-source tool, or similar.
• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and strives to continually learn.
• Previous exposure to financial services, credit cards or merchant analytics is a plus, but not required
• Experience with extracting and aggregating data from large data sets using SQL or other tools
• Understanding of ML techniques
• Competence in Excel, PowerPoint and Tableau

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
Entity: 
Technology
Job Family Group: 
Business Support Group, Subsurface Group
Job Description: 
About bp 
bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition. 

Our internships 
Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 11-week summer programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business. 

Role and responsibilities 
bp’s Technology Upstream R&D group develops and deploys innovative technologies that support safer, faster and more reliable operations across bp’s portfolio. 
As a subsurface technology reservoir engineer in our Subsurface & Wells group, you’ll combine your reservoir engineering knowledge with data science capabilities, including Python, machine learning, high-performance computing, AI and analytics. You’ll contribute to projects that transform subsurface ways of working and deliver value across bp’s businesses. 

The precise nature of your role and projects will depend on your skills and business needs. Your responsibilities may include: 
• Work with regional teams around the world, combining reservoir engineering and data science methods to develop innovative solutions to complex subsurface challenges. 
• Develop and deploy Python code to accelerate subsurface workflows and improve predictability by broadening the characterisation of reservoir uncertainty. 
• Automate and parallelise subsurface workflows using bp’s high-performance computing capabilities. 
• Provide technical support to colleagues using deployed technology solutions. 
 
Requirements 
To apply for this role, you must hold, or have already achieved, a minimum 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) in Reservoir Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. 
In addition, you must be currently completing a PhD in Reservoir Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline, with approximately 9-18 months remaining until your expected PhD completion date. 

You'll also have: 
• Experience of coding in Python, or demonstrated programming experience in another language, such as MATLAB or C++, with the ability to learn Python. 
• An interest in developing innovative technology solutions for subsurface challenges. 

Desirable skills and experience 
The following are advantageous but can be developed through training and on-the-job experience: 
• Familiarity with AI techniques, including coding agents. 
• Familiarity with Jupyter notebooks. 
• Experience using code management tools such as Git for version control. 
• Skills in data analytics and statistical analysis. 
• Skills in machine learning or automation. 
• Familiarity with working in a Linux environment. 

You are also expected to have strong spoken and written English language skills, including business and technical English. Language skills will be assessed throughout the recruitment process. 

Please note: We value individuals who take initiative, are committed to excellence, and can adapt positively to change and challenges in a supportive environment. 
 
Location 
This role will be based out of one the following UK office: 
• Sunbury – ICBT (International Centre for Business & Technology), Chertsey Road, Sunbury on Thames, Middlesex, TW16 7LN 
 
Start & end dates 
Monday 21st June 2027 to Friday 3rd September 2027 
Please note: Our internships are full-time. If you will struggle to be available for these dates &/or may not be able to work full time, please flag this if you are invited to a technical interview, or earlier if possible. 

Other information 
Please note the following when applying:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people.
At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

Cboe interns work with a variety of staff across multiple departments and have the opportunity to put their skills to work in their field of interest, while learning about Exchange technology and operations through our robust Options Institute courses.

The three main foundational pillars of our internship program are: develop, educate and network. We want to ensure each of our interns receive a real-world working experience that encourages academic, professional and personal growth.

Candidates should be versatile, eager and able to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive financial and technical environment. Our internship program runs from June to August and you will wrap up your internship with a final presentation and retreat. Visit our student page for more information about our internship program!

The Data Pipeline Engineering team is hiring for a Software Engineer Intern – Data Pipeline Engineering

Data Pipeline Engineering Team, What We Do
We design, develop, deploy, and support data driven batch and streaming systems supporting North American exchange markets trading over $500B notional securities daily. We store every order, cancel, and execution with care. 

We architect systems managing billions of events per day. We optimize for scalability, resiliency and performance. 

We live and breathe automation. We are analytical thinkers. We are always learning our craft. If it’s broken, we fix it. If it needs refactoring, we refactor it. If it’s hard to test, we make it testable. We are pragmatic. We ship code weekly. We’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

Join our Data Pipeline Engineering team managing, reconciling and processing all data across all Cboe North American trading exchanges environments. 
Help us develop and support all exchange integrated back-office processing to 

perform trade clearing, customer reporting, billing, symbol processing, regulatory reporting, data exchange with numerous 3rd parties, data backup and replication, and variety of business automation capabilities to enhance and extend exchange operations for our real-time trading system.

jobs.title: Compliance Technology Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Compliance Technology Intern

Jain Global is an innovative multi-strategy investment firm founded in July 2024 by Bobby Jain with over 400 employees operating from offices in New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong, we are looking to add to our growing teams.   

About the Role

We are seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Compliance Technology team for the summer of 2027. In this role, you will support the firm’s compliance function by contributing to technology solutions that help meet regulatory obligations. Collaborating with senior engineers and the Legal & Compliance team, you will design, build, and ship one well-scoped project end to end: a working tool that automates a process the Compliance team currently handles manually. 

You will write production-quality code, work with real data, and partner directly with compliance officers and engineers. You’ll create something the team actually uses. 

Your Project 
Your project will be chosen from our 2027 roadmap based on team priorities and your skills. Projects will fall into one of two areas: 
• Internal monitoring. Build services that ingest trading or activity data, apply compliance rules, flag exceptions, and surface them to reviewers through a clean interface. Examples include checking that activity stays within defined restrictions, or reconciling records and timestamps across systems to catch discrepancies. 
• Team metrics and reporting. Build an automated pipeline that collects, calculates, and visualizes the metrics Compliance reports to management, replacing manual spreadsheets with a repeatable, auditable system. 

Key Responsibilities 
• Translate policies and compliance requirements into a technical design, working closely with senior developers and Compliance stakeholders. 
• Write clean, tested code in Python and SQL, plus front-end work as needed. 
• Build dashboards or web interfaces that give compliance users clear, actionable views of exceptions or metrics. 
• Validate your system’s output against manual results to confirm accuracy and support auditability. 
• Present progress in weekly check-ins and demos. 

What You’ll Build and Learn 
• Data ingestion pipelines that pull from internal databases, files, and APIs 
• Rules or metrics engines with clear logic and automated tests 
• A user-facing dashboard or web interface for non-technical users 
• Logging and error handling suited to a system people depend on 
• Documentation that lets another engineer maintain your work 
• You’ll work within a real engineering workflow, including version control, code review, and testing before release. 

Deliverables 
• Requirements and design document, reviewed with stakeholders 
• Working end-to-end prototype with data ingestion and core logic 
• Feature-complete tool with a dashboard or interface for compliance users 
• Automated tests and a validation summary comparing results against the current manual process 
• User guide and technical handoff documentation 
• Final demo and presentation to Compliance and Technology leadership, with recommendations for next steps 
 
Qualifications & Experience 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with an expected graduation in 2028 (rising senior). 
• Proficient in Python or another general-purpose language (Java, C#, or similar). 
• Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. 
• Experience with Git and a solid grasp of data structures and algorithms. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
• Curious mindset with a willingness to learn quickly. 
Preferred 
• Experience with React / TypeScript or another front-end framework, and REST APIs. 
• Familiarity with Snowflake, Postgres / MySQL, or AWS. 
• Exposure to Docker or CI/CD pipelines. 
• Prior internship or substantial personal or academic projects. 
• Interest in financial markets, trading systems, or regulatory technology. 
 
Compensation
The estimated base salary range for this position is $182,000 for Masters students and $234,000 for PhD students, which is specific to New York and may change in the future.
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer
As an employer, we believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of Jain Global teams to drive competitive performance. We believe an inclusive environment can yield exceptional contributions.

jobs.title: Data Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
Welcome to Whataburger Careers!

Our Flavor — Why Whataburger
Whataburger isn’t just a fast-food burger chain it is where bold leadership starts — and where potential doesn’t just grow, it heats up. Whether you're leading the line or working behind the scenes, this is the place where opportunities stack up, and every day gives you a chance to Make a Difference.
 
Since 1950, we’ve invested in people who lead with integrity, Serve with Heart, and bring their best flavor to the team. We believe in working together, speaking up, having a little fun, and Winning as One — because great burgers (and great teams) start with the right ingredients. If you're ready — to learn, grow, impact, and Move Forward Boldly — we’ve got your back and your path cooked to perfection.
 
Your Recipe for Impact — What You’ll Do
As a Data Scientist Intern, you’ll help turn data into insights that support better decisions across the business. Working alongside experienced analytics and technology professionals, you’ll contribute to data preparation, exploratory analysis, reporting, and model development while building foundational data science skills in a real-world environment. Through your work, you’ll help Make a Difference by uncovering opportunities that improve business outcomes, Serve with Heart by supporting teams with reliable data and actionable insights, Win as One through collaboration across functions and projects, and Move Forward Boldly by exploring innovative tools, technologies, and analytical approaches that help drive continuous improvement.
 
Day-to-Day Ingredients — Responsibilities
As a Data Scientist Intern, you will:
 
• Assist in developing proof-of-concept data models and analytical solutions.
• Write, test, and maintain Python code for data analysis and modeling projects.
• Query and extract data using SQL to support reporting and business initiatives.
• Clean, structure, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis.
• Support feature engineering and dataset development efforts.
• Utilize tools such as Git, notebooks, and cloud platforms to support development workflows.
• Document code, processes, and project outcomes to promote knowledge sharing.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate on sprint-based project work.
 
What You Bring to the Table — Required Experience
As a Data Scientist Intern, you must have: 
 
• Current enrollment in an Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree program.
• Completion of at least 80 college credit hours.
• Foundational knowledge of Python programming.
• Basic understanding of SQL and data querying concepts.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
 
Extra Toppings — Desired Experience
As a Data Scientist Intern, we prefer you to have: 
 
• Coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Experience working with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or scikit-learn.
• Exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
• Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive modeling.
• Experience using Git or other version control tools.
• Exposure to cloud-based analytics or development platforms.
• Experience working on team projects using Agile methodologies.
• Curiosity for emerging technologies and data-driven innovation.
 
Where & How You’ll Work
This role is based at the San Antonio Home Office, working on‑site Monday through Thursday with remote flexibility on Fridays. In this role, you’ll have strong collaboration with leadership, across cross-functional teams, and with external partners to align capabilities with restaurant realities. The work environment is fast‑paced and requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and strong collaboration skills. Full‑time availability is required, with occasional extended hours based on business needs, along with occasional travel to properties, project sites, and external meetings. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of the San Antonio Home Office.
 
Whataburger is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, veteran status, age, or other condition or status protected by law.
