jobs.description:
As a Software Engineer Intern, you will join our innovative AI research and development team to work on cutting-edge, impactful real-world AI challenges.  You will collaborate with experienced AI researchers, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to design, develop, and implement advanced machine learning models, including large language models to deliver scalable and transformative AI-driven solutions. This internship offers the chance to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world, high-impact AI projects and receive hands-on technical mentorship and career development support from industry-leading experts.  

This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work will be hybrid from our Reston, VA office. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position.    

What you will do: 

• Contribute to the AI lifecycle:  
• Support the end-to end AI product development process, encompassing data acquisition, preprocessing, model design, training, optimization, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation to ensure scalable and robust solutions.  
• Assist in all phases of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, preprocessing, model development, optimization, deployment, and evaluation. 

• Develop machine learning models:  
• Design, develop, and train advanced machine learning models, including deep learning and large-scale models, to address complex challenges in domains like natural language processing (NLP) and Generative AI.  
• Build and train machine learning models, including deep learning models, to solve complex challenges in areas such as natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI. 

• Analyze large datasets:  
• Conduct exploratory data analysis and advanced feature engineering on large-scale, semi-structured datasets to uncover actionable insights and enhance model accuracy and efficiency.  
• Perform data analysis and feature engineering on massive, semi-structured datasets to extract meaningful insights and improve model performance. 

• Engineer robust software:  
• Develop high-quality, production-ready code in languages such as Python, Java, C++, R, JavaScript, along with a good understanding of common AI development frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit-learn while actively participating in system design discussions, code reviews, and testing to ensure robust and maintainable software.  
• Write clean, production-level code in languages like Python and C++, and participate in design sessions and code reviews to ensure software quality. 

• Research emerging technologies:  
• Research and prototype cutting-edge AI and machine learning methodologies, including advancements in areas like explainable AI, federated learning, or multimodal models, while keeping abreast of the latest research and industry trends.  
• Help research and prototype new AI and machine learning techniques, staying up-to-date on the latest advancements in the field. 

• Collaborate across teams:  
• Partner with cross-functional teams, including product or project managers, data engineers and scientists, and software engineers to refine project requirements, align on objectives, and deliver innovative, high-impact AI-driven solutions.  
• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers and other engineers, to define project requirements and deliver high-quality technology products. 

Minimum Qualifications 
• By start date, a minimum of 30 completed college-level credit hours is required preferably in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. 
• Candidate must be a US citizen, reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S. per contract requirements.

Preferred Qualifications 
• A strong foundation in core computer science concepts, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis. 
• Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, with a strong preference for Python. 
• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn. 
• Demonstrated experience with large-scale datasets and data preprocessing. 
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
• Experience with version control systems like Git is a plus. 

Perks of working with us 
• Mentorship: You will be paired with a dedicated mentor to support your growth and development throughout the internship. 
• Hands-on experience: Gain valuable, practical experience working on impactful, real-world AI projects. 
• Learning opportunities: Access training resources and workshops to enhance your technical and professional skills. 
• Networking: Build valuable connections with a community of world-class scientists, engineers, and visionaries. 

Bot and Third-Party Applications

jobs.title: Product Management Intern - Vehicle Autonomy
jobs.description:
Job Description
Why join us?
General Motors is working toward a future with zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion. Vehicle Autonomy is an important part of that vision, helping create safer, more capable, and more seamless experiences for customers.

Our Product Management teams connect customer needs, business priorities, technology, and execution. We work across current and future autonomy products as well as the underlying software and platform capabilities that support GM’s vehicle autonomy roadmap.

As a Product Management Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment while contributing to work that supports the future of transportation.

The role
We are looking for a motivated student to join the Vehicle Autonomy Product Management organization for a summer internship. The intern will support product managers and partner teams across a range of initiatives, which may include current products, future product concepts, and foundational platforms that enable autonomy experiences.

The specific project will be aligned to business needs, the intern’s interests, and the skills they bring to the team. This is an opportunity to learn how high impact products are identified, evaluated, and iterated throughout the development cycle. A successful candidate is curious, organized, comfortable learning new technical concepts, and eager to collaborate with people across product, engineering, design, data, program management, and other partner teams.

What you’ll do
Opportunities may include the following:

• Support product managers with research, analysis, documentation, and day-to-day product activities.
• Help gather and synthesize customer, market, competitive, technical, and business insights.
• Contribute to product requirements, user stories, use cases, process flows, and other product documentation.
• Assist with roadmap planning and preparation of materials for team and stakeholder discussions.
• Analyze information and data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
• Participate in cross-functional meetings and help track decisions, actions, dependencies, and open questions.
• Work with engineering, design, data science, program management, and other teams to understand product capabilities and constraints.
• Help evaluate current and future autonomy experiences and the platforms that support them.
• Prepare presentations, status updates, and recommendations for a variety of audiences.
• Support the development and tracking of product success measures, customer feedback, and team objectives.
• Learn and apply product management practices in an automotive and software-defined vehicle environment.

Your skills and abilities
• Currently enrolled in a Master's or MBA degree program with a focus in engineering, computer science, data science, human-computer interaction, or a related field with a planned graduation date between December 2027 through August 2028.
• Interest in product management, vehicle autonomy, advanced driver assistance systems, automotive technology, robotics, or emerging mobility experiences.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex information and present proposals to stakeholders.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with teammates from different technical and professional backgrounds. Experience working on a team project with ambiguous or evolving requirements.
• Curiosity and willingness to learn & share new concepts

What will give you a competitive edge
• Coursework, projects, or prior experience involving product management, software development, data analysis, user research, systems engineering, robotics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or automotive technology.
• Experience translating user or business needs into requirements, workflows, features, or recommendations.
• Experience creating presentations, dashboards, reports, process diagrams, or other structured deliverables.
• Exposure to ADAS, autonomous vehicles, computer vision, sensor systems, vehicle systems, or software platforms.

Additional information
This internship is intended to provide meaningful work experience and development opportunities while supporting GM’s Vehicle Autonomy roadmap. Project assignments and responsibilities may vary based on organizational priorities and the intern’s background.

Compensation
The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of New York, Colorado, California, or Washington.

• The salary range for this role is $9,400-$11,100 per month. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
• GM will provide a one-time lump sum taxable stipend payment to eligible students selected for the 2027 Student Program - to help facilitate administration of relocation benefits, please apply using the permanent address you would move from.

What You'll Get from Us
• Paid US GM Holidays
• GM Family First Vehicle Discount Program
• Result-based potential for growth within GM
• Intern events to network with company leaders and peers

Work Arrangement
• Start dates for this internship role are May 24th and June 14th of 2027.
• Assignments will be based on team placement to ensure interns are located with their working team and leader.
• Hybrid : This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to their designated work location three times per week, at minimum.

About GM
Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us 
We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Benefits Overview
From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources.

Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada
Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale. Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix
Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Emplacement : Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Saint-Hubert du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Notre site web : https://www.pwc.ca/fr

Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?
Pendant ce stage de quatre mois au sein du departement service clientèle de l’après marché, votre principal objectif serait de concevoir et développer des outils logiciels destinés à améliorer le support offert aux clients.

Voici un aperçu plus détaillé de vos missions :
Vous commencerez par étudier les besoins des gestionnaires d’événement moteurs. Il s'agit de comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent, les questions les plus fréquentes et les lacunes actuelles dans le service. Une fois les besoins identifiés, vous passerez à la phase de conception. Vous serez chargé de concevoir des outils logiciels ou des plateformes en ligne qui simplifieront la résolution des problèmes pour les clients et l'équipe de support. Votre stage comprendra également un volet d'amélioration continue. Vous collecterez des commentaires des clients et de l'équipe du service client pour affiner et améliorer constamment les outils que vous avez créés. Enfin, vous générerez des rapports périodiques sur l'efficacité des outils que vous avez mis en place. Vous suivrez les performances du service clientèle pour vous assurer que les améliorations apportées ont un impact positif. Ce stage vous permettra de combiner des compétences en service clientèle avec des compétences en développement d'outils, le tout dans le contexte stimulant et passionnant de l'industrie aéronautique.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ?
• Développer et initier des stratégies d’optimisation afin de supporter nos clients.

• Supporter les gestionnaires d’événements moteurs.

• Coordonner et soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration continue.

• Implanter de solitions pouvant être appliquer à l’échelle planétaire. dans une optique de standardisation globale.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ? 
• Être éligible à travailler au Canada.

• Être inscrit dans une université canadienne pendant toute la durée de votre stage.

• Être en mesure de travailler sur place dans la province où vous êtes embauché, le cas échéant.

• Poursuivre des études en Administration ou en Génie mécanique, logiciel, informatique, industriel ou aérospatial.

• Une bonne connaissance de la langue anglaise, à l’écrit et à l’oral, est requise pour ce poste compte tenu des besoins opérationnels de l’Employeur et des personnes avec lesquelles le [candidat] sera appelé à interagir.

Atouts :
• Sens de l'organisation.

• Compétences en matière de gestion de projet.

• Capacité à géré plusieurs tâches à priorité variable de front.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada
Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés. Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés. Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux.

jobs.title: Business Systems & AI Intern
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
 
Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives. 
 
Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.
 
As the backbone of Canada’s financial ecosystem, Interac facilitates over 20 million transactions daily, supported by trusted partnerships with government and financial institutions. Consistently ranked as Canada’s most reputable financial technology brand, Interac is deeply embedded in the daily lives of Canadians.

Who You Will Work With:

You will join the Product Foundation team within Money Movement and work closely with Business Systems Analysts, Product partners, developers, Quality Engineering, and subject-matter experts.
 
During the internship, you will explore how AI can support the review of API specifications by identifying missing information, naming inconsistencies, conflicting definitions, validation gaps, and differences across specification versions. You will help develop and evaluate a controlled proof of concept, compare AI-generated findings with manually reviewed examples, and create repeatable workflows and guidance that improve the efficiency, consistency, and accuracy of API specification reviews.
 
This is a collaborative and hands-on opportunity to apply AI to a practical business and technology challenge. AI-generated observations will be validated by accountable team members before being used

What You Will Do:
 
• Assess the current API specification review process and identify pain points, repetitive activities, and common sources of rework in collaboration with the BSA and Product teams.
• Explore practical AI-assisted techniques for reviewing API specifications and detecting gaps, inconsistencies, and potential quality issues.
• Define a structured taxonomy and evaluation criteria for discrepancies such as missing fields, inconsistent naming, conflicting definitions, validation gaps, and differences between specification versions.
• Develop a controlled proof of concept that uses AI to compare and analyze selected API specifications and generate findings for human validation.
• Create structured reports that capture each discrepancy, its source reference, potential impact, confidence level, and recommended follow-up.
• Evaluate AI-generated findings against manually reviewed examples, document accuracy and limitations, and refine prompts or rules based on feedback.
• Work with subject-matter experts to validate observations and maintain clear traceability from identified issues through review and resolution.
• Develop user guidance, safeguards, and recommendations that support the future adoption or extension of AI-assisted API specification reviews across the Product Foundation, BSA, and Product teams

What You Bring:

• Basic understanding of LLMs, prompts, agents, and workflows
• Familiarity with APIs, data sources, and system integrations
• Ability to prototype solutions quickly and iterate based on feedback
• You are currently enrolled in a university or college program in a relevant discipline, like Data science, computer science, cybersecurity or IT

• Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with fraud teams and other stakeholders.

• Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with other teams and other stakeholders

• Have strong attention to detail to improve analysis and specifications
 
Although not required, you have some familiarity or previous experience with the following:
• Understanding of the payments/banking industry/fintech/finance

The hourly pay rate for this position is $25, and the internship term runs from January to April 2027. The exact amount will depend on factors such as skills, experience, and job-related knowledge. An internship opportunity at Interac also features:

• Flexible hybrid work model with monthly intern socials for better work-life balance
• Convenient downtown Toronto office located minutes away from Union Station
• Interac learning bootcamp designed to help you hit the ground running

• Investing in the Future – Help us unlock digital prosperity for all Canadians.

• Innovative Thinking – Collaborate on products, practices, and platforms that redefine what’s possible.

• Inclusive Culture – Be empowered to bring your whole self to work and realize your full potential.

• Inspiring Community – Work in an ecosystem where we lift each other up and rise together.

• Intentional Support – Enjoy flexible, supportive offerings that prioritize your total wellness.

Additional Pre-Employment Requirements:
 
To ensure the integrity of our organization, successful candidates will be required to complete background checks, which may include, Canadian Criminal Credit Check, Canadian ID Cross-Check, Public Safety Verification, 5-year Employment Verification, Education Verification, Credit Check, and Social Media Check.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe that innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together. jobs.description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Job Title:
Associate Electrical Engineer / Electronic Design Engineer.
Reporting To:
Design Engineering Manager
Work Schedule:
Onsite – Phoenix, AZMOOG Space and Defense Group is a proven provider of high performance and reliable space-rated avionics hardware and software. Products include control and data handling, power distribution, payload interface cards, mass memory, GPS receivers, motor and actuation drivers and controllers, and onboard computing. MOOG has partnered with NASA to provide electronic solutions for the Artemis Orion Crew Capsule, Viper Lunar Rover, Satellite Laser Communications Relay, OSIRIS-REX to study asteroid composition along with complete satellite buses for the defense department.

MOOG Space and Defense Group is seeking an Engineering Associate - Electrical / Electronic Design Engineer.
The Engineering Associate position is an entry level individual contributor role within the Electrical Engineering team. The focus is to leverage the basic principles, theories and methods acquired through education and jobs / internships and apply these to analog, digital or power designs. The ideal candidate must be willing to learn the many aspects of design and product development specific to Space / Defense environments. If you have the drive and enthusiasm to work with a team of high performers and learn from the best, this job is for you!

Key Responsibilities:
• Design Analog and high-speed digital circuits, including schematic capture and PCB layout specifications.
• Collaborate across disciplines to define product requirements and deliver technical presentations.
• Leverage modeling programs and tools to simulate circuits and interfaces and reduce design risks.
• Document designs, analyses, and results with clear, concise reports.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent.
• Deep understanding of the basic principles of electrical / electronic engineering design – having worked with processors, digital logic, analog circuits, and basic power circuits
• Knowledge of board design (interface requirements), schematic creation, and digital simulation.
• Strong communication skills and ability to produce technical documentation.
• Experience with lab instrumentation (DMM, Oscilloscope, …) to perform troubleshooting (hands-on), board bring-up, and cross-disciplinary collaboration.
• Problem solving skills
• Organization skills

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with Schematic Capture / Creation tools & PCB Layout Tools
• Knowledge of Space grade electronics design and development.
• Experience with VHDL/Verilog coding for space applications.
• Experience with Signal Integrity analysis tools, PSPice, Mathcad and other essential design tools.

jobs.title: Data Science Graduate
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Data Scientist Graduate is a key member of the client-facing Data Science Lab team in the European region. As a Data Scientist, you will be accountable for the development and delivery of analytics-driven strategies and solutions for Visa’s external clients in Europe. In this role, you will work collaboratively with VCA and a multitude of internal functions, their senior leaders, and our clients in promoting an insight-driven culture, creative analytic solutions, and best practices to drive business performance with a clear commercial ‘value’ and measurable ‘return’. Half of your day will involve delivering projects (coding/working with data), and the other half will be dedicated to discussing data requirements and managing internal and external meetings. Please bear in mind that our workload varies tremendously, as each project is very bespoke. Sometimes we might be delivering a CSV file; another time, a predictive machine learning model or segmentation. Whatever the solution is, you will be involved in the end-to-end process, starting from gathering clients’ requirements all the way to delivering actionable insights that enable our clients to make data-driven business decisions.
Principal Responsibilities
• Promote the use of data science to solve business challenges for external clients, showcasing creative and impactful solutions.

• Collaborate with VCA consultants to identify and develop data science opportunities that support business development and revenue growth.

• Apply predictive modeling and machine learning techniques to improve client outcomes in areas like customer acquisition, retention, and profitability.

• Analyze VisaNet data to uncover key performance metrics and identify issuer P&L opportunities that drive growth for clients and Visa.

• Deliver business-centric insights through effective data visualization and storytelling that support strategic decision-making.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data science solutions.

• Manage multiple data science projects, ensuring clear scope, methodology, and alignment with client goals and timelines.

• Develop and execute analytic plans using appropriate statistical and data mining techniques, while maintaining thorough project documentation.

• Enhance existing solutions by introducing new methodologies, tools, and best practices in the field of data science.

• Automate processes and stay current with emerging tools, software, and techniques to continuously improve efficiency and innovation.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications

What we’re after:
• Permanent right to work in the UK, please specify this on your CV

• Graduating in 2026, ready to start the job on January 2026

• Graduate/Postgraduate degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Operational Research, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• Fluent in English.

• Ability to communicate with impact and interest in working in a consulting-like environment and client-facing project roles.

• Familiarity with modern distributed systems, including Hadoop, SQL, MLP, and Apache Spark.

• Familiarity with one or more data analytics/programming tools such as Python.

• Knowledge of applying predictive modelling and machine learning techniques to problems.

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Graduate Subsurface Technology
jobs.description:
Entity: 
Technology
Job Family Group: 
Business Support Group, Subsurface Group
Job Description: 
About bp 
bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition. 

One Subsurface early careers programme 
Curiosity uncovers what others can't see. Through the One Subsurface early careers programme, you'll apply science, data and technical expertise to understand the resources beneath the surface and help shape how energy is delivered to the world. 

Why Subsurface technology at bp? 
• Experience subsurface technology through structured rotations and projects. 
• Apply science, data and technical expertise to real business challenges. 
• Learn from experienced specialists and dedicated mentors who support your development. 
• Join a global network built on collaboration, curiosity and continuous learning. 

As part of the One Subsurface programme, you’ll complete two or three rotations designed to give you breadth of experience across Subsurface Technology while supporting you to build technical depth. Whether you're analysing data, interpreting the subsurface or helping solve complex technical challenges, you'll gain real-world experience that helps turn academic knowledge into practical expertise. 

Join us and you’ll get the support of a structured technical pathway and our training programme, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. In return, you'll bring your ideas, curiosity and ambition to real business challenges. Along the way, you'll be part of a supportive bp early careers community that will help you grow, succeed and make a meaningful impact from day one. 

Role and responsibilities 
bp’s Technology Upstream R&D group develops and deploys innovative technologies that support safer, faster and more reliable operations across bp’s portfolio. 

As a graduate geologist in our Subsurface & Wells group, you’ll combine your geological knowledge with data science capabilities, including Python, machine learning, high-performance computing, AI and analytics. You’ll contribute to projects that transform subsurface ways of working and deliver value across bp’s businesses. 

The precise nature of your role and projects will depend on your skills and business needs. Your responsibilities may include: 

• Work with regional teams around the world, combining geoscience and data science methods to develop innovative solutions to complex subsurface challenges. 
• Develop and deploy Python code to accelerate subsurface workflows and improve predictability by broadening the characterisation of geological uncertainty. 
• Automate and parallelise subsurface workflows using bp’s high-performance computing capabilities. 
• Provide technical support to colleagues using deployed technology solutions. 
 
Requirements 
To apply for this role, you must be in the final year of, or have completed, a PhD in Geology, Earth Science or a closely related geoscience discipline. You must also hold an undergraduate degree with a minimum classification of 2:1 or equivalent. 

You'll also have 
· Experience of coding in Python, or demonstrated programming experience in another language, such as MATLAB or C++, with the ability to learn Python. 
· Passion for creating innovative technology solutions 

Desirable skills and experience: 
The following are advantageous but can be developed through training and on-the-job experience. 
· Familiarity using AI techniques (such as coding agents) 
· Familiarity with using Jupyter notebooks. 
· Experience with code management tools such as Git for version control 
· Skills in data analytics and statistical analysis 
· Skills in machine learning or automation 
· Familiarity with working in a Linux environment 
 
You are also expected to have strong spoken and written English language skills, including business and technical English.  Language skills will be assessed throughout the recruitment process. 

Please note: We value individuals who take initiative, are committed to excellence, and can adapt positively to change and challenges in a supportive environment. 

Location 
This role will be based at the following UK office: 
Sunbury* – ICBT (International Centre for Business & Technology), Chertsey Road, Sunbury on Thames, Middlesex, TW16 7LN 

*From Q4 2027 – Q1 2028, roles based at Sunbury and St James’s Square will move to Timber Square (Ink Building, 25 Lavington Street, London, SE1 0NZ). Individual move dates will vary by role and will be shared nearer the time. 

Start date 
Monday 6 September 2027 

Other information 
Please note the following when applying: 
• You can only apply to one bp early careers opportunity globally per academic year – within this time, we will only process the first application you make. You will be withdrawn from any subsequent applications.  
• We recruit on a rolling basis – this means roles may close once positions are filled or we have enough applications. If you’re interested in a role, we strongly recommend applying as soon as possible while applications remain open. 
• Exploration Days are a key part of the assessment process and will be in person – bp will cover reasonable travel and accommodation costs, in line with the travel policy which will be shared with you. Please ensure you will be available to attend in person. 
• Unless you apply to a role with a location explicitly stated, role locations are not guaranteed – where not stated, you will be placed in a location based on business need. 
• Accommodation – once confirmed, where you need or decide to move closer to your location, you are responsible for organising and funding this accommodation. 
• Hybrid working – please note, bp operates a 60:40 hybrid working policy for most office-based roles, normally requiring three days per week in the office. 
 
Adjustments 
We are keen to make our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any adjustments/accommodations, to any stage of the recruitment process, please mention this in the allocated section on your initial application form. Someone will then be in touch to discuss or confirm the adjustments/accommodations as appropriate for you. Alternatively, if you would like to discuss adjustments before applying, please get in touch: 
https://careers.bp.com/contact-us 

Reward 
Starting salary: £43,000 per annum, plus a discretionary, performance-related annual bonus. 
Sign-on bonus: £5,000 one-off payment, subject to tax and National Insurance. 
Holiday allowance: 28 days, flexible bank holidays and two wellbeing or duvet days. 
Wellbeing allowance: Claim up to £1,500 each calendar year, subject to tax and National Insurance, for products and services that support physical, mental, financial and social wellbeing. 
Private Medical Insurance: We’ll pay for private healthcare, and you only pay an income tax charge. 
bp share plans: You can choose to take part in our share plan and buy bp shares every month. 

Travel Requirement
No travel is expected with this role
Relocation Assistance:
This role is not eligible for relocation
Remote Type:

Our digital graduate programme
Technology at bp isn’t an add-on – it’s the engine. Whether you're into AI, data or digital systems, our digital early careers programme gives you space to think boldly, build creatively and grow at speed.

Why work in digital at bp?
• Use world-leading technologies to tackle complex global challenges.
• See your ideas come to life in groundbreaking projects.
• Explore different paths and shape the technology career you want.
 
The digital disciplines are a logical grouping of digital capabilities that facilitate the development of skills and experience, career progression and digital talent in bp. Our digital disciplines are made up of specialist sub-disciplines which focus on aspects of our digital capability. 
 
Digital Engineering: We have the deep technical expertise to plan, architect, build, engineer, operate, and maintain our digital estate. This includes: 
• Software Engineering 
• Enterprise Technology 
• Software development engineering in test 
• Architecture 
• Site reliability engineering 
 
Data and AI: We build data products, derive actionable insights, build ML/AI applications using analytics, data science and AI. This includes:

As a digital graduate, you’ll complete three 12-month rotations designed to give you breadth of experience across your chosen business area while also supporting you to build technical depth.
Join us and you’ll get the support of a structured technical pathway and our training programme, designed to help you grow both professionally and personally. Fast-moving. High impact. Full of possibility. In supply, trading & shipping (ST&S), every decision matters – and you’ll be making them sooner than you think.

About the Supply, Trading & shipping development programme 
Once hired into the development programme your world-class learning journey will incorporate face-to-face classroom learning with SME’s, as well as online and virtual learning and on-the-job training, giving you the behavioural and technical skills you need to build a truly outstanding career. In addition, you'll have a buddy and mentor assigned to you, helping you to navigate the organisation, guide your development and learn what it takes to be successful.
Our supply, trading & shipping programme is global in nature – wherever you’re based, you’ll benefit from the same outstanding training, development, and support. The rotational structure of our programme provides you with variety which means you’ll be challenged in many ways – all of which will build your confidence, expertise and experience at pace, giving you the flexibility to eventually take your career in the direction that suits you best. We have designed the structure of our programme to allow for a degree of flexibility that create a personal development journey.  

Supply, Trading & shipping development track and career pathway:  Analytics track
Over the course of the 3-year programme, analysts have an opportunity to directly influence the bottom line as part of a highly commercial and skilled team. Working in the fast-paced world of our trading business and with access to vast amounts of data and information, you’ll focus on rotations that are designed to build your skills and knowledge to drive continued growth in trading profits and acting as a subject matter expert on energy market fundamentals. 
 
ST&S Analytics includes a range of disciplines, some of these are mentioned below:
• Short term market analytics (Strategists): seeks to identify and understand fundamental drivers that influence market prices up to two years forward. Analysts are often co-located on the trading desks, and employ models of supply and demand, physical storage, weather, shipping, and power generation, coupled with real-time data feeds, to provide actionable commercial insights to the front-line trading teams.
• Fundamentals Modelling & Innovation: We spearhead our digital ambition, advancing our fundamental modelling capabilities, leveraging AI and Machine Learning to generate data driven insights, increase automation, and delivered in line with the trading bench / discipline strategies.
• Strategic insights: Identifying high margin deployment of capital expenditure, offtake and sale decisions and highlighting investment and trading opportunities for T&S and bp in incubatory and established energy markets.
• Structuring: works closely with the trading and origination teams to structure and value complex financial and physical transactions. The modelling of key drivers of financial value, deal scenario analysis and designing tailored customer solutions are a strong focus for the team.

jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the TimeDescription

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Entry Level opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. Are you interested in boosting your knowledge through experience and exposure, while supporting a mission that seeks to protect our nation and its allies?  If so, then Northrop Grumman is the place you!

Our professionals live and breathe different perspectives; we are curious about the world, accepting each other, and aware that the more ideas, backgrounds, opinions and experiences we bring to our work, the stronger that work will be. Just as you would invest your time and hard work into our company, we focus on investing back into you through enriching professional experiences and high-quality learning and development opportunities. We want you to bring your whole self to work, and for you to have meaningful connections with your coworkers, customers and communities, while providing the best products, systems and technologies to protect our world.

The qualified candidate will become part of Northrop Grumman’s Naval & Oceanic Systems business unit headquartered in Annapolis, MD which is seeking S/W Embedded Engineers for Entry-Level opportunities. Our site supports the development, test, and sustainment of state-of-the-art subsea systems. This opportunity will provide you with exposure to a wide range of advanced technologies, including uncrewed undersea vehicles (UUVs), remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), undersea payloads, acoustic and non-acoustic sensors, sensor processing, navigation, platform integration, subsea and maritime-surface communication technologies, advanced algorithms, digital engineering, and more.

Roles and Responsibilities
You’ll Have an Opportunity to: 
• Bring ideas into reality by designing and developing digital logic for our advanced mission solutions
• Gain hands-on exposure to the programmable logic full life-cycle: design, simulation, implementation, verification, and system integration
• Implement and debug designs in simulations and on real hardware
• Collaborate directly with experienced engineers to solve design challenges, get feedback, and learn best practices
• Engage in a full life-cycle approach-- design, implementation, test verification, production of digital electronic equipment and other hardware systems 

Basic Qualifications
​​Basic Qualifications for an Associate​ S/W Embedded Engineer:
• Be completing or has completed their Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution   
• Be majoring in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a closely related STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) degree. 
• Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite) as well as Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Basic Qualifications for a S/W Embedded Engineer:
• Be completing or has completed their Master’s degree from an accredited institution   
• Be majoring in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a closely related STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) degree. 
• Be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite) as well as Program Special access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher
• A current/active US Government Secret clearance

At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, everything begins with a bold idea and the drive to make life smarter, faster, and more connected. jobs.description:
Job Description

Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies; we are passionate about bringing great science to life. Our commitment to quality and innovation supports cutting-edge life science research, patient diagnostics, and ensures the safety of water, food, and pharmaceuticals. As scientists and clinicians pursue small, everyday advances and life-changing discoveries, we provide trusted answers to their most critical questions and challenges. We can’t wait for you to join us as we continue our mission to improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com. 

We are seeking a motivated Junior Full Stack R&D Software Developer to join our growing R&D team based at the Harwell Science Campus near Oxford.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of innovative commercial web-based spectroscopy applications, working alongside firmware, hardware, quality, and data science engineers in a highly collaborative environment.

Our primary technology stack consists of .NET, C#, and Angular, and we follow Agile/SCRUM methodologies within a structured project framework with assistance from AI. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career software engineer looking to develop their technical expertise while contributing to products that support scientific innovation.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain full-stack web applications for scientific instrumentation using .NET, C#, Angular, and modern web technologies
• Deliver software features throughout the entire product lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, release, and post-launch support
• Collaborate closely with software, firmware, hardware, quality, and data science teams to develop integrated product solutions
• Develop and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and user-facing web applications while ensuring performance, quality, and usability
• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software defects, applying best practices such as code reviews, version control, automated testing, and continuous improvement
• Contribute to Agile/SCRUM development activities, including sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and technical documentation
• Stay current with emerging software technologies and development practices, including DevOps, test-driven development, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted software development tools and workflows

Qualifications

What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline
• Recent graduate or candidate with up to 2 years of software development experience, including internships, placements, or graduate projects
• Strong programming skills in C# and .NET, with knowledge of web application development principles and modern software engineering practices including use of AI across the development cycle
• Familiarity with front-end technologies such as Angular, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript
• Understanding of software testing, debugging techniques, and software quality best practices
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies and apply them effectively
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work successfully in a multidisciplinary team environment and contribute to shared goals
 
Desirable Skills
• Experience with REST API design and development, relational databases, and data modelling
• Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and modern software delivery methodologies
• Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing frameworks, and software quality best practices
• Understanding of cloud technologies, modern software architectures, and scalable web application development
• Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and workflows
• Experience working within Agile/SCRUM environments and collaborating in cross-functional engineering teams

What Success Looks Like
• Delivering high-quality software features that meet customer and business requirements
• Collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams
• Applying problem-solving skills to address technical challenges of increasing complexity
• Continuously developing technical expertise and contributing to engineering best practices
• Taking increasing ownership and responsibility as proficiency and experience grow

What We Offer
• Outstanding company culture
• Personalised development opportunities
• Company pension scheme, yearly company bonus, private health care, stock purchase plan, medical & life insurance
• A position within an international organisation, offering a dynamic working environment with exciting challenges and opportunities
• The opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies that support scientific discovery and advancement

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience across their IT estates. Our more than 125,000 people in 70-plus countries are entrusted by our customers to deliver transformative technologies to ensure the success, safety and well-being of businesses and people around the world. By combining strengths and expertise globally, we create solutions and deliver greater outcomes for customers across their entire IT estate. Our global team of consulting, engineering, and technology experts partners with the world’s most innovative companies to help them thrive in an AI-powered world. With a strong foundation of values, deep industry expertise, and an extensive partner network, our people are trusted by clients to lead transformative change.

About the Role
DXC Technology is seeking a Software Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that software solutions align with organizational goals and technical requirements. This role is ideal for candidates ranging from entry-level to senior analyst levels, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects while developing deep expertise in requirements analysis, system design, and quality assurance processes.
In this position, you will work closely with business leaders, users, developers, and quality assurance teams to gather requirements, document technical specifications, and ensure that systems are optimized for performance and security. You will play a key role in translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable information for non-technical stakeholders, while also ensuring that business needs are accurately communicated to development teams.

This role supports an ITAR-compliant client account and requires strict adherence to specific security and work authorization requirements, reflecting the sensitive and mission-critical nature of the work performed. As such, candidates must be able to provide proof of US citizenship and meet specific security and work authorization requirements outlined below.

• Gather and document clear project goals and technical specifications by meeting with business leaders and users
• Analyze existing software architectures to identify performance issues, security gaps, and optimization opportunities
• Create detailed functional designs, user stories, and Software Requirement Specification (SRS) documents
• Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical teams and communicate business needs clearly to developers
• Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to technical standards
• Coordinate defect tracking with quality assurance teams
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues
• Serve as a cross-functional liaison between business and technical teams

Inside the Role
Develops, analyzes and models operational, economic, management, accounting and other organizational data. Prepares operations analyses, including analysis of competitors, operational effectiveness and capacity utilization. Prepares plans or recommends solutions to new and complex problems, develops innovative strategies, quantifies the competitive performance of the organization's operations and/or markets, evaluates the potential impact of changes and reports on economic forecasts that affect the industry. Responsibilities are within the Data Science & Business Intelligence job family group as a generalist or in a combination of job families.
Posting Information
We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected.

We Take Care of Our Team
Position offers a starting salary range of $71,000 – $91,000 USD
Pay offered dependent on knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans.

What You Will Drive 
Data Mining, Extraction and Analysis - Identify relevant data sources, collect data, and perform various analytical techniques to extract insights using SQL, Excel, Python, or specialized analytics software. Develop, analyze and model operational, manufacturing, and other organizational data. Work with large, complex data sets to solve difficult, non-routine analysis problems, applying advanced analytical methods as needed.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.

The Role and Impact 
As a CPU Validation Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the functionality, performance, and reliability of Intel's cutting-edge CPU products. Your day-to-day work will involve developing and executing validation plans, performing silicon debug, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize designs and resolve issues. Your contributions will be integral to delivering high-quality, performance-driven CPU solutions that meet Intel's standards.

Business group 
You will be part of Intel Corporation's Component Design team, which focuses on developing innovative and high-performance processors that drive computing technology forward. This group plays a critical role in designing, validating, and delivering technologies that support Intel's leadership in global innovation and enable advancements across industries, empowering businesses and individuals worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Defines, develops, and performs functional validation for CPUs, focusing on validation of the CPU internals and CPU integration in system level features for Intel performance and power efficient cores.
• Applies various hardware and software level tools and techniques to ensure validation coverage and that performance, power, and area goals are met.
• Reviews proposed design changes to assess impact on validation plans, tasks, and timelines.
• Develops CPU validation methodologies and test plans, executes validation plans, and collaborates with other engineers for design optimization, troubleshooting, and failure analysis.
• Applies knowledge of CPU core architecture, processor microarchitecture, and design.
• Performs silicon debug to identify root causes and resolves all functional and triage failures for CPU issues.
• Tests interactions between various CPU features using validation infrastructure.
• Develops postsilicon validation infrastructure (e.g., performance monitors, behavioral checkers, state space coverage) and test environment used in validation testing.
• Publishes CPU validation reports summarizing all validation activities performed, reviews results, and communicates to relevant teams.
• Works with architecture, design, verification, board, platform, and manufacturing teams to maintain and improve debug, validation test strategy, methodologies, and processes for CPU interfaces and to meet desired product specifications.
• Develops content to create or increase specific IP interactions using a variety of tools and techniques (including patching techniques using microcode, firmware, or custom OS builds).
• Engages in all phases of the product life cycle, develops, and validates content and infrastructure, and bug hunts in multiple environments (simulation, emulation, FPGAs) to ensure silicon readiness.

Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences.

Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related STEM field with 0 years of relevant experience.
• Knowledge of CPU Architecture.
• Courses in VLSI\Digital Design or related.
• Knowledge of coding language like C/C++, Python.

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Verilog, System Verilog, and X86 assembly coding.
• Use of AI agents in your projects, college classes, or software development.
• Familiarity with RTL simulation and emulation environments.
• RTL Debugging at module level or soc level system simulation failures.
• Knowledge of basic lab hardware\equipment's like scope, power supply, etc.
• Excellent analytical and debugging skills, with a creative approach to problem-solving.
• Effective collaboration skills to work across teams.

You'll gain hands-on experience, develop the skills needed for your future career and build a network that will support you throughout your journey. 

Why Technology? 

From AI and automation to cyber security and cloud engineering, technology is powering the solutions that will help create a more sustainable future. 

Across the two-year programme, you could gain experience in areas such as software development, data and AI, cyber security, cloud engineering, digital products and platform technologies. Whatever path you follow, you'll develop future-ready skills while helping us build smarter, more secure and more resilient digital experiences for our customers and colleagues. 
 
Support to help you thrive 

We're looking for potential, not perfection. That's why you'll be supported every step of the way through structured development opportunities, experienced mentors and line managers, dedicated graduate learning, buddy support and a network of graduates from across the business. 

With offices across the UK and a hybrid approach to working, flexibility is an important part of our graduate programmes. You’ll need to be open to travel when required and, for some placements, relocation, giving you the opportunity to experience different teams, locations and parts of our business. 

Click here to explore the full job description. 
 
What we need from you:  
  
• Expecting a minimum 2:1 degree (2:2 if combined with a Master's) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Mathematics or a related discipline 
• Right to work in the UK
• Curious, proactive and keen to learn 
• Willingness to travel and relocate between placements where required 
• Available to start in September 2027 
 
Here’s what's in it for you:  

• Starting salary of £36,000 per annum 
• Eligible for our annual bonus scheme and profit-based share incentive plan 
• A two-year programme, featuring three rotational placements across different areas of our Technology Teams 
• Structured support and development throughout the programme 
• Opportunities to learn from experienced professionals and build your network 
• A chance to make a meaningful contribution while developing skills that will support your future career 

Why should you apply?   
  
We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.  
  
https://www.morethanacareer.energy/centrica
  
If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Job Description:

3M is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across manufacturing operations located in Brockville, ON. 
 
*Successful security clearance under the Canadian Controlled Goods Registration program is a mandatory pre-requirement for this position at this location. Please note the following are some (but not all) of the listed requirements for Controlled Goods Clearance:
• Must be a Canadian citizen normally residing in Canada, or must be a Permanent Resident normally residing in Canada

• If applicable, living outside of Canada during the past five years will require an international criminal name check
 
The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
 
As a Data Analyst, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
 
• Gather, clean, validate, and analyze manufacturing and operational data from multiple systems.
• Develop recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support plant and operational leadership.

• Partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, and supply chain teams to understand business needs and define reporting requirements.

• Develop and maintain Power BI Reports, Power Apps, Power Automate Flows and SQL Databases.

Your skills and expertise

• High School Diploma/GED or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
 
Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science or Business Analytics (completed and verified prior to start)
• Two (2) years of experience in data analysis in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain environments.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$138,000.00 - $190,000.00
Location:
Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Applied Materials, Inc. is the global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations Make Possible® the technology shaping the future.
 
At Applied’s CTO group, we focus on enabling technologies for quantum information applications, i.e. superconducting qubits and optical quantum computing. Our primary objective is to collaborate with system companies and universities to develop quantum devices with significantly lower error rates compared to current standards. Our approach centers on harnessing state of the art materials engineering and semiconductor processing to enhance device performance.
 
To advance our quantum technology initiatives, we are seeking a passionate Superconducting Circuit Quantum Engineer with a strong background in superconducting qubit devices. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in superconducting circuit/device design, micro/nanofabrication, and cryogenic characterization, and will apply this expertise to develop novel materials, processes, and devices for emerging quantum information technologies. We value people and teams who turn possibilities into reality. We are deeply committed to fostering a Culture of Inclusion where every person knows they belong, feels empowered to bring their whole self to work, and is inspired to grow.
 
Responsibilities
• Design and develop superconducting quantum circuits and devices, including qubits, resonators, couplers, and related test structures.
• Develop and optimize fabrication processes for superconducting quantum devices, with emphasis on materials, interfaces, patterning, deposition, etch, and device integration.
• Design experiments, collect and analyze data, and translate results into actionable improvements in materials, processes, device design, and performance.
• Troubleshoot complex device and process issues, perform root-cause analysis, and develop solutions to improve device performance, yield, and reproducibility.
• Measure and analyze relevant material, electrical, microwave, and device properties and interpret their impact on superconducting quantum circuit performance.
• Collaborate across materials, process engineering, device design, characterization, and integration teams to develop new quantum technologies.
• Evaluate and implement new materials, fabrication technologies, characterization techniques, and analytical instrumentation.
• Generate high-quality technical documentation, reports, presentations, and development plans for internal and external stakeholders.
• Engage with customers, research partners, vendors, and suppliers to address technical challenges and identify new technology opportunities.

Functional Knowledge
• Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines

Business Expertise
• Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market

Leadership
• Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

Problem Solving
• Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

Impact
• Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills
• Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus

Additional Information

Full time

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

Job Description:
Responsibilities 
Health Research, Inc. is seeking an Hourly Project Assistant II to work within the Office of Science, supporting work in the Center for Health Informatics and the Center for Population Health Science, New York State Department of Health. The incumbent will join the Office of Health Informatics data modernization team, assist the Office of Public Health, and provide administrative and technical support to workgroups and assist in creating evaluation reports and analytics related to Data Modernization Initiatives spending for internal and external stakeholders. 
 
The incumbent will also assist with obtaining, preparing, and analyzing data from various sources for the prevention agenda and other population health dashboards, and will assist with surveillance activities, including the analysis and development of reports and education materials for various target audiences. 

Minimum Qualifications 
Undergraduate or graduate student enrolled in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Public Health or related field; OR one year of experience with data analysis in public health or related field. 

Preferred Qualifications 
• Experience and familiarity working with health and/or public health data. 
• Experience conducting data management activities. (i.e. SAS, SQL, Python, SharePoint Experience) 
• Experience conducting data analysis. 
• Demonstrated experience and/or coursework with computer science or data analytics with strong competencies in data structures. 
• Experience of using tools such as CANVA, TEAMS, Tableau, Microsoft Outlook/PowerPoint/Excel etc. 
• Demonstrated communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

Conditions of Employment 
Hourly, grant funded position expected to last through 11/30/2027. Compliance with funding requirements such as time and effort reporting, grant deliverables, and contract deliverables, is required.
 
Valid and unrestricted authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
 
The selected candidate must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the official work location specified in the job posting and must also be located in or willing to relocate to one of the following states: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Vermont, or Massachusetts, prior to hire.
 
This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, with a combination of onsite and remote work.

HRI participates in the E-Verify Program.
