jobs.description:
Career Category
Sales & Marketing Operations
Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients 
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

CD&A Data Scientist, Obesity – Associate – Hybrid
This role requires three days a week on-site.
The Data Scientist – Associate role within Commercial Data & Analytics (CD&A) is a hands-on analytics position supporting commercial strategy, performance measurement, and decision-making across Amgen’s portfolio. Based in Thousand Oaks, this role will contribute to analytical projects that address commercial business questions and work closely with cross-functional partners to help deliver actionable insights.
This position is designed for an early-career data scientist who is eager to develop their technical capabilities, commercial understanding, and ability to communicate analytical findings. The successful candidate will work under the guidance of more experienced team members while taking ownership of clearly defined analyses and deliverables. The role does not have direct reports.

What you will do
Commercial Analytics & Data Science
• Support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of analytical solutions used in commercial decision-making, including forecasting inputs, patient and market segmentation, and performance analytics
• Apply statistical and machine-learning techniques to structured commercial and healthcare datasets
• Conduct exploratory data analysis, data preparation, feature engineering, and model evaluation
• Assist with interpreting analytical results in the context of business objectives, data quality, and methodological limitations
• Contribute to the documentation and quality review of analytical methods and outputs
Data & Technical Execution
• Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from enterprise data sources
• Use Python and/or R to clean data, conduct analyses, and support the development of analytical models
• Work within cloud-based analytics environments and use curated enterprise data assets
• Support repeatable analytical workflows, code documentation, quality control, and model deployment activities
• Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Tableau or Spotfire
• Troubleshoot data and analytical issues with support from senior team members and technology partners
Business Partnership
• Assist in translating business questions from marketing, forecasting, insights, and leadership teams into defined analytical tasks
• Prepare clear summaries of analytical findings for technical and non-technical audiences
• Support ongoing commercial reviews, planning activities, and ad hoc analyses
• Collaborate with forecasting, insights, data strategy, and technology partners within CD&A
• Build knowledge of the obesity market, Amgen’s commercial business, and the healthcare environment
Ways of Working
• Manage assigned analytical tasks and timelines in a fast-paced commercial environment
• Apply structured problem-solving and attention to detail when completing analyses
• Seek guidance when business requirements, data, or analytical results are unclear
• Incorporate feedback from team members and business partners to improve analytical outputs
• Follow applicable data governance, compliance, privacy, and documentation standards

What We Expect of You
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The motivated professional we seek is someone with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree
OR
Associate’s degree and 4 years of relevant experience,
OR
High school diploma/GED and 6 years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications
• Working proficiency in Python and/or R
• Experience using SQL and relational databases
• Experience with Tableau, Spotfire, or a similar data visualization tool
• Familiarity with cloud analytics platforms such as Databricks, Azure, or AWS
• Foundational understanding of statistical modeling and machine-learning concepts
• Experience preparing, cleaning, and analyzing large or complex datasets
• Ability to summarize analytical findings clearly and connect them to business questions
• Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or commercial analytics is preferred
• Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to learn
• Effective collaboration and communication skills in a matrixed organization

What You Can Expect of Us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:
• A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
• A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
• Stock-based long-term incentives
• Award-winning time-off plans
• Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

jobs.description:
Job Posting End Date
10-23-2026Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary 

Responsible to the assigned supervisor for performing entry level engineering work activities and projects requiring the application of engineering knowledge in a safe, effective, efficient and economic accomplishment of assigned objectives.
Job Description

What You’ll Do:
This position is for the role of a Tools & Analytics Engineer within the Transmission System Operations Engineering (TSOE) organization. The role entails supporting and enhancing the tools, applications, data systems, analytics, and automation processes used to manage Transmission Facility Ratings, Configuration Management, transmission modeling, and regulatory compliance activities across the transmission system.
Expected activities include, but are not limited to:
• Providing technical support for TSOE-owned applications, databases, reports, dashboards, and automation solutions used by Transmission Engineering, Operations, Ratings & Configuration, and Configuration Management organizations.
• Developing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications, scripts, APIs, reports, and integrations used to support transmission modeling, facility ratings, engineering workflows, and business processes.
• Creating and supporting SQL, Oracle, and other database queries to analyze engineering, operational, and compliance-related data and provide actionable information to engineering and leadership teams.
• Designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI dashboards, performance metrics, and reporting solutions that improve visibility into Transmission operations, Configuration Management activities, FAC-008 compliance, and engineering performance.
• Supporting Transmission Planning System (TPS), ODMS, facility ratings processes, and related transmission modeling tools by validating data quality, identifying discrepancies, and coordinating corrective actions.
• Reviewing outage requests, asset changes, engineering records, and system data to identify potential impacts to transmission models, facility ratings, and systems of record.
• Performing root cause analysis of data quality issues, model discrepancies, reporting inaccuracies, and process failures to identify improvement opportunities and enhance data integrity.
• Collaborating with engineering, operations, IT, vendors, and external stakeholders to define requirements, implement enhancements, and support modernization of TSOE applications and data systems.
• Providing subject matter expertise related to transmission system modeling, facility ratings, MLSEs, electrical asset data, Configuration Management, and applicable NERC and industry standards.
• Identifying and implementing opportunities to automate manual processes, improve engineering efficiency, reduce compliance risk, and increase the accuracy and accessibility of transmission system data.
 
What we’re looking for:
Engineer Associate SG6
Education/Experience
· This is an entry level position for new graduates with a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a program accredited by ABET*;
· Passing the Fundamentals of Engineering examination in preparation for future licensing as a Professional Engineer (PE) is encouraged and preferred.
 
Engineer SG7
Education/Experience
• Has typically acquired a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a program accredited by ABET* along with two or more years of related engineering experience.
• Individuals with a Master's degree in engineering from an engineering program accredited by ABET* may be considered for entry into the organization at this level.
• Individuals with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology can satisfy this degree requirement, if they obtain a certified Professional Engineering (PE) license. 
*ABET - Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology.

Acceptable alternative:
• Bachelor's degree in engineering (non-ABET) plus a Master's degree or PhD in engineering from a university with an ABET accredited Bachelor's program.
• **VP or above may waive the requirement for a degree from a university with an Non ABET accredited program

In addition:
• Transmission system modeling (TPS, ODMS, PSSE, bus/branch concepts)
• Facility Ratings and FAC-008 knowledge
• NERC compliance understanding
• SQL and Oracle database experience
• Power BI development
• Python, .NET, PowerShell, or other programming experience
• API and system integration experience
• Data analytics and business intelligence
• Understanding of transmission assets, stations, transmission lines, relays, and ratings methodology
This role requires schedule flexibility. Candidates should expect to work outside of standard business hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. The ability to work non-traditional hours and adapt to changing schedules is essential for success in this position.

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Our Toronto office is looking for a Consultant to join its Strategy, Value Creation & Analytics practice within Financial Advisory Services. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, analytics and artificial intelligence. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with business acumen and client facing skills to help organizations solve complex problems, improve decision making and adopt modern data and AI enabled ways of working. This is a new role.

The ideal candidate will be intellectually curious, technically strong and comfortable learning and applying new technologies. Using modern AI tools effectively is an expected part of day to day work. The candidate should be able to use AI to improve research, analysis, coding, problem solving, documentation and solution development, while applying professional judgment and validating outputs. 

As part of the team, you will support client and stakeholder needs while helping organizations advance their data, analytics and AI capabilities. You will translate complex business and financial requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate technical concepts in a way that is accessible to business stakeholders. 

Responsibilities 
• Work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business problems, define analytical requirements and translate them into practical data, analytics and AI solutions. 
• Apply business analytics to research, analyze and interpret complex information, identify meaningful patterns and develop actionable insights and strategic recommendations. 
• Identify opportunities where AI, automation or advanced analytics can improve existing business processes, analytical workflows or client solutions. 
• Design, prototype and implement AI enabled solutions and workflows where appropriate, including solutions using large language models, APIs, structured prompting, retrieval based approaches, workflow automation and other emerging AI technologies. 
• Develop analytics applications, reporting solutions and decision support tools using Power BI, Tableau and other visualization or analytics technologies. 
• Work hands on with data using SQL, Python, Power Query, Excel and related technologies to extract, transform, integrate, analyze and validate structured and unstructured data. 
• Design, build and maintain scalable data transformation and ETL processes that support analytics, reporting, AI applications and business decision making. 
• Apply statistical analysis, machine learning and other analytical techniques where appropriate, and translate technical outputs into practical business insights and usable tools. 
• Develop KPIs, metrics, analytical frameworks and data models that enable organizations to monitor performance and make more informed decisions. 
• Assess data quality, identify gaps or inconsistencies and apply appropriate validation and quality control procedures before information is used for analytical or AI driven decision making. 
• Collaborate with clients to define project requirements through interviews, workshops, research and data analysis, and contribute to project plans, timelines and implementation approaches. 
• Work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clients, and other teams to support the successful implementation and adoption of data and AI solutions. 
• Communicate analytical findings and technical concepts clearly through presentations, reports, dashboards and other client ready deliverables. 
• Stay current on developments in analytics, artificial intelligence and data technologies, and proactively evaluate how new capabilities can be applied to client and internal business problems. 
• Apply responsible AI practices, including appropriate consideration of data privacy, confidentiality, security, accuracy, explainability and human oversight when using AI technologies. 

How do we define success for your role? 
• You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspects of your work: Integrity, Respect and Collaboration. 
• You develop a strong understanding of your clients' industries, business models, challenges and opportunities. 
• You combine strong technical execution with practical business thinking rather than treating analytics or technology as an end in itself. 
• You are comfortable working directly with data and technology and can independently investigate, troubleshoot and solve technical problems. 
• You critically evaluate analytical and AI generated outputs rather than accepting results without appropriate validation. 
• You communicate complex analytical and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders. 
• You identify opportunities to improve the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of client delivery through data, automation, analytics and AI. 
• You consistently produce high quality, accurate and well structured work. 
• You actively contribute ideas, share knowledge and support the development of the team's data, analytics and AI capabilities. 
• You continuously grow your expertise through learning, experimentation and professional development. 

Your experience and education

Deep specialization in all of these areas is not required, but candidates should demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn and apply new AI technologies.

jobs.description:
Who Are We? 
Ditch Witch is a premier division of The Toro Company. At Ditch Witch in Perry, Oklahoma we pride ourselves on being the leading manufacturer in the underground pipe and cable market. Our plant in Perry stands out because it's a place for people to learn and thrive. We enjoy coming to work because our plant is our community, we see our teammates not only as coworkers but as neighbors and family members. All of our locations build the intricate network of machinery that contributes to the Ditch Witch Division. We contribute to building communities, cities, and the world. We invite you to apply and join a team of highly skilled and highly passionate people. 

Sponsorship: 
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. 

Electrical Design Engineer at Ditch Witch:
This person, will research and design components and electrical/electronic systems for Ditch Witch or Subsite branded products. Primary duties include design and selection of components related to electronic or electromechanical equipment. The employee will use ECAD software to create electronic schematics; direct the work of drafter/illustrators, and technicians; works closely with various component suppliers; and performs other duties as assigned.

What Will You Do?

• Collect and analyze technical information from a variety of sources, including:• Conversations with engineers, product managers, suppliers, etc.
• Technical documents
• Operation of equipment
• Your own tests & experiments

• Maintain design concepts for circuits and systems, involving analog and digital design techniques and interface sensors with microcontrollers.
• Design, implement, and test electrical circuits to demonstrate compliance with specifications.
• Prepare technical design and production documentation.
• Define measurement techniques, tuning procedures, and special test fixtures for production use.
• Develop Desktop (Windows and Linux) applications.
• Design for embedded Linux systems.
• Design for bare-metal embedded systems.
• Serve as an expert within the department for a design-related field and provide consulting to others on technical matters.
• Coordinate product sustaining activities with other personnel, including the flow of information and documentation to other departments.
• Evaluate feasibility and applicability of newer technologies and methods to existing products and designs.
• Meet or exceed typical expectations for creativity, productivity, quality, and safety.

Note: The responsibilities and tasks outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company.

What Do You Need?

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering only from an ABET accredited engineering college or university.
• Engineer I, 0 - 2 years of experience (Advanced Degree in lieu of experience).
• Engineer II, 2 - 4 years of experience (Advanced Degree in lieu of experience).
• Engineer III, 4 - 6 years of experience (Advanced Degree in lieu of experience).
• Knowledge of, or experience in., developing embedded firmware for 8/16/32-bit microcontrollers in C/C++.
• Knowledge of, experience in, developing application software for embedded Linux systems (Qt/C++).
• Knowledge of, or experience in, developing desktop applications in C# or Python.
• Knowledge of, or experience in, common communications busses such as SPI, I2C, RS232, and CAN.
• Good oral and written communication skills.
• Works well in a team environment.
• Results-driven and action-oriented; positive and energetic.
• High degree of personal and professional integrity.
• Good problem-analysis and resolution skills.
• Strong process orientation and drive for continuous improvement.

Work Environment:

• Office environment most of the time with regular trips to the shop and outside of work.
• Shop and outdoor environments include physical hazards such as utilities (typically gas, electric, and water lines), powered vehicle, bicycle, and pedestrian traffic, sharp objects, and moving machinery. Outdoor environment includes work in all kinds of weather while operating and demonstrating machinery and construction site conditions such as open excavations, unimproved land, uncompleted structures, etc.
• Working with hazardous materials, including fuels, lubricants, solvents, and batteries.
• Occasional overnight travel.
• Rapidly changing workload, priorities, demands, schedules, and deadlines.
• Regular, continuous use of a computer.

What Can We Give You?     

At Ditch Witch, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical/dental/vision plan, 401k, and many other great benefits – Ditch Witch offers employees at our Perry, OK location a variety of perks, including:  

• Dress for your day - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, office-plant blended environment. 
• Wellness - In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health, financial health, and other types of resources to every full-time employee. 
• Growth Opportunities – TTC prides itself on giving our employees the chance to grow their careers. Tuition reimbursement, opportunities to move into new areas of interest, and promotion opportunities are a few examples. 
• Competitive Salary – The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. It is not common to be hired at or near the top of the range; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is between ​$78,600-​$112,000​. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. You may be eligible to participate in an incentive program, which rewards employees based on individual and organizational performance. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics. If you need to, you can access your pay early with the dailypay app. 

The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Enterprise Engineering [Bay Area]

Palo Alto, CA | Hybrid

NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products that operationalize AI across enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We partner with other NTT companies (NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, NTT Docomo) to ensure successful deployment to NTT clients. Our clients benefit from AIVista's deep product AI expertise combined with the industry domain and systems integration experience of NTT DATA.

Role Description

AIVista turns foundation models into specialized, governed agents that run mission-critical, regulated enterprise operations. Behind every agent is platform software: services, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines and much of it is shaped by what our customers need.

This is an entry-level role. We hire for strong fundamentals and teach the rest.

AIVista is a service-as-software platform that embeds domain-specific models and agents into customers' real workflows, with governance, observability and agent orchestration built in.

As a Software Engineer, you'll build platform features with and for our customers. You'll join requirement sessions, help turn what a customer needs into a design, write the code, and see it work in their environment. Senior engineers will mentor you and review your work, and you'll own well-defined parts of the platform from design through production.



The role suits someone who wants to learn how enterprise software is built and deployed, and who enjoys working with the people who use it.

Responsibilities

 - Build platform features — design, implement, and test the services, APIs, and integrations that make up the AIVista platform.

 - Work directly with customers — take part in requirement discussions, ask the questions that make requirements precise, demo your work, and help debug integration issues in customer environments.

 - Turn requirements into software — write short designs, break work into steps, and deliver against the requirement, not just the ticket.

 - Own quality — write well-tested, readable code, and learn and apply our production practices.

 - Learn fast — pick up new systems, languages, and customer domains as the work requires.

Representative Projects

 - Build a connector that lets agents read from a customer's system of record, with the authentication and access controls that customer requires.

 - Implement a data pipeline feature a customer asked for, and write the tests that prove their data stays correct.

 - Add the observability a customer needs to trust an agent workflow in production.

 - Fix a performance or reliability problem found during a customer deployment.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Hands-on software experience through internships, research, work, or substantial personal projects.

 - Demonstrated computer science fundamentals in 2 or 3 of the following:

 - data structures and algorithms, including complexity analysis

 - operating systems (processes, memory, concurrency)

 - networking (HTTP, TCP, DNS)

 - databases (SQL, indexing, transactions)

 - Proficiency in Python or another modern language (Go, TypeScript, Java, Rust, or similar). You should be able to write code you'd put your name on.

 - Sound testing and debugging habits. You can find why something is broken, not just that it is.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical work to non-engineers.

 - Interest in working directly with customers. (some travel required)

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience deploying and running software on a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers such as Docker.

 - Projects using LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

 - Internship or project work with real users or external stakeholders.

 - Independent work — open-source contributions, shipped side projects, or technical writing.

Our interviews focus on fundamentals and how you reason through problems, not framework trivia.

You don't need to check every box. If you're excited about this work and confident you can do it, even if your experience doesn't line up with every qualification above, we'd rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out. Strong candidates often bring backgrounds we didn't expect. You will need to be in the office in Palo Alto, CA a minimum of 4 days per week.

Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) plan

 - Significant company HSA contribution

 - Paid holidays and flexible PTO

 - And other benefits

The estimated annual base salary range for this role is $150,000–$200,000 USD. The salary for the successful applicant will depend on job-related factors such as education, training, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future. Total compensation also includes variable pay in the form of an annual target bonus and other cash incentives, with a combined potential of up to 50% of base salary.

NTT DATA AIVista is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Who We Are 

At Moxxi, we’re redefining performance marketing with cutting-edge technology and a relentless focus on results. As a profitable, bootstrapped start-up, we are led by a team of industry veterans in performance marketing, ad tech, and digital publishing. Together, we’re building the premier platform to incubate, scale, and optimize digitally born businesses, setting new standards for data-driven success. 

Our entrepreneurial team brings proven experience from both global corporations and fast-growing startups. We’re passionate about delivering scalable, profitable outcomes for our partners through advanced profiling, targeting, and continuous optimization. Joining Moxxi means becoming part of a growing start-up in the heart of NYC, where you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your career, expand your skill set, and shape the future of performance marketing. 

The Role:

We're looking for a Junior Optimization Analyst to help us turn data into decisions. You'll work across teams—supporting product managers, account managers, and senior analysts—to analyze performance, uncover insights, and drive measurable improvements across Moxxi's portfolio.

This is a foundational analytics role for someone who's energized by the question "what is the data telling us?"—and wants to figure out what to do about it. You'll dig into performance data, support experimentation, build reporting that stakeholders actually use, and help translate findings into action. You'll also collaborate cross-functionally with design and engineering teams, giving you visibility into how insights move from analysis to implementation.

You'll be mentored by experienced team members who will help you sharpen your analytical thinking and learn the rhythms of experimentation, measurement, and iteration. Whether you eventually go deeper into analytics, move into product management, account strategy, or operations, this role will build the foundation. Your work will directly impact the metrics that matter most to the business.

What You'll Do:

Data Analysis & Reporting

• Pull, organize, and analyze performance data from internal tools and platforms

• Build and maintain dashboards that track key growth and optimization metrics

• Prepare clear summaries of what's working, what's not, and what the data suggests we try next

• Spot trends, anomalies, and patterns that inform optimization decisions

• Support senior analysts with data gathering, QA, and visualization tasks

• Develop a strong understanding of the metrics that drive business performance

Optimization & Experimentation Support

• Assist in setting up, monitoring, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments

• Track test performance and flag results that hit significance or show unexpected patterns

• Help document experiment hypotheses, methodologies, and learnings for the team

• Use data to support the prioritization of optimization opportunities

• Identify underperforming areas across funnels, flows, and campaigns and surface them to stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with product managers, account managers, and analysts to understand priorities and how data supports decision-making

• Partner with account managers to connect optimization efforts to client goals and performance

• Support senior analysts in forming and validating hypotheses

• Collaborate with design and engineering teams on implementation of tests and product changes

• Participate in growth meetings, stand-ups, and retrospectives—sharing data-driven observations

Process & Tool Management

• Help maintain documentation for optimization workflows and testing processes

• Support the rollout of new tools, dashboards, or tracking implementations

• Assist with QA for tracking, tagging, and data accuracy

• Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve efficiency (training provided—curiosity required)

Who You Are:

• 0–2 years of experience (or relevant internships) in analytics, marketing, product, operations, or related fields

• Genuinely curious about data—you want to understand what the numbers mean and what to do about them

• Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets—you can wrangle data, build formulas, and create clear summaries

• Detail-oriented with a knack for spotting things that don't look right in a dataset

• Strong communicator who can translate data into plain language and actionable insights

• Eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and ways of working

• Excited about using modern tools—including AI—to work smarter and move faster

Nice to Have:

• Exposure to analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, etc.)

• Basic understanding of experimentation and A/B testing concepts

• Familiarity with SQL or interest in learning it

• Experience with any project management or documentation tools (Notion, Asana, JIRA, etc.)

Why You'll Love This Role:

• Data is central: You'll work with data every day to understand performance and drive decisions

• Optimization is the job: You'll spend your time figuring out how to improve things—not maintaining the status quo

• Broad exposure: Work across product, analytics, account management, design, and engineering to understand how growth actually happens

• Learn from experts: Get mentored by experienced PMs, account managers, and analysts who've built and scaled products

• Career flexibility: Build a foundation that opens doors to analytics, product management, account strategy, operations, or wherever your interests lead

Salary Range
$60,000—$65,000 USD

jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Rendering & Animation team (R&A) builds the graphics engine which renders the canvas for all Figma applications. Our mission is to make rendering performant, feature-rich, reliable, maintainable and extendible across all products & surfaces. The team plays a core, bedrock role for the company because it underpins the technology driving the user experience, touching many other teams, and as such is one of the most impactful areas of Figma.

The R&A team is devoted to hiring individuals with graphics expertise. We are interested in a variety of sub-domains, including 2D GPU-driven rendering, computational geometry & vector graphics, animation frameworks, anti-aliasing algorithms, shader effects, and more recently branching into video/image processing. A PhD Intern specializing in any of these areas would be a phenomenal fit for the team with a lot of exciting projects available.

As an intern on our team, you'll take ownership of a high-impact project at the intersection of your technical strengths and our most pressing graphics, rendering, or media challenges. You'll work closely with your intern manager, team leads, and collaborators across 1–2 partner teams to deliver tangible results within your internship. This is an opportunity to do significant, portfolio-worthy work that directly supplies Figma's visual platform.

This is a 12 or 16-week internship role that can be held from one of our US hubs (San Francisco or New York) starting in May or June of 2027.

What you'll do at Figma:

• Learn from industry graphics engineers and participate as an embedded team member of the Rendering & Animation team

• Collaborate with engineers, PMs, designers, and researchers to scope and execute your work

• Develop, validate, and document solutions from prototypes to production-ready systems

• Drive projects that apply research insights to meaningful product challenges

• Contribute to exciting domain areas; some examples: crafting and optimizing shaders for sophisticated effects, investigating improvements to anti-aliasing algorithms, improving media processing capabilities, animating spline interpolation, and more!

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• Current enrollment as a 4th or 5th year senior PhD student pursuing a PhD in Computer Graphics, Media Processing, or a related field

• Experience working with OpenGL, WebGL, WebGPU, Vulkan or Metal and their respective shader languages (GLSL, WGSL) or other low-level graphics APIs

• Proficiency in either C++ or Rust

• A track record of rigorous problem-solving through academic or applied research, with experience thinking holistically about use cases and the low-level technology required

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

• Demonstrated expertise in computer graphics, supported by publications at conferences such as SIGGRAPH, Eurographics, High Performance Graphics, NVIDIA GTC, or Pacific Graphics

• Proficiency in WebAssembly, web graphics, 2D graphics, performance optimization, animation, geometry, or media

• Interest in art and design applications

• Experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code

• Related industry experience via a past internship or full-time role

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience collaborating across functions

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure

This internship role is based in either Figma’s San Francisco or New York hub offices, and has the hourly base pay rate stated below. Figma also offers interns a housing stipend and travel reimbursement. Figma’s compensation and benefits are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

$74—$74 USD

We're looking for an entry-level Product Owner who is eager to learn, passionate about technology, and excited to help build solutions that make a real difference for customers. You'll work alongside experienced Product Managers, developers, designers, and business stakeholders to help shape products from concept to delivery.

jobs.title: Formal Verification Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
As a Formal Verification Engineer at NVIDIA, you will work in the formal verification team for the industry's leading chips. We are looking for outstanding candidates with knowledge of formal methods. The engineer will own the task of formal verification of RTL units for next generation chip designs. This will involve the candidate having deep knowledge of architectural as well as micro-architectural details of the unit. Ideal candidate must have strong analytical skills, computer architecture background and as well as experience in application of effective verification methodology.

What you will be doing:
• Developing comprehensive FV testplan documents.

• Identifying key behaviors for verification of DUT and creating a verification plan. 

• Developing verification environment including environment assumptions, assertions and cover properties in context of the verification plan. 

• Applying various FV techniques to proof correctness of digital designs.

• Debugging RTL to identify failure scenarios.

• Developing scripts to automate the verification process. 

• Review formal setups and proofs with design and verification teams.

What we need to see:
• BS, MS, or Ph.D. in CS/CE/EE/Mathematics or equivalent experience.

• Strong analytical skills to solve difficult problems.

• Knowledge/Experience in formal verification techniques.

• Strong knowledge of architectures of CPU/GPU designs and digital logic. 

• Understanding of abstraction techniques for effective verification.

• Hands-on experience with HDLs such as Verilog / System Verilog.

• Ability to understand RTL quickly. 

• Understanding of temporal logic assertions. 

• Preferable experience with Formal Verification Tools (eg. Jasper, IFV, SMV, SPIN)

• Excellent communication skills with ability to work with team members and collaborate effectively.

Come, join our Formal Verification team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 116,000 USD - 189,750 USD for Level 2, and 136,000 USD - 218,500 USD for Level 3.

About Us
Rhombus brings video security, access control, and connected sensors together in a single cloud-based platform, helping organizations protect their people and spaces. Our engineering teams build the software and connected devices that make physical security simpler, smarter, and easier to manage.
About the Role
Build something that matters. As a Software Engineering Intern at Rhombus, you’ll work alongside engineers to develop features and solve problems across our cloud platform, web and mobile applications, or embedded device software.
You’ll take ownership of a defined project, collaborate with engineering and product teammates, and gain experience moving an idea through design, development, testing, and delivery. Your project will align with your interests, skills, and team priorities, with guidance and feedback throughout the internship.
We welcome candidates interested in backend, frontend, mobile, or embedded engineering. You don’t need experience in every area to apply.
Engineering Areas
Depending on your interests, experience, and team priorities, your project may focus on one or more of these areas:
Backend: Build APIs, services, and data workflows that connect devices to our cloud platform. Familiarity with databases, cloud services, Python, Go, or Java is a plus.
Frontend: Develop responsive web interfaces, reusable components, and intuitive customer workflows. Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and modern web frameworks is a plus.
Mobile: Build and improve iOS or Android features, integrate backend APIs, and enhance usability and reliability. Familiarity with Swift/iOS, Kotlin/Android, or cross-platform mobile development is a plus.
Embedded: Develop and test device software or firmware, explore hardware–software interactions, and improve device performance. Familiarity with C/C++, Linux, microcontrollers, device interfaces, or hardware debugging is a plus.

What You'll Do
• Develop a scoped engineering project that contributes to Rhombus products or the systems behind them.

• Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions.

• Write readable, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and incorporate feedback from teammates.

• Test and debug your work, with attention to reliability, performance, security, and the user experience.

• Document your approach, communicate progress, and present your results and learnings at the end of the program.
What You Bring
• Ability to work at Rhombus HQ during Summer 2027 (June-August).

• Actively pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar technical field of study and graduating by June 2028.

• A foundation in programming, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.

• Experience using at least one programming language through coursework, personal projects, research, or a previous internship.

• Evidence of something you’ve built, tested, or improved—and the ability to explain your approach.

• Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to ask questions, learn new tools, and act on feedback.

• Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with teammates.

• Prior professional internship experience is preferred.

• Prior internship experience developing and launching product is a plus.
What You’ll Gain
• Ownership of a meaningful project with clear goals and tangible outcomes.

• Mentorship, code reviews, and practical feedback from experienced engineers.

• Exposure to how engineering, product, design, and hardware teams build connected products.

• Experience balancing technical decisions with customer needs.

• A final project presentation that demonstrates your work and growth.
Location
This is a full-time (40 hours/week) onsite position based out at our HQ in Sacramento, CA. Candidates must be able to commute to the office 5 days per week.
Compensation
The hourly pay range for this internship is $25–$30, based on relevant skills and experience.
What We Value
Customers Come First: We're obsessed with improving our users' lives and constantly question how we can improve upon what already exists.
One Team: Innovating in the physical security industry can't be accomplished by just a single person, which is why we collaborate with exceptional individuals who inspire us to be our best.
Think Greater: We believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to create an open environment where individuals can contribute and make an impact.
Act with Integrity: We believe honest communication is key to success. We conduct business the way it should be - with high ethical standards and to always do what's right.
Rhombus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. We actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in our hiring practices and throughout our organization.

jobs.title: Design Verification Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Design Verification Engineer Intern

Astera Labs · San Jose, CA · Internship · On-site

About Astera Labs

Astera Labs builds connectivity solutions that help power modern AI infrastructure. Our Hardware Engineering teams design and validate high-performance products that connect processors, accelerators, memory, and network fabrics.

The opportunity

Join the Design Verification team and help validate digital designs before and after silicon. You’ll learn the team’s verification flow, develop and run tests, analyze simulations and waveforms, and contribute to the regressions and coverage that help ensure products behave as intended.

This internship is designed for someone who enjoys understanding how a design should work, creating experiments that exercise it, and investigating the evidence when results differ from expectations. You’ll work with experienced verification and design engineers on a meaningful project with visible product impact, while building practical skills in digital design verification and semiconductor development.

What you’ll do

• 
Learn the product domain, assigned project, verification environment, test flow, and tools needed to contribute effectively.

• 
Read specifications and design documentation to understand functionality, interfaces, corner cases, and verification requirements.

• 
Develop or extend simulation tests and verification components under engineering guidance, using SystemVerilog, UVM-style methodologies, Python, or related tools.

• 
Run simulations and regressions in a Linux environment using the team’s submission scripts, workspace setup, and test definitions.

• 
Analyze test logs, errors, assertions, and simulation output to identify failures and determine whether the issue is in the test, environment, design, or infrastructure.

• 
Use waveform-debug tools such as Verdi or DVE to inspect signal behavior and explain the sequence of events leading to a failure.

• 
Add or update tests, test definitions, regression lists, manifests, and supporting scripts to improve coverage and confidence in the design.

• 
Review coverage results and help identify meaningful gaps in functional or code coverage.

• 
Collaborate with design, firmware, validation, and other engineering teams to communicate findings, reproduce issues, and track corrective actions.

• 
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, issue tracking, documentation, and project planning.

• 
Take ownership of an assigned verification project, deliver the work in a usable state, and explain what was verified and how it supported the product flow.

• 
Present your project, results, and key learnings at the end of the internship.

What you bring

• 
Coursework, projects, research, or hands-on experience in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.

• 
Foundational understanding of digital logic, computer architecture, RTL, hardware interfaces, or software development.

• 
Programming experience in one or more of SystemVerilog, Verilog, Python, C, C++, or a comparable language.

• 
Curiosity about how complex digital designs work and a methodical approach to testing assumptions and debugging failures.

• 
Comfort learning in a Linux environment and working with source control, command-line tools, and technical documentation.

• 
Ability to organize priorities, ask focused questions, take ownership of deliverables, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.

• 
Persistence, learning agility, and a collaborative mindset in an environment where verification work requires iteration and investigation.

Helpful experience

• 
SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained-random testing, assertions, scoreboards, monitors, drivers, or functional coverage.

• 
RTL design or verification using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or similar hardware description languages.

• 
Simulation and waveform-debug tools such as VCS, Verdi, DVE, or related EDA tools.

• 
Python or shell scripting for test generation, regression management, log parsing, or data analysis.

• 
Familiarity with simulation regressions, test manifests, coverage databases, or CI/test infrastructure.

• 
Exposure to PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, SERDES, memory systems, SoC design, or other high-speed connectivity technologies.

• 
Git, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools for collaborative engineering workflows.

Internship experience and compensation

This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.

Equal opportunity

Astera Labs is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We value diverse perspectives and consider qualified candidates without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Astera Labs is seeking a motivated Digital RTL Design Intern to join our San Jose design team. This internship offers hands-on experience in digital logic design and RTL development for high-performance connectivity and networking ASICs.

You will work closely with experienced architects and design engineers to translate design specifications into synthesizable RTL, develop and debug digital logic, and contribute to the design and integration of complex ASICs. You will collaborate with verification, synthesis, physical design, and other cross-functional teams throughout the ASIC development process.

RTL design and implementation

• 
Develop and maintain synthesizable Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL for digital ASIC blocks and subsystems under the guidance of experienced engineers.

Translate design specifications into digital logic, including datapaths, control logic, finite state machines, counters, register interfaces, and other functional blocks.

• 
Implement, modify, and integrate RTL modules following established design and coding guidelines.

• 
Participate in RTL code reviews and contribute to design quality, readability, reusability, and maintainability.

• 
Debug RTL functionality and assist with resolving design and integration issues.

• 
Learn and apply digital design best practices for performance, power, and area optimization.

Assist with identifying corner cases and resolving functional issues discovered during simulation.

Support RTL lint checks and other design-quality checks.

Develop familiarity with verification methodologies, SystemVerilog assertions, and regression-based testing.

Review basic synthesis and timing reports to understand how RTL coding decisions affect hardware implementation.

Support RTL integration and design-readiness activities throughout the development cycle.

Learn industry-standard EDA tools and methodologies used in digital ASIC design.

Document design functionality, debugging results, and technical issues.

Familiarity with Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or other scripting languages.

• 
Interest in high-performance ASICs, networking, data-center infrastructure, or AI and cloud computing.

jobs.title: Data Scientist 1
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

DATA SCIENTIST I – OPTICAL, PHYSICS, AND MATH 

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Data Scientist I for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will have an opportunity to support Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture by modelling, simulation, prototyping, and characterization of advanced EO/IR payloads that support national defense space missions.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO

• Guide/author data collection and analysis software

• Analyze and assess payload calibration data

• Shadow algorithm development SME

• Collaborate closely with firmware development, electronics interface control, and optical teams

• Use excellent investigative and trouble-shooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions in the lab and in the field

• Communicate effectively with project management, customers, and team members across disciplines

• Attend technical interchange meetings with team members and other project personnel, and represent the organization in matters pertaining to the development of projects

• Provide status on assigned tasks and program schedules

• Review documents and resolve technical engineering and integration issues

• Manage time and resources to meet assigned deadlines

• Develop detection and calibration algorithms for optical systems throughout their product lifecycle

• Simulate all parts of the electro-optical payloads: radiometric, detector, optical prescriptions

• Be a self-starter who takes initiatives, identifies problems and presents solutions

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A DATA SCIENTIST I:

• Bachelor’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Math, or related field.

• Ability to obtain security clearance

• Experience in optical systems development, performance modeling, and/or data analysis

• Strong data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

• Working knowledge of MATLAB, python, C/C++

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Master’s or PhD preferred.

• Experience with EO/IR payloads, infrared focal planes, or space-based sensor systems

• Experience writing alignment procedures, test scripts, and verification plans

• Experience with automated test equipment or optical STE

• Active TS/SCI U.S. Government Security Clearance

• Hands-on experience with optical alignment, metrology, interferometry, and imaging-system characterization

• Hands-on expertise with electro-optical systems, imaging systems, light sources, and/or military/space payloads

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.
WHAT TO EXPECT 

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. 

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Department

• Gather requirements

• Partner with your team lead to produce clean, effective, on-brand user experiences

• Implement designs with a high level of fidelity 

• Research design patterns and propose technical solutions to common web UI/UX problems

• Coding, testing, and deploying modern web apps

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Experience with JS/HTML/CSS and at least one framework such as React, Vue, etc

• Working knowledge in at least one server side language, such as Ruby, Python, Golang, etc

• Experience using SQL to update and retrieve data

• Experience with database management and security a plus

• Strong analytical and communication skills

• Ability to adapt to a fast-paced work environment

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Technologies Used

• JS, TS, Vue 3, Vite, PostCSS, Playwright, Node, Fastify, Golang, Mysql, AWS, Git

jobs.title: Data Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Apply early for priority consideration. Gallup has limited openings for this internship, and the position will be filled quickly.

As a data engineering intern at Gallup, you’ll help build and modernize the data tools, infrastructure and pipelines that enable teams to work with data at scale. Alongside experienced technical leaders, you’ll put your Python and SQL skills to work on meaningful projects while learning best practices, experimenting with modern tools and seeing firsthand how strong data engineering supports better decisions.

What You’ll Do 

During your internship, you will:

• Build foundational data tooling and infrastructure designed to scale as the volume and frequency of data grow

• Help modernize legacy data pipelines using Python, SQL and Gallup’s evolving data platform

• Troubleshoot data quality issues in large, imperfect datasets

• Apply data engineering practices to move, transform and validate data across systems

• Help build reliable, efficient data workflows

• Learn from senior technical leaders who will mentor you on engineering practices, tools and approaches

• Collaborate with engineers and interact directly with stakeholders to understand needs and deliver useful solutions

• Use AI-enabled development tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work

What You Need 

• Enrollment in an associate, bachelor’s or graduate degree program in computer science, data engineering, information systems, statistics, math or a related field required

• Classroom or work experience writing SQL required, including joins, aggregations and troubleshooting query performance

• Classroom or work experience coding in Python for data processing, scripting or automation required

• Working knowledge of relational database and data modeling concepts, including schema design and dimensional or star-schema modeling, required

• Comfort using AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to support high-quality, efficient work required

• Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and how data are moved, transformed and validated between source systems and a warehouse preferred

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and warehouses (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, Redshift) preferred

• Exposure to pipeline orchestration or transformation tooling such as Apache Airflow, dbt or Apache Spark preferred

• Familiarity with version control and collaborative development using Git or GitHub preferred

• Enrollment at a college or university within an 80-mile radius of San Francisco, California, required

• Anticipated graduation between August 2027 and May 2028 preferred

• Availability to work 40 hours per week for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027 required

• A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s San Francisco office Monday through Thursday required, with the option to work remotely on Friday

• Eligibility to work in the United States required; this position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship

What We Offer

• A full-time summer 2027 internship that pays $45 to $50 per hour

• The potential to work up to 20 hours per week during the school year, depending on business demands

• The potential for a full-time job offer upon graduation, based on Gallup’s business needs and intern performance

What You’ll Experience

• Mission-driven work: Make a meaningful difference in the world through work that applies science and technology to important human and organizational problems.

• An empowering culture: Collaborate with smart, passionate people who welcome your ideas, perspectives and technical judgment.

• Learning and development: Grow your skills through hands-on research, experimentation and exposure to AI systems, extensive data and engineering challenges.

• Room to challenge assumptions: Work in an environment where curiosity, rigorous thinking and questioning existing approaches are expected.

• Brand strength, startup energy: Work on emerging technology in a fast-moving environment backed by Gallup’s research, science and global brand.

• A vibrant workplace: Work from Gallup’s San Francisco office in the heart of the Financial District, steps from the Embarcadero and public transit.

Our teams produce great work together, inspire each other to deliver exceptional outcomes, grow their potential and celebrate each other along the way. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.

jobs.title: Internal Communications, GTM
locations: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking an Internal Communications Manager to serve as a dedicated communications partner to our go-to-market (GTM) organization – the teams responsible for selling and diffusing Claude into enterprises around the world. 

Internal communications at Anthropic is not a support function that plans meetings and sends newsletters. The best people in this role operate like advisors who embed themselves deeply in the orgs they support, earn a seat at the leadership table, write on behalf of executives, and see around corners, anticipating what the organization will need to hear before anyone asks for it. There are traditional elements to the role too, like all-hands planning and org change announcements, and you'll run those with operational excellence. 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or NYC. 

Responsibilities

• Own the internal communications strategy for your portfolio within GTM, becoming an expert in the team's work and a trusted member of its leadership support team

• Serve as an advisor to our Chief Commercial Officer and their team - helping them think through what to say and when, draft communications in their voice, and give them expert counsel

• People manage a small team (one/two directs), supporting the global GTM org 

• Translate complex sales strategy and customer stories into narratives that land with employees across every function 

• Anticipate communications needs before they arrive (e.g. launches, customer wins, organizational change, moments of external attention) and have a plan ready for how we’ll bring employees along

• Design and implement strategies to boost signal and reduce noise, so employees know what's important and what it means for them

• Plan and execute internal fora like all-hands and AMAs with operational excellence

• Partner closely with the broader internal communications team to ensure updates are accurately and consistently cascaded across existing channels and live forums

You may be a good fit if you

• Are an exceptional writer with a particular talent for distilling complex concepts into plain English, with a nose for great storytelling

• Have served as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and know how to build those relationships: when to push, when to listen, and how to deliver a recommendation even when it’s something an exec may not want to hear

• See the big picture and are able to connect individual team updates to company strategy and mission

• Have a keen eye for organizational culture and can recognize authentic moments worth amplifying

Strong candidates may also

• Have 15+ years of experience in communications or an adjacent craft where you learned to make complex, high-stakes material clear under pressure (e.g journalism, speechwriting, chief of staff work, strategy and operations)

• Have worked at AI companies, frontier tech companies, or other organizations where the work moves faster than most people can follow

• Have built or run internal communications programs during periods of rapid organizational growth

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$295,000—$345,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: R&D Firmware Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About the role 
 Our R&D engineers develop implant products for the Active Implantable Systems (AIS) group. This team builds technologies to monitor, diagnose, and treat heart conditions like irregular rhythms, heart failure, and sudden cardiac arrest. You will work within this division to help create solutions that address clinical needs and improve patient care. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to develop software tools and solutions. 
 Contribute to embedded firmware design and implementation for AIS technologies. 
 Write and maintain code using C++, C#, and Python. 
 Support wireless communication features, including Bluetooth and socket programming, for real-time data exchange. 
 Engage in cybersecurity-focused development to maintain data integrity. 
 Explore the use of artificial intelligence in medical device applications. 
 Identify and solve technical challenges related to device functionality, data flow, and system integration. 
 Ensure all engineering solutions meet clinical needs, regulatory standards, and patient safety requirements. 
 Participate in Agile development processes. 
 
 What you'll need 
 
 Current status as a rising junior or rising senior, or a student working toward a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering. 
 Proficiency in Python, C, C++, and C#. 
 Familiarity with Agile methodologies. 
 Ability to communicate effectively with diverse teams and a desire to learn new technologies.
