To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Sales
Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Start Date: December 7, 2026 or January 4, 2027
Relocation is not provided for this opportunity.

The Experience
As a Business Development Associate at Salesforce, you aren’t just starting a career in sales. You are joining the #1 AI CRM to redefine how business is done. This role is a unique hybrid of active sales development and operational excellence. You will serve as the engine of our SMB (Small & Medium Business) team, tasked with both proactively hunting new business through targeted outbound prospecting and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to streamline workflows. You will be the operational backbone of the team, using data-driven insights to refine our outreach strategies while building the foundational skills to become a world-class Sales Development Representative.

The Salesforce Business Development Associate Program is a fast-track, high-impact initiative. You will work at the intersection of human creativity and Agentic AI, mastering our Customer 360 platform to identify high-value opportunities, optimize lead flows, and drive scalable growth for our customers.

Career Acceleration: Successful completion of this 3-5 month program positions you to advance to the Sales Development Representative role, equipped with a technical and operational edge that sets you apart in the industry.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing
• Pipeline Development: Qualify inbound and outbound leads via phone outreach to prioritize high-potential SMB opportunities.
• Strategic Prospecting: Master the art of the hunt by identifying SMB prospects and executing personalized outreach. You’ll be supported by proven playbooks and tools, with an expectation to provide input on what’s working to help us continuously sharpen our approach.
• Operations & Process Optimization: Drive organizational efficiency by maintaining Salesforce data integrity and deploying AI-powered insights to streamline workflows, improve pipeline hygiene, and scale sales productivity.

You’re Our Person If...
• Sales & Career Ready: Not just interested in sales but hungry for it. Passionate about mastering the #1 AI CRM and building a long-term career in professional sales. Previous internship or work experience in sales is a plus!
• Resilient and Goal Oriented: Energized by achieving/exceeding targets and KPIs, displays a high level of accountability, and brings unstoppable energy and resilience to every challenge along the way.
• Operational Problem Solver: A natural ability to break down complex challenges and develop efficient step by step technical solutions.
• Effective Communicator: Strong verbal and written skills with the ability to convey complex value propositions clearly and professionally.
• Growth Mindset: A self motivated learner who is eager to master the tools and skills required to progress into a full cycle sales role.

Why Salesforce:
• Hands-on Experience: Gain real-world experience in lead qualification and customer profiling while serving as the operational backbone of the team. You will balance direct prospect engagement with critical business operations, ensuring our systems run at peak efficiency while you develop the core sales skills needed for your next career step.
• Growth Trajectory: Build your foundation on the #1 AI CRM. You will develop the technical and operational fluency that serves as a launchpad for your career at Salesforce. This role provides the blueprint to grow into a high-impact sales career.
• Community: Join a team built on Trust and Innovation. We prioritize continuous mentorship and collaborative problem-solving, ensuring you have the support to bring your full self to work while making a tangible impact on how businesses grow.

This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: SoC Software Engineer – New College Graduate 2026
jobs.description:
We are looking for a New College Graduate SoC Software Engineer to help shape the future of accelerated computing within SOC/Data Center/Automotive/Embedded. Imagine developing foundational technology for tomorrow’s AI factories, next-generation data centers, self driving cars and autonomous robots—and even data centers in space. You will join a world-class team building and maintaining software for complex heterogeneous computing systems that power groundbreaking AI, HPC, and accelerated computing workloads. Your work will span hardware, firmware, operating systems, and applications as you help bring sophisticated products from early silicon through deployment.

This is an opportunity to learn from some of the best engineers in the world while solving meaningful system-level challenges. If you are a creative software engineer who enjoys low-level technology, tackling difficult problems, and turning new ideas into working products, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll be doing:
• Design and develop SoC software, validation solutions, and test frameworks for CPU, SoC, and GPU-based platforms. Your work may span user space, the kernel, firmware, and SoC boot software.
• Build next-generation system validation and reliability software that supports the journey from virtual prototypes and first silicon to production-ready hardware, large-scale deployment, and rapid failure resolution.
• Contribute to system software architecture and collaborate with internal teams to integrate new capabilities across the software stack.
• Work closely with architecture, ASIC, firmware, platform, and new product introduction teams to understand requirements and bring new computing platforms to life.
• Investigate challenging hardware and software issues, develop creative solutions, and improve the performance, reliability, power efficiency, and serviceability of our platforms.
• Explore emerging technologies and industry standards, then apply what you learn to solve real-world engineering problems.

What we need to see:
• Pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
• Strong C or C++ programming skills and an understanding of object-oriented design.
• Familiarity with low-level systems software, device drivers and understanding of OS and computer architecture.
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with curiosity about how hardware and software work together.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Knowledge of Linux systems or kernel internals.
• Understanding of server, PC, embedded, or other complex computing architectures.
• Experience with SoC development, pre-silicon environments, silicon bring-up, or hardware validation through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.
• Experience contributing to a team software project, open-source project, technical competition, or substantial personal project.
• Exposure to AI, automation, or data-driven techniques for accelerating validation, analyzing failures, or improving system reliability.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 108,000 USD - 178,250 USD for Level 1, and 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 2.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. 
 
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:
The Dexcom R&D Electronics Team is a group of highly motivated and talented engineers with a wide range of experience and talents. This team designs high volume medical wearables, so our focuses are on high volume, low power, battery operated, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication, pico-Amp sensing technologies that meet the high bar of medical device standards. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Gap Year
jobs.description:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy.  With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

 

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

Netic’s Gap Year Software Engineers join our product team for a year to build the features that put AI in the hands of real businesses. This role is for college students who want to take a year off school to work full-time as an engineer, combining technical excellence with customer empathy to craft products that make complex AI feel simple and deliver immediate value to essential service industries.

Gap Year engineers are full-time employees, not interns. You’ll earn a full salary and equity, have a dedicated mentor, and we’ll cover room and board in an apartment next to our office in San Francisco or New York. The program is modeled on our first Gap Year engineer, who took a year off from Harvard to own products used by real customers, work on-site with them, and meet our board and investors before returning to finish his degree.

If you want to start a company someday, this is the year to learn how. You’ll see up close how a fast-growing startup wins customers, ships product, makes hard decisions, and builds a team. You’ll also leave with relationships with the investors, founders, operators, and teammates who can advise you, back you, or co-found with you when it’s your turn.

We need to hire multiple Gap Year engineers who are currently enrolled in college and can commit to 12 months full-time. We hire on a rolling basis, and start dates are flexible.



What You’ll Do:

 - Build agentic products: Design, code, and ship full-stack features for Netic’s AI platform.

 - Co‑create with customers: Work closely with our customers, including on-site, to understand workflows, gather feedback, and turn pain points into features that stick.

 - Own end‑to‑end delivery: Drive projects from spec to production, handling data models, APIs, front‑end polish, and post‑launch iteration.

 - Ensure quality: Build, test, and monitor features in production to ensure reliability and performance.

 - Learn how a company is built: Sit in on sales calls and leadership meetings to see how a fast-growing startup wins customers, makes decisions, and builds a team.

 - Build your founder network: Get to know our board, investors, and leaders across tech—people who can advise you, back you, or build with you when you start your own company.



What You’ll Bring:

 - Proven builder: You’ve shipped real projects end-to-end, whether through school, internships, hackathons, or on your own.

 - Full‑stack foundations: Comfortable with React, TypeScript, and Python, or ready to pick them up fast.

 - AI experience (nice‑to‑have): Hands‑on with LLM APIs, embeddings, or RAG patterns—or hunger to learn fast.

 - Customer empathy: You care about the people who use what you build and want to work with them directly.

 - Founder‑level ambition: You want to start a company one day and want to learn how great companies are built first.

 - Excellent communicator: Able to explain technical trade‑offs to engineers and product decisions to customers.



Program Details:

 - Duration: 12 months, full-time, in person in San Francisco or New York.

 - Eligibility: Currently enrolled in college and able to take a full year off before returning to finish your degree.

 - Compensation: Full-time base salary and equity. [Salary range]

 - Housing: Room and board fully covered, in an apartment next to our office.

What brings us together is our commitment to:

 - Live to build

 - Run through walls and win

 - Obsess over customers in each line of code

 - Lose sleep over the "almost perfect"

 - Show internal locus of control

 - Prioritize finesse: refinement of first principles thinking, execution, and craftsmanship

jobs.title: ASIC/FPGA Verification Engineer – Or Lead - Associate - Experienced
jobs.description:
ASIC/FPGA Verification Engineer - (Associate, Experienced, or Lead) - SoCal

Company:
The Boeing Company

Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems has an exciting opportunity for multiple ASIC/FPGA Verification Engineers (Associate, Experienced, or Lead) to join us as part of our Boeing Electronic Products team in either El Segundo or Huntington Beach, CA
From complex digitally beamformed phased arrays for constellation satellite programs to computing and networking equipment for commercial airplanes, the Boeing Electronic Products group develops ASICs and FPGAs that are at the heart of Boeing’s products!
We leverage leading-edge technology and work with world-class partners to provide some of the most complex SoCs in the world. We develop robust, high-performance custom processors using the latest ARM IP to enable high-integrity, low SWAP-C flight computers. And we're applying the latest digital IC design processes with industry-best tools to enable applications that cut across every domain at Boeing.

Our diverse development portfolio provides opportunities to learn with exposure to the breadth of the Boeing product line – approximately half our design/verification work is within the Space & Launch business unit, and half is from other parts of Boeing (AvionX; Missiles & Weapons; Strike, Surveillance and Mobility; and Autonomous Systems).

As an ASIC/FPGA Verification Engineer on the Boeing Electronic Products team you will develop state-of-the-art digital ICs/SoCs to support the most critical programs across the enterprise. We collaborate with other electronics groups across the company and around the world and support ASIC/FPGA design and verification for electronics that we build in El Segundo and for units designed at other sites.

Position Responsibilities:
• Design and implement an ASIC/FPGA verification environment utilizing UVM & System Verilog.

• Develop self-checking and reusable test benches from the ground up, employing Object-Oriented Programming principles such as Inheritance and Polymorphism, while utilizing UVM to build drivers, monitors, predictors, and scoreboards.

• Create Functional Coverage Models and conduct Code Coverage analysis to ensure thorough verification of designs during simulation.

• Set up regression tests and collect coverage metrics to ensure comprehensive verification and track progress over time.

• Assist in FPGA-based prototyping and validation based on program and system requirements and complexity.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that verification strategies align with overall project goals and timelines.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):
• A Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (specializing in Electrical, Mechanical, or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or equivalent non-US qualifications relevant to the job description

• Proven experience in ASIC/FPGA verification processes

• Familiarity with defining the architectural framework for ASIC/FPGA verification using SystemVerilog/UVM, including the delivery and release of production designs

• Proficiency in hardware verification languages, particularly SystemVerilog and SystemVerilog Assertions

• Demonstrated experience in implementing test plans effectively

• Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles, such as Inheritance and Polymorphism

• Capability to design self-checking and reusable testbenches from the ground up

• Experience in developing Functional Coverage Models and achieving Code Coverage closure

• Capable of collaborating with design and system engineering to establish accurate and verifiable ASIC/FPGA level specifications

• Familiarity with waveform debug tools

• Revision Control Systems: svn, cvs, git

• Proficient in Linux Environments

• Experienced, Level 3: 5+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Lead, Level 4: 10+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Master's Degree in EE, Computer Engineering/Science, or related field, or equivalent experience

• Experience with hardware-based integration and test of ASIC/FPGA designs

• Experience with hardware emulators, especially Palladium

• Experience with high-speed Serdes interfaces (JESD204C, PCIe, Ethernet)

• Proficient in scripting languages: Make, Perl, Python, etc.

• Familiarity with space-based design techniques and radiation mitigation

• Demonstrated history of 1st pass success with ASIC designs

Typical Education/Experience: 
Associate, Level 2: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), computer science, engineering data science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 2 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience or non-US equivalent qualifications. In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

jobs.title: Analog/Mixed Signal System Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Analog/Mixed-Signal System Test Engineer (NCG)

Job Description

As an Analog/Mixed-Signal System Test Engineer, you will join a key team developing sophisticated advanced-node CMOS products. You will help validate circuits such as PLLs, DLLs, ADCs, regulators, amplifiers, transmitters, receivers, and CDRs for electrical and optical interconnects against performance targets.

This role is designed for a highly motivated early-career engineer who can apply strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals to lab bring-up, characterization, automation, data analysis, and debugging. You will work independently on defined technical problems while collaborating closely with experienced designers, validation engineers, and cross-functional partners.

Basic Qualifications

• 
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, completed or expected by the start date.

• 
Master’s or PhD training in Electrical Engineering is preferred.

• 
Strong fundamentals in transistor-level analog design, feedback and stability analysis, and noise and jitter analysis.

• 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

Desired Experience

• 
Hands-on experience through research, projects, internships, or coursework designing or validating high-speed mixed-signal circuits, including ADC/DAC data converters, RX front ends, TX drivers or serializers, low-jitter PLLs, TX/RX calibration, low-jitter clock distribution, or other high-speed analog circuits.

• 
Experience with lab chip bring-up, automation, data collection, data analysis, and debugging.

• 
Experience using lab equipment such as UXR oscilloscopes, DCA instruments, VNAs, PNAs, BERTs, or comparable measurement equipment.

• 
Strong programming or scripting ability in Python, MATLAB, C, or comparable languages.

• 
Design and tapeout experience in advanced CMOS nodes, such as 20 nm or newer, is a plus.

• 
Knowledge of optical transceivers, TIA design, and optical application drivers is highly desirable.

• 
Experience with PCB design is a plus.

• 
Familiarity with Verilog RTL or DSP design concepts is a plus.

• 
Relevant research publications or patents in analog or RF IC design are a plus.

• 
Demonstrated ability to work as an independent technical contributor, drive results, and collaborate effectively with a broader engineering team.

• 
Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

What You’ll Do

• 
Develop and execute system-test and validation activities for advanced-node CMOS products and high-speed electrical or optical interconnect circuits.

• 
Bring up lab silicon, automate measurements, collect and analyze data, and debug performance issues to help determine root causes.

• 
Characterize circuit behavior using appropriate laboratory equipment and measurement methods.

• 
Build or improve Python, MATLAB, C, or similar scripts for test automation, data reduction, visualization, and repeatable analysis.

• 
Partner with circuit designers and validation teams to translate performance targets into test plans, experiments, and actionable findings.

• 
Document test methods, results, limitations, and recommendations in clear technical reports and presentations.

• 
Contribute to debugging and improvement of mixed-signal systems while balancing measurement quality, schedule, and technical risk.

• 
Share knowledge, participate in design and validation reviews, and help establish effective laboratory and documentation practices.

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

The base range for this role is between $150k - $175k annually

This is a temporary, onsite internship located in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Relocation assistance is not available.
 
Who we are:
At LMCU, you'll find more than just a job - discover a fulfilling career where your contributions truly matter. Join our talented team at Lake Michigan Credit Union and discover the difference an employer who puts people first can make in your career and life.

About this position: 
The Business Intelligence Analyst Internship offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience designing and delivering analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across LMCU. This role is ideal for students passionate about transforming data into meaningful insights through modern reporting and visualization tools. Interns will work closely with our Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to develop semantic models, create interactive visualizations, and support self-service analytics initiatives using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. 
 
What you’ll do: 
• Develop Semantic Models: Assist in designing, building, and maintaining semantic models within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI to provide trusted, scalable, and reusable datasets for enterprise reporting and self-service analytics. 
• Create Reports and Visualizations: Develop interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help business users understand performance, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions. 
• Enable Self-Service Analytics: Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver intuitive analytics solutions that empower users to explore data independently and responsibly. 
• Ensure Data Quality and Governance: Apply data governance standards, validation processes, and documentation practices to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting assets and semantic models. 
• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Data Governance teams to align reporting solutions with enterprise data strategy, governance policies, and business objectives. 
• Contribute to Innovation: Explore emerging capabilities within Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and analytics technologies to recommend improvements that enhance usability, scalability, and performance. 
• Adhere to and champion our core values of curious minds, collaborative hearts, and continuous excellence
• Must comply with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, the Patriot Act, and the Office of Foreign Assets Control.

What you’ll bring:
• College student freshman, sophomore, junior, senior or master level status or a recent college graduate within the last 3 months currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. 
• 3.0 GPA or greater.
• Proficiency in SQL for data querying, analysis, and validation. 
• Experience with DAX, Power Query, or data transformation techniques is a plus. 
• Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Excel, and version control tools such as Git is a plus. 
• Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI semantic models, or cloud-based analytics platforms is preferred. 
• Familiarity with Power BI and data visualization concepts. 
• Understanding of data modeling, dimensional modeling, and semantic layer concepts. 
• Knowledge of data governance principles and data quality practices is beneficial. 
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights.

At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team. 
 
What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry? 
 
GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind!  Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters. Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following: 
 
• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients.  
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge.  
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion. 
• Interact with GDIT leaders. 
• Participate in professional development. 
 
How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own 
 
GDIT is seeking a talented Software Developer who is passionate about technology and software applications. This individual must be motivated to deliver innovative capabilities that directly impact some of GDIT’s most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the country. 
 
A Day in the Life 
 
• Assist in researching, designing, developing, and/or modifying enterprise-wide systems and/or software applications. 
• Assist in designing and coding software components, units, and modules that meet product specifications and development schedules. 
• Assist in performing systems modeling, simulation, and analysis. 
• Assist in testing and debugging assigned components and units. 
• Participates in large system and subsystem planning. 
• Collaborate with hardware engineers on machine characteristics that affect software systems and work with them to resolve incompatibilities working closely with supervision, software development team and customer support team.
• Create and modify new and/or existing technical documentation such as user manuals, system documentation, and training materials. 
• Troubleshoot problems and provide customer support for software operating systems and application issues. 
• Maintain current knowledge of relevant technology as assigned. 
• Participate in special projects as required. 
 
The Must-Haves 
 
• Currently enrolled in an associate's, bachelor's or master's degree program in computer science, IT, engineering, or other STEM field from a United States-based college or university. 
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, and Teams)
• Desire to learn new software languages and technologies. 
 
What You’ll Need to Deliver Your Best Every Day 
 
• Strong communication skills. 
• Ability to build meaningful relationships with managers and members of your team in a remote environment. 
• Be self-aware enough to identify and correct your mistakes, and not be afraid to ask for help when needed.
• Prioritize tasks and responsibilities. 
• Be active in seeking out ways to develop yourself and gain new knowledge personally and professionally. 
• Intuitiveness with an ability to identify and solve complex problems related to rapidly changing technology.  
• A sense of genuine, intellectual curiosity and a nimble mindset 
 
What Will Make You a Stand-Out Candidate 
 
• Understanding of automation technologies 
• Understanding of software development best practices 
• Understanding of ITSM concepts 
 
GDIT interns are paid and full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks. Applicants should have a minimum of one semester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. Take the first step and apply today! 
 
Note: We receive a high volume of applications and review them on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks of your application.

Job Description:
Job description: 
The Associate Software Engineer Student will join the Contact Centre Innovation & Operations (CCIO) team, helping design and deliver innovative solutions that improve the employee and client experience. Working alongside engineers, product owners, AI specialists, and operations teams, the student will contribute to initiatives involving Generative AI, virtual agents, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, contact centre technologies, and digital employee experience solutions.

Preferred skills: 
• Curious mindset and passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and tools.
• Comfortable working in a collaborative Agile team environment.
• Self-motivated with the ability to take ownership of assigned work.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

jobs.title: Canada Indigenous Technology Apprentice - Fnim
jobs.description:
We are:
Accenture Technology, the people who deliver the services and solutions that power our clients’ businesses. We are technology rainmakers, movers and shakers. Every day, we imagine the impossible and enjoy the thrill of making it happen. We help clients tackle their biggest business problems and unlock growth potential in the cloud. Through Agile methods, we turn the New into reality at speed. We partner with key tech players, like Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP and Workday and together, deliver bigger and better results. We see ourselves as a culture of cultures, teaming up from delivery centers and client sites around the world. Ready to learn as much as you can? Because we'll give you numerous opportunities from informal training sessions to courses and certifications to keep your tech smarts sharp.
 
You are:
Ready for on-the-job training. You have always enjoyed learning new things and you’re excited to get hands-on experience in an innovative workplace.
 
About the Indigenous (FNIM) apprenticeship:
• An “earn and learn” program designed with and for FNIM peoples offering.
o Salary, training, and meaningful real-world experience in a supportive environment
o Personalized coaching to help you build your skills at the entry-level position and advance your career
o A strong community and network of FNIM buddies (mentors), peers, and role models.
• A full-time, year-long position with an opportunity to continue with us at the end of the program, supporting your ongoing growth, and success.
 
· Either you a have a high-school diploma, GED/ equivalent or an associate’s degree (without a bachelor’s degree)
 
· You are looking to start a new career journey, even if your previous experience is in a completely different field
 
We honor and value the unique identities, histories, and strengths of FNIM peoples, and welcome you to bring your whole self and your community’s knowledge to our team.
 
The work:
• Develop technology solutions that make a difference to business, society, and the environment
• Join a diverse and inclusive team, filled with different Accenture teammates from around the world
• Learn programming skills to build portions of applications that solve our client's business and IT challenges
• Actively work in delivering large IT solutions to clients on time and within budget
• Learn about every stage of the Service Delivery Lifecycle –– from new system rollouts to enhancements to ongoing maintenance of applications
• Closely analyze and test any new components or enhancements to existing IT modules 
• Talk with team members to design solutions that meet end users’ needs and technical requirements
• Roll up your sleeves and work on all aspects of programming:
o Define, design, and deliver new applications with your teammates.
o Write the programing code that you have been taught at Accenture that brings new apps to life.
o Develop the system details and interfaces.
o Fix any bugs that creep into any old or new code.
o Make sure critical systems continue running for our clients by maintaining the software code
o Analyze basic tech issues and stop the damage
o Keep well-written records describing how the software works, any special configurations, and how to troubleshoot and/or solve problems
o Support implementation of new technologies, ensuring a successful transition to what’s new

Here's what you need:
o This role is only open to candidates who are of First Nations, Inuit or Métis heritage or descent.
o High school diploma or equivalent
 
This is not required but bonus points if:
• You have a strong track record of good grades
• You can look at problems holistically, analytically and creatively
• You feel comfortable speaking up and sharing your thoughts in person and in writing
• You are curious about business and technology and want to constantly learn
• You have experience being on a team –– at school, North American Indigenous Games, PowWow Drumming, coaching, band councilor or being a team member at another job, or in the military
• You have exposure to a minimum of one programming language (e.g., Java, Javascript, C, C++, C#, SQL, Python, etc.)
• You can use Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
• You have exposure to advanced Excel functions such as pivot tables, v-look ups, macros

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location,
role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation, based on full-time
employment, for roles that may be hired as set forth below. 
The recruiting efforts for this position are intended to fill a brand new position.
The base pay range shown below is intended as a guideline to reflect the majority of offers for this role. 
It does not represent a maximum limit — in some cases, actual compensation may exceed the range where appropriate.

Information on benefits is here.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. jobs.title: IT Business Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. 
 
Who Are We? 
The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA.

Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users.

At Ditch Witch in Perry, Oklahoma we pride ourselves on being the leading manufacturer in the underground pipe and cable market. Our plant in Perry stands out because it's a place for people to learn and thrive. We enjoy coming to work because our plant is our community, we see our teammates not only as co-workers but as neighbors and family members. All of our locations build the intricate network of machinery that contributes to The Toro Company. 
 
What Will You Do? 
In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: 
• Partner with Strategic Technologies team members, business stakeholders, and IT teams to analyze data quality issues across enterprise applications and business systems.
• Perform data cleanup activities including identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated records and supporting remediation efforts.
• Assist in developing and testing data validation rules, monitoring processes, and governance practices to improve data accuracy and consistency.
• Research and evaluate AI-powered tools and techniques to automate data quality management, identify anomalies, and support ongoing data governance efforts.
• Collaborate with business and technical teams to design a sustainable, long-term process for maintaining clean and reliable data using AI and automation capabilities.
• Document requirements, workflows, and proposed future-state processes to support continuous improvement initiatives.
• Present findings and recommendations to team members and stakeholders, contributing innovative ideas that improve business processes and system effectiveness.
 
What Do You Need? 
To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 
• Junior or Senior standing preferred. 
• Demonstrated interest in data management, business systems, AI technologies, process improvement, or enterprise applications through coursework, projects, internships, or extracurricular activities. 
• Basic understanding of data analysis and data management. 
• Experience with Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data validation, filtering).
• Basic knowledge of AI/ML concepts, generative AI tools, or automation technologies. 
• Understanding of databases and data structures. 
• Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Enjoys working with data, identifying quality issues, and ensuring information is accurate and reliable. 
• Curious & Innovative: Passionate about learning new technologies and exploring AI-driven solutions to improve business processes. 
• Collaborative Communicator: Works effectively with business and IT stakeholders and can clearly document findings and recommendations. 
• Proactive Problem Solver: Takes initiative to identify opportunities for process improvement and develop sustainable, long-term solutions.
 
What Can We Give You? 
At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: 
• Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. 
• Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. 
• Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $20–$24. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations.
 
The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Oceanographic Lidar Sensing and Field Campaign Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description:

AMA is seeking a highly motivated intern to join the NASA/RSES team in advancing lidar ocean remote sensing technologies. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of active remote sensing, mechanical and electrical engineering, and ocean science. The successful candidate will focus on redesigning, characterizing, and implementing advanced data acquisition electronics for improving profiling ocean lidar measurements.
 
Duration: Equivalent of 40 weeks at 10hr a week
Schedule: Highly flexible timeframe and variable weekly hours to accommodate the selected candidate’s schedule.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
• Assist with electro-mechanical hardware design, including component layout, wiring, power supply integration, and modular package development.
• Develop and enhance software programs to interface with, operate, and control updated instrumentation.
• Support the integration of hardware and software components into complete instrumentation systems.
• Conduct performance evaluations to assess functionality, reliability, and overall system effectiveness.
• Perform laboratory testing and validation of new and modified designs.
• Participate in at-sea field experiments to evaluate system performance under real-world operating conditions.
• Analyze test results and help identify design improvements and performance enhancements.
• Document design, testing, and validation activities to support continued system development.
• undefined

Qualifications and Skills

jobs.description:
Product Intern - Richmond, VA (Summer 2027)

Job Description

Company Overview:
CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a  mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and  connections that improve their businesses and lives. 
 
We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for  over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a  language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We  continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we  deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best  resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate. 
 
Learn more about CoStar. 
 
Role Description: 
We're looking for a creative, organized, and passionate individual to join the CoStar Group Product Development team to help us dream up and bring to life user-friendly products and applications. As a Product Intern, you will work hand-in-hand with Product Managers, Software Engineers, User Experience Designers, and other business partners to deliver features and enhancements across CoStar Group's products and platforms.

In this position, you'll have the opportunity to transform product concepts from idea to reality, collaborate with Agile software development teams, and help create intuitive customer experiences. You'll gain exposure to the full product development lifecycle, including product strategy, user research, requirements gathering, design, testing, launch, and performance measurement.

You'll also have the opportunity to learn how emerging technologies, including AI, analytics, and automation tools, are helping product teams better understand customer needs, improve workflows, and drive innovation
 
This position is located in Richmond, VA and offers a schedule of Monday to Thursday in office and the option to work from home on Friday. 

Responsibilities: 
• Clearly articulate requirements in task, bug, feature, and project tickets.
• Maintain an up-to-date backlog based on product and business priorities.
• Work with UX/UI Designers to create wireframes and mockups for new products and features.
• Participate in Agile development meetings such as daily standups, sprint planning, and backlog refinement.
• Coordinate with Quality Assurance Analysts to perform acceptance testing on features prior to release.
• Manage communications with a variety of cross-functional stakeholders.
• Track and analyze product performance after launch.
• Perform user, market, and competitive research.
• Use KPIs, customer feedback, and research data to identify opportunities for product improvement.
• Research industry trends and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled products and workflow automation, to identify opportunities that enhance customer experiences and business outcomes.
• Bring ideas for product optimization and new feature development to the team.
 
Basic Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree from an accredited, not-for-profit university or college in Business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. 
• Must be planning to return to school following the completion of the Summer 2027 internship.
• Must have an expected graduation date of December 2027 - June 2028.
• Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA.
• Available to participate in the full 10-week summer internship program and commit to a 40-hour work week throughout the internship. 
• Coursework, project, internship, leadership, or work experience related to product development, technology, business analysis, customer experience, analytics, information systems, computer science, real estate, finance, economics, or a related field.
• Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with team members and stakeholders. 
• Ability to contribute both independently and as part of a team.
• Drive to identify and deliver software solutions that solve a user-facing or business problem in smart, scalable ways.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Exposure to Agile methodologies, product development processes, or software development teams.
• Exposure to UI/UX principles, wireframes, mockups, user research, or customer experience design.
• Experience using data, customer feedback, research, or KPIs to inform recommendations or decision-making.
• Interest in technology, data, emerging trends, AI-powered products, or workflow automation tools.
• Experience balancing multiple tasks, deadlines, or project responsibilities.

What's in it for you?  
When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.      
 
The final salary or hourly rate offered for this role will fall within the range set forth below based on a  variety of factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. 
 
Base Compensation: $26-$30 (Hourly) 
 
We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing

jobs.title: Product Development Intern - Electron Beam Instrumentation
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Development Intern to join our team, focusing on the design, development, and testing of advanced electron beam instrumentation for the semiconductor industry. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced R&D environment.
 
In particular, the intern would work in the following areas:
• Develop methods and test plans for characterization of electron beam based subsystems such as detectors and electron beam sources.
• Work with vacuum chambers, pumps, valves, gages and related equipment.
• Design, set up and execute multi-disciplinary experiments.
• Analyze data and prepare summary reports.
• Work with simulations based on physical models and build correlations with experimental data.
• Collaborate with scientists and engineers across the company.
 
Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.
• Strong academic record.
• Basic understanding of electron optics, vacuum systems, high voltage electronics, or charged particle physics is a plus.
• Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) or simulation tools (e.g., COMSOL, ANSYS) is desirable.
• Experience with laboratory equipment and data acquisition systems.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or C++ is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong analytical mindset.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Minimum Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Total Rewards
Base Pay Range: $38.50 - $48.00 per hour based on pursuit of a Masters and Ph.D.
Primary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

• Develop software components for the high-performance network telemetry.
• Implement telemetry ingestion, packet decoding, validation, and normalization functions.
• Design and develop data persistence and telemetry analytics capabilities.
• Create tools to reconstruct network paths and calculate per-hop latency and congestion metrics from telemetry reports.
• Develop operational monitoring, health metrics, and visualization capabilities.
• Participate in testing, debugging, performance characterization, and validation of telemetry collection systems.
• Collaborate with networking, switch, software, and architecture teams to define and verify telemetry requirements and workflows.

• Pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Familiarity with packet structures, protocol analysis, and packet capture tools.
• Knowledge of telemetry, monitoring, observability, or network analytics concepts.
• Understanding of data storage, databases, and data processing pipelines.
• Familiarity with Linux operating environments and software development tools.
• Exposure to HPC, AI infrastructure, large-scale networking, or cloud-native monitoring technologies is a plus.,
Skills

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description:
 
Job Description
Our team develops HPE Slingshot, an industry-leading interconnect used in some of the world’s largest HPC and AI systems. As an intern, you’ll work alongside experienced architects, logic designers, and verification engineers on a switch or NIC ASIC verification project for a future generation of Slingshot. You’ll learn industry-standard SystemVerilog and UVM verification techniques, participate in technical design and debug discussions, and see how our team is applying emerging agentic AI workflows to solve complex engineering problems.

• Develop SystemVerilog and UVM testbench components, including models, monitors, scoreboards, and checkers

jobs.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.
Job Title:
AI Product Management Intern
Company:
Prologis

Do you want to play a role in global commerce? Are you seeking practical experience to supplement your academic pursuits? 

The Prologis Summer Internship Program offers students of diverse educational backgrounds the opportunity to secure work experience within their field of study. Over a course of 10-12 weeks, our interns will get to collaborate on various significant projects that impact Prologis’ business landscape. Students will have the opportunity to interact and connect with leaders within the company and build workplace acumen through various seminars and Q&A sessions. Regardless of their assigned departments, interns will have access to local market tours in order to fully comprehend Prologis’ business and how their summer contributions impact the end product. 

Prologis seeks both undergraduate and graduate level interns passionate about kickstarting their careers while helping us further our industry leading work across the organization. 

A day in the life 

 This internship supports Operational Excellence’s AI workstreams by turning business challenges into practical AI product concepts and working prototypes. You will work with business partners to understand how work gets done, identify opportunities for meaningful improvement, and explore how emerging AI capabilities can address those needs. You will translate business needs into user stories and workflow designs, support early prototypes using approved AI tools, and test your ideas with users. You will consider both the value of a solution and the experience of the people using it, including where AI performs well, where it falls short, and where human judgment is needed. With guidance from the team, you will take ideas from discovery through prototyping, user feedback, and a recommendation for next steps. Your work will help Prologis evaluate promising AI opportunities and shape useful, intuitive experiences for employees. 
 
Key responsibilities include: 
• Investigate business workflows and user needs to identify specific problems where AI could deliver meaningful value. 
• Research and experiment with emerging AI capabilities, connecting what the technology can do with practical business applications. 
• Understand business needs and future paths, then translate them into concepts for potential products and initial prototypes. 
• Support product discovery by testing business cases, documenting findings, and helping move selected projects through completion. 
• Connect business processes with AI technology, with a focus on user interfaces and user experiences. 
• Help improve consistency across AI user experiences at Prologis. 
• Create and manage a central repository of AI user stories and experiences to support product discovery and development. 

Building blocks for success 

Required: 
• Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program as a rising sophomore, junior, or senior, or currently enrolled in a graduate program. 
• Demonstrated hands-on use of generative AI tools to build, automate, analyze, or improve something in an academic, personal, or professional project. 
• Experience using Microsoft Office applications. 
• Clear verbal and written communication skills. 
• Attention to detail and commitment to professionalism and integrity. 
• Ability to collaborate as part of a team and willingness to learn. 

Preferred: 
• Coursework, project, or internship experience in product management or development, artificial intelligence, business operations, user experience, or a related field. 
• Experience translating business needs into product concepts, user stories, workflow designs, or early prototypes. 
• Experience researching emerging technology or evaluating potential business cases. 
• Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes. 

Hiring Salary Range of: 
Undergraduate: $25–$30 per hour. Graduate: $35–$40 per hour. 

People First
Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. People come first here.

All full-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time. 

All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

GDIT Summer Internship Program – Summer 2027 Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Associate Internship 
 
Sponsorship is not available for this role. 
 
At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team. 
 
What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry? 
 
GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind!  Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters. Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following: 
 
• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients.
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge.
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion. 
• Interact with GDIT leaders.
• Participate in professional development.
 
How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own 
 
Our Artificial Intelligence/ Machine Learning summer interns will work on a range of projects that ideally align with their interests. Some interns will use statistical techniques to provide insights into internal or external customer data to guide decision-making and enhance user experience. Other interns will build machine learning algorithms or work on artificial intelligence system deployments. The ideal intern will have knowledge of computer languages and their applications to enable a system to perform specific functions. 
 
The Must-Haves 
 
• Currently enrolled in an associate's, bachelor's or master's degree program in computer science, IT, engineering, or other STEM field from a United States-based college or university. 
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Office products (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, and Teams) 
 
What You’ll Need to Deliver Your Best Every Day 
 
• Problem solving and interest in big data.
• Interest in data transformation, model selection, cross-validation, and deployment 
• Interest or experience with big data platform tools 
• Knowledge of statistical techniques 
• Knowledge of Python or other programming languages 
• Experience working in a collaborative team environment. 
• Intuitiveness with an ability to identify and solve complex problems related to rapidly changing technology. 
• Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions.
 
GDIT interns are paid and full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive Applicants should have a minimum of one semester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. Take the first step and apply today! 

Note: We receive a high volume of applications and review them on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks of your application.

Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your ambition to deliver your best work.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Quant Research Intern (Summer 2027 – London)

About Jain Global 
Jain Global is an innovative multi-strategy investment firm founded in July 2024 by Bobby Jain. With over 400 employees across New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong, we bring together diverse teams to pursue excellence across asset classes and investment styles. We are seeking driven, intellectually curious individuals to join our growing Systematic Trading team.  
 
Role Overview
 
We are seeking a highly motivated intern to join the Systematic Trading team at Jain Global. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of quantitative research, technology, and financial markets. As a member of our internship program, you will collaborate with portfolio managers, researchers, and technologists to develop and test data-driven trading strategies.
 
You will gain hands-on experience in data analysis, model development, and systematic investment approaches, while contributing to the design and optimization of scalable trading systems. This internship is designed for individuals with strong analytical and programming skills who are passionate about applying quantitative methods to real-world market problems.
 
Responsibilities

• Assist in collecting, cleaning, and managing large and complex financial datasets for analysis.
• Develop and test quantitative models for pricing, forecasting, and trading using statistical and mathematical techniques.
• Collaborate with quantitative researchers and developers to design systematic trading strategies.
• Contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency, optimize runtime, and reduce operational risk.
• Apply programming and analytical skills to solve applied problems in a fast-paced, research-driven environment.
• Communicate findings clearly to team members and contribute to ongoing research discussions.

Qualifications & Skills

• Pursuing a Master’s or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computational Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
• Strong programming skills in Python or another object-oriented or functional programming language.
• Solid understanding of statistical modeling, including both linear and non-linear techniques.
• Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets and extract actionable insights.
• Demonstrated interest in applying technology and quantitative methods to solve complex trading problems.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate in a dynamic, high-performance environment.
 
Why Join Jain Global

• Mentorship: Work directly with senior investors and researchers in quantitative trading.
• Ownership: Lead meaningful projects and drive innovation in a collaborative, entrepreneurial setting.
• Exposure: Gain insight into a multi-strategy investment model and the inner workings of systematic trading.
• Impact: Develop solutions that influence real investment decisions across asset classes.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Join a culture that encourages creativity, independent thinking, and the pursuit of innovative ideas.
• Global Reach: Collaborate with teams across New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
• Career Path: Potential for full-time opportunities upon successful completion of the internship.
 
Compensation
The estimated base salary range for this position is £70,000 for Master's students and £110,000 for Ph.D. students, which is specific to London and may change in the future.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer
As an employer, we believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of Jain Global teams to drive competitive performance. We believe an inclusive environment can yield exceptional contributions.

jobs.description:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

We Began As An Original. We Remain An Original At The Top Of The Convenience Industry. Our company invented the concept of convenience retailing. But we didn’t stop there. 7-Eleven® has captured the world with a proven willingness and ability to innovate. We were the first company in America to offer fresh-brewed to-go coffee. More than six million of our Slurpee® beverages have been sipped since 1966. And, to continuously stay ahead of the curve, we introduce more than 2,500+ new products each year.

With over 86,000 global locations, 7-Eleven Inc. is the world’s largest operator, franchiser and licensor of convenience stores and is also one of the nation’s largest independent gasoline retailers. The company continues to achieve operational accolades, win awards in franchising and drive innovation in retail in the mission to make life a little easier for our guests by being where they need us, when they need us.

About these Opportunities: 7-Eleven Inc. has several opportunities for Summer Internships. Each internship opportunity will occur during the summer months, (11 weeks), focused on a specific functional area, and will provide the candidate with a depth experience within the area, culminating in a project presentation to functional leaders. Each intern will work closely with a coach who will meet regularly to discuss project progress, provide direction and ongoing feedback. In addition, each intern will attend a lunch series which will provide a cross-functional view into the organization and give the interns exposure to senior leadership. The interns will also have the experience of touring a store and learning about our distribution systems. 

This is a eleven (11) week paid internship program. You must be currently enrolled in college pursuing an undergraduate or master’s degree. This opportunity does not include relocation or living stipend.

Position Summary
The Fuel Pricing Data Scientist Intern will support the development, testing, and monitoring of machine learning models that drive data-driven fuel pricing decisions across our retail network. This role is designed for a highly motivated student who wants hands-on experience working with real-world time-series data, pricing systems, and enterprise ML platforms. The intern will work closely with Senior and Lead Data Scientists and gain exposure to production-grade modeling, MLOps, and large-scale data infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
· Support the development and testing of machine learning models used for dynamic fuel pricing.
· Assist with time-series forecasting workflows (e.g., demand, price movement, or market response modeling).
· Perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis on large pricing and market datasets.
· Write Python and SQL code to support modeling, analytics, and data pipelines in environments such as Databricks.
· Help validate model outputs through back-testing, diagnostics, and performance tracking.
· Contribute to documentation of models, assumptions, and experimental results.
· Partner with senior team members on pricing experiments, model monitoring, and business analysis.
· Present findings and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
· Learn and apply emerging AI tools (e.g., automation, LLMs) to support modeling workflows.

Required Qualifications
· Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
· Coursework or hands-on experience in: Python programming, LLM Experience, and statistics or machine learning, and SQL and data analysis
· Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
· Ability to work with large datasets and learn complex business processes.
· Clear communication skills and willingness to collaborate across teams.

Preferred Qualifications
· Exposure to time-series forecasting, predictive modeling, or optimization.
· Familiarity with tools such as:
o Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn
o Spark or Databricks
o Git for version control
· Interest in pricing, economics, retail analytics, or energy markets.
· Prior internship, research, or project experience in data science or analytics.

What You’ll Gain
· Hands-on experience with enterprise-scale fuel pricing systems.
· Real exposure to production ML, forecasting, and optimization models.
· Mentorship from senior data scientists and ML engineers.
· Experience working in cloud-based data platforms and MLOps environments.
· Visibility into how machine learning directly influences pricing and revenue decisions.
· A strong foundation for future full-time Data Scientist or ML Engineer roles.
