jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
The opportunity
Unity Vector builds an offline ML platform that powers insight, experimentation, attribution, and AI-driven decision-making across the company.

Our systems operate at scale across batch and streaming data, supporting analytics, product intelligence, machine learning pipelines, and business operations. As data volume and complexity grow, our platform enables large-scale model training, feature generation, and experimentation workflows that power production ML systems.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer,Intern to join our Offline Infrastructure team. This is an ideal role for people who is excited to work on large-scale systems and apply research-driven thinking to real-world machine learning problems.

You’ll help build and evolve the infrastructure that powers training data generation, ML workflows, and distributed model training. Working closely with experienced engineers and researchers, you’ll contribute to systems that ensure our ML pipelines are reliable, scalable, and efficient.
This role offers the opportunity to bridge research and production—translating advanced ideas into systems that operate at scale.

What you'll be doing
• Build and maintain data pipelines that generate training datasets for machine learning models and experimentation
• Contribute to infrastructure that supports distributed training workflows (e.g., PyTorch, Ray)
• Work with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Flyte, or similar) to support multi-stage ML pipelines
• Improve reproducibility and reliability through dataset validation, monitoring, and testing
• Partner with ML engineers to support experimentation and model iteration
• Help optimize performance and efficiency across data processing and training systems
• Contribute to the evolution of our offline ML platform architecture as it scales
What we're looking for
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Systems, or a related field
• Strong foundation in machine learning systems, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing (through research or projects)
• Experience with Python and working with data-intensive workloads
• Familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and/or distributed systems (e.g., Ray, Spark)
• Experience (academic or applied) with data pipelines, model training workflows, or large datasets
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate research ideas into practical systems
• Interest in building scalable, reliable infrastructure for machine learning
• Nice to Have
• Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Flyte, etc.)
• Exposure to large-scale data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, streaming systems)
• Publications or research in ML systems, distributed systems, or related areas

jobs.title: Sparse Linear Algebra Libraries Intern
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. 

We are looking for software engineering interns for our Sparse Linear Algebra team, which develops libraries like cuSPARSE that are a key part of high-performance computing and deep learning software stacks. The main purpose of these libraries is to provide the fastest computing primitives for operations like sparse matrix-vector and sparse matrix-matrix products, among many others. We see strong interest in optimization of such key functionalities from various industrial and research organizations - from gaming and machine learning to autonomous driving and chip modeling. All of these operations need to be optimized for current and future GPUs and for a wide range of unstructured sparse matrix inputs, which can also necessitate changing the underlying algorithms mathematically and using techniques like code/kernel generation. Does the idea of being at the heart of these projects and applying your knowledge to develop and optimize algorithms which make an impact around world excite you? If yes, then come and join our team!

During your internship, you will work with senior software engineers on the libraries team who will provide mentorship and guide you in developing highly optimized algorithms. Projects will involve implementing new numerical algorithms, defining APIs, analyzing performance, finding appropriate solutions for difficult numerical corner cases, and other general software engineering work.

What you'll be doing:
• Prototype and develop numerical algorithms for high-performance sparse linear algebra libraries for GPUs
• Analyze the performance of GPU implementations and find opportunities for improvements
• Collaborate with team members to understand software use cases and requirements

What we need to see:
• Pursuing MS or PhD in Computational Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or equivalent program area.
• Strong C++ programming, debugging, performance analysis, and test design skills
• Experience implementing sparse linear algebra algorithms
• Parallel programming experience using CUDA and/or OpenMP
• Experience with domain-specific language design, code/kernel generation, and compiler optimizations

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Exposure to numerical methods, floating-point arithmetic and numerical error analysis
• Knowledge of GPU/CPU and network hardware architecture
• A scripting language, preferably Python
• Understanding of composability and fusions, compilers, and implementation of programming languages
• Familiarity with recent CUDA developments like cuTILE and Tile++ and eExperience with sparse compilers (MLIR or TACO)

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! 

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 20 USD - 71 USD.

American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments.

Privately controlled and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct over 40% of our profits every year—more than $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone.

All 1,400 of us across the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you.

Role Summary

The Global Fixed Income Group at American Century Investments is seeking a curious, analytically minded intern to help solve real-world investment problems using data, research, and code. Working alongside our systematic credit investment professionals, you will explore large financial datasets, test investment ideas, and contribute to research and security-selection models used in our investment process.

• Own a research project from initial hypothesis and data analysis through testing, interpretation, and presentation.
• Work directly with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to investigate investment signals and enhance systematic credit strategies.
• Analyze large financial and market datasets using Python.

• How systematic investment teams generate, evaluate, and test research ideas.
• How financial data is cleaned, analyzed, and converted into investment signals.
• How quantitative models inform credit selection and portfolio decisions.

jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. 
 
Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. 

Job Description

Candidates must be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) from January 11- June 25, 2027. No relocation assistance is available.

THE ROLE
The goal of the Audio Machine Learning Research team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real-time, on physical devices, for applications such as voice pickup, hearing augmentation and ones we haven't even thought of yet. As part of the team, you will work with experts in machine learning (ML), digital signal processing (DSP), software engineering and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms. 

Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge technology in the audio domain. We are looking for candidates passionate about machine learning and audio to help us shape the next chapter in the future of Bose!

Responsibilities:
- Most of your time will be devoted to prototyping, implementing and evaluating ML algorithms, curating and developing internal resources, and presenting your findings. 
- You will integrate your novel solutions into existing systems and platforms to showcase new (proof of concept) solutions.
- You will be able to contribute to projects, which will be shipped to Bose customers, apply for patents, and/or submit papers to top-tier AI and signal processing conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICASSP, Interpeech, etc.).

Education:
- Pursuing or recently finished a graduate-level degree in ML, Computer Science, Music Technology or a related field. 

Skills:
- Practical knowledge of Applied audio ML (TensorFlow/PyTorch, TFLite/ONNX is a plus) and Audio DSP (Python, Matlab and/or C/C++). 
- Hands-on experience in at least one of the following research topics: Audio source separation, Speech enhancement, Microphone array signal processing, Tiny ML, Generative audio modelling 
- Familiarity with methods for spatial sound synthesis and/or room acoustics simulation/analysis is a plus.
- Strong communication skills. You will be presenting your work to a large interdisciplinary community.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.‎

Our data analytics interns could support one of the following verticals: Credit Risk & Pricing Analytics, Loan Servicing Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Retail Analytics and SilverRock Analytics.

A successful candidate should have knowledge of data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau and Excel. Above all, the candidate should have a passion for uncovering actionable insights from data.

The analytic interns will be responsible for things like:
• Conducting data analysis to generate meaningful insights from data sets
• Brainstorm ideas and provide creative solutions to challenges in data analysis
• Participate in all phases of the analytic lifecycle, from research design, data collection and data processing to model building, deployment, and presentation of results.
• Innovate existing products and services while using technologies and data analysis to identify new opportunities to improve customer experience and profitability.
• Provide ad hoc analysis and special projects as required.

So what are we looking for?
• Killer analytics and reporting abilities. You’ll need the capability to analyze data and in return, prepare timely reports on your findings.
• A mind for the details. Okay, we know “detail-oriented” is on about every job description – but we really mean it!
• Fantastic problem solver. Your job is not only to find the problem, but more importantly, find the solution.
• Agile in a fast-paced environment. We move, and we move quickly. Thriving in an environment that never stops, is a must.
• Intellectual curiosity. Why? What? How? Do you find yourself always wanting to learn more and broaden your knowledge base? If so, this could be the role for you!
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma and competence for a wide variety of audiences including management.

The Specifics.
• Bachelors or Master’s student with a graduation date between December 2027 – May 2028
• Pursuing a quantitative degree in Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or other STEM fields
• You have a GPA of 3.5 or higher
• Data analysis experience
• Working knowledge in SQL, Python, Tableau and Excel
• Our internship program is 11 weeks starting May 2027 – August 2027
• Internships will be base out of our Home offices in Tempe, AZ and Dallas, TX
• You can expect a regular on-site schedule; Monday-Friday, 40 hours per week
• Relocation not provided for internship

So What About the Perks? Perks matter.
• Not Just Coffee Runs. We’re talking real world experience. You’ll walk away from our internship program with hands-on experience, completed projects, full portfolios, and newly developed skills.
• Who Says You Have to Walk Away? Across both our Tempe, AZ and Dallas, TX offices, over 60% of our interns stay through the fall semester, return the following summer, or are brought on full-time after graduation.
• Growth & Development. You will be mentored by industry professionals, be given guidance along the way, and the tools to be successful.
• Philanthropy: Give for Good. We are proud to be difference makers in our communities. We dedicate time for our Interns to give back with us.
• Gratitude is Green. Out Internship Program is paid, because, well… money matters!

• In-House Gym. We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day or finish strong with a workout!
• Give Us a Reason (or not), and We’ll Celebrate. Regardless of whether there is a holiday or not, we are finding ways to kick back and enjoy each other’s company outside of day-to-day work.
• Smart-Casual Dress. Come dressed in jeans (you’ll fit right in with the rest of us).

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

jobs.title: Product Innovation Intern
jobs.description:
Want to accelerate your career? Join a team of driven people, performing with purpose. 

At Avis Budget Group, we are proud to be a performance driven organization. Our 21,000+ employees encourage each other to be at their best through outstanding leadership, training and tools and rewards. 
As a participant of our ABG Accelerate internship program you will be encouraged to explore different areas of our business to grow both personally and professionally to jump start a rewarding career. 

The 10 Week Accelerate Internship Program consists of: 
• Learning the ins and outs of your department 
• Professional development workshops 
• Hear from our leaders to learn more about our business 
• Network with our senior leadership team 
• Visit our field operations to learn how your team influences our daily operations 

What you’ll do:
• Support Product Management in optimizing features and journeys at the entry point of the rental experience, from reservation through pickup, to improve conversion, engagement, and retention while reducing friction for customers and frontline teams
• Partner with Business, Engineering, UX Design, Analytics, and Operations teams to understand customer needs and operational realities, and help turn complex scenarios into clear, tangible product requirements
• Assist with writing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria, and documenting customer flows and edge cases
• Analyze customer behavior and performance data (e.g., user journeys, friction points, funnel conversion, drop-off, NPS and customer feedback themes) to understand why customers behave the way they do, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of product changes
• Evaluate how product changes affect customers and station operations, and help the team prioritize improvements
• Contribute to team rituals such as backlog grooming, sprint planning, and stakeholder reviews, and present a final project and recommendations to leadership at the end of the internship

What we’re looking for:
• Active enrollment at a college or university, graduating May or June 2028.
• Pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing (digital marketing or e-commerce focus a plus), Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Product or Project Management, or a related field
• Interest in product management, digital experiences, customer journeys, and understanding customer behavior
• Technical curiosity and the ability to understand how systems, APIs, and digital products work, and to talk with engineers about them
• Strong analytical skills and curiosity about customer behavior, with the ability to turn data and behavioral patterns into clear insights and recommendations; working knowledge of Excel required, and experience with SQL or other data analysis tools is a plus
• Coursework or experience in customer research, segmentation, or analytics (e.g., surveys, A/B testing, funnel analysis) is a plus
• Ability to break down ambiguous or complex scenarios into clear, structured requirements
• Detail-oriented mindset with strong written and verbal business communication skills
• Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and work in a fast-paced corporate environment
• Familiarity with Agile practices and tools such as Jira or Confluence is a plus
• Customer-Led, Ownership-driven mindset

The hourly rate for this position is $35 an hour.

Who we are:
Here at Avis Budget Group, you will be joining a team of 25,000 driven people, performing with purpose. Together, we’re moving the future of transportation forward with our innovative, customer-focused solutions.
Our culture is performance driven, where we encourage and support each other to be at our best through leadership, training, tools, and rewards.
We are proud to make a positive difference to the lives of our colleagues, customers, and communities where we operate.

jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern - Plasma Light Source Characterization
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

KLA is looking for summer interns at our Ann Arbor, Michigan location. This position provides an opportunity to work with engineering teams on projects aiming to develop and characterize laser plasma light sources for KLA’s next generation inspection and metrology tools! In particular, the intern would work in the following areas:

• Develop methods and test plans for characterization of laser plasmas
• Design optical systems for imaging, shadowgraphy, and interferometry
• Work with vacuum chambers and related equipment.
• Design, set up and execute multi-disciplinary experiments.
• Analyze data and prepare summary reports.
• Work with simulations based on physical models and build correlations with experimental data.
• Collaborate with scientists at external partner organizations.
 
Qualifications:
• Experience with plasma metrology (e.g. pump/probe, spectroscopy, imaging)
• Experience with high power lasers
• Strong academic record.
• Familiarity with optical design software (e.g., Zemax, Code V, LightTools) or simulation tools (e.g., COMSOL, ANSYS) is desirable.
• Experience with laboratory equipment and data acquisition systems.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or C++ is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong analytical mindset.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in 4-year graduate program in Physics, Optical Engineering or related field with immigration authorization to undertake corporate internship projects.

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Total Rewards
Base Pay Range: $27.00 - $48.00 per hour based on pursuit of a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D.
Primary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Use of AI Statement 
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

Equal Opportunity Statement
KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation.

For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jobs.description:
UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Graduate Software Engineer

Salary: £32,500
Programme start date: September 2027
Citizenship required: UK citizenship required
Security clearance: Security Check (SC)
Travel required: Approximately 10%
Location: New Malden, London
Working arrangement: Site-based requirements apply, with flexible working options subject to the role and programme needs
Hours: Full-time
Requisition ID: R10251080

What’s your possible?
At Northrop Grumman UK, you’ll be part of a team driving innovation where it matters most, solving tomorrow’s challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. We call it Defining Possible. This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions; it’s the foundation for your career development and the impact we have within the community.

This is more than just a job. It’s a mission.
Ready to begin your software engineering career by developing technology that supports strategically important national defence programmes?

As a Graduate Software Engineer, you will help develop software-centric capabilities that enable mission success in some of the most demanding operational environments. From day one, you will contribute to live projects and help deliver software that supports critical UK defence capabilities.

Working within a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will design, develop, test and integrate software solutions. You will apply Agile and DevSecOps approaches throughout the software lifecycle, learning from experienced engineers and technical specialists as you solve complex customer challenges.

This is an opportunity to strengthen your technical expertise, explore different areas of software engineering and contribute to pioneering projects with real purpose.

Our Graduate Programme
Our structured two-year Graduate Programme is designed to help you turn your academic knowledge and coding experience into practical software engineering expertise.

Starting in September 2027, the programme combines on-the-job learning with technical, professional and leadership development. There may also be opportunities to rotate across projects, giving you exposure to different types of work and helping you explore your technical interests.

You will have a dedicated mentor, buddy, project lead and line manager, providing guidance and support throughout your development. From the beginning, you will contribute to meaningful work while learning from experienced engineers and technical specialists.

What you’ll do
• Contribute to software development projects within multidisciplinary engineering teams
• Design, develop, test and integrate software solutions
• Apply Agile and DevSecOps approaches throughout the software development lifecycle
• Participate in technical reviews and collaborative team activities
• Learn from experienced engineers and technical specialists
• Help deliver mission-critical capabilities for UK defence customers

Along the way, you could develop experience in:
• Software architecture and object-oriented design
• Java, C++ and other object-oriented programming languages
• Application development and systems engineering
• Cloud technologies and modern distributed systems
• Microservice architectures, web development and open-source software
• DevSecOps tools and CI/CD pipelines
• Systems integration and Agile delivery
• Cybersecurity principles and secure defence environments
• Applied artificial intelligence capabilities

What we’re looking for
We are looking for graduates who are passionate about software development and computing, enjoy solving challenging problems and want to use technology to make a meaningful difference. You will bring an analytical approach, logical reasoning and the ability to contribute effectively within a collaborative engineering team.

Essential:
• A relevant degree, achieved or on target to be achieved, such as Software Engineering or Computer Science (or can demonstrate equivalent knowledge and skills through work experience or other training)
• A genuine passion for software development and computing
• Experience writing software in one or more object-oriented programming languages, such as Java, C++, C# or a similar language
• An understanding of the software development lifecycle
• Strong analytical skills and logical reasoning
• The ability to solve problems in innovative ways
• The ability to deliver requirements within reasonably agreed timescales
• The potential to contribute to projects through to their conclusion

We welcome applications from candidates who have gained relevant skills outside of traditional degree routes. If you've built your expertise through work experience, an apprenticeship, professional certifications, bootcamps, open-source contributions, or significant personal projects, then we encourage your application.

If you do not meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Sometimes people hesitate because they cannot tick every box. If this opportunity interests you and you believe you could grow into the role, we would like to hear from you.

Security clearance
Due to the nature of our work, you must have Sole UK citizenship and be able to gain and maintain UK Government Security Check clearance in line with the requirements of the role.

Our recruitment team is on hand to answer your questions and guide you through the process. Contact Earlycareers@uk.ngc.com for further information.

Benefits
• Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements and compressed fortnights with every other Friday off
• Private healthcare, dental, life assurance and pension
• Flexible benefits package, including critical illness cover and a health cash plan
• Holiday buy and sell scheme
• Career development programmes
• Annual performance incentive programme

Why join us?
• A Mission to Believe In: Every day, we contribute to building a more secure and connected world.
• A Place to Belong and Thrive: Every voice matters. Find community and belonging through our employee networks and get involved with STEM volunteering events.
• Your Career, Your Way: Discover your possible through diverse roles, mentorship and development opportunities tailored to your ambitions.

Ready to apply?

Yes: Submit your application online.

Possibly: If you would like to learn more about the programme, the role or the security clearance process, contact Earlycareers@uk.ngc.com.

Not this opportunity: Explore other opportunities with us. We’re growing across the UK.

Northrop Grumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our diverse and inclusive workforce.

jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 10-31-2026
Job Description

Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms. 
The Opportunity: 
We are looking for Versatile, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions. 
The Work itself: 
• Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability 
• Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings 
• Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads 
• Develop robust and scalable products intended for a myriad of customers including end-user merchants, b2b, and business to government solutions. 
• Leverage innovative technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later Technology 
• Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities 
Essential Functions:
• Demonstrates basic knowledge and asks questions about project requirements.
• Reviews and asks questions about solution strategies that improve the design and functionality of a payment product feature.
• Applies standard processes on the use of front-end programming languages (e.g. HTML, C++, Java) to write code that fulfills website modification requests and technical requirements, under close guidance.
• Works under close guidance from others to support the piloting of new technology capabilities and features that enhance the user website experience across e-commerce products.
• Identifies and advances bugs that threaten website functionality
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
Visa will accept applications for this role until at least May 19, 2026.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience
Preferred Qualifications:2 or more years of work experienceLanguage Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages .NET, SQL Server, MVC framework, React, Bitbucket, C++The Skills You Bring:Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scaleChallenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutionsLanguage Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., SQL, Java, C#, C++)Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalabilityLearner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum teamsWe do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa.

The Skills You Bring
• Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale
• Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions
• Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, C#, C++)
• Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability
• Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.
• Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams

Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.
Work Hours
Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements
This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements
This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 1 - Flight Software
jobs.description:
Sierra Space Careers:
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. 

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role
The Software Engineer I role involves designing, developing, and testing software applications for space systems and technologies. This entry-level position is ideal for individuals with a basic understanding of programming languages and software development principles who are eager to grow their skills in a collaborative environment. The role includes writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating with senior engineers, and staying current with industry trends.

In this role, you will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies while writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards. You will collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently. Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members. You will participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards, troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner, and document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference. Additionally, you will stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team.
About You
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. 

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Requires bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
• Typically, 0 - 2 years of experience.
• Basic understanding of one or more programming languages and software development principles.
• Ability to write clean, maintainable code.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required

Preferred Qualifications:
• Additional experience in embedded systems or software development through coursework, internships, or employment.
• Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or C++.
• Understanding of software development methodologies such as Agile or Scrum/Kanban.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Compensation:

Pay Range:
$83,999.00 - $115,498.25
Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Elevate Your Career
At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. 
 
We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified. 

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Overview:
Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

Job Description Summary:
System Integration and Test (I&T) Engineer 1 serve as the system integrator for technologies and product lines developed using Draper's core capabilities.​ In this role they plan, execute, and manage I&T activities starting from early test concept development through system certification. This includes functional simulation, subsystem and system integration and test, verification and validation (V&V), performance evaluation, and acceptance testing. System I&T Engineers leverage multi-disciplinary engineering expertise and collaborate with other Systems Engineers to establish clear, verifiable, and traceable requirements, inform and drive system concepts, architectures, and designs to promote testability, and utilizes resident expertise and lessons learned to support the development of highly reliable, robust, and complex systems.

• Ability to independently complete assignments by applying technical knowledge to defined problems with minimal oversight. 
• Contribute content for technical reports and presentations with appropriate guidance.
• Adapt appropriately to changes in program requirements.
• Identify challenges associated with assigned work and communicate them to project leadership.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist
jobs.description:
The opportunity
ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.
You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences.

What you will do
• Work with data scientists and subject matter experts to understand project questions, available data and appropriate outputs.
• Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks.
• Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias.
• Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them.
• Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts.
• Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing.

What you will bring
• Hands-on experience applying data science through a project, research, internship or commercial work.
• Experience using Python gained through employment, an internship, research or substantial personal or academic projects.
• A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation.
• Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices.
• Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English.
• A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field.

Useful additional experience
• Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation.
• Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required.
• Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience.

What you can expect
You will learn from colleagues with a range of technical and subject expertise while contributing to complex, varied projects. We will support your career development through ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to deepen both your data science and consulting skills. As your experience grows, you will take on more responsibility in shaping and delivering solutions.

Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship 
We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany, applicants must: 
• Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and 
• Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand). 
Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided.

Working at ICF means applying a passion for meaningful work with intellectual rigor to help solve the leading issues of our day. Smart, compassionate, innovative, committed, ICF employees tackle unprecedented challenges to benefit people, businesses, and governments around the globe. We believe in collaboration, mutual respect, open communication, and opportunity for growth.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building an inclusive workplace that allows everyone to thrive. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. 

Learn more about what we do and our commitment to inclusion. 

The benefits of joining ICF:

Our people at ICF are our most important asset, so we invest in them from the moment they arrive. When you join our team, you’ll have access to a vast array of benefits to help you live your life well.
 
We offer a hybrid working policy, which will provide you with the flexibility to collaborate in the office, as well as in the comfort of your own home, ensuring you are able to successfully deliver the requirements of your role.
 
To support you, our employee wellbeing hub is designed to provide highly personalised support across a comprehensive range of wellbeing issues, such as mind, body, finances, community, career programs and HR support.
 
We enjoy celebrating success, which is why we have a competitive recognition program called ‘You Matter’, which awards points as a ‘thank you’ for your work achievements. ICF also offers a range of competitive benefits, which include:

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector is seeking an Associate Cloud Software Engineer (Level 1) to join our team of highly qualified, diverse professionals within the Western Region Software Engineering Directorate. This position is located onsite in Redondo Beach, CA.
 
*Please be aware that this position will be contingent upon obtaining and maintaining customer and/or business funding*

jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

$73,800.00 - $123,200.00

Position: Software Developer Graduate (AI Proficient) 

Employment type: Full-time   

Location: Lake Forest/ San Leandro/ Scottsdale/ Philadelphia 

Work Type: Hybrid (3 days a week in office)    

Work Authorization: This application is intended for candidates that are eligible for full-time work authorization in the United States upon completing their education.  

Please be prepared to answer the following in your application:   

• Do you now, or will you in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. F1, J1, H-1B, CPT, OPT visa status, etc.) to work legally in the United States?  

Position Overview: 

As a Software Developer Graduate at AVEVA, you step into a full-time, production-grade role from day one — shipping real software for the industrial enterprises that keep the world running. What sets this role apart is how you'll build: leveraging the latest agentic coding tools, from intelligent code generation and AI-assisted debugging to autonomous workflows that accelerate every stage of the development lifecycle. This isn't about occasionally using a tool — it's about engineering with an AI-proficient mindset as a core part of how great software gets made. With AI and cloud at the center of our strategy and a global portfolio of 75+ products, this is where a sharp, self-directed graduate grows into an engineer who doesn't just keep pace with the future of software development, but helps define it. 

Key Responsibilities: 

• Recognize, articulate, and make technical decisions / trade-offs around multiple dimensions (scaling, reliability, performance, maintenance, etc.) that have an impact on your team 

• Design, develop, test, and debug software applications 

• Deliver software on-time and constantly work to make accurate estimates and deliver on those estimates 

• Provide technical support of products including direct customer support and escalated issues 

• Document product behavior and implementation details 

• Collaborate with team members on how to approach and prioritize development efforts 

• Understand and proactively follow team processes, documentation, best practices, and code style guides 

• Give insightful feedback on pull requests, engineering designs, and features 

• Expand your working knowledge of your respective technical domain

• A Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field​ graduating with a GPA of 3.0 or above 

• Software product or application development experience 

• Familiarity with agentic engineering tools and coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar development harnesses.

• Good experience with developing software in major programming languages such as: C++, C#/.NET, JavaScript, etc. 

• Familiarity with software design patterns (objected oriented design), Computer Science fundamentals/principles and methodologies, as well as knowledge of operating system internals 

• Sharp debugging and problem-solving skills 

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

• An eagerness to accept and expand upon skills and knowledge based on feedback 

• Someone who seeks advice on how to approach and prioritize development efforts 

• A self-motivated person with excellent time management skills

Flex work hours, 20 days PTO rising to 25 with service, three paid volunteering days, primary and secondary parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision‑making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

Join our Technical Product Development team as an Associate Product Manager and help shape innovative solutions that support clinical research and improve the customer experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate market needs into product requirements, support product development, and coordinate successful launches across our portfolio of software, devices, and services. If you are passionate about technology, customer-focused innovation, and bringing impactful products to market, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer
• Competitive compensation.
• Health, dental, and vision coverage in the United States, and comprehensive health and dental coverage in Canada.
• Paid time off and company holidays.
• Remote work opportunities across the United States and Canada.
• Employee wellness and professional development programs.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Support product strategy, roadmap development, and lifecycle management for new and existing software, devices, and services, from initial planning through launch, maintenance, and retirement.
• Conduct market research, analyze competitive trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities, define product requirements, and prioritize features that address business and customer needs.
• Collaborate with Product Development, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Quality and Regulatory Affairs teams to refine user stories, coordinate releases, manage risks, and ensure alignment with quality and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate product development timelines, documentation, stakeholder communications, and cross-functional launch readiness, including training materials, product demonstrations, and sales enablement resources.
• Monitor product performance, customer satisfaction, serviceability, and business outcomes while supporting continuous improvement, financial planning, and effective management of product-related risks.

What We Look For
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, preferably in business, science, or a related field.
• 0–3+ years of relevant experience in product management, operations, commercial functions, or related roles.
• Experience supporting product planning, market research, customer requirements gathering, or software and technology product development.
• Strong project coordination, analytical, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and communicate product progress effectively.
• Understanding of product lifecycle processes, including requirements definition, development, testing, launch, and ongoing product improvements.
• Strong customer focus, sound judgment, and effective collaboration and influencing skills across cross-functional teams.
• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly.
• Familiarity with regulated healthcare technologies, clinical data capture, medical devices, or relevant quality and regulatory standards is preferred.
• Ability to work remotely from the United States or Canada with preference for Eastern Time Zone alignment; and travel occasionally as business needs require. 

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Clario is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Engineers support ASIC, FPGA, or SoC verification activities across advanced aerospace programs including space systems, satellite technologies, communications systems, and related digital subsystems while gaining exposure to broader digital product development activities.

Engineers assist in development of electronic architecture and detailed specifications for various electronic products. jobs.title: Product Analyst - Virtual Events and Shareholder Meetings
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is growing! We are seeking a Product Analyst to join our Issuer Governance and Communications team. This role will focus on the online platform for virtual events and shareholder meetings. This person will help inform the product roadmap, translate client and market needs into product requirements, and improve the practices and workflows that support successful virtual meetings.

Working across Product, Technology, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and client-facing teams, the Analyst uses data, market research, and customer insights to support platform improvements, evaluate opportunities in adjacent market segments, and contribute to go-to-market plans. 

Responsibilities
• Research customer needs, industry trends, and market competition to help assess existing products, proposed enhancements, and new product opportunities.
• Gather, document, and clarify business requirements and technical specifications in partnership with product managers, client-facing teams, and Technology.
• Support product roadmap planning by analyzing customer feedback, platform performance, and market intelligence.
• Analyze and monitor new and existing products and services, identifying opportunities to improve functionality, user experience, and operational workflows.
• Support the evaluation of proposed product requirements and development initiatives, including preparing inputs for business cases and return-on-investment analyses.
• Coordinate assigned activities with Technology and service delivery teams to support development schedules, operational readiness, and product launches.
• Partner with Marketing and Sales to support coordinated go-to-market plans, product positioning, and launch materials.
• Conduct research and analysis to inform product pricing and potential expansion into adjacent market segments.
• Help document and improve procedures and practices that support virtual events and shareholder meetings.
• Use established procedures to resolve routine issues, communicate findings clearly, and seek guidance on complex or unfamiliar matters.
• Track assigned deliverables, maintain accurate documentation, and meet agreed-upon deadlines.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, marketing, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience that provides knowledge of fundamental business and analytical concepts.
• Foundational understanding of product management, market research, business analysis, or related practices, gained through education or work experience.
• Ability to gather and analyze information, apply established procedures, and make sound judgments on routine business problems.
• Ability to translate customer and business needs into clear, organized requirements and supporting documentation.
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage structured assignments and meet deadlines.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask questions, confirm understanding, and share findings with cross-functional colleagues.
• Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, presentations, and documentation tools.
• Willingness to learn, incorporate feedback, and develop technical and functional expertise under guidance.
• Interest in digital platforms, virtual events, shareholder meetings, or issuer governance and communications; familiarity with these areas is helpful but not required.

This role is Hybrid meaning you will be assigned to our Long Island or New York City Office and given the flexibility to work remotely 2-3 days per week.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $115,000 USD
Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
Bonus Eligible.

Our solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams.

Job Description
Develop software and modeling solutions for AI-enabled camera silicon. This role supports the full software development lifecycle for standards-based real-time hardware video codecs. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to enhance existing video codec technologies and contribute to the development of next-generation codec solutions.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and optimize video codec algorithms focused on video quality, low latency, and hardware efficiency.
• Implement and maintain reference codec models.
• Collaborate on silicon architecture modeling and hardware/software co-design.
• Develop silicon verification and diagnostic tools.
• Design and maintain real-time product firmware.
• Implement and tune software rate control algorithms.
• Work with engineering teams to integrate and validate codec solutions.
Required Skills
• Strong programming skills in C and C++
• Embedded software development experience
• Familiarity with video compression standards (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1, or similar)
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools to improve software design, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation efficiency.
Location Dayton (Beavercreek), Ohio
Experience
• 1 to 5 years of relevant experience in software or embedded systems development

jobs.title: Senior Associate Product Manager - Enterprise AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

OUR PEOPLE: 
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

ROLE SUMMARY: 
As part of LSEG Enterprise AI, we are hiring a Senior Associate Product Manager to support the strategy, roadmap and delivery of foundational platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable and governed AI expansion across LSEG's product portfolio. 

This is a great opportunity for an early-career product manager to develop their craft across a broad range of platform and enablement areas, supporting LSEG teams to build AI-powered products on a common enterprise platform.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 
• Supports the definition of vision, strategy and roadmap for LSEG's Enterprise AI Platform, working closely with stakeholders including product managers & engineering teams.
• Assists in owning product direction for one or more platform capability areas (e.g. platform services, developer tooling, agent capabilities, governance and enablement), as assigned.
• Participate in hands-on frontier AI products, prototyping, building and validating with customers 
• Partners with Engineering to help deliver secure, scalable and reliable platform capabilities, tracking delivery progress and surfacing blockers.
• Helps maintain platform standards, documentation and reusable services that support AI product development across LSEG.
• Supports adoption of common AI infrastructure and tooling, including gathering feedback from internal teams and users.
• Works with Security, Architecture, Governance and Risk teams to help ensure platform features comply with enterprise policies and Responsible AI standards.
• Engages with product teams across LSEG to gather requirements, document use cases and support roadmap prioritisation.
• Helps define and track success metrics for platform adoption, operational performance and developer experience.
• Assists in coordinating with industry partners and cloud providers on specific platform initiatives.
• Contributes to LSEG's Enterprise AI strategy by supporting delivery of foundational platform capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.
• Some understanding of or strong interest in AI platforms, LLM ecosystems, APIs and enterprise software is desirable.
• Early career experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering or a related field (internships and graduate schemes considered).
• Experience or coursework involving software platforms, APIs or cloud-native services is a plus.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Curiosity, willingness to learn quickly, and comfort operating in a fast-changing environment.
Preferred:
• Exposure to financial data, analytics systems or enterprise-scale data workflows.
• Familiarity with basic BI tools, metrics dashboards or monitoring stacks.
• Prior experience working in or alongside technology teams in a large organisation.

Career Stage:
Senior Associate
London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject. 

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

jobs.title: Data Analyst/Data Engineer - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking an entry level data analyst/data engineer to help us collect, transform and extract meaning from data for the Global Technology Services (GTS) Control Tower team at State Street. The position performs a wide range of activities with experts from GTS, business intelligence, business analysis, data engineering, process engineering, governance, and data analysts to collaboratively solve a wide array of complex technical problems.

About the GTS Control Tower team
The GTS Control Tower team is an exciting and growing area of State Street with unique insight into the whole spectrum of our data, metrics, and dashboards at State Street. This name change reflects the work we are actively doing across GTS: integrating dependency management, business analysis, process design, and governance to transform data into action and keep remediation efforts flying smoothly.

The GTS Control Tower Mission
Our core focus is on transforming data into actionable insights. Our goal is to enable GTS Leadership to accelerate progress against key strategic initiatives across GTS and to drive results.

Core Responsibilities
• Report & Dashboard Development: Design, develop, and maintain high quality, accessible interactive Power BI dashboards and reports that clearly communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) and business insights.
• Data Modeling & Transformation: Build and optimize semantic data models, including relationships, calculated columns, and measures using DAX. Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) using Python and Power Query (M).
• Data Source Integration: Connect, consolidate, and manage data from multiple sources such as SQL databases, Azure services, Excel, and other enterprise systems into reliable, well structured datasets.
• Performance Optimization: Tune data models and DAX calculations to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and user experience.
• Security & Platform Administration: Implement and maintain row level security (RLS), manage Power BI workspaces and apps, and support capacity and governance best practices within the Power BI Service.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into analytical solutions, and deliver actionable, decision ready insights.
• Documentation & Standards: Create and maintain clear documentation for data models, transformation logic, report definitions, and operational procedures to support transparency and long term maintainability.

What We Value
• Willingness to learn and develop new skills, embracing challenges and continuous improvement
• Strong work ethic, focus on achieving goals, and delivering measurable results
• Desire for creative thinking, problem-solving, and proposing new ideas to improve processes or products
• People who thrive in a collaborative team environment

Requirements
• An online portfolio with examples with nonconfidential data that demonstrates your analysis skills
• Some experience with Microsoft Power BI, DAX, Power Query, M, ETL, Python, PySpark, SQL
• A Bachelor's degree in a data analytics, data science, computer science or equivalent experience

Salary Range: 

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.
