jobs.title: Placement Technologist Intern
jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future 
At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.
SALARY: £22,750 - £25,750
Placement / Trainee Technologist

JOB PROFILE DESCRIPTION 

WHAT IS A PLACEMENT? 
 
Eligibility: Our Placement Programme is designed for undergraduate students who are in their second year of study and will be entering their third year. This 12-month fixed-term contract begins in the summer and is part of a sandwich year Placement at Level 6. It provides invaluable real-world industry experience. Please note that we can only consider applications from candidates who meet these criteria. 

Purpose: The Placement aims to offer undergraduates a full year of industry experience between their second and final years of study, running from summer to summer. This opportunity allows students to apply classroom theory in a practical setting and gain valuable hands-on experience. 
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS
As a Placement/Trainee Technologist with Kainos, you’ll work on projects that make a real difference to people’s lives – including the lives of people you know.

You’ll start your journey with our AI-first Technologist Academy, where you’ll build strong foundations in modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, quality assurance, low-code development, cyber security and data & AI.

After the academy, you’ll join our Early Careers Programme where you’ll gain hands-on experience across different roles, supported by experienced mentors and real project work. You will also continue to develop your technical, professional and business skills during this time. 

At Kainos, we operate in a fast-moving, dynamic environment, so adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are key. You’ll have the opportunity to work across different teams, projects, and business units, developing the skills to become one of our future technical leaders.

What You’ll Experience

Software Engineering 
You’ll learn to design, build, and maintain high-quality software solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks. Expect to work on scalable, secure applications that deliver real value to users.

Test / QA Engineering 
You’ll develop skills in automated and manual testing, ensuring the quality and reliability of our solutions. You’ll learn how to embed quality into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Data & AI 
You’ll explore how data and AI can transform services, from building data pipelines to applying machine learning and generative AI to solve real-world problems.

Low Code 
You’ll use low-code platforms to rapidly deliver business solutions, learning how to combine speed with maintainability and integration best practices.

Platforms 
You’ll gain experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and automation, ensuring our solutions are secure, scalable, and performant.

Cyber Security 
You’ll learn how to build systems that are protected against the latest Cyber & AI security threats. You’ll learn the techniques attackers use to compromise applications and to defend against them.

Upon Completion

You’ll graduate from the Early Careers Programme with a broad technical foundation and the skills to shape our future. Many of our leaders started their careers this way.

You will be responsible for:
• Contributing to technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers and users.
• Contributing to the specification, validation, implementation and operation of technology solutions, gradually taking ownership of more complex work as your capability develops.
• Collaborating with team members to understand problems, define requirements, challenge assumptions and contribute to solution design and delivery.
• Learning to use AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and confidence, while maintaining accountability for delivery outcomes.
• Developing breadth across multiple delivery disciplines, including software engineering, quality assurance, platforms, data, cyber security and low-code technologies, while building deeper expertise over time.
• Seeking feedback and continuously improving your knowledge and skills.

Minimum essential requirements:
• Currently studying towards, at least a Level 6 bachelor’s degree in a relevant subject. 
• Must have unconditional right to work in the UK and be eligible for UK Security Clearance (for further details, see FAQS on website). 
• Familiarity with one or more technology domains, such as software development, data, testing, cloud platforms, cyber security or low-code technologies, gained through study, projects or practical experience.
• An understanding of how technology solutions are designed, built, tested, deployed and supported, and awareness of the different activities required throughout the delivery lifecycle.
• Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, tools and ways of working, including AI-assisted delivery approaches.
• The ability to analyse problems, challenge assumptions, identify key information and work with others to develop effective solutions.
• Experience using AI-assisted tools to support learning, creativity or problem-solving.
• The ability to communicate clearly and effectively, adapting your style when working with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• The ability to work effectively as part of a team, seek feedback, share knowledge and contribute positively to collective outcomes.
• Exposure to source control, continuous integration, data processing, cyber security practices or cloud platforms.

Desirable:
• Participation in technology-related activities such as hackathons, competitions, clubs, community initiatives or open-source projects.
 
THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING:

Working Arrangements: Upon joining, you will be expected to work in your contracted office for 5 days per week for the duration of the AI-First Technologist Academy. After which, you will work in a hybrid model with 3 office days each week to support your learning and development with your team. Ensuring you are available to attend the office or client sites when required to do so.

Travel expectations: At Kainos, we work with a diverse range of clients, and some of our projects require travel. If travel were required, we will endeavour to keep this to a minimum and ensure sufficient notice is provided. 

Popularity of scheme: We’re looking forward to receiving and reviewing your application. We strongly encourage you to apply early. If a high number of applications are received, this role may close earlier than the advertised deadline. In cases where a large volume of applications is received, the recruitment team will apply enhanced criteria to refine the shortlisting process.

Completing your application: Please note that the application process is two parts, completing a questionnaire and uploading your CV. It is essential that you complete the questionnaire in full, to the best of your ability. We recommend avoiding the LinkedIn quick apply function, as it may alter the format of your CV and exclude important details. Instead, please apply directly via the Kainos Careers website: Your Kainos story starts here
Once the role closes, the Job Description will no longer be accessible. We recommend saving a copy in advance.

TIMELINES*

Closing Date – Friday 23rd October 2026
Assessment Centre – W/C Monday 16th – Wednesday 25th November 2026 
Outcomes Communicated – W/C Monday 30th November 2026
Start Date –

jobs.title: Product Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
28800 Ida St Valley Nebraska 68064-8016

Why Valmont
 
We’re Here to Move the World Forward.
Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.
 
Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce. Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

A Brief Summary of This Position:
The Product Analyst Intern will support Valley Irrigation Product Management by turning product, sales, and inventory data into accurate, actionable insights. This part-time role runs through the fall 2026 and spring 2027 academic terms and is designed for a college student who enjoys working with large data sets, building clear reports, and presenting recommendations to product and commercial leaders. The position may be performed on-site or remotely following an initial in-person orientation, with occasional office check-ins.

Essential Functions:
• Analyze product, sales, and inventory data at the SKU and part-number level to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Build and maintain standardized Excel workbooks, pivot tables, data queries, and repeatable reporting tables for management review.
• Apply inventory aging measures and product life-cycle concepts to evaluate product health and inventory exposure.
• Identify mature or declining products that may require obsolescence review, forecast-methodology review, reduced forecast status, liquidation pricing, or scrap and inventory-disposal decisions.
• Use approved analytical and artificial intelligence tools, where appropriate, to analyze data, summarize insights, create charts, and support data-driven presentations.
• Develop clear charts, graphs, written summaries, and recommendations for senior product managers and commercial team members.
• Validate data accuracy, reconcile inconsistencies, and document data sources, assumptions, and analysis methods.
• Present findings, answer questions, and revise analysis based on stakeholder feedback.
• Report to Troy Long, VP of Hardware Product and Warranty; this position has no direct or indirect reports.

Other Important Details about the Role:
• Work part time during the fall 2026 and spring 2027 academic terms on a schedule coordinated with the manager and the student's academic commitments.
• Collaborate with product managers and commercial team members to clarify business questions and convert them into structured analyses.
• Maintain organized source files, analysis workbooks, and reporting formats so results can be reviewed and reused.
• Manage multiple assignments, communicate progress and risks, and meet agreed deadlines with limited supervision.
• Participate in team meetings, an initial in-person orientation, and occasional in-office check-ins when working remotely.
• Handle business and product information with appropriate care and confidentiality.
• No routine travel is required.

Required Qualifications of Every Candidate:

Master Data Management Intern 

Department: Data Management / Transformation Office

Job Summary
A Master Data Management (MDM) intern assists with organizing, cleaning, and governing core enterprise data assets like product, customer, or supplier information across systems.

Essential Duties
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical Master Data Management (MDM) Intern to join our data team. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience supporting enterprise-wide data governance, data quality, and system integration initiatives. You will work closely with data stewards, IT professionals, and business stakeholders to help maintain a reliable, accurate "single source of truth" for critical business data.

• Data Cleansing & Validation: Assist in data collection, auditing, profiling, and cleansing activities to identify anomalies and ensure high data quality across enterprise platforms.
• Process & Governance Documentation: Help document data flows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), data dictionaries, and governance policies.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with business units and technical teams to research data discrepancies, answer inquiries, and support root-cause analysis for data issues.
• Project Support: Participate in active MDM system migrations, software upgrades, or testing initiatives (such as validating data models, user acceptance testing, or report building).
• Reporting & Analysis: Utilize tools like Excel, SQL, Sheets to track data quality metrics and generate routine operational reports.

Qualifications & Requirements
• Education: Currently enrolled in an Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree program in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field.
• Technical Aptitude: Familiarity or coursework involving database concepts, SQL, or data analysis using Google Sheets / Excel. Eagerness to learn enterprise tools (e.g., Informatica, SAP, Salesforce, or Oracle).
• Attention to Detail: Strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and structural organization.
• Communication Skills: Effective verbal and written communication skills to explain technical findings and collaborate with team members.
• Problem-Solving: Demonstrated analytical mindset with an interest in untangling complex data workflows and improving business processes.

What You Will Learn
• Real-world experience managing enterprise-grade data governance frameworks and MDM tools.
• Direct mentorship from experienced data architects, analysts, and data stewards.
• Practical insight into how data quality impacts company-wide digital transformation and business intelligence.

The Summer 2027 Population Health Analytics Graduate Internship offers graduate students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of healthcare, data analytics, and population health strategy. This internship is designed for individuals who are passionate about leveraging data to solve complex healthcare challenges and improve health outcomes, affordability, and the overall member experience.

As a member of the Population Health Strategy Analytics team, the intern will work with large-scale healthcare datasets, including medical and pharmacy claims data and electronic medical record (EMR) information, to generate actionable insights that support Highmark's Living Health strategy. Through collaboration with analytics professionals, clinical stakeholders, and business leaders, the intern will contribute to high-visibility strategic initiatives focused on improving population health, enhancing care delivery, and driving value-based healthcare outcomes.

The program provides hands-on training and exposure to advanced healthcare analytics, strategic planning, and business decision-making. Interns will participate in meaningful projects that involve data exploration, trend analysis, performance measurement, predictive insights, and strategic research. They will have the opportunity to strengthen analytical and technical capabilities, gain exposure to executive leadership, and develop the communication and storytelling skills needed to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

Typical responsibilities include supporting day-to-day analytics activities, conducting research and reporting, analyzing healthcare and population health data, developing insights and recommendations, participating in strategic projects and initiatives, and collaborating across teams to support organizational objectives. This internship provides a unique opportunity to make a measurable impact while building a strong foundation for a career in healthcare analytics, population health, and business strategy.

This job has the goal of providing the opportunity to acquire practical experience through direct exposure to the related business line(s) and to develop the next generation of diverse business professionals. Pursuing a Master's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Epidemiology, or a related field.

7. Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned. 

This internship is ideal for graduate students seeking meaningful experience in healthcare analytics and strategy, offering the opportunity to contribute to population health initiatives while developing the analytical, business, and leadership skills needed for a successful career in healthcare and data-driven decision-making.

Your Future in Product Starts Here 
For more than a century, TIAA has stood alongside educators, researchers, healthcare workers, and nonprofit professionals — helping them build the financial security they deserve. Recognized as one of the world's most ethical companies, we are an organization where your work is both purposeful and rewarding. Our internship program is at the heart of that mission. 

At the center of that promise is something most financial services firms can't offer: guaranteed lifetime income. TIAA's Insurance Solutions & New Markets (IS&NM) organization builds, manages, and evolves the products — like TIAA Traditional and CREF — that give millions of educators, researchers, and nonprofit professionals the confidence that their money will outlive them. This summer, you'll get an inside look at how that promise is built and brought to market. 

Where You'll Make an Impact 
As an intern in IS&NM, you'll contribute to work that spans: 
• Flagship Product Exposure – Build foundational knowledge of TIAA's core annuity products, including TIAA Traditional and CREF, and understand what makes guaranteed lifetime income possible 
• High-Impact Projects – Contribute to initiatives that inform product strategy, business development, and operational decision-making 
• Strategic Storytelling – Build Excel and PowerPoint deliverables and Tableau visualizations that inform real decision-making 
• Independent Research – Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis that sharpens your analytical edge and shapes business direction 
• Career Exploration – Gain exposure to diverse functions within IS&NM's Product and Business Development organization 

Your Path Within IS&NM 
Insurance Solutions & New Markets owns the products at the heart of TIAA's mission — the insurance and annuity solutions that convert savings into guaranteed income for life, and the new product and market opportunities that extend that promise to more people. You'll gain exposure to: 
• Retirement Products — TIAA's flagship retirement products and solutions, including TIAA Traditional, Secure Income Account (SIA), Guaranteed Fixed Account (GFA), TIAA Stable Value, CREF, Real Estate Account (REA), Individual Retirement Accounts, RetirePlus, and In-plan Managed Accounts 
• Product Development & Innovation — How new products, features, and market opportunities are developed and brought to market 
• Business Strategy & Operations — The planning processes and operational effectiveness efforts that drive enterprise execution 
• Business Development & Product Implementation — How strategic partnerships and third-party implementation bring TIAA's products to life for clients and plan sponsors 

Key Responsibilities and Duties 
• Gain exposure to key business functions within IS&NM's Product and Business Development organization 
• Support product management activities and research related to TIAA's retirement products and solutions 
• Prepare research materials and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, and Tableau 
• Collaborate with internal teams to help deliver on product or solution strategy 
• Conduct meetings with subject matter experts to understand product offerings, lifecycles, features, and benefits 
• Apply academic knowledge and curiosity to contribute to real business challenges 
• Support business planning, market research, and competitive analysis

jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a highly motivated Algorithm Engineering Intern to join our algorithm engineering team. The intern will focus on accelerating and optimizing image-processing and computer vision algorithms on GPU platforms.
 
Required Qualifications
• Strong programming skills in C/C++.
• Hands-on experience developing CUDA applications and writing CUDA kernels.
• Understanding of GPU architecture and parallel programming concepts.
• Experience with Linux-based software development environments.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Proficient in writing CUDA kernels for image-processing or similar compute-intensive workloads.
• Strong knowledge of CUDA kernel optimization techniques for improving compute efficiency and memory performance.
• Strong understanding of performance optimization techniques and hardware-aware software design.

Currently pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

Requires less than 1 year of related experience

Job Title:
IT Customer Experience Technologies Intern
Company:
Prologis

Do you want to play a role in global commerce? Are you seeking practical experience to supplement your academic pursuits? 

The Prologis Summer Internship Program offers students of diverse educational backgrounds the opportunity to secure work experience within their field of study. 

Over a course of 10–12 weeks, our interns will get to collaborate on various significant projects that impact Prologis’ business landscape. Students will have the opportunity to interact and connect with leaders within the company and build workplace acumen through various seminars and Q&A sessions. Regardless of their assigned departments, interns will have access to local market tours in order to fully comprehend Prologis’ business and how their summer contributions impact the end product.

You will work with business and technology stakeholders to identify use cases, translate requirements into solution concepts, and build and validate AI-powered prototypes. You will also explore how generative AI and agentic capabilities can integrate with enterprise applications, data, and workflows, while evaluating solutions for accuracy, reliability, usability, security and measurable business value.

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

jobs.title: AI/Machine Learning Intern - Research and Development
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Role: 
Conduct original research and develop practical AI/ML methods that accelerate GM’s research, engineering, and product development capabilities. This role is intended for a recent or soon-to-be-completed Ph.D. who brings strong depth in one or more advanced AI areas and the ability to work across disciplines. The intern will develop proof-of-concepts (POCs), evaluate them on meaningful engineering or scientific problems, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate with senior researchers and engineering partners to move promising ideas toward impact.

The Team: 
GM R&D is seeking an outstanding early-career intern to contribute to advanced work in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models. The role is designed for a fresh Ph.D. It emphasizes research depth, originality, experimental rigor, and growth toward independent technical leadership. The successful candidate will work with senior researchers, technical fellows, and engineering collaborators to formulate important problems, develop new methods, build research prototypes, and validate results. The work may span causal reasoning, neurosymbolic AI, world models, multimodal and generative AI, engineering agents, or related areas. The intern will be expected to connect theory and experimentation with real engineering needs while maintaining high standards for reproducibility, explainability, uncertainty awareness, and responsible AI.

What You’ll Do:   
• Conduct original research in one or more advanced AI areas such as causal AI, neurosymbolic AI, world models, multimodal or generative AI or engineering agents.
• Translate engineering and scientific challenges into well-defined research questions, hypotheses, algorithms, and experimental plans.
• Design, implement, and evaluate machine learning models and proof-of-concepts using real, simulated, experimental, or engineering data.
• Develop methods that can reason about physical systems, causal relationships, uncertainty, constraints, temporal evolution, or complex interactions among components.
• Establish meaningful baselines and evaluation protocols; analyze failure modes, robustness, generalization, interpretability, and uncertainty rather than relying only on headline accuracy.
• Build reproducible research code, data-processing workflows, and experiment pipelines using modern deep learning practices.
• Collaborate with GM R&D researchers and engineering partners to understand domain constraints, validate research results, and identify pathways from POCs to practical use.
• Communicate technical findings through research reports, presentations, publications, invention disclosures, demonstrations, and clear documentation.
• Contribute to technical discussions and research roadmaps by identifying promising approaches, important risks, and high-value experiments.
• Participate in a collaborative research culture that values intellectual curiosity, constructive peer review, responsible innovation, and continuous learning.

More About Who You Are
• A curious and intellectually rigorous researcher who enjoys working on difficult, open-ended problems.
• Deeply grounded in at least one technical area, while eager to learn and collaborate across adjacent AI, computational science, and engineering disciplines.
• Motivated by research that can create measurable value in real-world engineering workflows, not only benchmark performance.
• Comfortable moving between mathematical formulation, algorithm development, software implementation, and empirical validation.
• Able to explain complex ideas, assumptions, limitations, and results to both technical and general audiences.
• Independent in driving research tasks to completion while actively seeking feedback and working effectively with senior mentors and cross-functional teams.
• Committed to careful experimentation, reproducibility, safety, explainability, and responsible use of AI.

Required Qualifications:     
• Pursuit of a PhD in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field. 
• Must be a current student
• Able to work fulltime, 40 hours per week during the summer months 
• Demonstrated research depth in at least one relevant area, supported by a dissertation, publications, patents, open-source work, research software, or comparable technical contributions.
• Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, with working knowledge of optimization, probability/statistics, numerical methods, or scientific computing as appropriate to the research area.
• Experience developing and evaluating models in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, or comparable tools.
• Ability to formulate experiments, select appropriate metrics and baselines, analyze results, and communicate technical conclusions with appropriate caveats.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers, engineers, and technical stakeholders.
• Ability to work on-site or in a hybrid research environment in accordance with GM work practices and project needs.

Preferred Qualifications:    
• Research experience in causal inference, counterfactual reasoning, neurosymbolic methods and world models for engineering applications.
• Experience with multimodal AI, large language models, agentic systems, retrieval and reasoning, or AI-assisted engineering and software development.
• Evidence of research impact through high-quality publications, patents, invention disclosures, open-source contributions, awards, or successful technology demonstrations.
• Research or internship experience in automotive, mobility, aerospace, industrial, energy, defense, national laboratory, or university-industry collaboration settings.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). 

The position is subject to export control restrictions and requires the successful candidate to be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident, asylee or refugee).

Work Arrangement: 
Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Moutain View, CA three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business].  
 
Compensation: The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.

The salary range for this role is $10,300–$13,600 monthly. 

The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Start dates for this internship role are May 24th & June 14th of 2027.

jobs.title: Research and Development Intern - Smart Manufacturing Systems
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Role: 
The Materials & Manufacturing Systems Research Lab at the General Motors R&D Center located in Warren, Michigan is seeking a technically exceptional AI/ML intern with world class, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), World Models, and Agentic AI skills to perform leading edge research in the area of Smart Manufacturing Systems.
 
This is an exciting growth area at GM R&D where researchers will be part of a dynamic team focused on improving GM’s advanced manufacturing capabilities. Assignments will vary depending on background, but they will be expected to provide immediate technical and professional leadership in assignments to identify, define, and develop future strategic applications of AI into GM’s future factory operations.

Researchers are also expected to counsel GM engineering management on manufacturing engineering process, practice and tool improvements, as well as carry out leadership roles in GM programs and/or projects. They will likely represent GM in a variety of research activities with contractors and academic collaborators, and at other GM Centers, and external agencies and technical organizations. In addition, researchers are expected to develop a strong record of invention, publishing and presenting.
 
The specific research focus of the Smart Manufacturing Research Group is to develop advanced AI/ML, Agentic AI, mathematical modeling and optimization approaches and build real-time, decision support tools that enable GM’s plants to meet efficiency and quality goals. In this role, you will work hands-on to architect, build, deploy, and scale AI/ML models, agents, agentic systems that address complex manufacturing engineering and operations challenges. The ideal candidate is comfortable developing production-grade AI/ML solutions, evaluating emerging technologies, and engaging senior leaders in clear, actionable discussions on strategy, roadmap, and business impact. A background in manufacturing systems and process design, smart manufacturing, digital twins, simulation, statistics, quality management, control systems and machine vision would also be highly desirable. Experience with production operations is a plus.

What You’ll Do:   
Build, validate, deploy, and scale AI/ML models for high-impact manufacturing engineering, research and development applications.

Conduct technical work across a broad set of AI domains, including classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, Large Language Models, multimodal AI, agentic AI, World Models, and physics-based AI.

Translate business and engineering problems into practical AI/ML solution strategies and executable technical plans.

Serve as a technical authority on model development, deployment architectures, data strategy, evaluation methods, and responsible AI practices.

Generate new concepts and ideas while conducting research programs that apply the latest AI/ML tools

Drive technical assignments in a resourceful and timely manner with minimal supervision

Work well with fellow researchers, centers, operational groups, plant personnel and universities.

Maintain state-of-art technical skills and knowledge

Develop working relationships with internal and external subject matter experts

Effectively communicate and detail results through internal and external publication

Collaborate with global technical teams and lead discussions as an expert in manufacturing AI/ML

Required Qualifications:  
• Pursuit of an advanced degree (PhD or Masters) in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
• Must be a current student
• Demonstrated success building and deploying AI/ML models in production or high-value applied research environments.
• Deep expertise across multiple AI domains, including machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, generative AI, world models, and physics-based machine learning.
• Strong understanding of modern AI/ML development workflows, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
• Experience applying AI/ML to complex technical domains such as engineering, simulation, scientific computing, and advanced manufacturing engineering.
• Background in manufacturing process modeling, design, control, and optimization
• Manufacturing engineering theory and principles of production management & operations
• Excellent collaborative skills
• Proven record of high impact publications in peer-reviewed conferences/journals
• Able to work fulltime, 40 hours per week during the summer months

Preferred Qualifications:   
• PhD in relevant field of study

At Manulife John Hancock, we believe in investing in the future – starting with you. Our Technology Co-op Program is your launchpad to success, offering the support, structure, and exciting opportunities you need to thrive and make your mark. Our co-op program offers more than just experience; you'll join a vibrant community, participate in engaging events, and benefit from personalized mentorship. 

As a Data Engineer Co-op, you’ll gain hands-on experience building and supporting the data systems that power business insights and decision-making. You’ll work with modern data tools and platforms to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and workflows, helping transform raw data into meaningful, actionable information. Join a supportive team and experience a values-first culture where your career development and well-being are prioritized alongside your job impact. We offer multiple roles within this program, providing support from our diverse, passionate, and talented technology teams. You’ll receive guidance from experienced engineers while gaining exposure to data architecture, data processing, and analytics workflows in an enterprise environment. 

We are currently looking for a highly motivated student to join us in our Toronto, Ontario, Canada office for a 4-month co-op, running from January 5th – April 22nd 2027. This is a hybrid position, where you are expected to be in the office Tuesday-Thursday, with the opportunity to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.  

Position Responsibilities: 

• Contribute to a team of data engineers focused on building reliable, scalable data systems 

• Support the development and maintenance of data pipelines and workflows 

• Assist with data ingestion, transformation, and preparation for reporting and analytics use cases 

• Collaborate with engineering and business teams to understand data requirements and support solutions 

Required Qualifications: 

• Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 

• Experience with SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java) 

• Interest in data engineering concepts, including data pipelines and data processing 

• Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git, Bitbucket) 

• Strong communication skills and willingness to learn in a collaborative environment 

Preferred Qualifications: 

• Exposure to data tools (e.g., Spark, Databricks, or similar technologies) 

• Basic understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, or data warehousing 

• Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) 

• Understanding of large-scale data processing concepts 

When you join our team: 

• We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.  

• We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.  

• As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.  

• As part of our co-op program, you will gain early access to Manulife John Hancock’s premier early talent program, GRO, tailored to graduating students! This program is designed to launch your career with the support, structure, and opportunities you need to thrive. 

Application instructions: 

• Submit your resume, cover letter, academic transcript, and work term evaluation (if any) in one PDF file. 

 Please note the salary range is  expected to be between $52,650 CAD to $70,200 CAD. 

The actual salary will vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. The annual salary will be pro-rated based on the length of the work-term

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - C++
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Building trusted markets — powered by our people.
At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

Cboe interns work with a variety of staff across multiple departments and have the opportunity to put their skills to work in their field of interest, while learning about Exchange technology and operations through our robust Options Institute courses.

The three main foundational pillars of our internship program are: develop, educate and network. We want to ensure each of our interns receive a real-world working experience that encourages academic, professional and personal growth.

Candidates should be versatile, eager and able to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive financial and technical environment. To be eligible for this internship, applicants must be enrolled in a university or college program and should not be scheduled to graduate before December of the year in which the internship takes place. Our internship program runs from June to August and you will wrap up your internship with a final presentation and retreat. Visit our student page for more information about our internship program!

The Real-Time team is hiring for Software Engineer intern. 

The Real-Time Intern will work closely with the Real-Time Team as we design, develop, and support the Exchange trading system. We care deeply about system reliability, testability, recoverability, fault tolerance, throughput, and latency. We measure times in nanoseconds. Our engineers have a strong understanding of computer science fundamentals and software engineering. We are looking for like minded individuals to join us. 

Your responsibilities and learning objectives will be: 

Working alongside our software development team to contribute to projects integral to our business. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with experienced developers and fellow interns, providing hands-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex systems. You will gain practical experience writing production-quality code as you work on a high-throughput, low latency trading system in an Agile development environment. 

The ideal candidate has: 

• Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science or related field. 
• Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms. 
• Experience with C++, or experience in another language with a strong desire to learn C++. 
• Experience with Linux or UNIX-like operating systems. 
• Self-directed, self-motivated. You’ll really stand out with: 
• Knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python preferred).
• Experience with SQL.
• Knowledge of network programming fundamentals.

Benefits and Perks
• Competitive compensation
• 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire.

Some of our employees’ favorite benefits and perks include:
• Daily complimentary in-office lunch from local restaurants
• Endless free coffee and snacks to fuel your workday
• Monthly in office networking events and happy hours
• Associate Resource Groups (ARGs) and affinity groups for support and community building

More About Cboe Global Markets
We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.
Learn more about life at Cboe on our website, LinkedIn, and our student page for more information about our internship program!

Equal Employment Opportunity
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our employees’ differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

#LI-CP1
 
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Our pay range for interns is determined by function and education level. The national new hire base pay range for this job in the United States is $22.00 - $42.00 per hour. This range represents the minimum and maximum base pay target for new hires working in the position full time. 
 
Within the range, individual pay is determined by years of education completed. In addition to base pay, eligibility for our total rewards program may include benefits such as 401 (k) with a generous company match and paid sick time. Your recruiter will provide more details about the total compensation package during the hiring process

jobs.description:
As a Data Analyst Intern, you will join a collaborative analytics team focused on transforming data into actionable business insights that support strategic decision-making for our Agency Performance, Insights and Operations Division. Reporting to a Data Analytics leader, you will work with business partners to collect, analyze, and interpret data from a variety of sources, develop reports and dashboards, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and communicate findings to stakeholders. Through hands-on projects, you will gain experience using data to solve business problems, improve operational performance, and support data-driven recommendations that help achieve organizational goals.

Primary Accountabilities
• Develop an understanding of the organization’s business environments, corporate culture and structure to support work initiatives.
• Open to and supports new ideas, systems and procedures. Generate creative ideas and actions in response to changing situations.
• Supports and plans work on small projects with direction from management.
• May assume the duties normally performed in the department, alongside professionals who perform these roles.
• Presents project results to management and/or department personnel.
• Performs analytical work within the assigned functional area.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements
• Must be in student status at an accredited 4-year college or university during the internship, graduating August 2027 or later.
• Must be pursuing a Bachelors, Masters, or PhD.
• Major/program must align with internship role.
• Experience with Microsoft Office preferred
• Experience with predictive analytics, SQL, and AI tools such as Claude preferred.
• Position requires the ability to perform basic math calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) and basic statistics.
• Position requires the ability to provide verbal and written communication regarding product development issues to various departments and levels of management

This role will work a Hybrid schedule based in Madison, WI.

jobs.title: SSD Hardware Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The SSD Hardware Engineering team develops next-generation storage solutions that power data centers, AI infrastructure, client computing, and intelligent edge applications. Working across hardware, firmware, validation, manufacturing, and system engineering fields, the team delivers high-performance, reliable SSD products while using advanced design methodologies, automation, and AI-enabled engineering tools.

As an SSD Hardware Engineering Intern, you will support the design, validation, characterization, and debug of next-generation SSD products. You will gain hands-on experience with high-speed hardware design, PCB development, signal integrity, power integrity, board bring-up, and hardware validation while collaborating with multi-functional engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges and deliver industry-leading storage solutions.

Responsibilities
• Support the design, validation, characterization, and debug of SSD hardware platforms and subsystems.
• Assist with schematic reviews, PCB design activities, board bring-up, electrical measurements, and laboratory-based hardware testing.
• Perform data collection, analysis, and documentation of validation results to support product quality and performance objectives.
• Support signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), and system-level analysis through simulation, measurement, and correlation activities.
• Develop automation tools, scripts, dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering productivity, validation efficiency, and technical decision-making.
Minimum Qualifications
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, academic projects, laboratory work, or engineering experience in hardware design, electronics, embedded systems, storage systems, or related technical fields.
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Knowledge of circuit analysis, digital electronics, PCB design fundamentals, and electronic components.
• Familiarity with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, USB, Ethernet, or similar technologies.
• Understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission lines, or high-speed digital design concepts.
• Experience with building electronic circuits or PCB design tools through coursework, academic projects, research, or internships. 
• Experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, spectrum analyzers, or similar test equipment.
• Strong analytical, solving, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve productivity, technical analysis, documentation, and engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications
• Pursuing a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Coursework, research, or project experience involving high-speed digital design, hardware validation, or board-level development.
• Knowledge of SSD architecture, NAND flash memory, storage systems, embedded systems, or data center technologies.
• Experience with board-level debugging, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation.
• Familiarity with SI/PI simulation and analysis tools such as HyperLynx, ADS, Sigrity, HFSS, or equivalent technologies.
• Experience using Python, MATLAB, Tcl, or similar languages for automation, testing, and data analysis.
• Experience applying AI-assisted engineering tools, workflow automation, or data-driven analysis techniques.
• Previous internship, research, or project experience related to hardware development, validation, or electronic system design.

Job Description:

At GDIT, our people are our business. We pride ourselves on the work our innovators do to support and secure some of the most complex government, defense, and intelligence projects across the world. We wouldn’t be successful without our ability to attract new talent to join our team. 

What sets a GDIT internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry? 

GDIT’s Summer Internship Program is designed with you in mind!  Our internship provides you the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that is helping to solve our clients’ most challenging matters. Throughout GDIT’s 10-week Summer Internship Program, you will have the opportunity to do the following: 

• Work side-by-side with GDIT professionals delivering work for clients.
• Collaborate with a team of peers to research and propose solutions to a current business challenge.
• Participate in a mentoring circle led by an early career champion. 
• Interact with GDIT leaders.
• Participate in professional development.

How You’ll Make this Internship Opportunity Your Own 

Our Artificial Intelligence/ Machine Learning summer interns will work on a range of projects that ideally align with their interests. Some interns will use statistical techniques to provide insights into internal or external customer data to guide decision-making and enhance user experience. Other interns will build machine learning algorithms or work on artificial intelligence system deployments. The ideal intern will have knowledge of computer languages and their applications to enable a system to perform specific functions. 

The Must-Haves 

• Currently enrolled in an associate's, bachelor's or master's degree program in computer science, IT, engineering, or other STEM field from a United States-based college or university. 
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Office suite (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Excel, and Teams) 

What You’ll Need to Deliver Your Best Every Day 

• Problem solving and interest in big data.
• Interest in data transformation, model selection, cross-validation, and deployment 
• Interest or experience with big data platform tools 
• Knowledge of statistical techniques 
• Knowledge of Python or other programming languages 
• Experience working in a collaborative team environment. 
• Intuitiveness with an ability to identify and solve complex problems related to rapidly changing technology. 
• Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions .

GDIT interns are paid full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks. Applicants should have a minimum of one semester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. Take the first step and apply today! 

Note: We receive a high volume of applications and review them on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks of your application.

jobs.title: Differentiable Simulation Research Intern
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. 

Research in this internship will focus on scalable differentiable algorithms, including adjoint and automatic differentiation methods. The work will connect simulations with experimental data for calibration and data assimilation using AI/ML methods. These approaches will be evaluated on simulation workloads and assessed for integration into NVIDIA software used by researchers, engineers, and partner developers. If you enjoy working across mathematics, code, hardware, and engineering applications, we would love to meet!

What you'll be doing:
• Prototype GPU-native solvers with adjoint and automatic differentiation techniques for engineering simulations.
• Integrate AI-based methods with simulation algorithms for parameter calibration, inverse problems, and data assimilation using experimental or simulation data.
• Co-design numerical algorithms and differentiation strategies for GPU parallelism, memory hierarchy, mixed precision, reduced synchronization, and distributed multi-GPU execution.
• Evaluate numerical accuracy, convergence, gradient quality, performance, and scalability on workloads in CFD, mechanics, thermal systems, and multiphysics.
• Identify promising methods and help move them toward reusable capabilities in CUDA-X libraries.

What we need to see:
• Pursuing a PhD in applied mathematics, scientific computing, computational engineering, computer science, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent program area. 
• Strong foundations in algorithms related to PDEs, numerical linear algebra, iterative solvers, optimization, or scientific computing.
• Research experience with adjoint methods, automatic differentiation, inverse problems, data assimilation, gradient-aware simulation approaches, or a related area.
• Experience writing numerical software in Python and C++, with familiarity with parallel or GPU computing.
• Ability to design computational experiments, evaluate numerical and performance tradeoffs, and communicate technical results clearly.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience developing, scaling, or analyzing GPU solvers, including multi-GPU or distributed execution.
• Hands-on CUDA experience and use of profiling, benchmarking, or performance analysis to improve numerical algorithms.
• Experience calibrating computational models or assimilating experimental data in scientific or industrial applications.
• Experience with NVIDIA Warp, CUDA-X libraries, PyTorch, JAX, PETSc, Trilinos, MFEM, libCEED, OpenFOAM, or related computational science frameworks.
• Publications, open-source contributions, or deployed research software in numerical methods, scientific computing, differentiable simulation, or computational engineering.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! 

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD.
You will also be eligible for Intern benefits. ​

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 16, 2026.

Job Description

Realty Income owns and manages one of the world's largest portfolios of commercial real estate, and we've paid an increasing monthly dividend every month since 1969. We're an S&P 500 company (NYSE: O) operating across the U.S. and Europe and the work of running a portfolio at that scale spans real estate, finance, accounting, data, and technology. This is your chance to see how it actually fits together.

As a 2027 Summer Intern at Realty Income, you'll spend 10 weeks at our San Diego headquarters working on real-time challenges alongside experienced professionals and business leaders. You'll own a defined project, deliver something tangible, and present to senior stakeholders at the end of the summer. Beyond the hands-on experience, you'll get structured training, mentorship, and access to leaders across the company. Strong performers may be considered for a part-time co-op opportunity during the fall, and/or a full-time offer after graduation. This program is intended to be a pipeline into our early career roles.

You will work with a cohort of ~18 interns placed across teams including Accounting, Asset Management, Corporate Leasing, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Development, Finance Operations, Fund Accounting, Internal Audit, Investment Management, IT, Operational Excellence, and Machine Learning. Throughout the summer you’ll have the learning opportunities throughout the entire business to strengthen your skills.

• Own one end-to-end project tied to a real business priority. For example, analyzing performance across a segment of the portfolio, improving a reporting or close process, evaluating a workflow against its current state, or building a model or tool the team will keep using beyond the summer internship.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across teams
• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to analyze challenges and develop practical solutions
• Strong adaptability and learning agility, with the ability to thrive in changing environments and adopt new ways of working
• Data literacy, with an interest in using data and analytics to generate insights and inform decision-making
• Proficient with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Teams, and SharePoint, and able to learn new tools quickly

ASIC Verification Engineering Intern 

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
 
Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company, is a leading provider of next-generation networking solutions for the mobile enterprise: http://www.arubanetworks.com/company/about-us. We have an exciting opportunity for a ASIC Post-Si Verification Engineering Intern to join our team in Roseville, CA.
 
The company designs and delivers Mobility-Defined Networks that empower IT departments and #GenMobile, a new generation of tech-savvy users who rely on their mobile devices for every aspect of work and personal communication. To create a mobility experience that #GenMobile and IT can rely upon, Aruba Mobility-Defined Networks™ automate infrastructure-wide performance optimization and trigger security actions that used to require manual IT intervention. The results are dramatically improved productivity and lower operational costs.

Responsibilities:
The intern will be working with the HPE Aruba ASIC development team on next generation products. You will have a summer project that will be used for/in the development activities of current or future ASIC's. This ASIC team develops state of the art, world class Networking Chips for the marketplace and our customers. We are looking for individuals that have the desire and ability to contribute at this level.
 
The intern will be working with and learning from the senior members of the ASIC / VLSI team. Responsibilities may include RTL/Physical Design, Pre-Silicon verification; Post-Silicon verification; Formal Verification; Script &/or Tool development; schedule breakdowns, document generation, and several other possible duties. Several assignments are possible, so final alignment will be based on student skills and business needs. 
 
Education & Experience:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
• At least 3rd Year of engineering courses completed.
 
Knowledge & Skills:
• Basic programming or scripting knowledge (e.g., Verilog, SystemVerilog Python, PERL, TCL, C, C++).
• Experience with hardware design
• Strong interest in high-tech and a passion for learning.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
• Ability to work within a team environment

Impact/Scope:
• University students actively enrolled in a university/college/institution pursuing a Bachelor's degree in a technical area of study, and who typically works during school breaks and then returns to their university. While this applies to most interns, there may be opportunities for full-time students to work as part-time interns during the school year in some countries.

As an Engineering Winter Intern, you will have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge in a hands-on environment focused on embedded systems and software-related technologies.

We are looking for students with a technical foundation and a genuine interest in embedded systems, operating systems, system programming, and software development. The role is open to candidates from different academic backgrounds, provided they have relevant coursework or experience aligned with these areas.

Your Responsibilities

• Apply knowledge of embedded systems, operating systems, or system programming in a practical environment.
• Use programming knowledge in C and/or Python as part of your technical work.
• Leverage concepts learned through relevant coursework or previous technical experience.
• Learn and contribute in an environment where interns can further develop their technical skills and gain practical experience.

Your Background

• Currently pursuing a degree in a technical field such as: Computer Science Electronics Information Technology Or another related technical discipline.
• Coursework or practical experience in embedded systems is highly desirable.
• Coursework or knowledge in operating systems and/or system programming is highly desirable.
• Programming knowledge in C and/or Python.

You grow at Aptiv.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

• Immerse yourself in a full-time, Monday-Friday co-op session, that will run January – July/August (it is expected students will take a semester off from coursework to fully engage with this working mentorship opportunity).​

Our team is responsible for design and development of dozens of unique displays for Commercial and Military Avionics. Our team designs products that support the full avionics industry.
• Work with an outstanding team of engineers that develop displays for commercial and military avionics applications.
• Tackle challenges and apply problem-solving skills in a hands-on work environment.
• Create and/or implement changes to product design or development processes.

What You Will Learn:
• Display and optical technologies
• Engineering design and process best practices
• Avionics and Aerospace industry standards
•

• Must be pursuing Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Engineering and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.

• Experience working on collaborative projects and teams
• Experience with Microsoft Office (Excel)

• Ability to read hardware schematics and mechanical drawings
• Comfortable with C++ or Python
• Experience with optics and optical measurements.
• Familiar with model-based engineering
• Prior internship, coop, or other work experience

• Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
• Relocation Eligibility

jobs.title: Technologist New Grad
jobs.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future 
At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.
SALARY: £29,000 - £32,000 
Graduate / Trainee Technologist 
 
JOB PROFILE DESCRIPTION  
 
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS 

As a Graduate/Trainee Technologist with Kainos, you’ll work on projects that make a real difference to people’s lives – including the lives of people you know. 

You’ll start your journey with our AI-first Technologist Academy, where you’ll build strong foundations in modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, quality assurance, low-code development, cyber security and data & AI. 

After the academy, you’ll join our Early Careers Programme where you’ll gain hands-on experience across different roles, supported by experienced mentors and real project work. You will also continue to develop your technical, professional and business skills during this time. 

At Kainos, we operate in a fast-moving, dynamic environment, so adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are key. You’ll have the opportunity to work across different teams, projects, and business units, developing the skills to become one of our future technical leaders. 

What You’ll Experience 

Software Engineering 
You’ll learn to design, build, and maintain high-quality software solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks. Expect to work on scalable, secure applications that deliver real value to users. 

Test / QA Engineering 
You’ll develop skills in automated and manual testing, ensuring the quality and reliability of our solutions. You’ll learn how to embed quality into every stage of the development lifecycle. 

Data & AI 
You’ll explore how data and AI can transform services, from building data pipelines to applying machine learning and generative AI to solve real-world problems. 

Low Code 
You’ll use low-code platforms to rapidly deliver business solutions, learning how to combine speed with maintainability and integration best practices. 

Platforms 
You’ll gain experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and automation, ensuring our solutions are secure, scalable, and performant. 

Cyber Security 
You’ll learn how to build systems that are protected against the latest Cyber & AI security threats. You’ll learn the techniques attackers use to compromise applications and to defend against them. 

Upon Completion 
You’ll graduate from the Early Careers Programme with a broad technical foundation and the skills to shape our future. Many of our leaders started their careers this way. 
 
You will be responsible for: 
• Contributing to technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers and users. 
• Contributing to the specification, validation, implementation and operation of technology solutions, gradually taking ownership of more complex work as your capability develops. 
• Collaborating with team members to understand problems, define requirements, challenge assumptions and contribute to solution design and delivery. 
• Learning to use AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and confidence, while maintaining accountability for delivery outcomes. 
• Developing breadth across multiple delivery disciplines, including software engineering, quality assurance, platforms, data, cyber security and low-code technologies, while building deeper expertise over time. 
• Seeking feedback and continuously improving your knowledge and skills. 
Minimum essential requirements: 
• Currently studying towards, or already obtained (within the last 2 years, at point of application), at least a Level 6 bachelor’s degree in a relevant subject. 
• Must have unconditional right to work in the UK and be eligible for UK Security Clearance (for further details, see FAQS on website). 
• Familiarity with one or more technology domains, such as software development, data, testing, cloud platforms, cyber security or low-code technologies, gained through study, projects or practical experience. 
• An understanding of how technology solutions are designed, built, tested, deployed and supported, and awareness of the different activities required throughout the delivery lifecycle. 
• Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, tools and ways of working, including AI-assisted delivery approaches. 
• The ability to analyse problems, challenge assumptions, identify key information and work with others to develop effective solutions. 
• Experience using AI-assisted tools to support learning, creativity or problem-solving. 
• The ability to communicate clearly and effectively, adapting your style when working with both technical and non-technical audiences. 
• The ability to work effectively as part of a team, seek feedback, share knowledge and contribute positively to collective outcomes. 
• Exposure to source control, continuous integration, data processing, cyber security practices or cloud platforms. 
Desirable: 
• Participation in technology-related activities such as hackathons, competitions, clubs, community initiatives or open-source projects. 
  
THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING: 
 
Working Arrangements: Upon joining, you will be expected to work in your contracted office for 5 days per week for the duration of the AI-First Technologist Academy. After which, you will work in a hybrid model with 3 office days each week to support your learning and development with your team. Ensuring you are available to attend the office or client sites when required to do so. 
 
Travel expectations: At Kainos, we work with a diverse range of clients, and some of our projects require travel. If travel were required, we will endeavour to keep this to a minimum and ensure sufficient notice is provided.  
 
Popularity of scheme: We’re looking forward to receiving and reviewing your application. We strongly encourage you to apply early. If a high number of applications are received, this role may close earlier than the advertised deadline. In cases where a large volume of applications is received, the recruitment team will apply enhanced criteria to refine the shortlisting process. 

Completing your application: Please note that the application process is two parts, completing a questionnaire and uploading your CV. It is essential that you complete the questionnaire in full, to the best of your ability. We recommend avoiding the LinkedIn quick apply function, as it may alter the format of your CV and exclude important details. Instead, please apply directly via the Kainos Careers website: Your Kainos story starts here 
Once the role closes, the Job Description will no longer be accessible. We recommend saving a copy in advance. 

TIMELINES* 
 
Closing Date – Friday 23rd October 2026 
Assessment Centre – W/C Monday 16th – Wednesday 25th November 2026 
Outcomes Communicated – W/C Monday 30th November 2026 
Start Date – August 2027 
 
*Dates are subject to change due to business needs 
 
While we use innovative technology to help make our recruitment process efficient and accessible, AI doesn't make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team, and you'll get to know us by name as we guide you through each stage of your Early Careers journey. 
 
If you have any questions, please get in touch with the Kainos Early Careers Talent Acquisition Team: earlycareers@kainos.com 

Embracing our differences   
At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building
