jobs.title: Data Analyst Apprentice
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Data Analyst Apprenticeship Programme 2027
 
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one apprenticeship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered.
 
Location: Cheltenham
Start date: September 2027
Salary: £23,000
Duration: You'll join us in a permanent role from day one while completing an 18-month development programme
Structure: You’re expected to work in the office at least 3-4 days per week and must live within a commutable distance
Qualification: Level 3 Data & AI Foundations apprenticeship
 
Data Analyst Apprenticeship Programme

Turn Data into Real Business Impact
 
Ready to earn, learn and launch your career? This is more than your first job. You’ll gain real experience, work towards a recognised qualification and build skills that will shape your future.
 
Data is at the heart of everything we do. From understanding sales performance to identifying trends in claims data, our Data Science and Analytics team helps colleagues across Howden turn complex information into meaningful insights that drive better business decisions.

As a Data Analyst Apprentice, you'll learn how to work with real business data, uncover patterns, solve problems and create reports and dashboards that make a genuine impact. You'll develop the analytical and technical skills needed to work with data confidently, while learning tools such as Power BI, SQL and Python.
 
You’ll join Howden on a permanent role and complete an 18-month development programme designed to develop your technical knowledge, professional skills and confidence to kick start your career.
 
What you’ll be doing?

You will begin with a structured induction before joining our Data Science & Analytics team, where you will work alongside experienced colleagues and gradually take on more responsibility.
 
During the programme, you'll:
• Gain exposure to both data analytics and data science, helping you understand how analysis, reporting and data models can be used to solve different business problems. 
• Support a range of live data projects for different areas of the Retail business.
• Analyse datasets to understand what the information is telling us, looking for patterns, trends, gaps or unusual results that may need further investigation. 
• Clean, organise and check data before it is analysed, spotting errors or inconsistencies and helping make sure the information is accurate and reliable. 
• Learn how to turn your findings into clear reports for key business stakeholders.
• Build your technical skills by learning to use tools such as Power BI, SQL and Python.
 
Who are we looking for?

No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!

You’ll be:
• Interested in data, technology, IT or coding and eager to learn more. 
• Comfortable working with numbers and using logical thinking to understand problems. 
• A strong problem solver who enjoys spotting patterns and finding practical solutions. 
• Attentive to detail, particularly when checking information and identifying errors. 
• Able to communicate your ideas clearly and confidently.
• Someone who is keen to collaborate with different people across the business. 
• Organised and able to manage several tasks or projects at the same time. 
 
To be eligible for our apprenticeship, you must:
• Have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
• Have lived permanently in the UK for the last 3 years.
• Have achieved a grade C/4 in GCSE English and B/5 in GCSE Maths.
• Not already hold a qualification that significantly overlaps with the content of this apprenticeship.

Application process

Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!

• Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
• Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
• Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
• Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!
 
Why should you apply?

At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll gain exposure to an exciting global industry, receive structured development throughout the summer and build relationships that could shape your future career.

You'll also benefit from:
• £23,000 and a generous pension scheme.
• Completing fully funded professional qualifications relevant for your role.
• Structured learning and development through our 18-month apprenticeship development programme.
• 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
• Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.

Ready to apply?

Want to know what life at Howden is really like? Visit our Early Careers hub to explore our culture, learn more about the insurance industry, and get practical tips to help you prepare for our recruitment process. It's also a great way to work out which career path suits you best.

You can also follow our TikTok accounts, @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, for behind-the-scenes insights into life at Howden, career advice, and application tips from our Early Careers team.

Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one apprenticeship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.
 
#ECApprentice27 #RetailECA27

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
• Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

• We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

• We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustmen

jobs.title: UK Analyst Programme
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

Applications are open until 25 October 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and may close this opportunity before the advertised deadline. We encourage you to apply to ensure your application is considered. To learn more about our programmes and how to apply, please visit our website: www.mufgcampus.com  
 
Who We Are 
We are MUFG. With over 360 years of heritage and more than 160,000 employees in 50 countries, we’ve grown to become one of the top ten banks in the world.   
 
Combining our global network and financial strength with a dedication to becoming the world's most trusted financial group, we pride ourselves on exceeding client expectations and building long-term relationships. We support our clients and protect their interests with the highest levels of professionalism and expertise, while also serving society and fostering a sustainable vision for growth.  
 
We’re looking for ambitious, driven individuals to join our team, and help us to become the world’s most trusted financial group. With graduate schemes and Analysts available around the world, you will have the opportunity to learn from some of the best experts in the industry.  
 
Business Area Overview 
Markets Engineering is the technology and quantitative engineering arm that builds and maintains the systems powering MUFG.  
  
Key areas of responsibility include: 
• Pricing & Valuation systems – Libraries and platforms that price vanilla and exotic products and compute official valuations. 
• Quantitative models – Implementing, integrating, and productionizing models from Quant Research (e.g. SSABR vol surfaces, copula-based spread-option models) into robust, testable code. 
• Risk & Analytics – Delta, vega, and other sensitivities; scenario and stress frameworks; Value-at-Risk and FRTB-SA capital calculations. 
• Trade & market data infrastructure – Market data capture/curation, curve and surface construction, trade capture, and lifecycle processing. 
• Regulatory & control deliverables – Margin (IM/VM), PnL attribution, Totem/consensus submissions, and model-governance support. 
What to Expect 
Our 18-month Analyst Programme begins with a comprehensive training curriculum designed to build your understanding of our products, clients, and business strategy. This foundation will equip you with the knowledge and confidence needed to succeed as you transition into your role. 
As part of a select Analyst cohort, you'll learn from some of the most experienced professionals in the industry while building connections with peers across the programme. Our collaborative culture encourages teamwork, while also creating opportunities for you to make your own impact. In our open and inclusive environment, senior colleagues are approachable, invested in your development, and eager to support your growth. In addition, your buddy and mentor will make sure you have all the support you need to succeed. And you’ll enjoy an ongoing commitment to your development as you build a lasting and rewarding career with us. 

Key Dates 
Assessment Centre: 20th & 27th November2026 
Start Date: 19th July 2027 

Join Our Team 
We look for talented, motivated and ambitious people who will be able to help drive our business forward. 
Successful candidates will: 
 
• have strong math and programming interests  
• have a strong interest in financial markets  
• have excellent communication & interpersonal skills  
• have high levels of motivation and integrity  
• Have excellent attention to detail and accuracy  
• be innovative and have the ability to generate new and creative ideas  
• be in their final year of study or have graduated in the last 12 months  

We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.

MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership.

We make our recruitment decisions in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with our commitment to identifying the right skills for the right role and our obligations under the law.

jobs.title: Business New Grad - Data and Analytics
jobs.description:
Programme start date: September 2027
Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. 
 
Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.   
 
As a graduate, you will join the Data and Analytics Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.   
 
Our Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users, spanning over approximately 190 markets, Data & Analytics partners with the global financial community supplying extensive, quality data, news, information and analytics that inform investment decisions.  
 
We are the #1 supplier of real-time market data to the global financial and investor community, carrying up to 176 billion market messages, from over 150,000 data sources every day.  
 
This dynamic business offers graduates opportunities in London to join Data and Analytics and be aligned to Analytics or Data and Feeds. To allow us to place you in the right area we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business. 
To be eligible you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027. 
 
Highlights of the Graduate Programme  
• Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success 
• Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction 
• Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions 
• Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals 
• Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills 
• Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme 
• Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities  
 
Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to Data and Analytics, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework. 
  
What we are looking for:  
We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity for Data, who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.  
• You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.  
• A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.  
• Customer centric and product led mindset
• Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.   
• The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.  
• People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.  
• Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the US without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.   
 
You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.  
  
Application close: 28 November, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.   
 
Recruitment Process: 
• The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. 
• The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG. 
• The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style 
• The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.  
   
Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only. 
Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

jobs.title: Global Portfolio Associate - Food Safety
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

As a member of Neogen’s Global Portfolio team, the Global Portfolio Associate - Food Safety supports portfolio management activities through data analysis, project coordination, lifecycle execution, market insight development, and commercial initiatives.

Working closely with Portfolio Managers and cross-functional partners, this role helps organize and analyze portfolio information, coordinate product and commercial activities, and support informed business decisions. The position provides an opportunity to build expertise in portfolio management, commercial strategy, product lifecycle management, and the Food Safety market while contributing to global portfolio growth and optimization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Portfolio Performance and Support
• Support Portfolio Managers in monitoring the performance of assigned product portfolios.
• Track and organize portfolio information including revenue, volume, pricing, product mix, supply performance, and customer trends.
• Prepare portfolio review materials, dashboards, reports, and performance analyses.
• Gather and organize data to support portfolio reviews, planning discussions, and business decisions.
• Participate in portfolio planning activities and contribute information and analysis to support recommendations and improvement opportunities.
• Develop knowledge of portfolio management principles, business drivers, and commercial performance metrics.

Lifecycle and Portfolio Optimization
• Support product lifecycle management activities across assigned portfolios.
• Coordinate product updates involving packaging, labeling, specifications, pricing, product information, and other portfolio changes.
• Maintain portfolio documentation, product hierarchies, lifecycle records, and supporting data.
• Support initiatives designed to improve portfolio effectiveness, simplify product offerings, and enhance customer value.
• Assist with portfolio rationalization, product enhancements, and product change initiatives.
• Partner with Portfolio Managers and cross-functional teams to support lifecycle execution and established portfolio management processes.

Market, Customer, and Competitive Insights
• Gather, organize, and summarize customer, market, competitor, and industry information.
• Support market research, competitive benchmarking, and opportunity assessments.
• Compile customer feedback, sales input, Technical Services observations, and regional market insights.
• Monitor relevant market developments and communicate findings to Portfolio Managers and other stakeholders.
• Assist with the development of presentations, analyses, and recommendations based on market and customer insights.
• Build knowledge of customer applications, purchasing drivers, competitive dynamics, and market trends across Neogen’s Food Safety portfolio.

Growth and Commercial Enablement
• Support Portfolio Managers with portfolio growth, pricing, retention, and product adoption initiatives.
• Assist with the development and coordination of commercial materials, product communications, presentations, and sales resources.
• Coordinate activities with Marketing, Sales, Technical Services, Regional teams, and other cross-functional partners.
• Collect and analyze data to help evaluate the effectiveness of commercial programs and portfolio initiatives.
• Support business case development, product positioning activities, and opportunity evaluations.
• Participate in portfolio growth initiatives while developing knowledge of commercial strategy and portfolio management.

Project Support and Coordination
• Support portfolio projects and initiatives led by Portfolio Managers and cross-functional teams.
• Coordinate meetings, agendas, action items, project documentation, and follow-up activities.
• Track project milestones, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
• Gather information and prepare updates for portfolio projects and strategic initiatives.
• Identify and communicate project risks, dependencies, delays, or issues requiring escalation.
• Support product launches, continuous improvement initiatives, and other cross-functional projects as assigned.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Chemistry, Food Science, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
• Up to three years of professional experience in product management, portfolio management, marketing, commercial operations, project coordination, or a related field.
• Experience using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
• Demonstrated ability to organize and analyze data or information.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and assignments.
• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with teams across multiple functions, regions, and time zones.
• Ability to travel domestically or internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting product, portfolio, marketing, commercial, or project-based initiatives.
• Experience working with data analysis, reporting, dashboards, or business performance metrics.
• Experience supporting product lifecycle activities, product launches, pricing initiatives, or commercialization projects.
• Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, or customer insight analysis.
• Experience within food safety, food science, microbiology, diagnostics, laboratory testing, or a related industry.
• Experience working with global or geographically distributed teams.
• Familiarity with portfolio management, product management, commercial strategy, or product lifecycle management concepts.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret data and communicate relevant findings clearly.
• Ability to prepare organized reports, presentations, and business materials.
• Ability to work collaboratively across Marketing, Sales, Technical Services, Portfolio Management, and other functions.
• Ability to follow projects and deliverables through completion.
• Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Proactive approach to learning and problem solving.
• Interest in developing expertise in portfolio management, commercial strategy, and product lifecycle management.

Location and Working Style
This position is remote and requires regular collaboration with global teams across multiple functions, regions, and time zones. Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required.

Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support portfolio projects, regional meetings, customer events, product launches, and other business initiatives.

Neogen is a global company focused on protecting the world’s food supply. We provide products and solutions that support food safety, animal safety, and related industries, helping customers detect risks, improve quality, and protect both people and animals. Our work spans farms, laboratories, food production environments, and other critical areas throughout the global food supply chain.

Job Description:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES! At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. 

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. 

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE. 

Milwaukee Tool is seeking an EMC Technician 1 to join the Red Ink EMC Lab. This is an entry-level position ideal for someone interested in hands-on EMC laboratory testing. As an EMC Technician 1, you will support developmental and pre-compliance electromagnetic compatibility testing of Milwaukee Tool’s expansive products. The successful candidate will learn to operate specialized test equipment, set up and troubleshoot test configurations, collect test data, engage with test requestor stakeholders, and help maintain an organized and safe laboratory environment.

Shift Hours:
Working 1st shift from 8:00am-4:30pm

You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:
• Set up equipment, cables, antennas, probes, and test fixtures according to established lab procedures and schedule.
• Perform pre-compliance EMC testing in accordance with applicable international standards and internal test requirements.
• Operate electronic test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, amplifiers, receivers, oscilloscopes, and other laboratory instrumentation.
• Monitor tests and accurately document test results and observations through standardized test reports.
• Assist with troubleshooting test setups and resolving basic equipment or test configuration issues.
• Effectively communicate test status, issues, and significant findings to laboratory engineering staff.
• Develop familiarity with applicable EMC standards, test methods, and laboratory practices.
• Support laboratory preventative maintenance and continuous improvement efforts.
• Ensure lab safety procedures are always adhered to by all personnel in the Red Ink EMC lab.

What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:
• Associate’s degree in electrical engineering technology or related technical field. In lieu of a degree, a High School diploma accompanied by 2+ years of experience in an electrical test lab environment.
• Ability to work independently while also taking directions from engineers and experienced technicians.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately follow written procedures.
• Experience with electronic test equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, and multimeters. 
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Proven ability to successfully manage multiple tasks and consistently deliver to a deadline. 
• Ability to read and understand basic electrical schematics and technical documentation.
• Computer skills needed to navigate MS Office products, especially Excel.
• Capability to lift and manipulate 50lbs.

Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:
• Two or more years of experience working in an EMC, electrical, or electronics laboratory.
• Experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, antennas, power amplifiers, or near-field probes.
• Experience assembling or troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems.

We provide these great perks and benefits:
• Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
• Generous 401(k) savings plan.
• Education assistance.
• On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
• And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.

jobs.title: Entry Level FPGA Design/Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Collaborate with a team of hardware and systems engineers to design, verify, and integrate FPGAs for avionics hardware. As an Entry Level FPGA Design/Verification Engineer, you will support the full FPGA design lifecycle across Xilinx, Microsemi, and other device families, following the DO-254 design process. Based in Grand Rapids, MI, you will work in a team environment. Your work will take FPGA designs from requirements through simulation, documentation, and integration into circuit card assemblies.

This role offers hands-on ownership of well-defined tasks with room to grow. You will use your technical foundation and judgment to complete standard design and verification work, flex your task sequence as priorities change, and ask senior engineers for guidance when issues fall outside established procedures.

Job Description
In this role you will:

• Design, simulate, and verify FPGAs, and manage requirements using the applicable requirements tool.
• Support any phase of the FPGA design lifecycle on Xilinx, Microsemi, and other product families.
• Prepare the documentation needed for product development and DO-254 certification.
• Test and integrate the FPGA into a circuit card assembly.
• Contribute to the design and development of products, solutions, and systems, including technical improvements to existing products and components.
• Execute standard technical tasks under established instructions and work routines. Re-sequence tasks as work situations change.
• Resolve issues that call for good technical knowledge and judgment within established procedures. Consult senior team members when issues fall outside defined parameters.
• Explain technical information clearly to teammates and, for customer-facing work, serve as an interface between the customer and GE.
• Broaden your knowledge of your technical discipline and build an understanding of how your team's work fits with other teams. Lead a junior team when needed.

The Ideal Candidate

You are an early-career FPGA engineer who is comfortable with both design and verification and familiar with DO-254 discipline for avionics hardware. You take care with the quality of your own work and the work of others on the team. You also see how your FPGA fits into the circuit card assembly and the larger system.

You are curious and eager to learn. You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. You work well within a defined framework, and you know when to ask for help. You document, plan, and follow through on your commitments.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma/GED with at least 6 years of experience in the relevant Job Family Group(s)/Function(s)).
• 0–1 years of professional engineering experience, including internships and co-ops.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Zynq and PolarFire devices in system-on-chip or system-on-module applications.
• Knowledge of high-speed data interfaces and functions used in computing applications, such as PCIe, AXI bus, SERDES, and DMA.
• Knowledge of avionics interfaces and protocols such as MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, ARINC 664, and Ethernet.
• Experience with VHDL test benches, UVM test benches, and VxWorks C software.
• Familiarity with the DO-254 design process for avionics hardware.
• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
• Good interpersonal skills and willingness to lead a junior team.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information
GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Web/Full Stack Software Engineer I - Sensors, Space and Air

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Central Engineering at Micron Technology, Inc. is a rapidly growing organization that delivers critical services and drives innovation across multiple technical domains. Originally established to create economies of scale and improve efficiency for the Technology Products Group, the organization has evolved to deliver industry‑first products, core design process automation, and advanced AI and data science solutions.
Responsibilities
• Develop, enhance, and debug CAD tools, flows, and methodologies to improve the efficiency and quality of NAND, DRAM, and HBM memory designs.
• Provide production support for in-house and commercial EDA tools across design, physical layout, and verification environments.
• Deliver training, documentation, and ongoing support to end users for new tools, flows, and methodologies.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - Web
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Building trusted markets — powered by our people  

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.  

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.   

Role Overview 

Web software engineers at Cboe are tasked with designing and implementing applications, developing user interfaces and components that are critical to maintaining operational and customer readiness. This requires careful attention to detail, knowledge of algorithms and data structures, and ability to design testable and scalable systems. Cboe web services are running 24x7, and web engineers are responsible for ensuring uptime and resilience for applications that support all Cboe markets. 

We use industry-leading technologies like Python, Django, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS to build websites that handle millions of requests per day, providing high-quality market data and real-time access to Cboe exchanges for our customers and the investing public. We operate at the tip of the spear, maintaining the primary interface for command and control of Cboe markets worldwide. We are aggressive, yet agile. We care about user experience. We care about code quality. We care about testing. We care about automation. We’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Design, implement, test, extend, and maintain functionality for our web applications and systems. Good Python, JavaScript (React, NextJS), HTML/CSS, and Linux knowledge. Basic understanding of UX and the Cboe Design Systems (Chroma and Contour). Basic understanding of SQL and familiarity with relational databases. 

Implement automated unit tests and test changes to systems and platform functionality prior to deployment. 

Contribute to remediation efforts for incidents arising from own changes. 

Provide input into team sprint planning and participate in periodic team meetings. 

Participate in peer code reviews. Capable of giving and receiving constructive feedback. 

Participate in requirements gathering and analysis. Contribute to documentation, technical specifications, and requirements for our data and applications. 

Demonstrate interest in system and business knowledge and take steps to improve understanding of Cboe's markets and technology. Assertive and detail oriented, with excellent communication skills. 

Prioritize and manage time effectively across projects in a deadline-driven environment. 

Demonstrate excellent communication skills. Regular communication with technical colleagues and be a positive representation of software engineering internally and externally. 

Performs other related duties as required or requested. 

Cboe operates a flexible and hybrid work environment, with our teams working regularly from our offices in Kansas City and Chicago. 

Job Requirements 

• BS in Computer Science or demonstrable equivalent knowledge 

• 0-2 years of experience developing websites or web applications; internship, academic, or personal project experience is welcomed 

• Exposure to MVC web frameworks (Django preferred) through coursework or projects 

• Familiarity with JavaScript 

• Familiarity with Python, or experience in another language with a strong desire to learn Python 

• Familiarity with modern web standards, including HTML5 and CSS3 

• Familiarity with Linux or UNIX-like systems 

• Experience with Apache, PostgreSQL, or ReactJS is a plus 

• Experience with Python unit testing and full-stack web testing is a plus 

Benefits and Perks 

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal, and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are given at any organization. Still, you should know what we offer: 

• Medical Coverage 

• Prescription Drug Coverage 

• Additional Medical Benefit 

• Dental Coverage 

• Vision Coverage 

• 401K or Pension Company Match 

• Spending Accounts 

• Life and AD&D Insurance 

• Retirement Savings Plan 

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) 

• Voluntary & Additional Benefits 

• Paid Time Off 

More About Cboe Global Markets 

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people.  Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.   

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.  

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn. 

Equal Employment Opportunity 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.   

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)
At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $76,500-$99,000, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location. 
 
This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs. 

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.​

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

jobs.title: Hardware Design Validation Engineer New Grad - Memory Subsystem
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA's System Product Team is seeking curious, collaborative, and motivated hardware engineers to take our GPU memory subsystem from first silicon power-on to production. This role sits at the intersection of hardware and software, offering the opportunity to work directly with silicon, board, and firmware teams to shape how NVIDIA products perform from the ground up.

What you'll be doing:
• Planning and performing DDR memory tuning, validation, and feature enablement on NVIDIA products.
• Reviewing silicon design specifications, component datasheets, board schematics, and layout to inform engineering decisions.
• Applying knowledge of digital, analog, and computer design to debug and resolve controller, memory, board, and software/firmware level issues across all stages of the product lifecycle.
• Refining memory bringup and validation strategy by providing feedback and recommendations to silicon, board, and software teams.

What we need to see:
• Recently completed a BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 2+ years of relevant experience, including internships, co-ops, or research projects.
• Understanding of high-speed signal integrity and hands-on experience with oscilloscopes.
• Familiarity with schematic capture and board design.
• Working knowledge of PC systems, Windows OS, and Linux.
• Strong grasp of EE fundamentals with the ability to break down complex problems using first principles.
• Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, or Perl.
• Ability to work effectively across teams and time zones in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary environment.
• Genuine curiosity about technology and a passion for continuous learning.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience as a tutor or teaching assistant in an engineering or technical subject.
• Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to cross-functional audiences.
• Hands-on experience with memory subsystem design or validation.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite

The Program
This role is part of the Research and Development Engineering Development Program, designed to cultivate engineering and leadership skills across key areas of Stryker’s innovation ecosystem. Engineers in this program will participate in on-site functional rotations within R&D, gaining hands-on experience in critical aspects of medical device development. The program spans 20 months, beginning each September, and includes comprehensive training in both technical and professional competencies. Participants will also benefit from exposure to Senior Leadership and networking opportunities across Stryker’s global business units.

What You Get Out of the Program
Stryker, a global leader in medical technology, is committed to investing in exceptional talent. We’re seeking the brightest graduates to join our team and help shape the future of healthcare innovation.
This development journey is tailored for high-potential individuals seeking accelerated career growth. The Research and Development Engineering Development Program offers:
• Direct engagement with Senior Leadership
• Exposure to cutting-edge R&D technologies
• Executive mentorship
• Global collaboration and cross-functional training
• All of which lead to inspiring careers, lasting professional relationships, and fast-tracked career progression.

Position Summary:
As a Software Engineer, Applications at Stryker, you will support application software development and maintain design documentation for robotic-assisted surgery products. You will collaborate closely with peers and subject matter experts to develop market-leading software that meets customer and system requirements. Under supervision, you will follow the established design practices and apply sound software engineering principles to ensure that application software products are safe, robust, and user-friendly.
Mako SmartRobotics: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/joint-replacement/systems/Mako_SmartRobotics_Overview.html

Collaborative partners. People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, information, use cases, and industry analyses to develop best practices.

What You Will Do:
• Support and contribute to the design and implementation of application software that controls, navigates, and serves as the user interface for robotic surgical systems using Agile software development methodologies.
• Support and execute software product development activities under supervision in accordance with defined requirements and architecture, while adhering to established design principles and coding standards.
• Collaborate effectively with members of R&D, Quality, Marketing, and Project Management to ensure project success as a member of a Scrum team.
• Under supervision, follow established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) procedures and guidelines to ensure software quality through code reviews, unit and component testing, code analysis, and defect management.
• Assist in refining software engineering documentation in accordance with R&D procedures and the Quality Management System (QMS).

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Software, Computer Engineering / Computer Science or related discipline & 0+ years of work experience.
• 3.0 minimum cumulative GPA (or equivalent).
• Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and not require employment-based sponsorship now or in the future.
• Knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms.
• Exposure to C++ and object-oriented programming.
• Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills, and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and externally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with integrated development environments (IDEs) for projects.
• Exposure to the Qt/QML framework, Linux, Docker, and version control systems.
• Knowledge of SDLC and Agile software development.
• Experience with tools for static/dynamic software analysis, memory management, unit testing, and code coverage.
• Experience with or coursework in linear algebra, computational geometry, computer graphics, software architecture, image processing, and robotics.

BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service financial services provider. We offer corporate and investment banking, treasury management, as well as research and advisory services to clients around the world. #bmocapitalmarkets

BMO Capital Markets is seeking highly motivated quantitative talent to join its Equity Derivatives Structuring team.
 
We are looking for intellectually curious individuals who are passionate about financial markets, derivatives, and quantitative problem solving, and who are willing to invest the effort required to become experts in equity derivatives.
 
This opportunity is well suited to both outstanding recent graduates from leading quantitative programs and early-career professionals currently working in structuring, derivatives, quantitative analytics, trading, or risk management roles.
 
As part of the Structuring team, you will work alongside traders, sales professionals, engineers, and quantitative specialists to design, analyze, price, and execute equity derivative and structured investment solutions for institutional and wealth-management clients.

Position Overview
 
The successful candidate will contribute to the development and execution of equity derivatives solutions across a broad range of products, including vanilla options, light exotic derivatives, structured notes, systematic investment strategies, and volatility-based solutions.
 
The role offers significant exposure to both quantitative analysis and commercial decision-making, providing a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise while building client-facing and business skills.
 
Successful candidates will gain hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, from idea generation and quantitative modeling to trade execution and client engagement.

Key Responsibilities
Structuring & Product Development
• Design and analyze equity-linked investment and hedging solutions.
• Structure and price vanilla and light exotic derivative transactions.
• Support the development of structured notes and customized investment solutions.
• Evaluate risk-return characteristics of proposed transactions and investment strategies.
• Perform payoff analysis, scenario testing, and sensitivity analysis.
 
Quantitative Analysis & Technology
• Develop and maintain analytical tools using Python.
• Support pricing, risk management, and trade analytics platforms.
• Conduct quantitative research on derivatives pricing, volatility, and market behavior.
• Identify opportunities to automate and enhance existing processes and workflows.
 
Client Solutions & Commercial Development
• Partner closely with sales and trading teams to deliver customized client solutions.
• Prepare quantitative analyses and marketing materials supporting client transactions.
• Learn to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and effectively.
• Participate in client discussions and presentations as experience develops.
 
Collaboration
• Work closely with traders, sales professionals, quantitative researchers, risk managers, and technology teams.
• Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and client-focused culture.
• Demonstrate ownership, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence.

Qualifications
Required
• Master's degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong quantitative undergraduate academic background.
• Strong programming skills in Python.
• Solid understanding of derivatives pricing and options theory.
• Knowledge of stochastic calculus, probability theory, and quantitative modeling techniques.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Demonstrated interest in financial markets and derivatives.
 
Preferred
• Internship or professional experience within derivatives, structured products, structuring, trading, quantitative research, or risk management.
• Familiarity with equity derivatives and volatility products.
• Exposure to numerical methods and derivatives pricing models.
• Experience working with financial datasets and quantitative analytics tools.

Successful candidates typically demonstrate:
 
• Strong quantitative aptitude.
• Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning.

• Strong work ethic and attention to detail.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Collaborative mindset and team orientation.
• Entrepreneurial attitude and willingness to take initiative.

Why Join BMO?
This role provides a unique opportunity to build a career at the intersection of quantitative finance, trading, and client solutions.
 
You will receive direct exposure to:
 
Equity derivatives and structured products
Volatility and options markets
Trade structuring and execution
Quantitative modeling and analytics
Institutional and wealth-management clients

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher - AI for Earth System Sciences
jobs.description:
Argonne National Laboratory, a U.S. Department of Energy national laboratory located near Chicago, Illinois, has an opening for a highly motivated post-doctoral appointee at the Decision and Infratsructure Science (DIS) Division. Recently Argonne had successfully developed AI foundation models for weather and Seasonal-to-subseasonal forecasting, hydrology and urban digital twins. As we move many of these models from development to application to infrastructure and resilience workflows within DIS and supporting DOE and private sector utilities, we have started building out a team to support these fforts. A successful candidate will collaborate with scientists in DIS, Environmental Sciences division and Argonne leadership Computing Facility to further develop the AI foundation models, benchmarking and deploy them for applications.

The ideal candidate would be a PhD in geophysical sciences, computer science, or machine learning with experience in developing and verifying deep learning-based models for large dynamical systems (e.g. weather, hydrology). Expertise in data and model parallelisms for distributed training on large GPU-based machines is essential. Candidates with experience using diffusion-based or other generative AI methods and multimodal data training approaches, fine tuning and optimizing inference is desired. Background in atmospheric science, especially weather modeling, are particularly sought after. This is a one-year position that can be extended to two years that we want to fill immediately.

Contributes technical expertise through analysis and support for programs and projects associated with machine learning, HPC, and computational problems related to earth system science and other dynamical systems. Development, evaluation, and applying machine learning/computational approaches, synthesis activities, computational tools, compiling results, preparing reports, publications, and documentation. In particular, this position is for projects related to applying and developing machine learning-based weather models for the S2S timeframe with an emphasis on generative AI techniques, evaluating such models, and working with a team of scientists interested in pushing the boundary of predictability.

Position Requirements
• Recent or soon-to-be-completed PhD (completed within the last 0-5 years) in geophysical sciences, computer science, or machine learning with 0 to 2 years of experience
• Knowledge of deep learning, PyTorch/ JAX, and scaling deep learning models to large GPU-based machines
• Knowledge in training domain specific AI foundation models built using transformers, GNN and diffusion
• Technical knowledge in using HPC systems for visualization and analysis
• Technical knowledge of large, dynamical systems (preferability the atmosphere)
• Knowledge and experience in writing scientific code
• Skills in clear, concise writing of technical papers, and interacting and communicating effectively with colleagues.
• Problem solving skills.
• Organizational skills and flexibility in coordinating a broad spectrum of activities.
• Knowledge of atmospheric dynamics, process scale models, and numerical computation techniques
• Knowledge of data analysis
• Knowledge of using atmospheric and hydrological observational datasets, data assimilation techniques, and statistics. 
• Ability to work and communicate with stakeholders from public and private sectors
• Some familiarity in subseasonal-to-seasonal modeling and or coupled atmosphere-ocean modeling
• A successful candidate must have the ability to model Argonne’s Core Values: Impact, Safety, Respect, Integrity, and Teamwork.

Postdoctoral

Job Profile
Postdoctoral Appointee

Worker Type
Long-Term (Fixed Term)

Time Type
Full time

jobs.title: Engineer 1 - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Job Description
About the team
Every item Nordstrom sells passes through a receiving dock before it reaches a customer. The Building Technology Inbound team builds and runs the applications that make that happen. Our portfolio of services supports receiving across Nordstrom's Supply Chain facilities, keeping inventory flowing accurately and quickly from the moment it arrives. When our systems work, product reaches stores and customers faster. When they don't, the effects show up on the dock floor within minutes, so the work has real, visible impact.
We work in a modern stack (Kafka, Spring Boot, Postgres, AWS, Kubernetes) and use AI-assisted development, including Claude Code, as part of how we build.

About the role
As an Engineer 1, you'll join an experienced team and take on well-scoped work across our inbound application portfolio. You'll write, test, and ship production code, learn how a warehouse really operates, and grow quickly with support from senior engineers and an engineering manager invested in your development.

What you'll do
• Design, build, and maintain Java/Spring Boot services and REST APIs that support receiving operations
• Develop event-driven integrations using Kafka
• Write and optimize queries and schemas in Postgres
• Deploy and operate containerized services on Kubernetes and AWS
• Write automated tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines
• Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback
• Participate in a week-long on-call shift that rotates among team members, helping troubleshoot and resolve production issues (with support from senior engineers as you ramp up)
• Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, while owning the quality of what you ship
• Partner with product, operations, and other engineering teams to turn operational needs into working software

What we're looking for

Required
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Professional software engineering experience (internships and substantial project work count)
• Working knowledge of Java or a similar object-oriented language
• Understanding of REST API design and general web service concepts
• Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
• Solid fundamentals: data structures, testing, version control (Git)
• Clear communication and a habit of asking good questions

Nice to have
• Exposure to Spring Boot, Kafka, or other messaging and streaming systems
• Exposure to Kubernetes and containerization (e.g., Docker), or experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.)
• Supply chain, warehouse, or logistics experience, such as WMS, receiving, inventory, or fulfillment. This is a real advantage, but we'll teach you the domain if you bring curiosity.

What success looks like
• First 90 days: You've shipped production changes, understand how receiving flows through our systems, and can navigate our services and tooling independently.
• First year: You own features end to end, contribute meaningfully to operational stability, and are a trusted teammate on the team.

Why join us
You'll work on systems where software meets the physical world, with a team that values craftsmanship, learning, and sensible use of AI tooling. Nordstrom offers a strong legacy, a supportive culture, and room to grow.

jobs.title: Design Manual Publishing & Ground Rule Validation Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries 
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com. 

New College Graduates Overview: 
We offer many full-time employment paths for recent graduates, which provide accelerated training in a fast-paced work environment, cross-functional working opportunities, and talent mobility. New college graduates are provided with mentorship, networking, and leadership opportunities, which give our new team members life-long connections and skills.​ 

Summary of Role: 
GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Design Manual Publishing & Ground Rule Validation Engineer to join the RF Design Enablement organization. This role develops, validates, documents, and publishes semiconductor design rules and Design Manual content that enable reliable, manufacturable, and customer-ready use of GlobalFoundries technologies. 

Essential Responsibilities include: 
• Partner with Process Integration, Manufacturing, Device Engineering, Customer Engineering, Program Management, PDK Development, and EDA teams to identify technology features and process limitations requiring design-rule coverage. 
• Participate in the development, optimization, and qualification of semiconductor design rules across multiple technology platforms. 
• Perform design-rule margin calculations using process, reliability, yield, and silicon-characterization data. 
• Develop layout-based Designs of Experiments (DOEs) and electrical test structures for inclusion on technology test vehicles. 
• Coordinate Ground Rule Validation activities from layout creation through silicon measurement and data collection. 
• Analyze silicon characterization results using statistical and data-mining techniques to assess rule robustness and manufacturability. 
• Generate technical reports and recommendations supporting design-rule qualification decisions. 
• Drive continuous improvement of design rules and process assumptions based on measured silicon data. 
• Own the preparation, review, publication, and maintenance of Design Manual content delivered as part of GlobalFoundries PDK releases. 
• Collaborate with PDK teams and technology stakeholders to collect, validate, and document publication requirements. 
• Ensure Design Manual content is technically accurate, complete, consistent, and aligned with approved design rules. 
• Execute document quality-assurance reviews, change tracking, revision control, and publishing workflows. 
• Support Design Manual release-readiness reviews and publication milestones. 
• Maintain documentation repositories, publication records, release notes, and supporting documentation artifacts. 
• Improve Design Manual publishing processes, templates, tools, and automation workflows. 

Other Responsibilities: 
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications: 
• Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Solid State Physics or related field from an accredited degree program. 
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing. 
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) 
• Strong organizational and documentation skills, with careful follow-through on day-to-day work and commitments. 
• Strong data analysis, data mining, and problem-solving skills. 
• Understanding of semiconductor process fabrication flow, nanofabrication, solid-state and semiconductor-device physics, and Design of Experiments methodology. 
• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
• Familiarity with EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso Schematic Editor, Virtuoso Layout Suite, and Calibre DRC and LVS. 

Preferred Qualifications: 
• Prior related internship or co-op experience. 
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
• Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. 
• Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Strong planning & organizational skills 
• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Solid State Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant engineering discipline, with 0 to 2 years of semiconductor-industry experience in device engineering, process integration, or unit-process areas. 
• PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Solid State Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant engineering discipline; or demonstrated ability to solve complex, non-recurring problems with initiative and creativity.

jobs.title: Test Development Engineer
jobs.description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity
Allegro Microsystems is looking for an enthusiastic Test Development Engineer to join our Product and Test Engineering team.
 
In this role, you will work closely with senior test engineers, IC designers, and product engineering teams to develop automated test solutions—including C++ test programs and custom hardware interface boards—used to test our high-performance mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs) during wafer probe and final package manufacturing. This is an exciting, hands-on opportunity to build expertise in semiconductor Automated Test Equipment (ATE), first-silicon bring-up, and production release in a collaborative, supportive environment.
 
What You Will Do
• Collaborate with senior engineers to write, debug, and maintain modular test programs in C/C++ on Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to evaluate analog and mixed-signal sensor and power ICs.
• Assist in the design, schematic capture, and checkout of custom test hardware, including Device Interface Boards (DIBs/loadboards), probe interface boards (PIBs), probe cards, and socket hardware.
• Participate in first-silicon bring-up, collecting correlation data to validate bench measurements against ATE results across operating temperature ranges.
• Perform statistical data analysis (using tools like JMP, Python, or Excel) to evaluate Gage R&R, characterize parametric distributions, identify test yield issues, and support test-time reduction (TTR) efforts.
• Partner with IC Design, Product Engineering, Quality, and global manufacturing teams (including AMPI) to release robust, automotive-grade test solutions into high-volume manufacturing.
• Use standard bench instrumentation (oscilloscopes, arbitrary waveform generators, DMMs, power supplies) and thermal systems to debug hardware and software test routines.
 
What You Will Need
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering Technology (EET), or a closely related field.
• 0 to 5 years of academic, internship, co-op, or industry experience in electronics testing, hardware lab bring-up, or semiconductor environments.
• Foundational knowledge of C/C++ (object-oriented programming) and/or Python for test execution, scripting, and data collection.
• Solid understanding of analog and mixed-signal circuits, with hands-on proficiency using standard lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters).
• Basic exposure to schematic capture and PCB layout fundamentals (e.g., Altium, OrCAD, KiCad, or similar tools).
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, eagerness to learn complex mixed-signal systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a One Allegro mindset.
 
Desired Qualifications 
• Hands-on exposure to semiconductor Automated Test Equipment (ATE), particularly Teradyne / Eagle Test Systems (ETS-88, ETS-364, ETS-800), Advantest, or Cohu platforms.
• Familiarity with wafer probers (e.g., TEL) or automated IC handlers.
• Exposure to semiconductor data formats (STDF) and statistical process control concepts (e.g., normal distributions, , Gage R&R, JMP).
• Coursework or project experience in power electronics, sensor interfaces, semiconductor physics, or Design for Testability (DFT).
 
 Applicants for this position must be legally authorized to work in the U.S without employer sponsorship, now or in the future. The company will not sponsor employment visas for this position, including F-1, OPT, CPT or other work authorization requiring future sponsorship.

Why Allegro?
 
Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
We foster a culture of Real Innovation, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.
You’ll experience Real Connection, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.
Join us—and help build what’s next.

jobs.title: Graduate Health Data Analyst New Grad - Access and Innovation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job title: Graduate Health Data Analyst
Location: Burgess Hill, West Sussex (hybrid)
Length of programme: 2 years (September 2027 - August 2029)

Our Early in Career Development Programme accelerates your growth to directly impact patients' lives. Start your career with a UK market leader in biotechnology, recognised as the #1 Best Big Company to Work For (2021) and dedicated to equity, diversity, and inclusion.

The Opportunity
The Access & Innovation team works to demonstrate and enable the value of diagnostics for patients and the UK NHS. Within the team, Health Economics uses clinical, economic and real-world evidence to understand NHS patient pathways, demonstrate value and support healthcare decision-making. As a Graduate Health Data Analyst, you will analyse healthcare data to identify gaps and inequalities in care, helping shape improvements to NHS pathways that could enable earlier diagnosis, better access to care and improved outcomes for patients. Alongside this, you will develop skills in real-world evidence, clinical study development, health economics and market access. Throughout the two-year programme, you will benefit from ongoing support and development opportunities, gaining exposure to projects across Access & Innovation while building both technical and broader healthcare strategy skills.

Key responsibilities 
• Analyse UK healthcare datasets, including Hospital Episode Statistics (HES), Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) data, disease registries, national clinical audits and other NHS datasets, to identify trends, variations in care and opportunities to improve patient pathways.
• Support the design and delivery of real-world evidence studies, including defining clinical and health economic outcomes, prospective data collection and retrospective analysis of existing healthcare databases and registries.
• Use analytical tools such as R to clean, analyse and interpret healthcare data.
• Develop clear data visualisations, dashboards and pathway maps using tools such as Power BI and R Shiny, while exploring how digital and AI-enabled tools can support evidence generation.
• Generate data insights to support health economic analyses, NHS business cases and access strategies, helping demonstrate the value of diagnostics to patients and healthcare systems.
• Collaborate with teams across Health Economics, Market Access and the wider Access & Innovation function.

Who are you
To be successful in this opportunity, applicants should also have:
• Recent graduate with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Statistics, Medical Sciences, Epidemiology or Health Economics. We welcome candidates from a range of academic backgrounds who can demonstrate strong practical data analysis skills or the potential to develop these.
• Some practical experience using R or another statistical programming language for data analysis, with knowledge of SQL or database querying desirable.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with confidence working with data and quantitative information.
• Strong attention to detail, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly.
• Curious, collaborative and motivated to develop new skills, with an interest in healthcare, real-world evidence and applying digital and AI technologies to improve healthcare decision-making.

Please note: Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must already hold a valid authorisation to work in the UK.

Application process:
Stage 1: Submit your CV and cover letter
• Our focus is to understand why you have applied for this role and what you will bring to the role to ensure team and personal success. 
• Applications close on Friday, 16 October 2026. The application process may be extended beyond this date but could close at any point after this time.
Stage 2: Recorded video interview 
• You will take part in a recorded video interview, where you will be presented with questions and record your answer to support your application
• Estimated date: November 2026
Stage 3: In person assessment centre 
• You will take part in our full day in person assessment centre at our Roche offices in Burgess Hill, Sussex. Further details will be provided if successful.
• Expected date: w/c 07 December 2026. The exact date will be provided if successful.

Ready to apply? Go ahead and join us, we are waiting for you! 

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
