jobs.title: Software Engineer 1 - Ground Software
jobs.description:
Sierra Space Careers:
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. 

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role
The Software Engineer I role involves designing, developing, and testing software applications for space systems and technologies. This entry-level position is ideal for individuals with a basic understanding of programming languages and software development principles who are eager to grow their skills in a collaborative environment. The role includes writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating with senior engineers, and staying current with industry trends.

In this role, you will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies while writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards. You will collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently. Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members. You will participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards, troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner, and document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference. Additionally, you will stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team.
About You
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. 

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Requires bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
• Typically, 0 - 2 years of experience.
• Basic understanding of one or more programming languages and software development principles.
• Ability to write clean, maintainable code.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required

Preferred Qualifications:
• Frontend development experience, preferably using React, Typescript, NodeJS, FastAPI or similar.
• Familiarity with both Windows and Linus/Unix development environments.
• Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, sockets, client-server architectures).
• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and/or automated testing frameworks.
• Exposure to command and control (C2), telemetry, or mission-operations software concepts.
• Basic understanding of spacecraft, satellite, or ground system operations concepts.
• Understanding of Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team environment.

Compensation:

Pay Range:
$83,999.00 - $115,498.25
Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Elevate Your Career
At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. 
 
We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified. 

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

Sierra Space Careers:
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. 

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role
The Software Engineer I role involves designing, developing, and testing software applications for space systems and technologies. This entry-level position is ideal for individuals with a basic understanding of programming languages and software development principles who are eager to grow their skills in a collaborative environment. The role includes writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating with senior engineers, and staying current with industry trends.

In this role, you will design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies while writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards. You will collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently. Utilizing version control systems such as Git, you will manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members. You will participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards, troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner, and document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference. Additionally, you will stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team.
About You
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. 

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Requires bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
• Typically, 0 - 2+ years of experience.
• Basic understanding of one or more programming languages and software development principles.
• Ability to write clean, maintainable code.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Some exposure to or coursework/project experience related to DevOps/DevSecOps practices.
• Basic proficiency in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline concepts (e.g., GitHub Actions or GitLab CI).
• Basic familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker.
• Familiarity with Linux environments. 
• Foundational understanding of security and software development best practices.
• Coursework or project experience with C/C++ build tools is a plus (CMake, Conan).
• Ability to assist in identifying inefficiencies in development workflows under guidance.
• Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills, with eagerness to learn from senior team members.
• Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
• Exposure to orchestration tools like Kubernetes is a plus.
• Basic exposure to infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
• Exposure to logging and monitoring tools (ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana).

Compensation:

Pay Range:
$83,999.00 - $115,498.25
Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Elevate Your Career
At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. 
 
We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is identified. 

Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

What You Will Do

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

Join the Space and RF Sensors Software team at Raytheon, where we develop cutting-edge software applications focused on solving our customers' toughest defense challenges. In this role, you will be part of an elite software engineering team to design, code, integrate, and test critical real-time embedded software with applications to advanced next generation radar, sensor, guidance, and fire control systems. Operating at the leading edge of technology, you will contribute across all phases of the software development lifecycle to deliver innovative solutions that help keep our nation and allies safe.

Key Responsibilities:
• Work on complex technical problems and collaborate to provide innovative solutions. Requires investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions.
• Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration, dependent on program phase
• Assist in the derivation of system and software requirements, architectural modeling, and technical analysis
• Design, code, unit test, integrate, and document real-time embedded software solutions with a focus on RF, radar modes and sensing capabilities.
• Participate actively in software peer reviews, code inspections, and technical decision-making alongside multidisciplinary teams, including program leadership and customers
• Support program execution to ensure work products meet technical, cost, schedule, and quality baselines.
• Follow established software development processes and practices to maintain software product integrity.
• This position requires the eligibility to obtain a security clearance. Except in rare circumstances, only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.
 
Qualifications You Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from accredited institution. Degree must be obtained by start date.
• Experience developing, and testing or debugging software using C, C++, or similar object-oriented programming language
• Real time embedded software development experience
• Familiarity with computer scripting languages such as Python
• Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving experience
• Experience developing software in a team-based development environment with strong teamwork and communication skills. 
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

Qualifications We Prefer
• Knowledge of Software Development Processes and experience participating in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, implementation, and testing
• Experience working with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and automated build environments.
• Familiarity with Scrum/Agile, DevSecOps, Git/GitLab
• Hands-on experience developing low-level device drivers or real-time embedded operating system (RTOS) applications.
• Hands-on experience with hardware-software integration and embedded system testing
• Familiarity working with physical hardware 
• Familiarity and practical application of fundamental data structures and algorithms.
• Practical exposure to radar technologies, radar signal processing, or RF systems.
• Experience with developing and integrating software for Radar systems
• Experience developing embedded software utilizing ADA, Rust or similar secure programming languages
• Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of cybersecurity principles
• Experience working on UNIX, Redhat Linux, Windows, VxWorks, Green Hills, Integrity or other Real Time Operating Systems.
• Familiarity with Unified Modeling Language (UML)
• Experience developing low-level code for microcontrollers or platforms like Arduino or Raspberry Pi
• Familiarity with cryptographic algorithms (e.g., AES, RSA, ECC) and their application in software assurance
• Understanding of anti-tamper techniques and methods for protecting intellectual property and sensitive data
• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and developing secure software systems
• Familiarity with static and dynamic code analysis tools, such as Coverity, Fortify, or SonarQube

Job Title: Entry Level C# Software Engineer

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI is looking for a C# Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain software tools that keep aircraft safe and operational. Your work will directly impact the Navy’s F/A-18 fleet readiness by enhancing maintenance detection software and anomaly detection algorithms. This role requires travel to NAVAIR Oceana for software deployment and troubleshooting. Candidate must reside in the greater Virginia Beach area.

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop full stack applications for aircraft maintenance detecting and reporting. 
• Develop responsive and user-friendly front-end interfaces while contributing to back-end integration and API development to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
• Collaborate effectively within a cross-functional Agile team, participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
• Build robust backend services with C# to manage large datasets.
• Perform thorough software testing and debugging to ensure functionality, reliability, and performance, identifying and resolving issues throughout the development lifecycle.
• Write clean, efficient, and scalable code following best practices and coding standards to ensure maintainability and long-term performance of applications

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.
Summary of the role
As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.

Job Summary

Responsible for evaluating mechatronic systems as part of an interdisciplinary team with the expectation of providing technical feedback and suggestions for improvement. May include mix of analog and digital design working with microcontrollers, sensors, and associated firmware and software. jobs.title: Software Engineer 1
jobs.description:
About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.
 
Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

About the Role
Centric Software is seeking a motivated Software Engineer I to join our product development organization. This is an entry-level software engineering position for candidates who have a strong foundation in computer science and software development and are eager to grow their skills while contributing to production software used by customers around the world.
As a Software Engineer I, you will work as part of an agile development team alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and quality engineers. You will contribute to product features, resolve defects, improve existing functionality, and develop the technical and professional skills needed to become an increasingly independent software engineer.
You will receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and hands-on experience with Centric Software's development practices, tools, architecture, and products.

Responsibilities
Software Development
• Design, implement, test, and maintain software features under the guidance of experienced engineers.
• Work on user stories, product enhancements, technical tasks, and defect resolution as part of an agile development team.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that follows established engineering standards and best practices.
• Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve code quality and technical skills.
• Investigate software defects, identify root causes, and implement appropriate fixes.
• Develop an understanding of the existing application architecture and make changes that integrate effectively with the broader product.

Technical Areas 
Depending on team needs, product area, and individual strengths, you may contribute in one or more of the following areas:
• Full-Stack Development: Develop product functionality across front-end and back-end components using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Java, and related frameworks.
• Front-End Development: Build responsive, maintainable user interfaces and reusable components while delivering a high-quality user experience.
• Back-End Development: Develop server-side services, business logic, APIs, and application components with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.
• Database Development: Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, queries, performance optimization, and integration with application features.
• AI and Emerging Technologies: Contribute to selected projects involving Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, machine learning, or AI-enabled product capabilities.

Engineering Practices
• Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements clarification, design, implementation, testing, code review, deployment, and defect resolution.
• Use source control, continuous integration, automated testing, and issue-tracking tools as part of the team's development workflow.
• Create unit and automated tests to verify software behavior and reduce regressions.
• Learn and apply secure, scalable, and maintainable software engineering practices.
• Use modern development tools, including AI-assisted development tools where appropriate, to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality and accountability.
Collaboration and Growth
• Collaborate effectively with engineers, QA, product managers, and other members of the product organization.
• Ask questions, seek feedback, and communicate technical issues, progress, and risks clearly.
• Take increasing ownership of assigned work as technical knowledge and experience grow.
• Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other team activities.
• Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
• Work with an assigned mentor and engineering manager to establish development goals and build technical depth.
• Develop toward independently delivering well-defined product features and resolving increasingly complex technical problems.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Foundational knowledge of software development concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design.
• Programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, research, or professional experience.
• Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++, or a similar language.
• Understanding of fundamental web application concepts, APIs, databases, and client/server architecture.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and work within an existing, large-scale software codebase.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively within a software development team.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial but not required:
• Java and Java-based server-side development
• JavaScript and TypeScript
• React, Angular, Node.js, or similar web technologies
• HTML and CSS
• SQL and relational databases
• NoSQL databases
• REST APIs and distributed applications
• Git and Bitbucket
• Jira and other Agile development tools
• Jenkins or other continuous integration/continuous delivery tools
• Unit testing frameworks such as JUnit
• Cloud technologies and containerized applications
• Natural Language Processing, machine learning, or Large Language Models
• AI-assisted software development tools

What Success Looks Like
During your first year as a Software Engineer I, you will progressively:
• Become proficient with Centric Software's development environment, tools, processes, and product architecture.
• Successfully complete well-defined engineering tasks and product stories with appropriate guidance.
• Develop the ability to investigate and resolve software defects independently.
• Consistently write maintainable code supported by appropriate testing.
• Incorporate code-review feedback and demonstrate continued improvement in engineering quality.
• Communicate effectively with your team regarding requirements, technical decisions, progress, and risks.
• Take increasing ownership of features from implementation through validation and delivery.
• Build the technical foundation required to progress toward a Software Engineer II role.
Work Environment
This position operates in a collaborative development environment. Depending on the team and product area, employees may work in a remote or hybrid arrangement that includes regular collaboration from Centric Software's Campbell, California office.
Specific in-office expectations will be communicated based on team requirements.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Test Research Associate - Research Associate II - Electrical Systems
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Physical Sciences Laboratories (PSL) supports the effective and timely development and operation of national security systems through scientific research and the application of advanced technologies. PSL has more than 150 specialized laboratories used to test, analyze, and troubleshoot virtually every aspect of rocket and satellite system design, development, construction, deployment, and operation. The expertise of the laboratories’ technical staff allows PSL to stay abreast of new technological developments and program support issues associated with rapidly evolving space systems.

The Microelectronics Technology Department (MTD) is part of PSL with specialized laboratories used to test, accelerate, and analyze, failures in electronics used for space system. MTD is comprised of three sections: one that performs radiation effects testing, one that performs electrical characterization of microelectronics, while the third section performs failure analysis on microelectronics using tools that can identify anomalies from the macroscopic down to the atomic scale. We are looking for a Semiconductor Test Research Associate (Research Associate II - Electrical Systems) who will support principal investigators and staff scientists, in conducting electrical measurements of CMOS, III-V and novel material technologies in addition to designing printed circuit boards (PCB). Work will include using probe stations to perform measurements on bare die, as well as building test setups to evaluate packaged components.

Highlights of our lab’s capabilities can be seen here: Virtual Tour

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA.
 
What You’ll Be Doing
• Performing electrical measurements on, bare die using automated and manual probe stations, or packaged parts using test fixtures
• Assemble test setups based on requirements provided by the principal investigator
• Programing laboratory instruments using LabView or Python
• Collecting and analyzing measurement data
• Preparing reports and presentations to present measurement results
• Maintain equipment capability by ensuring it is calibrated and serviced when needed
• Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed 
• Training and mentorship will be provided 
 
What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring 
• Strong written and oral communication skills 
• Must work well in a team environment 
• Possess organizational, time management and project management skills 
• Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need 
• Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations 

What You Need to be Successful
Minimum Requirements:  
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university program in electrical engineering, computer engineering, material science, physics or related discipline (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)  
• 0-1 year of industry work experience 
• General knowledge of semiconductor devices and circuits
• Experience working in a lab environment while following laboratory safety protocols
• Ability to quickly troubleshoot problems
• This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance. 
• Transcripts
 
How You Can Stand Out 
It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:  
• Experience in the space industry, including internships
• Experience using benchtop lab equipment such as semiconductor parameter analyzers, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, DC power supplies, switch matrix, multimeters, etc.
• Experience automating lab instruments using python, LabVIEW, or other programming language
• Experience designing multilayer PCB
• Familiarity with testing III-V technologies, such as GaN HEMT
• Ability to handle multiple priorities and projects simultaneously

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)
$37.44 - $56.16

Pay Basis: Hourly
Leadership Competencies
Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:
• Operate Strategically
• Lead Change   
• Engage with Impact   
• Foster Innovation   
• Deliver Results 

Ways We Reward Our Employees 
During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.
Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:
• Comprehensive health care and wellness plans

• Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation

• Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options

• 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire

• Flexible spending accounts

• Variable pay program for exceptional contributions

• An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . jobs.title: FPGA Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments. 

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

THE OPPORTUNITY 
Silvus is seeking an FPGA Design Engineer who will report to the Director of FPGA Engineering on the FPGA Engineering team. The successful individual in this role participates in all aspects of the research and development process from concept to field deployment. FPGA Design Engineers are responsible for the efficient implementation of novel signal processing algorithms for Silvus' MIMO wireless networking products. In addition, they participate in the support and development of FPGA-based designs for our advanced wireless systems R&D. These are exciting projects aimed at addressing challenging real-world communication needs. 

This position is based at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant West Los Angeles, CA, and is on a hybrid schedule. A minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion. 

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Digital design architecting for wireless communication projects.
• Fixed point design of signal processing blocks while working with systems engineers.
• RTL coding, simulation, and test bench development.
• FPGA synthesis and timing closure.
• Hardware verification and troubleshooting; familiarity with logic analyzers.
• Provide support to the RF and Software Engineering teams.
• Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field plus a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in FPGA design; OR an advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• Proven expertise working with multiple clock-domain, high-utilization FPGA designs.
• Experience with Xilinx FPGAs, SoCs, and the Vivado IDE.
• Experience with tcl or python.
• Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.
• All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
• Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE).
• Demonstrated experience with fixed point binary arithmetic, and digital signal processing designs.
• Experience using MATLAB.
• Experience with communication systems on FPGA or ASIC designs.
 
WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
• Office environment.
• Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:• Lift equipment up to 20 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.
• Perform bending and reaching movements to place items on lower and higher shelves.
• Kneeling or squatting to access lower shelves.
• Walking/Moving in the labs.

COMPENSATION: $110,000 - $150,000 / annually

jobs.title: Product Manager 2
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$100,000.00 - $136,500.00
Location:
Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

The Opportunity
The Product Manager supports the development, commercialization, and growth of service products within the Etch Service Business Unit. This role partners with product management, engineering, sales, field service, operations, and finance teams to identify customer needs, analyze market opportunities, support business planning, and execute product growth initiatives.
The successful candidate will contribute to product strategy execution, market analysis, customer engagement, and portfolio management activities while developing expertise in semiconductor equipment services, product management, and service commercialization.

Key Responsibilities
• Support the development and execution of product and business strategies for assigned service offerings.
• Analyze customer requirements, market trends, competitive activity, and installed-base opportunities to identify growth opportunities and business insights.
• Assist in developing product requirements, value propositions, pricing recommendations, and go-to-market plans.
• Support commercialization activities, including product launches, sales enablement, customer communications, and marketing collateral development.
• Track and analyze business performance metrics, including revenue, adoption, market penetration, profitability, and customer feedback.
• Develop forecasts, business analyses, market assessments, and management presentations.
• Collaborate with engineering, service operations, sales, marketing, and finance teams to support product lifecycle activities.
• Participate in customer meetings and voice-of-customer initiatives to better understand customer challenges and business requirements.
• Support annual operating plans, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning processes.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer - System Integration Labs
jobs.description:
Our engineers are the technical visionaries behind our innovative solutions. Globally recognized for delivering cutting-edge systems, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate across functions, and lead advancements that shape our industry. Supported by a culture of flexibility, growth, and innovation, join us to create a lasting legacy in safety and simulation. 
Description
As a Software Developer, you will develop real-time simulation software used in military aircraft system integration laboratories. These engineering simulators reproduce aircraft systems and functions so that teams can test and validate software before it is installed on an aircraft. The emphasis is on aircraft controls and system behaviour rather than visual simulation.

Responsibilities
• Develop object-oriented software components, primarily in C++, to reproduce aircraft behaviour in real time.
• Simulate the digital and analog signals associated with the aircraft’s avionics systems.
• Participate in all phases of software development, including problem analysis, requirements definition, design, implementation, informal testing, troubleshooting, and integration.
• Support the software’s user community.
• Work with several simulation models used for a single aircraft and adapt your approach to different systems and technical requirements.
• Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 employees, including a subgroup of approximately four employees that works closely with other subgroups.
• Work autonomously while collaborating regularly with software, systems, avionics, and other engineering groups.
• Valid driver’s license, or ability to commute to the Mirabel offices

This is a full-time, Monday-Friday hybrid working arrangement, with an expected presence of two to three days per week at the Mirabel office and occasional work from the Saint-Laurent office. Employees are expected to work 40 hours per week, and core working hours are from 9:30AM – 3:30PM.

Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science.
• Up to three years of software development experience.
• Knowledge of C++ and C#.
• Ability to learn aircraft systems, simulation models, and new technical concepts quickly.
• Ability to work autonomously, manage changing technical requirements, and demonstrate flexibility across multiple simulation models.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Ability to communicate orally and in writing about technical subjects in English or French.
• Ability to meet the requirements of Canada’s Controlled Goods Program and, in certain cases, applicable International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status and a Level II Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Knowledge of Rust or Java.
• Knowledge of FPGA development or technologies.
• Knowledge of aeronautics, avionics, or aircraft systems.
• Experience developing real-time simulation software.
• Demonstrated interest in aviation.

Benefits
We’ve designed flexible policies to promote well-being and growth, based on role-specific eligibility and requirements:
• Hybrid work arrangement combining office-based and remote work.
• Flexible working hours.
• Career development and internal mobility opportunities within CAE.
• Mentoring and access to the CAE Career Track program.
• Collaborative and positive work environment.
• Opportunity to be part of a small professional community within a large organization.
• Work-life balance.
• Comprehensive CAE benefits program, including health insurance, an employee stock purchase plan, a pension plan, and a physical activity program.

About CAE
At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

Regular

jobs.title: Software Engineer 1 to 3 - Digital Engineering
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION 

As a Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will help build, operate, and maintain the in-house software behind our digital thread — applications and services that keep product data connected across the product lifecycle and, over time, become the systems of record our teams work in every day. You'll ship real features across the stack from day one and work alongside senior and staff engineers who will invest in your growth. 

You will learn the product-data domain — how requirements, design, PLM, ERP, manufacturing, and quality data connect — while contributing directly to delivery and operations. This is a high-growth role in a fast-paced environment where your work has immediate, visible impact. 

This is an ideal role for an engineer early in their career or a few years in who is eager to learn, takes ownership, and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced engineers building something foundational. We're hiring at levels I through III; your level will be set based on your experience and interviews. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

Build Across the Stack 

• Build features across the stack — services, APIs, data models, and web user interfaces — with guidance from senior engineers and growing independence over time. 

• Implement data flows, mappings, and workflow automation between our software and the engineering systems we use today. 

• Help migrate data and users onto in-house software as it replaces off-the-shelf tools. 

• Take on larger pieces of work as you grow — at level III, owning features end to end, from design through production. 

Operate & Improve 

• Write tests, contribute to code reviews, and help keep our applications and services observable and reliable. 

• Help operate our software in production, including monitoring, triage, and resolving user-reported, sync, and data-quality issues. 

• Write clear technical documentation and grow your understanding of the engineering ecosystem and digital thread. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Up to ~5 years of software development experience; internships, academic, or equivalent projects count for early-career candidates. 

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language and a willingness to work in our stack (e.g., Go, TypeScript). 

• Understanding of APIs, databases, web application fundamentals, and basic distributed-systems concepts. 

• Solid problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn the product-data domain. 

• Good written communication and collaboration habits. 

• U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Experience building web applications (e.g., TypeScript, React) through work, internships, coursework, or personal projects. 

• Exposure to system integrations, data pipelines, or event-driven services. 

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), CI/CD, and testing practices. 

• Any exposure to PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), requirements/ALM, or MBSE systems. 

• Interest in aerospace, defense, or engineering data. 

COMPENSATION 

• Denver, Colorado Base Salary: $70,000 – $160,000 

• Long Beach, California Base Salary: $75,000 – $165,000 

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. 

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

• This role operates in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment supporting national security space operations, where adaptability and rapid decision-making are essential. 

• Participation in an on-call and support rotation may be required as you grow into operating our software in production. 

• A supportive, mentorship-driven environment with room to take on increasing ownership. 

• Occasional travel to other company sites as needed. 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS 

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. 

• Work Location: this role is hybrid/onsite at our facilities in Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA. #LI-Onsite 

• Work environment is a standard office setting, working at a desk or on a production factory floor. 

• Physical demands may include frequent standing, sitting, walking, bending, and lifting or carrying items up to 20 lbs. 

• This position will be open until it is successfully filled.

From helping them recruit talent to helping them recruit patients for their studies to helping match them to strategic partners and even going to Washington to win reforms, RA Capital’s large team has people with nearly every relevant expertise one might need to turn an idea into a cure that actually helps people. 

If you live for first-principles problem-solving with great colleagues, thrive on complexity, and want to do meaningful work that ripples across industries and ecosystems, you’ll feel at home at RA Capital. Here, questions are welcomed, ideas are tested, and victories are shared. Even our lawyers are creative and engaging. And don’t get us started on our compliance team’s wicked sense of humor; nothing about what we do is boring. 

Are you ready to bring your creativity, discipline and collaborative spirit to help us invent the future? Join us and you’ll collaborate daily with investors, founders, physicians, biologists, engineers, economists, and reform advocates who think in systems and act with urgency. 

Join us to invent a happier, healthier, more productive future - and have fun doing it.

Software Engineer, Data/AI – Healthcare Data & AI

About the Team

RA Capital’s Data Engineering team builds the enterprise data platform that powers research, investment, and operational workflows across the firm. Beyond traditional data pipelines, we are actively developing AI-native data access patterns that enable users to interact with complex healthcare datasets through LLM-powered, governed, and auditable interfaces.

Our work sits at the intersection of healthcare data, large-scale data engineering, and applied AI, with a strong emphasis on reliability, compliance, and production readiness.

About the Role

We are seeking an early-career software engineer to help build and operate AI-enabled data platforms and intelligent data workflows for healthcare data.

This role goes beyond traditional ETL. You will build healthcare data pipelines as well as AI-driven workflows and data applications that connect large language models with enterprise data and tools. This includes developing governed data access layers where LLMs translate user intent into structured queries and building agentic workflows that retrieve information, invoke tools, orchestrate multi-step tasks, and support self-service analytics, discovery, and decision-making.

Responsibilities

• 
Design and maintain scalable, production-grade data pipelines for healthcare datasets, including claims and provider data.

• 
Build and optimize data models to support analytical and AI-driven workloads.

• 
Develop high-quality Python and SQL code for data standardization, reconciliation, validation, and application workflows.

• 
Build AI-powered data applications and agentic workflows that connect LLMs with enterprise data and internal tools, retrieve information, execute multi-step tasks, and automate data and research processes with appropriate guardrails.

• 
Build and improve AI-native data access frameworks, including LLM-to-SQL and LLM-to-GraphQL patterns and reusable interfaces for structured data access.

• 
Build backend services, APIs, and reusable software components that power data and AI applications.

• 
Develop evaluation and testing frameworks to measure the accuracy, reliability, and performance of LLM-powered and agentic workflows.

• 
Write automated tests and contribute to CI/CD, deployment, and production support for data and AI systems.

• 
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, healthcare data vendors, and internal stakeholders to translate user needs into production-ready data and AI solutions.

•

Key Skills and Experience

Strong software engineering fundamentals and an interest in building production systems.

•

•

Strong communication, ownership, and collaboration skills.

Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States. In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business. Are you ready to change the world with us?

ABOUT THE ROLE

The internship program at Clēnera is designed to give current undergraduates an opportunity to immerse themselves into the complex world of renewable energy. We have created thoughtful experiences across the company to provide meaningful experiences for the interns and value for the organization. Students who will be successful in this program will bring a passion for the renewable energy industry, a strong work ethic centered around self-motivation, and a desire to learn and grow by working alongside some of the best and brightest in the industry. 

The Data Engineering & Reporting Intern supports the development of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and visualizations used to support business decision-making processes. jobs.title: Customer Data Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.



We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!




THE ROLE

We are looking for analytically minded and detail-oriented individuals to join the Customer Data Services team in our New York or San Francisco office on a fixed-term basis starting at the beginning of January 2027. This role is open to early-career candidates with up to 2 years of experience who love working with complex data and want to see how it drives real decisions at the world's largest companies.

 

Watershed is a growth-stage start-up that works with 800+ customers globally, including 100+ of the Fortune 500 and 5 of the top 6 US banks, to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work hands-on with customer business data, transforming it to fit Watershed templates and enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact.



YOU WILL

 - Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value.

 - Partner with customers to understand their raw data and recommend best practices for preparing it.

 - Communicate data issues clearly to customers, covering impact, options and trade-offs.

 - Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices.

 - Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during third-party verifications.

 - Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our work and inform product development.



YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

 - Have up to 2 years of experience working with large data files in Excel, whether through internships, co-ops or academic projects. Python or SQL is a plus.

 - Thrive on complex, messy data and enjoy the work of making it clean, structured, and trustworthy.

 - Are detail obsessed. You double check your work and do not consider something done until you know it is right.

 - Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks.

 - Have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes.

 - Are a strong written and verbal communicator. You can concisely communicate externally to non-technical audiences.

 - Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them.



FIXED-TERM DETAILS

 - Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 additional months.

 - Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office.

 - This position requires being in person in our San Francisco or New York office 4 days per week.

   





   

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.



What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.



What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

 - Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial

At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment.

Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets - building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens.



About the Role

We're hiring software engineering interns for Summer 2027; each intern will be embedded in a specialized track. You won't be shadowing or running demos - you'll own a real problem on a small team, write code that ships to production, and work on systems and datasets that don't exist anywhere else: petabyte-scale 3D reconstructions, foundation models trained on physical space, and positioning infrastructure deployed globally.

Select your primary track when you apply. We'll match you based on fit; switching tracks after matching is uncommon but possible if there's strong mutual interest.



Track 1: ML /AI Infrastructure

You'll build the systems that make large-scale physical AI possible. Not just run experiments, but design the distributed training pipelines, data ingestion infrastructure, and GPU optimization layers that let us train foundation models on billions of images and 3D data points.

 - Model Training with PyTorch — Implement, train, and evaluate model architectures in PyTorch, iterating on data loaders, loss functions, and training loops to improve model quality and convergence on real production datasets.

 - Training Infrastructure — Design and scale distributed training pipelines for our Large Geospatial Model, handling petabyte-scale spatial data across multi-GPU and multi-node environments.

 - Data Pipelines — Build high-throughput ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that transform raw imagery and 3D point clouds into training-ready datasets.

 - Observability — Instrument training runs with metrics, dashboards, and alerting so engineering teams can debug and iterate faster.

Best for: Students obsessed with the intersection of ML and systems - PyTorch, distributed computing (Ray, Spark), CUDA, and high-performance architecture.



Track 2: Product Engineering

You'll build the product APIs and services that sit behind our spatial computing products, helping customers manage projects, organize spatial data, upload content, and turn it into useful experiences. You'll work across backend and product engineering to take features from design to production, with a focus on clear interfaces, reliable workflows, and software that other teams can build on.

 - Product Features — Build and ship features for managing organizations, projects, spatial data, and content.

 - API Design — Design the interfaces that connect our products, web and mobile applications, and developer tools, making them consistent, well-documented, and easy to use.

 - Workflows & Integrations — Connect the steps behind core product workflows, from uploading and processing data to making results available to users and applications.

 - End-to-End Delivery — Collaborate with engineers across frontend, backend, and infrastructure to launch features and learn from real customer use.

Best for: Students who enjoy building products from the backend up and interested in how APIs and data power user experiences. Motivated by shipping software that real customers and developers use.



Track 3: Backend Systems

You'll build and harden the high-throughput services that power our Visual Positioning System and reconstruction platform - processing vast volumes of visual data and delivering centimeter-level positioning to users and robots globally.

 - Service Development — Design and ship microservices in Go or C++ that sit in the critical path of our positioning and reconstruction APIs.

 - Data Ingestion — Build and optimize pipelines that ingest, validate, and route large volumes of visual and sensor data from diverse hardware sources.

 - Performance & Reliability — Profile service bottlenecks, improve latency, and improve system observability through structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

 - API Design — Contribute to internal and external API design, writing clean, well-tested, production-grade interfaces that other teams and customers depend on.

Best for: Pragmatic engineers who care about correctness, performance, and clean systems design and want to see their code serving real traffic within weeks.



What You'll Bring (All Tracks)

 - Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Vision, or a related field.

 - TypeScript, Python, C++ or Go experience for Infrastructure and Backend tracks.

 - Genuine curiosity about how AI interacts with the physical world - 3D reconstruction, spatial reasoning, or real-world positioning systems.

 - Ability to work independently, debug ambiguous problems, and communicate clearly with a small team.

 - Available for 4 days per week in our San Francisco office for the full 12-week internship.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure - Kubernetes, AWS or GCP, Docker, Terraform.

 - Familiarity with CUDA or GPU parallelization.

 - Open-source contributions to libraries like PyTorch, OpenCV, COLMAP, or similar.

 - Prior work in robotics, autonomous systems, XR, or spatial computing (coursework, research, or projects acceptable)

 - Exposure to Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or 3D reconstruction techniques

 - Familiarity with REST APIs

 - Experience with SQL or other relational databases

 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to write, debug, and improve code



Compensation & Benefits

The expected hourly rate for this internship is 48–70/hour, based on assessed skills, experience, and relevant coursework. Housing assistance is available for candidates outside the Bay Area - details provided during the offer process.



Location & Work Model

This internship is based in our San Francisco, CA office. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask interns to be on-site a minimum of 4 days per week. To make that easy, we provide lunch every day and snacks are always stocked.



Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.



Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.



Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern
jobs.description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.




THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

 - Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

 - Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

 - Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.




YOU

 - Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

 - Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

 - Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

 - You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

 - Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

 - Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich or San Francisco (we support visa)




TECH STACK

 - FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

 - BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

 - AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

With over half a billion rides and counting, Lyft is solving hard problems in a flourishing domain with a lot of data and creative solutions in Marketplace, Mapping, Fraud, Growth and beyond. We're actively building the next-generation Machine Learning (ML) platform for low-cost, ultra-immersive transportation to improve people’s lives using modern ML with petabyte-scale data. Our Machine Learning Engineers are excited to work on these challenging problems and redefine solutions to directly impact various aspects of Lyft's primary business.

As a PhD Machine Learning Engineer Intern on our Applied AI team, you'll take on an open research problem tied to product experiences used by millions of riders. Working closely with a Staff ML Engineer mentor, you'll scope the problem, develop and evaluate new methods on real data, and take the work far enough that it can be shared with the research community, with the goal of a paper submission to a top ML venue.

If you are a PhD student who enjoys turning open-ended research questions into working systems, and you want your research to be tested against real users and real data, this opportunity is for you!

Responsibilities:

• Own a research project from start to finish: frame the problem, review related work, propose new methods, and design rigorous offline and online evaluations

• Design, build, train and test ML models in areas such as reinforcement learning, sequential decision-making, personalization

• Write production-quality code that turns research prototypes into working pipelines on Lyft's data and ML infrastructure

• Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and fellow ML Engineers to frame research questions within the business context

• Analyze experimental and observational data, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Write up results for publication at a peer-reviewed venue, with support from your mentor and the team

• Participate in code and spec reviews to ensure code quality and distribute knowledge

Experience:

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, and returning to your program after the internship, with a graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required)

• A track record of ML research, shown through publications, preprints, or substantial research projects

• Strong foundation in reinforcement learning and sequential decision making, especially problems with delayed or long-horizon rewards

• Solid grounding in both causal inference and counterfactual evaluation

• Good understanding of ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX

• Strong programming skills in Python or a similar language

• Proven ability to effectively turn research ML papers into working code

• Curiosity and ability to quickly learn new concepts and technologies

• Strong problem solving mindset, resourcefulness, and willingness to figure things out independently through research or collaboratively through brainstorming

• Demonstrated oral and written communication skills

• Bonus Points

• Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, WWW, RecSys, or AAAI

• Experience with offline reinforcement learning, off-policy evaluation, or learning from logged interaction data, recommender systems or personalization

• Practical knowledge of how to build efficient end-to-end ML workflows on large-scale data (for example Spark or SQL)

• Familiarity with online experimentation and A/B testing

Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options

• Mental health benefits

• In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off

• 401(k) plan to help save for your future

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
