jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Leidos is looking for a Junior Software Engineer Intern to join a high performing agile team to support a nationally significant and fast-paced management programs. The Leidos team is focusing on full stack development of user interfaces, restful services, APIs, database scripting, AWS Cloud infrastructure, and integration of micro-services.

Primary Responsibilities
• The Junior Software Engineer Intern needs to be local to Tucson and will be responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of the an agile team.

• The intern will be mentored by Senior Staff through program increment planning, industry standards, and related development activities.

• The individual will analyze and study complex system requirements, use design software tools, provide support using formal specifications, data flow diagrams, and other accepted design techniques with the help of other team members. 

• The individual will be mentored through software engineering principles and standards to ensure that developed code is modifiable, efficient, reliable, understandable, fault tolerant, modular and reusable. 

• The individual will be assigned various tasks across the program’s full stack to help gain experience, knowledge and application of object orientating programming languages.

Basic Qualifications
• Working towards a Bachelors’ degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or similar discipline.

• Knowledge of, exposure and/or experience working with software design patterns and Web Application Development.

• Knowledge of, exposure and/or experience using some of the following Programming Languages and tools: Java, JavaScript, Typescript, Python, C++, SQL

• Familiarity with one or more of the following Development Frameworks: React, Svelte, Vue, Django, SpringBoot, Flask, FastAPI, NodeJS

• Self-motivated to learn and apply themselves to problem solving

• Familiarity with GIT standards

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance

• US Citizenship required

• Must be able to commute to or is located in the Tucson area

Preferred Qualifications
• Some experience developing front end user interface frameworks either through side projects or relevant work experience 

• Familiarity with working in an agile environment

• Familiarity with working on Full Stack Development

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

September 21, 2026

jobs.title: Product Management Intern
jobs.description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond. 

Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.

Summer Intern - Product Management - Carmel, IN

The Product Management Intern is a short-term opportunity for individuals interested in pursuing a career in product management. During the internship, you'll have the chance to learn about the Allegion Commercial business, product development process, work closely with product managers, and contribute to real-world projects.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position. 

 What You Will Do:
• Conduct market research to identify customer needs and preferences by analyzing and reporting on product trends, customer reviews, and customer feedback.
• Analyze data and interpret market and technology trends to assist product managers in making data-driven decisions to drive product success.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, marketing and operations to help drive product initiatives forward through product development processes.
• Collect, analyze, and manipulate data from business systems using Microsoft Excel.
• Develop an understanding of consumer needs and requirements and represent them in MRDs and PRDs.

What You Need to Succeed:
• Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in business, management, technology, or engineering with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for conducting market research and identifying opportunities for product improvement.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Team player able to quickly establish successful cooperation with all colleagues.
• Experience with: Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Teams. 

Why Work for Us?

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if: 
• You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.

jobs.description:
THE FIRM

As a leading international law firm, we are dedicated to excellence through impactful communication, collaboration, and community involvement. Our company culture has earned us one of the "100 Best Companies to Work For" for 27 consecutive years. This honor, along with many others, highlights our commitment to innovation and professional development. At Alston & Bird LLP, our foundation is made of trust, reliability, and compassion.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Alston & Bird’s Information Technology team is seeking a Developer Intern to join our office. This internship provides hands-on experience supporting software development initiatives and technology solutions that serve the firm’s attorneys and business professionals.

Duties, among others, include assisting with application development, testing, troubleshooting technical issues, documenting processes, and supporting system enhancements. The Developer Intern will collaborate with developers, business analysts, and end users while gaining exposure to the full software development lifecycle.

This is a collaborative position requiring strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, with a passion for technology and software development.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

• Assist in the design, development, and testing of mobile and web applications for use across all areas of the firm. 
• Support data science initiatives by cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data to uncover insights. 
• Collaborate on the configuration and deployment of AI tools like Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure OpenAI. 
• Documentation, technical write-ups, and internal training materials. 
• Attend team meetings and brainstorming sessions to share ideas and learn from senior staff.
• Collaborate with firm users and clients to assess business needs and recommend/design modern digital solutions.
• Become familiar with all firm applications and solutions that can be used in a solution design to meet requirements, including but not limited to SharePoint Online, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services) to enhance solution capabilities and user experience.
• Integrate applications and data across platforms using APIs, connectors, and cloud services.
• Attend meetings with users, stakeholders, and colleagues to align goals and progress.
• Perform additional duties as requested.

SKILLS NEEDED TO BE SUCESSFUL

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
• Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and mobile app development. 
• Exposure to Microsoft 365 tools and interest in generative AI platforms like Copilot. 
• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Experience with programming languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, or Python.
• Understanding of networking, server management, and cloud storage (e.g., Azure, OneDrive).
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

Professional business references and a background screening will be required for all final applicants selected for a position.

GM is developing a breakthrough new system for vehicle software and communications, and you'll be at the heart of it. At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

What you'll be doing
CIBC’s Enterprise Anti-Money Laundering team is hiring for Winter Co-Ops! This is an exciting opportunity to join a highly collaborative, agile, team-based environment where you’ll support reporting, analytics, and data visualization that enable informed decision-making across the function. As a Co-op Student on the Business Intelligence team within Enterprise Anti-Money Laundering, you’ll gain hands-on experience in a business intelligence function while building technical capability across SQL, Python, Databricks, Tableau, and Power BI. You’ll contribute to meaningful work, strengthen your analytics and reporting skills, and gain exposure to a collaborative corporate environment focused on data-driven decision-making.

jobs.title: IT Technical Specialist Intern
jobs.description:
Job Location
NEWCASTLE INNOVATION CENTRE
Job Description
Ready to make an impact on globally renowned brands like Gillette, Pampers, Head & Shoulders and Oral-B that millions of consumers can’t live without? Want to work at a company consistently recognised as one of the UK’s leading graduate employers? 

Then apply for our IT Technical Specialist Industrial Placement at our P&G office in Newcastle, where business, innovation and technology come together to create a competitive advantage. 

You’ll play a key role in designing, building, and supporting best-in-class IT solutions. On this placement, you will be responsible for developing innovative applications. You’ll focus on creating an optimal user experience for product design, development and testing, while emphasising a data-first architecture that maximises flexibility and integrates seamlessly with essential systems. 

What to Expect: 

During your industrial placement you will get a first-hand experience of what a career as a P&G Technical Specialist and the non-management career pathway involves, and if it is right for you. You will be working on live business projects and expected to dive straight in and take the lead. During your projects you can expect to: 

• Contribute to the design and development of AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Agentic AI frameworks. 
• Participate in data engineering, analytics, and AI development projects alongside senior team members. 
• Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines and data transformation workflows using Databricks. 
• Support the development of interactive dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions using Power BI. 
• Support testing, troubleshooting, and optimisation of data. 
 
Key Accountabilities: 

• Actively deliver day-to-day technical outputs within defined service levels, project timelines, and coding/configuration standards. 
• Create, update and maintain clear operational documentation to support team knowledge continuity and improve operational efficiency. 

Each intern receives a customized learning plan to ensure they get the right levels of coaching, mentoring and training as they deliver their work. 

So, if you are looking for an exciting and challenging experience, have a passion for winning, leveraging and developing strong IT skills, leadership credentials and an interest in pursuing a career at P&G – this placement is for you! 
 
What You Will Gain:  

• Responsibilities and Real Work from Day 1: You will be given specific projects and responsibilities working on real and live business challenges, just like a true P&Ger.  
• Continuous Training & Coaching: You will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager.  
• Competitive Compensation & Benefits: The annual salary for this placement is £27,000. On top of this you’ll enjoy lots of benefits like the option to enrol in our pension, flexible working arrangements, and your very own ‘Flex4Me’ Fund which enables you to allocate a portion of your benefits package to the areas that matter most to you. 
• Full Time Role: Successful interns have the potential to secure a full-time position with P&G after graduation in our non-management IT track. As a 'build from within' company, our people start at entry level and increasingly develop their leadership ability and responsibilities. When we make a job offer, it’s with the belief that you have the potential to continually grow – building your impact through our organisations. We’ll help you get there, and you’ll be mentored and coached by skilled P&G veterans along the way. 

Job Qualifications

• You are pursuing or hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related quantitative discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: R&D PhD Imaging Technologies Intern
jobs.description:
Job Location
MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR
Job Description
Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!

The Opportunity:
Procter & Gamble is looking for a PhD student Intern to advance imaging technologies for research and product evaluation. You will design, prototype, and test imaging hardware and capture workflows that improve image quality, measurement repeatability, and quantitative assessment. Your work will combine imaging science, engineering, automation, and image analysis to support stronger product performance and higher quality before-and-after imaging across key programs.
 
The Ideal Candidate Has:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical approach to complex technical challenges.
• Hands-on research experience and the ability to independently plan, execute, and troubleshoot experiments.
• Interest in developing imaging technologies that integrate hardware, software, automation, and quantitative analysis.
• Strong attention to detail when evaluating experimental data.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a disciplined approach to documenting and explaining technical work.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design and prototype imaging hardware and supporting software.
• Integrate and evaluate components that impact image capture.
• Develop and apply image-processing and image-analysis methods.
• Design and conduct experiments to evaluate image quality and overall system performance.
• Analyze images and experimental data using different scientific computing tools.
• Identify technical challenges, recommend improvements, and document system designs, experimental methods, results, and key learnings.
• Communicate findings to multidisciplinary partners and deliver a working prototype, validated workflow, or quantitative evidence of improved performance.

Job Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Imaging Science, Applied Physics, or a closely related quantitative engineering or scientific discipline.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience conducting independent research and communicating technical results.
• Hands-on experience with experimental research, engineering development, computational methods, or hardware prototyping.
• Experience using Python, MATLAB, or a similar scientific programming environment for data analysis, algorithm development, or experimental research.
• Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027. It has the expectation to be in the office 4-5 days per week at our Mason Business & Innovation Center location.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience designing, integrating, calibrating, or testing imaging systems.
• Experience with optics, illumination, camera systems, automated positioning or motion-control hardware, and different imaging techniques.
• Experience developing computer-vision methods for image registration, object detection, quality assessment, and quantitative measurement.
• Experience developing and applying deep-learning workflows using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
• Record of scientific contributions through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or patents in quantitative bioimaging, computer vision, or a related field.
 
What We Offer:
• Meaningful work from Day 1: You will take ownership of a real technical challenge with applications in research, product evaluation, and technical communication.
• Hands-on technical experience: You will gain practical experience integrating imaging hardware, automation, experimental workflows, and quantitative analysis.
• Mentorship and learning: You will work closely with experienced technical leaders and receive regular coaching throughout the internship.
• Visible business impact: Your work can help improve the quality and reliability of imaging measurements used across different research programs.
• A collaborative environment: You will work across scientific and engineering disciplines while strengthening your skills in imaging, prototyping, experimental design, computer vision, and technical communication.

 Just so you know:
 
At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise. 
Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits. Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

If you have a disability that affects your ability to complete our online application process, please visit our Disability Accommodation Page.

Join Leidos’ mission-focused engineering team and deliver software that powers data analytics, computer vision, and AI capabilities for national security customers. At Leidos, we don’t just offer internships - we offer career acceleration. This is your chance to work alongside industry-leading experts in Artificial Intelligence (AI), autonomous systems, and multi-modal information retrieval.

Leidos is looking for a curious and enthusiastic Systems Engineer Intern to join our team in Arlington, VA supporting our national security customer. You’ll work side-by-side with system/software engineers and research/data scientists to help evolve a production platform that combines microservices, data search & analytics, and machine learning services. This is a great role if you enjoy translating real user needs into clear technical requirements, improving processes, and building the engineering documentation that turns ideas into delivered capability.

• Partner with engineers and stakeholders to capture use cases and decompose requirements
• Research and evaluate technologies to improve performance, usability, reliability, and maintainability
• Support system design and architecture efforts for a platform that includes:• a user-facing interface for search and analytics
• microservice-based components
• multiple ML-enabled services

• Produce high-quality engineering artifacts such as SysML/UML diagrams and design notes
• Contribute to an iterative delivery environment by communicating progress, risks, and dependencies clearly

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Systems Engineering or related field
• Experience with SysML and/or UML

jobs.title: Data Specialist Intern
jobs.description:
Spécialiste de données 
 
Vous êtes un passionné dans votre domaine? Vous recherchez un milieu de travail où vous pourrez innover, vous dépasser et collaborer avec des experts provenant de secteurs variés? Vous aimeriez vous joindre à une entreprise d’envergure mondiale, qui est un chef de file dans son domaine, et dont vous seriez fier de contribuer aux projets? Venez partager votre passion avec nous! 
 
Le rôle que nous vous proposons : 
 
En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de joindre notre nouveau département de Plateforme de données et Intelligence Artificielle au sein de notre équipe de spécialistes et d’ingénieurs de données. Vous pourrez ainsi participer à la mise en place et l’évolution de la stratégie de données de CAE afin d’améliorer les services et développer de nouveaux produits tout en s'appuyant sur ces données. Êtes-vous prêt à : 
 
• Assembler des ensembles de données complexes qui respectent les exigences opérationnelles fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles. 

• Définir, concevoir et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus internes : l’automatisation des processus manuels, l’optimisation de la transmission de données, la nouvelle conception de l’infrastructure pour une plus grande évolutivité, etc. 

• Mettre au point des outils d’analyse qui utilisent le pipeline de données pour fournir des perspectives applicables en matière d’acquisition de clients, d’efficacité opérationnelle et d’autres mesures clés du rendement opérationnel. 

• Maintenir les données séparées et en sécurité à travers les frontières nationales par l’entremise de plusieurs centres de données. 

• Travailler avec des experts en données et en analyse pour parvenir à une meilleure fonctionnalité de nos systèmes de données. 

• Être un contributeur-clé dans la transformation de l’entreprise. 

Le passionné que nous recherchons possède : 
 
• Solide connaissance du français, de l'anglais, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral 

• Expérience de travail avec les données, le codage et la création de scripts (Python/Java/Scala/SQL/JS/Bash), et avec les services cloud Microsoft : Azure, Databrick, etc. est un atout. 

• Expérience en matière d’élaboration et d’administration de gros systèmes de données. 

• Expérience en utilisation d’outils de traitement de données massives : Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, est un atout 

• Expérience en utilisation de bases de données relationnelles SQL et NoSQL, y compris SQL Server et CosmosDb est un atout 

• Expérience en utilisation de pipelines de données automatisées et d’outils de gestion du flux de travail : DevOps, ARM, Data Factory, Airflow. 

• Expérience en utilisation de services infonuagiques tel que Microsoft Azure, Databrick. 

• Expérience en utilisation de systèmes de traitement de flux : Storm, Spark-Streaming. 

*Tous les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada et se conformer aux exigences relatives au Programme des marchandises contrôlées du Canada (PMC). Toutes les personnes embauchées seront tenues de remplir, signer et retourner le formulaire du programme des marchandises contrôlées dans la semaine suivant l’envoi. Ils devront également fournir une copie de leur passeport ou de leur certificat de naissance. Tous les étudiants détenant un permis de travail devront en fournir la copie et fournir un certificat de bonne conduite du ou des pays où ils ont résidé au cours des 5 dernières années. 
 
*Veuillez prendre note que si vous détenez un permis d’études, de travail ou d’étudiant international, les délais de vérification de sécurité peuvent prendre jusqu’à 8 semaines. 
 
*Pour tous les stagiaires embauchés, nous rembourserons les frais de stage jusqu'à concurrence de 250 $ par stagiaire sur présentation de pièces justificatives. 
 
CAE vous propose : 
 
• Salaire déterminé selon le nombre d'années et/ou crédits cumulés 

• Horaire flexible 

• Bureau air ouvert / télétravail 

• Occasion de travailler sur une diversité de projets en équipe multidisciplinaire 

• Possibilité d'embauche/prolongation 

• Stationnement gratuit (autos et vélos) et accès STM 

• Club de course et activités sportives 

• Vestiaires et douches 

Alors, venez partager votre passion avec nous! 
 
Avec plus de 10 000 employés présents dans plus de 35 pays, CAE est un chef de file mondial en formation dans les domaines de l’aviation civile, de la défense et sécurité, et de la santé. Pour en apprendre plus : www.cae.com. 
 
CAE remercie tous les candidats pour leur intérêt. Toutefois, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les candidats sélectionnés pour une entrevue.

Data specialist 
 
Are you looking for a work environment where you can innovate, reach greater heights and collaborate with experts from a wide range of sectors? You want to join a world-class company and industry leader with projects to which you would be proud to contribute? Come share your passion with us! 
 
The role we are offering you: 
 
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to join our new Data and AI Platform department within our team of data specialist / data engineers. You will thus participate in CAE’s Data Strategy and its evolution. Your work will allow CAE to offer better services and develop new products based on data. Are you ready to: 
 
• Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements. 

• Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability. 

• Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics 

• Keep data separated and secure across national boundaries through multiple data centers. 

• Be an active member of the business transformation 

Our ideal candidate has: 
 
• Strong knowledge of French, English, both written & spoken 

• Industry experience working with data, coding and scripting (Python/Java/Scala/SQL/JS/Bash), and with Microsoft cloud services: Azure, Databrick, etc is an asset 

• Experience developing and administering large data systems. 

• Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment. Experience with big data tools: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka. 

• Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including SQL Server and CosmosDb. 

• Experience with automated data pipeline and workflow management tools: DevOps, ARM, Data Factory, Airflow. 

• Experience with Microsoft cloud services: Azure, Databrick. 

• Experience with stream-processing systems: Storm, Spark-Streaming.

jobs.title: PLM Business Intelligence & Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
KLA's IT group supports business growth and productivity by connecting people, process and technology around the world. We work to improve the technology that drives our business to thrive and focus on empowering employee use of technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enhances employee productivity, business analytics and process excellence.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst Intern to support strategic initiatives across Data Governance, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Analytics, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) domains. Job Duties include:

Data Governance
• Support governance initiatives involving Product, BOM, Part, Supplier, Customer, and Manufacturing data
• Assist in defining and documenting data governance processes, policies, standards, and business rules
• Support data cataloging, metadata management, data lineage, and business glossary initiatives
• Participate in data quality assessments and root cause analysis of data issues
• Assist Data Stewards and Data Owners in maintaining critical business data domains
 
Business Analysis
• Gather and document business requirements from Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Service teams
• Support mapping of business processes across PLM and ERP systems
• Conduct gap analysis and identify opportunities for process improvement

jobs.title: Capital Markets Intern - Quantitative Technology Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

ABOUT RBC CAPITAL MARKETS
RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
We work with clients in over 100 countries to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks. RBC Capital Markets is part of Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), one of the top 15 largest banks globally and fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalization. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
Join our Summer Analyst Program and make a real impact on the future of Capital Markets. You'll work on meaningful projects that shape how we serve clients - from building intelligent trading systems to developing data pipelines that power our decision-making. Alongside experienced technologists, you'll design, develop, and deploy tools that matter.
This isn't a passive learning experience. You'll own real deliverables in a collaborative project team setting, guided by RBC Capital Markets' lead architects and technologists. You'll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge technologies including machine learning, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and algorithmic trading systems. Dedicated mentoring sessions with business-aligned technology leaders will deepen your understanding of how technology drives client value across trading, risk management, and market operations.
Beyond the work itself, you'll network with peers across Capital Markets through social events and skill-building sessions, building relationships that often lead to full-time opportunities.
You'll have the opportunity to contribute to one or more of these areas:
• Architecture – Shape the foundational systems that power modern capital markets
• eTrading & Algorithmic Trading Technology – Work on platforms that execute trades at scale with intelligence and precision
• Commodities & Futures Technology – Apply data science and automation to commodity markets
• Equities Technology – Leverage machine learning to enhance equity trading and market intelligence
• Market Data Operations and Engineering – Build systems that aggregate, process, and deliver critical market data
• Fixed Income & Currencies Technology – Develop analytical tools and trading systems for global markets
• AI & Machine Learning Engineering – Build predictive models, develop recommendation systems, and optimize trading algorithms
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?
We seek talented individuals with intellectual curiosity, a drive to solve complex problems, and the energy to thrive in a fast-paced environment. You should be confident in your abilities while remaining eager to learn, collaborate, and push boundaries.
Successful candidates will be evaluated on individual merit. We're looking for:
Essential qualifications:
• Entering the final year of a four-year college or university program or enrolled in a relevant master's program (anticipating graduation Winter 2027 or Spring 2028)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Demonstrated interest in technology, financial markets, or both
• History of academic excellence
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Preferably pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Data Science or Business Analytics
Valuable experience and skills (the more, the better):
• Programming: Python, Java, C#, C/C++, or Scala; familiarity with frameworks like .NET or J2EE
• Data Science & AI: Experience with machine learning libraries, statistical modeling, or predictive analytics
• Data Engineering: SQL and/or NoSQL databases; ETL pipeline development; familiarity with tools like Spark or Kafka
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Software Engineering: Version control (Git), testing frameworks, agile methodologies
• Systems & DevOps: Linux/Unix administration, CI/CD pipelines
• Financial acumen: Understanding of markets, trading concepts, or financial products
• Business Analysis: Requirements gathering and cross-functional collaboration
 
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
• Hands-on mentorship from experienced technologists and emerging AI practitioners working on real problems
• Exposure to diverse domains within Capital Markets
• Tangible impact – your work directly influences how RBC serves institutional clients
• Career acceleration – Summer Analysts often transition into full-time roles with accelerated progression
• Skill development in high-demand areas including machine learning, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering
• Network within one of the world's leading investment banks
• Culture of innovation where we challenge conventions and embrace emerging technologies
 
We thrive on the challenge to be our best, think progressively, continue our growth, and deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our individual/collective potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
From this experience you would gain:
• Direct exposure and hands-on experience including opportunities to do challenging work
• Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
• Opportunity to connect with different Capital Markets businesses
• Ability to work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
• Training including orientation sessions as well as an in-class curriculum and regular information sessions with key business leaders
 
.This position is non-exempt and paid at the equivalent hourly rate.
RBC’s compensation philosophy and principles recognize the importance of a highly qualified global workforce and plays a critical role in attracting, engaging, and retaining talent that:
• Drives RBC’s high-performance culture
• Enables collective achievement of our strategic goals
• Generate sustainable shareholder returns and above market shareholder value

Founded in 1989, PanAgora (Greek for across marketplace) Asset Management is a premier provider of investment solutions spanning most major asset classes and risk ranges. We seek to provide investment solutions using sophisticated quantitative techniques that incorporate fundamental insights and vast amounts of market information. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.

From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.

As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high-impact research - designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm.

Take the next step in your career.
 
Role purpose

Dates: 28th June 2027 - 17th September 2027
Working hours: 09:00 - 17:30

We are looking for exceptional machine learning students to join our world-class technology teams for a 12- week summer internship, working alongside quantitative researchers on cutting-edge machine learning problems.
As an intern within the Technical Machine Learning team, you will be engaged in a mixture of individual and collaborative work to tackle some of the toughest research questions.

You will also use a combination of off-the-shelf tools and custom solutions written from scratch to drive the latest advances in quantitative research.

Key Responsibilities of the role include

What does the technical machine learning team work on?
• Implementing ideas from published research papers
• Writing custom libraries to efficiently train models on petabytes of data
• Reducing model training times by hand optimising machine learning operations
• Profiling custom machine learning architectures to identify performance bottlenecks
• Evaluating the latest hardware and software in the machine learning ecosystem

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for interns that will be comfortable working both independently and in small teams on a variety of engineering challenges, with a particular focus on machine learning and scientific computing.

The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience:
• A current undergraduate, master's or PhD student in machine learning or a related discipline
• Strong object-oriented programming skills and experience working with Python, PyTorch and NumPy are desirable
• Experience in one or more advanced optimisation methods, modern ML techniques, HPC, profiling, model inference; you don’t need to have all of the above
• Excellent machine learning reasoning skills, with the ability to develop your own models when standard approaches are insufficient
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team with complementary expertise

Finance experience is not necessary for this role and candidates from non-financial backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
 
Why join us? 
• Highly competitive compensation plus annual discretionary bonus
• Lunch provided (via Just Eat for Business) and dedicated barista bar
• 30 days’ annual leave
• 9% company pension contributions
• Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance
• Comprehensive healthcare and life assurance
• Cycle-to-work scheme
• Monthly company events

AI & Digital Transformation Intern — Intelligent Infrastructure, Technology & Engineering Strategy. GPA: Min 3.0

jobs.title: Enterprise Sustainability & Impact Intern - Modeling & Analytics
jobs.description:
Internship candidates can expect a full-time onsite internship program during summer 2027. Specific program dates will be shared during the recruiting process.

Carefully selected from universities across the country, our interns bring distinctive ideas and perspectives to our organization. Our employees are passionate about building our emerging talent and future leaders. In addition to their day-to-day tasks, interns participate in professional development workshops, senior leadership Q&A's, volunteer initiatives, networking and social events, and more!

Enterprise Sustainability & Impact Intern - Modeling & Analytics
In this role, you will support Northwestern Mutual's Enterprise Sustainability & Impact team and work alongside your hiring manager, mentor, and team on an enterprise-relevant project. This role offers the opportunity to apply quantitative and analytical methods to explore climate- and environmental-related risks, identify meaningful trends and patterns, and support business-relevant insights that contribute to enterprise resilience, sustainability, and long-term business performance. The project scope and analytical approach may be shaped by business needs as well as the selected candidate's background, experience, and perspective. Job responsibilities may include:
• Conducting research and analyzing climate, environmental, economic, geospatial, financial, and other relevant datasets to identify trends, patterns, and potential business implications.
• Applying quantitative and analytical methods to explore climate- and environmental-related risks and opportunities, using approaches appropriate to the project, available data, and candidate expertise.
• Developing clear data visualizations, which may include maps, dashboards, charts, or other visual analytical products, to communicate findings and support decision-making.
• Translating complex analytical findings into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Preparing executive-ready presentations, written summaries, and other materials for the Enterprise Sustainability & Impact team and cross-functional business partners.
• Contributing to the development of repeatable tools, methodologies, or processes that can support future analysis and decision-making.
• Collaborating cross-functionally to understand business context, test assumptions, and strengthen the relevance of the work.

Bring Your Best! What this role needs - minimum qualifications
• Currently pursuing a master's or doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in Environmental, Resource, or Agricultural Economics; Geography or Geospatial Science; Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics; Risk Management & Insurance; Climate Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability; Economics, Finance; or a related quantitative discipline.
• Available to participate in a full-time, onsite internship in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, during Summer 2027.
• Cumulative grade point average of 3.0 or higher.
• Demonstrated quantitative, analytical, research, and problem-solving ability.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Commitment to high ethical standards, data integrity, confidentiality, and responsible data stewardship.

Preferred skills and proficiencies
• Experience applying quantitative methods—such as econometrics, statistical or financial modeling, valuation, and scenario or sensitivity analysis—to evaluate uncertainty, risks, and potential outcomes.
• Proficiency with analytical tools such as Python or R; data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau; and/or Geographic Information Systems such as ArcGIS or QGIS.
• Experience preparing, analyzing, quality-checking, and documenting large, complex, or multi-source datasets.
• Familiarity with climate, hazard, weather, environmental, and socioeconomic data used in climate risk analysis, including sources such as NOAA, Climate Central, FEMA, the U.S. Census Bureau, or comparable datasets.
• Ability to critically assess assumptions, costs, risks, benefits, and alternatives; communicate findings clearly through oral, written, and visual formats; and offer constructive perspectives in consultative discussions.
• Demonstrated initiative, intellectual curiosity, and learning agility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and manage multiple priorities. Prior internship or professional experience in a corporate, consulting, financial services, insurance, sustainability, or related environment is preferred; insurance or financial services experience is a plus.

Next steps
We encourage you to apply! Once your application is reviewed, if selected to move forward, our University Relations team members will reach out for a call, where we will learn more about you, share internship opportunities aligned to your interests and abilities, and discuss next steps in our recruiting process.

Who we are
Northwestern Mutual has been helping families and businesses achieve financial security for over 160 years through a distinctive planning approach that integrates risk management with wealth accumulation, preservation, and distribution. With more than $290 billion in assets, $30 billion in revenues and more than $1.9 trillion worth of life insurance protection in force, Northwestern Mutual delivers financial security to more than 4.6 million clients. People are the power behind Northwestern Mutual, and diversity makes us better. NM is committed to reflecting and serving the marketplace. We do so by attracting and improving the engagement of those who bring their outstanding perspectives, ideas, and beliefs. At Northwestern Mutual, people matter. And you’ll be working for a company that’s consistently voted among the “most admired” in the nation. We invite you to explore your career interests with us.

Compensation Range:
Pay Range - Start:

$16.50
Pay Range - End:
$30.00
We believe in fairness and transparency. It’s why we share the salary range for most of our roles. Internship salaries are determined based on academic tenure and major. The standard pay structure is listed. 

Build a strong career foundation with a best-in-class company that puts our clients' interests at the center of all we do. Get started now!

Northwestern Mutual is an equal opportunity employer that welcomes talented individuals of all backgrounds. We are committed to creating and maintaining an environment in which each employee can contribute creative ideas, seek challenges, assume leadership and continue to focus on meeting and exceeding business and personal objectives.

Job Description Summary
Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority, and at GE Vernova, we take our responsibility seriously. That is the singular mission of GE Vernova: to continue electrifying the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it. 

Innovation
Are you passionate about innovation? Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world? 

We operate with a founder’s mindset. We deliver innovation with passion, speed, and courage. We continuously challenge our thinking and are empowered to dream big and take smart risks.

What impact you’ll make 

As a student withing the Systems Architecture team, you will be an active contributor to the application of Generative AI in product management, the execution of automation solutions and other services productivity initiatives.

Job Description
What you’ll do (Job Responsibilities)
 
• Assist in developing AI-driven tools to improve and augment key business functions in engineering and product management.
• Engage with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Services, manufacturing and digital technology, to integrate new methodologies.
• Support the training and adoption of Generative AI tools within the organization.
• Technical Research & Prototyping: Assist the engineering team in subcomponent selection, hardware research, and lab-based prototype demonstrations to validate automation initiatives.
• Data Gathering & Computer Vision: Drive collection of visual data from site visits.
• Documentation & Operational Enablement: Help bridge the gap between development and field operations by assisting in the creation of training materials, and documentation required for handover to the services teams.
• Work with the services team to drive productivity initiatives for planned inspections and upgrades.
 
What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)
 
• Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Computer Science Engineering.
• Demonstrated basic knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration.
• Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
 
Eligibility Requirements: Ability to work on-site as required by the business; must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. 

What will make you stand out (Desired Qualifications)
 
• You have a passion for exploring technological advancements and energy industry innovations.
• You are someone who brings a proactive mindset toward process improvement and power generation industry problem solving.
• You have experience with data analysis or tools related to power generation field such as Gas Turbines.
• You have an interest in bridging the gap between digital technology development and on-site power plant services.
• Knowledge in Mechanical and Computer Science or Electrical and Computer Science is a plus. 

About GE Gas Power

GE Gas Power engineers cleaner, more accessible energy that people depend on, powering growth and prosperity for people everywhere. Our leading technologies produce a third of the world’s electricity thanks to our talented people, who make gas work for our customers, stakeholders and the world. Through relentless innovation and continuous partnership with our customers, we are building the energy technologies of the future and providing the cleaner, more efficient power people depend on today.

The pay range for this position is $1,000-$2,000 USD weekly. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Benefits Available to you: 
Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority, and at GE Vernova, we take our responsibility seriously. That is the singular mission of GE Vernova: to continue electrifying the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it. In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce.

Employees with a permanent address greater than 50 miles away from the work location are eligible.

Inclusion

Our Culture | GE Vernova

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. 
 
Who Are We? 
The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA.

Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users.
 
What Will You Do? 
In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: 
Damaged Instrumentation Repair
• Sensor Repair - Diagnose and identify failure mode and repair if possible• Pressure Transducers
• Optical Sensors
• String Potentiometers
• Rotary Encoders
• Calibration tools (i.e. Torque wrenches, TC readouts, etc.)

• Data Acquisition• Interface with DAQ systems and confirm issues

• Will require simulation of Input/Outputs• Document issue in detail for communication with OEM

Instrumentation Document Management
• Assist in creating processes and documentation for calibration and preventative maintenance procedures on many types of test systems and sensors
• Create electrical schematics of basic circuits and electrical systems
Assist in the update of complex electromechanical testing systems as needed
 
What Do You Need? 
To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: 
• Pursuing an Associate degree in Applied Science with a focus in Electrical Technology from a technical college
• Completed at least one year of coursework in Electrical or Instrumentation Technology
• Familiarity with DC circuits, soldering, wiring, electrical schematics, electrical diagnostics, problem-solving, and KiCad
• Strong attention to detail
 
What Can We Give You? 
At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including:

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

IS Manager
__
As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience through various projects. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your skills by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.
 
The work model for the role is onsite/hybrid in Cary, NC.
 
You will be mainly accountable for:
• The agents and connectors: building the AI layer's agents, tools and data connectors in Python, reading from our business systems through APIs and SQL.
• Multi-step workflows: designing agent flows in LangGraph or a comparable framework, with human approval built in. You'll work with read-only access and sandbox environments; nothing writes to a live system without human approval.
• The right retrieval for each question: a database query, an API call or a document search, and knowing which one fits.
• Evaluation: building evaluation sets, measuring whether answers are right, and improving them.
• Weekly delivery: shipping small pieces every week and demoing them to the team and to business users.
• AI assistants, owned: using AI coding assistants openly, and being able to explain every line you commit.
• Documentation: writing up what you build and learn so the next person can pick it up.

• Currently enrolled in a master's program, or in the third or fourth year of a bachelor's program, in computer science, mathematics, data science or industrial engineering in the United States. Master's students preferred.

• Intern must have reliable transportation to and from the worksite during the summer.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now and in the future.

• SQL, including joins across multiple tables.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Join us to turn ideas into world-changing realities where every voice matters and every difference builds a healthier world. Make a real-world impact through hands-on experience.

Job Description
Are you passionate about electrical engineering and eager to gain hands-on experience in a world-class lab environment? As an Electrical Engineering Co-op at GE HealthCare, you’ll work alongside engineers and technicians on high-impact projects that support the development of cutting-edge CT scanner technologies.
 
This 12-month co-op is designed to give you exposure to real-world challenges and prepare you for a future career in electrical engineering or product development. You’ll be part of the premium CT hardware engineering team, contributing to solutions that improve quality, reduce costs, and enhance patient care.
 
As a Co-op, you’ll take on project-based assignments with mentorship and training from experienced engineers. You’ll gain skills in electrical technician work and contribute to initiatives that support innovation and operational excellence. Looking for a well-rounded Electrical technical student that can execute on a variety of tasks on this super-awesome fun-tastic team.

Key Responsibilities
You’ll work on a variety of hands-on tasks, including:
• Soldering, assembling prototypes, and building test fixtures
• Setting up and running data acquisition equipment for testing
• Using electrical test equipment (DMMs, oscilloscopes, power supplies, network analyzers, etc.) to evaluate new designs
• Documenting test results and troubleshooting electrical systems
• Prototyping, reworking, and designing circuits to improve CT scanner performance
• Conducting experiments and diagnostic tests to support root cause analysis
• Evaluating software and hardware and implementing improvements
• Communicating technical findings to improve system performance and reliability
• Supporting the development of engineering, manufacturing, and service documentation
• Complying with Environment Health and Safety (EHS) regulations and quality policies

Qualifications
We’re looking for students who are ready to learn, lead, and make a difference. You are:
• Currently enrolled full-time in a technical diploma or degree program (pursuing Associate’s or Bachelor’s) in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field
• Available to work a minimum of 20 hours/week during spring/fall semesters or 40 hours/week during summer
• Able to work onsite at our Waukesha, WI facility
• Legally authorized to work in the U.S. (we do not sponsor employment visas for this role)

Preferred Qualifications
You may stand out if you have:
• Experience in mechanical or electrical trades
• Familiarity with Cadence or other ECAD software
• Basic understanding of a programming language such as Matlab
• Familiarity with digital electronics, switches and/or flux capacitors
• Strong communication skills and ability to simplify technical concepts
• Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills
• Proven leadership and initiative in academic or extracurricular settings
• Passion for technology and continuous learning
• A cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher (on a 4.0 scale)

Why Join Us?
At GE HealthCare, we’re building a healthier world powered by innovation and collaboration. As an Electrical Engineering Co-op, you’ll gain hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to a global organization that values inclusion, integrity, and impact.
 
We offer competitive compensation and a culture that supports learning, growth, and real-world contributions.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

jobs.description:
Job Location
BOSTON GO & TECH CENTER
Job Description
Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.
This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!

The Opportunity:
P&G has an opportunity for a PhD intern to work in the Grooming Research & Development business to develop innovative new solutions at the intersection of Data Science, Generative AI and Cognitive Science. The work will focus on understanding how consumers perceive changes in their skin and hair before and after shaving. The intern will explore key aspects of the shaving experience, such as perceived skin smoothness, evenness, and tone, by combining image-based technical measurements with visual perception and consumer data. Using approaches such as computer vision, multimodal AI, and Generative AI, the goal is to identify the skin and hair characteristics that drive what consumers see and experience, and better connect technical product performance with consumer perception. The ideal candidate is a curious and proactive PhD student with strong scientific, analytical, and problem-solving skills who enjoys tackling open-ended research problems, working across disciplines, and developing creative solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and evaluate multimodal GenAI approaches to understand skin and hair perception from images.
• Connect image-based measurements with consumer data to identify key visual drivers of perception and product experience.
• Build benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and metrics to assess model alignment with human perception.
• Explore agentic and multimodal AI workflows that integrate images, technical measurements, and consumer data to address open-ended R&D problems.
• Translate findings into actionable insights for R&D and product development.

Job Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
• Education: Working towards a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, Statistics, Cognitive Science, Human Factors, or a related quantitative/scientific field
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning, computer vision, multimodal AI, image analysis, data analysis, statistics, or quantitative modeling.
• Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027 in Boston, Massachusetts. Expected in-office schedule is 3 days a week in office at Gillette’s Boston, MA location. 

Preferred Qualifications:
• Analytical Methods: Experience with computer vision, image processing, machine learning, statistical modeling, perception research, human-subject studies, or multimodal data analysis. Experience connecting objective measurements to human perception is especially relevant.
• Generative AI: Familiarity with multimodal GenAI, vision-language models (VLMs), foundation models, or agentic AI workflows.
• Development Tools: Familiarity with collaborative development tools and workflows, such as Git and GitHub.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 
 
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

Position Summary 
Are you a curious, motivated ready to make an impact? Join F5’s Summer Internship Program and dive into hands-on projects that power real-world solutions! 
 
As a Software Development Engineer Intern, you will collaborate with talented engineers, design and build scalable systems, and explore technologies that keep the digital world safe. Whether your passion is backend development, DevOps, or learning new tools, you’ll take on meaningful challenges, sharpen your skills, and make your mark at F5.  
 
Eligibility 
• Open to students currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree at an accredited college or university in the United States. 
• Planning to graduate between December 2027 and June 2029. 
• No more than 2 years of full-time professional tech industry experience in a similar role. 
• Interns must be able to work onsite for the duration of the summer but can still participate in F5's hybrid work environment. Fully remote work options are not available. 
• This specific role is San Jose-based, and interns are expected to relocate if not currently residing in the San Jose, CA area. 
• Must be able to commit to a 12-week summer internship starting on one of the following dates (depending on your academic calendar): 
 May 24, 2027 – August 13, 2027 
 June 1, 2027 – August 20, 2027 
 June 21, 2027 – September 10, 2027 

The Ideal Candidate 
• Able to contribute to real-world projects and the development cycle of products that meet team goals.  
• Work with peers to design, implement, and test code in a collaborative environment.  
• Help analyze requirements, test features, and integrate components into applications.  
• Assist with creating technical documentation for designs and new features.  
• Participate in design and code reviews to learn best practices and ensure quality.  
• Collaborate with your project team to explore and develop data-driven solutions.  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 
• Technical Curiosity: You’re eager to apply your programming knowledge, learn new languages and tools, and grow your technical skill set.  
• Problem-Solving Mindset: You can think critically, use data to make decisions, and aren’t afraid to ask questions when faced with challenges.  
• Adaptability & Initiative: You’re willing to take on new challenges, contribute ideas, and adapt as projects evolve.  
• Team Player: You enjoy working with others, exchanging ideas, and supporting your peers to achieve common goals.  
• Strong Communicator: You can share your thoughts clearly, listen actively, and value different perspectives on the team.  
  
Qualifications 
• Currently pursuing  a bachelor’s or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related fields. 
• Must have at least two additional quarters/semesters of school remaining following the completion of the internship. 
• Be enrolled in an accredited college or university in the United States. 
• Demonstrated experience programming in an object-oriented language (e.g. Python, Go, Java, C#, C). 
• Demonstrated knowledge in computer science fundamentals (e.g. Data Structures and Algorithms). 
 
Preferred Skills (Not Required but Valued)  
• Experience with Systems & Scripting (e.g. Linux, Shell scripting). 
• Experience with Infrastructure & DevOps (e.g. CI/CD automation, Docker, Kubernetes).  
• Experience with Research & Applications (e.g. AI/ML). 
 
Why You’ll Love F5  
• Training & Mentoring: Develop your skills with comprehensive training and support from experienced mentors.      
• Wellness Weekends: Enjoy additional days off for rest and rejuvenation.      
• Continuous Learning: Embrace daily learning opportunities with autonomy and responsibility.      
• Intern Week: Gather with company leaders, fellow interns, and future colleagues for a fun and interactive week of events to celebrate interns and prepare you for a future at F5. 
• Path to Permanency: Excel in your internship and return to a full-time role in the same location after graduation!  
 
The hourly pay range for this position is: 42 USD – 55 USD.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 

What We Offer

Location:
Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

jobs.title: PhD Research Intern - Cross-Disciplinary Vision Science
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAn, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We, the Human Performance and Experience (HPX) team at NVIDIA Research, strive to lead AI innovation by deeply understanding humans. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about cross-disciplinary research in vision between humans and machines. We expect candidates with backgrounds in computer vision, human vision science, robotic vision, and related fields to be well-suited to this position. You will be working in a team of research scientists and engineers from varied backgrounds and closely collaborating with product engineers. Join us in transforming the future of AI and human interaction.

What you’ll be doing:
• Decompose research questions into smaller, more manageable parts and tackle them in iterative steps.
• Think critically to identify unseen gaps, and creatively bridge them with non-traditional, high-impact solutions.
• Connect with researchers and product engineers to ground research findings in real-world problems.
• Lead knowledge dissemination effort, with options for conference, journal, and in-house publication.

What we need to see:
• Currently pursuing a Ph.D. or equivalent academic program, demonstrated by a track record of research and publications.
• Deep interest in gaming and/or human behavior in related application domains.
• Training or systematic knowledge and skill in the field of Cognitive Science, Neuroscience, Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
• Proficiency with Python, Rust, and/or C++.
• Experience with AI model training and evaluation frameworks, like PyTorch.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience with quantitatively modeling human perception, cognition, movement, and/or decision-making.
• Comfortable with modern software development, version-control systems, like git(hub/lab). 
• Experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and inference workflows.
• Familiarity with and interest in modern deep learning models, including working with large-scale, multi-modal foundation models (such as recent LLMs, VLMs).
• Demonstrated public portfolio (e.g. repositories, OSS contributions, notebooks, packages, or technical blog posts with code).

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD.

You will also be eligible for Intern benefits. ​

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 10, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Optical Engineering Intern 

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
 
The HPE Optical Engineering team is seeking a motivated Intern to support the development, testing, and automation of next-generation optical networking solutions. This role offers exposure to a wide range of activities, including optical module validation, test automation, firmware verification, AI-driven workflow development, and advanced high-speed networking technologies. The successful candidate will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to projects supporting 400G, 800G, and emerging 1.6T optical products.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain automated test solutions using Python, LabVIEW, and related tools.
• Support Design Verification Testing (DVT) and characterization of optical transceivers and networking hardware.
• Assist with optical module performance testing, data analysis, and report generation.
• Contribute to firmware validation and testing activities for active electrical loopback (ELB) modules and related hardware platforms.
• Explore and develop AI-based tools and agents to improve engineering workflows, data analysis, and productivity.
• Analyze test results, identify issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive resolution.

Education & Experience
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field.
• Experience through coursework, co-op terms, personal projects, or research in software development, hardware testing, or networking technologies.
• Exposure to laboratory environments, automation, or embedded systems is an asset.

Knowledge & Skills
• Programming experience in Python; familiarity with LabVIEW is a plus.
• Understanding of basic networking concepts and communication protocols.
• Interest in optical communications, fiber-optic systems, or high-speed digital design.
• Familiarity with scripting, data analysis, and test automation methodologies.
• Exposure to firmware, embedded systems, or hardware debugging is beneficial.
• Knowledge of AI/ML tools, LLMs, or agent-based workflows is an asset.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced engineering environment.

What You'll Gain
• Hands-on experience with industry-leading optical networking products.
• Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including coherent optics, 800G/1.6T networking, automation, firmware validation, and AI-enabled engineering workflows.
• Mentorship from experienced optical, hardware, firmware, and software engineers.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
