Job Description:
 
About the Organization
The Analytical Engineering Lab applies scientific and engineering methods to investigate product escalations, perform physical and root-cause analysis, and address unique or complex technical issues. The team drives product reliability through proactive risk mitigation across the product lifecycle from concept and development through production and end of life.

Role Overview
As a member of the Analytical Engineering Lab, you will support the analysis, testing, validation, and reliability assessment of electrical and electronic components, subsystems, and hardware systems. You will work with experienced engineers and internal and external development partners to identify risks, evaluate product performance, and develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Analyze electrical and electronic components, subsystems, integrated circuits, and related algorithms using established engineering principles, specifications, and requirements.
• Execute established test plans for existing and new designs.
• Support validation of: Electrical tolerances, form, fit, and function, shock and vibration performance, electromagnetic interference and emissions, product safety, reliability and durability, thermal performance, system power consumption and electrical characteristics.
• Assist with physical and root-cause analysis of electrical hardware issues, product escalations, and unique technical problems.
• Evaluate the reliability of materials, components, designs, and manufacturing techniques.
• Develop an understanding of electrical hardware design and development processes.
• Collaborate with internal engineering teams and outsourced development partners.
• Contribute as a member of cross-functional project teams to develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions for low- to moderately complex products.
• Document analysis, test results, findings, and recommendations in clear technical reports and presentations.
• Provide technical support for design validation, reliability assessments, and proactive risk mitigation activities.

Required Education and Experience
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program in Electrical Engineering, preferably with at least three years completed; or
• Currently enrolled in a master’s degree program in Electrical Engineering.

Required Knowledge and Skills
• Basic experience with or understanding of electrical design tools, simulation tools, and engineering software.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Understanding of electrical and electronic component design, integrated circuits, and hardware systems.
• Familiarity with electrical testing, measurement equipment, and engineering test methods.
• Understanding of thermal and electromagnetic properties of materials and methods for managing electromagnetic emissions.
• Ability to interpret engineering specifications, requirements, schematics, and test data.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Proficiency in English and the applicable local language, where required.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a technical project team.

Preferred Qualifications
• Coursework or project experience in electrical design, electronics, signal integrity, power systems, thermal analysis, electromagnetic compatibility, or reliability engineering.
• Experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, spectrum analyzers, or network analyzers.
• Familiarity with root-cause analysis, design verification, validation testing, or reliability testing.
• Experience analyzing test data using tools such as MATLAB, Python, Excel, or similar software.
• Exposure to product development, manufacturing, or hardware troubleshooting.

jobs.description:
About the Role: 
 
This application is for a 6-month student role from January - June 2027. Resume review begins in October 2026. 
 
The US Integrated Analytics & Insights (II&A) are thought-partners responsible for understanding therapeutic area and brand performance by leveraging structured and unstructured data to generate actionable insights, inform strategy and customer understanding, and execute projects. The co-op will play a critical partnership role within the US Nephrology team. 
 
What You’ll Do: 
 
The co-op will be a member of our Decision Sciences team- specifically under the Insights and Analytics function. The team is a direct partner with our rare disease therapeutic area. We partner with a variety of stakeholders (Brand Marketing, Field Execution, Advanced Analytics & Omnichannel, Patient Services) to build integrated US business insights and enable a culture of data-driven decision making with high quality and impactful analysis. 
 
As a co-op, you will be involved in: 
• Supporting the US Nephrology Insights & Analytics team in upcoming foundational market research and data analysis ahead of a new product launch 
• Supporting the end-to-end execution of insights and analytics projects, including business question definition, study design, data acquisition, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of findings to stakeholders. 
• Developing actionable insights and recommendations by integrating multiple data sources, including claims, EMR, market research, and secondary data, to inform business decisions within the nephrology portfolio. 
• Creating clear and compelling deliverables, including executive presentations, dashboards, data visualizations, and written summaries that communicate key findings and strategic implications. 
• Project management of primary market research projects for the nephrology insights team 
• Secondary data analysis of claims and EMR data 
 
Example projects may include: 
• Manage patient or HCP market research projects end to end including deﬁning the business need, requesting proposals from vendors, advising on research sample, monitoring ﬁeld and designing read out plans 
• EMR and Claims Data Analysis 
• Patient journey and treatment pathway analyses 
• Development of integrated insight reports that combine market research and secondary data analytics to address key business questions. 
 
Who You Are: 
 
• Experience in life science, marketing, technology or analytics preferred 
• Experience using analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms to analyze and interpret data preferred. 
• Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear business insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders. 
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, work independently, and thrive in a collaborative team environment. 
• Interest in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, market research, or patient-level healthcare data is preferred.

The selected candidate will work hands-on with electrical hardware, RF systems, and embedded software to build, integrate, and evaluate prototype and pre-production systems in a research environment.
This position will interact with engineers, researchers, and sponsors, spending the majority of time working at a PSU/ARL facility located in State College, PA.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

• Assist in the design, fabrication, and integration of electrical hardware and RF system test setups/fixtures
• Develop, modify, and troubleshoot software (C, C++, Python) supporting hardware test, automation, and data collection
• Perform hands-on assembly, wiring, configuration, and bench-level testing of hardware/software systems
• Support system integration, test, and evaluation activities in lab and field environments; document results
• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux-based systems and test environments
• Maintain lab equipment, inventory, and configuration records; support procurement of parts/tools as needed

• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and hands-on technical skills
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance up to TS/SCI

Preferred Skill/Experience include:
• Experience with embedded systems or hardware/software co-design
• Experience with lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers)
• Prior DoD/IC laboratory, systems integration, or trusted systems experience
• Active security clearance (Secret or higher)
• Experience with scripting/automation for test and data collection

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.  
 
What You Will Do 
Join our Test Solutions Engineering team within the Hardware Discipline Center at Raytheon, where you will be at the heart of hardware innovation developing cutting-edge electrical solutions for mission-critical defense systems. In this role, you will have a hands-on opportunity to design, build, and integrate state-of-the-art electrical test systems supporting complex defense products across their entire lifecycle—from high-tech engineering development labs to factory production, field operations, and long-term sustainment. Working within a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will ensure our test equipment meets the highest technical, performance, and reliability standards. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Design, develop, and integrate specialized electrical test products, interface adapters, cabling, and custom test fixtures for complex defense systems. 
• Develop detailed schematics, circuit board layouts, and electrical engineering documentation adhering to rigorous industry and defense standards. 
• Validate and characterize hardware performance utilizing advanced laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and power meters. 
• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex electrical anomalies and hardware integration issues across development and production environments. 
• Support project execution by ensuring test system designs meet established technical performance, schedule, and budgetary commitments. 
• Collaborate closely with systems, mechanical, software, and reliability engineers to deliver robust, integrated test architectures. 
 
Qualifications You Must Have 
• Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline. Degree must be obtained by start date. 
• Experience selecting, calculating values for, and integrating passive and active electronic components (such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors) within analog or digital circuit designs. 
• Experience operating laboratory test and measurement equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, waveform/function generators, spectrum analyzers, or network analyzers) to test hardware, interface with sensors, or measure electrical signals. 
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, labs or projects. 
 
Qualifications We Prefer 
• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher from an ABET-accredited institution. 
• Experience with circuit design, schematic capture, and simulation tools (such as PSPICE, LTspice, or Keysight ADS) for analog, digital, or mixed-signal applications. 
• Proficiency in programming or scripting languages (such as Python, C/C++, or MATLAB) for test automation, data acquisition, and instrumentation control. 
• Experience creating formal engineering documentation, technical specifications, and delivering presentations to technical peers. 
• Demonstrated diagnostic problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills in a laboratory or hardware development setting. 

What We Offer  
•  Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

jobs.description:
Data & AI Engineer 
Location: Leeds
Salary: Competitive Salary + Package (dependent on experience) 
Career level: Specialist/Consultant
 
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge. 
 
We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too. 
 
“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO 
 
As a team: 
 
Working across industry groups, our Data & AI team combines deep technology, business and industry expertise to design and deliver some of the largest, most challenging and highest profile data and AI solutions in the world. We operate across Financial Services, Resources, Products, Communications and Health & Public Services. 
 
Our practice is built around three strategic capabilities: AI Platform Engineering, AI Pipelines, and Data Products. Together these capabilities cover the full spectrum of modern data and AI delivery — from the cloud infrastructure and platforms that underpin AI workloads, through the pipelines that move and transform data at scale, to the data products that turn engineering effort into lasting business value. 
 
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join as an entry point into this capability, working across our three areas and developing your skills and specialisms as you grow. Our engineers work in an AI-augmented delivery model — using GenAI tooling as part of everyday engineering practice, applying AI-assisted approaches to how we design, build, test and document, and creating data and platform foundations that are ready for the AI and agentic systems our clients are building and running. 
 
You'll learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of experts, this could be the role for you. 
 
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will work across the following: 
 
• Building and operating cloud data and platform solutions across modern cloud and data platforms including Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake 
• Developing and maintaining scalable batch and streaming data pipelines, applying ETL/ELT patterns to ingest, validate, normalise, cleanse and transform data at scale 
• Building and supporting cloud platform infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep or CloudFormation, contributing to the automated provisioning and management of cloud environments 
• Implementing CI/CD pipelines for data and platform solutions using Git, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including AI-assisted approaches to automated testing and documentation as part of standard delivery practice 
• Applying data modelling principles — including dimensional/Kimball, medallion architecture and source-to-target mapping — using AI tooling to draft and iterate models, with the ability to critically review outputs for correctness and fitness for purpose 
• Implementing data quality, lineage, observability and monitoring capabilities, applying automation and AI-assisted tooling to build scalable, self-describing pipelines and platforms 
• Supporting cloud platform operations including networking, identity and access management, security fundamentals and policy adherence 
• Using GenAI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering delivery — writing, testing and documenting with AI assistance and applying engineering judgement to validate and correct generated outputs 
• Developing a working understanding of agentic concepts — including how autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI systems interact with data and platform infrastructure — to inform how you design and build solutions that are fit for agentic consumption 
• Collaborating with architects, product engineers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and contribute to solutions that meet both technical and business needs 

We are looking for experience in the following: 
 
• Cloud engineering across one or more of: Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake 
• Python and SQL, with strong engineering fundamentals 
• Batch and/or streaming pipeline development, or cloud infrastructure and platform engineering — or both 
• CI/CD tooling for data and platform delivery (Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) 
• Practical use of GenAI or AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Databricks Assistant or similar) in day-to-day engineering work 
• Some familiarity with AI-ready architecture concepts — including awareness of how engineering decisions around quality, latency, schema, security and lineage affect the reliability of downstream AI and ML systems 
• A basic understanding of agentic AI concepts and how autonomous systems interact with and depend upon data and platform infrastructure 
 
You should apply if: 
 
You don’t need to tick every box on this list. We’re looking for curious, driven technologists who have demonstrable experience across a number of the skills and technologies above, and the appetite to grow into the rest. If you relish a challenge, embrace learning as part of your everyday work, and want to be part of a team that pushes boundaries and holds itself to a high standard — we want to hear from you. 
 
Set yourself apart with one or more of the following: 
 
• Data modelling experience including dimensional design, medallion architecture or source-to-target mapping 
• Hands-on experience building pipelines that support agentic workflows or LLM-based applications 
• Familiarity with data product principles: discoverability, reusability, quality contracts and SLAs 
• Hands-on experience with Decision Intelligence Platforms (e.g. Palantir, Quantexa) 
• Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation or similar) 
• Cloud networking, identity, access management or security engineering experience 
• Familiarity with policy-as-code or platform governance controls 
• Relevant cloud or data platform certifications (e.g. Azure Data Engineer Associate, AWS Data Analytics Specialty, Databricks Certified Associate Developer, AWS Solutions Architect Associate) 
• AI or ML engineering certifications (e.g. Databricks Generative AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer) 
 
What's in it for you 
 
At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 25 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days’ leave per year for charitable work of your choice! 
 
Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

jobs.title: Finance Data Platform Consultant
jobs.description:
Finance Data Platform Consultant 
Career level: Consultant (CL9) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Platform Transformation) 

Why this role 
Finance has always run on data infrastructure of some kind, but the modern data platform matters more to a finance function than it ever has, and this is where you learn to build one. You'll work on the finance data platforms our clients depend on: a governed foundation that holds the enterprise's financial data, integrates with the ERP estate producing it, and carries the reporting, analytics and AI the CFO's teams use. You'll be hands-on from the start: modelling data, building and testing the pipelines that feed the platform, and getting the numbers on it to agree with the ledger. You'll grow quickly, on real programmes, alongside people who architect this work for a living. 

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control. 

"Every leader needs to think of themselves as a reinventor. … Being a reinventor is believing that every part of the enterprise and their product has to be reinvented using tech, data, AI—new ways of working, new ways of engaging." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO 

What you'll bring 
Working on the finance data platform. Hands-on experience of a modern cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks or Palantir Foundry, or something comparable) and a working grounding in how one is put together: the layers that take data from raw ingestion through a conformed core to the curated sets finance consumes, the data products built on top of them, and the access and security rules around them. You build and test what the design calls for. You write queries and transformations that are efficient as well as correct, because compute on these platforms is a cost the client pays for, and you can explain why a piece of finance data sits where it does. 

Integration with the ERP estate. Financial data originates in the ERP and the applications around it, and the integration is where most of the difficulty sits. You'll build and test the connections into that estate (SAP, Oracle or whatever a client runs) across subledgers and the general ledger, consolidation, close and reconciliation tooling. You work with ETL, ELT and API patterns, with both scheduled batch loads and change-data-capture feeds, and you handle the things source systems do in practice: master data that changes underneath you, late postings, restatements and reopened periods. You take reconciliation seriously. What the platform reports has to agree with what the ledger says, and building the tests and monitoring that prove it is often your job, as is catching a broken feed before it reaches a reporting pack. 

Enterprise structure and finance master data. An awareness of how a finance data model reflects the legal, management and reporting structure of the enterprise: chart of accounts, entities and ledgers, cost and profit centre hierarchies, and the finance master data underneath them. The same work runs on ERP programmes, where chart-of-accounts and finance master data design are core workstreams, so this is capability you can put to use on a platform build and on an ERP implementation alike. You'll work within the governance and lineage the design sets, document what you build, and keep a figure in a report traceable back to the transaction behind it. 

Analytics and reporting. This is what the platform is there to serve, and a good part of your work will sit here: building management reporting, the datasets behind self-service analytics, and the semantic and metrics definitions underneath both, so a measure such as margin or cost to serve means the same thing in every report that uses it. You'll build and test those models and reports, check the numbers behind them against the ledger, and work with the finance people who use them on what they need. 

AI on the platform. This is where financial data turns into decisions: predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, AI-generated commentary and agentic workflows among the use cases, along with the human-in-the-loop controls that keep finance in charge of what the models produce. You'll build the data behind them, and there is every opportunity to be part of those conversations and the design work as the use cases take shape. Experience of analytics or AI work in a finance setting is a real plus, not something we expect you to arrive with. 

Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and follow it through, and you support the team around you. You're comfortable in workshops and working sessions with client finance and technology people, contributing to the design workstreams the lead runs in front of the client, and you produce clear analysis and options that inform the decisions taken. Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, build and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. If you already work this way, that's a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience.

You take ownership and follow through. You work well in a team and build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues. jobs.title: High Speed Serdes Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. 

We are now looking for a Validation Engineer in the DGX Server Product Engineering Team. In this role you will be working with a team of HW/SW engineers to develop and implement complex automated test plans for our industry leading GPU accelerated computing products.

What you will be doing:
• Own validation of products from start to finish including test plan development, automation, design for validation requirements, resource planning, coverage metrics, test execution, bug resolution, and release to production.
• Collaborate with ODMs, component suppliers, and QA teams to ensure no gaps in coverage.
• Coordinate internal and external teams in different times zones.
• Develop system level stress and performance testing strategies using industry leading Deep Learning/AI applications.
• Solve complex system level hardware and software issues on GPU accelerated computing platforms.

What We Need to See:
• Recently completed a BS, MS, or PhD in EE or CE or related field or equivalent experience. 
• Ability to work on site in hardware lab environment 5 days a week
• Experience in validating and debugging complex systems.
• Developing/running real world workload and factory diagnosis tools
• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficient in collaborating across teams and suppliers to deliver quality products on tight schedules.
• Familiarity with lab instrumentations like Oscilloscopes (Digital Multi Meter)
• High-speed IO validation and SERDES validation experience (50GBaud/s and above) is a must.
• Strong understanding of DSP-based high-speed SERDES architectures.
• Coding experience with programming and scripting languages such as C/C++, JS and Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience with datacenter products including system management, security, networking, and storage.
• Familiarity with Ethernet and InfiniBand switch architectures is a strong plus.
• Hands-on experience with SERDES performance tuning would be a strong advantage.
• Track record of continuous process improvement with a passion for tools and automation.
• Proven knowledge in Circuit and Waveform analysis.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer Associate
jobs.description:
Company
Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

When you join the Federal Reserve—the nation's central bank—you’ll play a key role, collaborating with leading tech professionals to strengthen and protect our economic, financial and payments systems. We invest in contemporary and emerging technology each year to support the Federal Reserve and our economy, and we’re building a dynamic and diverse team for our future. 

We invite applications for AI Solutions Engineer - Associate
The AI Solutions Associate Engineer role is ideal for early-career professionals looking to build a career in supporting the development and maintenance of AI/ML solutions using Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI frameworks, combined with Infrastructure as Code and automation practices. The engineer will contribute to building and supporting scalable, secure AI-powered systems for the Federal Reserve System under the guidance of senior team members.

Infrastructure Platforms & Operations: 
You will be joining The Infrastructure, Platforms & Operations portfolio. This business line supports the strategic direction and product delivery for System IT infrastructure and operations, as well as the alignment of technology to business strategies. The team serves as the business partner for secure and reliable IT products, services, and operations. 

This position does not sponsor employment visas. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents with at least three years of legal residency.

There are three (3) vacancies for this job profile, candidates will be selected based on the needs of the position and the strength of the candidate pool.

AI/ML Solution Development
• Work under close direction and guidance; follow established methods and policies.
• Contribute to RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows to support business use cases
• Write automation scripts using Python to help streamline AI model deployment, data pipelines, and operational processes
• Assist in building and deploying GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions leveraging AWS Bedrock and related AI/ML services, under guidance from senior engineers
• Support configuration of AWS infrastructure for AI workloads including compute, storage, networking, and security using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles
• Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning using GitLab or similar tools
 
Application Development & Support
• Assist in developing user interfaces using React for AI front end, monitoring solutions, and administrative applications
• Help troubleshoot and resolve routine to moderately complex AI infrastructure and application issues
• Code, test, debug, and document AI/ML pipeline components and infrastructure enhancements
• Produce ad-hoc queries, reports, and simple automation tools as requested by technical teams and business management
• Support system health checks and basic troubleshooting to help ensure reliability of deployed solutions
 
Collaboration & Process Improvement
• Work as part of an Agile team, contributing to AI capabilities that support business processes and decision-making
• Participate in design reviews and team discussions, raising questions and sharing observations
• Support change and problem management activities using standard tools, following FRIT change management policies and procedures
• Assist with analysis of business requirements as they relate to AI solutions
• Help document AI solution details, runbooks, and operational procedures following technical writing best practices
 
Minimum qualifications:
0 to 3 years of direct relevant work experience in AI/ML engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering OR a bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred. 
Information technology Interns with a BA degree and a strong technical foundation, from their internship experience, and relevant coursework in AI/ML are encouraged to apply
 
What we are looking for:
• Foundational knowledge of Generative AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), and prompt engineering
• Basic exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and vector databases
• Basic understanding of Agentic AI concepts and orchestration patterns
• Working knowledge of Python for scripting and automation
• Basic proficiency with Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools
• Familiarity with core AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, VPC, IAM)
• Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as GitLab
• Basic knowledge of React for frontend development
• Understanding of version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
• Basic knowledge of SQL queries and data analysis techniques
• Certification related to Information Technology or AI/ML preferred (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, AWS AI Practitioner, or similar)
 
Technical Competencies:
• General knowledge of cloud computing concepts and AI/ML system basics
• Basic understanding of networking fundamentals and security principles
• Willingness to learn and grow problem-solving skills to debug technical issues with guidance
• Ability to follow technical standards and engineering best practices
• Basic awareness of performance measures and metrics relevant to system health (nice to have)
 
Professional Competencies:
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail
• Ability to document technical work clearly for technical and non-technical audiences
• Collaborator who is cooperative and open to feedback and mentorship
• Demonstrates enthusiasm for learning new AI technologies and staying current with industry trends
• Basic understanding of risk management principles in decision-making, particularly regarding responsible AI use
 
In addition to meeting the above requirements the following are nice to have but not required:
• Coursework, projects, or internship exposure to AWS Bedrock or GenAI/RAG applications
• Exposure to AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, or similar)
• Basic knowledge of vector databases and embedding models
• Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, ECS, EKS)
• Exposure to API development and RESTful services
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies
• General familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts (e.g., logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards) and related tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or similar platforms

Additional Information:
The full salary range for the Associate Engineer job profile: $76,000-$95,800.00-$124,500.00.

Regular
Job Description

Summary

As an Associate Software Engineer, one works with and is mentored by a talented group of engineers in a fast moving, collaborative Agile development environment. In this entry level role, one plans, designs, develops and tests software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools.

Position Responsibilities

• Works within a defined software life cycle development process
• Supports the full life-cycle of product including design, coding, debugging, test, deployment and maintenance
• Codes, simulates, integrates and validates software. Writes quality code that is modular, reusable, testable, and scalable. Writes unit tests to test code you've written.
• Participates in software design reviews
• Delivers work on time according to estimated completion dates and project schedule & budget
• Supports and derives algorithm design from detailed software requirements
• Uses JIRA to keep an accurate work log and status of all tasks. Works closely with multiple teams of software developers supporting different programs
• Follows AV's software development process to develop quality code under general supervision
• Works on problems of limited scope. Operate in a continuous learning environment under moderate supervision
• Works closely with other engineering disciplines
• Other duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related discipline is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
• 0 - 2 years of relevant experience in Windows or Linux application software development. Object Oriented Design experience a must; Qt experience is a plus.
• Expertise in one of the following: C# .Net, Java, C++, and/or Web UI
• Demonstrated familiarity with source code configuration management tools such as SVN and Git
• Experienced writing unit tests, using an IDE and understanding basic debugging techniques
• Demonstrated mathematical and analytical skills are required
• Demonstrated understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, database, and operating systems.
• Willingness to travel locally (Occasionally)

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

• Experience with test-driven development is preferred
• Experience with Android, iOS, or React/Redux web development is preferred
• Demonstrated basic knowledge of networking is preferred
• With guidance from senior engineers, one contributes to the design, coding, documenting and testing software using the Scrum Framework

• Demonstrates strong listening, questioning, clarifying and summarizing skills to effectively communicate in one-on-one and small group setting
• Develops and enhances professional expertise. Demonstrates ability to research and re-engineer to propose alternate solutions to issues.
• Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties
• Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives

• Has effective problem-solving, analytical, interpersonal and communication skills

Physical Demands

• Required to stand and sit for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)

No Clearance

Job Description

Summary

In this entry level role, the Software Engineer I (Embedded) has the opportunity to develop a variety of innovative unmanned and robotic systems for multiple defense and commercial applications. The Embedded Software Engineer writes functional software for deployment on embedded devices and systems like aircraft and payloads and have the opportunity to test out those devices in flight test environments. This requires the engineer to design, develop, code, test and debug system software as well as analyze and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of the software on particular devices. There is a mix of full lifecycle development as well as a need to use existing software code base to expand the capabilities to match specific program requirements.

Position Responsibilities

• Writes and tests software to support integration of sensors and embedded processors into aircraft (such as autopilots, payloads, software defined radios or other functional components) or other robotic systems
• Designs and implements software for prototypes and products using established AeroVironment and industry developed tools and practices. Ensure good configuration control and management of software
• Assists in writing of system requirements, system test plans, diagnostic tools, and in validation testing of software. Assist with hardware selection and recommend processing, memory and storage needs of systems
• Support development of rapid prototyping and conceptual level testing and will require estimating time to develop software and scoping the depth of the development with project/program management to fit timeline and budget constraints
• Works closely with other engineering disciplines. Focused on getting the job done
• Supports transition of development software to production environments and to certification. Participates in multi-disciplinary development teams
• Develops proof of concept capability demonstrations. Conducts and supports design reviews
• Follows AV's software development process to develop quality code under general supervision
• Works on problems of limited scope. Operates in a continuous learning environment under moderate supervision
• Other duties as assigned

• A BS degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or related field is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
• Minimum 0 - 2 years of experience years of relevant experience
• Experienced trouble-shooting systems is required and is proficient with Python, C, C++11,C++ STL and/or OpenCL
• Demonstrated knowledge of Visual Studio, Eclipse or similar IDE as well as defect tracking tools
• Experienced working with common protocols such as RS-485, RS-232, CAN, I2C, SPI, USB
• Demonstrated mathematical and analytical skills are required
• Periodic travel will likely be required in support of testing equipment at approved flying locations
• Periods of development may require long irregular hours around deadlines, weekends and some holidays and in field test environments

• With guidance from senior engineers, be able to contribute in the design, coding, documenting and testing software

• Experience using Video 4 Linux and modifying and compiling Ubuntu Linux Kernels is desired
• Experience developing drivers for Linux/ARM and Robot Operating System (ROS) is desired
• Basic electronics knowledge and use of lab equipment is preferred
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills
• Understanding of the design of the system that one is working on and understand the role that assigned tasks play in the system

Our engineers are the technical visionaries behind our innovative solutions. Globally recognized for delivering cutting-edge systems, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate across functions, and lead advancements that shape our industry. Supported by a culture of flexibility, growth, and innovation, join us to create a lasting legacy in safety and simulation. 
Description 
Are you interested in solving complex engineering challenges while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, operational specialists, and members of the Canadian Armed Forces? 

Join CAE’s embedded software development team and contribute to the operational effectiveness and evolving capabilities of the CF-18 fighter aircraft. You will participate in multiple stages of the system and software development lifecycle, from technical investigations and client discussions to requirements, design, implementation, testing, integration, qualification, and in-service support. 

Responsibilities 
• Contribute to projects that optimize the operational effectiveness of the CF-18. 
• Develop new functionality and improve existing mission-computer capabilities in areas such as armament, communications, tactics, information acquisition and processing, and human-machine interfaces. 
• Participate in technical investigations and discuss potential solutions with clients and operational specialists. 
• Define and analyze system and software requirements. 
• Contribute to design, modelling, programming, integration, testing, debugging, and software qualification activities. 
• Collaborate directly with operational specialists, including CF-18 pilots, and members of the Canadian Armed Forces. 

This is a full-time, Monday-Friday hybrid working arrangement, with an expected presence of two to three days per week at the Mirabel office and occasional work from the Saint-Laurent office. Employees are expected to work 40 hours per week, and core working hours are from 9:30AM – 3:30PM. 

Minimum Qualifications 
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, electrical, aeronautical, software, computer, or another relevant engineering discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

• Understanding of mathematical models or algorithms related to flight mechanics.

jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena is seeking a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity (SI/PI) Engineer to contribute to high-speed interconnect and chip designs for AI-driven networking systems. The role contributes to the development and validation of complex interconnect technologies supporting next-generation networking performance. The successful candidate will contribute across simulation, analysis, and laboratory validation activities.

How you will make an impact:
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and develop complex interconnect structures, including ASIC packages and high-speed transitions for SerDes and RF links.
• Interpret design requirements and build 2D/3D electromagnetic (EM) models for simulation and analysis.

• Education: Master's degree in Electrical Engineering OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience: Previous internship, co-op, or applied project experience in the application of SI/PI simulation and analysis tools, including HFSS, SIwave, ADS, Sigrity, and MATLAB.
• Utilization of Cadence Allegro or similar EDA tools.
• Application of PCB and package design principles, high-speed signaling, power delivery networks (PDN), IR drop analysis, and transmission line theory.
• Exposure to laboratory test instruments, including VNA, oscilloscope, BERT, and spectrum analyzer.
• Demonstrated teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and continuous learning capabilities.

Nice to haves:
• Education: PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
• Background in semiconductor, RF, or high-speed circuit design.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

Viridien (www.viridiengroup.com) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. 

Job Description:
Start your career with a recognized leader in geoscience technology and solutions! As a member of Viridien’s Subsurface Imaging team, you will receive comprehensive training to apply knowledge of seismic data acquisition, wavelet processing, and velocity modeling to generate precise 3D images of the Earth's subsurface. This role empowers you to help our clients extract maximum value from their data and make well-informed assessments to minimize environmental impact and exploration risk. You will learn to experiment with various mathematical and geophysical concepts while leveraging state-of-the-art geoscience technology and high-performance computing applications to ensure a high-quality product.

You will be part of a diverse and supportive team, working collaboratively with other Seismic Imagers to solve some of the world’s most complex subsurface challenges. As a key contributor, your responsibilities will include managing daily operations, performing data analysis, ensuring optimal quality control, conducting research-driven problem-solving, and optimizing workflows. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Research and Software Development teams to develop innovative techniques and tools and contribute to publications on emerging technologies.

At Viridien, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about science, technology, and making an impact, we’d love to have you on our team. Let’s shape the future of geoscience together!

Organization: The University of Rochester Clinical and Translational Science Institute Informatics Core provides comprehensive informatics infrastructure and expertise to support the full spectrum of clinical and translational research. The Core offers secure access to and integration of clinical, research, and populationlevel data; advanced data management and harmonization services; and analytic support spanning biostatistics, real-world data, and multi-omics integration. NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Join NVIDIA, where we are pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI and cloud computing. As a versatile Systems Software Engineer - AI and Cloud, you will be part of a team of dedicated professionals that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, you will have the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects that craft the future of technology. This role offers an outstanding chance to engage with advanced AI models and cloud-native architectures, making significant contributions to NVIDIA’s versatile products and technologies.

What you'll be doing:
• Evaluate cloud-native, full-stack applications using microservices architecture to power AI use cases, bringing to bear NVIDIA frameworks, SDKs, and microservices.

• Design and implement agentic workflows with advanced techniques like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and the latest AI models.

• Evaluate user experiences and analyze the technical performance of AI solutions, compiling findings into comprehensive reports. Offer practical suggestions for product improvement to senior executives and engineering management.

• Engage with various teams across NVIDIA such as product, marketing, hardware, software engineering, and QA to improve NVIDIA's product offerings.

• Develop developer-focused content, including detailed tutorials and code samples, to demonstrate the latest features in NVIDIA’s tools and libraries.

• Write technical whitepapers and product briefs, and run technical demos of our products at prominent industry conferences.

What we need to see:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related degree (or equivalent experience).

• Proficiency in Python and JavaScript for programming and debugging, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

• Basic familiarity with C++ programming and its application in high-performance computing environments.

• Experience in crafting cloud-native systems optimized for Kubernetes deployment, using inference frameworks such as vLLM and NVIDIA Triton Inference Server.

• A solid understanding of API design principles for building scalable, production-ready inference systems.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Advanced knowledge of LLMs, modern AI software architecture, and cloud APIs.

• Contributions to public-facing technical content and open-source projects.

• Expertise in deploying LLM inference frameworks like Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or TensorRT, including on Kubernetes or edge devices to improve performance.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. The Internal Communications team aims to create clarity, trust, and shared understanding that inspires our employees to do their best work. We partner across the company to craft clear, compelling narratives about what’s being built, why it matters, how it aligns to our strategy, and most importantly, how it advances our mission.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced internal communications leader to own the strategy for our Enterprise & Growth portfolio, spanning B2B, Revenue, Partnerships, Marketing, Enterprise Engineering, Ads, Commerce, and Consumer Verticals. These teams are changing how businesses operate, bringing AI into working life, and expanding access to its benefits. This work is central to our mission of ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity: helping people and businesses everywhere put AI to use in ways that improve their lives and livelihoods.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with executives to help employees understand where the business is going, why decisions are being made, and how their work ladders up. You will draw on a deep understanding of the teams you support and leverage strong relationships across the company to shape the communications approach and deliver the writing and programs that bring it to life.

A central part of this role is helping employees understand how our technology reaches people and businesses – and what we learn when they use it. You will bring user and customer experiences into companywide conversations, help employees understand the products and capabilities we’re building for businesses and the problems they solve, and help leaders communicate through rapid growth and change.

We’re looking for someone with sharp editorial instincts, boundless creative ambition, and the sound judgment to handle sensitive, confidential, and consequential work with care. You should be equally comfortable setting the communications direction, writing an executive message that addresses what’s on employees’ minds directly and transparently, and hosting a live conversation that invites candid questions and open discussion.

OpenAI is a unique and fast-moving working environment. Priorities can shift quickly, and important work often begins before every detail is settled. You will often need to get up to speed on unfamiliar topics, recommend a path with incomplete information, and adjust as decisions evolve. We’re looking for a pro who takes initiative, understands what matters to employees, and anticipates tough questions and pain points early enough to help leaders address them.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Set and deliver the communications strategy for Enterprise & Growth. Understand the portfolio’s priorities, identify where communications can make a difference, and lead programs from initial recommendation through execution and evaluation.

 - Advise senior leaders and shape their communications. Develop leadership updates, narratives, and presentations. Offer clear recommendations on framing, timing, and delivery, holding a high bar for accuracy, clarity, and transparency with employees.

 - Guide communications through complex and sensitive changes. Develop plans for leadership transitions, organizational changes, and evolving business priorities. Work with People, Legal, External Comms, and XFN partners to explain decisions, prepare leadership, and address questions employees are likely to have.

 - Lead company-wide user and customer storytelling. Build programs that show how people and organizations use our technology, how it benefits them, and what employees can learn from their experiences. Develop creative formats that bring these stories to life, encourage engagement, and spark new ideas for what we could build next.

 - Bring employee perspectives into communications decisions. Synthesize questions and feedback from Slack, leadership forums, and other channels. Help leaders understand where employees need more context, recommend responses, and assess whether communications are improving understanding, morale, and trust.

 - Keep work moving as priorities change. Move quickly, adapt as new information comes in, and keep everyone involved informed about decisions and next steps. Respond to feedback, adjust course without losing momentum, and bring a constructive, collaborative attitude to challenging moments.

 - Strengthen the broader Internal Communications function. Contribute to shared priorities, provide thoughtful ideas and feedback, and turn successful approaches into practices others can use.




YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in internal or executive communications, marketing communications, operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex communications programs. People Management experience (1-2 years minimum) is required.

 - Experience advising senior leaders. You have built trust through preparation, discretion, and thoughtful and strategic recommendations, and can navigate disagreement with confidence and utmost respect.

 - Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain business strategy and complicated decisions clearly, adapt to different leadership voices, and identify the details that make a message trustworthy and credible. You can produce strong work on a short timeline and incorporate detailed feedback without losing the purpose/“the why” of the message.

 - Curiosity about how businesses grow and how people use technology. You can connect commercial priorities, product developments, and customer experiences to our mission and the questions and themes employees care about.

 - Strong program leadership, ownership, and adaptability. You bring structure to ambiguous work and carry it through with limited direction. You can move between strategic planning and hands-on execution, learn an unfamiliar part of the business quickly, and revise your approach when new information changes the picture.

 - Sound judgment and resilience under pressure. You stay constructive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented through compressed timelines, candid feedback, and changes in direction. You can rethink a draft or plan quickly, raise concerns early, and make thoughtful decisions about when to move and when to pause for more context. Your partners have deep trust in your judgment and look forward to working with you on the most challenging projects.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. 

This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area. #LI-hybrid 

Who We Need 

Truveta is building a diverse and inclusive team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking enthusiastic new graduates who are problem-solvers, collaborative teammates, and eager to make a difference in healthcare. If you’re excited about purposeful work, joining a mission-driven team, and launching your career in a supportive environment, Truveta could be the perfect place to start. 

This Opportunity 

At Truveta, you'll help health systems turn clinical data into better care. You'll work at the intersection of cloud services, analytical data platforms, and user experiences, building technology that lets clinical and quality teams define, monitor, and act on the metrics that matter most. 

Health systems deserve modern, intuitive tools for measuring care quality. Too often, getting answers from large-scale clinical data requires specialized skills and long turnaround times. At Truveta, we are building a next-generation analytics platform that lets health systems securely explore their data, track performance over time, and drive measurable improvements in patient outcomes. 

We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the services behind Truveta's clinical analytics experiences. You will develop scalable cloud services, APIs, and analytical data infrastructure, and contribute across the stack to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance solutions that make self-serve analytics a reality for health systems. 

You will work closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering teams to translate the needs of clinical and quality leaders into intuitive, scalable experiences. This role offers the chance to solve challenging technical problems, shape the future of Truveta's analytics platform, and make a meaningful impact on our mission of saving lives with data. 

Work Areas: 

• Build analytics infrastructure that serves population-level health data with low latency, so health systems can interactively explore and slice large datasets.

• Design and build self-serve dashboarding capabilities that enable health systems to define, customize, and share the metrics they use to monitor care quality.

• Develop services and APIs for metric definition, computation, and monitoring, with strong tenant isolation, access control, and data security.

• Optimize query performance and data modeling (aggregation strategies, caching, and storage layout) to deliver fast, reliable analytics at scale.

• Partner with Product, Design, and Data teams to turn clinical quality use cases into well-scoped, production-ready features. 

Key Qualifications 

• BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2+ years of experience building, deploying, and operating scalable cloud services using .NET (C#), Python, or a similar language.

• Experience with data, OLAP, or analytics technologies, such as analytical databases, BI and dashboarding tools, or data modeling for reporting workloads.

• Solid backend development experience with REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures on platforms such as Azure.

• Working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of query performance and data modeling tradeoffs.

• Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and deliver end-to-end solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience building embedded analytics, dashboarding, or other data-driven products for technical or business users. 

• Familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, including row-level security and tenant data isolation. 

• Familiarity with healthcare data, clinical quality measures, or health informatics. 

• Experience with containerized deployments, observability, and operating production services. 

Why Truveta? 

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together. 

We Offer: 

• Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage 

• Great benefits package 

• Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans 

• 401K plan 

• Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning 

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off 

• Generous parental leave 

• Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)

Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.

We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. jobs.title: Software Technician
jobs.description:
10Beauty is a robotics startup based in Burlington, MA on a mission to forever change the beauty and wellness space. We have raised $70M from some of the leading venture and celebrity investors in the country to build the world’s first fully autonomous 5-step manicure machine. We have pre-sold our first 1,000 machines to some of the most iconic brands in America, including Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom, Equinox and Marriott.

As of November 2025, we launched our first robot at Ulta Beauty in Everett, MA and are continuing to scale across said brand locations above. We are a fast growing 60+ person organization with deep robotics experience.

Come join the company who will put 'beauty robotics' on the map!

Introduction

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Software Technician to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for machine bring-up of our manicure robots, taking each machine from freshly built to fully operational using tools our team has built in-house. You'll combine software setup, networking, and hardware support to make sure each robot is ready to be deployed at customer locations.

This is an on-site role at our headquarters in Burlington, MA. If you enjoy working with computers and electronics and are excited about robotics, this is a great first step into the industry.

What You'll Do

• Perform machine bring-up on new robots, getting each one configured, connected, and ready for deployment

• Use our internal tools to install software, run setup steps, and verify that each machine works as expected

• Connect to robots remotely using SSH and other remote access tools 

• Assist with hardware work, including connecting components, checking cables, and helping diagnose hardware issues

• Follow written procedures and checklists carefully and consistently

• Document your work clearly, including setup results, issues found, and steps taken to fix them

• Shift between tasks as priorities change throughout the day

What You Have

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• A diploma from a technical or vocational high school program, or an associate's degree in IT, electronics, or a related technical field, is preferred

Experience

• Hands-on experience setting up, troubleshooting, or repairing computers, electronics, or other technology

• Experience in a tech support, electronics repair, or IT help desk role (such as retail tech support or computer repair) is a plus

• Experience working with robots or robotic systems is a plus

• Basic batch or shell scripting experience is a plus, not a requirement

• Exposure to SSH and remote access tools

Skills & Competencies

• Comfortable with computers beyond everyday use, such as installing software, changing settings, and troubleshooting problems

• Some exposure to the command line, SSH, or remote access tools, or a strong interest in learning them

• Basic understanding of networking, such as IP addresses, Wi-Fi, and connecting devices to a network

• Ability to follow detailed instructions accurately

• Strong documentation habits, so others can follow what you did

• Ability to switch tasks on the fly and stay organized when priorities change

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work hands-on with robots and equipment in a lab or production environment

At 10Beauty, we consider a wide-range of factors when determining compensation, based on individual qualifications, skills, and experience. Equity and benefits are included for all full-time employees. If you believe you can contribute to our team, we invite you to apply. We appreciate diversity and welcome those who can bring fresh perspectives and skills to our team. 

Salary Range
$45,000—$50,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

Thank you for considering 10Beauty!

jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Scientist Intern at Mercor, you’ll work on research at the frontier of post-training, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), data generation, and model evaluation.

You’ll investigate how datasets, rewards, and training methods affect the capabilities and behavior of large language models. This may include designing controlled experiments, developing new evaluation methodologies, conducting systematic failure analysis, and testing approaches to improve tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning.

You’ll work closely with research scientists, research engineers, and domain experts to turn open-ended questions into rigorous experiments. Your work will contribute to Mercor’s research agenda and may support external publications, benchmark releases, and the development of frontier AI systems.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop and investigate research questions related to post-training, RLVR, data quality, and model evaluation.

 - Design and run controlled experiments to understand how datasets, rewards, and training strategies affect model performance.

 - Study reward-shaping and post-training methods, including approaches such as GRPO and DAPO.

 - Develop methods for measuring data quality, usability, and performance uplift on key benchmarks.

 - Design and evaluate datasets, rubrics, evaluators, and scoring frameworks for complex model capabilities.

 - Conduct systematic error analysis to identify model failure modes and opportunities for improvement.

 - Analyze experimental results and communicate findings through clear reports, research artifacts, and presentations.

 - Build the research tooling and data pipelines needed to conduct experiments at scale.

 - Collaborate with research scientists, research engineers, applied AI teams, and domain experts producing training and evaluation data.

 - Contribute to research publications, benchmark releases, and other public research outputs where appropriate.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Currently pursuing a master’s or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics, or another relevant field.

 - Demonstrated ability to formulate research questions, design experiments, and draw sound conclusions from empirical results.

 - Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following:
   
   - Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating language models.
   
   - Agentic AI system, RL environments
   
   - Developing benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, or data-quality measures.

 - At least one publication or open source project.

 - Strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and the ability to write reliable research code.

 - Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals, experimental design, and statistical analysis.

 - Intellectual curiosity.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced research environment with rapid iteration and a high degree of ownership.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Previous research experience in language models, reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or post-training.

 - Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating language models.

 - Familiarity with RLVR techniques, reward modeling, or agentic AI systems.

 - Experience developing benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, or data-quality measures.

 - Research publications or submissions at competitive CS conferences such as ACL, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or EMNLP.

 - Research papers, technical reports, open-source projects, or other work samples demonstrating relevant skills.



Why Mercor

Impact: Your work powers how AI labs train and deploy their models

Learning: Get early exposure to frontier AI research and engineering

Growth: Work with a high-velocity team where interns ship to production

Benefits

 - Mentorship from experienced researchers.

 - Work on real, high-impact projects.

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Free Equinox membership

 - Team events and offsites.

 - Potential full-time return offer.

jobs.description:
HEALF IS EUROPE'S FASTEST-GROWING COMPANY.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.




THE NEXT CHAPTER IS HARDER AND MORE INTERESTING.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Moving from university to building your first production systems can be daunting. We understand! You will have hands-on support from experienced engineers around you to help support your learning and development.



You’ll help design, build and maintain the applications that replenish our warehouses, distribute stock internationally and directly drive the underlying key performance indicators of Healf’s business.




YOU WILL:

Learn: How to go from zero to robust working enterprise systems

Build: Cloud-native software robustly on AWS

Science: Using the latest Anthropic AI models you will bridge the gap between engineering, analytics and data science to invent genuinely smart systems

Impact: Developing intuitive user experiences people thank you directly for because it fundamentally improves how they perform their roles



As part of a small team you’ll have direct exposure to AWS infrastructure, the products, the sales and the supplier ordering data. You’ll get to meet and spend real time directly with the users of your systems.



Most importantly, you will be deploying your ideas daily with very little getting in the way of generating value.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Physics, Mathematics, Robotics or AI related area

 - A genuine passion to understand how things work, how processes interoperate and where system feedback loops might drive oscillations in business outcomes

 - Willing to attend our Hammersmith office 2-3 days a week

 - Open to travel; either to our Southampton warehouse and/or European warehouse locations so as to learn the real physical processes that we support in the warehouse operation space (~ once a year).
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Have a University or hobby project you’ve worked on that you think shows just how great you are? It doesn’t have to be software specifically! We would love to hear about it so please include a link on your application!




OUR HIRING PROCESS

 1. Introductory call with our Talent team (30mins)

 2. Technical take-home and review with an Engineer (60mins)

 3. Meeting with more of the team (30mins)

 4. Meeting with our COO (30mins)


THE DEAL

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.

We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.




IF THE MOST IMPORTANT WORK OF YOUR CAREER IS AHEAD OF YOU, THIS IS THE PLACE TO DO IT.
