jobs.description:
Job Description:
Quant Research Intern (Summer 2027 – New York)

About Jain Global 
Jain Global is an innovative multi-strategy investment firm founded in July 2024 by Bobby Jain. With over 400 employees across New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong, we bring together diverse teams to pursue excellence across asset classes and investment styles. We are seeking driven, intellectually curious individuals to join our growing Systematic Trading team.  
 
Role Overview
 
We are seeking a highly motivated intern to join the Systematic Trading team at Jain Global. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of quantitative research, technology, and financial markets. As a member of our internship program, you will collaborate with portfolio managers, researchers, and technologists to develop and test data-driven trading strategies.
 
You will gain hands-on experience in data analysis, model development, and systematic investment approaches, while contributing to the design and optimization of scalable trading systems. This internship is designed for individuals with strong analytical and programming skills who are passionate about applying quantitative methods to real-world market problems.
 
Responsibilities

• Assist in collecting, cleaning, and managing large and complex financial datasets for analysis.
• Develop and test quantitative models for pricing, forecasting, and trading using statistical and mathematical techniques.
• Collaborate with quantitative researchers and developers to design systematic trading strategies.
• Contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency, optimize runtime, and reduce operational risk.
• Apply programming and analytical skills to solve applied problems in a fast-paced, research-driven environment.
• Communicate findings clearly to team members and contribute to ongoing research discussions.

Qualifications & Skills

• Pursuing a Master’s or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computational Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
• Strong programming skills in Python or another object-oriented or functional programming language.
• Solid understanding of statistical modeling, including both linear and non-linear techniques.
• Ability to analyze and interpret large datasets and extract actionable insights.
• Demonstrated interest in applying technology and quantitative methods to solve complex trading problems.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills with the ability to collaborate in a dynamic, high-performance environment.
 
Why Join Jain Global

• Mentorship: Work directly with senior investors and researchers in quantitative trading.
• Ownership: Lead meaningful projects and drive innovation in a collaborative, entrepreneurial setting.
• Exposure: Gain insight into a multi-strategy investment model and the inner workings of systematic trading.
• Impact: Develop solutions that influence real investment decisions across asset classes.
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Join a culture that encourages creativity, independent thinking, and the pursuit of innovative ideas.
• Global Reach: Collaborate with teams across New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
• Career Path: Potential for full-time opportunities upon successful completion of the internship.
 
Compensation
The estimated base salary range for this position is $182,000 for Master's students and $234,000 for Ph.D. students, which is specific to New York and may change in the future.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer
As an employer, we believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of Jain Global teams to drive competitive performance. We believe an inclusive environment can yield exceptional contributions.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?
At RBC’s 2025 Investor Day, we reaffirmed our strategic ambition to become a client-centric, future-ready leader by harnessing data, digital innovation, and AI to deliver unparalleled value. Our commitment to technological excellence—recognized globally as a top-three bank for AI maturity—positions us at the forefront of an AI-informed banking era. With a bold goal to generate up to $1 billion in enterprise value from AI by 2027, we are accelerating investments in transformative technologies to redefine industry standards.
To fuel this vision, we are seeking a highly motivated Intern to join our team and contribute to cutting-edge projects in advanced analytics for risk management. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply data science and software engineering skills in real-world applications, directly impacting risk management workflows through solutions like generative AI, machine learning, and deep learning. As part of our dynamic team, you will collaborate on projects that drive efficiency, automation, and strategic business value—playing a key role in shaping the future of RBC’s AI-driven innovation.

What will you do?
• Participate in the end-to-end development of high-impact AI solutions, from idea design and PoC to production deployment.
• Work closely with business users to understand their needs, translate business use cases into practical technical problems, and iterate on solutions based on feedback.
• Focus on building real-world applications that address business challenges, rather than conducting pure research.
• Continuously learn and keep up with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies, sharing knowledge with the team.
• Present technical solutions and project updates to both technical peers and senior managements.

What do you need to succeed?
Must-have
• Hands-on experience prototyping GenAI applications, including working with foundational LLMs (e.g., GPT models via API) and transformer models (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers); familiarity with frameworks and tools (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack), and vector databases (e.g., Weaviate, PGVector).
• Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including designing and refining prompts to optimize LLM outputs.
• Hands-on experience developing modular, robust, and scalable software in Python 3.x.

About the Team: 
The Automated Driving Production Technology Team develops and improves the production technologies, hardware processes, and analytical capabilities that support automated driving systems. We work across engineering, manufacturing, quality, testing, and operations to improve efficiency, scalability, reliability, and performance. 

Our team combines expertise in hardware systems, production technology, data science, artificial intelligence, process engineering, and analytics to deliver data-driven improvements to production processes and engineering productivity. 

What You Will Do: 
We are hiring an intern to support AI and hardware process efficiency initiatives through data analysis, process optimization, automation, and analytical tool development. 

AI and Data Science 
Analyze production, quality, equipment, test, and operational data to identify trends, bottlenecks, variation, and improvement opportunities.

Hardware and Process Efficiency

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The HBM Platform Architecture team defines the electrical, thermal, and power-delivery architectures that enable Micron's next-generation High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions. Working closely with architecture, design, packaging, and technology teams, the organization drives innovation in signaling, power integrity, thermal management, and system optimization to support AI, high-performance computing, and data center applications.

As an HBM Platform Architecture Intern, you will contribute to the development of future HBM platforms by evaluating electrical, thermal, and power delivery architectures for advanced memory systems. You will work alongside experienced architects to analyze design trade-offs, develop modeling tools, and investigate solutions that improve performance, power efficiency, reliability, and scalability for next-generation memory products.

Responsibilities
• Perform signaling and timing analysis for on-die and off-die interfaces across multiple system and packaging topologies.
• Develop and evaluate thermal models to analyze heat transfer, thermal performance, and design trade-offs in advanced memory systems.
• Analyze power delivery networks (PDNs), including IR-drop, electromigration (EM), power integrity, and power grid optimization for advanced HBM architectures.
• Develop modeling, simulation, and automation tools to support power delivery, thermal analysis, and architecture evaluation activities.
• Collaborate with architecture, design, packaging, and technology teams to evaluate system-level trade-offs and support future HBM technology development.

• Coursework or project experience in analog design, I/O design, signaling, DRAM technologies, high-speed interfaces, packaging, or 2.5D/3D integration technologies.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Next-Generation HBM Architecture Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Memory Systems Architecture team defines the next generation of High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) solutions that power artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and data center applications. The team drives architectural innovation across memory systems, controllers, interfaces, and reliability features to deliver industry-leading performance, scalability, and efficiency for future computing platforms.

As a Memory Systems Architecture Intern, you will contribute to the architecture and microarchitecture development of future HBM products. You will work alongside experienced architects to evaluate new memory features, analyze architectural trade-offs, develop performance models, and explore solutions that improve memory performance, reliability, and efficiency for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

Responsibilities
• Research and evaluate next-generation HBM architecture and microarchitecture features, including memory scheduling, refresh management, reliability features, thermal behavior, and memory controller interactions.
• Develop and enhance performance models, simulators, and analytical tools using Python, C++, or similar technologies to assess architectural trade-offs and system performance.
• Analyze workload behavior, simulation results, and architectural data to provide recommendations for future HBM product development.
• Utilize AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to accelerate software development, specification analysis, data exploration, and technical documentation while validating outputs using sound engineering judgment.
• Collaborate with architecture, design, memory controller, and cross-functional engineering teams to support feature definition, design reviews, specifications, and roadmap development.

Minimum Qualifications
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, academic projects, publications, or coursework in computer architecture, memory systems, VLSI, semiconductor design, or related technical fields.
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Coursework or project experience in computer architecture, memory hierarchies, DRAM technologies, interconnects, or hardware system design.
• Programming experience with Python and at least one of the following: C++, SystemVerilog, or similar engineering languages.
• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, standards documentation, datasheets, or hardware interface definitions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Experience utilizing AI coding assistants and large language models (LLMs) such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar technologies as part of engineering workflows.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with memory or system simulation environments such as Ramulator, DRAMSim, gem5, or related architectural modeling tools.
• Knowledge of HBM, DDR, LPDDR, GDDR, memory controller architectures, or memory subsystem design.
• Familiarity with memory reliability and availability concepts, including ECC, repair mechanisms, refresh algorithms, or RAS features.
• Experience with SystemVerilog, digital design, RTL development, or verification methodologies.
• Experience applying AI tools to software development, data analysis, technical research, document analysis, workflow automation, or agentic engineering workflows.
• Understanding of AI training, inference, accelerator architectures, and the role of HBM in large-scale AI systems.
• Previous internship, research, publication, or project experience related to memory systems, computer architecture, semiconductor design, or SoC development.

jobs.description:
Posting Title
Undergraduate / Graduate (Spring / Summer) Intern - Cyber Security Research – 5G.
Location
CO - Golden.
Position Type
Intern (Fixed Term).
Hours Per Week
40.
Working at NLR
NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.
Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.

Job Description
The National Laboratory of the Rockies’ (NLR) cybersecurity research is strengthening our grid against tomorrow's threats. The selected intern would join the Cyber Mission Assurance team to support research efforts within the Cybersecurity Research Center’s portfolio including:
• Characterization of the potential for U.S. electric grid disruption from natural hazards and human threats
• Assessment of the cybersecurity of distributed energy systems
• Strengthening the resilience of the U.S. electric grid
 
The Cyber Mission Assurance team is looking for talented Software or AI Engineering interns to help build intelligent, data-driven applications for 5G and emerging 6G networks. This internship focuses on developing RIC rApps, xApps, and dApps, along with NWDAF-based analytics, enabling closed-loop automation and AI-powered optimization across the RAN and core network.
 
Interns will work on cloud-native, microservice-based systems that apply machine learning and advanced analytics to real network data, contributing to next-generation autonomous networks.
 
Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement RIC applications:• rApps (non-real-time optimization and policy-driven automation)
• xApps (near-real-time RAN control and optimization)
• dApps (distributed and domain-specific intelligent network functions)

• Develop and enhance NWDAF analytics functions for performance monitoring, prediction, anomaly detection, and optimization
• Build AI/ML models for network intelligence (forecasting, classification, reinforcement learning, root-cause analysis)
• Implement closed-loop automation workflows using AI insights and RIC control interfaces
• Develop cloud-native microservices using containers and Kubernetes
• Integrate with O-RAN and 3GPP interfaces (A1, E2, O1, service-based APIs)
• Process and analyze large-scale, time-series and streaming network data
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on design, testing, and validation
• Document software designs, experiments, and technical results
 
What you will learn:
• End-to-end development of RIC rApps, xApps, and dApps in 5G/6G systems
• Practical implementation of NWDAF-based analytics and AI pipelines
• Applying AI/ML to closed-loop network automation
• Building telecom-grade, scalable cloud-native software
• Insights into 6G intelligence, autonomous networks, and standardization trends
.

"Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.

Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution. 
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

• Experience working in Linux-based environments, command line, and networking
• Demonstrated knowledge and/or experience with AI-driven systems, distributed software, and telecom networks
• Knowledge or experience with data analytics pipelines such as one of the following:(Kafka, Prometheus, Grafana, time-series databases)

Preferred Qualifications
• Knowledge of 5G architecture, O-RAN, RIC, or 3GPP NWDAF concepts
• Experience with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)
• Experience with cloud-native technologies i.e. docker

jobs.title: Applied and Research Scientist/Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
The Opportunity 
Adobe Researchers and Applied Scientists are building the next generation of advanced technologies and user experiences, creating new forms of creativity, freeing people from routine tasks, and helping enterprises understand and act quickly on customer and business insights. Our teams publish in leading journals and conferences, partner with product teams to ship high-profile features, and explore new product opportunities across a wide range of domains. We foster collaborations that extend beyond the internship, whether that means contributing to your PhD thesis or seeing your work carried into a shipped product. 
All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located and hybrid. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities. 
Adobe Research focuses on the following research areas: 
• Audio 
• Computer Vision and Imaging & Video 
• Content Intelligence 
• Document Intelligence 
• Data Intelligence 
• Graphics (2D&3D) 
• Systems, Models & Languages 
• Intelligent Agents & Assistants 
• Natural Language Processing 
• Human Computer Interaction 
What you'll Do 
Under the direction of an Adobe mentor, you will: 
• Pursue a research problem to apply to Adobe's products, with the possibility of academic publication or direct product integration 
• Develop new algorithms, run experiments, and produce demonstration prototypes 
• Depending on project focus, contribute to translating research into working models, pipelines, or product-facing features 
• Document and present your work, both verbally and in writing 
What you need to succeed 
Minimum Qualifications 
• Current PhD or master's student in computer science, or related field (exceptional undergraduates will also be considered) 
• Ability to scope or formulate a research question, design an appropriate baseline and evaluation methodology, and reason about ML/statistical fundamentals 
• Strong communication skills and teamwork experience 
• Comfort working across the spectrum from open-ended research to applied, product-facing development, according to project specifications 
Preferred Qualifications 
• Relevant publications or research contributions at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, or ACL 
• Ability to balance exploratory thinking with delivering clear, practical results 
• Passion for solving real-world problems with web-scale data, using and inventing innovative Machine Learning algorithms 
• Demonstrates ownership, adaptability, and clear communication of your own work and its limitations. 

About Adobe
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern - Contacts
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ce que signifie être stagiaire en développement logiciel chez GoTo

Chez GoTo, nous façonnons l’avenir du travail en tant que pionniers des communications infonuagiques et de la technologie à distance en concevant des solutions flexibles et innovantes qui permettent à des millions d’utilisateurs de mieux vivre et travailler. En qualité de stagiaire au sein de nos équipes de développement logiciel, vous travaillerez avec des collègues curieux et passionnés qui transforment les possibilités en réalité. Ici, la collaboration, l’authenticité et la diversité des points de vue se traduisent par des résultats concrets, et vos idées sont réellement valorisées.
Vous ferez partie d’équipes d’ingénierie qui s’appuient sur des technologies de pointe, parmi lesquelles l’IA, afin de résoudre de véritables problèmes pour nos clients, en favorisant des solutions concrètes plutôt qu’en suivant des tendances. Nous vous invitons à tracer votre chemin : élargissez vos compétences, relevez de nouveaux défis, menez des initiatives et explorez des idées créatives. Notre culture est fondée sur la responsabilisation, l’apprentissage continu et le développement, permettant ainsi d’alimenter votre parcours professionnel tout en soutenant votre potentiel.
Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à redéfinir le fonctionnement de notre monde, bâtir l’avenir et faire changer les choses, tant pour nos clients que pour votre développement.

Nos équipes et nos opportunités:
Nom de l’équipe : Contacts
Compétences clés : Développement Web (TypeScript, JavaScript, WebComponents, LitHTML, HTML, CSS), Java
Description de l’équipe : Conçoit et tient à jour des outils de gestion des données des contacts et des appels, permettant aux clients de synchroniser, d’analyser et de gérer efficacement leurs données de communication.

Votre quotidien
En tant que développeur logiciel stagiaire, vos missions seront les suivantes :
• Collaborer avec des ingénieurs expérimentés et des mentors afin d’innover, de concevoir et de livrer de nouvelles fonctionnalités significatives pour les produits.

• Participer activement aux revues de code, à la rédaction de la documentation technique et à des déploiements fluides qui favorisent la qualité et la fiabilité.

• Explorer et évaluer le potentiel technique d’idées créatives afin de transformer les défis en solutions.

• Vous plonger dans les cérémonies Agile et collaborer étroitement avec des collègues passionnés venus du monde entier pour donner vie aux projets.

Ce que nous cherchons
Votre profil en tant que développeur logiciel stagiaire :
• Vous êtes actuellement en voie d’obtenir un diplôme en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe et avez acquis une expérience pratique dans au moins un de nos principaux langages de programmation ou cadres d’application.

• Vous communiquez efficacement en anglais et en français et aimez travailler dans un environnement diversifié et collaboratif.

• Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de motivation et de proactivité et vous montrez votre disposition à proposer des idées, à résoudre des problèmes et à contribuer à la réussite de l’équipe.

• Vous vous engagez à effectuer un stage à temps plein (40 heures par semaine) et comprenez que nous comptons sur vous pour considérer cette expérience comme un véritable emploi : soyez présent(e), impliqué(e) et profitez pleinement du temps passé parmi nous!

*Exigences linguistiques :
Pour les postes situés au Québec, vous devrez maîtriser le français afin de travailler aisément avec vos collègues, partenaires et fournisseurs locaux. La maîtrise de l’anglais est également importante, car elle vous permet de communiquer avec des parties prenantes à l’extérieur du Québec et d’accéder à la majorité des documents techniques et scientifiques. Ces exigences permettent à chaque personne de collaborer efficacement et de connaître l’actualité de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous offrons
• Une communauté collaborative : Rejoignez un environnement de travail qui valorise vos idées et contribue à votre développement. Collaborez avec des mentors chevronnés et des collègues talentueux, tout en acquérant une expérience pratique à chaque étape du cycle de vie logiciel. Notre environnement d’inclusivité vous encourage à apprendre, à contribuer et à jouer un rôle significatif, tout en évoluant aux côtés de professionnels qui tiennent à votre réussite.

• Un impact réel : Apportez des contributions concrètes aux projets en cours avec le soutien de mentors expérimentés, et observez vos idées prendre vie dans un environnement dynamique.

• Une carrière évolutive : Réalisez plusieurs stages afin de découvrir différentes équipes et technologies et bénéficier d’un apprentissage continu. Vous aurez la possibilité de prolonger votre stage et de rejoindre notre vivier de talents pour des postes situés en permanence à l’avenir.

• Une rémunération concurrentielle : Taux horaire concurrentiel (25 $ à 31 $/heure, selon l’expérience).

• Des avantages : Modèle de travail hybride pour plus de flexibilité, ordinateur portable fourni par l’entreprise et calendrier social dynamique avec des activités d’équipe.

Chez GoTo, vous trouverez la flexibilité, les ressources et le soutien dont vous avez besoin pour vous épanouir au travail, à la maison et partout ailleurs. Vous travaillerez à la réalisation d’un objectif commun avec une équipe ouverte d’esprit et unie dont l’impact est plus grand que la somme de ses parties. Nous nous engageons à créer un espace inclusif pour tous, parce que nous savons que ces perspectives uniques font de nous une entreprise et une communauté plus forte. Joignez-vous à nous pour faire partie d’une entreprise qui investit dans votre avenir. Ensemble, nous serons authentiques, nous verrons grand, nous avancerons rapidement, nous grandirons continuellement et nous maintiendrons notre priorité client. En savoir plus.

jobs.title: Applied GenAI Scientist Intern - GenAI Applications
jobs.description:
2027 Spring Intern - GenAI Applications

Why Genentech
We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

Department Summary
Genentech’s Data, Digital, and Analytics (DDA) organization applies data science and AI to high-impact business needs across Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG). We collaborate with business stakeholders and technology partners to translate advances in generative AI into practical applications that drive measurable business impact.

This internship position is located in South San Francisco, onsite.

The Opportunity
As an Applied GenAI Scientist Intern, you will explore how intelligent agents can reason, use specialized tools, and execute multi-step business workflows across CMG. Your project will focus on developing and evaluating a simple, reusable approach for adapting advanced GenAI agents to business use cases.

Building on the Deep Claude Agent approach, which uses Claude Code as an agent runtime, you will investigate how task instructions, reusable skills, context, and tool access affect agent performance. You will develop a working prototype and apply it to a focused CMG use case selected by your manager. Working with data scientists, business stakeholders, and platform partners, you will generate evidence and practical guidance for extending the approach to additional workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Define the use case and evaluation approach. Translate a selected CMG business need into a focused agent task, research questions, and measurable success criteria.
• Design and prototype specialized GenAI agents. Combine task instructions, reusable skills, and relevant tools and data to enable an agent to carry out the selected workflow.
• Assess and de-risk the model components the agent depends on. Compare hosted and open-weight options for specialized components such as the fast, calibrated classifiers used in routing, guardrails, and scoring, weighing accuracy, latency, and cost alongside licensing and data-handling terms. Recommend self-hostable alternatives where a dependency cannot be adopted as-is.
• Conduct systematic experiments. Investigate how agent configuration, context, memory, and tool selection influence reasoning, output quality, and task completion. Analyze failure modes and identify where human review is needed.
• Evaluate business value and reliability. Compare the agent’s performance with an agreed baseline, assessing accuracy, consistency, time savings, and execution cost.
• Develop a reusable capability and share findings. Deliver a working prototype, adaptable agent configurations, and clear guidance that makes the approach easier to apply across CMG use cases. Present results, limitations, and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Bring the latest techniques from academia into our organization and apply to our use cases.

Program Highlights
• Intensive 6-months, full-time (40 hours per week), paid internship.
• Program start dates are in January 2027.
• A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship.
• Ownership of an applied GenAI project, from experimental design through demonstration and evaluation.
• Collaboration with data scientists and business experts in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are

Required Education
You meet one of the following criteria:
• Must be pursuing a Master's Degree (enrolled student).
• Must have attained a Master's Degree.
• Must be pursuing a PhD (enrolled student).

Required Majors: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline. 

Required Skills
• Foundational understanding of machine learning and generative AI, including large language models.
• Experience using Python to conduct experiments, analyze data, or prototype AI applications through coursework, research, or personal projects.
• Ability to design experiments, critically evaluate results, and communicate findings clearly.
• Interest in applying GenAI to practical business problems and collaborating with domain experts.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications
• Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, prompt design, or tool-augmented reasoning.
• Familiarity with methods for evaluating LLM accuracy, reliability, and reproducibility.
• Exposure to Claude Code, agent skills, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
• Experience fine-tuning, serving, or benchmarking open-weight models, including encoder-based classifiers.
• Awareness of model licensing and data-handling terms when selecting third-party or open-weight components.
• Interest in commercial, medical, or government affairs applications within healthcare or biotechnology.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
• A commitment to Integrity, Courage, and Passion in daily work and decisions.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. 

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $52.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

About the role 
 NVIDIA is looking for a PhD intern to join the Deep Learning Efficiency Research team. This role focuses on two main areas: efficient diffusion language models and multimodal generative models, and efficient agentic AI with hybrid inference orchestration. You will work on research that bridges the gap between theoretical exploration and real-world application. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Research, design, and implement new methods for efficient deep learning. 
 Work on diffusion LLMs and multimodal models, including sampling efficiency, parallel decoding, and training pipelines. 
 Develop efficient agentic AI solutions, such as hybrid inference orchestration across cloud and edge, plus routing and scheduling policies. 
 Publish original research in top-tier venues. 
 Collaborate with internal teams, product groups, and external researchers to transfer technology. 
 
 What you'll need 
 
 Current enrollment in a PhD program for Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 Strong knowledge of machine learning and deep learning theory and practice. 
 Experience with large language models, diffusion models, multimodal models, or agentic systems. 
 Hands-on experience with large-scale model training, including data preparation and model parallelization techniques like tensor and pipeline parallelism. 
 A research track record that includes at least one publication at a top-tier conference such as ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, CVPR, or ICCV. 
 Excellent communication skills. 
 Bonus points for experience with CUDA, hybrid cloud-edge inference, or model optimization techniques like pruning, quantization, and NAS. 
 
 Location & details 
 
 This is a full-time, paid internship. 
 The role is based in Santa Clara, California, with both on-site and remote work options available. 
 Hourly pay ranges from 38 USD to 94 USD, depending on location, degree, and experience. 
 Sponsorship is not provided for this position.

jobs.title: Data Scientist Apprentice - Level 6 Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

2027 Data Science Apprentice – Level 6 Data Scientist
 
Start Date: 06 September 2027
Salary: £24,000 per annum
Employee type: Permanent
Location: Crawley
Working Schedule: Monday – Friday, 37 hours a week (8 hours Monday – Thursday, 5 hours Friday)
 
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to develop cutting-edge data science skills and solve real-world business challenges? Do you enjoy working with data, uncovering patterns, and using evidence to influence decisions? Are you curious about how artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics can help businesses innovate and improve performance? Our Data Scientist Apprenticeship provides an excellent opportunity to launch your career in data science while learning from industry experts within a leading technology company.
 
Benefits of the programme:
• Earn while you learn with a competitive salary.
• Gain hands-on, job-specific training and real-world experience.
• Achieve a recognised professional qualification.
• Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship
• Enjoy fully funded tuition fees on approved training programmes.
• Learn from experienced professionals and develop skills that will support your long-term career growth.
• Build valuable experience and develop your career in data science
 
About the Role
 
As a Data Scientist Apprentice, you will be valued for your curiosity, analytical mindset, and passion for solving problems using data. You will work with a variety of datasets, tools, and technologies to identify trends, build predictive models, and generate insights that support business decision-making.
 
Working alongside experienced data professionals, you will learn how to transform raw data into valuable business intelligence and help develop data-driven solutions that create measurable impact.
 
Your responsibilities may include:
 
• Identifying business challenges and using data science techniques to recommend solutions.
• Collecting, preparing, cleansing, and analysing data from multiple sources.
• Building skills in:
• Data Science and Analytics
• Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
• Statistical Analysis
• Data Engineering Fundamentals
• Data Visualisation and Storytelling
• Programming and Automation (e.g. Python, SQL)
• Supporting the development and testing of predictive models and analytical solutions.
• Working with data teams to create data products, dashboards, and insights used across the business.
• Evaluating model performance and supporting continuous improvement of analytical solutions.
 
What You Will Learn
 
Throughout the apprenticeship, you will gain experience and knowledge in:
 
• Data collection, preparation, and management techniques.
• Statistical methods and hypothesis testing.
• Programming languages such as Python and SQL.
• Machine learning concepts and model development.
• Data visualisation and storytelling techniques.
• Exploratory and predictive analytics.
• Artificial Intelligence fundamentals and responsible AI practices.
• Data governance, ethics, and compliance.
• Cloud-based analytics and data science platforms.
• Business and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Communicating technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Project management and agile ways of working.

Apprenticeship Programme

You will study towards a Level 6 Data Scientist Apprenticeship with The University of Nottingham. The programme is delivered over 42 months through a blend of:
• On-campus learning
• Online study
• Workplace-based learning 

You will typically attend university for a minimum of 4 weeks each academic year, delivered in 1-week blocks. On successful completion of the programme and End Point Assessment, you will achieve:
 
• A fully funded BSc (Hons) Data Science degree
• A Level 6 Data Scientist Degree Apprenticeship qualification

Entry Requirements 
To apply, you will need: 

• 3 A levels (BBC) including Maths (Citizenship Skills, General Studies and Critical Thinking are not accepted)

• Or a Level 4 Data Analyst qualification will be considered on a case-by-case basis 

GCSEs
· 
• Minimum of five GCSEs at Grade 4/C or above (Maths at Grade 5/C or above) Must include English Language and Mathematics

Please note that those with a relevant degree will not be eligible for this programme. 

Benefits 

• Competitive salary of £24,000 per annum
• Performance-related pay uplifts
• Holiday entitlement of 201 hours a year (plus a company day and bank holidays)
• Contributory Company Pension
• Health Care Cash Plan
• Hybrid/flexible working options
• Employee assistance programme
• Learning and development support
• Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives
• Life Cover
• 80 Hours Volunteering per year (first two years)

Thales Apprentice Recruitment Process 

1. Apply Online - submit your application online to register your interest. You only need to register for one role as you will have the opportunity to apply for additional roles at the full application stage. 
2. Upload Your CV 
3. Check your emails for the invitation to apply – this will come from recruiting@jobalerts.thalesgroup.com
4. Complete Your Application – follow the link provided in the email to complete your application. You can apply for one primary role and up to 3 additional roles. 
5. Complete Online Tests - undertake the online assessments designed to evaluate your suitability for the role. 
6. Virtual Assessment Centre - candidates who progress from the online assessment stage will attend a virtual assessment centre, which will include group exercises, and competency-based interviews. 
7. Job Offer – successful candidates who perform well throughout the recruitment process will receive a job offer from Thales.undefined

For further information about our Future Talent recruitment process, including hints and tips, or to connect with a member of the Future Talent Team, a Graduate, or an Apprentice, please visit Thales Future Talent - Connectr. 

Please note, assessment centres for shortlisted candidates will be held between February - May 2027. Induction week for all Graduate and Apprentices will take place from Monday 6 September - Friday 10 September 2027. Closing date: Our applications will close at 11.59pm on Wednesday 17 February 2027, this is the only time we will be accepting applications this year. Please note, we will be in contact by the end of February 2027 with details of next steps. 

PLEASE NOTE THAT ROLES MAY CLOSE EARLIER THAN THE ADVERTISED DEADLINE IF WE RECEIVE A HIGH NUMER OF APPLICATIONS. WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO AVOID MISSING OUT ON THIS OPPORTUNITY. 

Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.

To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.To be eligible for SC clearance, you will typically need to have lived in the UK continuously for the last five years. As part of the vetting process, you will be asked to provide evidence of your identity, right to work in the UK, any time spent overseas during the last five years, and your employment and/or education history.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/unite

Manufactured Home Product Analyst Intern:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.
 
As a Manufactured Home Product Analyst Intern, you will support efforts to shape and improve the manufactured home insurance product. Working alongside experienced team members, you will gain exposure to the intersection of data, product strategy, and execution. You will help analyze product performance, identify trends and opportunities, conduct competitive analysis, and turn findings into clear insights, documentation, and recommendations.
 
This is a great opportunity for a curious and motivated student who enjoys working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how products perform. Our team will teach you about the products and insurance industry. Successful interns will bring analytical ability, initiative, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in learning and contributing.
 
What You’ll Do
• Assist with analyzing product performance, profitability, customer needs, and market trends to identify potential risks and opportunities.
• Help turn data into clear reports, visualizations, and insights for team members and business partners.
• Conduct competitive and market research to support product decisions including development of state specific competitive analysis documentation of our top competitors.
• Identify risk management concerns, analyze client specific risk management items, and suggest corrective actions based on data analysis.
• Gain exposure to product changes throughout the development lifecycle, including planning, quality assurance, regulatory filing, implementation, and post-launch analysis.
• Collaborate with teams such as Product Management, Actuarial, Underwriting, Sales, and Technology.
• Help identify opportunities to improve products, reporting, and team processes.
• Participate in team meetings, ask questions, share ideas, and contribute to assigned projects.

Basic Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Risk/Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
• Interest in product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, market research, insurance, or product development.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning).
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.
• A willingness to learn, ask questions, accept feedback, and collaborate with others.

Preferred Skills & Experience
• Experience working with data through coursework, academic projects, student organizations, or a previous internship.
• Familiarity with data visualization concepts or tools.
• Exposure to SQL, Power BI, or similar data and reporting tools.
• An interest in insurance products, customer behavior, or market trends.
• Automation/AI exposure

Why Join This Team
• Gain hands-on experience supporting products with meaningful opportunities for improvement and innovation.
• Learn about the product lifecycle and how insurance products are developed, evaluated, and enhanced.
• Build practical skills in data analysis, market research, business documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
• Work with a supportive and flexible team that values questions, new perspectives, and professional development.
• Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced product professionals.
• Explore potential career paths in product analysis, product management, business analysis, and related fields.

Hybrid Opportunity: 2 days per week in office
Paid Internship: $25/hour

Employee type: Permanent
Location: Templecombe

What is the Engineering Development Programme?
 
This is a 3-year programme with the option to rotate, in Year 3, around the country across different business units experiencing different parts of an engineering lifecycle. You will be assigned to a succession of new or existing programmes where you will work with and be supported by other engineers to design and develop engineering solutions to meet the needs of our customers.

· Complete a 3-year Graduate Development Programme which is accredited by the IET, IMechE and RAeS
· An opportunity to rotate in Year 3 or explore an external secondment with one of our Thales partners
· Participate in discipline specific learning pathways and core training pathway focusing on transversal skills
· Develop key engineering skills, knowledge and competencies
· Work in a set location and domain for the entirety of the scheme, enabling you to fully understand how the Engineering Function operates
· Work on exciting new and existing products
· Build a professional network across the organisation

Requirements:
This is an entry-level graduate opportunity designed for individuals at the start of their professional career. We welcome applications from candidates who have completed a degree and have limited relevant professional experience. You will have gained or be on track to achieve a bachelor’s degree in a STEM Subject in one of the following subject areas:
 
• Computer Science (BSc or MSc)
• Computing (BEng or MEng)
• Computing and Data Science (BSc or MSc)
• Software Engineering (BSc or MEng)
• Combined Software & Electronic Engineering (BSc)
• All applicable technical or related degrees will be considered
 
Benefits
· Competitive salary of £34,000 per annum
· Performance-related pay uplifts
· Holiday entitlement of 201 hours a year (plus a company day and bank holidays)
· Contributory Company Pension
· Health Care Cash Plan
· Hybrid/flexible working options
· Employee assistance programme
· Learning and development support
· Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives
· Life cover
· 80 Hours Volunteering per year (first two years)
 
Thales Graduate Recruitment Process
 
1. Apply Online - submit your application online to register your interest. You only need to register for one role as you will have the opportunity to apply for additional roles at the full application stage.
 
2. Upload Your CV
 
3. Check your emails for the invitation to apply – this will come from recruiting@jobalerts.thalesgroup.com
 
4. Complete Your Application – follow the link provided in the email to complete your application. You can apply for one primary role and up to 3 additional roles.

5. Complete Online Tests - undertake the online assessments designed to evaluate your suitability for the role.

6. Video Interview - if successful in the online testing stage, you will be invited to complete a video interview.
 
7. Virtual Assessment Centre - candidates who progress from the video interview stage will attend a virtual assessment centre, which may include presentations, group exercises, and competency-based interviews.

8. Job Offer – successful candidates who perform well throughout the recruitment process will receive a job offer from Thales.

For further information about our Future Talent recruitment process, including hints and tips, or to connect with a member of the Future Talent Team, a Graduate, or an Apprentice, please visit Thales Future Talent - Connectr.
 
 Please note, assessment centres for shortlisted candidates will be held between February - May 2027. Induction week for all Graduate and Apprentices will take place from Monday 6 September - Friday 10 September 2027.
 
Closing date: Our applications will close at 11.59pm on Wednesday 6 January 2027, this is the only time we will be accepting applications this year. Please note, we will be in contact by the end of February 2027 with details of next steps.
 
Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.
 
To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.
 
To be eligible for SC clearance, you will typically need to have lived in the UK continuously for the last five years. As part of the vetting process, you will be asked to provide evidence of your identity, right to work in the UK, any time spent overseas during the last five years, and your employment and/or education history.
 
For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.
 
Thales is an equal opportunities employer, and diversity and inclusion are integral to the success of Thales.
At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.
 
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.
 
If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

• On campus teaching (around 22 days across the whole programme)

• T Level (Merit) or,

and

In this role as a Digital Electrical Engineer I, you will design and develop next-generation circuit card assemblies (CCAs) and FPGA-based solutions utilizing leading industry architectures including AMD, Altera, and Microchip. Your designs will power mission-critical applications across gigabit serial interfaces, Radio Frequency (RF) and Electro-Optical (EO) digital signal processing, embedded controllers, and processor interfaces. At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world. 

What You Will Do:
Join the Raytheon team within our Hardware Electrical Engineering Organization responsible for the design, test, manufacture, and mission support of advanced electrical subsystems utilized in extreme battlefield environments. In this role, you will contribute to cutting-edge technologies spanning target detection and tracking, guidance, navigation, digital signal processing, and communications. Working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams, you will apply rigorous engineering processes to solve complex hardware challenges, engineer high-reliability circuit card assemblies (CCAs), and advance solutions from design through lab integration. 

Key Responsibilities: 
• Design, model, and analyze electrical subsystems, components, and circuit card assemblies (CCAs) across broad mission architectures. 
• Support guidance section electronics development, including subsystem integration, test conduction, and GPS/IMU interface support. 
• Perform system-level and circuit-level electrical analysis, simulation, and component evaluations. 
• Execute hands-on integration, characterization, and troubleshooting of electronic hardware within laboratory and production environments. 
• Support failure investigations, root-cause analysis, and technical problem-solving alongside cross-functional engineering teams and external suppliers. 
• Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation, test procedures, and design data packages. 

Qualifications You Must Have:

• Experience or coursework with one or more of the following: RF, Microwave, Analog, Digital Electronics, Mixed Signal, Circuit Design or Analysis, Power Electronics, VHDL, FPGA, Electrical Components, Digital Signal Processing, or PCB design. 
• Experience operating laboratory test and measurement equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, waveform/function generators, spectrum analyzers, or network analyzers) to test hardware, interface with sensors, or measure electrical signals. 
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects. 

Qualifications We Prefer:
• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher from an ABET-accredited institution. 
• Hands-on laboratory experience with hardware/software integration, automated test scripting, test execution, and sensor control.

• Technical working knowledge of electronic components (e.g., semiconductor, passive, or electromechanical commodities) and component application.

• Knowledge of electro-optical subsystems and optical sensor interfaces. 
• Familiarity with Root-Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations and FRACAS processes.

jobs.title: Associate Applied AI Engineer - GenAI Systems
jobs.description:
Manulife is making a significant investment in Advanced Analytics and GenAI to transform how Finance, Treasury, and Actuarial teams make decisions. Our AI team builds practical, governed solutions that move from idea to implementation and are adopted in real business workflows.
 
We’re hiring two Associate Applied AI Engineers who bring strong technical depth, sound software engineering practices, and a modern GenAI design mindset to help deliver AI and GenAI capabilities that integrate effectively into real business workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with graduate-level training in AI/ML or related quantitative disciplines, as well as those in early-career applied AI roles, who want to work on meaningful business problems rather than research prototypes or notebook-based analysis alone. If you enjoy taking ambiguous business challenges and translating them into structured solution designs, measurable experiments, and production-ready outcomes, this role is for you.
 
Position Responsibilities: 
 
1. Contribute to end-to-end solution design (GenAI + ML)
Translate business problems into a clear solution approach, including user workflow, data flow, model approach, evaluation plan, and operational controls.
Create lightweight, high-quality design artifacts such as system context, runtime sequence, agent/tool maps, data lineage, and decision logs that support implementation and governance.
Participate in design discussions and make thoughtful trade-offs across accuracy, explainability, cost, latency, and maintainability.
 
2. Build models and GenAI components for Finance & Actuarial use cases
Develop ML solutions such as forecasting, classification, NLP, anomaly detection, optimization, and scenario analysis.
Build GenAI capabilities such as retrieval-based solutions (RAG), structured summarization and extraction, transaction understanding, variance explanation, and tool-using workflows where appropriate.
Engineer features from structured and unstructured data and help ensure solutions remain robust as data evolves.
 
3. Apply strong evaluation and testing practices
Implement performance evaluation using holdouts, backtesting, error analysis, and fit-for-purpose metrics aligned to the business problem.
For GenAI, help design practical evaluation approaches such as scenario coverage, edge cases, human review rubrics, quality scoring, and regression testing.
Document model limitations clearly and support guardrails that improve the reliability and safe use of outputs.
 
4. Partner closely to productionize and operate solutions
Collaborate with Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and Software teams to productionize solutions through reliable data pipelines, model packaging, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
Write maintainable, tested code using strong software engineering practices such as version control, modular design, logging, and code review.
Support monitoring for data quality, drift, performance deterioration, and operational failures, and help investigate issues when thresholds are breached.
Contribute to runbooks and support adoption and UAT with business users.
 
5. Work in a governed environment
Contribute to the documentation and evidence required for model risk review, including assumptions, validation results, monitoring plans, UAT evidence, and approvals.
Ensure privacy and security expectations are met through data minimization, appropriate access controls, and safe handling of sensitive information.
Follow established standards for reproducibility, traceability, model documentation, and auditability.
 
6. Grow team capability and delivery maturity
Learn quickly from design reviews, code reviews, and stakeholder feedback, and apply those lessons to future work.
Contribute reusable components, templates, examples, and testing patterns that make team delivery faster and more consistent.
Stay current with emerging AI and GenAI engineering patterns and bring forward practical ideas that improve how the team builds solutions.

Required Qualifications:
 
• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• 0–3 years of experience in applied data science / machine learning, including internships, co-ops, research, or early-career industry experience; strong academic project work may also be considered.
• Strong Python and SQL, with solid software engineering fundamentals such as Git-based workflows, code reviews, unit and integration testing, logging, readable code structure, debugging, and basic performance tuning.
• Hands-on experience with modern DS/ML tooling such as scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Spark/Databricks or similar, including data preparation, feature engineering, and model development.
• Demonstrated ability to turn a problem into a structured technical approach, including clear thinking around inputs, outputs, assumptions, failure modes, and evaluation.
• Exposure to building or evaluating GenAI solutions, including at least one of: RAG, structured summarization/extraction, LLM-based classification, tool/function calling, or multi-step workflows.
• Strong evaluation mindset across ML and GenAI, including metric selection, holdout testing, error analysis, scenario coverage, edge-case thinking, and basic regression testing approaches.
• Understanding of production-oriented development, including packaging code, working with APIs or services, handling configuration, monitoring outputs, and designing for maintainability.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - AI Agent Platform
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise
Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview
Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, is a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.
Job Description
We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time AI pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

What You’ll Do
• Build real-time voice AI features for emergency response workflows.
• Design and operate LLM-powered systems that support human 911 telecommunicators.
• Own features across the stack, from backend services and AI pipelines to frontend interfaces and internal tools.
• Work on low-latency audio processing, streaming systems, telephony integrations, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
• Help integrate speech models, LLMs, and emerging AI technologies into production systems.
• Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
• Help write and improve evaluation, testing, and observability for AI-assisted systems.
• Participate in on-call responsibilities (with support and shadow rotations to start), backed by clear runbooks and blameless post-incident reviews.
• Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

You Might Be a Fit If
• You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
• You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
• You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
• You take feedback well and act on it.
• You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
• You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
• You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

Relevant Experience
We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.
Relevant exposure may include:
• Projects involving LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.
• Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.
• Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
• Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
• Programming in Elixir, Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
• Familiarity with PostgreSQL or relational data modeling.
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Docker, Kubernetes, or similar deployment environments.
• Internships or co-ops in software engineering, infrastructure, or AI/ML roles.

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest

As an Associate Android Developer, you’ll help create high-quality features for Resmed’s mobile applications, used by customers at scale. You’ll join the newly formed team and work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and mobile developers to turn ideas into reliable Android experiences.
This opportunity is ideal if you are early in your career and eager to grow your Android expertise while contributing to a collaborative product team. You’ll receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and opportunities to learn, while taking ownership of your work and contributing from the start.

What You’ll Do
• Develop Android application features using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern Android architecture patterns such as MVVM.
• Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and Mobile Engineering partners to design and deliver new product features.
• Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using established engineering practices.
• Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
• Identify and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and application crashes.
• Improve application architecture, reliability, and maintainability.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.
Management Level Definition:
Contributions include applying intermediate level of subject matter expertise to solve common technical problems. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and recommendations for appropriate action. Works independently within an established framework and with moderate supervision.
Responsibilities:
• Designs limited enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of systems software, including operating systems, compliers, networking, utilities, databases, and Internet-related tools.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines.

Turn your curiosity into a career. If you’re passionate about engineering, eager to learn, and looking for a degree apprenticeship that blends academic study with hands-on experience, we’d love to hear from you….
 
We’re currently recruiting an apprentice to join our Hardware Engineering team, while also completing an Electro-Mechanical Engineering Degree Apprenticeship. It’s a fantastic opportunity to grow, as well as develop your skills.
 
Benefits of the Programme:
• Earn a salary while studying for your apprenticeship
• Gain hands-on experience in a real engineering environment
• Receive job-specific training and development
• Achieve a recognised engineering qualification
• Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship
• Have your university tuition fees fully paid
 
About the Role:
This exciting Hardware Apprentice role will develop your skills by the designing and implementation of the engineering solutions in accordance with programme and product requirements. Typical tasks will range from requirements management via the design and development cycle, to test, integration and validation of complex products and systems.
 
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, implement and test engineering solutions in accordance with Thales procedures
• Attendance at project reviews
• Creation of functional and physical system architectures

• Work as a team-player asking for guidance and direction where necessary

Through our degree apprenticeship you’ll be making the most of your talents, getting to understand engineering from the ground up; and doing so with the help of one of the biggest and best names in the industry. We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who are motivated, committed and keen to learn. A self-starter who can manage their time, show initiative and have a genuine interest in engineering and Thales. Successful candidates will show self-discipline and an aspiration to achieve a degree qualification.
 
Apprenticeship Programme:
You'll work towards a Level 6 Electro-Mechanical Engineering Degree Apprenticeship with the University of Nottingham while gaining valuable hands-on experience in the workplace.
 
The programme lasts 5.5 years and combines:
• On-campus learning
• Online study
• Practical, work-based learning
 
You'll typically attend the university for around four weeks each year, delivered in one-week blocks. Throughout the programme, you'll develop both your technical knowledge and practical engineering skills.
 
On successful completion of the apprenticeship and End Point Assessment, you'll achieve:
• A fully funded BEng (Hons) in Electro-Mechanical Engineering
• A Level 6 Electro-Mechanical Engineering Degree Apprenticeship qualification.

The programme is accredited by the Institute of Mechanical Engineers for those wishing to progress towards Chartered Engineer status later in their career.

Please note that applicants who already hold a relevant degree will not be eligible for this programme.

• Performance-related pay uplifts

jobs.title: AI Research Intern
jobs.description:
Pangram Labs is hiring talented AI Research Interns for Spring or Summer 2027.



Research interns conduct research relating to frontier AI detection research or related topics, with the goal of publishing a paper in a major conference venue. Examples of past internship projects at Pangram include EditLens (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.03154) and Scaling Laws for Wild AI Text (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40295).



What You’ll Work On



Interns are assigned a mentor, and choose a research topic or area prior to the internship. Current active research areas within Pangram include:



 - Adversarial Robustness: how do detectors perform against humanizers and adversarial paraphrasing?

 - Interpretability: can we build more explainable, interpretable AI detection?

 - Mixed Human/AI Authorship: how can we quantify the different facets of human-AI coauthorship?

 - New Architectures: how can we optimize Pangram’s architecture for efficiency or even higher levels of accuracy?

 - Multimodal Detection: how can we improve AI detection for images, video, and audio?

 - Effects of AI-Generated Data on LLM Training: what is the effect of AI-generated data on foundation model training?

 - Agentic AI detection: how can we harness the power of agents to give Pangram more context about authorship?

 - Topics of your choice: propose an original topic relevant to AI detection



Requirements



 - Currently pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence. Exceptional undergraduates entering their senior year are welcome to apply.

 - Prior research experience that has resulted in a published paper in a top AI venue.

 - Fluency in deep learning fundamentals and experience training neural networks.

 - Excellent programming skills in Python and a deep learning framework like Pytorch.

 - Experience working with an AI agent for research like Claude Code or Codex.



Compensation



 - $8,000-$11,000 per month

 - Relocation stipend available

 - In-office lunch

 - Top interns may receive return offers for full-time roles
