jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern - Masters
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We’re looking for machine learning engineer interns to join our fast-growing engineering team to help us develop a 24x7 global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer intern at Doordash, you’ll work on tackling new challenges in machine learning and artificial intelligence. You’ll conduct research that can be applied across Doordash engineering teams and engage in external collaborations and mentoring, while also performing research in any of the following areas: Auction, Game theory, Recommender systems, Ranking, AdTech, Computer Vision, Causal Inference, and Big data analytics. We offer a 12-week summer internship program in our San Francisco, Sunnyvale, New York, or Seattle offices.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Use cutting-edge research in ML/AI, NLP, RecSys, Ranking, Computer Vision, Causal Inference, Ad Tech, Graph analysis to solve real-world problems across discovery, ads,forecasting, fulfillment and search experiences at Doordash.

• Contribute and execute on research ideas that can be applied and used to improve product experience at Doordash.

• Collect, analyze, and synthesize findings from data and use these insights to build relevant ML models.

• Write clean, efficient, and sustainable code

We’re excited about you because you…

• Are working towards a Masters degree in Computer Science, ML, NLP, Statistics, Information Sciences or related field and are graduating between Fall 2027 & Summer 2028

• Have a mastery of at least one systems languages (Java, C++, Python, Kotlin, GoLang) or one ML framework (Tensorflow, Pytorch, MLFlow)

• Have experience in research and in solving analytical problems

• Are a strong communicator and team player.

• Have a passion for applied ML and the Doordash product

• Ideally have worked on publications in machine learning, AI, data science, data analytics, statistics, or related technical fields

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis
Compensation

The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay ranges for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Growth Creative Designer, International
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Ramp is redefining how businesses manage their finances, and our growth marketing team is how millions of businesses first hear that story. As we expand internationally, paid ads are one of our highest-leverage channels — and localized, high-craft creative is what makes them work in a new market.

Based in our London office, you'll own the creative that powers Ramp's international acquisition engine across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Direct Mail. You'll take the playbook we've built in the US and adapt it for the UK and EU — shaping how Ramp shows up across paid social, video, and display for international audiences. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing team to turn ideas into ads that move metrics, while pushing the creative bar on what a finance brand can look and feel like abroad.

This is a temporary full-time role, based in London.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and animate paid creative end-to-end across static and motion formats, tailored for international markets.

 - Create and localize ads for Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, and emerging channels across the UK and EU.

 - Adapt the US growth creative playbook for international audiences — and flag where local nuance means it needs to break, not just translate.

 - Develop scalable design and motion systems that help the team move faster while maintaining a high creative bar.

 - Concept hooks, headlines, visual treatments, and creative variants that earn attention and drive performance in-market.

 - Partner closely with Performance Marketing, copywriters, and product marketers (largely US-based) to bring ideas to life across time zones.

 - Iterate quickly based on performance data and contribute to international testing strategy.

 - Build templates, automations, AI workflows, and creative systems that increase team velocity.

 - Explore new tools, techniques, and AI-native workflows to expand what's possible inside our production pipeline.

 - Help evolve how Ramp's brand shows up across international growth marketing.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years of experience in visual design, motion design, or creative production

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating both static and motion work

 - Experience creating performance-driven creative for paid acquisition channels

 - Strong taste and a clear point of view on what makes great advertising — with an eye for what resonates in UK/EU markets

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment where speed and iteration matter

 - Ability to use performance data and business outcomes as creative feedback

 - Comfort collaborating with a primarily US-based team across time zones

 - Expertise in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (particularly After Effects)

 - Based in or able to work from the London office



Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience building automations, templates, component systems, scripts, or internal creative tooling

 - Fluency with AI tools such as Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Claude Code, or similar

 - Experience creating short-form video for Reels, Shorts, TikTok, and paid social

 - Experience creating or localizing creative for multiple international markets

 - Experience in finance, fintech, SaaS, or other high-growth technology companies

 - Familiarity with performance marketing and growth experimentation frameworks






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Performance AI
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.

WHO WE ARE 

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions.

You are:

• Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights.

• Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs.

• An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.

• A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies.

• Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management

• Assist in defining, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on user needs, business goals, and data analysis.

• Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Data Scientists, and UX Designers to ensure a shared understanding of product features and their underlying data implications.

• Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles.

• Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.

Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation

• Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization.

• Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements.

• Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch.

• Help ensure data quality and integrity within product features, flagging discrepancies or potential issues.

Facilitate Stakeholder Communication & Feedback

• Communicate product updates, release notes, and progress to various internal stakeholders, effectively highlighting the data-driven rationale behind product decisions.

• Gather feedback from users, internal teams (e.g., commercial, operations), and clients to continuously iterate and improve our products.

• Support in preparing presentations and documentation to articulate product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

Continuous Learning & Contribution

• Actively seek to deepen your understanding of AdTech data, our internal platforms (including WPP Open), and user behaviors through self-study and mentorship.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and tools within the team.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

• 0-2 years of experience in a product, business analyst, data analyst, or similar role with exposure to software development.

• Proficiency in SQL is essential, with the ability to write complex queries to extract, analyze, and manipulate data from various sources.

Software Engineering Resident - Multiple Teams
jobs.description:
Software Engineering Residency Program

Program Duration: January 11 through March 31, 2027 (11.5 weeks). Residents work 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM with a 30-minute lunch. 

Position Type: Temporary, Non-Exempt, Hourly

Conversion to Full-Time: This is the heart of the program: residents who successfully complete the residency may be eligible to join Bluestaq full-time as an Associate Software Engineer. Full-time offers are contingent on performance and business need.

Position Description
Ready to launch your software career? The Bluestaq Software Engineering Residency Program is an 11.5-week, paid, cohort-based program built around one goal: turning promising early-career developers into full-time Bluestaq Associate Software Engineers. This isn't a coffee-run internship. From week one you'll work real backlog items on the systems our U.S. Space Force customers use every day, guided by a dedicated engineer-mentor, and you'll close out the program by presenting your capstone work directly to Bluestaq engineering leadership.

Who We’re Looking For
We're offering the residency to early-career software talent ready to commit to a full-time engineering role, including: final-year associate, undergraduate, or master's students (graduating by January 2027), recent graduates in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. If you're excited about learning fast, collaborating, and shipping real-world solutions, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do
At Bluestaq, our residents aren't confined to one technology stack. You'll explore multiple technologies while contributing to impactful projects. Expect to work with languages and tools like Java, Python, Angular, Groovy, REST Services, GIT, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Athena, NiFi, Quarkus, and cloud platforms like Google Cloud, MS Azure, and AWS.

This isn't just about coding — we're all about growing your skills. You'll pair with experienced engineers, learn data storage solutions, front-end and back-end technologies, and cloud-based infrastructure, with structured milestones along the way: an onboarding week covering our tooling and secure development practices, a midpoint demo, and a capstone presentation. We offer the perfect balance of guidance and independence, allowing you to learn while making a real impact.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• You have software development experience through coursework, personal projects, bootcamp work, or prior internships.

• You have experience with software development and scripting languages.

• You're familiar with front-end/back-end technologies, data storage solutions, and cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, or MS Azure.

• You're capable of working in a team-centric environment.

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• You're passionate about big data technologies and excited to work with cloud infrastructures.

• You have ability to obtain a security clearance.

• You’re available to work full-time on-site for the full program (January 11 – March 31, 2027).

Benefits: This position is not eligible for employment benefits such as 401k, Medical, Dental, or Vision Insurance. This position is eligible for sick pay as per the Colorado Healthy Families & Workplaces Act (HFWA).
Salary Range (CO)
$40—$40 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineering Intern to help build and deploy AI-powered solutions for real business problems at Envoy.

This role sits between engineering, data, AI, and business teams. You’ll work directly with stakeholders to understand their problems, identify where AI or automation can help, and build working solutions that people can actually use.

This is a hands-on role. You won’t just work from a predefined list of tickets. You’ll be expected to understand the problem, figure out the right technical approach, build it, test it with users, and iterate based on feedback.

This is an onsite position that requires at least 5 days a week (Monday - Friday) in our San Francisco HQ office.



YOU WILL

 - Build AI-powered tools and internal applications for teams across Envoy.

 - Work directly with stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and requirements.

 - Build integrations across APIs, internal systems, data sources, and LLMs.

 - Prototype solutions quickly and turn successful prototypes into reliable tools.

 - Work with LLMs, agents, MCPs, APIs, and automation frameworks.

 - Use SQL and Python to access, transform, and validate data when needed.

 - Evaluate AI outputs and build guardrails, testing, and validation around them.

 - Demo your work, gather feedback, and continuously improve what you build.


YOU ARE  

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Strong programming fundamentals, especially in Python.

 - Comfortable working with APIs, databases, and SQL.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI tools through projects, coursework, hackathons, or previous internships.

 - Ability to take an unclear problem and break it down into something you can build.

 - Comfortable talking directly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Curious, independent, and willing to learn unfamiliar systems quickly.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building AI agents or applications using LLM APIs.

 - Experience with MCP, tool calling, RAG, or agentic workflows.

 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.

 - Experience building internal tools, web applications, or automations.

 - Experience working with production data systems or analytics infrastructure.


HOW SUCCESS LOOKS

 - By the end of the internship, you should have shipped solutions that are being used by real teams at Envoy.
   
   We care less about how much code you write and more about whether you can understand a problem, build the right solution, and create measurable value for the people using it.
   
    

 

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here https://envoy.com/privacypolicy/. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.description:
Work Arrangement

This is an onsite position.

Job Overview

The AEVEX Navigation and Autonomy Center (NAC) specializes in the development of advanced algorithms for autonomous systems, with expertise spanning navigation, autonomy, controls, sensor fusion and computer vision. We develop innovative solutions that integrate information from vision-based algorithms, inertial measurement units (IMUs), LiDAR, radar, and other sensors to provide accurate real-time state estimation, perception, planning, and control for autonomous platforms operating in complex, GPS-degraded, and GPS-denied environments.

We are seeking a highly motivated engineering student to join our team. As a co-op, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge research and development in robotics, autonomous navigation, and sensor fusion. You will contribute to real-world projects, applying your skills in algorithm design, machine learning, and embedded systems to enhance autonomy in challenging conditions.

Essential Functions

• Develop and implement computer vision-based localization, SLAM, or deep learning models for real-time navigation of UAS systems.

• Assist in integrating data from cameras, IMUs, GNSS, and alternative PNT sources for sensor fusion applications.

• Optimize and deploy navigation/autonomy algorithms for embedded systems, robotics platforms, or edge computing hardware.

• Perform simulation and validation of navigation algorithms using Python, C++, or Rust.

• Participate in flight test campaigns to validate software and algorithms on UAS.

• Work closely with senior engineers on research and prototyping efforts.

• Perform other duties as required.

Standard Essential Functions

• Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].

• Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.

• Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications 

• Strong programming skills in C/C++, Python, or Rust.

• Experience with ROS/ROS2.

• Demonstrated project or professional experience with one or more of the following:

• Computer vision and deep learning frameworks (OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Autonomy/planning algorithm development.

• Control systems design/analysis

• Embedded systems and real-time computing (Jetson, Raspberry Pi, FPGA, or microcontrollers).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Experience deploying software to robotic or hardware systems.

jobs.title: Data & Governance Industrial Placement
jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Join Haleon’s forward-thinking Quality Service team for a year-long opportunity to shape the future of quality in a global consumer healthcare company trusted by millions. This is your chance to contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen compliance, simplify systems, and elevate quality culture across manufacturing and commercial operations. 

Start date: 28th June 2027
 
At a glance: 

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of our Global Quality Service team and help shape the future. Our industrial placement programme offers:

• Gain Practical Experience: Develop real-world skills through involvement in global quality programmes, governance activities, data analysis, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Broaden Your Knowledge: Build an understanding of how Quality supports the end-to-end lifecycle of consumer healthcare products, from development and manufacturing through to distribution and consumer use. 
• Make an Impact: Contribute to strategic projects that drive innovation, strengthen compliance, and support the future of Quality at Haleon.
• Hands-On Learning: Work on key initiatives across governance, quality culture, communications, risk management, and consumer-focused quality programmes, applying your knowledge to real business challenges. 
• Data Detective: Transform data into meaningful insights, helping leaders make informed decisions and identify opportunities to improve performance.
• Global Exposure: Collaborate with colleagues across functions, sites, and markets, gaining experience in a truly international environment.
• Develop Future-Ready Skills: Strengthen your communication, stakeholder management, presentation, project management, and problem-solving skills while working with senior leaders and subject matter experts.
• Explore Emerging Technologies: Gain exposure to how digital solutions, data analytics, automation and AI are being used to transform quality processes and decision-making.
 
 Throughout your placement, you’ll have the opportunity to:
 
• Work with people across multiple markets and functions within our organisation.
• Hone soft skills, including meeting facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and presentations to senior leaders.
• Gain exposure to Quality within a fast-moving Consumer Healthcare company.
• Contribute to meaningful projects that support key business priorities and deliver real impact.
• Develop analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills through hands-on experience.
• Build a professional network and learn from experienced colleagues and mentors across the organisation.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, gaining insight into how different parts of the business work together to deliver trusted products to consumers.
• Explore potential career paths within Quality and the wider Consumer Healthcare industry.

We are looking for candidates who will demonstrate: 
• An analytical mindset: Comfortable working with data, drawing insights, and making recommendations.
• Personal Accountability: Takes ownership, delivers results, and builds credibility through actions.
• Organisation & Prioritisation: Manages multiple tasks independently and meets deadlines.
• High level of agility and curiosity: Eager to learn, adapt quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent data management skills: Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and digital collaboration tools.
• Initiative: Proactively seeks opportunities to contribute and improve processes.
• Collaboration: Works effectively across teams and builds strong relationships.
• Problem-Solving: Tackles challenges with a positive, solution-focused mindset.
• Creativity: Generates fresh ideas for campaigns, events, and learning initiatives

Who are we looking for?
Currently studying an Undergraduate or Masters in Business, Management, Computer Science or related disciplines.

If you are studying for your Undergraduate Degree you must be in your 2nd year of study (England) or 3rd year of study (Scotland) or an Integrated Masters Degree and seeking to complete a year in industry in partnership with your university. Please ensure the role is suitable for your placement year.
 
Role Start Date: 28th June 2027
 
Benefits:
• Salary: £28,860
• Haleon Bonus Structure
• A London travel allowance
• Health & wellbeing programmes to support your physical and mental health
• You will join IP Unite, Haleon’s community for students run by students to support charity events, sports clubs, STEM outreach and many more exciting projects
 
Application Process:

The application process has a total of up to 4 stages:
• Application – information will be required regarding your education and Right to Work.
• Online Assessment – you will be asked to complete a behaviour based online assessment and one-way video interview supported by Hirevue.
• Interview – if selected you will be invited to attend a final stage virtual interview; The interview will consist of a competency-based interview and may include a case study/technical exercise.
• Offer – candidates will receive an outcome within 2 weeks following interview.
 
Interviews will be held in November/December 2026

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

“I can influence my income.” 
 
You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. “I can lead a full life.” 
 
You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success. 
• Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options

I can succeed as a Data & Technology Track Summer Associate at Capital Group. 

As a Data & Technology Summer Associate at Capital Group, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting one of the teams that leverages data, analytics, and technology to drive business outcomes across Capital Group. Through meaningful work, coaching, mentorship, and collaboration with professionals across the firm, you'll strengthen your analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills while developing a deeper understanding of how data and technology support a global investment management organization. 
 
The Summer Associate Program provides experience within one of the business areas represented in the full-time Data & Technology Track of the Capital Group Rotational Program, a two-year rotational experience that provides exposure to multiple data, analytics, and technology functions through rotational assignments and professional development opportunities. High-performing Summer Associates may be considered for conversion into the full-time Data & Technology Track of the Capital Group Rotational Program upon graduation. 
 
What You'll Do 

Summer Associates are placed on a specific team for the duration of the program, providing meaningful experience within one of Capital Group's data and technology-focused functions. Opportunities may be available in areas such as: 

• Data & Analytics: Leverage business intelligence, reporting, analytics, and visualization tools to support decision-making and business outcomes 
• Data Science: Apply advanced analytics, modeling, and quantitative approaches to generate insights and solve business challenges 
• Digital Products & User Experience: Support the development of digital tools, platforms, and user-focused solutions that enhance business and client experiences 
• Data Strategy & Solutions: Contribute to enterprise data initiatives and help translate business needs into data-driven solutions 
• Additional Data & Technology Functions: Support teams driving innovation, analytics, and technology transformation across the firm 
 
Across these teams, Summer Associates may analyze complex datasets, build reports and visualizations, support digital product or data initiatives, evaluate business requirements, and help develop data-driven solutions that inform decision-making and improve business outcomes. Summer Associates also participate in professional development and networking opportunities throughout the program. 
 
What We're Looking For 

We're seeking individuals who are analytical, collaborative, and excited about using data and technology to solve problems and create value. Successful candidates demonstrate: 

• Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and quantitative skills 
• Intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a commitment to continuous growth and development 
• Ability to navigate ambiguity and approach complex challenges thoughtfully 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills 
• Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build strong working relationships 
• Attention to detail, organization, and execution 
• Initiative, accountability, and a willingness to take ownership 
• Interest in leveraging data, analytics, technology, and emerging tools to drive innovation and business outcomes 
• Comfort working with data and translating insights into recommendations 
• Foundational experience with analytical, quantitative, or technical skills through coursework, projects, internships, research, or extracurricular activities 
• Familiarity with data visualization, reporting, business intelligence, or analytical tools 
• Foundational programming experience (e.g., Python, SQL, R, Spark, or similar technologies) and an interest in continuing to build technical skills 
 
Qualifications 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's with an anticipated graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028 
• Degree in a quantitative, analytical, technology, engineering, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, statistics, finance, information systems, or related field preferred 
• Work authorization requirements vary by country. Candidates should have, or be able to obtain, authorization to work in the applicable country of employment 

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.” 
 
You’ve reviewed this job posting and you’re ready to start the candidate journey with us. Apply now to move to the next step in our recruiting process. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, check out our other opportunities and join our talent community. 
 
“I can learn more about Capital Group.” 
 
At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. jobs.description:
Company:
Maricopa Association of GovernmentsCloses: 
The position is open until filled.
Status:
Part timePay Rate:
HourlyTitle Range:
$23.00 - $23.00
 
Why Join MAG:
MAG is a great place to work. We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and a hybrid work environment that supports flexibility, with a minimum of three days per week in the office, along with a collaborative culture where employee contributions make a real impact.

About MAG:

The Maricopa Association of Governments (MAG) is a group of local governments working together on issues that touch the lives of every resident. We are a regional planning agency that develops solutions in areas such as transportation, environmental and air quality, and human services. MAG serves a thriving region of 5 million people. Our members include 28 cities and towns, three Native nations, and Maricopa and Pinal counties. Our planning area encompasses more than 10,000 square miles. MAG is the council of governments and the designated metropolitan planning organization for transportation planning for the greater Phoenix metropolitan area. 

Visit www.azmag.gov to learn more. 

Your Team 
The MAG Transportation Data Management and Application team is responsible for the collection, acquisition, and maintenance of data that supports initiatives across the spectrum of transportation programs. This includes developing inputs for the region’s socioeconomic modeling and the collection and maintenance of various types of socioeconomic data to support population and employment projections for the region. 

The Position 
MAG is seeking a qualified, team-oriented individual with experience in Data Science, Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Urban/Regional Planning, or a related field for a paid internship. 

Interns at MAG contribute to projects that support real-world planning decisions across the region. Interns will work alongside experienced planners, analysts, and GIS professionals who are committed to supporting their growth and offering opportunities to develop technical skills while gaining practical experience with regional data.

This position supports the Socioeconomic Data Program. The primary duties include, but are not limited to:

• Collecting, processing, and analyzing housing permit and residential data
• Processing and analyzing census, demographic, housing, and assessor parcel data
• Developing, maintaining, and enhancing multiple large and complex socioeconomic and transportation datasets for research and analysis and regional planning
• Using Microsoft Access, SQL, and GIS software to process, analyze and manage data
• Perform geocoding, geoprocessing and other spatial and non-spatial analysis
• Analyzing, interpreting, and visualizing current and historical data through tables, graphs, charts, and cartographic outputs
• Conducting quality assurance and quality control of data to identify and resolve errors and gaps
• Coordinating with MAG member agencies, stakeholders, and the public to collect and review data and fulfill data/analysis requests
• Conducting research and analysis independently and as part of a team

The Candidate 
Do you enjoy working with data and want to develop your technical skills in a professional planning environment? Are you detail-oriented, naturally curious, and eager to explore new software, data sources, and analytical methods? If so, this opportunity may be a great fit for you.

The most successful candidate will have:
• Ability to analyze data, identify patterns and inconsistencies, and draw accurate conclusions
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Curiosity and be capable of learning and applying new processes and procedures
• Ability to organize and manage information from multiple sources
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team
• Ability to manage multiple assignments and adjust priorities as needed
• Strong interest in data analysis, planning, Geographic Information Systems, or a related field

Technology Skills
Candidate should have a working knowledge of ESRI’s GIS suite and geoprocessing tools, relational database management systems such as MS SQL, statistics and the MS Office Suite, along with a willingness to advance their technological knowledge. Strong written, verbal, and organizational skills are required. Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, R, Java, and/or statistical packages/languages is desirable. Experience working with census data or economic impact analysis is a plus.

Experience and Education 
• High school diploma (or GED equivalent)
• At least two (2) years of relevant college coursework in Data Science, Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Urban/Regional Planning, or a related field
• Any equivalent combination of training, education, and experience that provides the required skills, knowledge and abilities

The Maricopa Association of Governments is an Equal Opportunity Employer. During the selection process, any applicant requiring accommodation for a disability should advise the Human Resources Division at HR@azmag.gov or by calling (602) 254-6300.

jobs.description:
We’re currently hiring a Data Scientist Intern to join our team in Summer 2027.
This is an entry-level, 10-week, full-time internship expected to begin in June and end in August. Work may be hybrid from our offices in Reston, VA or Denver, CO or done remotely from any U.S. location. At this time, we are unable to provide housing nor relocation assistance for this position. 

Ready to Make a Difference?
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Scientist intern to join our team supporting energy efficiency and load management programs for utilities. This role will focus on maintaining and enhancing predictive analytics models. 
 
The ideal candidate will apply advanced statistical and computational methodologies and integrate these analyses into supporting IT systems to help achieve business objectives. Responsibilities include analyzing large datasets—spanning customer behavior, energy usage, and marketing performance to identify appropriate techniques, develop and execute code, validate outputs, and produce technical reports. 

Basic Qualifications:  
• A completed bachelor’s degree plus enrollment verification or 9 credit hours complete in a Master’s degree program within data science or similar discipline
• Must be able to pass any required background check(s), which may include drug screening
• All work must be performed in the U.S. per contract requirements

• Proficiency in R and/or Python or statistical modeling, data manipulation, and visualization
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, including branching strategies, pull requests, and repository management 
• Working knowledge of SQL for querying relational databases 
• Strong understanding of predictive modeling techniques and machine learning algorithms 
• Familiarity with Docker for building and deploying containerized machine learning environments and applications 
• Experience with Microsoft Azure services (e.g. Azure Databricks, Azure Batch, Azure Blob/Table Storage)

jobs.title: Software Research Intern - PhD
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact
Intel is seeking a highly motivated Software Research Intern (PhD) to join the TCAD Software Development team within Intel Foundry. This internship offers an opportunity to work on advanced computational software solutions supporting semiconductor technology development. The selected candidate will contribute to cutting-edge software applications involving computational geometry, scientific computing, visualization, CAD technologies, and high-performance computing.
The internship is designed for PhD students interested in applying software engineering and research expertise to solve complex engineering challenges while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Intel. 

Business Group
The Intel Foundry Technology Development (TD) organization is focused on driving semiconductor process innovation and enabling future technology nodes. Within the LTD-TD TCAD team, engineers and researchers develop advanced simulation, modeling, and software solutions used to accelerate technology development. The team fosters a collaborative environment where software, mathematics, physics, and engineering intersect to solve challenging technical problems.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and optimize software solutions for engineering and research applications. 
• Participate in architecture design, feature development, prototyping, testing, and performance optimization. 
• Develop and enhance computational geometry algorithms and scientific software tools. 
• Create and improve 2D and 3D visualization capabilities using modern graphics technologies. 
• Develop numerical methods and simulation capabilities using finite element, level set, or related techniques. 
• Collaborate with software engineers, researchers, and domain experts to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions. 
• Perform software development, debugging, and performance analysis in Linux environments. 
• Document technical solutions and present findings to project stakeholders.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Candidates must be currently pursuing a PhD in one of the following or related disciplines with a strong software focus: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics or other closely related technical fields
• Minimum 3 months of educational, research, laboratory, internship, or industry experience.
• Strong academic performance with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher preferred.
• 3+ months of academic or professional experience in one or more of the following: 
 - Python and/or C++ programming
 - Computational Geometry
 - Scientific Visualization
 - CAD Tool Development
 - Optimization Algorithms
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software development skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in at least two of the following areas:
• Computational geometry algorithm design, analysis, and implementation (2D and 3D).
• Computer graphics and scientific visualization using OpenGL and/or ray tracing technologies.
• Contribute to CAD and geometry processing workflows involving solid modeling and voxel-based representations.
• Implement and optimize mesh generation algorithms for engineering simulations.
• 2D and 3D mesh generation algorithms, including: 
 - Delaunay triangulation
 - Quad meshing
 - Hex meshing
• CAD geometry representation, solid modeling, and voxel processing.
• Numerical analysis techniques including: 
 - Finite Element Methods (FEM)
 - Level Set Methods
 - Related computational modeling approaches
• Parallel programming and high-performance computing.
• Experience developing scalable scientific or engineering software applications.
• User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) development for scientific or engineering software.
• Experience with Qt framework for desktop application development.
• Image processing and visualization techniques for scientific and engineering applications.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details 

Summary: 

As part of Cencora's Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform modernization initiative, this intern will support the redesign of current products and design iterative enhancement features for both internal and customer-facing tools for the InSite Data Solutions Team. The role contributes directly to the platform's move toward continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) and a scalable, self-service solution delivery framework that provides greater business value to internal teams and customers alike.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Analysis: 
Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets using statistical methods and tools. Identify trends, patterns, and correlations in the data to generate actionable insights.

Dashboard & Product Development: 
Design and build dashboards for internal and customer-facing product builds using business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Contribute to the redesign of existing products and the development of iterative enhancement features as part of the team's modernization initiative.

Performance Tracking: 
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for different business units or projects. Provide regular updates on performance metrics and identify areas for improvement or optimization.

Data-driven Decision Making: 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their analytical needs and provide support in making data-driven decisions. Assist in identifying opportunities for process improvement based on data analysis.

Platform Modernization Support: 
Support the Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform modernization effort by contributing to a scalable, self-service solution delivery framework and helping advance the team's continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices.

Ad Hoc Analysis: 
Conduct ad hoc analyses as requested by stakeholders or team members. Assist in answering specific business questions through data mining, modeling, or other analytical techniques.

Documentation: 
Document processes, methodologies, and findings related to data analysis projects. Ensure that documentation is organized, accurate, and accessible for future reference.

Qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in undergraduate school and pursuing a bachelor's of Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
• Strong analytical skills with an ability to work with large datasets.
• Proficiency in Excel and Salesforce.com or similar CRM is preferred.
• Experience with business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
• Familiarity with SQL for querying databases is advantageous.
• Interest in or exposure to dashboard and product design principles, including user experience (UX) considerations for customer-facing tools, is a plus.
• Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
• Prior internship experience or coursework related to analytics is beneficial but not required.

Eligibility Requirements:

• Must be eligible to work in the US.
• We do not offer sponsorship to interns.
• Must be a rising Junior or Senior.
• GPA of 3.0 or higher.
• Must be pursuing a bachelor's degree

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description
 
Intern - Research - Drug Metabolism - AI

As a Gilead intern you will contribute to high-impact meaningful projects that will not only further advance our company’s mission but will allow you to gain real world experience at one of the most innovative organizations in the world. You will also have opportunities to participate in special events including professional development and leadership presentations, social/network building activities and local community volunteer programs.

Key Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following: 
• Apply artificial intelligence and machine-learning approaches to enhance scientific data analysis, interpretation, workflow efficiency, and decision support across DMPK applications.
• Develop, evaluate, and document reproducible AI-enabled workflows and AI agents, including large language model applications, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-enabled or agentic workflows, and programmatic analytical pipelines for scientific data and research use cases.
• Collaborate with DMPK, bioanalytical, LC-MS, and quantitative scientists to translate scientific questions and workflow needs into practical, data-driven or AI-enabled solutions.
• Analyze representative DMPK datasets and evaluate workflow accuracy, robustness, reproducibility, efficiency, and scientific utility.
• Initial applications will emphasize LC-MS, with potential applicability to PK/PD modeling, simulation, and project-support workflows.
• Document code, methods, model assumptions, testing results, limitations, and recommendations to support transparent and responsible use of AI-enabled scientific workflows.
• Showcase your work with a final presentation near the conclusion of your internship

• Preferred majors: Working toward a Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related AI-focused field
• Hands-on experience in Python, machine learning, statistical modeling, or generative AI tools 
• Ability to collaborate with scientists and translate research questions into data-driven or AI-enabled approaches
• Demonstrated strength in AI/ML development, including programming with Python, R, MATLAB; model development and evaluation; generative AI; large language models; retrieval-augmented generation; and AI workflow or agent development.
• Experience with reproducible scientific computing, version control, data visualization, and documentation of analytical workflows, with familiarity using Visual Studio Code, Git, GitHub, and AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
• Experience working with complex scientific datasets. Familiarity with LC-MS, mass spectrometry, proteomics, bioanalytical data, pharmacokinetics, PK/PD modeling, or simulation is preferred.

jobs.description:
The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. 
 
Who Are We? 
The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA.

Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users.
 
What Will You Do? 
In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: 
• Create a specification for the product. 
• Schematic capture and circuit design. 
• PCB layout with the help of one of Toro’s PCB designers. 
• Test the finished product in the lab using tools like oscilloscopes, multimeters, etc. 

The work will be guided by other electrical engineers to provide mentoring and keep the project on task. Other summer activities will include some job shadowing and supporting a current team project, possibly a vendor visit or trip to Toro manufacturing plant(s), and depending upon the candidate, some scripting in Python or similar language. 
 
What Do You Need? 
To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: 
• Majoring in Electrical or Electronic Engineering from an ABET accredited university. 
• Completed junior-level courses preferred. 
• Strong desire to learn, collaborate, and effectively communicate in a team setting while achieving a common goal. 
• Ability to stay organized and able to use Microsoft Office programs without much direction. 
• Bonus skills include: Analog circuit design, digital circuit design, ARM microcontrollers, PCB design, C programming, Python or similar Scripting Language.  
 
What Can We Give You? 
At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: 
• Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. 
• Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. 
• Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. 
• Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $22–$28. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations.
 
The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern - AI/ML
jobs.description:
Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology. 

AI/ML Engineering Intern — Copart
Copart is building the next generation of AI-driven applications to power our global operations and expansion. We're looking for a passionate Software Engineering Intern with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to help design, build, and ship these systems. You'll work closely with Product Managers, AI Architects, and Tech Leads to turn requirements into real, scalable AI features — from LLM-powered agents to production ML pipelines.
Core Duties & Responsibilities
• AI/ML Development: Design and implement features powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and machine learning models, integrating them into our core applications.
• Agent & Workflow Orchestration: Build and optimize conversational agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and prompt engineering workflows.
• Model Integration & Evaluation: Work with model APIs and open-source models, and help evaluate quality, latency, and cost trade-offs across approaches.
• Full-Stack Integration: Develop efficient, secure, real-time services that surface AI capabilities to end users; peer-review code and document solutions in an agile environment.
• Collaboration: Communicate proactively with teammates across AI research, infrastructure, security, and QA to continuously improve processes and engineering quality.
Required Skills
• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
• AI & LLM Foundations: Hands-on experience or academic projects with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face, Ollama); familiarity with RAG architectures and prompt engineering; understanding of vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus).
• Programming: Strong Python skills for data/AI work; solid foundation in data structures and algorithms.
• Data: Comfortable with SQL and working with relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL databases.
• Mindset: Excellent problem-solving with a strong mathematical/logical foundation; self-motivated, curious, and eager to master emerging AI tools quickly; capable technical writer able to document AI architectures and data flows.
Nice to Have
• Experience with AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Spring AI).
• ML/data science libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, pandas).
• Full-stack exposure: JavaScript/TypeScript with React or Next.js for AI chat interfaces and dashboards; real-time streaming (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events); or Java/Spring Boot backend services.
• DevOps: Git, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, and a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
• Basic Unix/Linux familiarity.

jobs.title: Enterprise Data Intern
jobs.description:
About Us 

American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments. 

Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone. 

All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you. 
 
Role Summary 

Explore Three Unique Data Career Paths: Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Data/AI 

Are you passionate about data, technology, and using information to solve real-world business challenges? Join American Century Investments for a 10-week summer internship and gain hands-on experience working alongside talented IT data professionals who are helping shape the future of our business. 

Whether your interests lie in Data Engineering, Analytics, or AI and Machine Learning, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, learn from experienced mentors, and apply classroom knowledge in a professional environment. 

This program is for currently enrolled undergraduate rising seniors who will graduate in December 2027 - Spring 2028. The deadline to apply is November 1, 2026. 

• Location: this onsite position will be based out of our Kansas City, MO or Southlake (DFW area), TX office. 
• Program dates: June 2nd – August 6th (10 weeks). 
• Work schedule: 40 hours/week - Monday – Friday (8 am – 5 pm). 
 
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future. 
 
How You Will Make an Impact 

As an Enterprise Data Intern, you will: 
• Partner with experienced data professionals on projects that influence business decision-making. 
• Explore technologies and platforms used across Data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud Computing, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML). 
• Learn how data is collected, managed, transformed, and leveraged to create value across the organization. 
• Gain exposure to modern cloud platforms, data pipelines, analytics tools, and AI-driven solutions. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, solve problems, and deliver impactful results. 
• Present project findings and recommendations to leaders and stakeholders. 

Our IT organization supports every area of the business, including Investment Management, Sales, Client Services, and Corporate Functions. Through a combination of cloud technologies, custom-built applications, and industry-leading software, we deliver solutions that help people make smarter decisions with data. 
 
What You Bring to the Team (Required) 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field. 
• Expected graduation between December 2027 and Spring 2028. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 
• Coursework, academic projects, internship experience, or personal experience in one or more of the following areas: Python, SQL, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Cloud Computing (AWS or Azure), Artificial Intelligence (AI), or Machine Learning (ML). 
• Effective verbal and written communication skills. 
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 
• Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and concepts. 
• Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, Competitively Driven. 
 
What We Offer 
• Competitive pay and 401k eligibility for employee contributions. 
• Mentor Program - during your time with us you will be assigned a dedicated mentor to provide career coaching and mentoring. 
• Access to our Business Resource Groups (Emerging Professionals, Pride, Mosaic, Green Team, and others.) 
• Casual dress code - be comfortable and express your unique self. 
• A robust social and philanthropic calendar of events hosted just for Interns! 
 
Additional Requirements 

Employees are required to be in the office on a scheduled frequency. Adherence to this schedule is essential to fulfilling the expectations of the role.

As such, American Century strives to provide a reasonable accommodation to any qualified individual under the ADA to perform essential job functions.

jobs.title: Branded Products Intern
jobs.description:
Investing in You, join a 100-year-old, family-owned leader in Ag – and grow with us!
Wilbur-Ellis invests heavily in our employees by offering skill development and training, competitive compensation and benefits, and a tradition of promoting from within for a broad range of career opportunities. And we foster a supportive, people-first work environment.

“We know the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.”

Our Summer Internship Program: 
Our Summer Internship Program (PLOT) offers an opportunity to gain meaningful experience in Branded Products while building the foundation for a successful career. During this 12-week program, you'll learn from industry professionals, tackle real-world projects, and develop working knowledge of product management, brand strategy, commercialization, customer insights, and product lifecycle management within the agricultural industry. You'll have the opportunity to present your internship learnings directly to leadership. This is more than just an internship. It's your chance to make a real impact, build professional knowledge, and sharpen your abilities in a dynamic, results-driven environment. Successful completion of the PLOT program can also earn you a scholarship between $1,000 and $3,000. 

Role Overview: 
As a Wilbur-Ellis Branded Products Intern, you'll gain experience in product strategy, portfolio management, market analysis, and commercialization initiatives. You'll work closely with the Branded Products team to support projects that help bring innovative products and solutions to customers across the agricultural industry. 
Responsibilities may include conducting market and competitive research, analyzing customer and product performance data, supporting product launch activities, assisting with product positioning and messaging, developing sales and marketing support materials, and collaborating with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, operations, and product development. 
You'll have the opportunity to share your ideas, contribute innovative solutions, and provide a unique perspective while supporting strategic initiatives that drive product growth and customer success. At the conclusion of your internship, you'll prepare and present a final PowerPoint presentation highlighting your project work, key learnings, and overall experience. 

What You Bring to the Role: 
As an intern, we understand you may not already have extensive professional experience. We are seeking a college student pursuing a degree in Agriculture, Agricultural Business, Marketing, Business Administration, Agronomy, Economics, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field with an interest in product management, marketing, and agriculture. 
Overall, we are looking for someone with strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills; attention to detail and problem-solving abilities; the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively; intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn; a self-starter who is eager to contribute ideas and collaborate across teams; and someone who brings their full self to work each day. We want to help you grow, and we want to learn from you, too. 

Examples of What You May Gain: 
• Exposure to branded product strategy and portfolio management within a leading agribusiness organization 
• Experience supporting product commercialization, market analysis, and product lifecycle initiatives 
• Opportunities to collaborate with product management, marketing, sales, operations, and business leadership teams 
• Development of analytical, project management, communication, and strategic thinking skills 
• Hands-on experience evaluating market trends, customer needs, competitive insights, and product performance 
• Exposure to product positioning, customer value propositions, and go-to-market strategies 
• Mentorship from experienced product management and business professionals 
• A deeper understanding of how branded products are developed, positioned, launched, and managed throughout their lifecycle 
• Real-world experience contributing to projects that support innovation, customer success, and business growth across the agricultural industry 
 
Compensation and Benefits: 
• In compliance with all states and cities requiring transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $17.00 to $24.00 per hour. Note that wages may vary based on location, skills, and experience. 

#LI-DNI

Please note that salary ranges provided for this role on external job boards are salary estimates made by outside parties and may not be accurate.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
Diversity of people, cultures, opinions, and ideas makes us all stronger. From leadership commitment to employee buy-in, we know that creating an inclusive environment and providing opportunities for all employees to reach their full potential is a shared responsibility.

Wilbur-Ellis is a company you can be proud to call your employer
Wilbur-Ellis markets and distributes agricultural products, animal feed specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. A privately held and consistently profitable company, we employ more than 4,000 people throughout North America and Asia-Pacific.

Wilbur-Ellis is for and about people
Wilbur-Ellis has enjoyed over 100 years of success and growth, all thanks to our people. Our employees are both leaders and team players who thrive on creativity, entrepreneurial spirit, and a dedication to quality work, our customers, and each other.

Wilbur-Ellis invests in the industry’s best workforce

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world.
