We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the team

The APAC Payments TechOps team ensures the accuracy of financial data flowing through Stripe's payment infrastructure, manages aging balances, maintains compliance with partner and regulatory requirements, and builds tooling to detect and resolve data quality issues at scale. Through the internship, you will work with real financial data, gain experience in payments data analysis and operational problem-solving, and have opportunities to present your work to your team and the wider org. Each intern has a dedicated intern manager, and every project is part of the team's roadmap and will directly help Stripe's mission.

What you’ll do

Every internship at Stripe centers around a real, legitimate project that our team urgently needs. We will support you in shipping it. Yes, you will actually ship it. Example projects include building data quality checks for payment flows, creating dashboards to surface aging balance trends, automating compliance reporting, or analyzing cost structures across partner networks. As a Stripe intern, you'll be tackling important projects while working alongside exceptional people who insist on doing their best work. You'll learn from people with high standards who are great at inspiring others to do more and go further. We value technical and personal growth, and see our internship program as a vehicle to foster both.

Responsibilities

• Analyze financial data by writing queries and examining data quality, reconciliation accuracy, or cost structures across Stripe's payment flows

• Write code or build tooling that will be used in production and has meaningful impact to Stripe's payment operations

• Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews, data model discussions, or analysis walkthroughs

• Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and finance stakeholders to seek and incorporate feedback on your work

• Learn quickly by asking great questions, by working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, and by communicating the status of your work clearly

Who you are

• Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

• Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 

• Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

• A strong fundamental understanding of quantitative analysis through pursuit of a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, data science, finance, economics, information systems, or a related discipline

• Some experience and familiarity with programming or data analysis, either through side projects or coursework. We work mostly in SQL, Python, and Ruby. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present

• Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

Preferred qualifications

• At least 2 years of university education, or equivalent work experience

• Familiarity with SQL and querying relational databases, either through coursework or personal projects

• Interest in payments, fintech, or financial systems

• Comfort with developer tools (e.g. git) and data visualization

• A strong interest in understanding how financial data flows through complex payment systems and ensuring its accuracy

• Ability to write clearly to explain analytical findings to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes

jobs.title: Content Design Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Content Systems is the heart of Lyft's language ecosystem. The team is made up of two distinct disciplines, Content Design and Learning Experience Design, who create and own language across Lyft's in-app experiences that help customers succeed on the Lyft platform.

We're looking for a Content Design intern to join our team for the summer. This role will both help design and build our internal content system (think information architecture), and embed in a rotation of design teams as a content design/learning design partner in building products across the Lyft community. Of course, you won’t be alone. You'll work with designers, researchers, marketers, and product managers day in and day out to develop experiences that reach and resonate with riders.

This internship will take place in our Toronto office during Summer 2027. 

What we're looking for

Responsibilities:

• Support our content system by establishing and translating information architecture to help manage content across Lyft 

• Help teams reconsider existing systems and processes (eg publishing workflows) to align to the new information architecture

• Support product strategy and vision through content, working on projects as a content designer and learning experience designer

• Translate complicated concepts into clear in-product copy (UI, notifications, errors, and more) and learning materials 

• Collaborate with designers, visual content creators, researchers, engineers, marketers, data science, product managers, and other stakeholders across tech and ops

• The ability to translate concepts across the UI, learning center, and knowledge base into connected content objects

• Manage multiple projects and competing priorities

• Maintain, evolve and champion the Lyft brand voice and style

Skills:

• Excellent writing skills; ability to demonstrate this in the UX writing, information architecture, or education design space preferred

• A systems mind that considers the holistic information experience 

• Ability to understand and discuss strategy, metrics, and results

• A collaborative, proactive mindset

• Nice to haves:

• Experience with design tools (Figma)

• Experience with content management systems (Ditto, Contentful, etc)

• Knowledge of accessibility best practices

Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelors, Masters or PhD degree in a writing or UX-adjacent field like English, Journalism, User Experience, Design, Education, Sociology, Psychology or Creative Writing from a university in Canada, with a graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required)

• Available during Summer 2027 for an internship in Toronto

• Required: A portfolio must be submitted with your application and should include at least 3 samples/case studies demonstrating one more of the following: UX writing, information architecture, education design.

*Note: Great candidates might not have a traditional background or strong experience in this field. That's expected, and we encourage those with the skills above to apply even if you're thinking "I'm not sure this is me"

What you'll get from Content Systems

Working with us:

• Guided mentorship from tenured content designers and learning experience designers

• Hands-on experience designing products with a full-stack tech team

• Discovering how to do more with more — we're focused on how AI can support us, not replace us

• Learn to solve product problems from the lens of content design and learning design

• Good humored, well-intentioned practitioners with over a century of combined content experience (yes, really) 

Benefits:

• Mental health benefits

• In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off

• Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. 

The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is CAD $40 - CAD $46 per hour. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

Lyft may use artificial intelligence to screen applicants, however, Lyft employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Annotation Specialist - Computer Vision
jobs.description:
Team Description:
Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms.

As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. 

This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. This position will also require obtaining the necessary government clearances. 

In This Position You Will:
• Use a variety of desktop and web-based software tools to review picture and video sources to identify objects, activities, events, and other items of interest to Computer Vision Researchers in images and video. 

• Perform diverse, detailed annotations in the form of bounding boxes, polygon segmentation, and metadata markups in accordance with established group procedures and a high degree of accuracy.

• Work with custom in-house software to troubleshoot bugs and optimize the annotation process.

• Learn new tools and/or technologies as necessary to follow team workflow and accomplish annotation tasks.

• Use an agile workflow for tracking responsibilities and task progress, including git for task/issue tracking.

• Work in a fast-paced environment that evolves regularly in response to changing research and customer needs.
Required Qualifications:
• Excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Willing to learn new tools or programs as project needs evolve and workflows change.

• Comfortable being proactive and asking questions or for clarification when needed. 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Suite.

• Excellent customer service focus and communication skills, both oral and written; ability to effectively communicate with multiple individuals in varying levels of the organization.

• Ability to maintain confidential data.

• Good interpersonal skills and a team player.

• High school degree required, advanced degree preferred.

• Flexibility to work variable, project-dependent hours. Work may be available regularly during active project periods, while other periods may have limited or no hours. A minimum or set number of weekly hours is not guaranteed.

• Ability and willingness to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when required by project needs.

• If not already cleared TS/SCI, willingness and ability to apply for and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

• Due to contractual requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship.
Company Description:
Kitware is a research and development software solutions provider with a mission to advance science, make a positive impact, and share our results all within a collaborative, employee-focused work environment that is friendly, fair, and flexible. Our work is improving healthcare outcomes, increasing national security, and advancing our national computing infrastructure. Our customers and collaborators include top universities from around the world, government organizations, national research labs, medical device manufacturers, car manufacturers, financial institutions, and many others.  
 
Kitware is proud to be 100% employee-owned.  
 
Additional Information:
Our team members enjoy a small company environment, flexibility in work assignments, and high levels of independence and responsibility. 
 
Kitware actively subscribes to a policy of equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, protected veteran status, uniformed service member status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. 
 
Any unsolicited resume sent to Kitware, including to Kitware's mailing addresses, fax machines or email addresses, whether directly to Kitware employees or to Kitware's applicant tracking system, will be considered Kitware property.  Kitware will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume, and will consider any candidate submitted by a recruitment agency without a fully executed contract with Kitware to have been referred free of any charges or fees.
 
If you need assistance with applying or interviewing for a role due to a disability or special need, please reach out directly to our HR team at hr@kitware.com at any time during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
About Wurl, LLC.

At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.

In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

About the role:

Wurl is seeking an intern with proven academic achievements in data analytics related fields for a year long internship. Wurl’s position in the video and ad delivery ecosystem generates large quantities of data that needs to be carefully analyzed and normalized. We’re looking for an intern that can become familiar with Wurl’s datasets and their usage and support our Data Science and Machine Learning team. The ideal candidate is a PhD / MSc in the field of DataScience, AI/ML, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.

Responsibilities: 

• Perform analysis tasks to identify anomalies and their root cause as well as propose and put in place validations to programmatically identify such conditions

• Propose methods to normalize the data, implement them, check accuracy and iterate until sufficient accuracy is achieved 

• Increase the accuracy of derived datasets and data products

Qualifications:

• Education - 

• PhD / MSC preferred. BSc with high gpa, multiple majors, notable projects is also accepted

• Field: DataScience, AI/ML, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science

• Technical

• Graph algorithms and network analysis

• Large-scale data analysis

• Data quality and anomaly detection

• Agentic / AI-assisted software development

• Familiarity with distributed data platforms such as Snowflake / Databricks

• Strong Python and SQL

• Applied statistics and probability

• Machine learning fundamentals

• Experiment design and causal reasoning

• Optimization / decision-making under uncertainty

• Ability to write clean, maintainable analytical code

• Non agentic development experience is mandatory

• Nice to have

• Modeling / Research

• Comfortable evaluating models beyond headline metrics

• Experience moving from research idea → prototype → validated result

• Ability to translate ambiguous problems into mathematical or statistical formulations

• Strong intuition for uncertainty, bias, variance, and noisy data

• Strong quantitative reasoning and mathematical knowledge

• Nice to have

• Problem Solving

• Ability to recognize when results look wrong

• Comfortable working with incomplete, messy, or contradictory data

• Advanced analytical problem-solving ability

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills

• Ability to form and test hypotheses quickly

• Nice to have

• Personal Attributes

• High intellectual curiosity

• Strong ownership and initiative

• Rapid learner

• Independent thinker

• Comfortable challenging assumptions

• Willingness to continue digging into 'funny' things until they make sense

• Effective communication skills and team player.

What We Offer:

• Paid internship ($30/hr) with flexible scheduling.

• Remote-first work culture and support.

• Mentorship from experienced engineers and product experts.

jobs.title: System Technology Research Engineer - (PhD Intern)
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
Are you a top-tier university student eager to dive into the world of semiconductor innovation? Intel's Foundry System Technology team is seeking a talented intern to help us push the boundaries of semiconductor and packaging manufacturing technologies.

Our team is dedicated to advancing Moore's Law, exploring new product opportunities, and leading industry-defining packaging development through System Technology Co-optimisation (STCO).

Position Overview: As a Research Engineer Intern, you will play a crucial role in developing STCO methodology and evaluating 3D/2.5D dis-aggregation schemes using solder microbumps or hybrid bonding for memory and logic stacking across different product architectures. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work on pioneering technologies and contribute to Intel's semiconductor processing and packaging roadmap.

What You'll Do: 

• Develop and enhance STCO methodologies.
• Perform system-level evaluations of novel devices, interconnects, patterning, materials, systems, and integration schemes.
• Collaborate with diverse teams to drive innovation across various applications.

Who We're Looking For: 

• Driven and Motivated; a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering high-quality results.
• Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex challenges with a strategic approach.
• Organized and Efficient: Strong prioritization and time management skills to handle a fast-paced workflow.
• Collaborative and Team-Oriented: Excellent stakeholder management and teamwork ethics.
• Flexible and Adaptable: Comfortable working in an agile environment with a tolerance for ambiguity.
• Strong Communicator: Good interpersonal skills to facilitate effective collaboration and communication

Internship Details: Minimum of 3 months during summer 2026, with potential for extension based on business needs.

Why Choose Intel?

• Collaborate with industry leaders and innovators.
• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies.
• Contribute to projects that shape the future of semiconductor processing.

If you're ready to embark on a journey of innovation and discovery, apply now to join Intel's Foundry System Technology team. We look forward to welcoming you to a transformative internship experience

Qualifications:
You must possess the below requirements to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Job Details:

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact:
As a Process Integration and Yield Engineering PhD Intern at Intel, you will be at the forefront of semiconductor manufacturing innovation. In this role, you will develop and optimize cutting-edge manufacturing processes while improving defect management strategies and driving process yield enhancements in high-volume production environments. Collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams, you will address complex technical challenges, troubleshoot process issues, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. This hands-on internship is an opportunity to grow your expertise, gain invaluable experience, and contribute to Intel's mission of delivering world-class semiconductor products.

Business group:
Intel Foundry plays a crucial role in advancing Intel's leadership in semiconductor manufacturing. As part of this team, you will contribute to Intel's efforts to deliver innovative technologies that enrich lives worldwide. The group focuses on developing and optimizing manufacturing processes that drive Intel's industry-leading products while supporting continuous improvement in high-volume production environments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Contribute to the development and optimization of module processes and integration flows for semiconductor manufacturing.
- Analyze defect data, conduct experiments, and assist in risk assessments to support yield improvement initiatives.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot process flow issues and optimize metrology strategies.
- Apply data analysis techniques to improve process performance and manufacturing efficiency.
- Participate in continuous improvement efforts focused on enhancing production quality and output.
- Engage in innovative projects to develop expertise and support Intel's business goals.

- Actively pursuing a PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Material Science, or Chemistry.
- Proficiency in microscopy techniques.
- Background in circuit design and semiconductor device physics.

- 3.0 GPA

jobs.description:
The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking hard-working and curious Software Engineers across all organizations to help design, build, and evolve the systems that power our products and platforms.

As a university graduate, you’ll work on real-world engineering problems across areas such as web, mobile, data, and platform development. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and partners from different functions, including designers and product managers. You will help build scalable systems and continue developing your technical skills and analytical thinking.

This role is designed for engineers who are excited not only about writing code, but also about understanding how software works end-to-end, validating solutions, and connecting technical decisions to real user and product outcomes.

What You’ll Do 

• Develop high-quality, reliable, testable, and maintainable code
• Participate in all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, deployment, and documentation
• Use modern development tools, including AI-assisted tooling, to support coding, testing, debugging, and workflow efficiency, while ensuring quality, correctness, and sound technical judgment
• Contribute to improving product quality, performance, scalability, and reliability with guidance from your team
• Review and iterate on solutions, identifying issues, debugging problems, and refining implementations
• Collaborate with engineers and multi-functional partners through stand-ups, code reviews, build discussions, and team meetings 
• Work both independently and collaboratively within a fast-paced development environment, communicating clearly and constructively
• Learn from your team, seek feedback, and contribute to a positive and inclusive engineering culture
• Additional responsibilities as needed based on specific role or team

What You Need to Succeed 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation date of December 2026 – June 2027
• 0-1+ years of experience through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects building applications or systems
• Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and coding principles
• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript
• Familiarity with the software development lifecycle - designing, building, deploying, and maintaining applications
• Exposure to or interest in modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, and an understanding of how to use them responsibly
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason through technical challenges
• Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and take initiative in solving problems
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain ideas and incorporate feedback
• Customer-focused mindset and passion for building high-quality products and engineering excellence at scale
About Adobe
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

jobs.title: SOC Design Team Methodology Intern - 2027
jobs.description:
The NVIDIA System-on-Chip (SOC) design group is looking for a motivated intern to join our Methodology team. In this role, you will help improve the way we design, configure, and verify in SOC Design fields— making them faster, more reliable, and increasingly AI-assisted. This is a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of digital ASIC front-end methodology and applied AI. You will contribute to real production flows used across NVIDIA's SOC projects, partner with experienced engineers, and see how modern AI agents can accelerate chip design. We are looking for someone who is curious about finding problems, open-minded in solving them, quick to learn new tools, and detail-oriented in execution — while being organized, collaborative, and a strong communicator.
 
What You'll Be Doing:
• Get up to speed on NVIDIA's SOC project development environment, tooling, and design flows.

• Identify pain points in SOC configuration work and related methodology areas, and help scope opportunities for improvement.

• Review conventional SOC design flows, document bottlenecks, and propose and prototype upgrades that improve turnaround time, quality, or automation.

• Develop and refine AI agents and automation scripts to support "Speed of Light" execution — helping engineers move faster by reducing manual, repetitive steps.

• Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and best-practice guides so that methodology improvements are repeatable and adoptable by the broader team.

• Collaborate with SOC Design engineers to gather requirements, validate ideas, and iterate on solutions.

What We Need to See:
• Currently pursuing a MS (or higher) Students in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, who will graduate at 2028

• Working knowledge of digital ASIC front-end design flows

• Strong scripting skills — Python, Perl, or similar languages — with the ability to automate tasks and build maintainable tooling.

• Genuine interest and foundational knowledge in AI agent development (e.g., LLM-based agents, prompt design, tool-use / function-calling, or agentic workflows).

• Fluent English, both written and spoken, for effective collaboration in a global team.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
• Coursework, projects, or internships in SOC design methodology.

• Hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI-style tool use, or similar frameworks).

• Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD, and software engineering best practices.

• Comfort working in a Linux development environment with large codebases and EDA toolchains.

• A problem-finding mindset — you don't just solve assigned tasks, you proactively surface issues and propose improvements.

• Strong communication and teamwork, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Applied Systems Engineering Rotation Engineer - New College Graduate 2026
jobs.description:

ASE engages with the entire lifecycle of next-generation AI supercomputing pre-clusters at scale. The team creates reference architectures, confirms feasibility through initial end-to-end integration and bring-up, and supports large-scale production environments. These environments allow internal teams to run workloads, gather detailed telemetry, and detect and resolve issues before they impact customers.

As an Applied Systems Engineering Rotation Engineer, you will move through different teams such as Architecture, Bring-up, and Production. Exposure to software, performance, or technical program management teams is possible when program needs align. Throughout four 3-month rotations, you will collaborate with senior engineers and mentors on projects that help NVIDIA design, integrate, validate, operate, and improve large-scale GPU compute clusters. This program is intended for New College Graduates who are curious, systems-minded, and eager to learn how architecture decisions become production-ready clusters. At the end of the year, final placement will be based on a combination of business need, host manager feedback, demonstrated strengths, and candidate preference.

• Evaluate, prototype, and validate emerging infrastructure, hardware, software, firmware, networking, storage, and accelerator technologies.

jobs.title: Hardware Platform Development Intern
jobs.description:
About the job

Build your first real systems engineering experience on AI hardware you can measure, test and improve.

As a Systems Engineering Intern in Austin, you will contribute to projects across hardware, firmware and software engineering. You will help validate advanced AI compute platforms from subsystem behaviour to full system performance.

You will support CPU and high-speed input and output subsystem work, including lab testing, automation and data analysis. Your work will help engineers understand performance, power, signal behaviour and reliability.

You will gain hands-on experience with technologies such as PCIe 6.0, 800G Ethernet and high-performance cooling. You will own defined technical tasks with guidance, then document your methods, results and conclusions.

This internship is a chance to turn academic learning into practical engineering judgement on real AI hardware.

The team and culture

You will join systems engineers who work across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical and thermal teams. Work happens through lab measurement, script-driven validation, shared debugging and clear engineering notes.

You will be given defined problems to own, with guidance from engineers who expect curiosity and careful thinking. Decisions are made through data, reproducible results and open technical review.

The team values people who think big, act fast, take responsibility and speak up. As an intern, you will be encouraged to ask questions, test assumptions and build confidence.

What we’re looking for

• Current enrollment in a bachelor's, master's or doctoral program in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or a closely related field

• Hands-on lab testing or technical measurement experience through coursework, research, student teams, internships or personal projects

• Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, C, C++ or MATLAB

• Foundational understanding of computer architecture, digital systems, embedded systems or hardware-software interaction

• Analytical problem-solving skills and interest in how hardware, firmware and software operate together

• Clear documentation habits, constructive communication and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools with guidance

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. 

Benefits

• Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility

• Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental and vision coverage to help keep you and your family healthy

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER (COMPONENTS)

The Components Engineering Team develops the world’s best flight hardware and fabricates it at an in-house machine shop for Starship. The team is making a next generation machine shop with advanced software and automation, an alien dreadnought machine that builds the machine. As a software engineer, you will design novel software solutions such as web applications for efficient factory operation, algorithms and AI to automatically create CNC programs, control and deployment of CNC machines, and much more. These improvements will enable rapid Starship production rates of 100+ per year as well as a quick development cycle, which are critical for SpaceX’s Moon and Mars missions. Previous manufacturing experience is not necessary, just the desire to make high-quality software to rapidly build Starships.

• Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across many SpaceX teams

• Own all aspects of software development, including design, testing, and deployment

• Rapidly create new applications that improve the production cycle time in the machine shop and the time to go from CAD to part in hand

• Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions

• Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, physics or other engineering discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree

• Experience in full stack development

• Developed, debugged, and deployed software that has been used in real world applications and projects

• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

• Thorough knowledge of computer architecture and networks

• Knowledge of AI tools and how to best solve problems using AI solutions

• Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework

• Experience with web-technologies such as nginx, haproxy, redis

• Experience with build systems like Make and package management tools such as pip, npm, nuget

• Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them

• Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container and deployment tools

• Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: Student Researcher Intern - Seed Model - Seed Responsible AI
Simulation – Sim to Real Intern
jobs.description:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.

About the Role
Join Field AI’s Simulation team for a 12-week internship building tools that connect real-world robot deployments with autonomy development. You’ll work alongside simulation and autonomy engineers on a scoped project in simulation tooling, sensor fidelity, real-to-sim workflows, or autonomy evaluation, with opportunities to validate your work against real robot data.
What You'll Get To Do
• 
Work with a mentor to define and deliver a focused simulation project over 12 weeks.

• 
Develop or improve robotics simulation tools using Python and/or C++.

• 
Help evaluate and improve simulation fidelity in an area such as sensor modeling, timing, robot behavior, or environment representation.

• 
Build tools for scenario execution, log replay, regression testing, metrics, or visualization.

• 
Use field logs, reconstructed environments, or real-world failure cases to create reproducible simulation scenarios.

• 
Collaborate with simulation and autonomy engineers to investigate differences between simulated and real robot behavior.

• 
Document your approach and share your results through a final demo and technical handoff.

Your project will focus on a subset of these areas, based on your interests, experience, and team priorities.
What You Have
• 
Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 
Programming experience in Python and/or C++ through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.

• 
Foundational knowledge in one or more areas such as robotics, simulation, computer graphics, physics, or software engineering.

• 
Experience building and debugging software, including familiarity with Git and Linux.

• 
Interest in understanding how sensing, timing, physics, and environments affect robot behavior.

• 
A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools.

• 
Availability for a 12-week internship.
What Will Set You Apart
• 
Hands-on experience with Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, Unity, Unreal, or another simulation platform.

• 
Familiarity with ROS2, including sensor messages, coordinate transforms, or recorded robot data.

• 
Experience working with robot or environment assets such as URDF, USD, meshes, or point clouds.

• 
Projects involving sensor simulation, physics modeling, 3D reconstruction, or procedural environment generation.

• 
Experience with automated testing, CI workflows, batch simulation, or data analysis and visualization.

• 
Experience using real robot data to evaluate simulation accuracy or autonomy performance.

• 
Participation in robotics research, student teams, competitions, or open-source projects.
Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
 
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
 
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
 
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Software Defined Radio Hardware Intern - Winter 2027
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. 

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Software Defined Radio Hardware Intern (Winter 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university. 

As an Intern, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past interns have designed and tested hardware/software that is now flying on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis. 

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to be an Associate Engineer.

Role

• Design, simulate, implement, and test our internally developed software defined radio hardware

• Bringup and debug hardware in the lab with top of the line instruments and equipment

• Write code to help evaluate performance and automate testing of satellite hardware

• Integrate these systems into the spacecraft by working closely with the rest of the team

Requirements

• A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development

• Currently pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent 

• Demonstrated ability to personally design, build, and test PCBA hardware from scratch (student design team projects, design competitions, personal projects)

• Solid EE foundation in one or more of the following areas:

• analog design (op amps, transistors, RLC filters)

• digital design (FPGAs, SOCs, SERDES, DDR, LVDS)

• mixed signal design (ADCs, DACs, power integrity)

• RF design (Lineups, s-parameters, impedance matching)

Bonus

• Experience building or using software defined radios

• Experience with Altium Designer (or other PCB design software)

• Experience with analysis software (ADS, ANSYS, Matlab)

• Experience with Python or similar programming languages

• Experience with soldering and rework

• Experience with EE lab bench equipment (power supply, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, etc)

The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.

Base Hourly Pay
$29—$29 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern, iOS
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



Explore our Engineering Blog https://builders.ramp.com & Emerging Talent https://builders.ramp.com/emerging-talent Blog to learn more about how we build at Ramp and what it’s like to start your career here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is, at its core, an engineering company, and is on a mission to build the best engineering team in the US! We are looking for iOS interns (12 or 16 weeks) who are excited to be part of our story and help us build a diverse and vibrant tech community. We hire engineers with a broad set of technical skills, who are highly cross-functional, and eager to solve a wide range of engineering challenges. Our ideal candidate has a strong sense of ownership and enjoys owning projects from inception to scaling them in production. We value people who take pride in their work, and show an aptitude for learning quickly whether they’re familiar with our stack or not. You'll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and ship new features for Ramp’s iOS app

 - Work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to our mobile codebase

 - Collaborate with Product and Design to bring new features and experiences to life

 - Learn from customer feedback and help continuously improve our product

 - Contribute to engineering tools and processes that help the team move quickly and scale
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Currently pursuing a B.S. or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, graduating December 2027 or later

 - Experience with Swift and/or iOS development through internships, coursework, or personal projects

 - Strong programming fundamentals and understanding of mobile development concepts

 - Experience building a mobile app, feature, or relevant project

 - Ability to turn product ideas into thoughtful engineering solutions

 - Desire to learn quickly, take ownership, and work in a fast-paced environment




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with SwiftUI

 - Familiarity with mobile design patterns and best practices

 - Experience shipping an iOS app or feature to real users

 - Exposure to technologies in our mobile stack, including Swift Concurrency, The Composable Architecture, Bazel, OpenAPI, or Buildkite

 - Experience with web or backend development




COMPENSATION

 - The monthly rate for this internship is $12,500 USD + housing stipend




RAMP BENEFITS

 - Apple MacBook

 - Catered Lunches in NYC office Monday-Friday




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

 

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice https://ramp.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.description:
Location: Burlington, ON

Our Team:
As a member of our Digital Design group, you will be working in a team environment, contributing to development of advanced digital subsystems in next generation mixed-signal ICs for Semtech’s Signal Integrity Products Division. You will have the opportunity to contribute to products in our data communications or broadcast video product lines.

Job Summary:
Joining our Digital Design team means you'll gain comprehensive experience across the full spectrum of digital silicon development - from initial concept definition through design, verification, and final implementation. You'll play a vital role as a project team member, delivering exceptional work while taking ownership of your contributions to ensure we successfully achieve our project goals and deadlines.

Responsibilities:
• Design RTL block for digital subsystems
• Interpret architecture and detailed design specifications to generate RTL or verification code
• Work with a team to functionally verify a design or component using constrained random functional verification
• Help create scripts and/or methodologies to improve or automate design processes
• Use the best in class CAD tools to implement digital designs (including Synthesis, DFT insertion, and STA/timing closure)
• Work with analog and digital engineers, system engineers and marketing to ensure the design meets all customer requirements
• Create technical, process or product documentation
• Assist in bring-up, lab debug, validation of products

Minimum Qualifications:
• Completed at least 3 years of a bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently and in a team environment
• Highly motivated and creative
• Well organized, thorough, and detail oriented
• Demonstrated ability to multitask and prioritize multiple simultaneous responsibilities
• Basic understanding of digital design and/or microelectronics; as evidenced through strong academic accomplishments in these areas
• Knowledge and familiarity with SystemVerilog, Verilog, or VHDL
• Knowledge and/or experience with programming and/or scripting languages: C/C++, Perl, Python, SystemVerilog, VisualBasic

• General Analog Design Techniques

36 - 48, $ per hour.

This application is for a 6-month student role from January - June 2027. Resume review begins in October 2026.
 
Portfolio Data & Digital Innovation (PDDI) is a multidisciplinary team dedicated to transforming how Development leverages data, technology, and artificial intelligence to make faster, better-informed decisions. We bring together expertise in portfolio analytics, data management, AI/ML innovation, Planisware technology, and digital product delivery to create scalable solutions that improve portfolio visibility, streamline operations, and accelerate decision-making. Through initiatives such as Project FORWARD, AI-powered automation, portfolio intelligence tools, and a connected data foundation, PDDI partners across Development, Finance, IT, and other functions to drive innovation, strengthen governance, and enable a more data-driven and agile organization.
 
What You’ll Do:
As a member of the Portfolio Data & Digital Innovation (PDDI) team, you will help shape the future of data-driven decision making across Biogen's R&D portfolio. Working alongside data scientists, portfolio strategists, data engineers, and business leaders, you will develop AI-powered solutions that improve portfolio visibility, accelerate decision-making, enhance data quality, and streamline operational workflows. You will contribute across the full solution lifecycle, from data acquisition and engineering to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities include:
• Collaborate with data scientists, portfolio analysts, and subject matter experts to develop and deploy innovative AI and analytics solutions.

• Passion for learning, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, and applying them to business challenges.

• Experience with Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, forecasting, or decision science methodologies.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, k8s, containerization, or Linux environments.
• Experience with data visualization and product development frameworks such as Streamlit, Power BI, or similar technologies.
• Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, quality, compliance, or R&D portfolio analytics.

• Legal authorization to work in the U.S.
• At least 18 years of age prior to the scheduled start date.
• Be currently enrolled in an accredited community college, college, university or skills program/apprenticeship.

Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or related field.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Enterprise Data & Systems - Salesforce & Snowflake
jobs.description:
WEX is a global commerce platform that has been simplifying the way businesses operate for over 40 years. Our purpose is simple: to reduce administrative burdens, streamline payments, and manage mobility. With a team of over 7,200 professionals across 16 countries.

Our specialties are employee benefits, business payments, and fleet/mobility solutions. We support more than 20 million SaaS accounts, 8 million Health Savings Accounts, and 19+ million vehicles worldwide. We're a growing company with a history of innovation and a focus on our customers, making this a great place to grow your career.

The WEX Summer Internship Program: Learn, Lead, and Make an Impact
Our 13-week paid internship program, running from late May to mid-August, is a chance for you to gain real-world experience and develop your skills. Recruiting begins in September and continues through November at our various locations across the U.S.
You won't just be a bystander; you'll work on impactful projects and contribute to WEX’s mission. We provide mentorship, professional development, and weekly learning experiences to help you build confidence and leadership skills. High-performing interns may even get the chance to lead their own initiatives.

We offer remote, hybrid, and onsite options for flexibility, and our goal is to bring top interns back full-time or offer them extended roles during the school year.
Imagine starting your career with a company that’s building what's next. Your future starts here.

About the Team/Role: 
We are seeking an inquisitive, proactive, and analytical Software Engineering Intern to join our Enterprise Applications & Systems Engineering organization. In this role, you will participate in solving a critical enterprise challenge: establishing a customer repository within our core enterprise architecture and CRM (Salesforce) by unifying data funneled through our modern data warehouse (Snowflake).

As our business scales across diverse commercial platforms, customer and account data originates across multiple legacy systems, transactional processing engines, and operational datastores. You will act as both a technical detective and a systems builder—collaborating with senior enterprise architects, software engineers, and business leaders to sleuth out golden record sources, gather requirements for essential customer attributes, and design reusable data ingestion and transformation patterns.

This internship offers hands-on enterprise systems experience, active mentorship from senior engineering leaders, and direct exposure to modern cloud data stacks and CRM architectures.

How you’ll make an impact:
• Investigate Source Systems: Trace data lineage across disparate systems (billing platforms, transactional processors, legacy portals, and operational services) to identify where key customer, account, and relationship attributes truly originate.
• Define Customer Schema: Partner with product managers, business analysts, and functional leads across Sales, Service, and Operations to document requirements for what constitutes the "single source of truth" for customer identity in Salesforce.
• Data Quality & Validation: Perform exploratory data analysis to evaluate consistency, detect schema drift, address duplicate records, and define mapping rules between upstream source models and their desitnations.
• Build for Reusability: Assist in designing and building scalable, modular data extraction, transformation, and ingestion workflows so future source integrations can plug in with minimal custom code.
• Harness Snowflake: Write optimized SQL transformations, views, and data processing routines within Snowflake to clean, normalize, and stage customer datasets for downstream consumption.
• Integrate with Salesforce: Collaborate with Senior Salesforce Developers and Enterprise Architects to map staged Snowflake data into standard and custom Salesforce objects.
• Active Mentorship & Agile Sprints: Participate in daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and architectural design reviews alongside senior systems engineers.
• Testing & Documentation: Document data dictionaries, entity-relationship diagrams (ERDs), integration flows, and automated validation tests to ensure maintainability.
• AI & Automation Exploration: Leverage AI-assisted developer workflows and modern automation tooling to accelerate querying, schema mapping, and documentation generation.

Experience you’ll bring: 
• Educational Foundation: Pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
• Analytical Mindset: A natural curiosity and tenacity for digging beneath the surface of complex systems to figure out how data flows, where discrepancies lie, and which source represents the ground truth.
• Passion for Reusable Systems: An instinct to build tools, scripts, and data models that solve problems systematically rather than with one-off manual patches.
• SQL & Relational Foundations: Solid academic or project experience writing structured SQL queries (joins, aggregations, window functions) and understanding relational database principles (foreign keys, indexing, entity relationships).
• Scripting & Programming Fundamentals: Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Java) and standard version control workflows (Git/GitHub).
• Rapid Platform Learner: While prior hands-on experience with Snowflake or Salesforce is a plus, a demonstrable aptitude and enthusiasm to learn both enterprise platforms quickly is paramount.
• Clear Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex data structures into plain language when interviewing stakeholders and gathering requirements.

Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Job Description

What is the opportunity?
The Quantum technologies intern will join the fast-paced, multi-disciplinary Innovation Group at RBC to explore where quantum technologies can augment finance capabilities to bring impact and advantage. We are seeking blue-sky thinkers who want to determine true applicability of their ideas in a wide variety of quantum fields to the financial sector. Those who are interested in learning about the intersection of quantum technologies with finance are encouraged to apply. This is a small, new team so self-driven candidates are a must. 

What will you do?
• Participating in experiments and theory development towards proof of concepts of financial applications of quantum technology
• Developing either algorithms, protocols, sensors, or networking techniques depending on your skill sets
• Researching and determining successful applications for quantum technologies for finance
• Benchmarking performance and documenting research and outcomes
• Collaboration with external vendors and university partners on research
• Supporting the broader Innovation team as needed

What do you need to succeed?
Must-have
• Currently enrolled at a Canadian post-secondary institution with a focus on Math in Computer Science (Quantum Information), or MScAC in Quantum Computing or equivalent
• Excellent interpersonal and highly developed communication skills (verbal and written)
• Creative and analytical thinker who is self-driven and capable of working in a fast-paced environment
• Strong MS Office skills – Word, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint
• Knowledge of programming and scripting languages - Python
• Communication, Time Management, Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement, Analytical Thinking, Problem Solving, Results Driven, Curiosity, Strategic Thinking

Nice-to-have

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. The Opportunity:
As a WaveLogic Software Intern, gain hands-on experience contributing to next-generation optical networking technologies. Work with experienced teams to help develop, validate, and improve software capabilities that support network solutions. Contribute technical skills while building knowledge of optical transport and switching technologies.

How you will make an impact:
• Develop understanding and expertise in next-generation network solutions using optical transport and switching technologies such as OTN and Ethernet.
• Develop embedded software skills to design, develop, validate, and document advanced networking features and capabilities deployed in service provider networks.
• Troubleshoot and resolve reported embedded software issues by identifying root causes, diagnosing defects, debugging, and delivering fixes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and test next-generation modem technologies.

The must haves:
• Education: Actively enrolled in a bachelor's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering,
• C, C++ programming language experience
• Good knowledge of embedded systems, device drivers (e.g., GPIO, I2C drivers), Linux/RTOS operating system knowledge, mutual exclusion, synchronization, interrupt handling, inter-process communication, memory management, etc.
• Positive work attitude, highly motivated, with the ability to seek out answers and learn independently
• Strong verbal and technical writing skills
• Collaborates well in a team environment

Nice to haves:
• Familiarity with datacom & telecom concepts such as DWDM, OTN, Ethernet, TCP/IP

• Ability to understand CPU hardware architectures, hardware functional specifications, and hardware timing diagrams
• Linux as a software development environment
• Design and development tools such as Git, Eclipse, JIRA, Confluence, GDB, Yocto

• Scripting experience, Python, Go, BASH

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Co-op Intern
jobs.description:
Career-defining. Life-changing. 

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:
Electrical Test Engineer Co-Ops at iRhythm work passionately to deliver innovative solutions that improve the quality of healthcare and the patient experience. In this role you will contribute directly to near and long-term commercialization efforts for our next-generation wearable bio-sensors, collaborating alongside a small team of multi-disciplinary engineers experienced in bringing medical devices to market. You will be treated as a regular member of the engineering team, inclusive of the associated projects, deliverables and accountability. 

Assignment Details
This is a full-time, six-month Engineering Internship / Cooperative Education (Co-op) assignment for a current student. It offers internship-style learning, mentorship, and meaningful project work, but it is not a traditional summer internship. Candidates must be available for the full January through June 2027 assignment in San Francisco.

About You:
We are seeking an enthusiastic electrical engineering student or new graduate to be a part of the iRhythm Electrical Engineering team. You will gain exposure to the testing approach required to release Class 2 compliant hardware in the medical device industry. Your tasks will be to test, analyze, design, evaluate and debug circuits to support exciting additions to our product line. You have excellent technical and documentation skills, approach prototyping and debug with curiosity, interested in automation, appreciate feedback and feel satisfied once you collected data to back up your ideas.

Desired Qualifications
• Pursuing a PhD or Master’s or Bachelor's degree in biomedical, mechanical, electrical, or a similar engineering discipline
• Strong EE fundamentals
• Detail-oriented with excellent troubleshooting and critical thinking skills
• Strong understand of analog and digital circuits, with underlying strength in math and physics
• Hands-on lab experience including soldering, data acquisition, lab test equipment: multi-meters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc
• Hands-on experience in prototype bring-up, debugging and functional verification
• Familiarity with schematic and layout tools (Altium a bonus) as well as circuit analysis and simulation tools (SPICE)

jobs.description:
Career-defining. Life-changing. 

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:
Join the team that supports released cardiac monitoring products after launch. Our Lifecycle Engineers ensure quality, reliability, compliance, manufacturability, and business continuity across the product lifecycle. The work connects electrical hardware, embedded firmware, manufacturing test systems, configuration control, verification, failure analysis, and technical documentation and the team focuses on supporting existing products through their lifecycle. As a Lifecycle Engineering Co-Op, you will support execution of changes to our electrical (PCBA design), embedded firmware, and manufacturing tooling software that keep our released medical device products safe, compliant, manufacturable, and reliable. You’ll work closely with our product development team of electrical, embedded firmware, and software engineers to resolve field and factory issues, manage obsolescence, improve yield, and maintain regulatory compliance.

Assignment Details
This is a full-time, six-month Engineering Internship / Cooperative Education (Co-op) assignment for a current student. It offers internship-style learning, mentorship, and meaningful project work, but it is not a traditional summer internship. Candidates must be available for the full January through June 2027 assignment in Orange County.

Responsibilities 
• Prototype and test electrical PCB components integrated with prototype product firmware and/or fixture software
• Support software updates to manufacturing equipment & test systems (fixture software, functional test scripts, ICT/boundary scan integration) to drive improvements to yield, throughput, and reliability.
• Support embedded software development and updates, ensuring compatibility with hardware and compliance with IEC 62304 and cybersecurity requirements.
• Support execution of V&V (unit/integration/system), including test plans, protocols, automated regression suites, and reports compliant with IEC 62304 and internal SOPs.
• Create and maintain engineering drawings, specifications, test methods, protocols, and reports to support design control, manufacturing transfer, and regulatory documentation
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, quality, and regulatory groups to prepare or review product requirements, test methods, test protocols, and test reports.
• Assist with failure analysis of production components, assemblies, and field returns
• Contribute ideas that may support future product improvements or intellectual property
• Perform lab equipment setup/maintenance as necessary

Minimum Qualifications
• Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD degree in Electrical or Computer Science Engineering or related fields
• Basic understanding of PCBA design principles, embedded systems, embedded software development (C/C++), and hardware/software integration.
• Familiar with lab test equipment and comfortable being hands-on in a lab environment (supporting fixture builds, following test protocols)
• Detail-oriented with excellent troubleshooting and critical thinking skills
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, and a positive attitude
• Comfortable working with minimal supervision
• Values and prioritizes a supportive team environment that enables open-minded and respectful discussion
• Strong working knowledge of MS office 365 tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Ability to understand and modify different programming scripts such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, etc., used for writing automated test scripts and frameworks a plus
• Familiarity with configuration and change control (Git, branching strategies, code reviews, CI; ECR/ECO, traceability) a plus
