jobs.title: Modeling Engineer Intern - Analytics, Simulation Sciences, Mass
jobs.description:
This job requisition is posted for our 2027 internship opportunities!

We are searching for a talented individual to join our development team. We are looking for an intern to work with a diverse team of software engineers and analysts to explore and develop solutions in support of AFRL, NASIC, and other Department of Defense and Intelligence Community projects. The candidate will be expected to evolve an existing Modeling & Simulation frameworks (AFSIM) and its codebase based upon customer needs. We are focused on finding innovative, self-starters who can adapt to a fast-paced, high-profile development effort.

The Modeling, Analytics, and Simulation Sciences Operation is heavily focused on support to the Intelligence Community and DoD through specialized software development and M&S tools and infrastructure. We have a unique blend of analysis and modeling capabilities with an understanding of S&TI missions which enables us to provide the Government with innovative solutions to complex software requirements. We are industry leaders in the Air Force Research Lab’s AFSIM modeling and simulation environment and are heavily involved in the Intelligence Community’s TMAP and ITASE MS&A efforts. This opportunity will give the candidate exposure to a wide array of new technologies to include the latest in modeling & simulation, graphic databases, and user interface design. Our dynamic software development teams work collaboratively to develop models of vehicles, sensors, and complex interactions. We utilize analytical tools to aid in understanding test results and solutions and creating graphical representations to relate findings to decision makers.
 
Radiance Technologies is a rapidly growing employee-owned company with benefits unmatched by most companies in the Dayton area. Employee ownership, generous 401K and profit sharing, health/dental/life/vision insurance benefits, educational reimbursements, competitive salaries, pleasant work environments, and stimulating assignments combine to make Radiance Technologies a great place to work and succeed. 

Required Skills
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or relevant technical degree
• 3.5 GPA or higher. (GPA must be on resume to be considered).
• US citizenship with the ability to obtain a security clearance
• Experience with programming languages such as C++ and Python
• Experience with Microsoft Office tools
 
Desired Qualifications
• Self-motivated and able to work well within a team
• Experience developing physics-based and logical models

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Data Center Silicon Hardware Engineering Intern Co-op - BS
jobs.description:
About Marvell
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

This is an existing vacancy.

Your Team, Your Impact
Join a team developing cutting-edge data center custom silicon (advanced computer chips) that power next-generation AI computing, networking, connectivity, and infrastructure. Working alongside experienced engineers across architecture, design, verification, and physical design, you will contribute to real-world projects while gaining exposure to industry-leading technologies and methodologies. This is an opportunity to learn, grow, and make meaningful contributions in a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive engineering environment.
What You Can Expect
• Work with experienced engineers on the design, implementation, and verification of digital hardware blocks and subsystems.
• Develop RTL, verification environments, test cases, scripts, and automation tools to support semiconductor product development.
• Debug RTL, simulation, and timing issues while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality designs.
• Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools and methodologies, including Verilog/SystemVerilog, UVM, formal verification, synthesis, coverage analysis, and design debug.
• Learn about advanced digital systems and connectivity technologies while building practical skills through real-world engineering projects under the guidance of senior mentors.

What We're Looking For
• Currently pursuing a BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, and enrolled full-time.
• Coursework in digital circuits, Boolean logic, computer architecture, and basic circuit analysis.
• Experience through coursework or projects using programming languages such as C, C++, or Python.
• Experience through coursework or projects involving Verilog, or SystemVerilog
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
• Interest in semiconductor design, verification, and hardware development methodologies.
• Previous internship, research, or project experience in hardware design, verification, or related technical areas is an asset.

Expected Base Pay Range (CAD)
32 - 43, $ per hour.

Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

• Support ad hoc projects and other Commercial Analytics initiatives as needed.

• Experience delivering multiple projects in an academic or professional setting.

• Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager - Product Management
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Product Management
Job Description
About CRFS
CRFS, part of Motorola Solutions, is a world leader in radio frequency (RF) spectrum monitoring, intelligence, and geolocation technology. Our mission-critical solutions empower defence, national security, and regulatory agencies worldwide to detect, identify, and geolocate signals of interest in complex electromagnetic environments. Operating at the cutting edge of spectrum dominance, electronic warfare, and signal intelligence, our RFeye ecosystem combines ruggedized sensors, direction-finding arrays, and advanced software suites.

The Role
We are seeking an ambitious, technically grounded Junior Product Manager to join our Product Management Team. Bridging the gap between engineering capabilities and real-world customer missions, this is not a "pure" product management role; it requires a technical understanding of electronic and RF/communication systems.
In this role, you will work closely with a Senior Product Manager to help drive the lifecycle of our electronic hardware, RF sensor platforms (RFeye Nodes), and embedded system architectures. You will be using our products and tools to run simulations, compile data, explore ideas, and present findings – as well as supporting product improvement activities and helping to solve customer needs.
This is an ideal opportunity for a Graduate Electronics/Systems Engineer or a Junior Systems/Product Specialist with 1–2+ years of industry experience looking to start or develop their career in technical product management within a dynamic, fast-paced technology business.

Key Responsibilities
• Simulations, Testing & Prototyping: Get hands-on with wireless and signal processing product developments. Run simulations, test new hardware, compile data, and explore product concepts to understand system capabilities and limitations.
• Product Evolution & Lifecycle Support: Assist in driving the technical roadmap for RFeye hardware, sensor platforms, and embedded architectures from concept to deployment and end-of-life. Contribute to activities to ensure that RFeye products meet customer requirements.
• Problem Solving: In conjunction with senior product managers, provide support to the sales and business development teams, exploring system configurations and features to meet customer needs.
• Market & Customer Insight: Research competitor products, analyse emerging technologies across RF sensing and Electronic Warfare, and compile market/Voice of Customer (VoC) insights.
• Hands-on Engineering: Be hands-on with wireless and signal processing product developments to understand their capabilities and limitations, with a view to ensuring they are the best they can be.

Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications & Experience
• Education: Degree in Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, RF / Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
• Experience Level:• A keen Graduate with good grades and a strong electronics/radio systems project background, OR
• 1–2+ years of technical experience in RF, telecommunications, defense, or aerospace.

• Technical Aptitude: Understanding of fundamental electronic system architectures, basic RF principles (e.g., frequency bands, signal propagation, dynamic range, noise floor, antennas), and embedded systems.
• Problem-Solving & Commercial Mindset: Analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, with an eye for trade-offs between cost, time-to-market, SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power), and performance.
• Communication and Approach: Good communication skills, both written and verbal. A positive attitude and ability to get things done, whilst being a committed team player. An ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and clients on product requirements and specifications.

Desirable Skills
• Hands-on experience with RF hardware, radio spectrum analyzers, software-defined radios, or wireless communication systems.
• Exposure to defense electronics, SIGINT/COMINT, or spectrum monitoring sectors.
• Understanding of deployable equipment use within a harsh or military environment.
• Sourcing, compiling and analyzing market, voice of customer and competitor information.
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools like Jira.

Travel Requirements
None
Relocation Provided
None

Experienced

No

Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.
By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.
Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus.

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos’ Defense Systems Electrical Systems department is seeking a talented Embedded Firmware Developer to join our team. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group of engineers specializing in advanced hardware-based products. The individual selected for this position will be an embedded design engineer with varied technical interests and demonstrated engineering and leadership skills. The individual must be a self- starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will lead efforts on and develop architectures for embedded systems integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, defensive radars, and space systems.

The selected candidate will be a key technical leader in a fast-paced, environment through all phases of the product life cycle from concept development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. The candidate will be responsible for architecting, implementing, and testing embedded firmware and software on a variety of platforms, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs. Additional skills such as communications data-link design, digital-signal processing (DSP) design, system design, experience with technical trade studies, and evaluation of technology improvements are a plus.

With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and the customer to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. This includes architecture decisions from requirements that help inform and drive hardware implementations and working closely with hardware engineers. Additionally, the engineer will support resolution of technical issues that are discovered during the manufacture and test of deliverable products. This will include troubleshooting board-level issues, assessing failures for root cause, and identifying corrective actions. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos Defense Systems Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Primary Responsibilities
• Key technical leader in a fast-paced, environment.
• Responsible for all phases of the product life cycle from concept development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support.
• Responsible for architecting, implementing, and testing embedded firmware and software on a variety of platforms, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs.
• Additional skills such as communications data-link design, digital-signal processing (DSP) design, system design, experience with technical trade studies, and evaluation of technology improvements are a plus.
• Support resolution of technical issues that are discovered during the manufacture and test of deliverable products.
• Troubleshooting board-level issues, assessing failures for root cause, and identifying corrective actions.

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
• Candidate must have at least 0+ years of experience in embedded system design.
• Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (such as FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures
• Proven experience with programming and/or hardware description languages such as: C, C++, assembly

jobs.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:
Performs a broad range of technical and laboratory activities supporting product development, verification, validation, and sustaining engineering efforts within a regulated R&D environment. Applies technical knowledge and practical experience to execute testing, troubleshoot equipment and systems, and support engineering projects with limited supervision. Works within established procedures and quality system requirements while exercising judgment in selecting appropriate methods and approaches for routine and moderately complex assignments. Serves as a technical resource for less experienced technicians and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives.

Engineering Tech I/II's are also responsible for:

• Performs and supports engineering experiments, product evaluations, and testing activities in accordance with approved protocols and project requirements.
• Collects, analyzes, and documents test data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with quality system requirements.
• Prepares test summaries, reports, and technical documentation to support engineering reviews and project milestones.
• Assists engineers in the development, setup, modification, and validation of test methods, fixtures, and equipment.
• Constructs, configures, operates, and maintains laboratory test equipment, instrumentation, and prototype assemblies.
• Downloads, configures, and verifies software, firmware, and test programs used in engineering and laboratory testing.
• Performs functional testing, fault isolation, root cause investigations, and troubleshooting of electronic, electro-mechanical, and test systems.
• Supports verification and validation activities for new products, design changes, and sustaining engineering projects.
• Reviews test data and identifies trends, anomalies, or failures requiring additional investigation.
• Assists with engineering change orders (ECOs), design documentation updates, and controlled document reviews.
• Maintains accurate laboratory records, equipment logs, calibration records, and preventive maintenance documentation.
• Ensures laboratory equipment and test fixtures remain qualified, operational, and available to support project schedules.
• Performs soldering, rework, repair, and assembly of electronic circuits, PCB assemblies, and prototype hardware.
• Supports investigation, documentation, and resolution of nonconformances and test-related issues.
• Maintains laboratory organization, inventory, and housekeeping in accordance with safety and 5S standards.
• Provides guidance and training to entry-level technicians on laboratory procedures, equipment operation, and best practices.
• Performs all assignments in compliance with company policies, quality system requirements, safety procedures, data integrity standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Other responsibilities as assigned.

Onsite: This position is fully onsite and open to candidates located in San Diego, California. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur onsite. 

Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, and test procedures.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills involving electronic, electro-mechanical, and laboratory systems.
• Knowledge of laboratory practices, data collection methods, and technical documentation requirements.
• Ability to independently perform routine and moderately complex testing activities with minimal supervision.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in a regulated environment.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including documenting technical findings and presenting results.
• Ability to prioritize multiple assignments while meeting project schedules and quality expectations.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Working knowledge of SolidWorks for viewing and reviewing engineering drawings and models.
• Familiarity with statistical analysis tools and data trending techniques preferred.

• Equivalent combination of education, technical training, and relevant work experience will be considered.

• 2 years experience in an engineering, R&D, laboratory, manufacturing, or regulated technical environment.

• Experience supporting product development, verification, validation, manufacturing, or sustaining engineering activities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Metrology Systems
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Metrology Division in Milpitas, California!

In this role, you will contribute to the development of next-generation metrology systems by designing and delivering high-performance software solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across multiple disciplines and geographies to create innovative products that accelerate technology development and improve customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop software for next-generation metrology tools and platforms.
• Create and enhance software emulation tools to accelerate product development, testing, and validation.
• Analyze requirements and translate them into robust software designs and implementations.
• Develop, test, debug, and deliver high-quality software features throughout the product lifecycle.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including systems, hardware, algorithm, and applications engineers located in the U.S. and internationally.
• Contribute to software architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support performance optimization, troubleshooting, and maintenance of complex software systems.

Required Qualifications

• Programming experience in C# and C++.
• Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design and Programming (OOD/OOP) principles.
• Experience developing multithreaded applications.
• Experience with WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation) GUI development.
• Knowledge of image processing concepts and techniques.
• Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, global engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing scientific, engineering, or instrumentation software.
• Familiarity with software architecture and design patterns.
• Experience working with complex distributed or real-time systems.
• Knowledge of semiconductor equipment, metrology, inspection, or imaging systems.
• Experience with automated testing and software quality practices.

Minimum Qualifications
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
Agency:
PHd

Job Function:
Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction: 
Data Science and AI

Job Description:
PHD Media: Senior Director, Data Science 

PHD is a global communications planning and media buying agency network delivering smart strategic thinking and creative innovation for the world’s leading brands.  Brilliant media thinking is in our DNA.  A culture of thought-leadership, creativity and innovation has seen us grow from a challenger agency in the UK, to a global leader with over 6,000 employees in over 100 offices worldwide.  We combine the latest industry insight with the best creative minds to produce planning innovation and create award-winning work for some of the world’s largest advertisers.  Finding a better way is our ethos and sums up how we approach everything – from a new client brief to the way we work.   

At PHD, we provide our clients with powerful and innovative media strategies, along with big ideas that are driven by insights. PHD Data Scientists deliver analytic solutions across a wide variety of client applications and help brands to connect better with the customers. They process and integrate big data in data clean rooms from media advertising platforms including the first party and the third-party data and support business insights and growth solutions.    

Our data scientists build advanced predictive models utilizing machine learning and advanced statistic. PHD data scientists leverage data to address various types of marketing challenges such as audience creation, segmentation, identifying audience journey, optimization, digital attribution, customer retention, customer behavior prediction, and cross channel customer experience.   

Role Overview:   

We are currently seeking a Senior Director to join our Data Science team. The ideal candidate will be a data science leader with the responsibility of managing expectations of internal and external stakeholders, performing predictive modeling and data queries across a multitude of platforms in Advertising and Marketing Technology domains.   

You will develop compelling actionable insights through quantitative analysis, innovative thinking, and storytelling with data. You will contribute to the delivery of smart marketing and strategic advice through the combination of data & insights gleaned through statistical and machine learning models, as well as data mining.   

By applying machine learning and data query methods, you will be a liaison between data and our client’s decision-making process. You will also inform internal and external stakeholders and prospective clients on ways of improving business processes.  

Areas of Responsibility:   

• Maintain a productive relationship with clients at the peer level or higher to ensure they are informed of any new activities or updates to existing projects   

• Participate on multi-disciplinary project teams developing marketing strategies for existing customers, as well as prospective clients   

• Coach and manage the learning path of other Data Science team members by standardizing processes and owning documentation    

• Present complex reporting, models, and dashboards of technical work to both informed and uninformed audiences through data storytelling to support media investment    

• Set up analysis parameters in partnership with Advertiser, Media Strategy and Digital Investment team   

• Build modeling and machine learning capabilities by deploying algorithms on top of our vast number of datasets, e.g., clustering, look-a-like modeling   

• Support Digital Attribution and Advertising Lift models built in data clean rooms    

• Evaluate model performance to determine cut-off points and audience targeting pools for deployment, e.g., lift charts  

• Obtain data from various sources, including but not limited to Amazon storage service S3, Omnicom 3P data partnerships, data clean rooms from walled-gardens, e.g., Google Ads Data Hub, Facebook Advanced Analytics, Amazon Marketing Cloud     

• Deploy scalable solutions to our cloud-based infrastructure to process, visualize and analyze data   

Requirements:   

• 10+ years of experience with predictive modeling, databases, computational simulation, clustering, machine learning, and remote computing in academia or industry   

• 8+ years of industry experience with Python, SQL, R, and other similar statistical computing environments   

• Very strong written and verbal communication skills; thrive in a rapidly evolving environment   

• Ability to clearly explain complex technical ideas to multiple audiences both verbally and in writing    

• Graduate degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering, information management, social sciences or business/marketing related fields    

• Experience working in high volume data bases, utilizing quantitative techniques to solve problems such as campaign analysis, optimization, customer segmentation, and/or predictive modeling (New graduates will also be considered depending on their educational background and academic record)    

• Strong command of statistical techniques and concepts    

• Strong attention to detail   

• A strong desire to learn and passion for digital marketing, research and analytics    

• Ability to work well with others and work in cross functional teams    

• Ability to manage and prioritize a number of concurrent tasks in a fast-paced environment

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, vacation days, sick days, personal days, paid parental leave, paid medical leave, and STD/LTD insurance benefits.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer Intern - Summer 2027 (USA) , Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
jobs.description:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. 

Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) is hiring Software Development Engineers to build mission-critical cloud services in secure, air-gapped environments supporting national security customers with distributed systems work with real-world impact.

The ADC SDE organization designs, develops, and operates cloud services within secure, air-gapped environments. Engineers in this space solve complex distributed systems challenges while delivering reliable, scalable infrastructure to government and defense customers. The work directly supports the mission of protecting national interests through innovative cloud technology.

The team builds and maintains tooling and automation that enables Region Reliability Operations to scale across US Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) regions, supporting top ADC priorities, contractual commitments, and operational excellence.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I interns, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
________________________

By applying to this position, your application will be considered for Summer 2027 internship roles. All intern roles require in-person work and are 12 weeks in duration, starting in May/June and ending in August. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in the United States.

Please note that the majority of our internships are in the Summer of 2027 and applicants will be processed based on business needs.

During the application process, you will be given the opportunity to select a preference or interest in other seasonal start dates. Please note that placement in a non-summer season is not guaranteed and is subject to availability.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

We will take your location preferences into consideration. Preferences are based on business availability and are not guaranteed. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in the United States including but not limited to: 

Locations:

-Arlington, VA
-Jessup, MD
-Seattle, WA
-Denver, CO
***Locations are subject to change***

During your application, you will have the opportunity to highlight your expertise in one or more of these specialized areas:

• Machine Learning • Distributed Systems and Data Management • Database Systems • Quantum Computing • Network Development • Query Processing and Optimization • Automated Reasoning • Embedded Systems • Data Engineering • Mobile Development • Game Development • Computer Science

While team placement is based on business needs, sharing your specific skills and interests helps us better align your experience with potential roles.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward. 
• Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation
• Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team. 
• Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness, including for AI-generated code.
• Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation. 
• Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output and when not to
• Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns, including AI-assisted. 
• Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties. 
• Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues. 

A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career. 

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

 As a summer intern, you will join a 12-16 week program in our Santa Monica office. You will work on a combination of team sprint tasks and a specific project. This role focuses on building high-performance code, considering technical trade-offs, and iterating on solutions. You will have the opportunity to specialize in Big Data, Full Stack, or Machine Learning to help prepare for a full-time career.

 Write, test, instrument, and deploy code with strong test coverage. 
 Use modern abstractions and frameworks within our Kubernetes environment. 
 Develop a clear understanding of our business, industry, and internal systems. 
 Contribute to the innovation and evolution of our product.

 Current enrollment in a full-time Computer Science degree program or a related technical field. 
 An expected graduation date between December 2027 and November 2028. 
 A foundation in software engineering through previous internships or equivalent practical experience. 
 Fluency in at least one general purpose programming language, such as Python or Java. 
 An interest in specializing in Big Data, Full Stack, or Machine Learning. 
 Ability to work in-person at our Santa Monica office for the summer. 
 Preferred skills include fluency in multiple languages, experience with relational and non-relational databases, and exposure to client-side frameworks like React. 
 
 Location & details 
 
 Location: Santa Monica, California.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
Qumulo is a software-defined cloud data platform. Our core is a distributed storage operating system in C & Rust, holding exabytes in the datacenter, at the edge, and natively in the cloud. Qumulo serves everything from a hospital's medical imaging archive to an animation studio's render farm in an environment where 99% correct doesn’t cut it.

About the Role:

Joining us, you'd learn and work across our distributed storage engine and the services that help customers store, manage, and protect their data, under the guidance of experienced senior engineers.

This includes a fault-tolerant block layer that erasure-codes and distributes data beneath the file system, a transactional file system where aggregates roll up as they change so a query across billions of files answers in real time instead of walking a tree, and that same machinery drives quotas, capacity trends, snapshot policy, multiple access protocols, plus replication and backup - all running in userspace.

All of which makes Qumulo a distributed operating system problem: scheduling, memory hierarchy, protection, and concurrency. We're AI-forward and specific about what that means. You will learn to use agents to help write code while developing your engineering judgment to ensure every design decision is correct, because nothing ships that isn't right.

Why join Qumulo:

Qumulo blends the flexibility of a startup with the security of a mature and profitable organization. Here you’ll work closely with a small team of smart, capable engineers who will serve as your mentors. Opinions are expected, disagreement is normal, and you'll get hands-on experience taking projects from ideation to release. We value quality, correctness, and performance. Our architecture, protocols, and patents are public, so you can read how most of this works before you talk to us - and we’re small enough that the work you do will actually show up in the product.

As a Software Engineer at Qumulo, you will:

 - Collaborate with team members on design, code reviews, and pair programming to deliver high-quality software.

 - Collaborate with team members and area leads on architecture and design of new/updated features.

 - Contribute to full-lifecycle feature development and testing using C, Rust, and Python.

 - Take ownership of defining and implementing customer-facing features and internal system improvements.

 - Help debug, troubleshoot, and fix test failures and complex product or service issues in production environments.

What we're looking for:

 - Recently graduated (or graduating within the next 9 months) with a degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Ability to write well-factored, maintainable, and well-tested code.

 - Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures, with solid academic or project experience in distributed systems, database concepts, concurrent programming, or operating systems concepts.

 - Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, Java, or Go demonstrated through classes, internships, or personal projects

 - Willingness to work collaboratively with a team to solve complex problems and learn quickly on the job.

 - Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our downtown Seattle HQ

Must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or transfer. This role is hybrid, based at our downtown Seattle HQ, targeting 3 days a week in-office.

The salary range for this role is USD $110,000 - $140,000 annual base salary plus pre-IPO stock options and benefits. Individual compensation depends on factors such as role level, relevant experience, and skill set.

Benefits & Perks:

 - Pre-IPO stock options

 - Flexible time-off policy

 - HSA and PPO health insurance options

 - Dental and Vision insurance

 - 401(k) plan

 - Choice of an ORCA card or parking subsidy



About Qumulo:
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.

Our Values: 
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Qumulo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law. All of which makes Qumulo a distributed operating system problem: scheduling, memory hierarchy, protection, and concurrency. We're AI-forward and specific about what that means. You will learn to use agents to help write code while developing your engineering judgment to ensure every design decision is correct, because nothing ships that isn't right.

Why intern at Qumulo:

Qumulo blends the flexibility of a startup with the security of a mature and profitable organization. Here you’ll work closely with a small team of smart, capable engineers who will serve as your mentors. Opinions are expected, disagreement is normal, and you'll get hands-on experience taking projects from ideation to release. We value quality, correctness, and performance. Our architecture, protocols, and patents are public, so you can read how most of this works before you talk to us - and we’re small enough that the work you do during your internship will actually show up in the product.

As a Software Engineering Intern at Qumulo, you will:

 - Collaborate with team members on design, code reviews, and pair programming

 - Collaborate with team members and area leads on architecture and design of new/updated features

 - Work directly with a team on core product features; not on a siloed intern project

 - Contribute to feature development and testing using C, Rust and Python

 - Define and implement customer-facing features and internal improvements

 - Help debug and fix test failures and product or service issues

What we're looking for:

 - Ability to write well-factored and well-tested code

 - Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures, with some experience in distributed systems, database concepts, concurrent programming, or operating systems concepts

 - At least one class, internship or personal project using C, C++, Rust, Java, or Go

 - Willingness to work collaboratively with a team to solve complex problems

 - Ability to reside in Seattle for the duration of your internship

 - Pursuing a BS or BA in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or equivalent experience, available for a full-time internship during Winter, Spring, or Summer 2027

Must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or transfer. This role is hybrid, based at our downtown Seattle HQ, targeting 3 days a week in-office.

The base pay for this intern role is USD $100,000 annual base salary (prorated to $1,900 per week for the duration of your internship), plus relocation, travel, and local transit support as applicable.

Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. jobs.title: Robotics Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Robotics Engineering Intern
San Francisco · Onsite · Internship

About Bracket Bot

We believe planet earth can thrive and be alive. Robots should manufacture goods, clean roadways, tidy our rooms, build more homes, cook healthy food, and lower the cost of living. We aren’t quite there yet, robots are too expensive, too difficult to program, fragile, and unfriendly. Bracket Bot is changing that.

We believe that robots are currently in the ENIAC era and we are bringing them to the Macbook era. We believe in high performance engineering teams where everyone you work with is what you imagined Bell Labs employees to be like. Intelligent, scrappy, dedicated, kind.

At Bracket Bot, we have a few objectives. We are working to make the ideal role model of a company, one where everyone is at the top of their field, inventing new ways to solve the problems we face across mechanical, electrical, software, and machine learning. What does a company that creates entirely new ways that teams work together look like? A company that invents new materials for lighter weight actuators and structures? A company that creates and publishes new inverse kinematics algorithms for robots? A company that is thinking radically differently, and executing on another level.

In every field there are small teams who did something their peers had decided was impossible. The 10-second barrier in sprinting, or the eight engineers who left Motorola and made the 6502 for 10x lower cost than other chips at the time making the personal computer possible. SpaceX has landed the same rocket 36 times. Bracket Bot believes actuated, alive machines can be glorious, affordable, easy to use, and ubiquitous, and we are pulling that future forward.

Our products are a mirror of what we think about the world, on engineering & research, and what we think should be introduced into the world. In history, there are simply products that should exist, and only once created, are obvious in hindsight. Bracket Bot’s mission is to introduce as many of these products into the world as possible. We believe there are hundreds of these in the space of robotics. Across physical robot hardware, software and operating system; the infrastructure and distributed systems they connect to; the AI inference they run, both local and cloud, and so much more.

Our first product, Bracket Bot 1, exemplifies what a small team of highly talented people can do. At Bracket Bot, we genuinely believe 100x engineers exist, and a room full of them can create things that dozens of other companies have failed to do. We’ve brought to market a robot that is 10x lower cost than any other robot in its category, while out performing them on manipulation, autonomous navigation, speech interaction, and developer UX.

We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged.

About the role

Robotics brings mechanical systems, electronics, software, and machine learning together. The fastest way to learn is to build, test, and debug the whole system.

We’re hiring a Robotics Engineering Intern to contribute to hands-on engineering projects with the Bracket Bot team. You’ll help build and improve robots, investigate failures, and take scoped projects from an idea to a tested result.

Your work will draw on your strengths while giving you exposure to the other disciplines that make a robot work.

What you’ll do

 - Build, integrate, and test robot hardware or software with the engineering team.

 - Help reproduce failures, collect useful measurements, and debug system behavior.

 - Develop prototypes, tools, or tests that support robot development.

 - Document results and communicate what worked, what failed, and what to try next.

 - Own a scoped engineering project through implementation and verification.

What we’re looking for

 - Hands-on engineering projects that show curiosity and follow-through.

 - A foundation in mechanical, electrical, software, or robotics engineering.

 - Willingness to build, measure, debug, and learn unfamiliar systems.

 - Clear communication and the ability to ask useful questions.

 - Care for the quality of your work and enthusiasm for physical robots.

Nice to have

 - Personal, university, lab, or competition robotics projects.

 - Experience with CAD, electronics, programming, or practical fabrication.

 - Experience building test tools or documenting technical projects.

Important notes

 - This is a hands-on internship based onsite in San Francisco.

 - We value evidence of things you’ve built and problems you’ve worked through.

 - You’ll collaborate closely with engineers on real robot development.

Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.description:
We are deploying machine learning directly onto custom hardware – and we want you to help drive it forward. This PhD internship is an opportunity to work on research that has direct impact on IMC's work tackling open problems at the frontier of low-latency ML inference and hardware acceleration.

You'll work alongside IMC engineers in one of the most demanding low-latency computing environments in the world. You'll own a focused research project from start to finish, present your findings to the team, and leave behind a prototype or benchmark that we can build on.

Your Core Responsibilities 

• Architect and develop an ML focused research project based on real-world use cases

• Work hands-on with hardware engineers to implement, verify, and deploy ML inference solutions

• Track and evaluate emerging research in neural architecture search, machine learning systems and quantization methods, and determine what translates to measurable improvements in our systems

• Present your project to the team, deepening our collective understanding of an area of ML acceleration

• Gain hardware design fundamentals from skilled RTL developers and learn how they apply to our industry

• Build skills to evaluate research not only from an academic perspective, but through real-world performance constraints, engineering costs, and industry impact

Your Skills and Experience

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field

• Solid understanding of hardware constraints and design trade-offs (e.g., pipelining, resource utilization, fixed-point arithmetic) that shape how ML models can be efficiently mapped onto FPGAs or custom ASICs

• Experience with hardware fundamentals, whether through VHDL/SystemVerilog development, HLS tools, or ML-to-hardware frameworks like hls4ml, FINN, or Vitis AI

• Understanding of machine learning fundamentals – neural network architectures, inference optimization, quantization techniques, ML frameworks such as PyTorch/TensorFlow

• Proficiency in Python or similar languages for tooling, testing, and simulation

• Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across disciplines with both technical and non-technical teams

jobs.description:
About Vital Lyfe

Vital Lyfe is a tech company redefining water autonomy through innovation, creating a new category of personal water making technology built to scale where infrastructure can’t.

 

The Mission
We're looking for a Software Engineering Intern to help build the software behind a high-demand consumer hardware product. We're spinning up manufacturing from scratch, scaling fast, and the software you work on will directly affect how we build, track, and deliver thousands of units.

You'll work alongside senior engineers on the tools, data systems, and infrastructure that power our operations and help us scale.

What You'll Do
• Build and improve internal tools that give our engineering and operations teams real-time visibility into production and manufacturing workflows
• Write integrations and scripts that connect systems and keep data reliable across the company
• Design and maintain dashboards that help teams understand operational data and make better decisions
• Assist with backend and cloud infrastructure work as we continue scaling our services
• Debug issues, write tests, and ship improvements alongside senior engineers

What We're Looking For
• Strong programming fundamentals and comfort learning new systems quickly
• Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Python or TypeScript
• Interest in software that supports real-world products and operations
• Familiarity with APIs, web applications, or cloud-based systems
• Practical and curious, with a habit of taking ownership and following through
• Able to break down a problem, work through it, and know when to ask for help
• Excited to work in a fast-paced environment where software and hardware intersect

• Experience supporting or contributing to live backend systems
• Background in building user-facing interfaces with React or a similar frontend framework

• Interest in manufacturing, hardware-software integration, or IoT systems

• Work on high-impact problems with global relevance
• Contribute to technology addressing water security and climate resilience

Ethicon Surgical Technologies offers a broad range of products, platforms, and technologies—including sutures, surgical staplers, advanced energy, robotic surgery, clip appliers, trocars and synthetic mesh devices—that are used in a wide variety of minimally invasive and open surgical procedures. Ethicon Surgical Technologies combines products and services of two market leading legacy companies, both with long histories of medical innovation. jobs.description:
GreatAmerica is a highly successful entrepreneurial company providing equipment financing to businesses across the United States. Our exemplary customer service, our principle-centered business philosophy and our team-based operating approach are key to our success and growth. We have also recently become a bank!

Position Summary

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work full time during the summer and part time during the academic school year breaks. The part-time scheduling portion of the Internship is very flexible, allowing for the Intern to match their school schedule with GreatAmerica’s workplace needs.

The Intern will complete the onboard training process and other appropriate onsite training classes. The Intern will be part of the Data Governance team and will be given the opportunity to work directly with our internal GreatAmerica Users. During that time the Intern will be getting hands on experience with multiple aspects of Data Governance. This includes but is not limited to: working with data artifacts and data artifact users, creating documentation, and supporting the implementation of the governance tooling. An ideal Intern for this role would excel in an evolving environment focused on initiating and maturing data governance processes and tooling.

Essential Functions

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Founded in 1939, Neuberger is a private, independent, employee-owned investment manager. From offices in 40 cities worldwide, the firm manages $567 billion in client assets (as of March, 2026) across a range of strategies—including equity, fixed income, quantitative and multi-asset class, private equity and hedge funds—on behalf of institutions, advisors and individual investors globally.

We are seeking a highly motivated Summer Quantitative Analyst to join in New York. The Summer Quant position will focus on Quantitative Analysis, Portfolio Analysis & Modeling to provide quantitative research, analysis and support to the Institutional Solutions, and Risk businesses. The internship will be 12 weeks in length, including six-week rotations across each of two businesses for broad exposure to quantitative careers within the asset management industry.

Responsibilities:

• Conduct generalist quantitative research using demonstrable market knowledge and intuition across multiple asset classes, including fixed income and equity markets globally, as well as alternative asset classes. Research will be academic and buy-side oriented.
• Solve real world portfolio management problems in a largely autonomous fashion while collaborating with team members.
• Translate academic and/or buy-side research into theses that are implementable and actionable.
• Conduct statistical analysis and develop sophisticated quantitative financial models used for asset allocation and security selection.
• Perform portfolio optimization, performance and attribution analysis, and portfolio risk (coherent measures) analysis.
• Build financial models to perform back tests on asset allocation and security selection strategies.
• Stay connected and current with academic finance research and developments and present findings to team members.
• Prepare materials for presentations.
• Help on daily portfolio management tasks in the areas of cash management, risk reporting and performance attribution.

Qualifications:

• Master’s degree candidates are encouraged in Financial Mathematics or related quantitative field or foreign equivalent.
• Qualified undergraduates in Finance, Mathematics or related STEM field considered.
• Expected graduates in December 2027 or Spring 2028 only.
• Strong statistical, econometrics and applied mathematics grounding.
• Knowledge of fixed income and equity markets.
• Passion for investing.
• Experience developing quantitative models to evaluate the expected return and risk associated with portfolio management decisions is a plus.
• Programming experience required; specific experience in Python, R, and SQL preferred.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

About Us
A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

Job Description:
Job Title: Electrical Component Engineering Intern
Rail Pass Type: Internship/Co-op (Full-time/Hybrid) 
Departure and Arrival Date (Start -End): January 2027 to August 2027 (8months). An earlier start date prior to January 2027 is preferred.
Vacancy: 1
Location: 100 Consilium Place, Scarborough, ON M1H 3E3 
Work hours/week: 40 
Pay Details: $23-$30 CAD hourly 

Stations on Your Journey:      
 
Welcome and Onboarding Station   
• Intern Orientation    
• Online Onboarding Curriculum 
• Buddy Program for mentorship and guidance   

Hands-On Work Station   
• Real-world projects with top industry talent  
• Paid internship + paid vacation  
• Hybrid work model   
• A chance to build your career with a global leader driving digital transformation and innovation that helps support sustainable future 

Networking Station       
• “Ask Me Anything” with the Executive Committee     
• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)   
• Social Intern Events: Coffee Breaks, Onsite/Offsite events 
• Business Intern Events: Intern Showcase & Graduation ceremony 
• Company Social Events: Holiday Party, Employee BBQs, Golf tournament, etc. 

About This Opportunity 

To provide support in managing the component database, creation of new part numbers, REACH and RoHS component compliance and part obsolescence analysis along with supporting hardware design in researching, identifying alternate component solutions and as required testing alternate solutions. 

Key Accountabilities 

In this position, you will be able to see the processes utilized when developing products in an engineering environment, which will vastly improve your understanding of key component characteristics and their application in electrical designs. Your technical and database development skills will help us reduce the number of technical issues raised by our contract manufacturers and improve communication flow.
• Alternate/multi-source Electrical, Electronic, Electromechanical (EEE) & mechanical components 
• Standardization of components and maintenance of the component database (AMPL) in SAP and Windchill
• Work in conjunction with Industrialization, Localization, Procurement, Suppliers and Subcontractors to identify and resolve EOL (end-of-life) issues and for new/alternate components
• Prepare complete component specifications for all component families
• Streamline information transfer to our contract manufacturers
• Work with Product HSE team to ensure compliance

Key Requirements

• The successful candidate should be working toward an Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Engineering Science, or Engineering Physics degree.
• Completion of the third year of an undergraduate degree
• Co-op student available for an 8-month term, with at least one additional quarter or semester of coursework remaining after the completion of the internship.
• Strong written and oral communication skills and familiarity with a project-based work environment.
• Knowledge of key electrical/electronic component characteristics (e.g., transistors, resistors, capacitors, Zener diodes, rectifier diodes, digital logic, LEDs, etc.).
• Understanding of mechanical component specifications and drawings.
• Awareness of HSE requirements (e.g., RoHS, REACH, fire/smoke/toxicity standards, shock/vibration, etc.).
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
• Ability to understand the “big picture” and apply critical thinking to resolve issues.
• Strong attention to detail and curiosity to understand the importance and impact of assigned activities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
• The ability to work 40 hours per week for the full duration of the internship is required. During the first two weeks, the intern is expected to be onsite five days a week.
• Please upload an unofficial transcript along with your resume as part of your application.

Preferred Qualifications 

• Previous co-op/internship experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Direct Marketing Data Assistant - Student Wage
jobs.description:
***** Federal Work Study Students Only*****

This position will remain open for applications for up to 30 days from the posting date. However, please note that the position may be filled before the 30-day period ends if a suitable candidate is selected. Interested applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close early once the hiring process is complete.

Overview:
University Annual Giving in the Office of Engagement is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated work study student employee to join our Direct Marketing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong, practical Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data cleanup, and an interest in supporting initiatives that enhance donor engagement and campaign performance. We offer a congenial, remote-first learning environment and welcome the opportunity to employ talented University of Virginia students who want to learn more about data-driven marketing strategies within the fundraising and higher education sectors.

Perform specialized office support functions or services that require some training, skill, or experience. Duties include providing customer service and specific information, data entry and use of standard office software programs & systems, work within established guidelines and policies. Limited supervision is provided; ability to perform a wide range of duties.

Key Responsibilities:
• Build, clean, and maintain large donor and campaign datasets in Excel, including use of pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, conditional formatting, and formulas to organize audience segments for direct mail, email, social media, and text campaigns.
• Set up and manage Excel-based A/B testing worksheets, including splitting audience lists, tracking test variables, and summarizing results for campaign review.
• Build and maintain audience segmentation queries in Snowflake for direct mail, email, social media, and text campaigns.
• Assist in data validation for campaigns, including verifying donor records within Salesforce Ascend.
• Investigate and troubleshoot data issues by analyzing query logic and applying problem-solving skills.
• Document query logic and maintain clear workflows for repeatable processes.

Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
• Strong, hands-on Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookup functions, and data formatting for large datasets.
• Solid understanding of relational database concepts and ability to write SQL queries involving joins, CTEs, and conditional filtering.
• Comfortable troubleshooting query results and explaining logic clearly.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks independently.

Eligibility:
Applicants must be a current UVA undergraduate or graduate student eligible for student employment and work study. This posting is for 2026-27 academic school year.

A resume and one academic reference is required to apply.
Rate of pay

$19.50/hour for up to 20 hours a week; a minimum of 10 hours a week. Fully-remote.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Resume and one academic reference required. 

Education: Current UVA student. Federal Work-Study eligible
Experience: None
Licensure: None

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is primarily a sedentary job involving extensive use of desktop computers. The job does occasionally require traveling some distance to attend meetings, and programs.

The University of Virginia is an equal opportunity employer. All interested persons are encouraged to apply, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. Learn more about UVA’s commitment to non-discrimination and equal opportunity employment.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
Are you ready for what’s next? 

Come explore opportunities within Brunswick, a global marine leader committed to challenging conventions and innovating next-generation technologies that transform experiences on the water and beyond. Brunswick believes “Next Never Rests™,” and we offer a variety of exciting careers and growth opportunities within united teams defining the future of marine recreation. 

Mercury Marine- Fond Du Lac, WI- Mercury Marine: Data Analytics Co-Op

Location: Plant 3- Fond Du Lac, Wi
Workplace Category: Onsite
Travel Required: Local only
Direct Reports: No
Visa Sponsorship: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. 
Relocation: Yes

Innovation is the heart of Brunswick. See how your contributions will help transform vision into reality:

Position Overview:

As part of the talented Customer Experience (CX) Data Analytics team, you will support a wide range of data engineering, analytics, and research initiatives that drive decision-making across Mercury Marine. This role offers exposure to the full data lifecycle—from building pipelines to uncovering insights in rich telemetric datasets—and the opportunity to present your findings to stakeholders across the organization.

At Brunswick, we have passion for our work and a distinct ability to deliver.

Essential Functions: 

• Build and maintain data processing and enrichment pipelines using Microsoft Fabric/Synapse
• Explore and analyze telemetric datasets to discover actionable insights that support engineering, manufacturing, and CX teams
• Respond to ad-hoc data requests to support and facilitate day-to-day business decisions
• Apply statistical methods and research techniques to solve analytical problems
• Present findings and recommendations to team members and stakeholders through reports and presentations

Diversity of thought and experiences is fundamental when imagining the unimaginable. Certain skillsets/experiences are necessary; however, others can be developed along the way.

Required Qualifications
• Currently in the final year of an undergraduate or graduate program in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field (completing coursework or nearing graduation)
• Foundational skills in statistics, programming, database querying, and data visualization
• Exposure to AI concepts such as building agents, prompt engineering, or machine learning workflows
• Eagerness to deepen expertise in one or more of these areas through hands-on project work

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar cloud data platforms
• Coursework or projects involving time-series, IoT, or telemetric data
• Comfortable communicating technical findings to non-technical audiences
• Experience building or maintaining agentic AI workflows

Working Conditions
• Learning Opportunities: Our Student Program is designed to provide hands-on experience in a professional setting. You will work alongside experienced professionals and get a chance to apply your academic knowledge to real-world tasks.
• Project Work: The work environment is supportive, collaborative, and conducive to learning. Student co-ops or interns typically work on specific projects or tasks that contribute to the organization's goals. This may range from supporting larger projects to handling smaller, individual assignments.
• Hours: Co-ops and Interns are expected to work 20–40 hours per week, depending on student availability and workload.
• Feedback and Performance Reviews: As a co-op or intern, you will receive feedback and performance reviews throughout your assignment. We value the importance for interns to understand their progress and areas for improvement.

The pay range for this position is $18.00-27.50 per hour. The actual hourly rate offered will vary depending on multiple factors including year in school/credits earned, degree, job-related knowledge/skills, relevant experience, business needs, and geographic location. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the specifics of the candidate’s qualifications and the business context.

Why Brunswick: 
Whatever tomorrow brings, we’ll be at the leading edge. As the clear leader in the marine industry, we’re committed to our values and supporting our exceptional people. We offer and encourage growth opportunities within and across our many brands. In addition, we’re proud of being recognized for making a splash with numerous awards! 

About Mercury Marine
Mercury Marine is a world leading manufacturer of marine propulsion systems. A $2.6 billion division of Brunswick Corporation (NYSE: BC), Mercury designs, manufactures and distributes engines, services and parts for recreational, commercial and government marine applications, empowering boaters with products that are easy to use, extremely reliable and backed by the most dedicated customer support in the world with 10,000 service points globally. Mercury’s industry-leading brand portfolio includes Mercury outboard engines; Mercury MerCruiser sterndrive and inboard packages; Mercury global parts and accessories including propellers, and SmartCraft electronics; Power Products Integrated Solutions; MotorGuide trolling motors; Attwood, Garelick and Whale marine parts; Land ’N’ Sea, BLA, Payne’s Marine, Kellogg Marine & Lankhorst Taselaar marine parts distribution; and Mercury and Quicksilver parts and oils. More information is available at mercurymarine.com.

Next is Now! 

We value growth and development, recognizing that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying.

Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is key to innovation and inspiration and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
