jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern - Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
Collinear's Internship program is designed for PhD students who are eligible to do a 12-week internship. Start dates are flexible and can be extended. 



As an MTS - Research Scientist (Applied Scientist), you will help build the data engine for frontier AI. You will develop the high-fidelity environments and evaluation stacks that the world’s leading AI labs rely on to stress-test their most advanced agents. You will work across domains including Computer Use, Enterprise MCP/Toolcalling and Coding. Verifier Design, Simulated Personas, Benchmarking Personal AGI are some of the research areas we work on.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build Agentic Environments: Design and implement the next generation of "SimLabs", ultra-realistic, long-horizon simulation environments where agents learn to navigate ambiguity and maintain context.

 - Programmatic and Agentic Verification: Develop rigorous, policy-aware judges and evaluations that measure genuine capability and safety beyond simple benchmarks.

 - Close the Loop: Design and execute high-quality post-training runs (CPT, SFT, RL) to deliver frontier performance on open-source models using curated, high-signal data.

 - Collaborate: Work daily with the founders and research staff to shape the roadmap and push the state-of-the-art in AI reliability.

 - Create. Work on analyzing model failure modes and creating frontier data pipelines which scale with test-time compute.
   


ABOUT YOU

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate a rare combination of technical depth, research intuition, and high agency.

 - Technical Foundation: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in a technical field (CS, Math, Physics, etc.), or a demonstrated "proof of work" through significant open-source contributions or industry experience.

 - Engineering Rigor: A strong foundation in software engineering with the ability to build robust, scalable infrastructure. You should be comfortable in a Python-friendly, CLI-first development environment.

 - ML Fluency: A principled understanding of foundation models, including how they are constructed, evaluated, and optimized.

 - Empirical Mindset: Experience conducting research or technical experiments with a focus on reproducibility and data-driven results.
   


WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT

 - Research Taste: You have a strong intuition for identifying what matters in complex problem spaces. You can balance deep research exploration with the pragmatism needed to ship a product.

 - Impact-Driven Agency: You care about outcomes, not just activity. You don't wait for a ticket; you identify gaps in the system, build the solution, and ensure it moves real-world metrics for frontier AI labs.

jobs.title: PhD Intern, Data Science (2027)
locations: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma’s Data Science team partners across product, engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to help Figma make better decisions with data. As a PhD Data Science Intern, you’ll bring rigorous research training to some of Figma’s most important and open-ended questions, from researching emerging product and user behaviors and Figma’s broader ecosystem to developing new measurement methodologies, applying causal inference or machine learning, and building analytical systems. You’ll own a data science project end-to-end: from framing the question and methodology to translating findings into insights that influence Figma’s products, strategy, or data science practices; with the potential to continue toward publication after the internship.

This internship will be based out of our San Francisco or New York hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

• Partner with cross-functional teams to turn ambiguous product, platform, or business questions into well-defined data science problems

• Analyze user, product, or business data to uncover insights and recommend actions

• Design and evaluate experiments, metrics, statistical or machine learning models, and analytical frameworks

• Communicate assumptions, tradeoffs, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners

• Own a focused internship project end-to-end, from problem framing and technical execution through final recommendations, with potential to continue toward publication after the internship

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Currently pursuing a PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Economics, Operations Research, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; with demonstrated experience conducting independent research (e.g. thesis or equivalent research milestone)

• Demonstrated fluency in one or more research methodologies or technical areas, such as statistics, experimentation, machine learning, causal inference, econometrics, optimization, user research methods, or AI/LLMs

• Experience using a scripting language such as Python or R, as well as proficiency with SQL, for analysis, modeling, or work with complex or large-scale datasets through research, internships, or applied projects

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and connect analysis to decisions, recommendations, or product/business impact

• A curious, rigorous, and self-starting mindset, with the ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and translate research into real-world impact

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

• Prior industry or applied research experience with experimental design, causal inference, forecasting, product measurement, user research, or applied machine learning to influence product, business, platform, or stakeholder decisions

• Publications or research relevant to applied data science

• Experience or interest in AI product measurement, LLM analytics/evaluation, recommendation systems, search, personalization, or evaluating AI-powered features

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

This internship role is based in either Figma’s San Francisco or New York hub offices, and has the hourly base pay rate stated below. Figma also offers interns a housing stipend and travel reimbursement. Figma’s compensation and benefits are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Internship
$68—$68 USD

jobs.description:
We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.

From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.

As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high-impact research - designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm.

Take the next step in your career.

The role

Dates: 28th June 2027 - 17th September 2027
Working hours: 09:00 - 17:30

We are looking for exceptional students to join us for a 12-week summer internship within our world-class technology teams.

These functions are central to our engineering efforts. As an intern you will work across a range of platforms that support our quantitative research. You will contribute to the development, enhancement and modernisation of the systems that underpin our business, gaining valuable experience with both legacy and cutting-edge technologies.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will write production-level code, collaborate with experienced software engineers and contribute to high-impact projects from day one.

Key responsibilities of the role include:

• Designing and delivering high-quality, maintainable code to work with large and complex datasets
• Supporting and evolving production platforms and research tools
• Partnering with quantitative researchers to understand and improve data quality and value
• Developing and optimising database queries and the underlying infrastructure
• Enhancing internal tools and data processing pipelines used at scale

As part of your internship, you will receive a structured onboarding experience and be paired with a dedicated mentor. Your mentor will be an experienced engineer who will guide your learning and development.

In addition to on-the-job training, you will gain access to internal technical and professional development courses, alongside opportunities to increase your financial domain knowledge.

Who are we looking for?

We’re seeking sharp, curious and pragmatic software engineers who are eager to work at the intersection of finance and technology.

The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience:

• Studying towards a 2:1 or above in Computer Science or a closely related discipline
• Graduating in 2028 and currently in their penultimate year
• Experience in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as C#, Java or C++
• Strong understanding of core computer science concepts, such as algorithms, data structures and systems architecture
• An interest in how engineering supports quantitative research and complex systems at scale
• A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving with sound judgement
• A proactive approach to improving code, systems and ways of working
• Clear communicate skills across technical and non-technical teams
• A collaborative mindset with a willingness to share ideas, feedback and knowledge

Why join us?
 
• Highly competitive compensation
• Lunch provided (via Just Eat for Business) and dedicated barista bar
• 30 days’ annual leave pro rata
• 9% company pension contributions
• Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance
• Opt-in private health insurance
• Monthly company events
• Centrally located office (close to five stations and six tube lines)

jobs.title: DRAM Technology Physical Design and Block-Level PPA Optimization Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Design Technology Co-Optimization (DTCO) team works at the intersection of process technology, standard cell architecture, and design implementation to optimize power, performance, and area (PPA) for advanced memory products. The team collaborates closely with standard cell library, RTL, and physical design engineers to evaluate design tradeoffs and develop methodologies that improve silicon outcomes.

As a DTCO Intern, you will gain hands-on experience assessing and optimizing PPA at the standard cell and logic block level. You will use industry-standard place-and-route tools and AI-enabled automation techniques to implement, benchmark, and optimize logic blocks while developing practical skills in physical design, timing closure, and design analysis.

Responsibilities
• Implement standard cell logic blocks using industry-standard physical design tools, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, and optimization activities focused on PPA assessment.
• Analyze and benchmark power, performance, and area across standard cell libraries and logic block configurations, identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Perform static timing analysis (STA), investigate setup and hold timing violations, and support timing closure activities.
• Execute physical verification checks, including DRC, LVS, and IR-drop analysis, and assist with resolving design issues.
• Leverage Generative AI, AI Assistants, and Agentic AI solutions to automate data collection, reporting, comparison, and workflow optimization for PPA analysis.

Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Demonstrated understanding of VLSI design concepts, CMOS circuits, digital logic, and the ASIC physical design flow.
• Experience through coursework, research, or projects using scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or TCL.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills with attention to technical detail.
• Expected graduation date of Fall 2025 or later.

Preferred Qualifications
• Hands-on academic, research, or project experience with place-and-route tools such as Synopsys ICC2, Cadence Innovus, or equivalent tools.
• Exposure to static timing analysis tools such as PrimeTime, Tempus, or similar timing verification platforms.
• Working knowledge of design constraints (SDC), LEF/DEF formats, and physical implementation methodologies.
• Understanding of low-power design techniques and power intent standards such as UPF or CPF.
• Experience applying AI, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI-Assisted coding and automation tools to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Financial Operations Analyst Intern will support Cambridge’s Service Experience team by using data analysis and process review to identify opportunities that improve financial professional and client service experiences. Interns will gain exposure to teams across Cambridge, learn how a broker-dealer operates, and contribute practical recommendations and solutions that help streamline the department’s work.
Key Deliverables and Responsibilities
• Complete data analysis projects focused on pain points in financial professional and client service experiences.
• Review and map current process flows to identify inefficiencies, service gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
• Propose and, when appropriate, implement solutions that streamline processes and improve the team’s use of data.
• Work within a collaborative project structure, taking ownership of assigned analysis while partnering with colleagues across teams.
• Use data from NetX, Wealthscape, Compass, TalkDesk, SharePoint, Excel, and Microsoft Copilot to review processes and develop insights.
• Use Power BI or other data analytics tools as needed to analyze and process relevant data sets.

What We Are Looking For
• Current undergraduate student pursuing Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• Experience with data analysis and process mapping.
• Ability to examine information, identify patterns or pain points, and translate findings into practical solutions.
• Strong problem-solving, organization, communication, and collaboration skills.
• Comfort working with Excel and an interest in learning business systems and analytics tools.
• Initiative and confidence to propose solutions and contribute within a collaborative project environment.
• Financial services industry knowledge is not required.

Program Summary: Cambridge’s Next Step 11-week paid summer internship program (May 17 – July 30) gives students the opportunity to gain valuable insight into both their chosen field and the financial service industry while working on meaningful projects that contribute to business outcomes. Each intern is partnered with a professional mentor and participates in our professional development program, which includes industry education, career workshops, leadership panels, and networking events. Nearly 30% of interns return to Cambridge as full-time associates.
 
Location: All internships are on-site, operating out of our Phoenix, AZ or Fairfield, IA offices. Apartment-style housing is available for Fairfield candidates, and some positions may be eligible to work out of our West Des Moines satellite office.
 
Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to accommodate temporary student work authorizations, including initial Curricular Practical Training (CPT) and Optional Practical Training (OPT).
 
Posting Window: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in November. Internships are expected to remain posted until January 15, but may close earlier if filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply early for greatest consideration.
 
Compensation: $17-$26 per hour depending upon location, role, and year in school. Interns also receive 2 paid holidays and 2 days of paid time off across the summer.

Why Cambridge?
Cambridge has competitive benefits and promotes a work/life balance to encourage individual success.  
• Premium benefit package including medical, vision, dental, life and long-term disability insurance 
• Vacation/sick time 
• 401K retirement plan with company matching program 
• Eleven paid holidays 
 
You can find more details about our comprehensive benefits package here.

Cambridge Overview: 
Cambridge is a financial solutions firm that provides business support services to thousands of independent financial advisors. These advisors offer personalized investment services including wealth management, financial planning, and retirement services to individuals and families across the country. Cambridge provides significant compliance, technology, and transaction processing support to these financial advisors and their offices.

(English follows) 
 
C-GE-416 – Stagiaire développeur(se) C++ CGF Unreal 
 
Vous êtes un passionné dans votre domaine? Vous recherchez un milieu de travail où vous pourrez innover, vous dépasser et collaborer avec des experts provenant de secteurs variés? Vous aimeriez vous joindre à une entreprise d’envergure mondiale, qui est un chef de file dans son domaine, et dont vous seriez fier de contribuer aux projets? Venez partager votre passion avec nous! 
 
Le rôle que nous vous proposons : 
 
En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de de développer des solutions pour les forces générées par ordinateurs (CGF) à travers « Unreal ». En tant que membre de l’environnement immersif, vous participerez au développement et à l’intégration de composants logiciels offrant aux pilotes un environnement de simulation d’un réalisme inégalé. Notre département est responsable des solutions d’affichage, du contenu et du rendu visuel, de la génération des effets sonores et des mouvements du simulateur, ainsi que du développement de l’intelligence artificielle des autres « joueurs » dans les scénarios de simulation militaire. Le logiciel auquel vous contribuerez sera déployé sur des simulateurs de vol qui contribueront à la formation de plusieurs pilotes, partout à travers le monde. 
 
Êtes-vous prêt à : 
 
• Travailler en collaboration avec une équipe hautement technique d'experts de l'industrie dans le rendu de simulation de vol. 
• Développer la prochaine génération d'effets de simulation de vol. 
• Apprendre et évoluer dans le monde hautement technologique des systèmes visuels et des simulateurs de vol. 
• Utilisez les derniers logiciels et matériels de technologie de jeu et travailler principalement dans un environnement de développement C ++ Windows sous Visual Studio. 
 
Le candidat idéal que nous recherchons possède: 
 
• Bonne connaissance du développement orienté objet en C ++, sous Windows. 
• Connaissance avancée en physique et dynamique. 
• Bonne connaissance du développement de jeux dans le moteur "Unreal" est un plus. 
• Bonne connaissance des outils de développement assistés par l’IA, notamment GitHub Copilot et Microsoft Copilot, avec une expérience pratique de leur intégration dans les flux de travail de programmation.

L’emplacement du stage est à Montréal. 
 
Le stage sera réalisé en mode hybride 
 
*Tous les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada et se conformer aux exigences relatives au Programme des marchandises contrôlées du Canada (PMC). Toutes les personnes embauchées seront tenues de remplir, signer et retourner le formulaire du programme des marchandises contrôlées dans la semaine suivant l’envoi. Ils devront également fournir une copie de leur passeport ou de leur certificat de naissance. *Veuillez prendre note que si vous détenez un permis d’études, de travail ou d’étudiant international, les délais de vérification de sécurité peuvent prendre un minimum de 16 semaines.

jobs.title: Client Co-op - ASIC IP
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Opportunity: 4 month work term, starting January 2027
 
Join the ASIC IP team and contribute to the design and verification of client protocol mapping IP used in Ciena's WaveLogic coherent engine chipsets. This role provides hands-on exposure to digital ASIC development, verification methodologies, prototype development, automation, and optical networking technologies. The position offers opportunities to build technical experience while contributing to defined engineering deliverables.

How you will make an impact:
• Design and verify digital blocks, cores, and subsystems for ASIC products and FPGA-based validation.
• Collaborate with design and verification engineers on client subsystem and core development activities.
• Implement digital designs using SystemVerilog, Verilog, and VHDL.
• Verify digital designs using SystemVerilog and UVM methodologies.
• Develop and enhance prototype and development automation solutions.
• Apply communications standards knowledge, including IEEE 802.3, ITU, and OIF specifications, within development activities.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
looking for a Data Analytics Intern who is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. This is a hands-on opportunity to work with real-world data, collaborate with experienced analysts, and make an impact from day one. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. We combine advanced engineering, data science, and clinical expertise to improve patient outcomes and drive operational efficiency. Our devices and solutions generate vast amounts of data—from real-time clinical usage to field performance—and we’re looking for someone who can transform that data into actionable insights that support better care delivery and smarter decision-making.

Job Description
As our Data Analytics Intern, you’ll work on real-world projects that impact how we service devices, support clinicians, and improve patient care. This intern will be motivated, have a positive attitude and be able to function on a team in a fast-paced environment. They should have the ability to self-manage with minimal supervision, to run multiple projects and to provide timely updates. Attention to detail and desire to produce quality work is always required.

The Data Analytics Intern will also work to:

• Build interactive Power BI dashboards to visualize device performance, service metrics, and clinical trends.
• Analyze data from SQL Server, Excel, and cloud platforms to uncover patterns and drive decisions.
• Collaborate with field ops managers, clinical engineers, and data scientists to define KPIs and reporting needs.
• Automate reporting workflows using Power Automate and Power Apps.
• Present insights to cross-functional teams and contribute to strategic discussions.
• Apply AI models to identify patterns in service logs and device usage that signal inefficiencies or potential failures.
• Develop predictive tools to optimize technician dispatching, reduce downtime, and improve service response times.
• Support the team in ad-hoc data projects and process improvements.

 Basic Qualifications
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Experience with data warehousing, data preparation, or data gateways
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Business Intelligence Stack (Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, and SSIS), including DAX, Power Query, and dashboard design.
• Understanding of JavaScript, CSS, SQL, and other JavaScript libraries
• Strong understanding of data visualization, predictive analytics, and machine learning basics.
• Proficiency in Python, R, SQL.
• Experience with biomedical data, image processing, or web apps preferred.

Desired Characteristics
• Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to break down complex problems into smaller, manageable parts.
• Attention to Detail: Accuracy in data handling and interpretation.
• Curiosity: Asking the right questions to uncover insights from data.

• Real-world experience in a regulated, high-impact industry.

jobs.title: Digital IC Design Intern - BS
jobs.description:
About Marvell 
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell’s Digital IC (or Digital Logic) Design teams span across multiple domains, giving you the opportunity to work on technologies that power next-generation cloud, AI, storage, and networking solutions. Some teams are responsible for the design and verification of high-performance Ethernet PHY chips. Other teams shape the micro-architecture of the blocks, accelerators and subsystems that make up a system-on-chip (SoC). Across all groups, you’ll collaborate with your direct team and cross-functional partners (across architecture, physical design, design verification, and more) to deliver robust, scalable solutions that enable Marvell’s leadership in data infrastructure.
What You Can Expect
• Deep dive into the digital design and implementation of real chip design efforts
• Develop and verify detailed, high-performance RTL design blocks and apply the digital design specifications for high-speed connectivity devices and next-generation chips
• Conduct synthesis, static timing analysis, timing signoff, and power analysis
• Debug design issues and ensure functional correctness 
• Investigate & execute new design techniques & flows, and explore emerging methodologies to improve design quality, efficiency, & productivity
• Collaborate with chip architecture, design verification, & physical design teams to solve complex problems and contribute to a team building real products

What We're Looking For
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028 
• Completed courses focusing on circuit design, circuit theory, digital logic design, static timing analysis, computer architecture, Verilog, VLSI, digital signal processing (DSP), SoC/ASIC design, or electronics 
• Proficiency in programming & scripting languages like Python, Perl, Tcl 
• Experience using tools like Synopsys (Primetime), Cadence (Virtuoso & Spectre X), and Mentor 
• Hands-on experience with RTL design and a firm understanding on how it integrates into the overall ASIC design flow 
• Strong analysis, problem solving, and communication skills 

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)
30 - 59, $ per hour.
The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements 
Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity 
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. jobs.description:
About Marvell 
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell’s Digital IC (or Digital Logic) Design teams span across multiple domains, giving you the opportunity to work on technologies that power next-generation cloud, AI, storage, and networking solutions. Some teams are responsible for the design and verification of high-performance Ethernet PHY chips. Other teams shape the micro-architecture of the blocks, accelerators and subsystems that make up a system-on-chip (SoC). Across all groups, you’ll collaborate with your direct team and cross-functional partners (across architecture, physical design, design verification, and more) to deliver robust, scalable solutions that enable Marvell’s leadership in data infrastructure.

• Debug design issues and ensure functional correctness
• Investigate & execute new design techniques & flows, and explore emerging methodologies to improve design quality, efficiency, & productivity
• Collaborate with chip architecture, design verification, & physical design teams to solve complex problems and contribute to a team building real products

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028
• Completed courses focusing on circuit design, circuit theory, digital logic design, static timing analysis, computer architecture, Verilog, VLSI, digital signal processing (DSP), SoC/ASIC design, or electronics
• Proficiency in programming & scripting languages like Python, Perl, Tcl

jobs.title: Robot Perception
jobs.description:
Who we are
With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe: Summer (May-Aug 2027) 

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment. 

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements. 

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! 

About the Opportunities 

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision. 

• Perception and Computer Vision interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. 

• SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale. 

What you’ll do 

• Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos. 

• Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data. 

• Deploy software to production on robot hardware. 

• Design data pre and post processing methods. 

• Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations. 

• Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics software. 

• Adapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems. 

• Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms. 

• Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues. 

What you’ll need 

• Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. 

• Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks. 

• Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 

• Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration. 

• Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference. 

• Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL. 

• Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools. 

• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake. 

• Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus. 

What’s good to have 

• Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

• Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. 

• The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

jobs.title: Research and Development PhD Intern
jobs.description:
Job Location
MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR
Job Description
Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!

The Opportunity:
P&G has an opportunity for a PhD intern to work in our Corporate R&D to develop an AI-agent-driven framework that automates and accelerates machine learning experimentation for time-series data modeling. The intern will explore how AI agents can propose and execute experiments, modify configurations or code, analyze results, and recommend next steps. This work will investigate improvements in data preprocessing, model architecture, training strategies, and hyperparameter selection while comparing AI-driven research with conventional experimentation in terms of model performance, reproducibility, and research efficiency.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong eagerness to learn and grow professionally and possess excellent communication skills—both written and verbal. This role is perfect for those with passion for innovation and problem-solving, along with a proactive attitude and the ability to adapt to new challenges. Join us in this dynamic environment, where your contributions will make a real impact as part of a collaborative team!

Key Responsibilities:
• Review existing literature and techniques in LLM-based AI agents, automated machine learning, and AI-enabled research systems.
• Prepare time-series datasets and establish a reliable, reproducible baseline model and evaluation pipeline.
• Design and implement an AI-agent-driven framework for proposing, executing, and analyzing machine learning experiments.
• Explore improvements in data preprocessing, feature representation, model architecture, training strategies, and hyperparameter selection.
• Implement appropriate validation, experiment-tracking, and reproducibility practices for AI-generated configurations or code.
• Compare AI-enabled and conventional experimentation approaches based on model performance, reproducibility, experiment throughput, and research efficiency.
• Document the framework, experiments, results, limitations, and recommendations.
• Share key insights and present final results to the broader R&D team.

Job Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

NVIDIA has pioneered programmable GPUs and the CUDA language, and this visionary Research team will take those technologies to the next level with its creative ideas and new inventions. This position offers you the opportunity to have a real impact while working with some of the most creative and forward-thinking people in the world who are here at this dynamic, technology-focused company.  

What you'll be doing:  
• Develop algorithms and design hardware and software, extending the state of the art in computing, networking, and other technology areas surrounding NVIDIA's business.  
• Invent new techniques, technologies, methodologies, processes, and devices, to enable new products or types of products. Deliverable results include prototypes, patents, and publications. 
• Contribute to research that informs NVIDIA's technology direction 5-10 years out. Work focuses on long-horizon problems rather than products currently shipping or in development, except as to how they can be extended and improved.  
• Projects can include but are not limited to: optimizing communication stacks for AI training and inference, designing network protocols and congestion control, co-designing AI systems across software and hardware, developing circuits and microarchitecture for network controllers and switches, and architecting networks built on optical switching and silicon photonics. 

What we need to see:  
• Pursuing a PhD degree in CS, CE, EE, Physics, Math, or equivalent program. 
• Relevant industry or university research experience (hardware, software, networking). 
• Background in networking architectures, topologies, routing, and system design. 
• Publications at top-tier conferences (ISCA, HPCA, NSDI, SIGCOMM, etc.), or research clearly on track toward them. 
• Hands-on experience with simulation of networks and high-performance computing systems. 
• Familiarity with inference and training systems for AI models and associated communication patterns. 
• Excellent programming skills in a rapid prototyping environment such as Python; C++ and parallel programming. 
• Experience building or using AI agents to accelerate research — automating experiments, analyzing results, or generating and reviewing code. 

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA is an industry leader with groundbreaking developments in High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great research talent to help us accelerate the next wave of computing!

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD.

jobs.description:

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Term: Summer (May-Aug 2027) 

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment. 

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements. 

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! 

What you’ll do 

• Brainstorm with engineers on cross-functional teams to conceptualize and develop real-time high-performance software to control and schedule fleets of mobile robots. 

• Apply best practices to the design of data structures and algorithms. Strive for both simplicity and performance. 

• Produce high-quality software contributing to projects that have a significant impact on the business. 

• Simulate robot behavior using internal simulation tools during feature development. 

• Develop path planning algorithms for manipulation and robot navigation. 

• Design, develop, and implement localization algorithms for mobile robots. 

• Define metrics for localization quality in the field. 

• Work broadly across teams to facilitate integration of localization sensors on robots and develop offline pipelines that improve the quality of localization. 

• Support system testing of systems and subsystems. 

• Provide technical support for manufacturing as needed. 

• Troubleshoot system problems in production or design by investigating issues related to product performance or production difficulties. 

• Evaluate and process engineering change requests. 

What you’ll need 

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering or related field. 

• Experience with event driven architectures, messaging systems and protocols such as RabbitMQ. 

• Experience with general-purpose programming environments, languages and scripting systems, data analysis packages: Linux, C++, Python, Matlab. 

• Knowledge of Git, Jira, and Confluence or similar tools. 

• Familiarity with DevOps or CI/CD – GitHub automation and docker or Jenkins. 

• Experience with libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, ROS, Boost, Eigen. 

• Hands on experience with embedded systems and platforms like Arduino, STM32, ESP32 or Raspberry Pi. Integrating sensors, motors and actuators using CAN, SPI, I2C. 

• Preferred experience with either of the following: path planning algorithms, motion control (including open- and closed-loop feedback systems). 

• You are interested in working in a dynamic Agile/Scrum based environment. 

• You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms. 

Our Environment 

• Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.

jobs.title: PhD Research Intern
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking outstanding Research Interns to join the Data-Driven AI for Robotics (DAIR) group. The focus is on learning embodied skills from large-scale human data. Our objective is to develop AI systems that capture, understand, and reproduce complex human motion and interaction skills across physical and digital embodiments, including humanoid robots and animated characters.

Our research spans the full stack: reconstructing human motion and human-object interactions from video; generating diverse, controllable character behaviors; transferring motion across embodiments; and training physically grounded controllers for humanoid robots and interactive virtual characters.

You will collaborate with a passionate and supportive research team that consistently produces influential work published at leading computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics conferences. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with world-class research and product teams across NVIDIA, following our strong “one-team” culture.

What you'll be doing:
• Innovate and implement novel AI algorithms that transform large-scale human data into controllable motion and interaction skills across physical and digital embodiments.
• Develop robust, scalable training and inference pipelines for motion reconstruction, generation, retargeting, and character and robot control.
• Build methods that transfer human skills to humanoid robots, including whole-body loco-manipulation and dexterous manipulation.
• Maintain a close, collaborative relationship with your mentor(s).
• Publish your research findings at leading computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics conferences.
• Partner with product teams to enable effective technology transfer of your work.

Research Topics Include:
• Human motion and human-object interaction reconstruction, synthesis, and generation.
• Learning character and robot skills from video, motion-capture, and teleoperation data.
• Cross-embodiment motion generation, retargeting, and tracking.
• Whole-body humanoid control, loco-manipulation, and dexterous manipulation.
• Reinforcement learning and imitation learning.
• Differentiable physics simulation and physically grounded motion generation.
• World action models, vision-language-action models, video and motion foundation models, and LLM-based agents for data generation and embodied AI.

What we need to see:
• Pursuing a PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
• Highly efficient and creative use of coding agents to accelerate research prototyping, experimentation, and development.
• Outstanding engineering skills in rapid prototyping and developing model-training and simulation frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo).
• Excellent skills in working with large-scale machine learning/AI systems and compute infrastructure.
• A promising research track record with at least one publication at leading computer vision, computer graphics or robotics conference (e.g. CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.).
• Experience in human motion modeling, human-object interaction, character animation, robot learning, reinforcement or imitation learning, cross-embodiment motion tracking, generative modeling, video understanding, or differentiable physics simulation is preferred.
 
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and productive people in the world. Job Description Summary

Job Description
Job Description Summary:
We are looking for a curious, collaborative, and highly motivated Data Science Co-op to join our SaaS team. This is an opportunity for students who want to strengthen both their technical skills and business acumen while working on meaningful projects that influence real product and customer outcomes.

As a Data Science Co-op, you will partner with teammates across data science, software engineering, product, and business functions to help solve problems using data. You will contribute to projects that improve product performance, customer experience, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision making. Along the way, you will learn from experienced professionals, build your network, and gain hands-on exposure to how data science supports growth in a SaaS environment.

This co-op is designed to provide practical experience, professional development, mentorship, and the opportunity to build skills that can support future full-time roles in data science, analytics, software, or related technical functions.

Essential Responsibilities:
In this role, you may:
• Analyze product and business data to identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities. 
• Build and improve dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help teams make informed decisions. 
• Support development of data models and machine learning solutions for use cases such as customer behavior analysis, forecasting, segmentation, recommendation, or operational optimization. 
• Work with large datasets from product usage, customer interactions, sales, support, and other business systems. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, customer success, and operations to translate business questions into analytical approaches. 
• Assist with data cleaning, feature engineering, validation, and exploratory analysis to improve data quality and model performance.
• Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through presentations, summaries, and visual storytelling. 
• Contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks, including A/B testing, KPI tracking, and performance analysis.
• Document methods, assumptions, and results so work is reproducible, understandable, and actionable. 
• Participate in team learning, mentoring, and professional development opportunities while gaining exposure to SaaS product and business operations.

Requirements:
• Currently enrolled in an Associate’s, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree program at an accredited university or in a credentialed technical training program; majors accepted are: Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Informatics, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, or another relevant STEM field
• Experience with data analysis, statistics, programming, or software/data projects through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects
• Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale, without rounding
• Willing to work in Austin, TX
• Reliable transportation, many of our sites do not have public transportation available

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen. Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

• Data analysis and visualization tools such as pandas, Jupyter, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
• Statistics and modeling techniques including regression, classification, clustering, or hypothesis testing
• Data wrangling and exploratory analysis
• Cloud, analytics, or SaaS data environments through coursework or projects

We are especially interested in candidates who are:
• Analytical and able to approach ambiguous problems with structured thinking
• Personable and comfortable collaborating across technical and non-technical teams
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail
• Curious learners who are eager to grow technically and professionally
• Self-motivated and able to manage tasks in a fast-paced environment

• Adaptable and excited to work on evolving priorities and business needs

Pay rates for this position begin at $24/hour and increase for each undergraduate year completed. Relocation support and housing assistance is available for those who relocate to a new city.

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Board Product Engineering team's core mission is to develop and implement effective board manufacturing strategies that support the needs of Marvell's various Business Units (BUs).

Marvell is seeking a motivated Summer Intern – Board Product Engineering to support board-level product engineering activities during the summer internship program. This role provides hands-on exposure to new product introduction, board assembly, manufacturing test, supplier coordination, and product readiness activities for advanced hardware products.
What You Can Expect
The intern will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to help track engineering builds, collect and analyze manufacturing data, document issues, support readiness reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement activities. This summer internship is intended for students who want practical experience in hardware product engineering and manufacturing operations.
• Support board-level product engineering activities for prototype and pre-production hardware builds.

• Assist with tracking engineering build milestones, action items, risks, and readiness status.

• Help collect, organize, and summarize data from board assembly, inspection, manufacturing test, and validation activities.

• Support documentation of build issues, failure symptoms, corrective actions, and lessons learned.

• Work with hardware design, operations, test engineering, quality, reliability, and supply chain teams to support NPI execution.

• How board-level hardware products move from prototype builds into manufacturing readiness.

• How engineering, operations, quality, reliability, and supply chain teams work together during new product introduction.

• How to organize build data, track issues, summarize technical findings, and communicate status to engineering teams.

• How manufacturing test, validation, and failure analysis activities support product readiness.

How to contribute to engineering documentation, lessons learned, and continuous improvement efforts in a real product development environment

jobs.description:
About Marvell 
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Test Operations Group supports the Test, Product Engineering and Production groups activities. Our primary function is to maintains various types of test equipment used on the test floor to develop, debug and process devices ranging from Carrier, Automotive, Enterprise and Data Center product lines. Interfacing with vendors from various manufactures including Advantest, Teradyne, Cohu, HonPrec, Seiko-Epson, Delta, Chroma, TEL, Semics.
What You Can Expect
Duties & Responsibilities:
• Responsible for helping to maintain Advantest 93K and Teradyne Uflex testers and related hardware (Boards Sockets device kits).
• Provide tester, handler and prober and hardware support to Test, Product Engineering and Production Teams.
• Work with the Field Service Engineers from the various manufactures to diagnose, troubleshoot and repair the handlers and prober systems.
• Perform hardware and software upgrades as needed.
• Help to input and track request for new hardware request from the Product, Test and Production teams as well as to provide a solution to the current process.
• Work with vendors to obtain quotes for replace and spare parts.
• Work with other team members to resolve test equipment issues.
• Assist in performing calibration and Preventive Maintenance as needed
• Work to help drive future improvements to Marvell’s Test floor environment.
• Must be willing to work in a multi-tasking, fast pace, team oriented working environment.
• This is a full-time onsite position.

What We're Looking For

• Working towards Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related fields.
• Basic understanding of hardware products, printed circuit boards, electronic manufacturing.
• Ability to organize technical information, summarize data and communicate clearly
• Comfortable working in a team environment and learning from team members across multiple disciplines.
• Basic PC skills with Microsoft office suite.
• Coursework or project experience related to the design and repair of electronics, circuits, electromechanical systems, manufacturing is preferred. 
• Knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Linux operating and networking skills and inventory control systems is a plus.
• Internships in the semiconductor field is a plus

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)
22 - 44, $ per hour.
The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:
• CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday. 

• CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

• If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS
This position requires you to have received a work-study award. To verify if you have received a work-study award, please consult the Financial Aid Award Summary area in your LionPATH account. A Federal Work Study award does not guarantee a job is available. 
 
The Science Department at Penn State York is seeking a motivated undergraduate student majoring in a science or engineering program to join our research team for the 2026-2027 Academic Year. As an Undergraduate Research Assistant, you will collaborate with the principal investigator and fellow team members on research projects focusing on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for image processing applications. This position offers an opportunity to gain practical coding experience and contribute to cutting-edge artificial intelligence projects. Students may work up to 15 hours per week.

Job Duties
• Data Simulation: Assist in generating and simulating datasets using computational tools and programming environments.
• Data Management: Collect experimental data from open-source repositories and store them according to established laboratory protocols for future research use.
• Data Analysis: Process and analyze experimental data, visualize trends, interpret results, and draw meaningful conclusions.
• Algorithm Implementation: Employ convolutional neural networks to enhance image processing capabilities and develop innovative solutions for challenges in various scientific, engineering, and medical applications.
• Report Compilation: Collaborate with team members to compile research findings into comprehensive formal reports.
• Professional Communication: Develop effective communication skills by presenting research outcomes and actively contributing to project discussions.

Requirements and Qualifications 
• Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student in an engineering or science program at Penn State York with an eligible Work-Study award.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow strict coding and data protocols.
• Eagerness to learn and contribute meaningfully to ongoing research initiatives.
• Excellent teamwork and interpersonal communication skills.
• Familiarity with programming using MATLAB and Python.

The starting hourly rate for this job is $15.00. 
 
Federal Work Study job performance is evaluated either annually or through ongoing mentorship. Students who received a Federal Work Study award have the opportunity to obtain a job and perform related duties either on campus, or remotely, if possible and at the discretion of the employer. Students applying for Federal Work Study positions should clarify expectations with their potential employer regarding either on campus/in person or remote work arrangements.

(English follows) 
 
C-GE-055 – Développeur Logiciel [Système d’exploitation & Configuration] 
 
Vous êtes un passionné dans votre domaine? Vous recherchez un milieu de travail où vous pourrez innover, vous dépasser et collaborer avec des experts provenant de secteurs variés? Vous aimeriez vous joindre à une entreprise d’envergure mondiale, qui est un chef de file dans son domaine, et dont vous seriez fier de contribuer aux projets? Venez partager votre passion avec nous! 
 
Le rôle que nous vous proposons : 
 
En intégrant notre équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de développer et d’intégrer de nouvelles technologies propres à l’infonuagique (« cloud computer ») afin de préparer l’évolution technologique de nos simulateurs de vol. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous veillerez au développement d’une nouvelle expertise en matière d’automatisation des processus au sein de CAE afin d’accélérer notre évolution en tant que puissance de la haute technologie. Plus spécifiquement, vous contribuerez à la mise en place d’environnements virtuels qui permettent la création et la configuration des systèmes d’exploitation utilisés dans notre environnement d’entraînement complet. Êtes-vous prêt à: 
 
• Apprendre et utiliser les nouvelles technologies DevOps et conteneurs afin de développer et déployer des solutions logicielles novatrices. 
• Intégrer de nouvelles solutions de diagnostic, de suivi et de déploiement dans nos produits de simulation. 
• Créer, modifier et harmoniser des scripts ou du code logiciel afin d’automatiser les étapes qui ont ou auront été fait manuellement lors de la preuve de concept. 
• Adapter les interfaces afin de supporter de nouveaux outils et environnements. 
• Chercher des solutions à des problèmes inédits tel que faire fonctionner des pilotes sans interface physique.
• Contribuer à l’évolution de notre culture d’entreprise innovante en haute-technologie. 
 
Le candidat idéal que nous recherchons possède: 
 
• Expérience dans le développement logiciel sur Windows et Linux. 
• Connaissance des outils d’intégration logiciel et de contrôle des sources (Github ou autre). 
• Bon sens de l’organisation et de la planification. 
• Personne dynamique axée sur les résultats ayant un fort esprit d’équipe et un bon sens de l’initiative. 
• Outils d’automatisation tel que MDT, PowerShell, Infrastructure en tant que code/IaC (un atout) 
• Bonnes compétences en communication (à l’oral et à l’écrit). 
• Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite (français et anglais) un atout : La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise pour ce poste, car il implique la participation à des réunions et projets ayant une portée internationale, ainsi que des interactions avec des collègues ou clients situés dans d'autres provinces ou pays.
 
Scolarité souhaitée: 

• En cours d’obtention d’un diplôme d’études universitaires dans le domaine de l’informatique/génie informatique ou tout autre domaine connexe. 
 
L’emplacement du stage est à Montréal. 
 
Le stage sera réalisé en mode hybride. 
 
*Tous les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada et se conformer aux exigences relatives au Programme des marchandises contrôlées du Canada (PMC). Toutes les personnes embauchées seront tenues de remplir, signer et retourner le formulaire du programme des marchandises contrôlées dans la semaine suivant l’envoi. Ils devront également fournir une copie de leur passeport ou de leur certificat de naissance. Tous les étudiants détenant un permis de travail devront en fournir une copie et un certificat de bonne conduite du ou des pays où ils ont résidé au cours des 5 dernières années. 
 
*Veuillez prendre note que si vous détenez un permis d’études, de travail ou d’étudiant international, les délais de vérification de sécurité peuvent prendre un minimum de 16 semaines. 
 
 Pourquoi choisir CAE pour votre stage?
 
• Travaillez dans un environnement de bureau moderne à aire ouverte.
• Contribuez à une variété de projets stimulants au sein d'équipes multidisciplinaires.
• Bénéficiez d'un accompagnement, de coaching et de mentorat tout au long de votre stage.
• Profitez d'opportunités de prolongation de stage et de possibilités d'embauche à la fin de votre parcours.
• Accédez facilement au campus grâce à un arrêt de la STM situé directement sur place.
• Stationnement gratuit pour les voitures et les vélos.
• Participez à une culture active avec un club de course et diverses activités sportives.
• Profitez d'un comptoir lunch offrant une variété de repas et d'options alimentaires.
• Accédez à des vestiaires et à des douches sur place.
• Détendez-vous sur notre terrasse panoramique ouverte durant l'été et l'automne.
 
Chez CAE, vous aurez l'occasion d'acquérir une expérience concrète, de collaborer avec des experts de l'industrie et de contribuer à des projets qui ont un impact réel, tout en développant votre carrière.
 
*Pour tous les stagiaires embauchés, nous rembourserons les frais de stage jusqu'à concurrence de 250 $ par stagiaire sur présentation de pièces justificatives. 
 
Avec plus de 13 000 employés présents dans plus de 40 pays, CAE est un chef de file mondial en formation dans les domaines de l’aviation civile et de la défense et sécurité. Pour en apprendre plus: www.cae.com et CAE Explore: programme de stages / internship program (youtube.com) 
 
CAE remercie tous les candidats pour leur intérêt. Toutefois, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les candidats sélectionnés pour une entrevue. 
 
Énoncé sur l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi 
 
À CAE, tout le monde peut contribuer à notre succès. Sans exception. 
 
Comme le reflète notre valeur principale "Un CAE", nous sommes fiers d’être une seule équipe passionnée, sans frontières et inclusive. 
 
À CAE, tous les employés sont accueillis indépendamment de leur race, de leur nationalité, de leur couleur, de leurs croyances, de leur sexe, de leur identité et de leur expression de genre, de leur orientation sexuelle, de leur handicap, de leur neurodivergence ou de leur âge. 
 
Dans cette offre d’emploi, le masculin générique est utilisé uniquement pour alléger le texte et désigne aussi bien le genre masculin, genre féminin ou diverses identités de genre.

jobs.title: Mixed Signal IP Integration Engineer New Grad
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Join a team focused on the design and integration of custom mixed-signal macros within an ASIC flow for next-generation high-baud-rate optical modems. Work involves advanced nanoscale CMOS technologies that enable high-performance optical and electrical interfaces. The role provides opportunities to contribute to mixed-signal circuit design and IP integration activities in a collaborative engineering environment.

How you will make an impact:
• Utilize knowledge of electronics, mathematics, VLSI design, and computer-aided design tools to solve engineering design challenges.
• Generate representations of mixed-signal blocks for the digital design team, including Verilog, Library Exchange Format, Liberty timing files, documentation, preliminary and final layout files, and SPICE netlists for chip-level LVS as part of IP integration activities.
• Develop understanding of the design and place-and-route of macro-level standard cell interfaces to facilitate analog-digital timing handoff and static timing analysis.
• Contribute to digital integrated circuit design using standard cell libraries and develop design-for-test solutions and models aligned with ASIC test methodologies.

The must haves:
• Education: Completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical or computing engineering.
• Experience: Previous internship, co-op, or applied project experience relevant to the role.
• Analog design principles and experience with schematic capture, layout, extraction, pre- and post-layout analog simulation, design rule checking, and layout versus schematic verification.
• Fully conversant with the custom IC tools from Cadence Design Systems.
• A solid understanding of digital design, including Verilog/RTL, place-and-route, and static timing analysis.
• Prior experience with Cadence Innovus or Synopsys Integrated Circuit Compiler II.

Nice to haves:
• Scripting in Python and Cadence Skill language
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Confident working in both Windows and Linux environments

Pay range:
The salary range for this role is 75,100.00 - 119,900.00

jobs.title: Software Engineer Junior - REST API Development - Officer
jobs.description:
About the Role 
We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our API Engineering team. In this role, you will help design, develop, test, document, and support REST APIs that power business applications, partner integrations, and client-facing services. 

You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, product managers, quality engineers, and platform teams to learn and apply modern software engineering practices while contributing to secure, scalable, and reliable APIs. This position is ideal for an early-career engineer who is eager to grow in backend development, systems integration, and API design, and who enjoys solving technical problems in a collaborative, mentorship-driven environment. 

Key Responsibilities 

API Development 
• Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services under the guidance of senior engineers. 
• Build and maintain reusable components, libraries, and integration services. 
• Help ensure APIs meet performance, reliability, and security requirements. 
• Learn and apply API versioning and lifecycle management practices. 
• Troubleshoot and help resolve API and integration issues across development and testing environments, escalating complex issues as needed. 

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing 
• Create and maintain clear API and integration documentation, including API specifications, developer guides, and usage examples. 
• Document technical work, implementation notes, and lessons learned. 
• Contribute to team knowledge repositories and engineering best practices. 

Integration & Architecture 
• Support the development of integrations between internal systems, external partners, and cloud services. 
• Follow enterprise architecture standards when implementing API solutions. 
• Learn and contribute to microservices and event-driven integration patterns. 
• Assist with API gateway onboarding and basic policy implementation tasks. 

Quality Engineering 
• Write unit, integration, and automated API tests with guidance from senior team members. 
• Participate in peer code reviews and design reviews to learn team standards. 
• Support CI/CD pipeline usage and basic deployment automation tasks. 
• Help identify reliability, performance, and maintainability issues. 

Security & Compliance 
• Learn and apply secure authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0 and JWT. 
• Follow secure coding practices and enterprise security requirements. 
• Support vulnerability remediation activities as directed. 
• Help ensure appropriate logging and monitoring is implemented in the services you build. 

Collaboration 
• Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and engineering planning activities. 
• Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and operations teams. 
• Communicate progress, questions, and technical ideas clearly to teammates and mentors. 
• Seek feedback and apply it to continuously improve technical skills. 

Required Qualifications 

Education 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience, including internships, bootcamps, or personal projects). 

Experience 
• 0-2 years of professional software development experience (internships, co-ops, and academic projects are valued). 
• Some exposure to building or consuming REST APIs, through coursework, internships, or personal projects. 
• Familiarity with at least one backend language/framework such as Java, C#, .NET, or Spring Boot. 
• Basic experience with Git-based source control. 

Technical Skills 
• Basic understanding of REST API principles and HTTP protocols. 
• Familiarity with JSON and API integration concepts. 
• Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL. 
• Foundational knowledge of software design patterns and object-oriented programming. 
• Willingness to learn API security concepts, including OAuth 2.0 and JWT. 
• Exposure to automated testing frameworks (unit testing) is a plus. 
• Interest in or coursework experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. 
• Curiosity about containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
• Eagerness to learn CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 

Preferred Qualifications 
• Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving Microsoft Azure. 
• Exposure to messaging or event-driven concepts (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus). 
• Experience writing basic technical documentation. 
• Familiarity with monitoring/logging concepts. 
• Internship or academic experience in financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries. 

What We Value 
• Strong desire to learn and grow as a software engineer. 
• Analytical and problem-solving mindset. 
• Attention to detail and commitment to writing quality code. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
• Ability to collaborate effectively and accept mentorship in a team environment. 
• Growth mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies. 
• Ownership mindset with the ability to drive assigned tasks to completion with support. 

Core Technologies 
• REST APIs (foundational) 
• Java, Spring Boot, C#, or .NET 
• Git 
• SQL Databases 
• Basic OAuth 2.0 / JWT concepts 

Nice to Have Technologies 
• Microsoft Azure 
• Docker / Kubernetes (exposure) 
• CI/CD Pipelines 
• Kafka or similar messaging platforms 

Desired Traits 
• Strong foundational engineering skills 
• Eagerness to learn cloud-native development 
• Security-aware mindset 
• Good communication and documentation habits 
• Ability to work effectively in Agile teams with mentorship 
• Passion for building reliable software and growing into a stronger engineer 

Role Summary 
This job description is aligned for an entry-level/junior engineer joining an Azure-based REST API platform team. The role emphasizes hands-on learning, mentorship, and gradual ownership of API development, integrations, testing, documentation, and cloud-native application delivery under the guidance of senior engineers.

Rockwell Automation's Leadership Development Program (LDP) is a distinctive 2-year program that produces world-class leaders.
