jobs.title: Business Intelligence Intern
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Howden Re Business Intelligence Summer Internship 

Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one summer internship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered. 

Location: London 

Start date: June 2027 

Salary: £32,500 pro-rata for 10 weeks 

Duration: 10-week programme 

Business Intelligence Summer Internship Programme 

Turn data into insight. Help shape decisions across a global industry. 

Looking for more than just work experience? If you’re curious about trends and financial markets and interested in how this data can influence business decisions, then this could be the perfect way to spend your summer. Join Howden Re's Business Intelligence team and discover how data is transformed into insights that help businesses navigate the global reinsurance market. 

You'll gain hands-on experience analysing real market data, exploring global industry trends, and contributing to reports and tools used by colleagues and clients around the world. Apply if you're naturally curious, analytical, and enjoy solving problems 

The 10-week programme is designed to give you meaningful exposure to the world of reinsurance, while helping you develop the knowledge, professional skills and confidence to kick start your career. 

Better still, our programme offers a direct pathway into our Autumn 2028 graduate roles, subject to business needs and individual performance. 

What you’ll be doing? 

You will begin with a structured induction before joining the Business Intelligence team to work alongside experienced specialists on real client projects. 

During the programme, you'll:

• Learn how to analyse financial and market data to identify trends shaping the global insurance and reinsurance market. 

• Research annual reports and other trusted sources to support business analysis. 

• Help maintain and update Nova, our market insights platform. 

• Validate outputs from automation and AI tools by checking accuracy and identifying anomalies. 

• Create charts, visualisations and supporting evidence for market reports. 

• Contribute to analytical projects that help colleagues and clients make informed decisions. 

Who are we looking for? 

No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know! 

You'll be: 

• In your penultimate year of study from any degree background and interested in a career involving data, research and commercial analysis. 

• Comfortable working with numbers and using data to solve problems. 

• Able to communicate complex data into interesting insights. 

• Able to manage detailed work accurately and consistently. 

• Curious about financial markets and the wider economic trends that shape them. 

• Keen to learn, take initiative and contribute to team projects. 

To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK. 

Application process 

Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know! 

• Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form. 

• Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best! 

• Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting. 

• Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future! 

Why should you apply? 

At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll gain exposure to an exciting global industry, receive structured development throughout the summer and build relationships that could shape your future career. 

You'll also benefit from: 

• £32,500 pro-rata over the 10-weeks. 

• Relocation support may be available for interns who need to relocate to take part in the programme. Support is assessed on a case-by-case basis and subject to eligibility criteria. 

• Opportunity to receive a deferred graduate offer for Autumn 2028. 

• Excellent training and development schemes and accelerated career progression. 

• Access to a buddy to support you throughout your internship. 

• 6 days of leave, fully paid, plus bank holidays. 

• Access to discounted personal health policies as well as a range of insurance products. 

Ready to apply? 

Follow our TikTok pages: @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, and explore our Connectr hub to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you. 

Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one summer internship programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered. 

#RESI2027

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
• Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

• We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

• We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

We are seeking passionate and dynamic Analysts to join our collaborative Financial Engineering team. This role is crafted for individuals who excel in applying analytical and quantitative techniques to solve real-world financial challenges. You will leverage your programming skills, financial acumen and critical thinking to uncover market opportunities and support our institutional clients in executing complex transactions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Technical Development: Use your intermediate coding skills (Python preferred) to design, develop and deliver cutting- edge financial engineering solutions.
• Data-Driven Insights: Deliver actionable analytics by developing robust quantitative solutions tailored for Investment and Client Businesses.
• Collaborative Innovation: Work closely with cross-functional investment and business teams to accelerate strategic initiatives and drive measurable business value.

• Financial markets and investment products
• Quantitative research and modeling

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.

ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.

At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.

Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.
 
About the Role
As a Design Evaluation Engineer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience supporting the evaluation, characterization, and validation of semiconductor products throughout the development lifecycle. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will perform bench testing, analyze measurement data, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to the development of solutions that ensure product performance and quality.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in evaluating, characterizing, and validating semiconductor devices using established test methods and laboratory equipment.
• Support debugging and analysis activities to identify and resolve product performance issues.
• Collect, analyze, and document measurement data, test results, and technical findings.
• Contribute to the development and improvement of evaluation, testing, and automation tools.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Design, Test, Product, Quality, and Applications Engineering.
• Present project findings and provide recommendations based on test and analysis results.

Must Have Skills
• Basic understanding of electrical or computer engineering principles.
• Familiarity with analog and digital circuits, test methods, and laboratory measurements.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to organize, interpret, and communicate technical data effectively.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Eagerness to learn new tools, technologies, and evaluation techniques.

Preferred Education and Experience
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
• Familiarity with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, or similar test instruments.
• Exposure to programming, scripting, or automation tools such as Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, C/C++, or similar technologies.
• Experience with engineering projects, coursework, or research involving testing, data analysis, circuit evaluation, or hardware/software development.
• Interest in semiconductor product development, validation, and characterization.

The NVIDIA Cosmos Platform enables multimodal world understanding, simulation, synthetic data generation, and embodied reasoning. We are looking for outstanding PhD interns to help advance the frontier of Physical AI and world models.

What you’ll be doing:
• Conduct research in generative AI, multimodal foundation models, world models, and embodied AI.

• Develop algorithms for video understanding/generation, action-conditioned simulation, multimodal reasoning, and policy learning.

• Train and evaluate large-scale models using video, image, language, and robotics or autonomous driving data.

• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across AI, robotics, simulation, and graphics teams.

• Publish research at top conferences and transfer innovations into NVIDIA products.

What we need to see:
• Currently pursuing a PhD in CS, EE, Robotics, or related fields.

• Strong background in generative AI, computer vision, multimodal learning, robotics, or reinforcement learning.

• Prior publication record and research experience.

• Strong Python and PyTorch skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Experience with large-scale foundation model training.

• Research in video models, VLMs, world models, robotics, or autonomous driving.

• Experience with distributed training, simulation, or embodied AI.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: HBM SoC Physical Design Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The HBM Physical Design team is responsible for implementing advanced High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) SoC and base die designs that enable next-generation AI, high-performance computing, and data center solutions. The team collaborates across architecture, RTL, verification, DFT, and signoff engineering to deliver high-performance, power-efficient silicon while developing innovative design methodologies and automation solutions.

As an SoC Physical Design Intern on the HBM team, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support the implementation of advanced HBM SoC designs. You will gain hands-on experience with physical design methodologies, timing analysis, signoff flows, and automation while contributing to the development of next-generation memory products that power AI and high-performance computing applications.

Responsibilities
• Support the physical implementation of SoC design blocks, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and physical optimization activities.

• Analyze timing, power, area, congestion, and physical verification results to find opportunities for design improvement and optimization.

• Assist with static timing analysis, timing closure, and debugging across multiple operating modes and process corners.

• Develop and enhance automation tools, scripts, reports, and workflows using Python, Tcl, shell scripting, and AI-assisted solutions.

• Collaborate with multi-functional engineering teams to document results, participate in design reviews, and present technical findings.

Minimum Qualifications
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, coursework, or academic projects in ASIC design, VLSI, digital IC design, computer architecture, or physical design.

• Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Knowledge of ASIC design flow concepts, including synthesis, place-and-route, static timing analysis, and physical verification.

• Understanding of timing fundamentals such as setup/hold analysis, clock skew, timing constraints, and critical path analysis.

• Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Tcl, Perl, and/or Shell.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and large language models (LLMs) such as Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience through coursework, research, or internships with RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows.

• Familiarity with industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence Innovus/Tempus, Synopsys ICC2/PrimeTime, Siemens Calibre, or equivalent platforms.

• Knowledge of multi-mode, multi-corner timing analysis, power intent methodologies, power delivery networks, or IR/EM analysis.

• Understanding of DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, signal integrity, clock tree synthesis, or congestion analysis concepts.

• Experience developing automation solutions, dashboards, or engineering workflows using Python, Tcl, or related scripting languages.

• Interest in HBM, DRAM, advanced packaging, memory-centric SoCs, or high-performance digital design.

jobs.title: Capital Markets Quantitative Technology Services Summer Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

ABOUT RBC CAPITAL MARKETS
RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
We work with clients in over 100 countries to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks. RBC Capital Markets is part of Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), one of the top 15 largest banks globally and fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalization. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
Join our Summer Analyst Program and make a real impact on the future of Capital Markets. You'll work on meaningful projects that shape how we serve clients - from building intelligent trading systems to developing data pipelines that power our decision-making. Alongside experienced technologists, you'll design, develop, and deploy tools that matter.
This isn't a passive learning experience. You'll own real deliverables in a collaborative project team setting, guided by RBC Capital Markets' lead architects and technologists. You'll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge technologies including machine learning, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and algorithmic trading systems. Dedicated mentoring sessions with business-aligned technology leaders will deepen your understanding of how technology drives client value across trading, risk management, and market operations.
Beyond the work itself, you'll network with peers across Capital Markets through social events and skill-building sessions, building relationships that often lead to full-time opportunities.
You'll have the opportunity to contribute to one or more of these areas:
• Architecture – Shape the foundational systems that power modern capital markets
• eTrading & Algorithmic Trading Technology – Work on platforms that execute trades at scale with intelligence and precision
• Commodities & Futures Technology – Apply data science and automation to commodity markets
• Equities Technology – Leverage machine learning to enhance equity trading and market intelligence
• Market Data Operations and Engineering – Build systems that aggregate, process, and deliver critical market data
• Fixed Income & Currencies Technology – Develop analytical tools and trading systems for global markets
• AI & Machine Learning Engineering – Build predictive models, develop recommendation systems, and optimize trading algorithms
WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?
We seek talented individuals with intellectual curiosity, a drive to solve complex problems, and the energy to thrive in a fast-paced environment. You should be confident in your abilities while remaining eager to learn, collaborate, and push boundaries.
Successful candidates will be evaluated on individual merit. We're looking for:
Essential qualifications:
• Entering the final year of a four-year college or university program or enrolled in a relevant master's program (anticipating graduation Winter 2027 or Spring 2028)
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Demonstrated interest in technology, financial markets, or both
• History of academic excellence
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Preferably pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Data Science or Business Analytics
Valuable experience and skills (the more, the better):
• Programming: Python, Java, C#, C/C++, or Scala; familiarity with frameworks like .NET or J2EE
• Data Science & AI: Experience with machine learning libraries, statistical modeling, or predictive analytics
• Data Engineering: SQL and/or NoSQL databases; ETL pipeline development; familiarity with tools like Spark or Kafka
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Software Engineering: Version control (Git), testing frameworks, agile methodologies
• Systems & DevOps: Linux/Unix administration, CI/CD pipelines
• Financial acumen: Understanding of markets, trading concepts, or financial products
• Business Analysis: Requirements gathering and cross-functional collaboration

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
• Hands-on mentorship from experienced technologists and emerging AI practitioners working on real problems
• Exposure to diverse domains within Capital Markets
• Tangible impact – your work directly influences how RBC serves institutional clients
• Career acceleration – Summer Analysts often transition into full-time roles with accelerated progression
• Skill development in high-demand areas including machine learning, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering
• Network within one of the world's leading investment banks
• Culture of innovation where we challenge conventions and embrace emerging technologies

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, think progressively, continue our growth, and deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our individual/collective potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.
From this experience you would gain:
• Direct exposure and hands-on experience including opportunities to do challenging work
• Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
• Opportunity to connect with different Capital Markets businesses
• Ability to work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
• Training including orientation sessions as well as an in-class curriculum and regular information sessions with key business leaders

The good-faith expected salary for the above position is $110,000 annualized depending on factors including but not limited to the candidate’s experience, skills, registration status; market conditions; and business needs. This position is non-exempt and paid at the equivalent hourly rate.
RBC’s compensation philosophy and principles recognize the importance of a highly qualified global workforce and plays a critical role in attracting, engaging, and retaining talent that:
• Drives RBC’s high-performance culture
• Enables collective achievement of our strategic goals
• Generate sustainable shareholder returns and above market shareholder value

jobs.title: Quantitative Trading Summer Analyst - Global Markets
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

RBC Capital Markets
RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors, and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

We work with clients in over 100 countries around the globe to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks.

RBC Capital Markets is part of a leading provider of financial services, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC). Operating since 1869, RBC is one of the top 15 largest banks in the world and the fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalization. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.

Quantitative Trading Summer Program
RBC’s quantitative trading teams are traders who program computers to trade for them. The Quantitative Trading Summer Analyst Program offers an unrivaled opportunity to work in one of these highly technical algorithmic trading groups for the summer, leading to a potential full-time offer. The teams are made up of mathematicians, software engineers, and data scientists who write and manage automated trading strategies. RBC’s strategic objective is to find excellent candidates with a STEM/Computer Science background, hire them onto our platform, and promote the ongoing development of this junior cohort to become leaders in this space.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
As a quant trader, summer analysts can expect to:
• Assist in developing trading strategies, improve the speed of trading systems, and evaluate models and technologies.
• Paper trade in your team’s asset class by working with voice traders to better learn our markets.
• Gain experience for the products your team trades: FX, equities, interest rates, ETFs, etc.
• Become immersed in a comprehensive education program for interns and junior traders/researchers that will develop critical quantitative skills and decision-making capabilities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?
In selecting summer analysts and considering full-time offers, we look for the following:
• Anticipated graduation in Winter 2027 or Spring 2028 at an accredited four-year college or university or master’s program.
• Engaged in study of Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
• Strong programming skills, with experience in python and at least one compiled language (Java or C++).
• Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced and challenging environment.
• The most successful people on our teams apply the following principles:• Be reliable. Product quality code, meet deadlines, follow through on commitments, anticipate and prevent problems.
• Be proactive. Apply even judgement and have the ambition to figure things out on your own.
• Be diligent. Respond strategically to operational issues to instill confidence in our processes.
• Be curious. Continually improve your skills. Take time to deliberately practice new skills and technologies that excite you.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
You should expect the following if you join us:
• Gain a strong sense of ownership and pride for your work—we write code for ourselves, not for customers or a third party.
• Understand what it would be like to have a career in quantitative trading, and work in a leading algo trading team.
• Learn about high-frequency markets, how to write high-performance code, and how mathematics and statistics get applied in a trading business.
• Learn how a professional electronic trading team manages the complexity of their stack and their market.
• Network with other teams to explore career possibilities across finance.

À propos de & Whitney Canada 
Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale. Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde. 

Un employeur de choix 
Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. 

Dates du stage : 5 janvier au 23 avril 2027
Emplacement : Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.
Consultez notre chaîne YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@PrattWhitneyCa
Notre site web : Accueil | Pratt & Whitney

Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ? 
Travailler au sein de l’équipe de Service Numériques pour les Moteurs (DES) – Logiciels de Station au sol responsable de l’ingestion des données de diagnostic du moteur et de surveillance des performances du moteur dans un environnement nuragique AWS. Apprendre à connaitre le traitement complet des données de vol pour les données moteur/avion provenant des enregistreurs de bord (FAST/DCTU) afin d'effectuer la surveillance de l'état du moteur. Réaliser des études d’amélioration continue sur les logiciels de traitement des données sur les moteurs en service. Rédiger et standardiser des documents de procédures et des documents de formation pour l’ensemble des processus.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ? 
• Participer au développement logiciel et à la validation du logiciel en tant que membre d'une équipe agile

• Analyser les exigences logicielles et préparer la documentation de conception

• Développer des modules en python orienté objet qui seront hébergés sur l'environnement AWS

• Participer à la validation/acceptation du logiciel ainsi que l’automatisation des tests

• Développer des méthodes et des outils pour surveiller les performances du traitement des données de la station au sol P&WC

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ? 

• Être éligible à travailler au Canada.

• Être inscrit dans une université canadienne pendant toute la durée de votre stage.

• Être en mesure de travailler en présentiel, dans les bureaux mentionne dans l’offre.

We are particularly interested in advancing fundamental generative AI methods for image, video, 3D, graph, and multimodal data. healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world’s most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.

• Participate in software design reviews, code reviews, debugging activities, and root cause investigations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including systems, electrical, mechanical, quality, and clinical engineering partners.

Job Posting Title:
Associate Product Manager Program

Job Description:
About Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology:
Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business around the world. 

We marry technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive innovation, scalability, and velocity across our portfolio. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. Our teams collaborate across The Walt Disney Company’s media brands and platforms —Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars—to deliver exceptional consumer experiences to millions around the globe and technical platforms and systems that drive Disney’s business. 

Why You’ll Love Working Here:
• Building the Future of Media: Our technologists are designing and building the platforms that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. 

• Reach, Scale & Impact: Disney’s technology and products serve as the signature doorway for fans to connect with our brands and stories. These platforms carry unmatched content that matters to millions globally. 

• Innovation: We design, develop and implement groundbreaking products and platforms that shape industry norms and solve complex, distinctive technical challenges. 

This opportunity is part of a structured development journey that blends hands-on experience, mentorship, and leadership growth across Disney’s world-class product and technology teams. 

About the Associate Product Manager (APM) Program 
• Full-time new hires for this role will start as a cohort in Summer 2027. 

• This is a two-year career accelerator program designed to foster the next generation of leading product management talent. 

• Team rotations occur at the 12-month mark, ensuring exposure to multiple teams and product domains. 

As part of the program, you will: 
• Gain hands-on experience building and launching products used by hundreds of millions of people. 

• Receive structured training on product management fundamentals and mentorship from Disney Product leaders. 

• Use data and user insights to understand business problems and help drive strategic decisions. 

• Participate in learning opportunities focused on strategic problem-solving, leadership development and networking. 

Job Summary:
As a Product Manager I (APM), you will assist in the development and execution of product strategies to meet business objectives. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, conduct market research, and support the product lifecycle from discovery to launch. As part of this development program, the role offers the opportunity to learn from an experienced product team and contribute to innovative projects for The Walt Disney Company. 

Responsibilities: 
• Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to develop features for an assigned product domain. 

• Learn to develop and communicate a strategic vision for engaging our fans, aligning with broader company goals and market trends.   

• Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and documentation to drive development of features. 

• Work with leadership to craft product strategy, Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), and roadmap. 

• Support product research by analyzing competitor offerings. 

• Contribute to strategy documents and presentations. 

• Conduct basic data analysis to inform product decisions (e.g., usage metrics, user behavior). 

• Support feature launches and internal communications. 

Basic Qualifications: 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to use data-driven insights to inform decisions and measure performance. 

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

• Experience through coursework, projects, or internships in product management or related technical domains such as engineering, software development and user experience. 

• Ability to recognize what makes a product valuable to the user and drive improvements to meet business goals. 

• Interest in product development, user experience, and technology. 

• Capacity to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 

• Collaborative mindset with proven ability to build strong relationships across a range of functions and work effectively in team-oriented environments. 

Required Education: 
• Upcoming or recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related technical field 

Location: 
The primary location for this role is the Greater LA, CA area, with additional opportunities potentially available in New York, NY. Final location and team placement will be determined at the time of offer based on business needs and team alignment. Candidates should be open and receptive to opportunities across all locations listed in this job posting.
The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles, CA is $$97,500.00 - $130,700.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in device evaluation, characterization, and validation activities using standard test methods and laboratory equipment.

• Support debugging and root-cause analysis of product functionality and performance issues.

jobs.title: Digital Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
As adoption of centrally developed products and corporate-scale capabilities continues to grow across multiple business units, we are seeking Product Owners to lead adoption, onboarding, and value realization for these products. In this role, you will own priorities for internal data and digital products that drive measurable business impact. You will collaborate across functions to understand diverse perspectives and define clear opportunities. Through this work, you will translate stakeholder needs into valuable products by maintaining and delivering a prioritized backlog. You will communicate product status to stakeholders and create personas, user journeys, user flows, and other stimuli to support these efforts. This role requires you to embrace Agile principles—fall in love with the Minimally Viable Product (MVP), fail fast, learn, and iterate to bring digital products to life. 

Key Business Areas include Brand Building, Digital Media, Creative Operations, Digital Commerce Execution, and Business Process Transformation. Product scope may range from enterprise data assets and analytics platforms to creative workflow tools, media measurement solutions, retailer-facing commerce capabilities, and marketing technology ecosystems.

Responsibilities:

As a Digital Product Owner, you will: 

• Set product vision and strategy across the relevant business units, service, product, program, technology domain, or IT process that creates clarity and structure in ambiguous environments. 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. IT, Brand, R&D, Finance, Sales) that act as business owners of your products while fostering innovation, shared accountability, and continuous improvement. 

• Translate cross-functional business needs into actionable user stories for the technical team. 

• Communicate your product’s progress and KPIs via roadmaps, quantifiable metrics, leadership reviews, and monthly memos. 

• Lead onboarding, communications, and adoption efforts for new features and releases, driving organizational change at scale. 

• Define and prioritize the backlog based on business value, priorities, and technical feasibility. Develop and run experiments to validate or disprove concepts. 

• Create user-centric materials (e.g. documentation, flows, mockups) to validate concepts through requirement gathering and support translation of ideas from diverse groups. 

• Champion data quality and governance to ensure trusted insights. 

• Ensure ongoing operational success through continuous improvement informed by product data, customer feedback, operational insights, and monitoring. 

Job Qualifications
Required:
• Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Analytics, or related field.
• Familiarity with data platforms (Azure Databricks, Power BI) and governance principles. 
• Strong communication skills to bridge ideas and requirements between non-technical and technical stakeholders. 
• Ability to bring structure to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred: 
• Growth Mindset, Agile Mindset
• Exposure to data stewardship practices
• Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and backlog management tools (Azure Dev Ops, Jira).

jobs.title: Software Development Associate
jobs.description:
What You’ll Do
We established the Technology & Operations Program (TOP) in 2000 to develop our next generation of leaders. During this two-year program for recent graduates, Associates experience four challenging six-month rotations in a particular track or career path, in this case, Software Development, before joining a permanent team. Associates will have the unique opportunity to rotate through many areas of the business gaining exposure and visibility across the firm, while benefitting from formalized training and mentorship.
Software development teams support a vast range of investment and financial platforms, including equities, fixed income, sales, trading, multi-asset solutions, private client, research, corporate finance, data management, and more. In each rotation you will be part of a different software development team, implementing functional and technical specifications provided by business analysts and development managers. You will learn both the functional and technical aspects of an application in addition to the languages and frameworks used for construction. All development rotations involve hands-on learning, supported by team members, project managers, and formal technology training. Software Developers use just about every programming language at AllianceBernstein, so Associates will learn and apply a broad range of technical skills throughout the rotations.
Examples of Software Development Rotations:
• Developing an analytics and pricing engine for mortgage-backed securities
• Implementing new quantitative models and enhancement of the portfolio management process
• Developing a system to identify trading opportunities based on new strategies
• Building a bond recommendation engine
• Automating trade processes to reduce risk and maximize efficiency
What We Are Looking For:
We’re looking for candidates who demonstrate academic excellence, innovation, leadership potential, technical ability and a passion for learning our business. Candidates will possess the following qualifications:
• December 2026 or May/June 2027 bachelor’s or master’s degree candidates in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
• Cumulative GPA of a 3.3 or higher
• Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (must be able to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship now or in the future)

• Demonstrated programming experience
• Exceptional analytical, creative, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work in a challenging, fast-paced, team environment
• Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance software development, automate workflows, and solve complex business challenges
What Sets us Apart
• TOP Associates participate in the rotation selection process!
• First-hand training and experience with innovative technologies through our apprenticeship model
• Extensive technical and business training opportunities
• Engage with senior leaders through networking events, coffee chats and lunch & learn sessions
• Formal mentorship program
• Tuition reimbursement for CFA, MBA and more
• 1 on 1 career planning and development sessions
• Opportunity to join multiple employee resources and wellness groups to connect with colleagues across the firm
About AB

Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Position Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated PhD-level scientist or engineer to develop and apply advanced modeling capabilities for plasma processing applications, including plasma etching, plasma-enhanced deposition, and atomic layer etching (ALE). This role focuses on understanding, modeling, and predicting plasma–surface interaction processes using a combination of physics-based methods and data-driven approaches.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with atomistic and mesoscale modeling techniques such as ab initio quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics (MD), and kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC). In addition, the candidate will be expected to develop and deploy machine learning (ML) models trained on data generated from large-scale, multi-dimensional high-performance computing (HPC) simulations, complemented by experimental measurements.

This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of first-principles modeling, large-scale simulation, and modern AI/ML methods, contributing directly to accelerated technology and product development in the fast-paced semiconductor equipment industry.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop and apply advanced models for plasma etching, deposition, and plasma-based surface modification processes

• Combine physics-based and ML-driven approaches to improve process understanding and predictive capability

• Collaborate closely with experimental teams to guide process development and interpret new experimental results

• Contribute to the development, validation, and maintenance of internal software tools, modeling frameworks, and best practices

• Communicate modeling results clearly and effectively to multidisciplinary teams, including scientists, engineers, and major customers

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please apply by October 30th, 2026. Note: This position may close early based on application volume or candidate selection.

• Must have a PhD in Engineering (e.g., Chemical, Materials, Mechanical) or Science (e.g., Physics, Chemistry) or a related field

• Demonstrated experience modeling plasma–surface or gas–surface interaction processes using ab initio quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, and/or kinetic Monte Carlo methods

• Strong background in machine learning, particularly in the context of scientific computing or HPC environments

• Experience working with large, complex simulation datasets and integrating modeling results with experimental data

jobs.title: Product Intern
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




ABOUT THE ROLE

OpenGov is looking for Product Engineer Interns who are eager to learn what it means to own a product — from customer discovery through delivery. This internship is built around a new kind of role born from AI's ability to handle execution work that once required multiple specialists. What AI cannot do is decide what matters, talk to customers, make the right call in ambiguous situations, or own whether a product succeeds. That is what Product Engineers learn to do — and this internship is where that journey starts.

This role is first and foremost about developing product thinking — not becoming a developer. The best interns will be the ones who grow genuinely curious about customers: who they are, what they actually need, and what outcomes depend on solving their problems. The engineering side — using AI-native tooling to write code, build interfaces — is a skill you will be introduced to and encouraged to develop. It is a career accelerator, not a day-one requirement.

If you have a background or strong interest in product management, UX design, engineering, or some combination — and you want real ownership of a problem rather than a slide deck — this internship is for you.

"Product Engineer" is two words — but the first word is the one that matters most. The second is how you get there.



The 10-week internship will run from June 7, 2027 through August 13, 2027.



 


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - A scoped product problem: a defined set of customers, problems, and outcomes — sized for a 10–12 week engagement with real impact.

 - Customer discovery: you will conduct or observe customer conversations and translate what you learn into product decisions.

 - User experience flows: you will define interaction patterns within an existing design system and validate them with users.

 - AI-assisted delivery: using AI-native tooling, you will move from intent to spec to working prototype — supported by your team, but accountable for the output.

 - Metrics: you will define what success looks like for your area and track it throughout the internship.
   
    


HOW AI WORKS IN THIS ROLE

AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and designers have historically spent their time on. As an intern, you will be hands-on with these tools from day one:

 - Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You learn to review, sharpen, and own what gets built.

 - UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. You make the product decisions within it.

 - Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes and support data. You interpret what it means and make the call.

 - Release content: AI generates release notes and enablement materials from shipped features. You review and refine them.

 - Test coverage: AI generates test cases from acceptance criteria. You learn to write criteria precise enough to verify.

What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job — and what you will be learning.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Participate in customer discovery conversations; synthesize what you hear into defensible product decisions.

 - Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the existing design system.

 - Write intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review AI-generated specs for accuracy and completeness.

 - Partner with your engineering and product mentor to resolve ambiguity in real time during the development cycle.

 - Track adoption and usage metrics for your scoped area; use them to drive iteration.

 - Present your product area and findings in a final intern showcase — covering the customer problem, what you built, and what you would do next.

 - Surface gaps, risks, and unanswered questions proactively; don't wait to be asked.

 


QUALIFICATIONS & WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Currently pursuing a degree in computer science, information systems, product design, HCI, business, or a closely adjacent field — or equivalent self-directed experience.

 - Genuine curiosity about customers and why products succeed or fail; you find yourself asking "who is this for and does it actually solve their problem?"

 - Strong written communication: you can articulate a product decision clearly enough that an engineer and a designer walk away aligned.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and speed: you make reasonable decisions with incomplete information rather than waiting for certainty.

 - Willingness to grow into code fluency using AI-native tooling — you don't need to arrive as a developer, but you must be willing to get there.

 - Prior exposure to product management, UX design, software development, or customer research is a plus — in any form (coursework, projects, prior internships, side work).

 - Familiarity with design tools (Figma, etc.) or development tooling is welcome but not required.

 


COMPENSATION

Atlanta, GA: $25 per hour 

 

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

We're hiring a Software Engineering Intern! This is a short term placement for students or recent graduates who demonstrate outstanding intelligence, motivation, and work ethic. The kind of person who raises the bar just by being in the room, even this early in their career.

You'll tackle real engineering problems, not busywork. Problems where creativity, first-principles thinking, and relentless iteration matter more than years of experience.  - Contribute to real, shipped product work, not a side project or sandbox

 - Ship fast, iterate based on feedback, and learn from production

 - Collaborate closely with product, design, and senior engineers

 - Sit in on architecture discussions and technical decisions to learn how we think, not just how we code

If you are looking to join a small, dynamic, growing firm in the financial technology sector, you have come to the right place. BlackEdge has built a strong foundation of success as an industry leading market maker in the treasury options space. Now we need talented people like you to build on that foundation by further improving and leveraging our existing success to expand into new markets.

The Role:

We’re seeking a Quantitative Researcher to tackle challenging, longer-term problems that drive our trading strategies forward. Unlike the fast-paced, short-cycle puzzles solved by our quantitative traders, you’ll dive into ambiguous problems that require deep mathematical intuition, independent research, and creative model development. Every day is an opportunity to get a little bit better. Everyone here takes deep pride and ownership in what they do. The buck doesn't get passed along, it stops with you.

jobs.description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.
 
Reports to: [Reports to: TBD]
Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid)

About the Role
CSC Generation's portfolio runs on a mix of legacy systems spanning .NET, Python, JavaScript, and Java. These applications are critical to daily operations, and they need someone dedicated to keeping them healthy while steadily modernizing how they are built, tested, deployed, and monitored.

As Software Engineer - Legacy Applications & Modernization, you will own the maintenance and incremental improvement of these systems — building CI/CD pipelines, increasing test coverage, containerizing applications, and adding observability so the team can catch problems before customers do. Within your first six months, you will have shipped pipeline and testing improvements that measurably reduce production incidents.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.
What You'll Do
• Maintain, debug, and enhance legacy applications written in .NET Framework, Python, JavaScript, and Java

• Analyze and resolve production issues with minimal downtime

• Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using AWS services, Docker, and Ansible

• Containerize legacy applications and orchestrate deployments

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management with Ansible

• Write and optimize SQL queries, administer relational database systems, and implement safe database migrations and schema updates

• Develop and integrate automated unit and integration tests, increasing test coverage and establishing test automation frameworks

• Implement logging, metrics, and tracing across legacy applications and configure monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues proactively
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or currently enrolled in a 4-year program pursuing the equivalent, or equivalent professional experience)

• Demonstrated experience with at least 2 of the following: .NET Framework, Python, JavaScript, Java

• Understanding of legacy application patterns and technical debt

• Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, etc.)

• Proficiency with Docker containerization

• Experience with Ansible for infrastructure automation

• Strong SQL query writing and optimization skills

• Experience administering and troubleshooting relational database systems (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.)

• Experience writing unit tests and integration tests using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, JUnit, pytest, or Jest

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities

• Excellent communication and documentation skills

• Version control experience with Git or similar
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working across multiple legacy technology stacks simultaneously

• Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Datadog, etc.)

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code principles

• Background in application modernization or refactoring projects

• Familiarity with agile development practices

• AWS certifications or other cloud platform certifications
Why Join
The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

• Meaningful Work from Day One: You will work on systems that power real brands and real revenue — your fixes and improvements have immediate, visible impact.

• Training & Development: Gain hands-on experience across multiple technology stacks, cloud infrastructure, and modern DevOps practices with direct mentorship from your manager and team.

• Trusted from Day One: You will own applications end-to-end — from debugging production issues to shipping pipeline improvements — with real responsibility, not busywork.

• Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
Interview Process
• Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.

• Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation focused on your experience with legacy systems, DevOps practices, and approach to modernization.

• Technical / Case Discussion - A technical conversation covering debugging, CI/CD design, SQL, and testing strategies relevant to the role.

• In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Houston office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.

• Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.

• Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.
Please Note
• Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately. 

• Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity.
US:
CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact hrbenefits@cscshared.com.
Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie-detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT SPAICE

SPAICE is building the geospatial intelligence layer for autonomous vehicles operating where GNSS is unavailable, unreliable, or denied. Our Spatial AI enables drones and satellites to determine their position, understand their surroundings, and transform every detection into actionable, geo-referenced intelligence. From denied airspace on Earth to complex orbital environments, SPAICE delivers resilient navigation and persistent situational awareness in any condition.

At SPAICE, you’ll work on some of the hardest autonomy challenges across air and space, developing technology for GNSS-independent flight, orbital awareness, formation flying, and autonomous operations. You’ll work alongside a mission-driven team and leading aerospace and defence partners, turning advanced research into systems with a tangible impact on real-world missions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

In this internship, you'll build the systems that get software onto aircraft, not code that sits on a shelf. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll join the Infrastructure & Product team to build the build tooling, test harnesses, data pipelines, and internal tools that let a small team ship autonomy software to real missions. Deployment tooling that puts a new build on a flight computer in one command. Test harnesses that catch a navigation regression before it ever reaches an aircraft. Pipelines that turn a field trial's raw flight logs into answers in minutes, not days. These are the challenges you'll help solve. 

Expect to write code that gets reviewed, merged, and used by the team. Expect to see the hardware your work runs on. Expect to leave with something real you can point at.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Build deployment and release tooling for embedded flight computers and edge-AI hardware, covering cross-compilation, containerisation, configuration management, and over-the-air updates.

 - Help build the test and evaluation infrastructure behind SPAICE's Spatial AI, replaying recorded flight data to catch navigation regressions before they reach an aircraft.

 - Develop data pipelines that ingest logs and sensor recordings from field trials, handling volume and sensor time alignment to make every flight searchable, replayable, and comparable.

 - Build the internal tools and product surfaces. Work on the visualisations, dashboards, CLIs, configuration tooling through which engineers and customers inspect and operate the system.

 - Collaborate with SPAICE's autonomy and perception engineers and cross-disciplinary teams, delivering well-tested, high-performance code into HIL/SIL setups and real missions.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's or Master's student, or a recent graduate, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Solid programming ability in C++ or Python, with experience building and debugging software on Linux.

 - Some exposure to the product side of software: web front-ends, APIs, databases, or data pipelines. Having built something other people actually used counts for more than the specific stack.

 - Comfortable working in Linux and with Git.

 - Interest in autonomy, robotics, aerospace, or space.
   
   


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation

 - Work on flight-grade autonomy software with industry leaders

 - Fast-paced, high-impact environment with genuine ownership

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT CYVL

The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it.

Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data.

The proof isn't a dashboard. It's a smoother commute, a safer walk to school and public dollars going where they matter most. We're a fast-moving team in Boston building hardware, software and AI for the real world. If you believe technology's highest calling is public good, come build with us.



THE ROLE

As a Hardware Engineering Intern at Cyvl, you won't be stuck on side projects. You'll work directly on the sensor stack that rides on the vehicles mapping roads for cities across the country. You'll collaborate with our engineering and product teams and learn how hardware actually gets designed, tested, and built in a fast-moving startup. This role is open as a Spring 2027 co-op or a Summer 2027 internship.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and iterate sensor mounts and enclosures in CAD, from first sketch to printed and machined parts you can hold.

 - Develop and run tests: design fixtures, write concise test plans and reports, and write simple scripts (Python, bash) to automate testing.

 - Work closely with engineers who invest in your growth through regular pairing and direct feedback on your work.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

 - 3D CAD fluency (SolidWorks preferred; Onshape and others welcome)

 - Experience building and running tests, including simple scripts to automate them

 - Excitement to learn new technologies and apply them quickly

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a collaborative environment

 - Able to work in person at our Somerville, MA office




NICE TO HAVE

 - A portfolio; it doesn't have to be perfect, we just want to see that you've built things

 - Designing for outdoor, automotive, or industrial applications (weatherproofing, shock, and vibration)

 - An understanding of DFX methods (manufacturability, usability, repairability, etc.)




WHY CYVL

Hard tech. Real streets. Your name on it.

 - Hard problems in the real world. You build end-to-end: our own hardware, software and AI, with work that shows up on the street in the real world.

 - Ownership that compounds. You own outcomes, not tasks. You work directly with customers and across our team, and you'll own more, sooner, than almost anywhere else.

 - Intense, with heart. We're building a category, so it's not a place to coast. We also take care of each other, have genuine fun together, and believe in what we are doing.




WHAT WE ASK

 - Cross lanes. "Not my job" doesn't exist here.

 - Own without a playbook. The plan is still being written, often by you.

 - Try, miss, try again. We make big bets. Some won't land, and we learn fast.

 - Be in the room. We're on-site in Somerville about 90% of the time.

We're a startup building a category. If that sounds like the draw, not the risk, we'd love to talk.




OUR VALUES

 - Real: Authentic and transparent. Focused on solving real problems with simple, effective solutions.

 - All Out: Bold, driven, and committed to delivering results that matter.

 - Accelerating: Always learning, growing, and moving with intention.

 - Reliable: We follow through and deliver at a consistently high bar.

 - Empowering: We lift each other up and help governments build infrastructure they can be proud of.




SEE OUR WORK

 - How Atlanta cut downtown potholes by 60% https://cyvl.com/case-studies/atlanta-ga

 - How Buffalo turned a campaign promise into a paving plan https://cyvl.com/case-studies/buffalo-ny

 - How to rebuild US infrastructure smarter https://www.theengineer.co.uk/content/opinion/how-to-rebuild-us-infrastructure-smarter-and-stronger



We build for every community, so we hire from all of them. The best people for this work come from different backgrounds, paths, and places, and many of them don't check every box. If this role excites you, apply anyway. If you need an adjustment to our interview process, tell us and we'll make it work.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern
jobs.description:
MEMBER OF TECHNICAL STAFF, INTERN

Pace is the AI operations platform for insurance, trusted by some of the leading carriers, specialty mutual groups, and tech-forward brokers.

Almost $400bn per year is spent on outsourcing in financial services. We’re here to change that, working side-by-side with some of the largest companies in the world.




ROLE

We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff, Intern to join our product and engineering team for the summer.

This is not a typical internship. You’ll be treated as a full member of the team from day one, owning a meaningful problem and shipping work used by our customers and insurance operations teams. 

Depending on your interests and the highest-priority needs of the team, you might:

 1. Build full-stack product features for browser automation and AI-powered workflows

 2. Work with our largest customers to understand their operations and build features that help them scale

 3. Develop evaluations, observability, and internal tools that make our agents more reliable

You’ll work alongside our engineers and users to take a problem from initial understanding through implementation and launch.




INTERNSHIP DETAILS

 - Duration: 10–14 weeks

 - Location: In person in New York 

 - Dates: Flexible start dates (May or June) 

 - Compensation and Benefits: Competitive compensation and generous meal stipend for lunch and dinner

 - Full-time opportunity: Strong performers may be considered for a full-time role after graduation




YOUR BACKGROUND

You might be a strong fit if you:

 - Have built something from scratch through a class, research project, internship, startup, open-source contribution, or personal project

 - Have a strong software engineering foundation and experience programming in at least one language

 - Enjoy working through ambiguous problems and learning by building

 - Take ownership, move quickly, and seek feedback

 - Care about the people using what you build, not just whether the code works

 - Are excited about building dependable AI systems for complex, real-world environments

Experience with AI systems, data pipelines, browser automation, full-stack development, or enterprise software is helpful but not required. We care more about your technical foundation, rate of learning, and the quality of what you’ve built than experience with our exact stack.




TEAM CHARACTERISTICS

The Pace team shares two defining characteristics:

 1. Integrity: We want to work with good people committed to doing the best work of their careers. We believe meaningful impact takes sustained focus, and we’re building for the next 5–10 years.

 2. Ambition: We’re building more than a successful vertical AI company. We’re pursuing a $100bn+ outcome across vertical services and want teammates whose ambitions match the opportunity—whether they aim to become exceptional individual contributors, lead at scale, or start companies of their own.


TRAJECTORY

Our goal is to invest in people with exceptional potential and accelerate their growth.

If there’s a strong mutual fit, this internship can lead to a full-time Member of Technical Staff role after graduation. From there, potential paths include:

 - Becoming a world-class individual contributor

 - Growing into engineering leadership

 - Owning and scaling a product or business line

We want Pace to be the best place to learn quickly, deliver meaningful impact, and advance your path toward doing something great.

At Pace, we’re building a talent-dense team where teammates grow into leaders. This might mean growing into a world-class IC, owning a line of business, or leading teams. Whichever your path, we want to support you to grow at Pace and beyond for the long term.

We’re a <40 person team based in person across New York and London. We’re fortunate to be working with leading customers and top investors, with the opportunity to make a real impact on one of the largest industries in the world.
