jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About Flagship Pioneering 

Flagship Pioneering is a biotechnology company that invents and builds platform companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps. Those big leaps in human health and sustainability exponentially accelerate scientific progress in areas ranging from cancer detection and treatment to nature-positive agriculture.   

 What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our scientific founders, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and transform for the benefit of people and planet.   

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.  

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. 

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps.You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

About the Role

This is a hands-on building role. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to design, prototype, and deploy AI-powered solutions that improve how teams work. Projects range from low-code automations using platforms like Zapier, Vercel, and Workato to full-stack applications built with tools like Claude Code and VS Code, written in Python or JavaScript, and deployed on cloud infrastructure like AWS.

You will take ownership of projects from start to finish: understanding a business process, exploring how to redesign it with AI, building a working solution, and iterating until it holds up in practice.

We’re looking for someone who is curious about not just how to build, but how to build well. That means learning to evaluate which tools and approaches fit a given problem, thinking through a design before jumping into code, and being open to feedback on your approach along the way.

Who This Is For

This role is for builders who are curious, resourceful, and eager to learn. You don’t need to know everything, but you should be excited to figure things out. You’re a strong fit if you:

• Have looked at a manual process and thought, “This wouldn’t exist like this if it were built today”

• Like to prototype quickly and learn by building

• Have hands-on experience building with AI tools, models, or APIs, even in personal or school projects

• Are starting to develop instincts for choosing the right tool for the job, not just using the one you know best

• Ask questions about why something is designed a certain way, not just how to make it work

• Care about whether something actually works reliably, not just in a demo

• Are energized by new technology and lean into learning it

• Can explain what you built and why to someone non-technical

Key Responsibilities

• Build and deploy automations using low-code platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) and, where needed, custom code (e.g., Python, JavaScript) to automate business workflows

• Integrate AI models via APIs into automation pipelines

• Help deploy and maintain applications on cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS)

• Learn to evaluate different tools and approaches for new projects, considering tradeoffs like speed, complexity, and long-term maintainability

• Test your own work thoroughly, with a focus on accuracy and edge cases, especially for data-sensitive workflows

• Iterate on proof-of-concept solutions based on real-world performance and feedback from business stakeholders

• Keep clear notes on how your solutions are built so others can understand, maintain, and extend them

• Support AI tool pilots and help create training materials that make it easier for non-technical users to adopt AI-enabled workflows

Basic Requirements

• Current graduate student in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript)

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks, and how web services communicate

• Comfort working with AI tools in a development or productivity context

• Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new tools quickly

Preferred Requirements

• Experience with low-code or no-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, Power Automate, Workato)

• Experience building and deploying applications on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Familiarity with version control (Git) and development environments like VS Code

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

The pay range for this role is $25 - $35 per hour. This role is a short-term engagement that is not eligible for health and welfare benefits. Retirement benefits may be available after completing a set number of hours. Compensation and benefits information is based on Flagship Pioneering’s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Privacy Notice for Applicants: When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. If you are located in the EU or UK, we process your data under GDPR and you have rights to access, rectify, and erase your data. To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

jobs.title: Silicon Engineering Intern - BS/MS - Multiple Teams
Hardware Engineer Intern - Machine Integration & Test
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Getting an autonomy stack onto a 40-ton excavator is a hardware problem long before it's a software one — brackets, harnesses, enclosures, and interfaces that survive vibration, dust, and weather. As our Machine Integration intern, you'll design and build the physical interfaces between our system and the machine, plus the test stands we use to prove them out before they ever hit a jobsite.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

jobs.title: IT Application Development Intern
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

POSITION SUMMARY:

At National Life Group, we are modernizing our business and evolving our customer experience through digital-first technology solutions. Our technology teams play a critical role in building, enhancing, and supporting the applications and platforms that enable our customers, agents, and employees to do business more effectively.

The IT Applications Development Intern will work within our Inforce Applications team and partner with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other technology professionals to develop, enhance, test, and support business applications. Depending on project needs, the intern may contribute to application development, system integrations, troubleshooting, production support, automation, and technical documentation.

This role provides hands-on exposure to enterprise application development and support within a large-scale technology environment. The intern will work with stakeholder teams across National Life Group in an Agile environment, gain experience with modern development practices and tools, and participate in the full application lifecycle—from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, and interested in applying software development and problem-solving skills to real business challenges while gaining practical experience working with enterprise technology platforms.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days. Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teammates to document and analyze digital customer experiences. You will develop metrics, reporting, visualization, analysis, and recommendations that help program leaders guide strategy and change initiatives.

• Work with technical teams to develop and support web applications, APIs, and solutions for internal and external users.

• Build and enhance applications using technologies such as Angular, Java, REST APIs, and cloud-based platforms.

• Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings and work with the team to deliver assigned development and support tasks.

• Use DevOps tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, and JFrog to support code management, testing, and automated deployments.

• Use approved AI tools for coding, research, troubleshooting, and documentation, including basic prompt engineering and validation of AI-generated results.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Currently enrolled in a degree program related to Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a similar technical field.

• Enthusiastic, curious, and eager to learn new technologies.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

• Basic understanding of software development concepts, web applications, APIs, or programming.

• Exposure to technologies such as Angular, Java, GitHub, DevOps tools, or cloud platforms is a plus.

• Familiarity with AI tools, prompt engineering, or using AI to support coding and troubleshooting is a plus.

• Previous coursework, personal projects, internships, or hands-on technical experience is a plus.

AI Proficiency Expectations

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining in a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All associates are expected to:

• Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

• Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

• Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

• Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life's AI guiding principles.

• Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention, and intellectual property.

Core Competencies

• Service Focus - Demonstrates a client centric focus for satisfying one’s external and/or internal customers; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.

• Decision Making - Makes a sense of complex information, critically evaluates, and creates solutions.

• Results Oriented - Sets performance and personal goals; Driven to meet or exceed goals and objectives.

• Plans and Aligns - Plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals; Aligns people and skills to tasks and assignments; Evaluates results of work.

• Demonstrates Learning Agility - Enhances skills and knowledge through continuous learning; Focuses on personal results by establishing stretch goals; Seeks feedback and changes accordingly.

• Establishes Relationships - Builds partnerships with others to instill trust, collaborate, and meet shared objectives.

• Communicates Effectively - Actively listens, conveys messages to meet different audience needs, and remains open to new ideas and opinions.

• Fosters Diversity - Values diversity and difference in thought, experience, and perspective; Promotes an environment that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion; Supports equal and fair treatment for all.

HOW YOU SHOW UP: 

• Highly reliable, engaged and possess a customer service attitude

• Demonstrate effective communication to various areas of the organization (technical and non-technical)

• Bring creativity, thought leadership, and curiosity to the table; actively participate in forums to contribute and learn

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, i.e. a problem solver’s mindset

• Eager to learn, ask relevant questions, seek new knowledge, and make connections

• Enjoy taking on challenges and working towards solutions both collaboratively and independently 

PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS: 

• 10-week paid internship (June 1 - August 6) with formal orientation and onboarding

• Networking opportunities with peers and leaders throughout the summer

• Cross-Departmental group project focused on an enterprise-wide solution presented at company-wide event

• Presentation skills coaching sessions

• Learning opportunities throughout program

• Access to mentors (former program participants)

The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.

Software Engineer Intern - Multiple Teams
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for software engineering interns who are excited to make an impact across different layers of our product and infrastructure. At Figma, we pair interns with teams that align with their skills and interests. This year, we're inviting you to share your interests from the start, so we can create the strongest possible match.

Our interns are embedded into small, collaborative engineering teams across the company. You’ll work closely with your mentor and teammates to ship meaningful features, tools, or systems. Whether you're working on internal infrastructure or user-facing features, you’ll get to learn, contribute, and grow in a supportive environment.

This internship will be based out of our London Hub with a 5/3, 5/17, 6/1 or 6/14 start date.

Engineering Interests at Figma:

When you apply, you'll tell us which areas you're most interested in to help us understand which kinds of engineering work you're most excited about:

• Product: Build full stack user facing features, including new collaboration tools, new product workflows, growth oriented experiments, and more

• Platform/Infrastructure: Build platform level tools, including distributed systems, developer tooling, performance/scalability work, and more

• Security Engineering: Build security-focused systems, product security tooling, detection, secure infrastructure, or privacy/security features

• Open: I’m flexible and still exploring different types of work

What you'll do at Figma:

• Join a small engineering team as a full member of the team, with your own project and mentor

• Contribute to projects that directly align with team goals and impact

• Collaborate with engineers, PMs, designers, and QA to break down features and plan timelines

• Build, document, and maintain tests, features, or infrastructure

• Share feedback and participate in peer code review

• Ship your project(s) by the end of your internship!

Some past intern projects:

• Diagramming improvements in FigJam

• Smart selection

• Shared fonts

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Experience writing clean code in at least one general-purpose language (e.g. C++, JavaScript, Python, Java, etc.), with a solid grasp of core CS concepts like data structures and algorithms

• Experience solving technical problems through school, work, or personal projects

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code

• Demonstrated curiosity about how systems are designed and operate, from infrastructure to UI

• Strong communicator who asks great questions, collaborates well with others, and is excited to learn, get feedback, and grow as an engineer

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

• Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers

• Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

jobs.description:
Join a Challenger
At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 


Work Term: January - April 2027
 
The Intern - Commercial Lending AI Engineer supports the design, development, testing, and support of RESTful APIs, ETL integrations, Power Platform–based solutions, and emerging AI‑enabled capabilities within the Commercial Lending Technology team. This includes supporting AI integrations, large language model (LLM)–powered workflows, intelligent agents, and automated business processes. The role contributes to the delivery of secure, scalable, and reusable interoperability and microservice solutions that support the bank’s digital payment capabilities. 
 

The Core Responsibilities of the Job
• Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of RESTful APIs, ETL integrations, Power Platform solutions, and AI‑enabled workflows. 

• Assist with requirements analysis and contribute to functional and non‑functional technical solutions. 

• Support development of microservices, LLM integrations, intelligent agents, and workflow automations. 

• Participate in Agile SCRUM activities and support sprint delivery. 

• Perform unit testing, support QA triage, documentation, code reviews, and incident resolution. 

• API and integration modernization initiatives within Payments Technology. 

• Power Platform automation and AI‑assisted workflow projects. 

• Proof‑of‑concept initiatives involving LLM‑based solutions and intelligent agents. 

• Collaborate with developers, architects, QA, Business Analysis, and Project Management teams. 

• Support coordination with external vendors and internal IT teams during delivery and production support.
Let's Talk About You!
• Enrollment in a Bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

• Academic, internship, or co‑op experience in software development or technology delivery. 

• Exposure to API development, integration, or enterprise application environments is preferred. 

• Foundational knowledge of RESTful API development. 

• Basic understanding of ETL concepts and integration patterns. 

• Exposure to AI-enabled solutions, including LLM integrations, intelligent agents, or workflow automation (nice to have). 

• Familiarity with J2EE/JEE frameworks such as Spring MVC, Spring Security, Hibernate, OAuth (nice to have). 

• Basic experience with SQL Server databases. 

• Familiarity with unit testing frameworks (JUnit) and version control tools such as Git. 

• Exposure to Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

• Effective problem‑solving and analytical skills. 

• Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and work in a fast‑paced environment. 

• Self‑motivated team player with a willingness to learn and take initiative. 

• Training or coursework in APIs, integration platforms, or AI technologies is an advantage.
How to Submit Your Application
• In ONE document, please submit your transcript and resume. Failure to do so will result in your application not being considered.
What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]
 
💰 Competitive discretionary bonus 
✨ Market leading RRSP match program
🩺  Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
📝  Employee Share Purchase Plan
👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one
🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days 
🖥  Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues
🎓  Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program
💛  A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience
 
The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion
EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.
We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.

All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.

Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. 

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview

CHAOS is seeking a highly motivated, mission-oriented Applied AI Engineer to help develop, integrate, and deploy AI/ML-powered capabilities across our product lines.

In this role, you will work closely with other data scientists, software engineers, product teams, and mission stakeholders to conduct advanced AI research and turn them into reliable, real-world software. The work will focus especially on defense applications where the systems must perform with extreme accuracy under constrained, adversarial, and operationally complex conditions.

We are looking for someone with strong data science and software engineering fundamentals, a record of technical excellence, and demonstrated experience applying AI/ML techniques to real products. Experience in aerospace, defense, critical infrastructure, robotics, RF systems, or other highly regulated or mission-driven environments is a strong plus.

You should be comfortable operating with independence, learning unfamiliar technical domains quickly, working across disparate teams, and moving prototypes toward production with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

• Build applied AI systems across CHAOS product lines, including model integration, inference services, evaluation pipelines, and production-facing AI capabilities

• Perform research and build products by working with product and mission teams to research, collect data, verify hypothesis and create robust, testable, maintainable, and deployable models

• Evaluate and improve model performance under real-world conditions, including adversarial GPS denied environments, low-power or edge deployments, and degraded or noisy inputs

• Develop production-quality software for data pipelines for acquisition, model serving, monitoring, lifecycle management, data processing, and system integration.

• Create rapid prototypes with mission and product teams, other relevant stakeholders and iterate toward production-ready implementations.

• Contribute to AI system reliability, by conducting testing, benchmarking, observability, interpretability, failure analysis, and performance optimization.

• Learn quickly from existing codebases, documentation, research artifacts, and domain experts, then use that knowledge to drive execution.

• Manage time effectively across meetings, technical discovery, implementation, experimentation, and production support.

• Travel: 10-20%.

• Location: Must work on-site at least 2 days per week from our San Francisco office; 2–4 days per week preferred.

Minimum Requirements

• US Citizen or Permanent Resident

• BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field or equivalent experience

• 2-5 years of professional software development experience (exceptional fresh grads welcome to apply)

• Very strong Python programming skills

• Experience in building, testing, deploying, and supporting production software and models

• Experience with AI/ML model integration, model serving infrastructure, or model lifecycle management

• Experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, robustness testing, interpretability, or ML observability

• Familiarity with APIs, Distributed systems, Containers, CI/CD, observability, and edge deployment environments/GPU optimization

• Excited to learn unfamiliar technical domains

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with explainable AI (IG, Counterfactuals, Occlusion etc)

• Any experience with realtime digital video processing

• Experience productizing machine learning models, LLM applications, computer vision systems, signal-processing systems, or autonomous/robotic systems.

• Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows

• Any experience with analog or digital RF signal processing

• Any experience with drones, sensor fusion, tracking, or moving-target detection systems

• Familiarity with edge deployment of in-data-path models, low-latency inference, hardware-constrained systems, or degraded-connectivity environments

• Experience in aerospace, defense, critical infrastructure, robotics, or other mission-critical environments is a strong plus

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

$150k-170k

Quantitative Intern - Credit
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXODUSPOINT

ExodusPoint Capital, founded in 2017 by Michael Gelband, began managing investor capital in 2018. The firm employs a global multi-strategy investment approach, seeking to deliver compelling asymmetric returns by combining complementary liquid strategies managed by experienced investment professionals within a robust risk framework. ExodusPoint brings together an accomplished team with hands-on experience running multi-manager businesses to create an institutional investment management firm.

The Role 

ExodusPoint is looking for a Quantitative Intern to join a Corporate Credit investment team in Philadelphia.

You will work directly with the team’s traders, helping build the analytics and tools they use to monitor markets, identify opportunities and manage risk.

The team trades investment-grade Corporate Credit across new issues and secondary markets. The role will be particularly focused on the quantitative side of the investment process – working with market and trading data, developing analytics, automating existing processes and finding better ways to present information to the desk.

We don’t require previous Credit or finance experience. We are looking for someone who is highly analytical, comfortable coding and interested in applying those skills to a live trading environment.

What You’ll Do

• Build dashboards and analytics for the trading team.

• Analyse market, pricing and trading data.

• Develop tools to identify relative-value opportunities and market dislocations.

• Help improve intraday P&L, position and risk analytics.

• Analyse liquidity and dealer activity across Corporate Credit markets.

• Automate existing data and analytical processes.

• Build and improve data pipelines used by the desk.

• Backtest quantitative ideas and help assess whether they are useful in practice.

• Work directly with traders to understand problems and build practical solutions.

• Use tools such as Claude Code and Codex to improve the speed and efficiency of development.

The work will be driven by problems the team is dealing with day-to-day. We want someone who is comfortable taking an idea or loosely defined problem and figuring out how to solve it.

What We’re Looking For

• Currently studying, or recently completed, a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Data Science or another quantitative field.

• Strong coding skills, particularly Python.

• Experience working with data and quantitative analysis.

• A good understanding of statistics and probability.

• Comfortable using modern coding and AI development tools.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Curious, self-motivated and comfortable working independently.

• An interest in markets and trading.

A combination of Computer Science and Mathematics / Statistics would be particularly relevant, although we are open to candidates from a range of quantitative backgrounds.

Graduate-level study is helpful but not required.,You do not need to have worked in Credit or financial markets before.

We care more about whether you can code, work with data and think through quantitative problems. Previous experience or coursework in markets, quantitative finance, machine learning or trading is useful, but not essential.

The Team

You will sit directly with the investment team in Philadelphia and see how the tools you build are used in the trading process.

This is intended to be an in-person, full-time internship lasting approximately 3–4 months. Candidates do not need to currently live or study in Philadelphia, but should be able to work from the Philadelphia office during the internship.

There may be scope for a longer-term opportunity depending on performance and the needs of the team.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

From day one, we've been breaking down barriers, empowering people with the tools, knowledge, and products to participate in the financial system. Our innovation doesn't stop — and we need bright, curious minds to help shape the future of finance!

As an Associate Product Manager, you'll be at the center of our product innovation. You'll work alongside top talent from engineering, design, research, and more to bring groundbreaking financial products to life. From simplifying complex financial processes to crafting seamless customer experiences, your work will help shape the future of fintech. This role offers direct mentorship from some of the most accomplished product leaders in the industry, giving you the chance to grow, learn, and make a real impact in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.

This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Collaborate with engineering, design, research, data science, and marketing teams to deeply understand our customers and their most pressing needs

• Define and execute product strategies that align with business goals and user expectations

• Be the voice of the product, facilitating communication and collaboration across teams

• Lead product launches, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet a high standard of quality

• Set and monitor KPIs to measure success and track product engagement and adoption

What you bring

• Currently enrolled in a full-time, degree-seeking program in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field, graduating between Winter 2026 and Summer 2027

• 0–1 years of experience in product management, product development, or related roles; internship or co-op experience in fintech or tech is a plus

• Sharp analytical and technical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to make data-driven decisions

• Demonstrated leadership and communication abilities, with experience thriving in collaborative, cross-functional teams

• An entrepreneurial spirit — takes ownership of projects, turns ideas into action, and drives innovation

• A passion for fintech and a desire to learn more about financial products, markets, and emerging technologies

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

• Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Fraud Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Cloudflare's Internal Fraud Platform team is focused on protecting Cloudflare from fraud and abuse: fraudulent signups, promo and trial abuse, payment fraud, chargebacks, and account takeover that cost the company revenue and support overhead. Today the team is built around data science, developing the signals and models that detect this activity. We're hiring our first software engineer to build the platform around that work: ingesting events from the internal systems where fraud shows up (billing, signup, support), evaluating and routing them, and getting decisions and case data in front of the people who act on them.

As the founding engineer on this team, you'll be the connective tissue between Cloudflare's internal systems and our fraud detection capabilities. You'll instrument the systems that generate fraud signals, build the pipelines and services that deliver those signals for evaluation, and create the tools our analysts use to investigate and resolve cases. You'll partner closely with data scientists to take models and heuristics from notebook to production, and have meaningful influence over the architecture, tooling, and engineering practices it's built on.

Responsibilities

• 
Build the Platform: Design, build, and operate the services and pipelines that ingest fraud-relevant events from internal systems (billing, signup, support, and others), evaluate them, and route decisions and case data to the right destinations.

• 
Deliver Signals for Scoring: Partner with the team's Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineer to expose the event data and contextual features their models need, and integrate model decisions back into the pipelines and tools that act on them.

• 
Build Investigation Tooling: Create the internal tools and workflows that let Trust & Safety, Support, and Finance analysts investigate flagged accounts and events and take action.

• 
Own Projects End to End: Drive initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and operation with minimal oversight. In many ways this is a 0-to-1 team, and you'll be expected to fill in the gaps.

• 
Ensure Accuracy and Reliability: Build fault-tolerant systems that handle retries, failures, and high event volumes without silently dropping or duplicating fraud signals, and maintain the operational health of what you ship, including addressing the root cause of recurring issues.

• 
Shape Technical Direction: As one of the team's first engineers, help establish the architecture patterns, tooling choices, and engineering standards that will scale as the team grows.

• 
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Trust & Safety, Data Science, Billing/Fintech, Support, and Product teams to understand fraud vectors and turn them into engineering requirements.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 
Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.

• 
Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services in production.

• 
Experience designing and building data or event pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar).

• 
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service security, and API standards such as OpenAPI, OAuth, or JWT.

• 
Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.

• 
Comfort owning ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems with limited existing infrastructure or precedent.

• 
Strong troubleshooting, cross-functional communication, and project ownership skills.

Bonus Points

• 
Experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments engineering.

• 
Familiarity with ML serving and feature engineering concepts 

• 
Experience with billing, subscriptions, or other financial/transactional systems.

• 
Experience building internal tools or dashboards for non-engineering stakeholders (analysts, support, finance).

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

For 10 years, Scale has provided the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and has helped enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. Scale's internship is not a side project. Interns own real, shipped work on the same roadmaps as full-time engineers, with mentorship from world-class talent and a culture that values ownership, speed, and truth-seeking. Many of our interns return as full-time Scaliens.

Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

• Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens

• Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs

• Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI

Example Projects:

• Build reinforcement learning and post-training data pipelines that power frontier model development

• Develop evaluation infrastructure that measures model reliability for enterprise and public sector customers

• Ship agentic AI applications and the tooling that makes them observable, testable, and safe to deploy

• Build fraud-detection systems that remove bad actors and keep Scale's contributor base safe and trusted

• Use models to estimate the quality of tasks and contributors, and guarantee quality on requests at large scale

• Devise advanced matching algorithms that pair contributors to customers for optimal turnaround and accuracy

• Create optimized and efficient UI/UX tooling, in combination with ML algorithms, for 100k+ contributors completing billions of complex tasks

• Develop new AI infrastructure products to visualize, query, and explore Scale data

The Fraud Investigation team’s mission is to ensure Robinhood customers have swift identification and resolution of fraud-related issues. We do this by interacting with customers when their accounts encounter fraud, placing temporary restrictions on accounts if needed, investigating customer-surfaced and RH-identified fraud, communicating in a timely manner, and efficiently restoring and remediating accounts to their pre-fraud status. We train and employ skilled and knowledgeable investigators, deliver consistent and high-quality support, and minimize impact from fraud losses to protect our customers and our company's financial health.

As a Fraud Operations Intern, you will conduct an end-to-end fraud investigation of accounts that have any concerns of fraud, with the ultimate goal of protecting our customers and minimizing fraud exposures to the firm. As a Fraud Operations Intern you will be responsible for reviewing fraud alerts, determining fraud or no-fraud and help identify emerging fraud trends through data analysis. 

This role is based in our Denver, CO office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

• Review and investigate suspected fraudulent alerts — both proactive and reactive — using multiple internal and external tools

• Recognize and actively communicate emerging fraud trends and findings to relevant stakeholders

• Document the rationale and determination for each alert and submit referrals to other Robinhood teams where necessary

• Interest in the end-to-end fraud investigation process and various fraud typologies, including Account Takeovers, Identity Theft, and Money Movement Fraud

jobs.title: Supply Chain Tooling Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is building a vertically-integrated residential energy company — hardware, software, and field operations all under one roof. As a Supply Chain Tooling & Optimization Intern, you'll work directly with the teams standing up our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP and scaling deployments across Texas. This is not a shadowing internship: you'll own real problems at the intersection of manufacturing, logistics, and software, building the tools and the intelligent layers on top of them that help us install batteries faster and more reliably.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build internal tools, dashboards, and trackers that increase visibility across the supply chain.

 - Contribute to our internally built TMS, WMS, and MRP — wiring up data pipelines, integrations, and the models behind them.

 - Analyze operational data from ERP, supplier portals, and shipping systems to surface bottlenecks, blocked orders, and disruptions.

 - Prototype inventory and network optimization — multi-site / multi-warehouse stock optimization, warehouse slotting, and staffing/labor planning.

 - Build first-pass forecasting models for material demand (to feed MRP planning parameters) and for the reliability of supplier commitments — how likely a supplier is to actually hit committed dates and quantities.

 - Ship these inside the tools planners already use, not as notebooks on a shelf — and reach for the simplest method that works.

 - Partner directly with planners, buyers, and ops managers to scope small MVPs, deploy frequently, and iterate on real feedback.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Industrial/Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Data Science, or similar.

 - Comfort writing Python and SQL, and a genuine interest in building tools — not just analyzing data.

 - Some exposure to at least one of: optimization / operations research or basic ML / anomaly detection (coursework, projects, or prior internships all count).

 - Familiarity with data analysis and dashboarding; bonus for experience with pipelines, APIs, or ERP systems.

 - Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Builder mindset — enjoys ambiguity, takes ownership, and is excited to make things work better, not just measure them.

 - Experience in a tech-enabled operations environment is a plus— energy, logistics, or manufacturing.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Supply Chain team tackles the challenge of sourcing battery cells, assembling high-capacity packs, and forging vendor partnerships to produce and deliver the industry's lowest-cost, highest-quality home battery systems at unprecedented scale.

By optimizing landed costs through strategic global sourcing, domestic manufacturing ramp-up, and durable supplier relationships, your work directly powers Base Power's mission of advancing human prosperity through energy abundance - delivering reliable whole-home backup and below-market electricity rates to tens of thousands of households.

These efforts drive uniquely massive impact by fueling one of America's fastest-growing distributed virtual power plants, already exceeding 200 MWh deployed and aggregating flexible storage to bolster the grid against surging demands from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. Exceptional candidates will seize the chance to build the supply foundation for a company raising billions to manufacture in-house and expand nationally, achieving grid-scale resilience at speeds and costs no traditional player can replicate.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Intern - Multiple Teams
jobs.description:
Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Electrical Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in Phoenix, Arizona.

This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. Interns will contribute to the design, development, testing, integration, and support of aviation products and technologies.

Depending on the assigned location, team, and product line, interns may gain experience across electrical engineering disciplines such as analog, digital, power, radio frequency, high-speed circuitry, embedded systems, firmware, programmable logic, circuit card assemblies, and supporting cables or interfaces.

You will work alongside experienced engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams while developing your technical, analytical, and professional skills.

What you will do
• Work under the guidance of experienced electrical, hardware, firmware, and RF engineers.
• Support the development, analysis, and review of electrical and electronic designs for aerospace and avionics applications.
• Assist with circuit card design activities, including requirements development, schematic capture, simulation, design review, and hardware integration.
• Support analog, digital, power, RF, microwave, and multifunction circuit designs based on project needs.
• Contribute to programmable logic and FPGA development activities, which may include firmware requirements, RTL coding using VHDL or Verilog, simulation, synthesis, timing analysis, and implementation.
• Assist with the development of simulation testbenches, verification procedures, board-level test procedures, and test scripts.
• Execute engineering tests using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and power supplies.
• Collect, analyze, and summarize measurement data, test results, anomalies, and supporting technical evidence.
• Support hardware and FPGA bring-up, integration, troubleshooting, debugging, regression testing, and failure-reproduction activities.
• Participate in hardware, firmware, and software integration testing under engineering guidance.
• Support testing and analysis of RF performance characteristics that may include gain, noise figure, sensitivity, impedance matching, VSWR, spurious emissions, and harmonic emissions.
• Participate in design reviews, code reviews, peer reviews, technical discussions, defect investigations, and project status updates.
• Develop, modify, and maintain engineering documentation, including requirements, specifications, procedures, test results, and design records.
• Identify opportunities to improve simulation, verification, test efficiency, repeatability, automation, and documentation quality.
• Apply sound engineering judgment, attention to detail, and disciplined configuration control while working in a regulated aerospace environment.
Required Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
• Foundational knowledge in one or more of the following areas: 
• Analog or digital circuit design
• Electronic hardware development
• Digital logic or programmable logic
• RF, microwave, electromagnetics, or communication systems
• Embedded systems or computer architecture
• Basic understanding of the engineering development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, testing, verification, and documentation.
• Ability to follow detailed technical procedures and work safely with laboratory equipment.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to document technical work and test results accurately.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while completing assigned work with appropriate independence.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and seek guidance when needed. 
• This position may require access to information, technology, software, or hardware that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. To comply with these requirements, applicants must qualify as a U.S. Person
Preferred Qualifications
• Student entering junior or senior year, graduate student, or recent graduate preparing for an entry-level electrical engineering role.
• Coursework, academic projects, student organization experience, prior internship experience, or personal projects involving electrical hardware, firmware, FPGA, or RF engineering.
• Experience developing or reviewing electrical schematics and working with circuit cards or electronic assemblies.
• Coursework or project experience using VHDL or Verilog, including state machines, synchronous design, and timing fundamentals.
• Exposure to FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado or ISE, Intel Quartus, or similar tools.
• Experience with simulation tools such as ModelSim, QuestaSim, ADS, AWR, HFSS, or equivalent engineering applications.
• Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Tcl for test, build, or engineering automation.
• Familiarity with common digital interfaces and protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, AXI, Ethernet, or DDR.
• Exposure to embedded processors, microcontrollers, or system-on-chip FPGA technologies.
• Experience using electronic or RF laboratory test equipment.
• Familiarity with RF concepts such as transmission lines, S-parameters, impedance matching, gain, noise figure, modulation, RF link budgets, or spectrum requirements.
• Familiarity with avionics products or technologies such as TCAS, transponders, TAWS, ADS-B Out, or ADS-B In.
• Demonstrated initiative, intellectual curiosity, and eagerness to learn in a collaborative engineering environment.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Acron Aviation is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
 
Additional Information:
Acron Aviation maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where allowed by law. Acron Aviation is an E-Verify employer

At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. To our team, there is no room for anything less than providing the absolute best. Electronics & Controls Intern
jobs.description:
About Pratt Miller, an Oshkosh company

Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.

Electronics Internship to work with a small team of electronics engineers and technicians supporting engineering related projects. This position requires gaining and applying engineering knowledge to solve real world engineering design, testing, analysis, and development problems on a wide variety of products in the automotive, defense, motorsports, aerospace, marine, and smaller niche industries. These efforts can be applied to short or long-term projects including virtual prototype development, electronic component, system, and full vehicle design, laboratory testing, engineering analysis, control systems, and product/system validation. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND SKILLS: Typical responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

• Perform engineering analysis
• Create engineering drawings, technical reports and specifications
• Support design, selection, and integration of electronic components
• Specify wiring and PCB requirements and designs
• Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) for system use and maintenance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: In addition to the responsibilities mentioned above, tasks relating to the following areas will be assigned as required.

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
• Have great attention to detail, work ethic and pride in workmanship
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Be reliable (with reliable mode of transportation). 
• Have excellent mechanical ability and likes to work with their hands
• Effective time management and organizational abilities
• Microsoft Windows environment (Powerpoint, Excel, Teams, etc)

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION/YEARS OF EXPERIENCE:
• Working toward a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering: Electrical, Mechatronic, Computer or related technical field
• Prefer participation in one or more collegiate-level design competitions (Formula SAE, Baja SAE, First Robotics, Solar Car, etc)

DESIRED SPECIALIZED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:
• Experience with schematic generation tools
• Knowledge of CAN-based control systems, including architecture, programming, and diagnostics
• Experience in harness design, build, and maintenance for vehicle data systems
• Experience in PCB design and build
• Experience with CAD software and 3D printing
• Basic programming experience in languages such as Simulink, C++, Python, or Visual Basic

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
• Position requires occasional or frequent moderate physical activity

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK:
• Standard 40 hours/week, weekday schedule with some flexibility.

jobs.description:
Entity:

Job Family Group: 
Supply & Trading Group
Job Description: 
Data Strategist Intern – Global Data Strategists Team

Role Synopsis
An opportunity for an industrial research R&D internship, for up to six-month duration, is available with the Data Strategist team. Our team is located on trading floors in London, Singapore, New York and Houston, with a remit to provide cutting edge quantitative research to bp’s commercial teams. We bring advanced statistics and machine learning to trading, merging deep technical know-how with expert domain knowledge to generate tradable insights for the deployment of risk. The team works directly with Traders, Market Analysts and IT, making use of distinctive data sets and agile technology solutions.

Key Accountabilities
You will work on a cutting-edge R&D project on a technical topic of strong interest to the Data Strategist team. You will be expected to review the existing academic literature on the topic, understand the application context and to advance the team’s domain knowledge as an outcome of the research. Hands-on implementation of machine learning prototypes and working with data using python are key elements of the project. You will work closely with other Data Strategists and traders. On completion of the research you will produce a high-quality technical report and present your findings to the global team in a formal seminar.

Essential Education 
Undergraduate degree, plus PhD or MSc in a quantitative discipline, (e.g. physics, mathematics, electrical engineering or mathematical finance) from a top-class institution.

Essential experience and job requirements
• Deep understanding of mathematical finance

• Statistics

• Time series modelling

• Data analysis

• Behavioural finance

• Predictive modelling

• Numerical methods

• Machine learning algorithms

• Python programming

Key competencies
• Creativity and disciplined research approach

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Practical, problem-solving mindset – real data is messy!

Desirable criteria and qualifications
• Knowledge of traded markets and financial instruments in the energy and commodities domain

• Experience in a front office role of an investment bank, hedge fund or energy major

Travel Requirement
Negligible travel should be expected with this role
Relocation Assistance:
This role is not eligible for relocation
Remote Type:
This position is a hybrid of office/remote working
Skills:
Agility core practices, Analytical Thinking, Computational Thinking, Continuous Learning, Data Analysis, Data cleansing and transformation, Data Management, Data Sourcing, Data visualization and interpretation, Dialogue enablement, Exposure Management, Machine Learning (ML), Macroeconomics, Market analysis methods, Market Risk Management, Statistics, Trade execution and management, Trading Fundamentals, Sentiment and Trends, Trading knowledge.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern - Optical Transport and IP Networking
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Opportunity: Work term of 8 months starting in January 2027.

Ciena is seeking a university intern to gain practical experience across software engineering, optical transport telecommunications, and Layer 3/IP networking. This role provides exposure to lab-based engineering, automation, technical validation, and knowledge transfer activities supporting Ciena networking solutions. The opportunity is suited for students interested in applying academic learning within a telecommunications engineering environment.
How you will make an impact:
• Conduct lab engineering activities for optical transport, routing, switching, and software-based networking solutions.
• Perform software development, scripting, automation, testing, and troubleshooting in a lab environment.
• Configure, validate, and document network scenarios involving Layer 3/IP networking concepts.
• Execute test plans, collect results, analyze issues, and document findings.
• Contribute to technical documentation, training materials, demonstrations, and knowledge-transfer content.
• Learn and document how new product features and solution capabilities are introduced to Services teams, partners, and customers.
• Collaborate with global technical teams across software, optical networking, and IP networking initiatives.
The must haves:
• Education: Actively enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field,
• Foundational software engineering skills, including experience with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar.
• Basic understanding of software development practices such as version control, debugging, testing, and documentation.
• Foundational understanding of Layer 3/IP networking concepts, including IP addressing, routing, switching, TCP/IP, and common network protocols.
• Interest in optical transport telecommunications, such as DWDM, OTN, coherent optics, photonic systems, or carrier networking technologies.
• Comfortable working in a lab environment with hardware, software, network elements, test tools, and engineering documentation.

Nice to haves:
• Experience with Python scripting, automation, REST APIs, Linux, Git, or similar development tools.
• Exposure to telecommunications or networking courses, labs, projects, or co-op experience.
• Familiarity with routing protocols such as OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, or MPLS concepts.
• Exposure to optical networking concepts such as fiber optics, wavelength division multiplexing, OTN, or coherent transmission.
• Experience creating technical documentation, lab notes, topology diagrams, or presentations.
• Interest in network automation, software-defined networking, cloud-based tools, or test automation.
Pay Range:
