jobs.title: Data Scientist - Nuclear Threat Reduction
jobs.description:
If you’d like to be considered for this opportunity we encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment as if applications are high the role will close before the closing date given. 

Year in Industry Placement - Data Scientist (Nuclear Threat Reduction) 
Salary 
£24,500 per annum plus benefits 
Location 
Aldermaston, near Reading, Berkshire; onsite 
Contract 
12 months 
Start date 
2 August 2027 
Working pattern 
9-day working fortnight 
 
About AWE 
What if you could work with remarkable people on extraordinary things? What if the end result was something a little bit special? What if your role was mission critical? 
For over 75 years, AWE has been at the forefront of nuclear weapons research and development. We have a critical mission: to provide the warheads for the UK's ultimate deterrent, Trident. We also use our unique skills to provide wider UK government with counter-terrorism and nuclear threat reduction solutions. 
It takes a special sort of person to work at AWE. What if that person was you? 
Role purpose 
Nuclear Threat Reduction supports the Government on national security issues involving radiological and nuclear materials. Work ranges from fundamental and novel research to the applied development of technology demonstrators. The team supports the Ministry of Defence by providing technical advice on detecting nuclear and radiological material, nuclear forensics, and international treaty monitoring and verification. These mission areas involve collecting and analysing large, complex datasets spanning multiple scientific techniques. 
This project investigates how data science techniques can contribute to analysing and understanding data gathered in support of the Nuclear Threat Reduction mission. You will gain experience of working in a multidisciplinary team of scientists applying data science techniques across a range of datasets. Following your year with us, you may have the opportunity to secure a graduate role for when you graduate. 
Entry requirements 
We are interested in candidates studying: 
• Computer Science 
• Forensics 
• Physics 
• Chemistry 
• Mathematics 
• You must be on track to achieve a minimum 2:2 in your degree by August 2027. 
• You must be graduating in either 2029 or 2030 and completing a placement year as part of your degree. 

Behaviours and qualities 
You will possess the following traits and qualities: 
• Growth mindset: You are full of grit and determination, clear about where you are going and how you will get there. 
• Curious: You love to think outside the box, and may even want to take the box apart. 
• Innovative: You are open to learning about new technologies and ground-breaking ideas. 
• Resilience: You advocate speaking up for yourself and others openly and constructively. 
• Team worker: You are dependable and reliable, and interested in collaborating with and supporting others. 

Salary and benefits 
• £24,500 salary. 
• A market-leading contributory pension scheme. 
• Generous holiday entitlement. 
• Excellent work-life balance. 
• A 9-day working fortnight, meaning you get every other Friday off work. 
Alongside these benefits, you will have the opportunity to learn from some of the top leaders in their field. 

Recuitment process and key dates 
• Online application: Choose the pathway that best matches your interests and goals. 
• Online assessment: If eligible, complete numerical, verbal, logical and cognitive reasoning assessments. Practice materials will be available. 
• Virtual assessment centre: Successful candidates will be invited to a virtual assessment centre during November or December 2026. 
• Pre-assessment support: Receive webinar guidance so you know what to expect. 
• Offer and clearance: Successful candidates will complete offer and security-clearance stages before joining in August 2027. 

Security requirements 
You must be a UK national holding a UK passport to be eligible to apply to AWE. You must have lived in the UK for 10 years to apply for Developed Vetting (DV) clearance for this role. 

Inclusion and diversity 
Our ambition is to create workplaces where we recognise and celebrate differences, encourage diverse contributions and enable employees to feel able to be themselves at work. We strive to create a genuine culture of openness and inclusion and encourage diverse applicants. 
Any inclusion information you provide will be used to encourage and support you through the application process and will be held only for this purpose in accordance with GDPR. 

Next steps: 
Everyone who works at AWE brings unique skills and perspectives to the table. We recognise that great people don’t always ‘tick every box’. That’s why we focus on your potential, your fit with our values, your transferable skills as well as your experience. Even if you don’t meet every point above, but you feel that this role and AWE are a great fit for you, please go ahead and apply, we’d love to receive your application.

Important things you need to know:
• We encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment if applications are high and the role therefore closes.
• You will need to obtain and maintain the necessary security clearance for the role. This will be funded by AWE. The nature of our work does mean you need to be a British Citizen who has been resident in the UK for the past 5 years in order to apply for SC clearance and 10 years for DV. 
• We want you to feel comfortable and able to shine during our recruitment process. Please let us know on your application form if you need any adjustments/accommodations during the process. 
• Our interviews typically take place over Teams and for most roles are a 1 stage process.

Our ambition is to create workplaces where we recognise and celebrate differences, encourage diverse contributions and our employees feel able to be themselves at work. We strive to create a genuine culture of openness and inclusion and encourage diverse applicants. Any inclusion information you provide will be stored in accordance with GDPR and kept separate from your application form and CV, and the information will not be shared with anyone involved in interviewing or making hiring decisions.
Please note that you must be a British Citizen to apply for a role with us.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

About the Team
At Micron Technology, we transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. The Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG) HBM Architecture team develops future High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) architectures, PHY design methodologies, and automation solutions that enable next-generation AI, high-performance computing, networking, and data center applications. The team works closely with Architecture, Design Engineering, Verification, Product Engineering, and external partners to advance memory technologies while improving design quality, productivity, and development efficiency.

Position Overview
As a Senior or Graduate Engineering Intern, you will collaborate with experienced HBM architects and engineers to support the development of digital design methodologies, automation frameworks, timing analysis flows, and architecture validation solutions for next-generation HBM PHY and IO subsystems. This role offers hands-on experience in digital design, verification, automation, and timing analysis, while providing opportunities to leverage AI Assisted engineering workflows, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Generative AI tools to enhance engineering productivity and design efficiency.

Responsibilities
• Support digital design, integration, and timing analysis activities for HBM PHY and IO subsystems, including timing constraint development and timing closure efforts.
• Develop and implement verification solutions using Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based environments, analyze simulation results, and debug functional or timing-related issues.
• Create Python-based automation tools and AI Assisted engineering workflows that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies to improve engineering efficiency.
• Collaborate with architecture, design, verification, and product engineering teams to evaluate features, validate architectures, and improve design quality metrics.
• Document technical findings and present results through design reviews, engineering discussions, and project presentations.

Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• Demonstrated understanding of digital design concepts including finite state machines (FSMs), pipelining, clock-domain crossing (CDC), timing analysis, and computer architecture.
• Experience with RTL design and verification concepts using Verilog or SystemVerilog.
• Proficiency in Python, C++, or a comparable programming language, and experience working in Linux-based development environments.
• Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with digital implementation flows, static timing analysis (STA), timing closure methodologies, and timing constraint development.
• Familiarity with UVM-based verification environments and regression infrastructure development.
• Experience using EDA tools from Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens, or equivalent vendors.
• Exposure to automation, software development, data analytics, AI Assisted workflows, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Generative AI-based productivity solutions.
• Coursework, research, or project experience related to VLSI design, digital systems, computer architecture, memory systems, timing analysis, or mixed-signal design environments.

jobs.title: Process Improvement Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
At Enact, we understand that there’s no place like home. That’s why we bring our deep expertise, insightful offerings, and extra mile service to work every day to help lenders put more people in homes and keep them there.

We’re looking for a Process Improvement Analyst Intern in Raleigh, NC to join us in fulfilling our mission, while utilizing our values of excellence, improvement, and connection. In addition to the multiple weekly events attended by all interns, you’ll work alongside industry experts for a 12-week internship beginning May 17, 2027. In this role, you will support the expansion of our internal Operations Copilot by contributing to evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement processes.

THE PROGRAM 

Enact’s Internship Program provides an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on experience in achieving business results while developing technical and professional skills. The internship program is a critical component of Enact’s talent pipeline as we look to interns to provide cutting edge ideas and skills that will drive business success.

Enact invests time, energy, and resources to create a worthwhile experience for interns. Interns work on meaningful business projects, but beyond that, they will network directly with leaders throughout the company (all the way up to the CEO), attend teambuilding events with their internship cohort, connect with the community through volunteer opportunities (both on-site and off-site), and attend professional development workshops. It’s a unique internship experience that helps interns develop a network of peers and mentors who act as a source of constant engagement and guidance during the internship.

LOCATION
Enact Headquarters, Raleigh, NC – Hybrid Schedule

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design month-to-month sampling aligned to company statistical methods and implement reproducible cohorts.
• Define and curate a “golden dataset” covering happy paths, edge cases, and synthetic augmentation to evaluate consistency and bias.
• Stand up continuous monitoring dashboards and alerting, supporting prompt versioning and automated regression testing.
• Build a closed-loop improvement process using test findings and underwriter feedback to guide operational playbooks.
• Document and communicate test plans, metrics, and release notes to support change management across underwriting. ​

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

• Pursuing a Bachelor’s/Master’s in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related field.
• Coursework or projects in experimental design, sampling techniques, and statistical inference.
• Hands-on experience with Python/SQL, data wrangling, and metrics design; familiarity with Snowflake or BI tools preferred.
• Interest in LLM/GenAI evaluation, prompt management, and MLOps.
• Strong communication skills and ability to turn analysis into operational playbooks. ​

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience building evaluation harnesses (regression suites, golden datasets).
• Exposure to cloud data pipelines and observability/alerting frameworks.
• Understanding of document extraction and data validation in financial services. ​

COMPANY
Enact Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACT), operating primarily through its wholly owned subsidiaries, is a leading publicly traded U.S. private mortgage insurance provider, offering borrower-centric products that enable lenders and other partners across the U.S. to help people responsibly achieve and maintain the dream of homeownership.

By empowering customers and their borrowers, Enact seeks to positively impact the lives of those in the communities in which it serves in a sustainable way. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, we play an active role in supporting a prosperous Triangle community. We also support our colleagues’ philanthropic efforts in their home communities across the U.S. Enact values all perspectives, characteristics and experiences, along with providing a positive and inclusive culture for employees to grow and succeed. We strive to create an environment where employees can bring their full, authentic selves to work to help each other and their customers.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and all hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

WHY WORK AT ENACT

• We bring innovative thinking to the situations at hand
• We seek out and incorporate diverse views to strengthen our outcomes
• We work on challenging and rewarding projects

This role is eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.   

Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

Job Description:
Length of term: 4 months (Winter 2027)

HYBRID

This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.

This co-op opportunity is voluntarily in person, remote or hybrid. If you decide remote or hybrid, you will be required to work within the province. Remote work outside of the province will not be a possibility. 
You will be joining one of our exciting teams in Corporate IT. At Corporate IT our team is focused on enabling technology at Sun Life through delivering robust, scalable, secure and reusable platforms and services that operate within our Enterprise Cloud, API and DevOps environments.

What will you do?
• Under the guidance of a Senior Engineer, contribute to the development, testing and deployment of APIs
• May assist in gathering functional requirements, developing technical specifications and test plans with internal team members and external partners
• Support in system or project documentation
• Work in a cross-functional Agile Scrum team

What do you need to succeed?
• Currently enrolled in a relevant technology program, such Computer Science or Engineering
• Enthusiasm, professionalism, and willingness to learn
• Fast learner with a keen interest in picking up new technologies
• Strong coding, debugging and problem-solving skills
• Knowledge of an object-oriented programming language such as C# or Java
• Familiarity of Python, Microsoft .Net core, .Net, Java Springboot framework
• Familiarity with SQL for relational or NoSQL databases
• A graduation date of April 2027 or later. 

What is in it for you?
• A friendly, collaborative, and inclusive culture where you’re an innovator and trusted partner
• An environment of continuous learning and improvement
• We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada
• Gain experience with a development team that uses some of the cutting-edge development technologies such as Azure DevOps, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted for. The Base Pay which you will be considered for will vary depending on the Campus program you are selected for.

Eligible Sun Life employees for various Campus Graduate programs will also participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Description:
About MedTech
Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.
Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Technology and Digital Quality Internship 
We are seeking highly motivated and meticulous Sophomores, Juniors and rising Seniors for the 2027 Summer Internship within the Technology and Digital Quality organization. We work on a “hybrid model”. This means that you will be asked to report on site three (3) times a week and can work remotely two (2) times a week. If you are selected for an intern position, you will work directly with your manager as your start date approaches to confirm your exact schedule. 
This position offers a valuable opportunity for hands-on experience in analyzing business processes and data, supporting decision-making processes, analyzing business challenges, formulating recommendations for improvement, and contributing to data-driven strategies across various T&DQ Functions. The ideal candidate will assist in gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help our organization make informed decisions. Below are a few examples of the types of experiences you can expect: 
• Digital Product Analysis: Understand and analyze end-to-end business processes and translate needs into digital solutions by building product backlogs in the form of user stories. 
• Data Ingestion and Engineering: Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets for analysis from various sources such as databases, APIs, and spreadsheets. 
• Data Analysis and Reporting: Perform statistical analysis and data mining to identify patterns, correlations, and insights into business data. Develop visualizations and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Excel to communicate data findings to key stakeholders. 
• AI and Automation: Create automated workflows for data extraction, transformation, and reporting using Python, R, or SQL. Contribute to the adoption of AI and digital technologies by supporting validation activities that enable innovative solutions while maintaining regulatory and compliance standards.
• Support Decision-Making: Assist in analyzing data to support business decisions and pivotal initiatives and partnering to put together recommendations for leadership.
• Collaboration: Work closely with various departments, including QA-Ops, JJRC, finance and operations to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.
• Continuous Process Improvement: Document methodologies, processes, and results to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing within the team. 
Not only will you develop your analytical skills through on-the-job assignments. You will: 
• Improve your industry knowledge through open forum conversations with senior company leaders and shadowing of T&DQ personnel. 
• Work in a fast-paced, technologically sophisticated corporate environment in an Internship program focused on developing individual analysts capable of pursuing careers across pharmaceutical and medical device businesses. 
• Build or improve your personal brand through skills building workshops and networking mixers. 
• Present your learnings and development experience to leadership. 
• Have the power to connect with and support our local towns through community activities. 
To be considered for the T&DQ 2027 Summer Internship program, you must meet the following requirements: 
• Permanent US work authorization without the need for sponsorship now, or in the future (F1, H1B, CPT, OPT or STEM OPT require sponsorship in future). 
• Enrollment (not necessarily taking classes) in an accredited college/university during the Internship. By start date, student must be considered an undergraduate sophomore or above. Master’s students must have earned undergraduate degree on or after June 2027. 
• Have a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher, which is reflective of all college coursework. 
• Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in science, communications, regulatory compliance, quality, finance, data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, supply chain, or technology related field. 
• Ability to clearly present data findings and interpretations to both technical and non-technical partners. 
• Ability to break down challenging problems into manageable components and derive actionable insights. 
• Understanding statistical concepts such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and data distribution. 
• Ability to work through challenges logically and deliver solutions efficiently. 
• Ability to provide their own transportation to this location and to/from work every day. 
• Ability to work full-time (40 hours a week) for the whole term.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Proven leadership and/or participation in campus/community service activities.
• Previous internship, Co-Op, or academic experience in a related field.
• Basic proficiency in data analysis tools Python, R, or SQL, and visualization tools Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.
• Familiarity with Cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Basic proficiency in IA tools, such as Power Platform
• Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and AI platforms/LLMs and tools.
• Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery methodologies.
• Six Sigma Green Belt certification

The expected pay range for this position is between $23.50 per hour and $52.50 per hour but will be based on candidate's program year, discipline, degree and/or experience. Co-Ops/Interns are eligible to participate in Company sponsored employee medical benefits in accordance with the terms of the plan. Co-Ops and Interns are eligible for the following sick time benefits: up to 40 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Washington, up to 56 hours per calendar year. Co-Ops and Interns are eligible to participate in the Company’s consolidated retirement plan (pension).

jobs.title: Data Science Intern
jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe. NCR Atleos was ranked #12 in Newsweek’s prestigious 2025 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® list.

Our NCR Atleos Global Internship Program offers a unique opportunity to explore the intersection of innovation and financial technology. Interns work alongside teams shaping the future of self-service banking, gaining firsthand experience with the tools and strategies that power millions of transactions every day. 
At NCR Atleos, you’ll be immersed in a culture that values curiosity and creativity. Our program is designed to accelerate your professional growth and help you build lasting connections. Many of our interns go on to join us full-time, equipped with the skills and relationships they’ve developed during their time here. 
If you’re ready to be part of something global, innovative and impactful, your journey starts here. 

 Data Science Intern – Overview

The Data Science team at NCR Atleos, established in 2019, is building a world-class analytics organization to drive innovation and operational excellence. As a Data Science Intern, you’ll work alongside experienced data scientists, analysts, and business leaders to solve real-world challenges using data-driven insights. This internship offers exposure to advanced analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence, with opportunities to contribute to impactful projects across the business.

Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with teams across Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance to understand business needs and support data-driven solutions.
• Assist in building and testing statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve business problems.
• Support data preparation, cleaning, and integration from structured and unstructured sources.
• Help develop dashboards and visualizations using tools like Power BI or Python-based libraries.
• Participate in projects such as cash forecasting, causal analysis, and geospatial data visualization.
• Contribute to the automation of data workflows and reporting processes.
• Document findings, methodologies, and project outcomes for internal use.

Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
• Familiarity with Python and SQL for data analysis and modeling.
• Understanding of statistical techniques such as regression, clustering, and time series analysis.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills and ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
• Interest in learning about cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks), geospatial tools (e.g., ArcGIS), and data visualization.

Why NCR Atleos?
Interns at NCR Atleos are part of a global team driving transformation in financial and retail technology. You’ll work on impactful projects, receive mentorship from industry experts, and gain exposure to enterprise-level systems and innovation.
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

Full time employee benefits include:
• Medical Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Life Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Short/Long Term Disability

• Paid Vacation

• 401k

NCR Atleos is an equal-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

By applying to NCR Atleos jobs, you acknowledge that the terms of the NCR Atleos Applicant Privacy Notice (Applicant Privacy Policy | NCR Atleos) will govern the collection and use of your Personal Data. This notice supplements NCR Atleos Privacy Policy, which is available at www.ncratleos.com/privacy

Statement to Third Party Agencies
To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Atleos only accepts resumes from agencies on the NCR Atleos preferred supplier list. jobs.description:
Job Description:
Summer 2027 Internship – Data Analyst Intern

Application Deadline: November 13, 2027
We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027 
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)

About Our Internship Program:
Dow Jones Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how . Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside our teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

At Xcel Energy, our employees are the driving force behind our success. So we make sure that, here, you can be your best. Doing work that makes a difference for neighbors and communities. Working with a team you can count on to push you. Expanding skills, staying ready for change, and capturing opportunities to grow. All with the support, rewards and recognition you need to thrive – during your internship and beyond.
 
Position Summary
Xcel Energy is seeking candidates to support our CFO Organization, specifically, within our Load Research or Energy and Demand Forecasting teams. These teams develop load profiles, forecasts, and analytical studies that support Xcel Energy’s resource planning, budgeting, regulatory filings, rate cases, and generation development decisions. Together, the teams work across the company on high-impact research and modeling efforts, including interval meter data analysis, weather-normalized load modeling, typical-load-year forecasts, class-level load studies, climate and emerging-technology impact analysis, EV adoption forecasting, and migration of analytics into Databricks. Interns may contribute to research, technical development, statistical modeling, or data analysis projects based on their interests and skill sets, with work that directly informs planning processes and ongoing business needs.
 
Typical intern responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
- Support load research and forecasting projects by gathering, reviewing, and summarizing data.
- Assist with analysis used for planning, budgeting, regulatory, and business decision-making.
- Help improve tools, reports, and processes that support recurring forecasting and research work.
- Explore how customer behavior, weather, and new technologies may affect energy use.
- Learn forecasting concepts and contribute to projects that strengthen future forecasting capabilities.
- Document work and share findings with team members and internal stakeholders.
 
This position is for a May 24, 2027 start date. This position may have the possibility to extend beyond the internship’s initial term based on the candidate’s successful performance and Xcel Energy’s business needs.

· Able to work full-time during the summer (up to 40 hours a week)/ part time during the school year (up to 20 hours a week) and commuting to the designated work location in-person, per our hybrid work policy.
· Good organizational, communication and problem-solving skills

• Experience with Python (pandas) or R, SQL, and/or Databricks

jobs.title: AI & Data Analytics Intern - Supply Resilience
jobs.description:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Seeking an innovative, data-driven AI & Data Analytics Intern to lead the development of an intelligent, predictive supply chain risk assessment tool. In this role, you will leverage internal enterprise data, external market intelligence, and advanced machine learning models to build an AI solution capable of forecasting supply chain disruptions before they impact operations.
Job Description
Are you ready to build data-driven solutions that protect and strengthen global supply chains? As the AI & Data Analytics Intern - Supply Resilience, you will integrate internal metrics—such as lead times, supplier performance, and inventory levels—with external market data, including geopolitical risks, weather events, commodity prices, and trade tariffs. In this hands-on role, you will design and validate predictive machine learning models (such as risk scoring, time-series forecasting, and anomaly detection) to flag supply bottlenecks and vendor risks before they occur. Using tools like Python/R and Power BI or Tableau, you will transform model outputs into actionable dashboards for supply chain planners and communicate key insights to business stakeholders.

This internship includes:

Data Integration & Pipeline Development: Identify, aggregate, and ingest internal supply chain metrics (lead times, supplier performance, inventory levels) alongside external market data (geopolitical risks, weather events, commodity price trends, trade tariffs).
AI/ML Model Development: Design, train, and validate predictive algorithms (e.g., risk scoring, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection) to flag potential supply bottlenecks and vendor risks.
Tool & Interface Creation: Build a functional prototype/dashboard or integrate model outputs into an actionable tool for supply chain planners.
Market Research & Feature Engineering: Analyze macro-market trends to engineer features that improve model accuracy and early-warning alerts.
Documentation & Communication: Present model logic, accuracy benchmarks, and actionable insights to key stakeholders and operations teams.

Additional Qualified Skills:
• Power BI, or Tableau for user interface creation.
• Python or R, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy
• Analytical problem-solving, independent initiative, ability to translate complex data into business insights
• Desired: Understanding of logistics, lead times, procurement dynamics, and risk factors

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Operations, or a related field

• Graduation date not later then Dec.2029

In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

• Engage directly with clients and drive the implementation and successful end user experience of analytics solutions.
• Analyze business processes and requirements, and assist in maintaining documentation including requirements, design, and user documentation

• You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspect of your work: Integrity, Respect & Collaboration

• Strong attention to the quality of work delivered (attention to detail)

The expected range of compensation for this role is $53,000-$78,000.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences. 

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.
 
Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:
 
• We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.

jobs.title: Weapon Systems Algorithms Engineer - Undergraduate Placement
jobs.description:
Weapon Systems Algorithms Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027

An Algorithm Engineer's role is to build the code that forms the digital nervous system of a product. In the Weapons System Algorithms & Performance team (WSAP), your solutions and ideas will impact emerging and future technologies.
It's our job to develop and optimise the algorithms inside weapon systems across the whole of MBDA.

Salary: £24,460

Dynamic working: : 2-3 days per week on-site due to workload classification

Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.

This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

What we can offer you:
• 1 year placement: Starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies 

• Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year 

• Company bonus: Based on company performance and will vary year to year

• Pension: Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%

• Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime

• Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday

• Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days

• Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…

• Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.

The opportunity: 

As an Engineer in the Weapon Systems Design division, you will be part of a rapidly expanding area of the MBDA business - providing specialist technical support at system level to a range of high-profile projects, including Future Combat Air System (FCAS), STRATUS and DragonFire.
The Weapon System Algorithms and Performance (WSAP) department specialises in a broad range of areas: developing cutting-edge algorithms, mathematically evaluating the performance of products, and working with the future business teams to bring technical excellence to our future concepts. We leverage the use of leading technologies and tools such as deep reinforcement learning and test-driven algorithm development to provide optimised weapon system solutions across the whole of the MBDA product line.
Over your time in the department, you’ll have visibility on not only algorithm development but weapon system architecture, performance modelling, and early stage concepting. Starting as an Algorithms Engineer in WSAP, you will work directly with MBDA project teams to ensure the delivery of critical algorithm components on time, on cost, and on quality to key programmes.

Our algorithms team is currently working on:

• Routing algorithms for long-range strike weapons
• Operator decision aids for strike mission planning
• Threat evaluation & weapon assignment algorithms for air defence
• Multi-weapon co-operation
• Application of machine learning techniques to air-to-air combat

Regardless of which project you work on, you’ll be part of a team comprising some of the most talented engineers, scientists and technicians in their fields, helping to deliver innovative battle-winning capabilities to MBDA’s customers across the globe

What we’re looking for from you:

Current undergrad working towards a degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science.
We are particularly interested in hearing from applicants with a strong interest in mathematics and applying mathematical techniques to engineering problems. Experience in programming for scientific/engineering applications (e.g. MATLAB, Python) would be an advantage.

Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given

We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more…

We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process.

jobs.title: Simulation and Modelling Engineer - Undergraduate Placement
jobs.description:
Simulation and Modelling Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027

Modelling modern weapon systems comes with many unique challenges. As a model developer, you will be working with highly sophisticated models, built up of multiple interdependent subsystems, to provide an accurate representation of the weapon system being used in real-world engagements. This means you'll often encounter new and exciting problems requiring your intuition and innovation to solve. 

Salary: £24,460

Dynamic working: The majority of your time you’ll be working onsite in an office environment with a team of people around you to support you with your work.

Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. 
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. 

This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

What we can offer you:
• 1 year placement: starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies

• Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year 

• Company bonus: based on company performance and will vary year to year

• Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%

• Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime

• Healthcare Cash Plan: provides support with everyday health related costs – including medical, dental, optical, physio and health & wellbeing

• Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday

• Flexi Leave: up to 15 additional days

• Facilities: fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…

The opportunity:

System modelling is a vital tool used to ensure MBDA provides reliable and cost effective weapon systems to our customers!

We build a variety of dynamic system performance models, embedded systems and real time models for MBDA products. Our models are developed and used extensively throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through to in service support. When used internally our performance models allow our system designers to estimate performance, which they can use to guide the product design. For our customer, performance models provide a method of verifying system performance whilst reducing reliance on prohibitively expensive testing and trials. Our real time models contribute to training environments for pilots and provide a variety of engineering testing capabilities. Once the product is in service, the customer continues to use our models to understand system capability and assist with operator training.

Models of modern weapon system are made up of a large number of automated subsystems integrated together to provide the overall capability. This provides unique challenges when: developing accurate system - or system of system level - models that are both large in scale and highly sophisticated with many interdependencies; or when developing lower fidelity models designed to run at real time whilst maintaining an accurate representation of the weapon system. As a model developer this means you’ll often encounter new and exciting problems which will require you to apply your intuition and innovation to solve.

You’ll learn how to build simulation software in programming languages/environments such as:
• Mathworks (MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow)

• Fortran

• C/C++

Our teams implement Agile working practices and dynamic working across multiple projects to meet demand, aided by the use of collaborative tools. We also work closely with other departments and companies to integrate subsystem models and design data. From these interactions you’ll gain a broad understanding of each subsystem that makes up the weapon and how the system architecture makes these subsystems work together to provide an overall capability.

This role is best suited to those interested in mathematical modelling and programming, are passionate about solving complex problems within highly technical teams and enjoy working in a supportive environment.

Current undergraduate studying towards a degree in an Engineering discipline (incl. General, Mechanical, Manufacturing / Production, Aeronautical/Aerospace, Software), or Mathematics, Physics, Computing or Natural Science field.

jobs.description:
Weapon Systems Algorithms Engineer - Summer Placement 2027

An Algorithm Engineer’s role is to build the code that forms the digital nervous system of a product. In the Weapons System Algorithms & Performance team (WSAP), your solutions and ideas will impact emerging and future technologies.
It's our job to develop and optimise the algorithms inside weapon systems across the whole of MBDA.

Salary: £24,460 (pro-rata)

Dynamic (hybrid) working: 2-3 days per week on-site due to workload classification

Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. 
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.

This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

What we can offer you:

10 week placement: Starting June 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies
Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year 
Pension: Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime
Annual Leave: 5 days
Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more.

The opportunity:

As an Engineer in the Weapon Systems Design division, you will be part of a rapidly expanding area of the MBDA business - providing specialist technical support at system level to a range of high-profile projects, including Future Combat Air System (FCAS), STRATUS and DragonFire.

The Weapon System Algorithms and Performance (WSAP) department specialises in a broad range of areas: developing cutting-edge algorithms, mathematically evaluating the performance of products, and working with the future business teams to bring technical excellence to our future concepts. We leverage the use of leading technologies and tools such as deep reinforcement learning and test-driven algorithm development to provide optimised weapon system solutions across the whole of the MBDA product line.

Over your time in the department, you’ll have visibility on not only algorithm development but weapon system architecture, performance modelling, and early stage concepting. Starting as an Algorithms Engineer in WSAP, you will work directly with MBDA project teams to ensure the delivery of critical algorithm components on time, on cost, and on quality to key programmes.
Our algorithms team is currently working on:
• Routing algorithms for long-range strike weapons

• Operator decision aids for strike mission planning

• Threat evaluation & weapon assignment algorithms for air defence

• Multi-weapon co-operation

• Application of machine learning techniques to air-to-air combat

Regardless of which project you work on, you’ll be part of a team comprising some of the most talented engineers, scientists and technicians in their fields, helping to deliver innovative battle-winning capabilities to MBDA’s customers across the globe

What we're looking for from you:

Current undergraduate working towards a degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science.

We are particularly interested in hearing from applicants with a strong interest in mathematics and applying mathematical techniques to engineering problems. Experience in programming for scientific/engineering applications (e.g. MATLAB, Python) would be an advantage.

jobs.description:
Job Description
The Role: 
Support the Chevrolet IndyCar Program by turning race, telemetry, timing, scoring, and track data into reliable analysis and decision support. The intern will work with Drew Bennison and the Race Strategy & Analytics team to prepare data, test analytical tools, evaluate model outputs, and communicate findings that help improve race-weekend execution.

The Team: 
The Motorsports Competition analytics team develops practical tools for race strategy and performance improvement across road courses, street circuits, ovals, and superspeedways. The team partners with race engineers, strategists, Chevrolet teams, Ilmor, GM engineering groups, and data/software specialists to make better decisions throughout testing, race events, and the offseason.

What You’ll Do: 
• Assist with collecting, cleaning, organizing, and validating IndyCar race, telemetry, timing, scoring, fuel, tire, and track data.
• Support back-testing, scenario analysis, and basic simulation of race-strategy recommendations.
• Help evaluate model inputs and outputs related to fuel usage, tire performance, cautions, pit cycles, track position, and remaining-race conditions.
• Maintain track configuration data, timing lines, pit segments, logical segments, and related documentation.
• Create clear charts, summaries, dashboards, and technical documentation for engineering and competition stakeholders.
• Support software and data-engineering tasks such as testing workflows, checking APIs or data pipelines, documenting defects, and verifying fixes.
• Participate in race-replay reviews and help compare model recommendations with actual race outcomes.
• Learn and apply disciplined practices for version control, testing, data quality, and communicating analytical assumptions.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

At Xcel Energy, our employees are the driving force behind our success. So we make sure that, here, you can be your best. Doing work that makes a difference for neighbors and communities. Working with a team you can count on to push you. Expanding skills, staying ready for change, and capturing opportunities to grow. All with the support, rewards and recognition you need to thrive – during your internship and beyond.

Xcel Energy is seeking candidates to support our Customer Energy and Transportation Solutions (CETS) organization, specifically within the Product Planning and Strategy team in Minneapolis, MN or Denver, CO. This paid internship offers a unique opportunity to work on high-impact analytical projects that support the planning, evaluation, and regulatory reporting of demand-side management (DSM) programs serving customers across our service territory. The intern will work directly with technical consultants to evaluate the cost-effectiveness and financial performance of DSM programs for Northern States Power-Minnesota (NSP-M) and Public Service Company (PSCo). A key responsibility of the role will be supporting the development of cost-benefit analyses and associated documentation for regulatory filings, including ownership of analytical components supporting the Company's South Dakota DSM filing.

In addition to regulatory and financial analysis activities, the intern will help identify and implement process improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of program planning and reporting. This includes evaluating opportunities for new dashboards, automated reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that provide ongoing visibility into program financial incentives, cost-effectiveness metrics, and mid-year program performance. jobs.title: Healthcare Analytics Intern
jobs.description:
At Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Nebraska, we are a mission-driven organization dedicated to championing the health and well-being of our members and the communities we serve.

Our team is the power behind that promise. And, as the industry rapidly evolves and we seek ways to optimize business processes and customer experiences, there’s no greater time for forward-thinking professionals like you to join us in delivering on it! As a member of Team Blue, you’ll find purpose, opportunities and the support you need to build a meaningful career and make a powerful impact in our community.

Are you interested in how hospitals and healthcare organization reimbursement for patient care is determined and applied? This internship offers an opportunity to learn about this, while providing hands-on experience with healthcare financial data, claims management, reimbursement methodologies, and impact model reporting while developing data analytics and business intelligence skills.

As a Healthcare Analytics Intern (Value-Based Program), you will work alongside value-based care and reimbursement professionals to support the analysis, reporting, and administration of value-based care programs. This role provides hands-on experience with healthcare analytics, financial performance measurement, provider reimbursement models, and healthcare operations while developing skills in data analysis, reporting, and process improvement.

Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Nebraska is a Partner of Choice for the Nebraska University System. Our Interns work a hybrid schedule and spend some days working on-site at our Omaha office located in Aksarben Village. Therefore, you will need to live within commuting distance from Wednesday, May 26 – Friday, July 30, 2027.

What You'll Do:
• Learn how healthcare claims data, provider reimbursement, population health, and value-based care programs are used to support business decisions.
• Build an understanding of how health insurance companies and healthcare providers work together to improve quality, member experience, and cost of care.
• Help create reports and dashboards that track trends in quality, cost, utilization, and financial performance.
• Support business processes and workflows that help value-based care programs run effectively.
• Assist with reviewing program performance, incentive payment calculations, and cost and utilization trends.
• Prepare reports, presentations, and summaries that help share key findings in a clear and meaningful way.

To be considered for this position you must have:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, Public Health, or a related field.

The strongest candidates for this position will also possess:
• Experience using Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, or data analysis tools.
• Familiarity with SQL, Databricks, or Power BI –or a willingness to learn.
• Interest in healthcare finance, reimbursement, contracting, revenue cycle, or healthcare operations.
• Curiosity and strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with an interest in learning how to apply them in a healthcare business setting.

What You'll Learn:
• How healthcare claims data is used to analyze trends and support business decisions.
• The basics of value-based care, provider reimbursement, and alternative payment models.
• How cost, quality, utilization, and financial performance are measured in healthcare.
• How dashboards and reports are developed to share data insights.
• How population health strategies support better outcomes and member experience.
• How health insurance companies and healthcare providers work together to improve outcomes and manage costs.
• How business processes and program administration support value-based care initiatives.
• How to communicate analytical insights through reports, presentations, and summaries.

#LI-DNP

Learn more about what makes BCBSNE such an exceptional place to work by visiting NebraskaBlue.com/Careers.

jobs.description:
At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.   

Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

Job Description:

You are as unique as your background, experience, and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families, and communities around the world. 

What’s it like to work at Sun Life?
You’ll find it dynamic and highly professional; collaborative and supportive. We encourage career mobility. Sun Life is also a socially responsible employer, supporting the communities in which we live and work, with a globally recognized commitment to the environment and sustainability.

This co-op will be hybrid, and students must be located near and be able to commute to our Wellesley, MA office.

The Role 
Sun Life U.S. Health and Risk Solutions is looking for a proactive, positive, and dynamic team player to join our Medical Intelligence team as a co-op student supporting the development of key training materials for conducting provider research for a wide variety of specialties. As a member of the team, you will gain valuable hands-on experience. This is an excellent opportunity to learn about healthcare research and navigation.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
• Research and compile data to develop a library of resources for provider identification for 40+ specialties

• Collaborate with Medical Intelligence Analysts to develop standard operating procedures for research processes

• Assist Medical Intelligence Team Leads with updating the team’s SharePoint site

• Other duties as assigned

• Core skill sets needed for this role:

• Experience in healthcare research or healthcare field preferred

• Exceptional internet researching skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills Working knowledge of MS office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook and Adobe products

• Proactive, able to manage multiple projects with demanding deadlines

• Highly-motivated, self-driven, focused, strong attentive to detail

The Candidate
To be eligible for a co-op at Sun Life, you must meet the following requirements:
• Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university during the time of internship (January 2027 - June 2027)

• Must be an undergraduate or graduate student in, healthcare information management, health administration, public health, nursing, or related field of study

• Eligible to legally work in the United States

• Ability to work full-time (40 hours/week) during co-op session

Compensation for this position will be $25/hr.

Job Description:
Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Surgery team will give you the chance to deliver surgical technologies and solutions to surgeons and
healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world’s most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

We are searching for the best talent for Electrical Engineering Interns within Robotics R&D. 

Purpose: This internship is based in Santa Clara, California and offers a unique opportunity for students passionate about electrical engineering design, development, and integration into medical robotics. Electrical engineering interns will work alongside other engineering domains such as mechanical, mechatronics, controls, software, and clinical engineering. This will support the prototyping, development, test, and production of surgical robotic platforms that will improve patient outcomes worldwide.

As an Electrical Engineering Intern, you will design, prototype, test and integrate multi-layer PCBA's for use in a complex medical device system. You will work with across engineering functions to make contributions in the fields of robotics, surgical instruments, and more. This role offers a high degree of autonomy and opportunities for project growth within the team as we progress towards realizing our vision.

You will be responsible for: 
• Develop and prototype PCAs (PCBAs) for implementation in robotic elements, subsystems and testing fixtures.

• Deliver documentation to support designs of PCAs in medical devices such as technical reviews, engineering studies, test results, and architecture documents.

• Work alongside senior engineers and mentors to develop reliable designs for various robotic tasks.

• Test, debug, and perform root cause analysis of issues identified during bench testing and system integration.

• Generate and present design concepts, perform design reviews to team members

• Participate in clinical assessments of robotic devices in inanimate anatomical models

Role Variability: This internship track covers a range of electrical engineering roles, including design, assembly, manufacturing, and test. Responsibilities will vary depending on the specific project, team, or role, providing a broad experience in robotics hardware development.

Qualifications / Requirements: 
Education
• Currently enrolled in an accredited program pursuing a bachelor’s or graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar degree and returning to an academic program after the completion of the internship.

Experience and skills
• Basic understanding and experience with oscilloscopes, DC power supplies, multimeters.

• Fundamental knowledge of circuit design theory and general electrical engineering principals.

• Ability to analyze problems and derive thoughtful solutions by working with your team members.

• Self-starter with proven examples of engaging in self-directed learning and remaining productive with minimal support.

• Available to work full-time (40 hours/week) and during hours agreed upon with the hiring manager.

• Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 reflective of all coursework

• Commitment to June 1 – August 20, 2027, or June 21 – September 10, 2027, term dates to align with cohort

• Permanent US work authorization without the need for sponsorship now, or in the future (The company does not provide sponsorship for employment visa status. Students currently in the country on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT require future sponsorship).

Nice-to-Have:
• Ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and adopt new AI tools and platforms to meet evolving project needs.

• Basic understanding of medical device development and design control.

• Prior prototyping design and/or firmware design.

• Experience with basic scripting in Python or Matlab.

• Experience with PCB design software such as Altium, Eagle, or KiKad.

• Prior internship or Co-op experience recommended

Why Join Us?
• Contribute to impactful projects that directly improve surgical outcomes and patient safety.

• Gain hands-on experience in mechanical design, integration, testing, and debugging.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including electrical, mechanical, software and robotic controls engineers.

• Work in an inclusive, innovative, and growth-oriented environment.

• Mentorship and professional development opportunities.

Ineligibility for severance.

We work in a variety of exciting robotic functions including, but not limited to, AI and automation, kinematic and dynamic analysis, motion generation, control algorithms, system response characterization, performance and detailed software development.

• Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure software quality.

• Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to define software architecture and system requirement.

• Develop C++ software for real-time, safety critical applications.

• Documentation of software design, algorithms, and implementation details.

Role Variability
This internship track covers a range of Robotics Controls & Autonomy engineering roles, including software development, robotics R&D, AI, and hardware/software testing. Responsibilities will vary depending on the specific project, team, or role, providing a broad experience in robotics development.

jobs.title: AI & Data Platform Engineering Intern - Undergraduate
jobs.description:
WEX is a global commerce platform that has been simplifying the way businesses operate for over 40 years. Our purpose is simple: to reduce administrative burdens, streamline payments, and manage mobility. With a team of over 7,200 professionals across 16 countries.

Our specialties are employee benefits, business payments, and fleet/mobility solutions. We support more than 20 million SaaS accounts, 8 million Health Savings Accounts, and 19+ million vehicles worldwide. We're a growing company with a history of innovation and a focus on our customers, making this a great place to grow your career.

The WEX Summer Internship Program: Learn, Lead, and Make an Impact
Our 13-week paid internship program, running from late May to mid-August, is a chance for you to gain real-world experience and develop your skills. Recruiting begins in September and continues through November at our various locations across the U.S.
You won't just be a bystander; you'll work on impactful projects and contribute to WEX’s mission. We provide mentorship, professional development, and weekly learning experiences to help you build confidence and leadership skills. High-performing interns may even get the chance to lead their own initiatives.

We offer remote, hybrid, and onsite options for flexibility, and our goal is to bring top interns back full-time or offer them extended roles during the school year.
Imagine starting your career with a company that’s building what's next. Your future starts here.

About the Team/Role: 
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented undergraduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field to join our Data, AI, and Risk Technology (DART), Semantic Foundation, and Enterprise Applications engineering teams as an intern. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI/ML applications, Big Data platforms, agentic systems, and Enterprise Semantic Models within the FinTech industry—supporting key business functions across Fraud and Credit Risk, Sales, Service, Marketing, HR, Finance, and Legal.
Working alongside experienced engineers and researchers, you will tackle real-world data engineering and platform challenges using modern technologies such as Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, PySpark, Snowflake, cloud platforms, and LLMs. Our team is global and remote-first (spanning the U.S., India, and Brazil), operating with agile sprint disciplines and maintaining a strong culture of ownership, learning, and cross-functional collaboration.

How you’ll make an impact:
• Contribute to Impactful Projects: Work on challenging projects that leverage AI/ML to address critical business needs in areas like fraud prevention, credit risk assessment, and real-time, data-driven decision making.

• Build Trusted Data Foundations: Contribute to semantic models and reusable data assets that provide consistent business entities, definitions, and context for analytics, applications, and AI use cases across the enterprise.

• Data Transformation & Pipelines: Develop advanced platforms, SQL queries, and tools to process, ingest, clean, enrich, and optimize core company data—leveraging consuming services, microservices, and DAGs to unlock value for both customers and internal teams.

• Design and implement: AI-assisted workflows that directly optimize our production environment. Apply specification-driven development and declarative system design to build highly scalable, model-driven solution. 

• AI Prototyping & Workflow Automation: Help construct and test proof-of-concept AI solutions, automated scripts, basic agentic workflows, and LLM implementations to solve everyday business problems.

• Improve Data Quality & Observability: Help implement automated data-quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities that improve the accuracy, completeness, freshness, and reliability of critical data platforms and pipelines.

• Contribute to Platform Reliability & Tooling: Work on engineering improvements, reusable frameworks, automated testing, and CI/CD to make data platforms more resilient, scalable, easier to operate, and productive for developers.

• API & System Integration: Partner with software engineers to build integrations connecting data and AI tools with enterprise corporate systems.

• Apply Modern Engineering Practices: Participate in design reviews, code reviews, architectural flow diagram drafting, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production-readiness activities.

• Tech Literacy & Stakeholder Enablement: Partner directly with non-technical business users and stakeholders to simplify complex technical concepts, guiding them on how to effectively integrate data and AI tools into their everyday workflows through hands-on support and documentation.

• Explore Emerging Technologies & Research: Research new AI tools, open-source libraries, GenAI, agentic applications, and AI-assisted development tools to present findings, demos, and lessons learned to the broader engineering team.

• Collaborate & Present: Work with big data technologies and partner with engineers, researchers, product managers, and stakeholders to brainstorm solutions and present project outcomes and business impact.

Experience you’ll bring: 
• Educational Foundation: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related field and will have completed at least your Sophomore year of school at the start of the internship.

• Strong Programming Skills & Fundamentals: Proficiency in coding using modern languages (preferably Python, Java, or Go) along with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, scripting, automated testing, system monitoring, and basic familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git/GitHub).

• AI/ML Expertise & Curiosity: Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, techniques, best practices, or a strong academic interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing.

• Data-Driven Mindset & SQL: Hands-on experience working with data, including data analysis, manipulation, and visualization, alongside an academic background or practical experience with SQL and relational database concepts.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to break down problems, investigate issues, evaluate possible solutions, and seek guidance when appropriate.

• Solution-Oriented: Desire to learn robust design solutions for small to medium-scale problems or system components.

• Collaboration & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate technical ideas, share progress, ask questions, and collaborate effectively with team members across different locations and time zones.

• Learning Agility & Self-Driven Learner: Curiosity, high motivation, and willingness to quickly learn new technologies, platforms, and business domains—including proactively utilizing GenAI-assisted development tools to streamline workflows, accelerate learning, and enhance productivity.

• Ownership Mindset: Willingness to take responsibility for an assigned problem and drive it toward a meaningful outcome rather than focusing only on individual tasks.
