jobs.description:
Job Location
MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR
Job Description
Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.
This internship is specifically designed for individuals working towards a PhD who are developing proficiency in their field. As an intern or co-op in management, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in a supportive environment. This is a 12-week paid internship, designed to provide you with a solid foundation for future career growth. The internship will take place from May (potentially early June) to August of 2027. Join us at P&G, where your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of consumer products!
 
The Opportunity:
P&G has an opportunity for a PhD intern to work in our on our corporate function R&D team using Machine Learning for Wearable Sensing & Human Motion. Reconstructing full-body human motion from a handful of noisy, drifting wearable sensors is a challenging machine learning problem, drawing on time-series modeling, multi-modal sensor fusion, human pose estimation, and biomechanics. As a PhD Intern on the CF R&D Data Science and AI team at P&G, you will work on this problem directly, and progress on it to enable new ways of understanding how people move and interact with products outside the lab.
Our research sits close to the product: the models we build inform design, ergonomics, fit, comfort, and the everyday experience of using our brands. Wearable sensing lets us observe movement and product interaction in real-world settings that lab-based methods cannot reach, and it lets us ask questions such as: How much physical effort does a task actually require? How does a product move with the body? Where does the experience break down? What should privacy-preserving, in-home consumer research look like going forward?
In this role, you will extend what wearable AI can do and turn those results into tools and findings that shape design decisions. You will work with teams across R&D, Brand, and Product Development to take your models from research prototype to production. Success depends on technical depth in deep learning and sensor data, combined with the curiosity, communication, and collaboration needed to work effectively with partners across functions and levels.

Key Responsibilities:
• Review the state of the art in full-body motion reconstruction from wearable sensors to inform modeling and sensor design choices for the project.
• Determine optimal sensor configurations — type, number, and placement — for a range of motion reconstruction tasks.
• Design, build, and refine deep learning models that convert IMU and EMG signals into accurate full-body motion.
• Evaluate models rigorously on public and internal datasets and critically analyze assumptions, failure modes, and limitations.
• Deliver a production-ready application that lets internal researchers upload recordings, run inference, and visualize results.

Job Qualifications
Required Qualifications: 
• Education: Working towards a PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, Applied Mathematics / Statistics / Physics (with relevant ML and sensor-data experience), or a related fields with a focus on machine learning, wearable sensing, or human motion analysis.
• Research experience in one or more of the following: machine learning for time-series data, Human Activity Recognition, wearable sensing, human pose estimation, or multi-modal sensor fusion.
• Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
• Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027. This is an in-person internship; candidate is expected to work from our Mason Business Center five days a week.
 
Preferred Qualifications: 
• Track record of research publications in venues such as NeurIPS, CVPR, SIGGRAPH, CHI, UbiComp/IMWUT, AAAI, or similar.
• Hands-on experience with IMU, EMG, or other wearable sensors.
• Familiarity with biomechanics, inverse kinematics, or human body models (e.g., SMPL).
• Experience deploying ML models to production or building research tools/APIs.

Just so you know: 

At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise.

Rather than exploring the design space uniformly, the goal is to prioritize experiments that are expected to provide the greatest reduction in uncertainty and the highest learning value. This work will treat consumer studies and first-principles simulations as two applications of the same underlying problem: how to allocate experimentation resources more efficiently.

• Identify next study, simulation, and measurement based on reduction of uncertainty
• Optimize experimental resources
• Create a prototype work process to demonstrate success

• Active learning / sequential experimental design — central to recommending the next most informative consumer study or simulation.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
As an entry-level Data Scientist, you will work with engineers, data professionals and product teams to frame problems, prepare data, build and evaluate analytical or machine-learning models, and communicate results. You will contribute to practical solutions that are technically rigorous, understandable and ready to be used by the business. This role is designed for a recent graduate who brings strong fundamentals, curiosity and evidence of applied project work.

Job Description
What You Will Do
• Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to translate a question into a clear analytical problem, success criteria and testable approach.
• Explore, clean, join and validate structured and unstructured datasets; document assumptions, limitations and data-quality issues.
• Build baseline and advanced models using statistical analysis, machine learning, optimization or time-series methods as appropriate.
• Compare models using relevant performance metrics and evaluate uncertainty, bias, robustness and generalization.
• Create clear visualizations, notebooks and concise presentations that explain methods, findings and recommended actions.
• Work with Data Engineers and AI Engineers to move useful analyses from prototypes toward reusable, monitored solutions.
• Use version control, code review, testing and reproducible workflows to create maintainable analytical assets.
• Protect confidential information and follow cybersecurity, data governance, intellectual property and Responsible AI requirements.
• Continue developing domain knowledge in energy, engineering and industrial systems through hands-on work and mentorship.
 
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree completed by the start date in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, Physics or a related quantitative field.
• Foundational knowledge of statistics, probability, experimental design and machine-learning concepts.
• Hands-on experience with Python or R through coursework, research, internships, co-ops or independent projects.
• Experience using common data analysis and visualization tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SQL, Jupyter, matplotlib, seaborn, Power BI or equivalents.
• Ability to explain technical work clearly in writing and conversation to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Demonstrated problem-solving, collaboration, attention to detail and willingness to learn.
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Internship, co-op, research, capstone or portfolio experience applying analytics or machine learning to a real problem.
• Exposure to cloud data platforms, distributed computing, data pipelines, Git, containers or ML lifecycle tools.
• Experience with time-series, simulation, optimization, computer vision, natural language processing or generative AI.
• Interest in renewable energy, physical systems, manufacturing or engineering applications.
• Experience validating results with subject-matter experts and incorporating feedback into an improved solution.

As an entry-level AI Engineer, you will help design, build, integrate and operate AI-enabled applications for engineering and industrial use cases. You will work across software, machine learning and data interfaces, partnering with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, software teams and domain experts. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys building working systems, learning new technologies and turning prototypes into maintainable solutions.

• Integrate machine-learning or generative-AI capabilities with approved data sources, engineering tools and enterprise platforms.

jobs.title: Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
Whether you come from a background in data analytics, artificial intelligence and automated data systems, or information systems, you can be successful in this role. We don’t require a specific degree or experience, but we’re looking for translatable skills and relevant expertise. We will provide you with the training and development opportunities needed to build a career here!

About The Role:
As a Data Coordinator, you’ll help make sure the data our Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools pull is spot-on. You’ll review, double-check, and analyze AI-generated info to catch and fix any mistakes or missing pieces. Plus, you’ll play a key role in helping our AI get smarter by sharing feedback and flagging any issues you find.

Compensation for this role is a fixed rate of $18.50/hour. 

We are currently looking for a Data Coordinator for our Monday-Friday, 10AM-6PM shift. 

Here’s a snapshot of what you’d be doing:
• Looking over data pulled from documents by AI, making sure it’s accurate and complete, and fixing any errors, gaps, or mix-ups you spot.

• Using our guidelines and simple data checks to find missing or incomplete info in documents, then logging and sharing what you find so we can keep improving.

• Digging into any errors or odd spots you find, helping keep our data clean and reliable, and collaborating on projects that boost overall data quality.

• Pitching in wherever needed to help foster a supportive and collaborative team culture.

About You:
• You know how to communicate your findings and suggestions in a way that makes sense to everyone.

• You’re comfortable working on your own, figuring things out as you go, and thinking critically to solve whatever comes your way.

• Details matter to you, and you’ve got an eye for catching the little things that make a big difference.

• Providing top-notch customer service comes naturally to you.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​
Your working location will be fully on-site in Reston, VA, but options exist for limited hybrid of on-site/work from home, based on project-dependent ability. This role requires frequent travel to sponsor locations in the Beltway area and to associate contractor and second party locations within and outside the continental United States. We are searching for analytical software engineers to join the Strategic Systems Operation Division within the Information Advantage Office at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. This role will focus on software implementation, test, and productization.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

• Ensure technical excellence and on-time completion of all project tasks

• Develop and deliver clear updates on program status to Fleet-level personnel at both individual and community meetings

• Interact and collaborate regularly with the engineering team, principal investigator, sponsors, and other stakeholders

• Ability to design, implement, and maintain high-quality, scalable software solutions across the full development lifecycle

• Experience developing, testing, and maintaining software in Linux and/or Windows environments

• Working knowledge of modern development tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks)

• Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and performance optimization

• Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, or container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Ability to produce clear, maintainable, and well-documented code

• Systematic troubleshooting of operating systems and input-output debugging

• Understanding of the network protocol stack

jobs.title: Derivative Valuation Analyst
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With:
AllianceBernstein is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Derivative Valuations Analyst to help manage the daily pricing of our complex OTC derivatives. You will sit at the center of Operations, Portfolio Management, Risk, and IT, ensuring our global investment teams have the accurate valuation data they need to make decisions.

What You’ll Do:
This role is the engine of our OTC daily pricing operations. Much of your day will be spent involved in detailed validation, investigating data anomalies, and communicating across teams. We are looking for someone who takes natural ownership of their work. The role requires proactive identification of pricing anomalies, independent price and curve verification, root-cause analysis and clear data-driven escalations to key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage the daily derivative pricing process by validating models across all OTC products, catching exceptions, and resolving discrepancies before they reach the investment teams or external clients. 

• Serve as the primary contact for daily pricing questions. When data looks unusual, investigate the underlying market data and provide clear, straightforward explanations to Portfolio Managers, Risk, Audit, and external partners.

• Maintain the integrity of our internal controls by tracking market events and regulatory shifts, ensuring our valuation processes consistently meet compliance standards.

• Work with secondary pricing sources and external vendors, such as Bloomberg, to compare data and ensure reliable quality controls.

• Take advantage of opportunities to use tools like Python or VBA to automate repetitive tasks, making the team’s daily workflows smoother and more efficient.

• Model, test, and validate new OTC markets, vendors, strategies, and instruments as they are onboarded by the firm

What We’re Looking For:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Quantitative Finance.

• Experience: 0 to 4 years of experience in OTC pricing, operations or middle-office roles.

• Attention to Detail: You take pride in your accuracy and have the focus to execute detailed validations reliably, even when working against strict daily market deadlines.

• Clear Communication: Ability to explain complex pricing or data issues simply and clearly for a variety of audiences.

• Intellectual Curiosity: A natural drive to question how systems and models work, taking the initiative to test things on the side and learn underlying mechanics rather than blindly following a checklist.

• Proactive Ownership: A strong sense of initiative to independently and proactively resolve system issues or feed failures, deploying a practical workaround to keep pricing moving forward and suggesting a longer-term permanent solution.

• Technical Stack: Advanced Excel skills are mandatory. Familiarity with Python or VBA is needed but not required on day one. Prior exposure to Bloomberg, ICE IPA, Calypso or SIM Corp is a distinct advantage.

About AB 
We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work. 

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us! 

All are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies and practices seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants based solely on job-related criteria.
Nashville, Tennessee

jobs.title: Design Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 
About Intel & Silicon Chassis
Intel is seeking an Entry Level Design Verification Engineer for the Silicon Chassis team. In this role, you will contribute to the verification of next-generation interconnect and chassis IPs that underpin Intel's most ambitious SoC and platform products.

Position Overview
You will work alongside senior engineers to build testbenches, write constrained-random tests, close functional coverage, and root-cause simulation failures - developing end-to-end verification skills from day one.
We look for engineers who think algorithmically, write clean code, and are excited to apply the latest AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how they work. You do not need to know everything on day one; you do need strong fundamentals, genuine curiosity, and the drive to ramp fast.

Key Responsibilities
• Develop testbench components, constrained-random stimulus, and functional checkers for interconnect and chassis IP under guidance of senior engineers
• Write, run, and debug simulation tests; analyze failures and root-cause issues to closure with clear technical write-ups
• Contribute to functional coverage plans, coverage closure analysis, and regression triage
• Participate in spec reviews, design discussions, and bug triage; learn to contribute across architecture, design, and software boundaries
• Use AI-assisted coding and debugging tools as an everyday part of development workflow; actively contribute to the team's productivity through automation and scripting
• Continuously build depth in hardware design, verification methodology, and the chip development flow

What We're Looking For
You should demonstrate the following professional traits to be successful:
• Genuine curiosity and the drive to ramp fast
• Algorithmic thinking with a commitment to writing clean code
• Enthusiasm for applying the latest AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work

Qualifications:

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications
• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science and 3+ months of Internship experience in a hardware design or verification environment
• Foundation in logic design and digital circuits - required; ability to read and reason about RTL is essential
• Demonstrated algorithmic thinking and software fundamentals application - required
• Demonstrated proficiency in at least one of C/C++, Python, or SystemVerilog through coursework, projects, or internships
• Coursework or project exposure to two or more of the following: computer architecture, parallel and distributed computing, operating systems, hardware/software interfaces, VLSI design
• Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants as a regular part of coursework or project work - not occasional use, but as a genuine productivity tool

Preferred Qualifications
• Coursework or project work in hardware verification, FPGA design, or RTL simulation (ModelSim, VCS, Questa, or similar)
• Exposure to SystemVerilog, UVM concepts, or assertion-based verification through coursework, self-study, or internship
• Familiarity with standard bus protocols (AXI, AHB, PCIe) or cache/memory hierarchy concepts
• Demonstrated project work (senior design, research, hackathon, personal) involving hardware modeling, algorithm implementation in HDL, or hardware-software co-design
• Comfort working in Linux environments, using version control (git), and writing build/test automation scripts
• Worked experience in any related field

jobs.title: Data Science Analyst
jobs.description:
Agency:
Omnicom Media 
Job Function:
Data and Analytics 
Job Subfunction: 
Data Science and AI

Job Description:
Position Summary
We are looking for a Data Science Analyst to join our growing data science practice. In this role, you will support the development and delivery of quantitative models and analyses across a portfolio of marketing clients, including predictive modeling, regression analysis, and statistical work spanning media, pricing, and promotional data. This is a great entry point for someone with a strong statistics background who wants to apply analytical skills in a fast-paced, client-service environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Build and maintain data science models such as Marketing Mix Models using regression-based techniques, working with weekly or monthly time-series data across media, pricing, and promotional variables.
• Conduct data validation, cleaning, and QA on client-provided datasets to ensure model-ready inputs.
• Run statistical analyses including adstock transformations, diminishing returns curves, and decomposition outputs.
• Support model documentation and prepare structured outputs (Excel workbooks, charts, summary tables) for internal and client review.
• Collaborate with senior team members on methodology decisions and model refinement.
• Contribute to internal tooling and process improvements as the team scales.

Desired Skills & Experience
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
• Strong foundation in statistical modeling, particularly regression analysis and time-series methods.
• Comfort working in Python or R for data manipulation, modeling, and visualization (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with concepts such as multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity, model fit diagnostics, and variable selection.
• Attention to detail and the ability to work carefully through large, messy datasets.
• Clear written communication skills for documenting analytical work.
• Exposure to Bayesian methods or hierarchical modeling.
• Experience with marketing data (media spend, impressions, GRPs) or consumer datasets.
• Prior internship or academic project experience in an applied analytics setting.

Salary Range: $55,000 - $65,000
 
Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

jobs.title: Brand & Product SLP - Brand and Product
jobs.description:
Stanley Leadership Development Program – Brand and Product
Towson, MD | Valley City, OH | New Britain, CT

Come make the world and accelerate your success. 

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of nearly 60,000 professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, CRAFTSMAN®, CUB CADET®, STANLEY® and BLACK+DECKER®

Why SLP?
The Stanley Black & Decker Leadership Development Program (“SLP”) is a high-profile rotational program that is an integrated process for accelerating the development of our future leaders. It is geared toward recent graduates with Product/Marketing experience and a relevant business degree with a passion for a long-term career in Product-focused roles.
The program offers invaluable experiences for early-career associates seeking challenging developmental opportunities to jump-start their careers. 

Brand & Product SLPs work in 3 rotations over 2 years across the United States. Each rotation has project assignments that allow participants to become familiar with how we do business and contribute to the success of the company.

Responsible for the product roadmap and overseeing a product throughout its lifecycle. Product partners with cross-functional teams to ensure that all products meet customer and business needs and align back to the overall brand and category strategy.

Additionally, they conduct market research and communicate with external stakeholders to get feedback and relay important information. 

Product Management also manages resource planning and works with operations and engineering to drive Design To Value (DTV), productivity and cost reduction.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact. 

What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities May Include:
• Analyze complex, high-volume data from various sources using diverse tools and techniques to derive actionable insights.
• Develop and maintain high-quality standardized outputs, including visualizations and dashboards, that translate complex data into clear, business-relevant insights.
• Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests by developing new reports or dashboards as needed, ensuring accuracy and relevance.
• Support the ongoing delivery of regular KPI reports, maintaining accuracy and relevance to business needs.
• Synthesize analytical findings into meaningful insights, presenting data in an easy-to-understand format for diverse business audiences.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their analytical needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven insights that support decision-making.
• Continuously seek to improve reporting processes by staying up to date on industry trends and best practices in data analysis and insight generation.
• Provide technical support and training on analytical tools and methodologies to empower business stakeholders in their use of data-driven insights.

JOB DESCRIPTION
You will make a tangible impact on our internal and external customers by building data-driven solutions and providing high impact analytical insights and recommendations. You will be a trusted advisor and empowered to put Customer at the heart of decision making, and an ambassador for Data Analytics across Digital and the wider Data Analytics Community

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Utilize your inquisitive mindset, analytical skills & ask the right questions to understand complex business challenges
• Develop and implement analytics aligned with the business needs and in accordance with best practices
• Use Statistical experience and Business knowledge to solve complex business challenges
• Interrogate, manipulate and analyze complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from varying sources using a variety of tools and analytical techniques
• Build engaging and interactive visualizations using state of the art methods
• Provide and concisely communicate high quality deep dive analysis with clear recommendations and actionable insight
• Collaboratively work within a squad to deliver solutions by defining and designing Data Analytics tasks (for example, data requirements, output, success criteria, timescales)
• Provide guidance on KPIs and best practice in reporting and analytical problem solving

• Experience in clearly communicating (verbal and written) Insight to technical and non-technical Stakeholders
• 1-3+ years of Data Analytics experience
• SQL

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments.

Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone.

All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you.

Role Summary

The Software Engineer is a role on the IT Client Experience team focused on helping build, support, and improve ACI’s digital client-facing platforms and experiences, including public websites, authenticated web experiences, mobile capabilities, and related Sales and Marketing technology integrations.

The primary responsibility of this role is to learn and contribute across day-to-day engineering and production support activities, including troubleshooting issues, validating releases, making code changes, improving support documentation, and partnering with senior engineers to keep digital experiences reliable, secure, accessible, and easy to use.

This position is well suited for an engineer early in their career who is eager to grow skills in modern web development, cloud-native platforms, integrations, observability, and production support while learning how technology enables client, advisor, sales, and marketing experiences.

This role reports to the IT Manager – Software Engineering.

This hybrid position will be based out of our Kansas City, Missouri office.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

How You Will Make an Impact

Digital Experience Engineering & Production Support
• Support ACI’s client-facing digital platforms by helping troubleshoot production issues, service requests, defects, and operational questions.
• Assist with triage by gathering details, recreating issues, reviewing logs or monitoring data, and coordinating with the appropriate engineers, product owners, vendors, or support partners.
• Help validate releases, hotfixes, content changes, and configuration updates to ensure web and mobile experiences are ready for production use.
• Provide clear status updates during support issues and contribute to post-incident notes, follow-ups, and documentation.
• Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and standard operating procedures for owned applications and integrations.

Web, Mobile & Platform Reliability
• Monitor application behavior, alerts, recurring issues, and client experience impacts across supported web, mobile, and marketing technology platforms.
• Assist with root-cause analysis and help implement fixes that reduce repeat issues and improve reliability, performance, accessibility, and supportability.
• Learn how front-end applications, APIs, content platforms, analytics, authentication, and third-party services work together to deliver end-to-end digital experiences.
• Support operational readiness by reviewing changes, checking deployment results, and confirming that monitoring and documentation are in place.

Software Engineering & Technical Growth
• Develop and maintain small enhancements, bug fixes, automated tests, and configuration updates for supported digital platforms.
• Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment activities, and technical discussions with guidance from senior engineers.
• Build familiarity with modern web development practices, including JavaScript/TypeScript, component-based UI development, APIs, CI/CD, cloud hosting, and observability.
• Learn and apply team standards for secure coding, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and production readiness.
• Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while following team review, testing, and governance expectations.

Team Collaboration
• Work closely with product owners, engineers, QA, UX, Marketing, Sales, operations, and support partners to understand priorities and deliver reliable digital solutions.
• Ask questions, seek feedback, and actively learn from teammates while building ownership of assigned work.
• Contribute to team rituals such as stand-ups, backlog refinement, planning sessions, demos, and retrospectives.
• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners, especially when explaining issue status, risks, or next steps.

What You Bring to the Team (Required)
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, finance, business, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
• Professional software development, technical support, internship, co-op, or related technology experience.
• Experience using AI-assisted software engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to support software development activities such as coding, debugging, testing, documentation, code review, and problem solving, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs
• Foundational understanding of software engineering concepts, problem solving, debugging, and application support.
• Interest in learning modern web technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, production operations, and digital client experience systems.
• Ability to communicate clearly, ask good questions, document findings, and follow established processes.
• Willingness to support production systems and occasionally respond to urgent issues or release-related needs.
• Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, Competitively Driven.

Additional Assets (Preferred)
• Exposure to front-end or full-stack development using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Svelte/SvelteKit, HTML, CSS, or related frameworks.
• 2+ years of software development experience
• Familiarity with APIs, integrations, authentication, content management systems, analytics tools, or SaaS platforms.
• Internship, co-op, academic, or early career experience supporting websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or enterprise applications.
• Exposure to Agile or product-oriented delivery models, including work in cross-functional pods or scrum teams.
• Curiosity about digital client experiences, accessibility, observability, monitoring, reliability, and continuous improvement.

The above statements are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

What We Offer
• Competitive compensation package with bonus plan
• Generous PTO and competitive benefits
• 401k with 5% company match plus annual performance-based discretionary contribution
• Tuition reimbursement, formal mentorship program, live and online learning

Learn more about our benefits and perks.

jobs.title: RF Device Engineer - Microelectronics/Semiconductor Engineering
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Physical Sciences Laboratories (PSL) support the effective and timely development and operation of national security systems through scientific research and the application of advanced technologies. PSL has more than 150 specialized laboratories used to test, analyze, and troubleshoot virtually every aspect of rocket and satellite system design, development, construction, deployment, and operation. The expertise of the laboratories’ technical staff allows PSL to stay abreast of new technological developments and program support issues associated with rapidly evolving space systems.

The Microelectronics Technology Department (MTD) is part of PSL with specialized laboratories for testing, accelerating, and analyzing, failures in electronics used for space system. MTD is comprised of two sections: one that performs radiation effects testing and discrete microelectronics testing, while the other section performs failure analysis on microelectronics using tools that can identify anomalies from the macroscopic down to the atomic scale. MTD is looking for an RF Device Engineer (MTS or Sr. MTS –Microelectronics/Semiconductor Engineering) to support investigations of electronics reliability and physics of failure of advanced RF systems that use silicon, SiGe, SOI, III-V, II-VI, and other technologies for space applications.

Highlights of our lab's capabilities can be seen here: Virtual Tour

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA.

What You’ll Be Doing 
• Perform accelerated life testing on microelectronic devices using temperature and electrical stress biases to determine mean time to failure (MTTF) and reliability metrics
• Conduct device characterization on GaN HEMTs, CMOS, MOSFETs, bipolar transistors, and other advanced semiconductor technologies (including pulsed-IV, DC, and RF characterization)
• Execute resistance measurements on materials and accelerated life testing on capacitors and PCB microvias
• Perform high-power RF measurements including S-parameter analysis, power calculations, and noise measurements
• Provide technical support to national security space programs, internal research teams, and academic collaborators
• Conduct applied research in microelectronic device reliability and RF system performance for space applications
• Support adoption and reliability assessment of new technologies for space systems
• Duties, responsibilities and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed

What Corporate Skills You’ll Bring 
• Strong written and oral communication skills 
• Must work well in a team environment 
• Possess organizational, time management and project management skills 
• Demonstrate flexibility and ability to adapt to changing organizational need 
• Interpersonal skills to coordinate efforts and work with other internal and external organizations 

What You Need to be Successful 
Minimum Requirements:
• Master’s degree from an accredited college/university program in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Sciences, or related discipline (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)  
• 0-1 year of industry work experience 
• Experience with engineering or scientific project execution
• Experience with microelectronic, semiconductor, or RF devices or systems
• Willing to travel occasionally to work location or customer site/domestically/internationally approx. 15% if required. 
• This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance. 

How You Can Stand Out   
It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:  
• Ph.D. degree from an accredited program in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Sciences, or related discipline  (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months) 
• Extensive experience with RF testing, design or engineering, including microwave devices or systems, MMICs, microelectronic devices, network analysis, amplifier biasing, impedance matching, load tuning, etc.
• Background working with space system programs is desired
• Experience with advanced test structure and circuit design using CAD tools such as Cadence, Silvaco, Tanner Tools, or Microwave Office
• Semiconductor fabrication or cleanroom experience
• Experience with FPGA/microprocessor programming
• Strong knowledge working with Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB or similar software for data analysis and collection is preferred

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

jobs.title: Data Integration Analyst 1
jobs.description:
The Data Integration Analyst I is responsible for supporting the transformation, configuration, and ingestion of client data files within Allied's insurance tracking systems. This includes translating client requirements into technical specifications, building and maintaining transformation logic, and assisting with validation and troubleshooting. The role contributes to both the initial implementation and ongoing maintenance of lender data configurations and helps ensure accurate, timely, and production-ready data delivery.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Transformation and Configuration Setup – 30%
• Analyze client file formats to extract data requirements and determine transformation needs.
• Translate business rules and client specifications into detailed source-to-target mapping logic.
• Configure import profiles and lender setup parameters in the system to ensure compatibility.
• Document transformation logic using standardized templates for handoff and reference.
• Perform initial transformation validations to catch formatting or logic inconsistencies.
• Collaborate with Analyst II and ETL developers to review and finalize complex logic components.
• Maintain configuration standards and contribute to improving reusable transformation logic.
• Update and version control mapping documentation as files evolve or rules change.

File Validation and Testing – 25%
• Conduct field-level validation of test files to ensure mappings, formats, and values align with system expectations.
• Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist with managing test cases and issue tracking.
• Review ingestion results and perform root cause analysis on failures or unexpected outcomes.
• Document validation steps, transformation checks, and test results for future reference.
• Coordinate with QA Analysts to ensure proper sequencing of test scenarios and confirm expected behavior.
• Validate backfeed generation and ensure record integrity across inbound and outbound transformations.
• Track validation progress and escalate blockers to ensure delivery timelines are maintained.
• Participate in post-testing review meetings to document lessons learned and process improvements.
• Perform regression testing after configuration changes to ensure no impact to previous logic.
• Collaborate with Analyst II to validate transformation logic under complex scenarios or overrides.

Client Communication and Onboarding Support – 20%
• Participate in technical onboarding calls to clarify file structures and system mapping requirements.
• Confirm understanding of client data structures and document assumptions or open questions.
• Provide professional, client-facing responses to data questions and transformation status updates.
• Collaborate with Implementation Managers to align onboarding timelines and expectations.
• Clarify system behaviors for custom or complex logic fields and offer alternatives when necessary.
• Help clients interpret system validation feedback and revise file formatting as needed.
• Track communication history and ensure all client logic decisions are documented.
• Maintain consistent, technically accurate communication with both client and internal teams.
• Review file content with client contacts and confirm transformation design aligns with their expectations.
• Communicate risks or edge cases early in onboarding to ensure expectations are managed.

Production Support and Issue Resolution – 15%
• Troubleshoot ingestion failures by reviewing file content, mapping rules, and transformation logs.
• Respond to helpdesk tickets involving configuration mismatches, invalid data formats, or field logic gaps.
• Coordinate with Production Support to hand off background on non-standard transformation behavior.
• Review system monitoring reports and error queues to detect trends in recurring data problems.
• Update known issues in lender profiles and documentation sites for reference by support teams.
• Validate post-deployment data imports to confirm production alignment with test results.
• Assist with file modifications or transformations as client files evolve post-go-live.
• Escalate persistent issues to Analyst II or QA with documented troubleshooting history.
• Monitor ingestion health and performance post-launch to detect degradation or latency.
• Document resolution steps and lessons learned from post-implementation support events.

Documentation and Process Improvement – 10%
• Maintain lender-specific documentation for mapping logic, transformation details, and exception handling.
• Ensure consistency and completeness in internal documentation repositories.
• Contribute to internal process documents including configuration walkthroughs and intake guides.
• Share newly discovered issues and edge cases through team channels or update logs.
• Participate in team review of standard procedures and propose updates when gaps are identified.
• Assist in the development and maintenance of standardized templates and review checklists.
• Provide documentation feedback based on implementation experience to improve clarity and usability.
• Support onboarding of new team members by sharing reference documents and leading walkthroughs.
• Document variations in configuration for lenders with custom logic to ensure long-term clarity.
• Collaborate with QA and other analysts to ensure documentation accurately reflects validated behavior.

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Certifications & KSA):
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
• Bachelor’s degree in technical field preferred.
• Experience in data mapping, file structure analysis, and transformation logic.
• Familiarity with ETL tools (Informatica or similar).
• Ability to troubleshoot data file ingestion failures and system configuration mismatches.
• Proficient in written and verbal communication, especially when working with cross-functional teams.
• Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks independently.
• Ability to understand and edit SQL scripts.
• Experience in completing technical projects in a collaborative team setting.
• Experience with retrieving and transforming data from CSV, XML, or JSON files.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

Our comprehensive benefits include: medical, dental and vision insurance coverage; 100% company-paid life and disability coverage, 401k options with company match, three weeks PTO by the end of the first year and much more. Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
On any given day, every moment matters to someone, somewhere. And every moment, Motorola Solutions’ innovations, products and services play essential roles in people’s lives. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. We keep utility workers connected and visible to each other with real-time voice and data communication across the smart grid. And we provide the situational awareness first responders need when a moment brings catastrophe. We help people be their best in their moments that matter when everyone around them is at their worst.

Guardian is a call taking & dispatching platform used by emergency service operators across the UK & Europe. We help 999 or 112 operators answer calls from the public and dispatch out nearby responders, enabling the right response when every second counts, and ultimately helping our customers save lives.

As our solution has grown from a small start-up to one of the leading offerings for Fire & Police agencies, our customers now trust us to solve more of their problems. The Guardian team is distributed across the UK. We currently have around 150 employees. We have a relaxed but hard working environment where jeans and t-shirts are the norm and good ideas and debate are encouraged. Our daily work is remote, with workflows managed via Google Chat & collaborative documents in G-Suite. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.



Job Overview

We are seeking a motivated and talented Forward Deployed Engineer Intern to work on real-world problems that contribute directly to the development of our autonomous surface vessels. You will gain hands-on experience in software development, testing, and integration, and work alongside experienced engineers to tackle complex challenges in autonomy, sensor fusion, and real-time processing. This role blends software development, field deployment, and problem-solving to ensure our technology delivers real mission impact.

 

This internship is ideal for students pursuing computer science, software engineering, electrical and computer engineering, or a related field, and eager to make an impact on the front line of maritime autonomy. All interns will be supported and mentored by experienced Forward Deployed Engineers.



Responsibilities 

 - Design, implement, and test software components for autonomous systems, including navigation algorithms, sensor integration, and communication protocols

 - Collaborate with the team to develop and optimize algorithms for real-time decision-making, path planning, and object detection

 - Assist in the development of testing frameworks and participate in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to validate software performance in simulated and real-world environments

 - Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, and networking issues that arise during deployments

 - Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, including design specifications, user manuals, and test plans

 - Work closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, to ensure seamless integration of software with hardware components



Qualifications

 - Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a related field

 - Programming skills in Python, C++, Typescript, Javascript, or Rust

 - Basic understanding of robotics principles, autonomous systems, and sensor technologies

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

 - Willingness to travel, spending time in the field testing and improving ASV systems in real-world maritime settings

 - This role requires full-time in office presence (40 hours/week) based at our headquarters in Austin, TX, from May through August 2027
   
   

Physical Demands

 - Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

 - Occasional standing and walking within the office

 - Manual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment

 - Visual acuity to read screens, documents, and reports

 - Occasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office supplies

 - Lifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT SEQUENCE

We are in the midst of the intelligence revolution. 

In some industries, a startup will emerge from this period as a leader. In others, the incumbent will be vastly advantaged. We believe the opportunity is exponential when existing competitive attributes are paired with the power of AI.

Sequence acquires ambitious, established enterprises in the service economy and refounds them as market leaders. We bring capital, engineering and operational expertise to each business we partner with.

Our engineers work shoulder to shoulder with management teams to reimagine their business around what is now possible with AI. We rebuild operations, workflows, products and services from the ground up.

At the center is Atlas, our proprietary technology platform, which is deployed across every Sequence company. What we build and learn from one business strengthens Atlas for the next, creating a compounding advantage that accelerates every new refounding.

We elevate, not replace, human talent and judgment. We build and expand businesses to define what's possible for their industries.

Sequence is based in New York City and backed by 8VC, Conviction, Lux Capital and other strategic partners.




THE ROLE

Engineering interns at Sequence work on the same problems as the full-time team — there are no intern projects here. You'll deploy into our operating companies to rebuild real workflows with AI, and build the platform infrastructure that makes every future transformation faster. You'll ship production systems that real operators depend on daily, and contribute to Atlas — the agent infrastructure, data systems, and developer tools that make the refounding motion repeatable across the portfolio.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Exceptional builder. Can turn ambitious ideas into simple, reliable products.

 - Demonstrated track record of impressive academic, professional, or entrepreneurial accomplishments.

 - Raw horsepower and tenacity. Will run through walls to deliver results.

 - Proven ability to build from zero to one.

 - Strong communicator. Can explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience and translate operator frustrations into system designs.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. Can figure out what to build first when nothing is well-defined.

 - Customer-Centric: We have two customers: our portfolio companies, and the customers they serve. We succeed only when our customer’s customer does. Our job is to make our operating companies better at serving theirs.

 - Stewardship: We inherit decades of someone else's work and trust. Respect it, understand it, then build on it. The goal is to make it the best it has ever been.

 - Integrity: Our currency is trust. Everything we want comes through reputation: the next deal, the next hire, the next capital partner. Do the right thing, especially when no one is watching; reputation compounds faster than revenue and cannot be rebought.

General Information
Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, PLF battles for freedom in the nation’s courts and the court of public opinion.
 
As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. Interns work remotely by default, but they can request to work physically in any of PLF’s offices. This is a part-time role.
 
You: An inquisitive, creative, and self-motivated college junior, senior, grad student, or recent graduate who knows the principles of liberty and seeks to advance them. You have strong written and oral communication skills and enjoy problem solving.
 
Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources.
 
Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation (PLF) is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the US Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 20 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. At PLF, we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.
 
The Strategic Research intern will be a member of the Strategic Research team. This team produces high-quality social science research to support PLF’s mission-driven goals. The team coordinates with PLF’s Litigation, Legal Policy, Constitutional Scholarship, and Communications teams. This internship is an opportunity for a wide variety of experiences, including the following:
 
·      Communicating with public officials to obtain public records.
·      Collecting, organizing, and analyzing data using Microsoft Excel, R, Python, GIS, or Stata.
·      Conducting literature reviews on such topics as regulatory reform, housing supply, property rights, coastal land rights, and more.
·      Developing internal data for litigation, communications, or legal policy campaigns.
·      Writing blog posts, op-eds, or one-pagers on topics relevant to PLF’s work.

About Us:
Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

Role Overview:
This is a project-focused internship for an AI engineer embedded on the DevOps team. You will report to the DevOps lead and partner with internal technology teams. The work centers on internal, production-adjacent tooling—not training or shipping customer-facing ML models.

Core Internship Projects:

• Generative assistant for alert response

• Learn our observability stack and what data exists today e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry.

• Prototype a generative agent that uses approved observability sources to propose structured mitigation suggestions for alerts (hypothesis, checks, likely causes, safe next steps), with traceability back to queries, dashboards, or signals where possible.

• Retrieval on internal data (RAG)

• Build and iterate on RAG over permissioned internal data sources (e.g. runbooks, tickets, docs, system design, network design, postmortems) so suggestions and Q&A are grounded and citeable.

• Work with teams to improve coverage and quality of that corpus (metadata, ownership, freshness).

• Path toward agentic remediation (design + scoped implementation)

• Outline how the system could execute approved remediations behind explicit guardrails and human approval.

• Implement only what is allowed and under review—no autonomous production changes without platform sign-off.

• Broader internal Q&A

• Explore how additional internal, permissioned firm data can support natural language questions for engineers.

• Across all phases, permissioning, auditing, logging, and cost controls are non-negotiable requirements, not stretch goals.

Responsibilities:

• Design and prototype agent workflows with tool use, policy boundaries, and human-in-the-loop where appropriate.

• Collaborate with platform and service teams to make more observability and operational context available in a safe, governed way for agents.

• Document experiments, limitations, evaluation approach, and safety assumptions; ship changes via Git (branches, merge requests, meaningful commits).

Requirements:

• Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

• Expected to graduate by Summer 2028

• Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. LLM APIs, assistants, or coding agents) in real projects; preferably experience building an agent (tools, orchestration, or similar—not only prompt-only chat).

• Experience with RAG (retrieval design, chunking, evaluation, grounding, or production-minded prototyping)—including applying it to real or simulated internal/knowledge-base style data, not only public tutorials.

• Python for prototyping and integration; comfortable consuming and creating APIs and working with JSON; able to understand YAML for configs.

• Git workflow: branches, merge requests, meaningful commit messages.

• Strong judgment on data handling: no secrets in prompts/logs, minimize sensitive data, follow internal policies.

Preferred Skills:

• Linux fundamentals (shell, processes, logs, permissions, basic troubleshooting).

• Networking basics: DNS, TCP/HTTP/S, ports, load balancing vs Ingress at a conceptual level.

• Kubernetes fundamentals: debugging, pods, services, ingress Coursework or projects involving Kubernetes, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CI/CD, Terraform/Ansible, or cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).

Compensation Range: $40.00-$50.00 per hour

DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Product Research Intern
jobs.description:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.
The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.
Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.
For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.
Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.


ABOUT THE TEAM
The Product Research team sits at the intersection of theoretical computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, and software engineering. The team turns research and algorithms into practical product capabilities that help organizations use data safely and effectively.
As a Product Research Intern, you’ll work with research scientists and collaborate with software engineers and other teammates. You’ll help explore how ideas developed in a controlled research setting can be tested, adapted, and applied in the messy, real-world environments where customers use Immuta. The work is research-oriented: you’ll go deep on a problem, understand how an approach works, and help move it from an idea into something practical.


YOUR INTERNSHIP

At Immuta, interns are treated like members of the team. You’ll join the team’s regular workflow, contribute to real work, and take on responsibilities that reflect your skills and the team’s priorities.

The exact projects will depend on what the team is working on next summer, but you can expect to:

• Explore a set of potential research and product projects, then spend meaningful time developing one project related to the team’s work.

• Work with research scientists to investigate approaches that could support Immuta product capabilities.

• Translate mathematical, statistical, or computational ideas into prototypes, experiments, and functional software.

• Apply research methods to practical problems involving data privacy, security, governance, machine learning, algorithms, or text analytics.

• Evaluate approaches using data, experiments, measurements, and clear reasoning.

• Collaborate with researchers, engineers, product teammates, and others to understand how research can become useful product work.

• Communicate your process and findings through documentation, reports, presentations, and conversations with teammates.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Depending on your role, you may work with:

• Python

• TypeScript

• SQL and databases

• Algorithms, statistics, and machine learning methods

• Text analytics and classification approaches

• APIs and application development workflows

• Data analysis, experimentation, and measurement

• AI-enabled tools and workflows used by your team

You do not need to know every tool listed above. We’re looking for a strong foundation, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• A strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or another quantitative field.

• Experience with research, a substantial independent project, or working with a professor is a plus.

• Programming experience and interest in applying technical skills to data and research problems.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain your work clearly.

• Curiosity, initiative, and interest in turning research into practical solutions.
At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes:
100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners)
Stock Options
Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity)
Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions)
Learning and Development Resources

Immuta complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.
 
NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS: Immuta does not accept candidates from third party recruiters. All candidates submitted through are considered to be submissions by the candidate and no submission will obligate Immuta to pay any third party for the referral or hiring of a candidate.
 
AI NOTICE: As part of our hiring process, Immuta may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support recruiting activities, such as application review and interview coordination. These tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human decision-making. To protect the privacy of all participants and the confidentiality of Immuta information discussed during interviews, candidates may not use external recording tools, AI meeting assistants, or third-party transcription platforms during interviews unless approved in advance by Immuta. If you require an accessibility accommodation or assistance during the interview process, please contact us in advance so we can support your needs appropriately. For more information on how we process your personal data, please visit our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants.

You’ll have the opportunity to understand how a product works across the stack, from the user experience and application layer to the services and systems behind it.


YOUR INTERNSHIP

At Immuta, interns are treated like members of the team. You’ll join the team’s regular workflow, contribute to real work, and take on responsibilities that reflect your skills and the team’s priorities.

The exact projects will depend on what the team is working on next summer, but you can expect to:

• Join the Full-Stack Engineering team as an engineer, rather than working on a separate intern-only project.

• Build, test, improve, and maintain software that supports Immuta’s product.

• Work across parts of the product stack, including user-facing experiences, application services, APIs, and backend systems.

• Collaborate with teammates to understand problems, explore solutions, and build things that are useful to customers.

• Develop your skills through the team’s normal engineering workflow, including coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and collaboration.

• Explore how AI and agent-based capabilities can be used to build better software and product experiences.

• Take ownership of well-scoped work, communicate your progress, and ask questions when you need context or support.

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Depending on your role, you may work with:

• JavaScript or TypeScript

• Web application frameworks and user-facing product experiences

• Node.js or other backend services

• APIs and data-driven application workflows

• Testing, debugging, version control, and code review workflows

• AI-enabled tools and workflows used by your team

You do not need to know every tool listed above. We’re looking for a strong foundation, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• A foundation in software engineering and experience with at least one programming language.

• A clear interest in building things and solving practical problems.

• Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn new technologies.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Experience beyond coursework, such as an internship, hackathon, side project, or other extracurricular experience, is a plus.

• Interest in JavaScript, AI, or building agent-based applications is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders.

Why This Role Matters

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will help build the user interfaces and backend software systems that allow engineers, scientists and operators to run the fusion demonstration facility. You will work closely with controls engineers, scientists, and operators to develop software that presents real-time system state, manages configuration and data, and supports safe facility operations.

What You'll Do

• Develop and improve web-based user interfaces for:

• System status and health monitoring

• Experiment or facility configuration

• Alerts, events, and diagnostics

• Assist in building backend services that:

• Serve real-time and historical facility data

• Manage configuration, metadata, and system state

• Interface with controls systems and data pipelines

• Support integration between:

• UI applications, backend APIs, and facility systems

• Write clear, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews

• Help test, debug, and validate software used in live environments

What You Bring

• Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Junior, Senior, or graduate student preferred)

• Coursework or experience in:

• Software development fundamentals

• Web or backend programming

• Familiarity with at least one of:

• TypeScript / JavaScript

• Go or Python

• Basic understanding of:

• Client–server applications

• APIs and data flow

• SQL and NoSQL Databases

Additional Requirements:

• Able to work full time, onsite for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning in Mid May- Mid June 2027

Bonus Points For

• Experience with:

• React or other modern UI frameworks

• REST or event-based API

• Git and collaborative development

• Interest in:

• Industrial systems, automation, or controls

• Data visualization or real-time systems

• Exposure to:

• Containers (Docker)

• Time-series or telemetry data

• 6+ months of a previous internship, co-op, or academic project experience outside of normal classes

• GPA of 3.5 or above 

• Basic experience with CAD Software, MATLAB, Python, or Excel

What We Offer

• Real resume building engineering experience

• Mentorship from experienced engineering professionals

• Exposure to the full product development lifecycle

• A collaborative and learning-focused work environment

• Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks provided 

• An unforgettable summer!

$30—$48 USD

TOTAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS FOR ELIGIBLE EMPLOYEES

Industry-competitive salary

• 
Equity plan

• 
6% employer 401k matching

Generous paid time off (including sick leave, vacation, paid family leave)

Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
